/de——/dezhing reg na rtsub pa dang / lus kyi mdog sngo bsangs su gyur cing / 'brum bu dmar po 'thon pa dang / 1rnams yin te/ rnam pa 'di dag thams cad tshang bar gyur na gsor mi rung ngo / /tshad par gyur na gso dka' bar bshad de/glo bur gyi rims ni/ nasems 'khrug pa'i gdung ba las mkhris pa'i rims tsha bar 'gyur te/ de yang 'dod pa dang / mya ngan dang / 'jigs pa dang / khro ba rnams sems 'khrug mkhris pa dang / bad kan gsum gang byung ba las rims su gyur pa de dag so so'i mtshan mas bstan to/ /rims nad gso ba'i thabs ni/ rims thog ma byung ma thag tu nyams stobs la mi gnod par smyung ba'i cho ga bya'o/ /de la rlung dang ngal ba dang / khro ba dang / mya ngan dang / lud pa lu ba dang / glo rdol ba rnams la rims su gyur pa la ni smyung ba'i cho ga mi bya'o/ /smyung bar bya ba'i tshad ni bkres shing skom par gyur pa dang /phyi sa dang gcin tshul bzhin du 5ra'abyung bar gyur pa dang / lus yang bar gyur na smyung ba'i cho ga legs pa yin no/ /smyung ba'i cho ga ha cang drags na ni skem pa'i nad dang / stom pa dang / mgo 'khor ba dang / dbugs mi bde ba dang / ngal ba'i nad du 'gyur ro/ /de la bad kan dang rlung gi rims la ni/skom du chu skol ba dron po blud do/ /mkhris pa dang tsha ba /dang dug las gyur pa'i rims la ni skom du ro kha ba skol ba'i khu ba grang mo blud do/ /bca' sga dang /ba le ka dang / ldum bu skra lo dang / pu shel tse dang / gla sgang dang tsan dan rnams skol ba'i khu ba grang mo blud na yang skom pa dang skyug pa dang /rims dang / lus tsha ba sel to/ /sgyung ba'i cho ga byas pa'i rjes la/ kha zas smin pa ni rlung dang mkhris pa dang bad kan so so'i tshos par byed pa'i sman 720 494

gang yin pa'i khu ba las gzhi blangs pa'i thug pa phan zhing 'phrod par blud do/ /yang na 'bras yos btags pa'i thug pa sba ba bca' sgas btab pa blud do/ /yang na rlung gi rims la ni/ sā ①lu'i chan ri dwags dang ri bya'i sha khu bcad ②dang bcas pa sbyin no/ /des zhi bar ma gyur na/ zhag bdun lon pa'i 'og tu tshos par byed pa'i sman dang zhi bar byed pa'i sman blud do/ /zhag bdun gyi snga rol rims gsar bu byung ba'i tshe/ sman btang ba ni sman de nyid kyis nad gzhi shin tu skyed par byed de①/ de la rlung las gyur pa'i rims la ni tshos par byed pa'i sman bilba la sogs pa rtsa ba lnga skol ba'i khu ba blud do/ /yang na pi pi ling gi rtsa ba dang / sle tres dang / bca' sga rnams lhan cig skol ba'i khya ba blud do/ /yang na sle tres dang / gla sgang dang / bye tsher dudang / bca' sga rnams lhan cig skol ba'i khu ba blud do/ /yang na skyu ru ra dang / gla sgang dang / rtsa ba lnga pa dang / sle tres dang / 'u su'i 'bras bu rnams lhan cig skol ba'i khu ba blud do/ /yang na rtsa mkhris dang / gla sgang dang / sle tres dang / pa la ka dang / thra ha tī rnam gnyis dang / gze ma rnams lhan cig skol ba'i khu ba blud do/ /yang na sbi ra dang / ka le (peshi dang / bca' sga rnams lhan cig skol ba'i khu ba blud na rlung nad la phan no/ /yang na thal tres dang / pi pi ling dang / rgun dang / shu ti'i 'bras bu dang / ha re nu ka dhirnams lhan cig skol ba'i khu ba blud do/ /yang na thang shing dang /khrukṣa da ni dang / sman ra sna dang / sgon shing dang / e la ba lu ka rnams lhan cig skol ba'i khu ba blud do/ /yang na/ sle tres dang / e shu ma ti dang /rgun dang pa tya la ka rnams lhan cig skol ba'i khya ba blud do/ /yang na ra sna dang /120—495

shing mngar dang / dong ka dang / tai pa la dang / shal ma li dang / ba la rnams lhan cig skol ba'i khu ba blud do/ /yang na khye lce ba dang / rgan dang shi ri sar ni dang / thal tres dang / sle tres rnams lhan cig skol ba'i khu ba blud do/ /'di rnams ni rlung las gyur pa'i rims sel bar byed do/ /gong nas thal tres zhes sgos pa man chad kyi sbyor ba lnga po 'di dag kun gyi khu ba ni bu ram dang sbyar bar bya'o/ /mkhris pa las gyur pa'i rims la ni/ tshos par byed pa'i sman sgyu ru ra dang / rgun dang / ba la ka dang / rtsa mkhris rnams lhan cig skol ba'i khu ba blud do/ /yang na pu tse shel dang / rgun dang /nisba dang / shing mngar rnams lhan cig skol ba'i khu ba blud ①do/ /yang na am bra dang / rtsa mkhris pa dang / bye tsher pa dang / sro sdelo rnams lhan cig skol ba'i khya ba blud do/ /yang na dug mo nyung dang / pu tse shel dang /gla sgang dang / shing mngar rnams lhan cig skol ba'i khu ba blud do/ /yang na seng ①phrom dang / me tog utpa la dang / padma dang / thal tres dang /sle tres rnams lhan cig skol ba'i khu ba kha ra dang sbyar ba'am/ yang na sro ④lo skol ba'i khu ba grang ba blud na mkhris pa'i rims sel to/ /yang na khye lce ba dang /sro ⑤lo dang / ba la ka dang / pu tse shel dang / rtsa mkhris dang / byi tsher rnams lhan cig tu skol ba'i khu ba bsgrangs pa sbrang rtsi dang sbyar zhing blud na mkhris pa'i rims sel to/ /yang na pu tse shel dang / rtsa mkhris dang / byi tsher rnams lhan cig skol ba'i khu ba bsgrangs pa sbrang rtsi dang sbyar te blud na mkhris pa'i rims sel to/ /yang na pu tse shel dang / katpal dang / dug mo nyung dang /gla sgang rnams lhan cig skol ba'i khu ba blud do/ /yang na gong du sman gyi sde tshan dhi120—496

bshad pa'i skabs nas smos pa/ thal tres la sogs pa'i sde tshan ①dang /utpal la sdesogs pa'i sde tshan gnyis so sor skol ba'i khya ba kha ra dang sbyar ba so sor blud do/ /yang na gla sgang dang / a ru ra dang / rgun dang / pu tse shel dang / dong ka dang / sro ①lo rnams lhan cig skol ba'i khu ba blud do/ /yang na pu tse shel btags te kha ra dang sbyar te btang na mkhris pa'i rims nad sel to/ /yang na pu tse shel dang / byi tsher dang / rtsa mkhris dang / rtsa shya ma dang / sro ④lo dang / ba sha ka rnams lhan cig bskol ⑤te bsgrangs pa'i khu ba kha ra dang sbyar te blud na khrag dang mkhris pa las gyur pa'i rims sel to/ /bad kan las gyur pa'i rims la ni/ tshos par byed pa'i kha lung gi rtsa ba dang /bca' sga dang / sle tres dang / pi pi ling gi rtsa ba rnams lhan cig skol ba'i khu ba nas tshig 'khus pa'i thal ba dang sbyar ba'am/ yang na pi pi ling la sogs pa'i sde tshan sngar bstan pa rnams skol ba'i khu ba nas tshig 'khus pa'i thal ba dang sbyar ba blud do/ /yang na pu tse shel dang / a ru ra dang / dbyi mong gedang /thang shing dang / yung rnams lhan cig skol ba'i khu ba blud do/ /yang na am ba ta dang / pu tse ⑦shel dang / murba dang / a rañdza dang / a ri ta dang /ku la ka rnams lhan cig skol ba'i khya ba blud do/ /yang na bca' sga dang /bong nga dkar po dang / ru rta dang / thang shing dang / byi tsher dang / gla sgang rnams lhan cig skol ba'i khya ba blud do/ /yang na tsha ba gsum zhes bya ba/bca' sga dang / pi pi ling dang / na le sham rnams dang / sman nag ta ma la dang / shi ri paṇi dang / sgon shing dang / sle tres rnams lhan cig skol ba'i khu ba blud do/ /yang na nā ga ge sar dang / yung dang / skyer pa dang /120 497

tsha ba gsum dang / pu tse shel dang / dug mo nyung lhan cig skol ba'i khu ba blud do/ /yang na bca' sga dang / byi tsher dang / pa sha ka dang / gla sgang rnams lhan cig skol ba'i khu ba blud do/ /yang na dong ga dang / dug mo nyung gi shun lpags dang / murba dang / bye'u rug pa dang / ke'u ka rnams lhan cig skol ba'i khu ba blud do/ /sman gyi sbyor ba bdun po 'di dag kyang bad kan gyi rims sel to/ /yang na nim pa dang / bca' sga dang / sle tres ①dang /thang shing dang / li zung ba dang / rtsa mkhris dang / ma ru dang / pi pi ling dang / thra ha tī rnams lhan cig skol chaba'i khu ba blud na bad kan gyi rims sel to/ /yang na sapta paṇi dang / sle tres dang / nim pa dang /stag ma rnams lhan cig skol ba'i khu ba bsgrangs ①pa sbrang rtsi dang sbyar te blud na bad kan gyi rims sel bar byed do/ /rlung dang mkhris pa gnyis 'dus pa'i rims la ni tshos par byed pa'i sman/ kaṇḍa ka ri dang / ba la dang / ra sna dang / khye lce ba dang / sle tres dang / rtsa shya ma rnams skol ba'i khu ba blud na sel bar byed do/ /yang na 'bras bu gsum dang / sha ma li dang / ra sna dang / dong ka dang / ba shi rnams lhan cig skol 4ba'i khu ba blud na/ rlung dang mkhris pa las gyur pa'i rims myur du sel to/ /yang na shing mngar dang /thal tres dang / rgun dang / tsan dan dang / me tog ma bhu peka dang /utpa la dang / tai pa la dang / shug pa dang / seng phrom dang / 'bras bu gsum dang / padma'i ze ba dang / ba ru sha ka dang / pu shel tse rnams chu bzang po'i nang du bskol te bsgrangs la zhag lon 6par byas pa'i nang du/'bras so brngos la phub ma bsal te btags pa dang / sbrang rtsi dang / kha ra 720 7/()8

dang sbyar te blud na/ rlung dang mkhris pa'i rims dang / lus tsha ba dang /skom pa'i nad dang / brgyal ba dang / skyug bro ba dang / mgo 'khor ba dang / khrag lud pa'i nad rnams sel te ①sprin la rlung bab pa bzhin no/ /rlung dang bad kan gnyis 'dus pa las gyur pa'i rims la ni/ tshos par byed pa'i sman pi pi ling dang / rgun lhan cig tu skol ba'i khu ba bsgrangs te sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba blud do/ /yang na dong ka la sogs pa'i sman gyi sde tshan sngar bstan pa rnams lhan cig tu skol ba'i khya ba go snyod btab (gepa dang bu ram dang sbyar te blud do/ /yang na thang shing dang / sro lalo dang / bgi dang / gla sgang dang / shu dag dang / 'u su'i 'bras bu dang / katpal/ a ru ra dang /bca' sga dang / rtsa ( bu ti ka rnams lhan cig tu skol ba'i khu ba'i nang du/shing kun dang / sbrang rtsi shas bskyed de sbyar ba 'thungs na/ bad kan dang /rlung gi rims dang / sprigs bu dang / dbugs mi bde ba dang / sgog nad lha gor dang / lud pa dang / skem pa'i nad dang / mchil 5 ma mang du 'byung ba rnams sel to/ /shing la thog shog 'bab pa bzhin no/ /bad kan dang mkhris pa gnyis 'dus pa las gyur pa'i rims la ni/ tshos par byed pa'i sman shing mngar dang / ba la dang / a rishā dang / pa to la dang /'bras bu gsum dang / 'di rnams lhan cig skol ba'i khu ba 'thungs na myur du sel bar byed do/ /yang na yung dang skyer ma dang / gla sgang dang / pu shel tse dang / shing mngar dang dong ga rnams lhan cig skol ba'i khu ba bsgrangs te/sbrang rtsi dang sbyar te blud na/ bad kan dang / mkhris pa'i rims med par byed do/ /nad gzhi rlung dang / mkhris pa dang / bad kan gsum char 720 4 99

'dus pa las gyur pa'i rims gso ba'i thabs ni/ gnyis shas che la gcig shas chung na gang shas chung ba de'i stobs bskyed par bya'o/ /gcig shas che la gnyis shas chung na gang shas che ba'i stobs dbri bar bya'o/ /yang na gang shas chung ba de'i stobs bskyed par bya ste/ de ltar shas che chung mi mnyam pa la ni/mdor na gang shas che ba'i stobs ni dbri/ gang shas chung ba'i stobs ni bskyed de—/ ci nas kyang stobs mnyam zhing cha mthun par bya'o/ /gsum char shas mnyam du 'khrug pa la ni/ thog mar bad kan gzhil ba'i cho ga bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu mkhyes pa gzhil ba'i cho ga bya'o/ /de nas rlung gzhil ba'i cho ga bya ste/de lta bu'i tshul gyis nad gzhi gsum las gyur pa'i rims gzhom par bya'o/ /de la gsum 'dus pa'i rims la ni tshos par byed pa'i sman dha ma ka dang / 'bras bu gsum dang / thang shing dang / shug pa dang / tsan dan dang / pu shel tse dang / pu tse shel dang / shing pa ru sha ka rnams lhan cig skol ba'i khu ba blud do/ /yang na rtsa ba gsum dang / gla sgang dang / 'bras bu gsum dang / pu tse shel dang / pa to la dang / ha ri sta dang / dug mo nyung dang / rtsa mkhris dang / sle tres dang / pa ta rnams lhan cig skol ba'i khu ba yang nad gzhi gsum las gyur pa'i rims sel to/ /gsum 'dus pa'i rims de'i mjug tu sna drung du skrangs par gyur na de ni gso dka' ba yin te/gtar te khrag dbyung ba dang / sman gyis bsku ba dang / mar btung bas gzhil bar bya'o/ /nad gzhi gsum 'dus pas lus dang ngag dang sems kyi spyod pa rnams ro bzhin du bya ba mi byed par bsdus nas/ srog la thug pa'i nad ror 'byin pa zhes bya ba skyed par byed do/ /①ror 'byin pa'i nad de mi la 120—500

thebs par gyur na/ shi ba'i khongs su bcug ste/ so shi bsngo bar dam bcas nas—/ snod chur bying ba snyeg ①pa bzhin du/ bang bya stod la myur du ④nyams su blang zhing gso bar bya'o/ /de la gso ba'i thabs ni/ shing tog kha lung gi khu ba shing kun dang / bca' sga dang / sman ro tsha ba dang / kha ba dang /rno sneb dag dang sbyar ba'i khu ba btsags pa slar dran par ma gyur gyi bar du khar blugs so/ /shing ma dhu ka'i snying po dang / rgyam tsha dang / shu dag dang /na le sham dang / pi pi ling rnams cha mnyam la chu'i nang du bdar te btsags nas snar blugs na yang slar dran par 'gyur ro/ /shi ri sha'i 'bras bu dang /pi pi ling dang / na le sham dang / rgyam tsha dang / skyer khaṇḍa dang / bye sku dang / ldong ros dang / shu dag rnams cha mnyam la ba gcin gyi nang du bdar te btsags nas rjomig tu bskus na yang dran par 'gyur ro/ /gang cho ga de ltar byas te/ /yang na slar dran par gyur pa de ni 'phral ba'am/ rkang pa gnyis kyi rting par lcags kyi thur mas bsreg go/ /bya gi dang / byi tsher dang /bha gi dang / li zur ba dang / bu bran shing dang / ma nu rnams lhan cig skol ba'i khu ba 'thungs na yang / bad kan dang / ror 'byin pa'i nad rims rmang ⑤du zhi bar byed do/ /kha lung dang / shing ska rjosma bhi dang /bilba dang / bya 1 dang / pā thā dang / e raṇḍa'i rtsa ba rnams skol ba'i khu ba lan tshwa dang ba gcin dang sbyar te blud na yang ror 'byin pa'i nad dang / lto sbo zhing ⑦rtul ba'i nad sel to/ /ka ra bi dang / ma nu dang / e raṇḍa'i rtsa ba dang / khyi lce ba dang / ba sha ka dang / sle tres dang / sngar bshad pa'i rtsa ba lnga pa chen po zhes bya ba bilba la sogs pa dang / rtsa ba lnga pa chung ngu zhes bya 120—501

———ba thraṇḍa 1paṇi la sogs pa dang / lnga tshan ṭache chung gnyis bsdus pa'i ming ni/rtsa ba bcu pa zhes / ste/ bcu po de dag dang / li zur ba dang / bu bran shing dang / byi tsher dang / bhagi dang / pu na sna ba dang / 'di rnams cha mnyam la ba gcin gyi nang du bskol te 'thungs na yang dran pa sor chud par 'gyur zhing / ror 'byin pa zhes bya ba'i rims tshabs chen po dang / ngal ba'i nad tshabs chen po yang myur du sel bar byed do/ /ka raṇḍa )dang / kru trug tres dang / btsod dang / khye lce ba dang / bilba dang / ku la ka dza dang / bṛ ha tī rnam gnyis dang / ka ra (pebī dang / tsha ba gsum dang /'di rnams skol ba'i khu ba 'thungs na yang / ror 'byin pa'i nad kyi rkyen gyis mid pa 'gags shing sgra ngar ngar por gyur pa yang sel bar byed do// //da ni rims ldang dub kyi dus mi 'dra bar bshad de/ dwangs ma la sogs pa lus zungs bdun gyi gnas rnams rlung la sogs pa nad gzhi gsum po rnams zhugs pa las rims ldang dub can du gyur te/ de yang rgyun chags kyi rims dang / rtag pa'i rims 6 dang / nyin re ba'i rims nyi ma gnyis shing lan gcig gi /ldang ba'i rims dang / nyi ma gsum zhing lan gcig ldang ba'i rims dang //8 rnam pa lngar gyur te de dag gso ba'i thabs ni/ tshos par byed pa'i sman shing nim pa dang / a ru ra dang / sle tres dang / gla sgang dang /pa to la dang / dug mo nyung gi ḍa'abras bu rnams cha mnyam ste lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / khye lce ba dang / pu tse shel dang / pa tha dang / thal tres rnam gnyis dang / 'di rnams cha mnyam ste lhan cig sbyar ba dang / pa to la dang /72()— 502

a rishā dang / rgun dang / dong ga dang / 'bras bu gsum dang / pa tha sha ka sha mas cha mnyam ste lhan cig sbyar ba dang / tsan dan dkar po dang /pu shel tse dang / 'u su'i 'bras bu dang / gla sgang dang / sle tres dang /bca' sga rnams cha mnyam ste lhan cig sbyar ba dang / thang shing dang / sbi ra dang / bca' sga dang / ba sha ka dang / skyu ru ra dang / a ga tsaru rnams cha mnyam ste lhan cig sbyar '-ib dang / sman gyi sbyor ba lnga po 'di dag so sor skol ba'i khu ba bsgrangs pa'i nang du sbrang rtsi dang sha kha ras bskyed de sbyar ba so sor 'thungs na/ sman gyi sbyor ba re res gong du smos pa'i rims nad rnam pa lnga po re re sel bar byed do / /①rims nad kyi grangs dang sman gyi sbyor ba'i grangs kyi go rim bzhin du so sor sbyar ro/ /yang na rims lnga po re re zhing yang sman gyi sde tshan ( lnga char gyis so so nas sel bar yang bshad do/ /de ltar tshos par byed pa'i cho ga bshad nas/ rims nad can gyi khong na nad gzhi tshos par gyur pa na gnas pa beer ma phyin na yang gnod pa chen por gyur te/ de bas na khong na nad gzhi tshos par gyur pa dang / tshos par ma gyur pa yod pa/nyams 5stobs dang dus dang nad las dpags te ci rigs par bkru sman gyis dbyung bar bya'o/ /de la bkru 6sman ni shing mngar dang / dong ga dang /rgyan dang / pu tse shel dang / pa tha dang / 'bras bu gsum dang /pa to la rnams lhan cig skol ba'i khu ba'i nang du/ a ru ra'i phye ma btab pa ni bkru 3bar byed de rims sel to/ /pa to la dang / dong ga dang / pu tse shel dang / bi shal dang / 'bras bu gsum dang / shing nye rang 8rnams skol ba'i khu ba nas tshig 'khus pa'i thal ba dang sbyar ba ni 'khru bar byed do/ //20 503

rims thams cad sbyong ngo / /pu tse shel dang / a ru ra dang / shing nye rong dang / darnyi'i rtsa ba dang / khyi lce ba dang / dong ga dang / nas tshig 'khus pa'i thal ba dang / mar dang / rgyam tsha rnams lhan cig skol ba'i khu ba yang 'khru bar byed de rims sel to/ /'bras bu gsum dang / pi pi ling dang / shing nye rong dang / rtswa byu ma rnams zhib tu btags la/ kha ra dang /sbrang rtsi dang sbrus te ri lur byas pa yang 'khru bar byed pa yin te/ 'dus pa'i rims dang / 'or nad skrangs pa ①dang / khrag lud pa'i nad sel to/ /rims rnying dang / bad kan zad par gyur pa la ni 'o ma bdud rtsi dang 'dra'o/ /rims gsar bu la ni de dug dang 'dra ste mi gsod par byed do/ /de la 'o ma gtang byeba'i thabs ni/ 'o ma rtsa ba lnga pa dang bskol te bsgrangs pa'am/yang na 'o ma chu bzhi 'gyur dang bskol te chu du bar byas pa'am/ yang na 'o ma shing sha pa'i snying po dang skol ba'am/ yang na 'o ma bzhos pa'i 'phro la dron po 'thungs na rims sel to/ /'o ma pi pi ling dang / shing mngar dang /rgun dang / ldum bu pa la dang / tsan dan dkar po dang / thal tres rnams dang lhan cig bskol te 'thungs na rims myur du sel to/ /'o ma shing bilba gzhon nu dang skol ba'am/ yang na e raṇḍa'i rtsa ba dang skol ba 'thungs na de ma thag tu gdug pa'i rims sel bar byed do/ /'o ma bu ram dang /bca' sga dang / ba la dang / byagi dang / gze ma dang lhan cig bskol te bsgrangs pa 'thungs na/ skrangs pa ③dang / rims dang / phyi sa dang /gcin 'gags pa zhi bar byed do/ /'o ma'i tshogs kyang ma slon te/ rims kyi drod kyis mdongs byamed par byas pa la ni gso ba'i thabs gzhan bya ste/ mar 120—504

khu nyi ①tshe'am/ yang mar sman dang skol ④ba'i me'i drod las dpags te btung bar bya'o/ /de la mar sman dang skol ba ni/ rgun dang skol ba'am/ yang na ba la dang skol ba'am/ yang na shing mngar dang skol ba'am/ yang na 'bras bu gsum dang skol ba'am/ yang na sle tres dang skol ba'i mar 'thungs na de ma thag tu rims sel bar byed do/ /ba sha ka chen po'i mar zhes bya ba ni/ shing ba sha ka dang / shing a ri shā dang / sle tres dang / bhagi dang / rtsa ba lnga pa dang / 'bras bu gsum dang / byi tsher dang / shing mngar dang / rgun dang / btang pa la rnams btags pa'i phye ma zho gnyis gnyis mar srang sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / chu mar kyi bzhi 'gyur dang bskol te chu du bar byas pa'i mar 'di'i ming ni ba sha ka chen po'i mar zhes bya ste/ de la tshod ran par 'thungs na rims thams cad sel to/ /ba sha ka chung ngu'i mar bya ba ni/ shing ba sha ka skol ba'i khu ba dang / ba sha ka nyid phye mar btags pa rnam pa gnyis kyis sgomar skol la sman gyi khu ba du bar byas te bsgrangs nas sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba'i ming ni ba sha ka chung ngu'i mar zhes bya ste/ de las tshod ran par 'thungs na/rims dang glo gcong chen po zad byed kyi nad dang / dbugs mi bde ba dang /lud pa dang / skya rbab dang / mkhris pa dang / khrag lud pa'i nad sel to/ /dge ba'i mar zhes bya ba ni/ ru rta dang / sug smel dang / rgya spos ④dang /bal bu dang / danta'i ⑪ rtsa ba dang / thang shing dang / e la ba lu ka dang /tsan dan dkar po dang / utpa la dang / btsod dang / bi sha la dang /bṛ ha tī rnam gnyis dang / yung dang / skyer pa dang / thal tres rnam gnyis dang / paṇi rnam gnyis dang / ha re nu ka dang / padma'i ze ba dang /120—505

—— —byi dong 1 ka dang / 'bras bu gsum dang / rtsa nashya ma dang / sri shing rna ma'i me tog dang / bal po se'u rnams cha mnyam ste/ zho gnyis gnyis zhib tu btags la mar srang sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / chu mar gyi bzhi 'gyur dang /lhan cig tu bskol nas/ chu du bar byas pa ni dge ba'i mar zhes bya ste/'di ni nyams stobs skyed )cing bzhin mdog bzang ba dang / bu mang bar byed la/ rims dang brjed byed dang ( / smyo byed dang / gcin snyi ba'i nad dang / skrangs pa 5)dang dug sel te/ dreg dang / skya rbab dang / skren —)dang / dbugs mi bde ba dang / skyigs bu 'ong ba dang / gcin 'gags pa drag po rnams kyang 'joms par byed do/ /dge ba chen po zhes bya ba'i mar ni/gong ma dge ba'i mar de dang / sman de dag nyid kyi steng du/ 'tsho byed ces bya ba'i sman sna bcu ste/ dzi ba ka dang / ri sha ba ka dang / me da dang /ma hā me da dang / bu tshad rto dang / ra mnye ba dang / muṅga paṇi dang /ka sha paṇi dang / dzi brnyi dang / shing mngar rnams dang / rtsa ba bcu sngar smos pa rnams kyis kyang bsnan la/ 'o ma mar gyi bzhi 'gyur gyi nang du bskol te / 'o ma du bar byas pa'i mar gyi ming ni dge ba chen po'i mar zhes bya ste nad do cog sel to/ /dug mo nyung dang / pu shel tse 8dang / ti ra dang /pu tse shel dang / tsan dan dkar po dang / bong nga dkar po dang / gla sgang dang / khye lce ba dang / thal tres dang / bilba dang / rgun dang / ta ma la ka dang / pi pi ling dang / skyu ru ra dang / bya byu dang / 'di rnams zhib tu btags te/ sngar phye ma'i sman sbyar ba'i thabs bstan pa bzhin du skol ba'i mar ni rims sel zhing / glo gcong chen po zad par byed pa da nga /72() 5()6

—/de/de— /de——/de/de —/de —————lus tsha ba dang / lud pa 'jam por byed de/ glo 'or dang klad pa na ba yang med par byed do/ /gla sgang dang / a ri sta dang / sbi ra dang / byi tsher dang / ba la dang / sro 1 lo dang / gze ma dang / khye lce ba dang / da pa ni dang / bya 1 dang ka la shi rnams lhan cig tu skol ba'i khu ba dang /mar gyi nang du phye ma'i sman ma nu dang / rgun dang / me da dang / skyu ru ra dang / dza da dang / danta'i 2rtsa ba rnams zhib tu btags pa'i phye ma skol la sman gyi khya ba du bar byas te btsags pa'i mar ni rims dang / glo gcong zad byed dang / lud pa dang / klad pa'i nad sel to/ /dpyad de dag gis kyang rims rnying thams cad la/ nad gzhi long ga na gnas pa ma phyin na/sman mar mas btang ba dang / bkru sman drag po mas btang ba gnyi ga cho ga bzhin du bya'o/ /de la sman mar mas btang ba ni/ tsan dan dkar po dang /me tog utpa la dang / ta pa la dang / shing mngar dang / a ka ru dang /ku la ka rnams dang / til mar dang / lhan cig skol ba mas btang na rims thams cad sel to/ /yang na pa to la dang / po son cha dang / a ri sta dang / sle tres dang / shing mngar rnams dang til mar lhan cig pa'i sman mar mas btang na des kyang rims sel to/ /yang na 'jam rtsi mas btang ba la phan pa zhes bya ba'i sman/ snya ba ni dang / pa shi ka dang / thang shing dang /sug smel dang / pa tha dang / ra sna dang / pa la dang / shu dag dang /dzi ba ka dang / zangs /rtsi ba dang / me da dang / me da chen po dang /ru rta dang / paṇi rnam gnyis dang / pi pi ling dang / sle tres dang / ga tha ma dang / po son cha dang / bu bran shing dang / shing mngar dang /720—— 507

a ri sta dang / ba sha ka dang / a shwa garnya rnams las zho gnyis gnyis zhib tu btags la/ til mar srang brgya nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / chu til mar gyi bzhi 'gyur dang / 'di rnams lhan cig tu skol la chu du bar byas nas btsags pa'i til mar 'di las tshod ran par mas btang na rims nad thams cad sel zhing /rlung nad tshabs ①chen po thams cad med par byed do/ /bkru sman drag po mas btang ba zhes bya ba ni/ pa to la'i rtsa ba dang / po son cha dang / pu tse shel dang / gze ma dang / dong ga dang / ster dang / ba la dang / a ri sha ①dang / gla sgang dang / pu shel tse ①rnams lhan cig tu 'o ma dang /chu 'o ma phyed kyi nang du skol la/ chu du bar byas te/ 'o ma nyi tshe lus pa bsgrangs la/ sbrang rtsi dang / mar dang sbyar ba'i nang du/ po son cha dang /gla sgang ④dang / pi pi ling dang / dug mo nyung dang / shing mngar rnams zhib tu btags pa'i phye ma dang sbyar ba 'di rims so cog bsal ba'i phyir mas btang na/ nad gzhi phyir 'byung zhing lus shin tu dag par 'gyur te de ma thag tu rims med par byed do/ /yang na bkru sman drag po mas btang ba ni/ po son cha dang / dong ga dang / pu tse shel dang / shing mngar dang / lo ma rnam ⑤bzhi zhes bya ba/ sa la brti dudang / bṛṇḍa baṇi dang / muṅga paṇi dang /ma sha paṇi rnams skol ba'i khu ba dron mo'i nang du/ rtswa ⑦shya ma'i rtsa ba dang /nye'u shing gi rtsa ba dang / gla sgang dang / shing mngar dang / po son cha rnams zhib tu btags pa'i phye ma dang / sbrang rtsi dang / mar dang bu ram sbyar ba ni bkru sman btang ba'i nang na mchog yin te/ btang ma thag tu rims rnying sgegi gnod pa thams cad sel to/ /yang na bkru sman drag po mas btang ba 120—508

ni| thraṇḍa baṇi dang / sbri ra dang / po son cha dang / ba la rnams skol ba'i khu ba dron mo'i nang du/ pi pi ling dang / po son cha dang / shing mngar dang / gla sgang rnams zhib tu btags pa'i phye ma dang / mar dang /sprang rtsi dang / sha ra'i khu ba dang / rgyam tsha bro ba tsam dang / 'di rnams sbyar te mas btang ①na rims sel cing yi ga 'bye ②ba dang / rngul phyin pa dang /nyams stobs skyed par ④byed do/ /sman mas btang ba'i cho ga 'di dag gi skabs su/ sman gyi tshad la sogs pa cho ga bzhin du ma sgos pa ni/ 'og nas las lnga'i le'u las rgyas par 'byung ngo / /rims ldang dub can gyis gnod par gyur pa la ni/ 'o ma skol ba pi pi ling gi phye ma dang sbyar te gzhan mi bsam par btung ngo / /yang na 'o ma skol ba'i nang du/ nyin re bzhin pi pi ling bcu bcur bskyed de btab pa 'thungs ④la/ pi pi ling gi grangs brgyar phyin nas slar yang nyin re bzhin bcu bcu bri ⑤ste btung bar bya'o/ /'o ma dang mar bskol te bsgrangs pa sbrang rtsi dang / kha ra dang / pi pi ling dang sbyar te dkrugs pa 'thungs na/ rims ldang dub can dang / snying na ba dang / glo rdol pa dang / lud pa dang / glo gcong zad byed kyi nad sel to/ /bilba'i phye zhun mar dang sbyar ba'am/ yang na dar ba dang sbyar ba'am yang na 'o ma dang /ba lang gi lce ba'i khu ba dang sbyar ba 'thungs na rims ldang dub can sel to/ /thog ma rims kyis 'debs par tshor ma thag tu ni mar khu mang du 'thungs la phyir skyug par bya'o/ /yang na rims kyis thog mar 'debs pa tshor ma thag tu dhi/kha zas 'grangs ⑦par zos la/ chang zhim po mang du 'thungs te nyal na 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /yang na shing kun dang / rgyam tsha dang / mar rnying pa 120—509

gsum sbyar te blugs so/ /yang na rims la/ ldong ros dang / pi pi ling dang / rgyam tsha rnams las 'bras kyi 'bru tsam re re zhib par ①til mar dang lhan cig btags te mig tu bsku'o/ /rims ldang dub can la ni/ nas dang /yungs kar dang / ru rta dang / nisba'i lo ma dang / rtsa ba pha chal sha dang /shu dag dang / a ru ra rnams cha mnyam ste/ zhun mar dang sbyar ①la bsregs te snar bdug par bya'o/ /yang na sa te dude ba dang / shu dag dang / gla sgang chen po dang / na khu li rnams btags te lhan cig tu sbyar ba bsregs te snar bdug go/ /yang rims zhi bar bya ba'i phyir sman de dag gong ma gnyis kyis lus bsku ba'am lus dril bar bya'o/ /shi ri sha dang / bilba dang / a mra dang / a dhid tha dang / a rdzu na rnams kyi lo ma dang / skye ba dang /skyer pa dang / 'di rnams btags la lhan cig tu sbyar te bsregs pas bdugs na yang rims so cog dang / gdon thams cad sel to/ /gu gul dang / dhya ma ka dang / shu dag dang / sra rtsi pog dang / nidza dang /arka dang / a ka ru dang / thang shing dang / 'di rnams lhan cig tu sbyar ba'i bdug pa 'di'i ming ni gzhan gyis ⑤mi thub pa zhes bya ste/ des bdugs na yang rims nad thams cad sel to/ /rgya skyegs kyi khu ba dang / til mar gnyis las srang sum cu rtsa gnyis gnyis dang / zho kha chu til mar gyi bzhi 'gyur gyi nang du/ a sho nagarnya dang / yung dang / thang shing dang / ha re nu ka ④ dang / ru rta dang / gla sgang dang / tsan dan dkar po dang / murba dang /spod 5na)dang / ra sna dang / shu ti dang / la phug rnams kyi phye ma lhan cig tu bskol te/ til mar 'ba' zhig lus pa'i ming ni rgya skyegs la sogs pa'i mar 120 510

zhes bya ste/ des lus bsku ba la sogs pa byas na rims so cog dang / zad byed kyi nad dang / smyo byed dang / dbugs mi bde ba dang / brjed byed dang / rlung sel cing / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / 'byung po 'joms par byed la/ sgrum ma rnams la yang dge ba yin no/ /mi mkhris pa'i nad drag pos btab nas ①lus shin tu tsha bar gyur pa la ni/ khong pa ④bsel zhing bser bu 'ong ba'i gnas su bzhag la/ bsil ba'i cho ga 'og nas 'byung ba 'di dag bya'o/ /de la bsil bar bya ba'i cho ga ni skyu ru ra mar gyi nang du brngos te btab ①pa'i phye ma rtsabs skyur pos 'dag gu byas pas lus la bskus na tsha ba zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /yang na chu'i sbra ba'am/ rgya shug gi lo ma brdungs te/rtsabs skyur bas dubatab pa'am/ nya phyibs shin tu bsel ba'am/ cwa drurba btags pa ⑤rtsabs skyur bas dhibatab pa'am/ 'dam shin tu bsel bas lus thams cad bsku bar bya'o/ /yang na sngar smos pa'i shing n+ya gro dha ⑦la sogs ④sman gyi sde tshan nam/ me tog utpal ⑨la sogs pa sman gyi sde tshan phye mar byas la/rtsabs sgyur po dang sbyar bas lus la bsku bar bya'o/ /yang na sman gyi sde tshan de gnyis las gang yang rung ba skol ba'i khu ba bsgrangs pa'i nang du/ tsha ba mi bzod pa'i mi nyid 'ju bar bya'o/ /yang na bu ram chang ngam/ rgun chang gi tsha'am— chang tham le ⑩pa'am/ rtsabs skyur ba'am/ 'o ma'i rgun lus la byug na yang tsha ba sel te bzang ngo / /shug pa dang / me tog utpal dang /ka lta ra dang / padma'i rtsa lag ⑪dang / le brgan rtsi 4)dang / pu shel tse dang / btsod dang / padma dang / btsag dang / ka tal dang / thal tres rnam gnyis dang / seng phrom dang / gla sgang dang / rgun dang / 'bra 120—511

go dang / tsan dan dkar po dang / skyu ru ra dang nye'u shing rnams lhan cig tu skol ba'i khu ba'i nang du/ sman de dag nyid kyi bye ma dang / rgya skyegs kyi khu ba dang / 'o ma dang / tsha dang / rtsabs kyi dwangs ma dang / zho kha chu dang til mar rnams blugs te bskol la til mar nyi tshe lus par byas la btsags ①pa 'di ni pags pa'i mdog bzang zhing / lus tsha ba dang / skom pa'i nad sel ba'i mchog yin te lus la bsku bar bya'o/ /ka ling ya ka dang / rgya shu ka ②dang /a darnya dang / shing mngar dang / btsag rnams btags la zhun mar dang sbyar te mgor bskus na yang skom pa'i nad dang / lus tsha ba'i gnod pa sel to/ /bal po se'u dang / rgya shug dang / seng phrom dang / dadhi tha dang / kha lung rnams btags pa zhun mar dang sbyar/ 'dis kyang skom ①pa'i nad dang lus tsha ba sel to/ /mgo bsku bar bya'o/ /padma'i lo ma dang / chu shing gi lo ma dang nyi snga rjoba'i steng du nyal la/ shing tā ⑤la'i lo ma tsan dan brdar rjoba'i khu ba'i nang du dmyugs pa'i bsil g.yob kyis g.yabs ⑦na yang lus tsha ba'i gnod ⑧pa sel to/ /rdzing bu'i me tog padma kha bye ba dang ldan pa'i phyogs sam/chu 'dren pa'i 'khrul 'khor yong ba'i phyogs su bsel khang bzang po byas pa'i nang du 'dug cing / bud med kyi lus tsan dan gyi 'dag gus byugs pas mthar sbyar na yang / lus tsha ba'i gnod pa sel to // //⑨da ni bad kan dang / rlung gi rims kyis thebs te/ grang bas nyen pa'i cho ga bshad de/ de ltar grang bas nyen pa la ni/ khyim dron po'i nang du 'dug la rngul gdon pa'i dugs bya zhing gos phyi ba la sogs pa bgo bar bya'o/ /120—512

sman ka ya sta dang / na gu ①li dang / pu tse shel dang / sle tres dang /a ka ru dang / na ku ta sdeku dang / sa ha de ba dang / shu dag rnams lhan cig sbyar bas lus byug cing de dag bsregs snepas lus bdugs na yang grang ba sel to/ /yang na sman de dag nyid btags pa'i phye ma dang / lan tshwa dang /nas tshig 'khus pa'i thal ba dang / tshwa dang rtsabs skyur ba rjol sogs pa dang /til mar rnams lhan cig tu skol ba'i til mar nyi tshe lus pas ⑤lus la bskus na yang grang ba sel to/ /zho kha chu 'am/ ba gcin nam/ tshwa dron pos lus la byug gam/ yang na bye'u rug pa dang / zan dutig li dang / shi kru rnams brdungs pas lus la bskus na yang grang ba sel to/ /yang na sbrebs par gyur pa la ni rlung sel ba'i rtsi shing rnams dang / gso ma brdungs pa'i khu ba dron po'i nang du/ lums su 'jug par bya'o/ /yang na thang shing dang a ka ru bsregs pas bdug gam/ yang na pog dang / kṣa bu ka bsregs pas bdug par bya'o/ /bud med lang tshol bab pa nu ma rgyas shing 'bur la yid tsam dbyibs ⑦dgu zhing / rked pa la sogs ⑧pa'i lus/ a ka ru'i lde gus byugs pa dang / mthar sbyar na yang grang ba shin tu dzrebs pa ⑨med par byed do // //⑩da ni rims nad can gye kha zas kyi bye brag bshad de/ rims nad can la ni—/ kha zas 'bras sā ⑪lu shun lpags dmar po la sogs pa dang / 'bras zhag drug cus smin pa bzang ngo / /tshod ma dang / khu bcud du ni/ sran chung dang / mon sran tsa na dang / mon sran sde'u dang / rgya sran dang /120—513

mon sran na gu bzang ngo / /bya na dang / khu bcud ni/ ri bong dang /dgo ba dang / 'ur ba dang / bya bar ti ra dang / brta ka dang / gong ma sreg rnams kyi sha bzang ngo / /tshod ma ni shing pa ta ①la'i lo ma dang / brta ka dang / karko ta la sogs pa bzang ngo / /de la cho gar bsrung ba'i mdo ni/rims na ba'am/ rims byang nas nyams ma brtas kyi bar du kha zas lci ba dang /bsil ba dang / chu grang mo dang / nyin par nyal ba dang / mgo mi 'thub ste ngal bar gyur pa rnams ④bsgrims te bsdad par ①bya'o/ /rims la nad bla gnyan thu'abyung ba mgo 'khor ba dang / dbugs mi bde ba dang / skom dang che ba dang / skyug pa la sogs par gyur na/ rims nyid la gnod par mi 'gyur ba'i so so'i sman gang 'os pa rnams kyis de ⑤bsal bar bya'o/ /rims drag po 'byung du mi btub cing cho ga gzhan gyis ma slon pa la ni sman chen po lus la gdags pa dang / sman gyi khu ba'am sngags chus khrus bya ba dang / zhi ba'i cho ga dang / sbyin sreg dang / gtor ma sbyin pa dang / dka' thub spyad pa dang / grub pa'i sngags kyi cho ga rgyas par bya ba rnams kyis zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /rims nad byung ba'i mtshan ma ni/ kha zas 'dod pa dang / mgo g.ya' ba dang / dzred 6pa 'byung ba dang / lus yang ba dang / rdul 'byung ba dang / khar 'byung ba 4rnams la rtogs par bya'o/ /rims nad gso ba'i le'u ste lnga pa rdzogs so// //'chi ltas kyi le'u bshad pa/ nad pa zad par ma shes te/ gya tshom du sman gyi las byas na/ dal gyi snon de las sto bar zad do/ /de bas na phrin pa 120 514

dang / 'chi ltas dang / mtshan ma 'di gsum las tshe rtogs par bya'o/ /de 'chi ltas ni 'chi bar 'gyur ba de'i ngang tshul dang / lus kyi mdog dang /dbang po dang / spyod pa'i tshul rnams 'gyur ba gang yin pa de dag ni/mdor na sman pa mchog gis 'chi ltas su rig par bya'o/ /de la dbang po rnams don rnams la log par 'dzin la/ sman pa dang mdza' bo bla ma la sdang zhing dgra la dga' bar gyur pa gang yin pa de ni 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /nam thang ba la sprin dang / 'ja' dang / glog mthong zhing / gzhal med khang dang bzhon ①pa rnams kyis nam mkha' khebs par mthong ba gang yin pa de ni 'tsho bar mi 'gyur ro/ /skar ma lha mo sgrib med ces bya ba dang / skar ma gong cug dang /dgu tshigs mi mthong ba dang / sa chen po gom pa brgyad khor khor yug tsam du chung ngur mthong ba de ni srog gi dbang po 'das zin pa yin no/ /nyin par skar ma me 'bar ba 'dra ba mthong ba dang / nyi ma'i mdog kha dog sna tshogs su mthong ba dang / rlung la gzugs yod par mthong ba gang yin pa de ni nges par 'chi bar bstan to/ /nyi ma 'char ba'i ngos la bu gu dod par mthong ba dang /mar me shi ba'i dri snar mi tshor ba de ni 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /me long la sogs pa la bdag gi gzugs brnyan yan lag ma tshang bar mthong ngam/ yang na ye med par mthong ba dang / sems can sna tshogs kyi cha byad mthong na de ni gshin rje'i khyim na gnas pa yin no/ /mig g.yon pa khung du bros pa 'am/ lce nag por gyur tam/ sna'i dbyibs 'gyur raman/ mchu nag por gyur cing dbyibs nyams sam/ kha mnam por gyur pa gang yin pa de ni spang bar bya'o/ /mig dmar por gyur pa dang / mig dmar bar gyur pa dang / mig mi 'gyur ba 120 515

dang / mchi mas gang ba dang / ya yor gyur pa dang / smin ma zhum pa dang /ya yor gyur pa de ni ror gyur par shes par bya'o/ /bzhin gyi mdog dmar ba dang / gnag pa dang / ser ba dang / sngo sangs su gyur pa dang / ngo tsha med pa dang / mdog mi sdug par gyur pa dang / dran pa nyams pa gang yin pa de'i tshe ni 'das zin par shes par bya'o/ /mgo bo la ba lang gi lci ba'i phye mas stug por khebs pa lta bur snang ba dang / skra bshig pa ①dang / sen mo dang / so mdog mi sdug par gyur cing zho byung bar gyur na/ de ni tshe zad par shes par bya'o/ /dpral rtsa ser skya dang / dud ka dang / dmar ba dang / sngo sangs dang / nag po dang / dkar po lta bur gyur pa gang la snang ba ni gshin rje'i khyim du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /dpral ba la shig 'gro ba dang / gtor ma bya rog mi 'dod pa dang / ha cang gnyid che ba dang / ha cang gnyid med par gyur pa de'i tshe ni ring por mi thub po/ long bu dang /pus mo'i ②lha nga dang / dpral ba dang / phrag pa dang / mkhur tshos dang /'gram pa dang / mur 'gram gyi sha lhod pa dang / sha 'phyang bar gyur pa gang yin pa de ni srog ring por mi thogs par spong bar 'gyur ro/ /sha bros la skad kyi gdangs che bar gyur pa dang / nyams ①stobs yod bzhin du skad zhom par gyur pa dang / skra mtshams bye ba gang yin pa de 'chi ba'i dus kyi zhags pas zin par shes par bya'o/ /kha zas zos kyang sha bros pa dang / kha zas ma zos kyang nyams stobs rjoskye ba dang / bzhin gyi mdog snum par ⑤gyur tam/ kha dog gzhan du gyur pa de ni srog gi dbang po 'das zin pa yin no/ /glo bur du dri mi zhim pa dang / dri mi zhim pa zhig tu gyur tam/ sbrang ma sngon po 'khor 120—516

bar gyur na de 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /da ni mtshan ma'i bye brag bshad de/ rmi lam du lus snum gyis byugs pa dang / lho phyogs su 'gro ba dang / phag dang /ma he dang / gcan gzan dang / bong bu dang / rnga mo la zhon pa rmi lam ①mi bzang ngo / /bud med skra bshig cing gos nag po dang / dmar bag gyon pas bcings te dgod ②bzhin du lho phyogs su khrid pa rmis na mi 'dod pa yin no/ /gshin dog dang / mu stegs can gyi rab tu byung ba la sogs pa dang phrad pa dang / de dag dang 'grogs ①pa dang / sbrang rtsi dang / 'bru mar 'thung ba dang / 'ji bas lus byugs te gar byed pa rmis na mi bzang ngo //ri dang / brag la sogs pa las lhung ba dang / bcing ba dang / gzhan gyis thub pa dang / bya rog la sogs pas mchus btsugs pa dang / lhung ba rmis na mi dge'o/ /lha ste'i shug to dang / rgya skyegs kyi shing dang / grog mkhar dang / shing pa ri pant+ra rnams la 'dzegs pa dang / 'bru mar dang /shing bal dang / 'bru mar btsir tshuba'i tshigs ma dang / lcags rnyed pa rmis na mi rung bar 'gyur ro/ /rmi lam na bag ma len pa dang / me tog dmar po'i phreng ba thogs shing gos dmar bag gyon pa dang / chus khyer ba dang /sha btsos pa za zhing rmi ba ni mi 'dod pa yin no⑤/ /rmi lam du rnam pa 'di lta bu dang / gzhan yang rnam pa sna tshogs de 'dra ba dag mthong na/ mi na pa ni nad kyis 'debs par 'gyur ro/ /na ba ni 'chi bar 'gyur ro// //da ni mtshan ma bzang po'i bye brag bshad de/ lha dang / bram ze dang /rgyal mtshan dang / gdugs dang / khyu ba dang / me tog padma dang / rgyal po 120—517

dang / ske tog dkar po dang / gos dkar po dang / chu dang ba dang / me 'bar ba dang / mdza' bo gson po dang / mi dge zhing des pa dang /bud med rgyan byis brgyan pa mthong zhing rmis na bzang ngo / /rmi lam du khyu ba dang /rta zhon pa dang / ri la 'jeg pa dang / shing 'o ma yod pa dang / 'bras bu yod pa la 'chag pa dang / me long dang / sha rjen pa dang / me tog gi phreng ba rnyed pa dang / chu chen po las brgal ba rmis na/ mi na bas ni nor rnyed par 'gyur—/ nad pa zhig na ni nad myur du 'tsho bar 'gyur ro// //da ni phrin pa'i bye brag bshad de/ phrin pa rigs ngan nam/ yan lag ma tshang ba'am/ mu stegs can gyi rab tu byung ba la sogs pa'am/ zhags pa dang / dbyig pa lag na thogs shing / rgod bag tu gyur pa dang / gos dmar po dang / nag po dang / rnying pa gyon pa dang / khyed reng can dang /'di rnams mi 'dod pa yin par bshad do/ /phrin pa lag pa nyed pa dang /mchi ma zag pa dang / mgo lus mar gyis byugs pa dang / rtswa shing gcod pa dang / bud med dang / ma ning phrin par 'ong ba dang / bud med kyi rtsig gi ming dang / ldan pa sna la sogs pa dang / ma ning gi rtsig gi ming dang ldan pa / mig la sogs pa la lag gis nom pa dang / pho mtshan gyi phyogs su lag pas nom pa dang / bong bu dang / rnga mo dang / ma te zhon te 'ongs pa dang / bsdad cing duḥ7khar smra ba 'di dag ni mi rung ba yin no/ /de dag las ldog pa ni dge ba yin no/ /sman pa nad pa'i gan du 'gro bar chas pa na/ glang po che'i skad thos pa dang / 'brug sgra dang / rnga sgra la sogs pa thos pa dang /120 518

rin po che dang / me tog gi phreng ba dang / sha rjen pa dang / gdugs dang /bum pa gang ba la sogs pa mthong na bzang ngo / /sman pa chas te 'gro ba na/pho'i ming dang ldan pa/ bya ngang pa dang / phug ron la sogs pa g.yon logs na gnas shing snang la/ mo'i ming dang ldan pa skyung ka dang / ri skegs la sogs pa g.yas logs na gnas shing snang ste/ nad pa'i khyim gyi nang du 'gro ba'i tshe legs par bsu na bya ba de don du 'gyur bar shes par bya'o/ /rta babs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / shing 'o ma can dang / 'bras bu dang me tog yod pa'i shing mthong ba dang / g.yas logs sam g.yon logs nas bya 'phur ①ram 'dug cing skad snyan pa sgog pa thams cad kyang dge ba yin no/ /khye dang wa g.yas phyogs su song na dge'o/ /srog chags go dha dang / sbrul dang / klu sprul mthong ba ni dus thams cad du mi 'dod pa yin no/ /de ltar sman pa gang gis bsgrims te legs par brtags shing bye brag phyed par byas nas las nges par rtsom ②pa de'i grags pa ni dge ba mang po tshogs pa'i nang du me tog gi phreng ba rnying pa bzhin du mjos par 'gyur ro/ /'chi ltas kyi le'u ste drug pa rdzogs so// //da ni 'khru ba gso ba'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /de la 'khru ba ni kha zas mi 'phrod pa dang / ha cang phyi ba dang / ha cang snum pa dang / ha cang rtsub pa dang / ha cang tsha ba za zhing 'thung ba dang / ha cang mang du za ba dang /ha cang nyung ngu za ba la sogs pas me drod med par byas nas/ nad gzhi shas rnyed pa las 'khru bar 'gyur te/ de yang nad gzhi gsum re res gyur pa dang /120—519

kun 'dus pa las gyur pa dang / mya ngan las gyur pa dang / 'jigs pa las gyur pa dang rnam pa drug yod de/ de dag gi mtshan ma yang bshad par bya ste/de la rlung las gyur pa'i 'khru ba'i mtshan ma ni/ phyi sa'i mdog rtsa dmar ba dang /dbu ba can dang rtsub pa dang / nyung ngu nyung bar 'gyur ba dang / yang dang yang du 'byung ba dang / be'u snabs su 'byung ba dang / 'khrog ①pa dang /sgra dang bcas su 'byung ba rnams so/ /mkhris pa las gyur pa'i 'khru ba'i mtshan ma ni/ phyi sa'i mdog ser ba dang / dmar ba dang / nag ⑧pa dang /sngo ba dang / ljang gur ①'dug pa dang / shin tu mnam dupa dang / bee ba dang / gzhang kha ⑤tsha 'ur 'ur por gyur cing 'brum pa 'byung ba dang / skom dad che bar gyur pa rnams yin no/ /bad kan las gyur pa'i 'khru ba'i mtshan ma ni—/ phyi sa'i mdog dkar ba dang / dri bshul ba dang / bska ba dang /snum pa dang / grang ba dang / cher mi 'khrog dupa dang / yi ga 'chu ⑦ba dang / brang tsha zhing kha nas chu 'byung ba rnams yin no/ /nad gzhi gsum char 'dus pa las gyur pa'i 'khru ba'i mtshan ma ni/ phyi sa phag tshil 'dra ba dang /mar dang / 'bru mar 'dra ba dang / sha bkrus pa'i khu ba 'dra ba rnams yin te gso dka' bar shes par bya'o/ /phyi sa sbrang rtsi 'dra ba dang / mar dang 'bru mar 'dra ba dang / mchin pa'i dum bu 'dra ba ske'abyung ba dang / 'o ma 'dra ba dang / sha brdungs brdungs pa 'dra ba dang / tshon sna tshogs su 'dug pa dang / dri shin tu dku ba dang / zhag tshig tshig po yod pa ni mi 'tsho/gzhang khar 'brum pa 'byung ba dang / gzhang phyir byung ba dang / sha zad pa dang / dbugs mi bde ba la sogs pa'i nad bla gnyan ⑨gyis thebs pa dang /120—520

me drod nyams pa dang / ther ①zug tu lto gang ba dang / mkhal rked na ba rnams kyang mi 'tsho ba'i mtshan ma yin no/ /'jigs pa dang / mya ngan gnyis las gyur pa'i 'khru ba'i mtshan ma ni/ rlung las gyur pa'i 'khru ba'i mtshan ma dang 'dra bar shes par bya ste/ de gnyis la yang rlung bsal ba'i cho ga bya zhing dga' ba bskyed pa dang snying mal du dbab par bya'o/ /de ltar 'khru ba rnam )pa drug po thams cad kyang / smin pa dang / ma smin pa'i bye brag gis rnam pa gnyis su 'gyur te/ de la 'khru ba smin pa la ni/ smyung ba'i cho ga dang /skyug pa'i cho ga go rim bzhin du bya'o/ /'di'i skom dang / zas ni bca' sga dang / ba le ka skol ba'i khu ba dang / kha zas yang ba'i bag dge'o/ /'khru ba ma smin ①pa bcad sngas na skran dang mdze la sogs pa'i nad du 'gyur te/ de la 'khru ba ma smin pa ni/ phyi sa chu'i nang du btang na zhabs su 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /'khru ba smin pa ni chu'i nang du btang na steng du 'ong zhing byer bar 'gyur ro/ /de la 'khru ba ma smin pa la ni byung ba'i cho ga dang skyug pa'i cho ga go rim bzhin du bya'o—/ /'di'i skom dang / zas ni bca' sga dang / ba le ka skol ba'i khu ba dang / kha zas yang ba'i bag dge'o/ / 'khru ba ma smin pa gcad 5pa sngas na/ skran dang / mdze la sogs pa'i nad du 'gyur te/ de bas na thog mar a ru ras bkrus la phyi sa bcad pa'i cho ga byas na bzang ngo / /de la bcad pa'i thabs ni/ pi pi ling la sogs pa'i sde tshan sngar bshad pa rnams skol ba'i sman gyi khu ba las gzhi blangs te/ 'bras thug dang / khu bcud byas pa'am/dar ba'i thug pa blud do/ /de la dar ba'i thug pa ji ltar sbyar ba'i thabs ni 'og nas zhib tu ston to/ /yang na yung la sogs pa'i sde tshan nam/ shu dag (20 52/

la sogs pa'i sde tshan skol ba'i khu ba ①las gzhi blangs la 'bras thug byas te blud na 'khru ba ma smin pa zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /yang na bca' sga dang / bong nga dkar po dang / shing kun dang / gla sgang dang / dug mo nyung ②dang /kru trug tres snernams lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / gla sgang dang / te dze ba ti dang / pa tha dang / pi pi ling dang / dug mo rnams lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / rgyam tsha dang / dug mo nyung gi 'bras bu dang / shu dag dang / pu dutse shel rnams lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / rtsabs ⑤ru tsha dang / shu dag dang /a ru ra dang / ba thā dang / bye dang ka dhidang bca' sga rnams lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / sug smel dang / dug mo nyung gi 'bras bu dang / sha ba ra'i seng phrom dang / yung dang / skyer pa rnams lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang /dug mo nyung gi shun lpags dang / bong nga dkar po dang / bca' sga dang /gla ⑦sgang rnams lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / smin par byed pa'i sman gyi sbyor ba drug po 'di dag las gang yang rung ba skol ba'i khu ba blud do/ /yang na sman gye sbyor ba 'di dag las gang yang rung ba zhib tu btags pa'i phye ma chu gtsang mar bskol ba'am/ chang ngam rtsabs ④skyur po'i nang du btab ste blud do/ /yang na/tsha ba gsum dang / bong nga dkar po dang / shing kun dang / shu dag dang /kha ru tsha dang / a ru ra rnams zhib tu btags pa'i phye ma chu skol ba'i nang du btab ste blud na 'khru ba ma smin pa tshabs chen po sel bar byed do/ /yang na/shu dag dang / bilba dang / pi pi leng dang / bca' sga dang / ru rta dang /go stod dang / ku la ka dang / bye dang ka rnams zhib tu btags pa'i phye ma chu skol ba'i nang du btab ste 'thungs na 'khru ba 'chad do/ /da ni 'khru ba smin pa'i cho 120—522

ga bshad de/ de la pho ba'i drod chung ste/ 'khru ba smin pa yang dang yang du 'byung bar gyur pa la ni/ gcod sman gyi cho ga sgyur te bya'o/ /de la gcod pa'i sman ni ldum bu sa mang ga dang / shing shasma li'i lo ma dang / seng phrom dang / pa tha dang / dha thā dang / da ①ta ka'i me tog rnams lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / shing lwang ko dang / garnya pre yi ku dang / me tog padma dang /ti ri tra dang / bilba'i shing tog gi shegs ma rnams lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang /shing dir gha brirnyi'i shun lpags dang / bca' sga dang / shing mngar rnams lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / dug mo nyung gi shun lpags dang / bal pho ②se'u dang /seng phrom dang / dha ta ki dang / garnya ma lig lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang /sman gyi sbyor ba 'di bzhi las gang yang rung ba zhib tu btags pa'i phye ma 'bras bkrus pa'i khu ba sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba'i nang du btab ste 'thungs na 'khru ba smin pa gcod par 'gyur ro/ /yang na 'khru ba smin pa la/ gla sgang bskol ba'i khu ba bsgrangs pa sbrang rtsi dang sbyar te blud do/ /de bzhin du seng phrom la sogs pa'i sde tshan dang / am pa shā la sogs pa'i sde tshan sngar bshad pa'i ④yon tan chen po 'di gnyis las gang yang rung ba cig ④bskol ba'i khu ba bsgrangs ⑤pa sbrang rtsi dang sbyar te blud do/ /yang na tai pa la dang / me tog padma'i 'dab ma dang / shing ro tsha ba'i shun lngags rnams lhan cig tu skol ba'i khu ba bsgrangs pa—/ padma'i ze ba dang sbrang rtsi dang sbyar te 'thungs na gcod par 'gyur ro/ /shing n+ya gro dha la sogs pa'i sde tshan sngar bshad pa zhib tu btags pa'i phye mas phye ⑦sreg pa'i kho pa bkang la/ snod kha bcad pa'i nang du btsos pa'i khu ba bsgrangs paske/ sbrang rtsi dang kha ra dang sbyar te 'thungs na dmu rdzings ⑦sel bar byed 120—523

cing / 'khru ba gcod do/ /yang na rtsa ba lnga pa dang / ba la dang / bilba dang / 'u su'i 'bras bu dang / utpal dang / bca' sga rnams skol ba'i khu ba las gzhi blangs pa'i 'bras thug bal po se'us skyur por byas pa'am yang na kha ra dang / sprang rtsi dang / rgun la sogs pas mngar bar byas pa blud do//yang na katpal dang / bong nga dkar po dang / gla sgang dang / dug mo nyung dang / bca' sga rnams skol ba'i khu ba bsgrangs pa sbrang rtsi dang sbyar te blud na/mkhris pa las gyur pa'i 'khru ba sel to/ /yang na utpal dang / dha ta ka'i me tog dang / bca' sga dang / bal po se'u'i shun lpags rnams lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / ldum bu sa mang ga dang / utpal dang / padma dang / seng phrom dang / chu shing gi 'bras bu'i khu ba dang / til rnams lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / dug mo nyung dang / gla sgang dang / rtsa mkhris dang / skyer khaṇḍa rnams lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / padma'i rtsa ba dang / tsan dan dkar po dang / seng phrom dang / utpal dang / bca' sga rnams lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / pa tha dang / byi tsher dang / bca' sga dang / shing lwang kho dang / dza myu'i ①shing tog gi rus pa dang / katpal rnams lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang /bilba dang / skyer pa'i shun sgogs ①dang / byi tsher dang / ba la rnams lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / dha ta ki dang / bong nga dkar po dang / bca' sga dang / dug mo nyung gi shun wags dang / 'bras bu dang / skyer khaṇḍa rnams lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / katpal dang / shing mngar dang / seng phrom dang /bal po se'u 'i shun lpags rnams lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / shing lwang kho dang /dha ta ka'i me tog dang / ldum bu sa mang ga dang / padma rnams lhan cig tu 120—524

sbyar ba dang / dug mo nyung gi shun lpags dang / skyer pa dang / pa tha dang /pi pi ling gi rtsa ba dang / bca' sga rnams lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / sman gyi sbyor ba bcu pa 'di dag las gang yang rung ba zhib tu btags pa'i bye ma 'bras bkrus pa'i khu ba sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba'i nad du btags te 'thungs ni ①mkhris pa las gyur pa'i 'khru ba sel to/ /mkhris pa las gyur pa'i 'khru ba yod bzhin du/mkhris pa dang mi 'phrod pa'i kha zas zos pas khrag 'khrugs par byas nas/khrag las gyur pa'i 'khru ba tshabs chen por gyur pa la na ④khrag lud pa'i nad sel ba'i cho ga sgyur ①te bya'o/ /de la khrag lud pa'i nad bsal ba'i cho ga ni/btung dhib dang / kha zas dang / mas btang ba kun la yang ra'i 'o ma dang sbyar bar bya'o/ /ba ya su dang / thal tres dang / seng phrom dang / kha ra dang / shing mngar rna mas zhib tu btags pa'i phye ma 'o ma grang mo dang sbrang rtsi sbyar ba'i nang du btab ste 'thungs na yang khrag nad las gyur pa'i 'khru ba sel to / /pog dang / rgya shug dang / shing dzamyu ⑤dang / bi yal dang / a mra dhidang / ardzu na rnams las gang yang rung ba'i shun lpags ⑦zhib tu btags pa'i phye ma/ 'o ma dang / sbrang rtsi sbyar ba'i nang du btab ste 'thungs na yang /khrag nad las gyur pa'i 'khru ba sel to/ /utpal dang / a maṅga dang / chu shing gi 'bras bu dang / padma'i ze ba rnams lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / til dang / sha ba ra'i seng phrom dang / shing mngar dang / sa oṃ ga dang /thal tres dang / utpal rnams lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / utpal dang /shasma la'i shun lpags dang / shing mngar ⑧dang / sha ba ra'i seng phrom dang til rnams lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / sman gyi sbyor ba 'di dag gsum las gang 120—525

yang rung ba btags 1/ pa'i phye ma 'o ma dang sbrang rtsi sbyar ba'i nang du btab ste 'thungs na yang khrag nad las gyur pa'i 'khru ba sel to/ /tsan dan dkar po 'am/ garnya thra yo ku gnyis las gang yang rung ba'i phye ma 'bras bkrus pa'i khu ba sbrang rtsi dang / kha ra sbyar ba'i nang du btab ste 'thungs na yang khrag nad las gyur pa'i 'khru ba sel to/ /yang na char pa'i chu dang / sbrang rtsi dang /bu ram gyi dbu ba sbyar ba'i nang du dug mo nyung gi shun lpags zhib tu btags pa'i phye ma btab ste 'thungs na yang khrag nad las gyur pa'i 'khru ba sel to/ /yang na shing mngar dang / utpal dang / chu srin gyi sen mo dang / kha ra rnams kyi phye ma lhan cig tu sbyar ba btang ngo / /khrag tshad dang / phyi sa thal ba snrel zhi byung ba la ni 'o ma'i nang du 'bras bu gsum gyi phye ma btab pa'am/yang na 'o ma bzhos ma thag pa dron mo ci ran par 'thungs te lan mang du 'khrus na zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /bad kan las gyur pa'i 'khru bas gnod par gyur pa la ni/kha zas sman bu ti ka dang / tsha ba gsum dang / bilba dang / kru trug tres dang / dar ba dang / bal po se'u dang / shing kun rnams dang legs par sbyar ba'i khu bcud dang ldan pa bza' bar bya'o/ /dbyi mong da nga/ bong nga dkar po dang / ru rta dang / ba tha dang / pu tse shel rnams lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / a ru ra dang / gla sgang dang / bca' sga dang / bilba dang /karka ti ka rnams lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / kru trug tres dang / pi pi ling dang / pi pi ling gi rtsa ba dang / pi pi ling chen po rnams lhan cig tu sbyar ba rnams dang / byi dang ka ④dang / shu dag dang / shang shing dang / 'u su'i 'bras bu dang / tsha ba gsum po rnams lhan cig tu sbyar ba ste ④sman gyi 120—526

/desbyor ba 'di bzhi las gang yang rung ba lhan cig tu skol ba'i khu ba blud na yang bzang ste/ me drod dang nyams stobs bskyed do/ /yang na a ru ra dang /kru trug tres dang / pa tha dang / shu dag dang / pi pi ling gi rtsa ba dang /dug mo nyung dang / bca' sga rnams skol ba'i khu ba dron mo'am/ yang na de dag gi phye ①ma'i sman byas na bad kan las gyur pa'i 'khru ba sel to/ /shing i ko ta'i rtsa ba dang / skyer pa rnams las srang re re btags te char ba'i chus brdzis la zho gnyis tsam reng bur byas te mas btang na 'khru ba thams cad kyang sel bar byed do/ /bilba dang / gla sgang dang / dha ta ka'i me tog dang /pa thā dang / bca' sga rnams kyi phye ma dang / chu shing gi 'bras bu'i khu ba rnams cha mnyam la bu ram dang / dar ba sbyar ba'i nang du btab ste 'thungs na yang 'khru ba gcod do // //⑤da ni rlung las gyur pa'i 'khru ba'i cho ga bshad de/ khrag dang / phyi sa byung ba'i rjes la rlung gi mthus phyi sa 'gags te be'u snabs dbu ba 'dra bar 'byung zhing / 'khrog ①pa'i nad kyi ming ni be'u snabs su 'byung zhing 'khreg pa zhes bya ste/ de la ni me drod chen po zhig na/ kru trug tres dang / bibee 'o mar dhiskol ba'i khya ba/ bu ram dang / til mar dang sbyar te nad par 'thungs na/ phyi sa 'gags pa bde bar 'gyur ro/ /'o ma bskol te phyung ba'i nang du/ pi pi ling gi phye ma'am/ yang na na le sham gyi phye ma btab ste zhag gsum gyi bar du 'thungs na be'u snabs su 'byung zhing 'khreg pa yun ring du lon pa yang sel to/ /til mar dang / mar dang / sbrang rtsi dang / kha ra dang /120—527

bca' sga dang / bu ram gyi khu ba rnams lhan cig tu sbyar la dkrugs te 'thungs na yang de ma thag tu be'u snabs su 'byung zhing 'khreg pa sel to/ /dha ta ka'i me tog dang / rgya shug gi lo ma dang / shing ka pittha dang / drub mar cang dang /seng phrom rnams kyi phye ma zho dang sbyar te 'thungs na yang be'u snabs su 'byung zhing 'khreg pas nyam thag pa sel to/ /bilba'i 'bras bu'i shags ①ma dang / bu ram dang / seng phrom dang / til mar dang / na le sham rnams lhan cig tu sbyar te/ zos na yang be'u snabs su 'byung zhing / 'khregs pas dub par ④gyur pa myur du sel zhing bde bar 'gyur ro/ /des kyang zhi bar ma gyur na/shing mngar dang / til mar mas btang ba'i cho ga ni/ shing shal ma le'i lo ma btsos dkris la 'jim pas g.yogs te/ me mar mur gyi nang du bcug la/'jim pa ni skams/ lo ma ni tshos par gyur nas/ lo ma de gtun gyi nang du zhib tu brdungs pa'i phye ma/ mar dang / shing mngar gyi phye ma dang ldan par 'o ma srang sum cu rtsa gnyis bskol te phyung ba'i nang du brdzis pa'i ming ni mas btang ba'i sman 'jam zhing 'khyel ①ba zhes bya dhi'adi mas btang na/ rims dang / mkhris pa las gyur pa'i 'khru ba sel zhing / skran dang/ tshad rnying 'joms par byed la/ pho ba'i nad dang / skrangs pa med par byed do/ /da ni pho ba'i me drod nyams pa gso ba'i cho ga bshad de/ me drod bri nas nad gzhi rnams kyis pho ba'i me drod dkrugs pa las/ pho ba'i me ⑤drod 'khrugs pa'i nad/rlung dang mkhris pa dang / bad kan gsum so so las gyur pa dang / kun 'dus pa las gyur pa rnam pa bzhir gyur te/ de dag mtshan ma dang gso ba'i thabs ni 'khru ba dang 'dra'o/ /de la rlung las grur pa'i pho ba'i me drod 'khrugs 120—528

par gyur pa'i mtshan ma dang / gso ba'i thabs ni/ rlung las gyur pa'i 'khru ba'i mtshan ma dang gso ba'i thabs dang 'dra'o/ /mkhris pa las gyur pa dang /bad kan las gyur pa dang / kun 'dus pa las gyur pa yang de bzhin du so sor sbyar ro/ /de la me drod bskyed pa'i thabs ni/ sman a dza mo dang / kru trug 1tres dang / dbyi mong dang / tsha ba gsum dang / rgyam tsha dang /sngar bshad pa'i thal ba rnam gnyis dang / pi pi ling gi rtsa ba dang / shing kun rnams shing tog kha lung gi khu bas ri lur byas te zos na me drod skyed par byed do/ /'bras bu gsum dang / ga bye'i 'bras bu dang / tsha ba gsum dang / rgyam tsha dang / kha ru tsha dang / rtsabs 4ru tsha rnams btags te dzee'u kha sbyar gyi nang du btab ste 'thungs na/ skya rbab kyi nad dang / pho ba'i nad dang / skran dang / zug cing na ba rnams sel to/ /sman la la phud dang /tsha ba gsum dang / rgyam tsha dang / go snyod rnam gnyis dang / shing kun rnams kyi phye ma mar khu dang brdzis pa kha zas kyi snga rol tu zos 5na/ rlung sel cing rnge drod skyed 6do/ /shu ti dang / 'u su'i 'bras bu dang / pa thā dang /bibee dang / kru trug tres dang / bca' sga dang / la la phud dang / pi pi ling gi rtsa ba dang / rgya shug 7gi 'bras bu rnams kyi phye ma/ mar dang / zho mar gyi bzhi 'gyur dang / ldum bu cang ge ri'i khu ba mar gyi bzhi 'gyur dang /'di rnams skol la mar nyi tshe lus par byas te 4ji ran par 'thungs na/ pho ba'i nad dang / gzhang 'brum dang / gzhang byung ba dang / gcin sri 9ba dang / lto spos pa 1 dang / be'u snabs su 'byung zhing 'khreg pa dang /dbugs mi bde ba dang / skya rbab kyi nad dang / skom pa'i nad dang /120—529

lud pa dang / drag tu 1sgyug cing 'chad du mi btub pa rnams sel cing yi ga 'bye bar byed de/ mkhris pa las gyur pa'i pho ba'i me drod 'khrugs pa'i nad la ni / skyer pa'i khaṇḍa dang / bong nga dkar po dang / bilba dang / byi tsher gyi shun lpags dang / bye tsher gyi 'bras bu dang / gla sgang dang / pā thā dang / dha ta ki dang / pu tse shel dang / bca' sga rnams kyi phye ma char pa'i chu sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba'i nang du btab ste 'thungs na/ gzhang 'brum dang /be'u snabs su 'byung zhing 'khreg pa dang / khrag nad dang / mkhal rked na ba dang gzhang nad rnams sel to/ /dug mo nyung gi shing dang / tsha ba gsum dang / gla sgang dang / rtsa mkhris dang / pu tse shel rnams cha mnyam pa dang /kru trug tres cha'i nyis 'gyur dang / dug mo nyung gi shun lpags cha'i bcu drug 'gyur dang / 'di rnams kyi phye ma 'bras bkrus pa'i khu ba dang sbyar te 'thungs na / pho ba'i nad dang / mig ser dang / skya rbab kyi nad dang / gcin nad dang / yi ga 'chus pa dang / 'khru ba dang / skran dang / skem pa'i nad dang rims sel to/ /bad kan las gyur pa'i pho ba'i me drod 'khrugs pa'i nad la ni/ sman sha thi dang / tsha ba gsum dang / a ru ra dang /thal ba rnam gnyis dang / pi pi ling gi rtsa ba dang / kha lung gi 'bras bu dang /rgyam tsha rnams kyi phye ma chu bskol te phyung ba'i nang du btab ste 'thungs na zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /ma dhu ka'i me tog bskol te gdus pa'i khu ba bsgrangs pa'i nang du sbrang rtsi de'i bzhi cha blugs pa 4sbyar te/ bum pa'i nang padma'i rtsa ba dang /a ka ru dang / til mar rnams sbyar bas byugs pa'i nang du blugs te 5zla ba gcig gi bar du nas kyi nang du bzhag pa las ran par 'thungs na me drod skyed 5120—530

do / /pi pi ling gi rtsa ba dang / kru trug tres dang / a rur dang / pi pi ling dang / byi tang ga rnams lhan cig tu sbyar bas rdza ma ri 1nang du bskus la / de'i nang du ngar ba blugs te/ nas kyi nang du zla ba gcig gi bar du bzhag pa las ran par 'thungs na pho ba'i nad dang / gzhang 'brum dang /lud pa dang / skran dang srin bu rnams sel to/ /de ltar pho ba'i me drod 'khrugs pa'i nad kyis thebs pa la ni mdor na tshabs che chung la sogs pa las dpags te shin tu bye brag phyed par byas nas/ me drod pa skyed pa'i kha zas dang /btung ba dang / sman gye phye ma dang / sman gyi khu ba btung ba dang / sman mar la sogs pa ci rigs par btang ngo / / 'khru ba dang / pho ba'i me drod 'khrugs zipa'i nad las/ srin 5bu'i nad 'byung ba'i phyir/ de 'og tu skabs 'dir/ srin bu'i nad kyi bye brag dang / de'i mtshan ma dang / gso ba'i thabs bshad de/ de la srin bu'i nad kyi mtshan ma ni/ rims na bar 'gyur ba dang / sha mdog ngan pa dang / ru shing na ba dang / snying na ba dang / lus byud pa dang / mgo 'khor 6ba dang / kha zas mthong na yid du mi 'ong ba dang / 'khru bar gyur na/ stor 7srin bu skyes pa'i mtshan ma yin no / /de gso ba'i thabs ni/ sman byi tang ga dang / rgyam tsha dang / nas tshig 'khus pa'i thal ba dang / kambi lya ga dang a ru ra rnams zhib tu btags pa'i phye ma dar ba dang sbyar te 'thungs na/ srin bu thams cad sel to/ /shi kru dang / skyer pa dang / mu sha paṇi dang / gla sgang dang / 'bras bu gsum dang / 'di rnams skol ba'i khu ba'i nang du/ pi pi ling dang byi tang ga'i phye ma btab ste sbyar ba 'thungs na yang srin bu sel to/ /su sha baṇi 120—531

btags pa'i phye ma dang / 'bras bsregs pa'i khu ba zos la/ tshal nan du rtsabs sgyur bo 'thungs na yang srin nad sbyang ①ngo / /bye tang ga'i phye ma sbrang rtsi dang sbyar te zos na yang srin bu sel to/ /shing pa ri (she bhad tra ka'i lo ma'i khu ba sbrang rtsi dang sbyar te 'thungs na yang srin bu sel to/ /yang na 'bras bu gsum dang / shu dag dang / danda'i rtsa ba dang / shaṃ pa ①lya ka rnams kyi phye ma mar dang / ba gcin mar gyi bzhi 'gyur ④gyi nang du bskol la/ ba gcin du bar byas nas tshigs ma btsags pa'i mar ji ran par 'thungs na yang srin bu sel to/ /'khru ba gso ba'i le'u ste bdun pa rdzogs so// //de la khrag lud pa'i nad ni/ nyi ma dang me la sogs pa'i tsha ba bsten ⑪ pa dang / kha zas la sogs pa tsha ches pa dang / skyur ba dang / lan tshwa dang /thal ba rnon tho po'i sman dang / ro tsha ba'i bag zos pas/ mkhris pa 'khrug par gyur pa las mchin pa dang / mcher pa'i nang na khrag gnas pa lud par gyur te/ yar yang 'byung la mar yang 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de la rlung las gyur pa'i khrag lud pa'i mtshan ma ni/ khrag gi mdog sngo skyar 'dug pa dang /dmar ba dang / sba ba dang / dbu ba can rnams yin no/ /mkhris pa las gyur pa'i khrag lud pa'i mtshan ma ni/ khrag gi mdog gos tshon nag por btsos pa'i kha dog 'dra ba dang / dud khar 'dug pa dang / ba gcin gyi mdog 'dra ba dang / skyer khaṇḍa'i mdog 'dra ba rnams yin no/ /bad kan las gyur pa'i khrag lud pa'i mtshan ma ni/ khrag gi mdog snum pa dang / yid tsam skya ④ba dang / 'byil ba dang / bska rngub rnams yin no/ /nad gzhi gnyis 120—532

gnyis 'dus pa las gyur pa'i khrag lud pa'i mtshan ma ni 'dres 3mar 'gyur ro/ /nad gzhi 2 gsum char 'dus pa las gyur pa'i khrag lud pa'i mtshan ma ni/kun gyi mtshan ma thams cad dang ldan pa yin no/ /de la nad gzhi re re las gyur pa'i khrag lud pa gyen du 'byung ba ni gso bee'o/ /nad gzhi re re las gyur pa dang / gnyis gnyis 'dus pa las gyur pa'i khrag lud pa thur du 'byung ba ni / kha zas dang / sman gyi cho gas mi ldang bar gso tsam du rung ste5 /nad gzhi gsum char 'dus pa las gyur pa'i khrag lud pa ni/ gyen du 'byung ba yang rung thur du 'byung yang rung ste shin tu gso dka' ba yin no/ /khrag lud pa'i rkyen gyis skyugs 6pa dang / brgyal ba dang / rims dang / dbugs mi bde ba dang / lud pa dang / skad 'gags pa dang / lus tsha bar gyur pa dang / khrag 7gi mdog shing dzamyu'i 'bras bu 'dra ba dang / 'ja' 'dra ba dang / mi ro'i dri mnam / pa ni gso ba'i thabs med do/ /de la nyams stobs dang ldan zhing za phod pa ni/ nad khrag ngan pa thog ma nas bcad 1rtan/de las skog nad lha gor ri nadang / skran dang / gzhang 'brum dang / rims dang / mdze la sogs pa'i nad du 'gyur ro/ /de bas na sngar gcad 1 par mi bya'o / /khrag lud pa la thog mar ni/ ci nus kyis smyung ba'i cho ga bya'o/ /de'i skom ni tsan dan dkar po dang / pu shel tse dang / sro ⑫lo dang / gla sgang rnams lhan cig skol ba'i khu ba blud do/ /khrag lud pa gyen du 'byung ba la ni thog mar brta ba dang / bkru sman bya'o/ /thur du 'byung ba ni nyams 15 stobs dang sbyar zhing / thog mar 'bras thug gi cho ga dang / skyugs ⑩pa'i cho ga bya'o/ /de la lus brta ba ni/ mar dang / sbrang rtsi dang / 'bras 120—533

brngos 1pa'i phye ma dang kha ra rnams sbyar ba'i nang du/ skyu ru ra dang / bal po se'u btab ste ro skyur bar byas pa drud do/ /de la bkru sman ni dong ka'i ༄ ༷tshig gu dang / skyu ru ra dang / shing nye rong dang / a ru ra 'di rnams las gang yang rung ba'i phye ma chu bskol te bsgrangs pa'i nang du btab la/ kha ra dang sbrang rtsis sbyar te gtang bar bya'o/ /sgyug sman ni/ gla sgang dang / /dug mo nyung dang / shing mngar skol ba'i khu ba bsgrangs pa/ po son cha'i tshig gu dang je/'o ma dang sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba ni khrag lud pa'i nad sel ba'i mchog yin te btung bar bya'o/ /sha zad pa dang nyams 5stobs zad pa dang / byis pa dang /rgad po dang / skem pa'i nad yod pa la ni/ skyug sman dang bkru sman byar mi rung ste/ khrag 'byung ba gcad 6pa'i cho ga bya'o/ /de la khrag 'byung ba ) bcad pa'i cho ga ni/ pa to la dang / sna ma'i me tog dang / nidza dang /tsan dan rnam gnyis dang / shug pa rnams lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / mon sran sde'u dmar ru dang / ba sha ka dang / seng phrom dang / sa nag po dang /ma da yan ti / ka rnams lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / ka ko la dang / ra mnye'i rtsa ba dang / thal tres rnam gnyis dang / shing mngar dang / nye'u shing gi rtsa ba rnams lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / 'bras sgang dang / skyu ru ra dang /dha ta ka'i gre tog dang / dug mo nyung gi shun lpags dang / sro lo rnams lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / sman gyi sbyor ba 'di bzhi las gang yang rung ba cha mnyam ste skol ba'i khu ba bsgrangs pa dang / kha ra dang / sbrang rtsi dang /sbyar ba ni khrag lud pa'i nad myur du sel ba'i mchog yin te shin tu grang mor btung ngo / /pri yi ku dang / skyer khaṇḍa dang / sa tshig pa dang / seng phrom 720—537/

rnams lhan cig tu zhib tu btags pa'i phye ma/ ldum bu ba sha ka brdungs pa'i khu ba'am / bskol ba'i khu ba bsgrangs pa gang yang rung ba kha ra dang / sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba'i nang du btab ste 'thungs na yang khrag lud pa'i nad sel to/ /chu srin gyi sen mo dang / shug pa dang / garnya pri 1yo ku dang / seng phrom dang /btsag rnams las gang yang rung ba'i phye ma char ba'i chu kha ra dang sbyar ba'i nang du btab ste 'thungs na yang khrag 'byung ba gcod do/ /seng ldeng dang / sapta parna dang / parja dang / shasma li dang / ko bi da ra rnams kyi me tog gi phye 2ma sbrang rtsi dang sbyar te zos na yang khrag lud pa sel to/ /u dum ba ra dang /tai pa la dang / a ru ra dang / 'bra go dang / rgun rnams kyi 'bras bu smin pa las gang yang rung ba sbrang rtsi dang sbyar te zos na yang khrag lud pa'i nad sel to/ /ku shadma da'i 'bras bu rlon pa shun lpags bshus la nang gi sa bon rnams kyang bor te/ bar gyi sha kham 4tshad du gtubs 5la/ brngos pa srang brgyad brtswa ḍa srang brgyad 6dang zhun mar bzang po srang sum cu rtsa gnyis lhan cig tu skol ba'i nang du/ dri gsum zhes bya ba/ shing tsha dang / gaddhā patra dang / sug smel rnams dang / 'u su'i 'bras bu dang / na le shaṃ dang /'di rnams la srang phyed phyed dang / pi pi ling dang / bca' sga dang / go snyod trīrnams las srang gnyis gnyis dang / 'di rnams zhib tu btags pa'i phye ma btab ste bsgrangs la/ sbrang rtsi zhun mar gyi phyed dang sbyar te zos na yang khrag lud pa'i nad sel to/ /glo rdol ba dang / glo gcong zad byed kyi nad dang / dbugs mi bde ba'i nad dang / snying stor ldang ba dang / thibs byed ces bya ba dang / rims dang / skom pa'i nad dang / lud pa dang /120—535

sgyug pa rnams kyang 'joms par byed la/ glo la phan zhing / sha skye ba dang /ro tsa ba dang / nyams ①stobs bskyed pa dang / sha mdog bzang ba dang /skad snyan par 'gyur ro/ /rgun dang / 'o ma bzhi pa zhes bya ba/ sa la paṇi dang / phri ②shaṃ paṇi dang / muṅga paṇi dang / ma sha paṇi rnams dang / ba la dang / bca' sga dang / gze ma dang / nye'u shing gi rtsa ba dang / 'di rnams las gang yang rung ba 'o ma dang bskol te 'thungs na yang khrag nad sel to//kha ra dang / e ya ①ba lu ka dang / rtsa drurba ④dang / tsan dan rnam gnyis dang / gla sgang dang / shug pa dang / me tog utpala'i gze ma dang /btsod dang / pu shel tse rnams kyi phye ma cha mnyam ste/ ra'i mar dang / 'o ma mar gyi bzhi 'gyur dang / char ba'i chu'i nang du bskol te mar gyi nyi tshe lus pa las btung ba dang ⑤/ mas btang ba dang / lus bsku ba dang / snar blugs pa gang yang rung ba byas na yang khrag lud pa'i nad sel to/ /bi da ri dang / shing mngar dang / me da rnam gnyis dang / di na ta li'i dushing tog dang / bal po se'u dang / nye'u shing dang / ldum bu ka ko la ⑦dang / kha lung gi shags ma dang / 'di rnams cha mnyam ste zhib tu btags pa'i phye ma/mar dang 'o ma mar gyi bzhi 'gyur dang chu'i nang du bskol te mar nyi tshe lus pa las ci ran par zos na rims sel cing phyi sa 'gags pa dang / lto sbos pa ⑧dang / zug cing na ba 'joms par byed de/ lud pa dang / khrag lud pa'i stind med par byed do/ /sna nas khrag 'byung ba la ni/ dung dang / btsag dang / dha ta ka'i me tog dang / shing mngar rnams gang yang rung ba'i phye ma btsags pa bud med kyi nu zho dang sbyar te snar blugs ⑩na gcod par 'gyur ro//120—536

bal po se'u'i khu ba dang / rtsa drurba'i ①khya ba dang / shing log kog gi tshig gu dang / kun dong gi khu ba 'di rnams las gang yang rung ba snar blugs na yang sna khrag zag pa gcod do/ /khrag lud pa thur ②du byung ba la ni/ khrag tshad kyi cho ga sngar bshad pa bzhin du bya'o/ /khrag lud pa pho mtshan nas 'byung ba la ni/mkhris pa las gyur pa'i gcin nad kyi cho ga rgyas par 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin du bya'o—/ /khrag lud pa bud med kyi mo mtshan las 'byung ba la ni/ 'o ma kha ra ①sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba blud na phan te zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /yang na btsag yug snam/shing dzamyu'i rjolo ma dang / utpala'i rtsa ba rnams las gang yang rung ba'i phye ma 'bras bkrus pa'i khu ba sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba'i nang du btab ste 'thungs na yang mo mtshan nas 'byung ba'i khrag 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /yang na sman a nanda dang /garnya pri yo ku dang / tsan dan dang / nā ga ge sar rnams gang yang rung ba'i phye ma chang dang sbyar te 'thungs na yang mo mtshan nas 'byung ba'i khrag 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /yang na mon sran sde'u ⑤dmar ru'i rtsa ba'i phye ma sbrang rtsi dang /skyer khaṇḍa rnams 'bras bkrus pa'i khu ba rjosbyar te dkrugs la 'thungs na yang /mo mtshan nas 'byung ⑦ba'i khrag gi rnam grangs thams cad sel bar byed do/ /yang na ldum bu bun sna ba dang / sha lu ka dang / sran chung dang / a lam bu sa rnams las gang yang rung ba btsos pas mo mtshan la dugs byas na yang na ba sel to/ /yang muṅga paṇi btags te til mar dang lhan cig ⑧btsos pa'i nang du/ srin bal lam/ shing bal smyugs la mo mtshan gyi nang du bzhag na yang khrag gcod cing 'jam la bde bar 'gyur ro/ /spyir na khrag lud pa'i nad yod pa la ni/ chu grang mo'i nang du 'jug pa dang / lud la chu grang mo thugs 120—537

par ①sogs pa dge ba yin te/ kha zas kyang sā ②lu dang / mon sran sde'u la sogs pa dang / ri dwags dang bya'i sha bsil ba'i bag rnams bzang ngo / /khrag rgyas pa'i nad gso ba'i le'u ste bdun pa rdzogs so// //de nas gcong chen po gso ba'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /de la gcong chen po'i nad ni/ nad gzhi bzhi las 'byung ste/ de yang brtsal drags ④pa dang /zad byed dukyi nad dang / phyi sa dang / gcin 'gags pa dang / dus su mi za ba dang rgyu 'di bzhi las 'byung ngo/ /de'i mtshan ma ni/ skad 'gags pa dang / lud pa dang / dbugs mi bde ba dang / yi ga 'chus pa dang /rims dang / klad pa na ba dang / thal gong na ba dang / rtsib logs na ba dang / snying na ba dang / mkhal rked na ba dang / khrag dang / bad kan skyugs rjopa dang / rnam pa bcu gcig po 'di rnams yin no/ /mtshan ma de dag gis nyam thag par gyur la/ sha brad cing nyams 0stobs med par gyur pa ni dor bar bya'o/ /de ma yin pa gzhan ni sman dang ldan pa zhig na cho ga smyur te bya'o/ /kha nas rnag 'dra ba dang / bad kan dmar ba ⑦dang / sngo skya dang / ljang gu dang / sngon po dang / ser po 'byung la dbugs mi bde ba dang / lud pas dgar te nyam thag pa dang skad 'gags pa ni mi 'tsho'o /kha zas phal cher phyi sa dang gcin 'ba' zhig tu gyur la/ sha skam zhing lus zungs zad de/ phyi sa khong na yod pa tsam gyis srog zungs byas pa gang yin pa de la ni khong na yod pa de mi bkru bar rtag tu bsrung bar bya'o/ /nyams skestobs yod la gcong chen po na ba la ni/ gso ba'i las sgyug sman dang /120—538

— — ————— —/de /de——bkru sman dang / sman snar blugs pa dang / bkru sman drag po mas btang ba dang / 'jam rtsi mas te)btang ba'i las 'di lnga bya'o/ /lus kyi sha zad pa la ni las lnga po 'di dag byas na de dag nyid dug dang 'dra bar 'gyur te byar mi rung ngo / /gcong chen po na ba'i kha zas ni/ 'bras sā (0lu dang / 'bras zhag drug cu pa zhusmin pa dang / gro dang / nas dang mon sran sde'u la sogs pa dge'o/ /skom du ni chang bzang ngo / /bya nad ni bya dang ri dwags kyi sha nad de dang 'phrad pa'i sha rnams rung ngo / /de'i sman ni pi pi ling dang /rgun dang / kha ra rnams kyi phye ma til mar dang / mar sbrang rtsis sbyar ba'am/yang na a shwa garnya dang / pi pi ling dang / kha ra rnams kyi phye ma sbrang (shertsi dang zhun mar dang sbyar ba zos na gcong chen po sel bar byed do/ /yang na bu bran shing dang / rgun dang / pi pi ling dang / a ru ra dang / 'bra mego dang /bye tsher rnams lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / bu ram dang / skyu ru ra dang /'bras yos dang / kru trug tres dang / pi pi ling dang / bca' sga rnams lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / ma nu dang / li zur ba dang / ra mnye ba dang /kha ra dang / byi'u rug pa rnams lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / sman gyi sbyor ba 'di rnams las gang yang rung ba'i phye ma mar dang sbrang rtsi shas bskyed de sbyar ba zos na/ lud pa dang dbugs mi bde ba sel cing / skad 'gags pa 'byang bar 'gyur ro/ /bal bu'i lo ma dang / na le sham dang / bca' sga dang /pi pi ling rnams yas kyi rim ( bzhin du dang po cha las re res bskyed pa dang /shing tsha dang / sug smel dang / bal bu'i tshad kyi phyed phyed dang / kha ra pi pi ling gi brgyad 'gyur dang / 'di rnams btab 'aste lhan cig tu sbyar ba'i 120—539

phye ma'i sman gyis ①ni/ lud pa dang / dbugs mi bde ba dang / yi ga 'chus pa dang / mcher pa na ba dang / rims dang / skem pa'i nad dang /pho ba'i me drod chung ba rnams sel zhing snying la phan te/ 'khru ba dang / skran dang / gzhang 'brum dang / skyug pa rnams sel to/ /bca' sga dang / pi pi ling dang / na le sham dang / nā ga ge sar gyi me tog dang / shing tsha dang / sug smel dang / 'di rnams mas kyi rim bzhin du tha ma'i cha re res bskyed pa dang de rnams bsdams ①pa'i tshad dang mnyam pa'i khar dang / 'di rnams btags te sbyar ba'i phye ma ni sgog ma 'gags pa la phan zhing / snying na ba dang / skran dang / gzhang 'brum gyis nyam thag pa rnams sel to/ /shing tsha dang / sug smel dang / pi pi ling dang / spyig rkang dang / kha ra rnams yas kyi rim bzhin du dang po'i cha nyis 'gyur nyis 'gyur gyis ①bskyed de btags pa'i phye ma sbrang rtsi dang mar dhisbyar ba'i phye ma ni rtsib logs na ba dang /dbugs mi bde ba dang / lud pa sel zhing yi ga 'bye bar byed do/ /nye'u shing dang / pi da ri dang / a shwa ganta dang / a ru ra dang / purna ṇa ba dang / ba la dang / /a ti ba la dang / na ga ba la dang / gze ma rnams kyi phye ma mar dang sbrang rtsi dang sbyar te zos na zad byed kyi gcong chen po zad par byed do/ /brag zhun dang / sbrang rtsi dang / tsha ba gsum dang / drub ⑤mar cang dang lcags ④kyi phye ma rnams sbyar te zos la/ kha zas su 'bras chan dang / 'o ma ⑦ldan par za ba gang yin pa de'i gcong chen po ni myur du 'byang bar 'gyur ro/ /sbrang rtsi dang / drub mar cang dang / byi dong khrug dang /brag zhun dang / lcags kyi phye ma dang / mar dang a ru ra rnams sbyar ba za 120—540

zhing kha zas mthun zhing 'phrod pa za ba ni gcong chen po mi bzad pa sel bar 'gyur ro/ /yang na gcong chen po'i nad yod pas/ kha ra dang / sbrang rtsi dang / mar gsar sbyar ba'am/ yang na mar dang / sbrang rtsi cha mi mnyam par sbyar ba zos la/ kha zas su 'bras chan dang / 'o ma dang ldan par zos na sha brta bar 'gyur ro/ /sman nir gurnyi'i rtsa ba dang / lo ma dang bcas par brdungs pa'i khya ba mar de'i bzhi cha dang lhan cig tu skol la/ mar nyi tshe lus pa las ran par 'thungs na/ gcong chen po'i nad kyis lus zungs zad par gyur pa las slar nyams hu)stobs bskyed cing brta bar byed de nad do cog kyang sel to/ /ma nu dang / le zur ba dang / rgun dang / ba la dang /me tog utpal dang / pi pi ling dang / dzha ta dang / dzi binta dang / shing mngar dang / bya byu dang / khye lce ba dang / bye tsher dang / dug mo nyung 2 gi shun lpags dang / gze ma rnams cha mnyam ste btags lapa'i phye ma mar de'i bzhi 'gyur dang / chu mar gyi bzhi 'gyur dang lhan cig tu bskol la mar nyi tshe lus par byas te btsags dzeepa las tshod ran par khu bcud dang sbyar ba'am/sha khu 'am/ 'o ma skol ba'am/ shing kun la sogs pa skol ba gang yang rung ba dang sbyar te 'thungs na/ gcong chen po'i mtshan ma rnam pa bcu gcig dang ldan pa sel bar 'gyur ro/ /ra'i mar dang ra'i 'o ma dang ra'i zho dang ra'i gcin dang / ra'i ril ma'i khu ba 'di rnams lan tshwa rnam pa lnga dang bskol te/mar nyi tshe lus pa las ran par 'thungs la de'i rjes la/ ra'i 'o ma 'thungs na gcong chen po sel to/ /nas las byas pa'i kha zas zos la ra'i ra bar nyal te ra'i 'o ma 'thung 5zhing ra'i ril ma dang gcin gyis lus dril ba dang / khrus 120———541

/de — —— —/de —— — byas na yang zad byed kyi gcong chen po sel to/ /til mar srang sum cu rtsa gnyis/'o ma de'i bzhi 'gyur dang / shing mngar gyi phye ma srang gcig dang bskol te 'o ma du nas til mar btsags te dang zhing dri ma med par byas la/ yang 'o ma bzhi 'gyur dang / shing mngar gyi phye ma srang gcig dang bskol te 'o ma du nas til mar btsags la/ 'o ma dang shing mngar gyis snga ma bzhin du bsnan zhing /skol ba de lta bu'i tshul du shin tu bsgrims te lan brgyar skol ba'i til mar gyi btung ba dang / snar blugs pa dang / lus la 0)bsku ba dang mas btang ba rnams byas na/ gcong chen po dang / snying na ba dang / rlung nad dang skya rbab rnams sel cing / nam tshong yan chad '-ikyi nad dang / smyo byed dang /khrag lud pa'i nad dang / me dbal rnams med par byed do/ /bilba la sogs pa rtsa ba lnga pa dang / gla —sgang dang / ba la dang / lo ma rnam pa ④bzhi ste/sa la paṇi dang / sri shan paṇi dang / muṅga paṇi dang / ma sha paṇi rnams dang / ldum bu ri྾ dang / pi pi ling dang / li zur pa dang / a ru ra dang / dzi ba ka dang / zangs 5/rtsi ba dang / sle tres dang / rgun dang /bun sna ba dang / me da dang / dzi binta dang / ka ka na se ka dang / me tog utpal dang / sug smel dang / dza da dang / bu bran shing dang / bu tsha rto dang / byi tsher dang / tsan dan dang / gyi ( da ri dang / gze ma dang / bya 1 dang / ma nu rnams las srang re re dang / skyu ru ra 'bru lnga brgya dang / 'di rnams chu phul gang la srang brgyad du brtsis pa de lta bu phul drug cu rtsa bzhi'i nang du bskol te/ chu bzhi cha gcig lus pa btsags la3/khu ba'i nang du/ til mar dang / zhun mar phyed ma srang bcu gnyis dang /120 542

kha ra srang lnga bcu blugs te yang bskol la byog tu rung ba tsam du gyur te/ tshos nas phyung la bsgrangs pa'i nang du/ pi pi ling gi phye ma srang gnyis dang /spyig rkang srang bzhi dang / sbrang rtsi srang drug dang / dri sna bzhi zhes bya ba/shing tsha dang / gharnya ①pa tra dang / sug smel dang / nā ga ge sar rnams cha mnyam pa sbyar ba ②srang gcig dang / 'di rnams sbyar ba'i sman gyi sde gu'i ming ni / drang srong tsu pa na'i sman zhes bya ste/ 'di las ran par zos na/snying na ba dang / dbugs mi bde ba dang / skom ①pa'i nad dang / lud pa dang / dreg dang / zad byed kyi gcong chen po rnams kyis nyam rjothag pa sel cing / yid gzhungs pa dang / skad snyan pa dang / ro tsa bar byed de sman bcud kyis len du 'gyur ro/ /shing ka pitta'i 'bras bu dang / byi shal gnyis las srang bco lnga bco lnga dang / skyu ru ra rlon pa srang ⑤sum cu rtsa gnyis/skom rjon srang bcu drug dang / a ru ra de'i phyed dang / pi pi ling dang /e la ba lu ka dang / seng phrom dang / byi dang ga dang / na le sham rnams las srang gnyis gnyis chu phul drug cu rtsa bzhi'i nang du bskol la/ bzhi cha gcig lus pa'i khu ba btsags te bsgrangs pa'i nang du bu ram srang nyis brgya blugs te sbyar ba de 'thungs na/ gzhang 'brum dang / gcong chen po dang /mdze nad sel zhing / skrangs pa ⑦dang / skya rbab dang / rims dang /mcher pa na ba dang / snying na ba dang / mkhal rked na ba dang / skran med par byed la/ pho ba'i nad dang / mig ser dang / sha bkra ④dang / srin bu dang /yi ga 'chus pa rnams sel to/ /gcong chen po'i nad la rims la sogs pa'i nad bla gnyan gzhan zhig byung na/ gsor rung ba gang yin pa de dag so so'i gso ba'i 120—543
