cho ga bya'o/ /mdor na skem pa'i nad gcong chen po yod pa la ni lus bkru ba dang /dri ba la sogs pas lus brta zhing / nyams ())stobs bskyed par bya'o/ /gcong chen po gso ba'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o// // skran kha zas kyis (1/nyes pa dang / 'dug nyal la sogs pa gnas pa'i nyes pa las rlung la sogs pa shin tu 'khrugs nas/ khong pa'i nang du skran phur ma lta bur 'dug pa rnam pa lngar 'gyur te/ lnga po de dag gi gnas ni/ glo ①g.yas g.yon dang / snying ga dang chu so rnams yin no/ /gzhan gang de'i mtshan ma dang / gso ba'i thabs dang bcas pa yang bstan par bya ste/ de la skran no cog ni yi ga 'chus pa dang / phyi sa dang / gcin sri ba dang / rlung gi shas che ba dang / rgyu ma 'khrug pa dang / lto sbo ba dang / sgregs pa mang du 'ong ba'i mtshan ma rnams kyis rtogs par bya'o/ /de la rlung las gyur pa'i skran gyi mtshan ma ni/ zug cing gzer ba dang / lto sbo ba dang / phyi sa dang gcin 'gags pa dang / skran nyid 'phar ba dang / gnas 'pho ba dang /che chung du 'gyur ba dang / ltag pa dang / mgo bo dang / za 'gram du zug pa dang / ru shing na ba rnams yin par bstan to/ /mkhris pa las gyur pa'i skran gyi mtshan ma ni/ lus tsha ba dang / skom dad che ba dang / mgo 'khor ba dang / rngul 'byung ba dang / sgregs pa skyur ba dang / khar kha ba bro ba dang / skran nyid reg tu mi bzod pa rnams yin par bstan to/ /bad kan las gyur pa'i skran gyi mtshan ma ni/ mchil ma mang ba dang / yi ga 'chus pa dang / brang tsha zhing kha nas chu 'byung ba dang / dbugs mi bde ba dang /120 544

lud pa dang / kha zas 'jur mi btub pa dang / skran nyid sra zhing phyir rlo ba dang sgyugs skyepa rnams yin no/ /'dus pa las gyur pa'i skran gyi mtshan ma ni—/ skran nyid mi bzad par na zhing tsha 'ur 'ur por 'dug pa dang / rdo bzhin du sra zhing phyir zlo ba dang / sems dang / lus dang / me'i drod nyams par byed pa rnams yin te/ gsor mi rung ngo / /bud med kyi khrag skran ni/ mngal rlug pa dang / bu byung ba dang / zla mtshan 'dzags pa las 'gyur ②te/ skran nyid na zhing tsha ba 'ur 'ur por 'dug pa sbrum ma dang 'dra bar 'gyur ro/ /de la skran gyis nyam thag ste/ rul rngo sbal bzhin du phyi rol tu rlo zhing rtsa mngon la nad mang po bla gnyan gzhan gyis kyang thegs shing / snying ga dang / lte ba'i phyogs dang / rkang lag skrangs te mi bzod par gyur pa ni spang bar bya'o/ /de la rlung las gyur pa'i skran la ni/ thog mar sman mar blud do/ /de'i 'og tu phye ma'i sman dang / lus snum gyis bsku ba dang /dug dang / bkru sman drag po mas btang ba dang / 'jam rtsi mas btang ba rnams ④kyis gso bar bya'o/ /de la sman mar ni byi dang ga dang / 'bras bu gsum dang / tsha ba gsum dang / dbye mo'i lo ma dang / 'u su'i 'bras bu dang / kru trug tres rnams kyi mar dang / 'o ma dang / chu'i nang du bskol la mar nyi tshe la lus pa las ran par 'thungs na rlung las gyur pa'i skran sel to/ /kha ru tsha dang / nas tshig 'khus pa'i thal ba dang / shu dag dang / pu tse shel dang / a ru ra dang / kru trug tres dang / byi dang ga dang / tsha ba gsum po rnams kyi phye ma zho gnyis gnyis/ mar srang sum cu rtsa gnyis dang /'o ma de dang mnyam pa dang / chu mar gyi bzhi 'gyur gyi 5nang du bskol te/120 545

—— ——— — —— ———————/de/de———mar nyi tshe lus pa las ran par 'thungs na yang / rlung las gyur pa'i skran na ba dang / bcan du sel cing skyigs bu dang / dbugs mi bde ba dang /srin bu dang / mcher pa'i nad dang lud pa rnams sel to/ /bca' sga dang /dbyi mong dang / kru trug tres dang / pi pi ling dang / nas tshig 'khus pa'i thal ba dang / rgyam tsha rnams kyi phye ma srang re re/ sman tsi ri dang /bilba skol ba'i khu ba dang / mar srang sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi nang du bskol te mar nyi tshe lus par byas pa ni skran dang / rtug skam dang / skya rbab dang /dbugs mi bde ba dang / pho ba'i nad dang lud pa rnams sel ①cing /rims dang / cham pa drag po dang / mcher pa'i nad dang / gzhang 'brum rnams zhi bar byed pa'i mchog yin no/ /shing kun dang / star bu dang /tsha ba gsum dang / bye'u rug pa dang / sug smel dang / shu dag dang /rtsabs ṣperu tsha dang / kha ru tsha dang / 'u su'i 'bras bu dang / go snyod dang /nas tshig 'a)'khus pa'i thal ba dang / bal po'i se'u dang / ma nu dang / a dza ghanta ④/dang / li zur ba dang / kru trug tres dang / la la phud rnams kyi phye ma mar dang / zho mar dang bzhi 'gyur gyi nang du bskol te/ mar nyi tshe lus par byas pa ni rlung las gyur pa'i skran dang / zug cing na ba dang / lto sgo ba'i nad rnams sel to/ /sba ma'i 'bras bu dang / sug smel dang / kru trug tres dang / tsha ba gsum dang / dbye mong dang / la la phud dang /rgyam tsha dang / go stod dang / pi pi ling gi rtsa ba rnams kyi phye ma/ rgya shug gi 'bras bu dang / la phug lhan cig tu skol ba'i khu ba sgyur por gyur pa/ zho dang mar /5'o mar ldan pa'i nang du bskol te/ mar nyi tshe lus pas skran dang 120—— 546

/de /de——/de/de — /de— zug cing na ba dang / phyi sa 'gags pa sel cing / mngal gyi nyes pa dang /zas 'jur mi btub pa dang / gzhang 'brum dang / dbugs mi bde ba dang /snying na ba dang / rtsib logs na 1ba rnams med par byed do/ /mar dang spyor ba'i sman bstan pa 'di dag nyid zhib tu btags te chu skol ba dang / zho kha chu dang / chang dang / rtsabs skyur bo dang / tshwa rnams las gang yang rung ba dang sbyar te 'thungs na yang / skran dang / zug cing na ba la sogs pa sel bar byed do/ /shing kun dang / shu dag dang / rtsabs 2ru tsha dang /bca' sga dang / la la phud dang / a ru ra dang / kru trug tres dang / ru rta rnams yas kyi rim bzhin du/ dang po'i cha res bskyed de btags pa'i phye ma chang la sogs pa gong du smos pa gang yang rung ba dang sbyar te 'thungs na/ skran dang / lto sbo ba dang / dmu rdzings ①sel te/ zug cing na ba dang /gzhang 'brum dang / dbugs mi bde ba dang / lud pa 'joms par byed la/pho ba'i drod bskyed par bshad do/ /shing kun dang / kha lud dang / star bu dang / bal po'i se'u dang / rgyam tsha dang / rtsabs (geru tsha rnams kyi phye ma chang bzang po dang sbyar te 'thungs na yang rlung las gyur pa'i skran sel to/ /rtsabs ⑤ru tsha dang / kha ru tsha dang / star bu dang / nas tshig 'khus pa'i thal ba dang / shing kun rnams kyi phye ma zho kha chu la sogs pa gang yang rung ba dang sbyar te 'thungs na/ skran dang / zug cing na ba dang / phyi sa 'gags pas nyam thag pa bde bar byed do/ /bye dang ga dang / bri ha tī dang /danta'i rtsa ba dang / snu ha kshi ra dang / 'bras bu gsum dang / rgyam tsha rnams kyi phye ma zho gnyis gnyis mar srang brgyad dang / chu mar gyi bzhi 'gyur gyi 120—547

ke——————sdenang du bskol la/ mar nyi tshe lus pa las nyin re srang phyed phyed sha khu dang sbyar te 'thungs nas tshuthur du bkrus pas/ kha zas sha dang ldan par zos na/skran dang / rtug skam dang / mdze dang / gzhang 'brum dang / me'i drod nyams pa dang / dmu rdzings rnams med par 'gyur ro/ /shing nye rong dang /snum ha kṣi ra dang / sgyu ru ra dang / ba la ka dang / kam bi lnga ka rnams las srang re re dang / rgyam tsha srang phyed dang / 'di rnams kyi phye ma mar srang brgyad dang / chu mar gyi bzhi 'gyur gyi nang du bskol te/ mar nyi tshe lus pa'i ming ni bye bind+ra'i mar zhes bya ste/ 'di las nyin re zhing zho gnyis gnyis 'thungs la/ chu skol ba dron pos phul te thur du bkrus na skran no cog dang dmu rdzings thams cad 'joms par byed do/ /mkhris pa las gyur pa'i skran yod pa la ni/ thog mar bu tshang rto la sogs pa'i sman mar dang / ma hā nyikta zhes bya ba'i sman mar dang / ba sha ka la sogs pa'i sman mar rnams las gang yang rung ba btang ste/ lto 'jam por byas pa'i rjes la bkru sman btang nas de'i 'og tu bcud mas gtang babar bya'o/ /n+ya gro dha la sogs pa'i sde tshan dang / utpal la sogs pa'i sde tshan sngar bshad pa rnams las gang yang rung ba skol ba'i khu ba dang / mar gyi nang du sman 'tsho byed ces bya ba sna bcu sngar bstan pa rnams kyi phye ma btab ste bskol la mar nyi tshe lus pa las ran par 'thungs na mkhris pa las gyur pa'i khrag lud pa'i skran sel to/ /a ru ra'i phye ma mar a ru ra'i bzhi 'gyur dang / skyu ru ra skol ba'i khu ba mar gyi bzhi 'gyur gyi nang du btab ste bskol la mar nyi tshe lus pa las ran par 'thungs na yang mkhris pa las gyur pa'i skran myur du sel to/ /yang na mkhris pa'i skran yod pa la ni 'bras bu 120 —548

— gsum skol ba'i khu ba'i nang du shing nye rong gi phye ma btab pa blud dam/ yang na kha ra dang / kam byi la'i sbrang rtsis sbyar ba btab ste thur du bkru bar bya'o/ /bad kan las gyur pa'i sman ni dugs dang / bcing ba'i dugs dang / sman mar btung ba dang / bkru sman rnon po dang / 'jam rtsi mas btang ba rnon po dang / bkru sman drag po mas btang ba rnon ①po dang / sngar rlung skran gyi cho gar bstan pa rnams kyis kyang gso bar bya'o/ /drod bskyed pa zhes bya ba'i sman bca' sga dang / pi pi ling dang / pi pi ling gi rtsa ba dang / kru trug tres dang / dbyi mong dang / nas tshig 'khyas pa'i thal ba rnams kyi phye ma srang re re mar dang 'o ma srang sum cu rtsa gnyis gnyis dang / chu mar gyi bzhi 'gyur gyi nang du bskol te/ mar nyi tshe lus pa'i ming ni srang drug pa'i mar zhes bya ste/ 'di las ran par 'thungs na yang bad kan las gyur pa'i skran sel to//pho ba'i nad dang / skya rbab kyi nad dang / mcher pa'i ②dang / lud pa dang /dbugs mi bde ba dang / rims 'joms shing skrangs pa dang / rtug skam med par byed do/ /dong ka la sogs pa'i sde tshan skol ba'i khu ba dang / mar gyi nang du drod bskyed pa zhes bya ba'i sman rnam pa drug po gong du smos pa ( rnams btags pa'i phye ma mar nyi tshe lus pa'am/ yang na pi pi leng la sogs pa dang sbyar ba'i mar sngar bshad pa las ran par 'thungs na yang bad kan las gyur pa'i skran sel to/ /kha ru tsha dang / kru trug tres lgo/dang / shing kun rnams kyi phye ma/ dar ba dang sbyar te 'thungs na yang me'i drod bskyed do/ /rtsabs 5ru tsha dang la la phud kyi phye ma ༄dar ba dang sbyar te 'thungs na yang bad kan dang rlung dang 'phrod/ bud med kyi mngal gyi khrag las skran du gyur pa zla ba bcu 120—549

'das na 1bu ma yin te skran yin par gyur na/ sman mar blud pa dang dugs byas pas lto 'jam por byas pa'i 'og tu snum pa'i cho ga bya ste bkru sman btang ngo //shu ti dang / tsi ri bil ba'i shun lpags dang / thang shing dang / bgi dang /pi pi ling rnams kyi phye ma til mar skol ba'i khu ba dang sbyar te 'thungs na yang mngal gyi khrag las gyur pa'i skran sel to/ /til skol ba'i nang du/ bu ram dang / tsha ba gsum dang / zhun mar dang / bgi rnams kyi phye ma btab ste 'thungs na yang khrag gi skran sel to/ /bud med zla mtshan mi 'byung ba la ni/sgyu ru ra skol ba'i khu ba'i nang du shing kibyu ka'i thal ba blugs la bskol te yang blud do/ /yang na nas tshig 'khus pa'i khu ba dang / tsha ba gsum gyi phye ma chang dang sbyar te 'thungs na yang khrag gi skran sel to/ /khrag gi skran khong du gram ④ste mngal gyi khrag drag tu 'byung zhing mi chod pa la ni/ khrag lud pa'i cho ga sngar bstan pa dang / rlung nad sel ba'i cho ga sngar bstan pa rnams kyis bcad cing na ba yang zhi bar bya'o/ /rlung la sogs pa las gyur pa'i nad 'byang du mi btub pa la ni/ sman pa sngon byed pa mthong zhing goms ①pas lag pa'i rtsa gtar zhing / bad kan dang rlung las gyur pa'i skran la me btsa' gdab par bya'o—/ /skran can la ni mdor (9na/ kha zas lci ba dang / bad kan skye bar 'gyur ba'i bag spang zhing / me'i drod dang / nyams (kyestobs rtag tu bsrung bar bya ste/ kha zas dang btung ba rnams tshabs che chung las dpag cing bza' bar bya'o/ /skran gso ba'i le'u ste dgu pa rdzogs so// //de nas dmu rdzings gso ba'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /dmu rdzings ni me'i 120—550

—drod chung ba dang / kha zas mi 'phrod pa zos pas nad gzhi 'khrugs nas/lus rngul ba dang / chu grang mo 'thungs te rtsa dang 'dzag sgo rnams 'gags pa lasarka/ dmu rdzings kyi nad ma rungs pa rnam pa ①brgyad skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de la rlung las gyur pa'i dmu rdzings kyi mtshan ma ni/ ltor zug cing na ba dang /rdol la thug pa ltar na ba dang / sgra 'byung ba dang / rkang lag dang rlig pa skrangs pa dang / gnyer ma nag po 'byung zhing rtsa mngon par 'byung ba rnams yin par bshad do/ /mkhris pa las gyur pa'i dmu rdzings kyi mtshan ma ni/ lto sha reg na 'jam pa dang / rims kyis 'debs pa dang / rngul 'byung ba dang /skom dad che ba dang / lus tsha ba dang / mgo 'khor ba dang / rtsa sngon po dang / ser pos g.yogs par 'dug pa rnams yin par bshad do/ /bad kan las gyur pa'i dmu rdzings kyi mtshan ma ni/ mchil ma mang ba dang / lus lci ba dang / dbugs mi bde ba dang / gnyid che ba dang / skrangs pa dang /yi ga 'chus pa dang / rims kyis 'debs pa dang / 'byang dka' ba dang /lto 'khrang ba dang / pags pa stug pa dang / rtsa mdog dkar pos g.yogs pa rnams yin par shes par bya'o/ /'dus pa las gyur pa'i dmu rdzings ni/bud med kyi dbang du bya ba'i phyir skra dang sen mo la sogs pa byi ste snyezos pa dang /'bebs tshupar byed pa dang / lus ma rung bar byed pa'i dug las kyang 'byung ste—/ mtshan ma thams cad dang ldan pa yin par shes par bya'o/ /dmu rdzings glo g.yas phyogs su 'byung ba la ni/ mchin pa'i dmu rdzings zhes bya'o/ /g.yon phyogs su 'byung ba ni mcher 4pa'i dmu rdzings zhes bya ste/ 'di gnyis ka yang bad kan dang khrag 'khrugs pa las 'byung ste/ mkhris pa dang bad kan 120—551

gnyis 'dus pa las gyur pa yin no/ /kha zas bya sgro dang spu ①'dres pa zos te/rgyu ma 'gags te phyi sa mi 'byung ba las gyur pa'i dmu rdzings/ snying ga dang lte ba'i bar gyi nang du dmu dzings skye ba ni 'byung dka' ba yin te gzhang 'gags pa'i dmu rdzings zhes bya'o/ /kha zas zag ①rngu dang bcas pa zos na ①rgyu ma nang nas brtol te/ kha zas kyi khu ba phyir zags pa las nang du gyur te/ lte ba'i 'og tu zug cing na ba byung ba'i ming ni rgyu ma rdol ba'i dmu rdzings zhes bya ste/de'i mtshan ma ni chu sor zug pa'i mtshan ma la sogs pa sngar bshad pa dang 'dra'o//chu'i dmu rdzings zhes bya ba ni/ snum bag 'thungs sam/ sgyug sman nam bkru sman btang ba'i rjes la/ chu grang mo 'thungs pa las nad du gyur na/ lto ba'i phyogs su zlum zhing cher gyur te/ mdog snum la lto rkyal pa gang ba bzhin du gyur pa yin no/ dmu rdzings rnam pa brgyad po 'di rnams kyi nang du rgyu ma brdol ba'i dmu sprungs dang / gzhang 'gags pa'i dmu rdzings gnyis ni gsor mi rung ngo / /lhag ma gzhan ni gso dka' bar bshad de/ de dag las kyang chu'i dmu rdzings su pegyur pa ni spang bar bya'o/ /de la rlung las gyur pa'i dmu rdzings la ni sman dzre ra la sogs pa'i sde tshan khyebatags pa'i phye ma dang / skol ba'i sman mar blud pa dang / dugs bya ba dang / snum bag gi bkru sman btang la lto zhi bar gyur nas—/ lto phyir mi skye bar ras kyis bcing ba dang / nad de dang 'phrod pa'i sman sbyar bas lto bskus pa'i steng nas/ pags pa drod che zhing spu 'jam la ma rul ba la lig to byas pa'am/ de med na dar srin bal can gyi lig to'am/lug lpags kyis bcings pa'i dugs byas la/ kru trug tres kyi phye ma ⑥dang /til mar lhan cig skol ba'i 'jam rtsi mas btang ba dang / sman sbi ra la sogs 120 552

pa'i sde tshan skol ba'i khu ba dang / sbyar ba'i bkru sman drag po mas btang ba dang / kha zas 'o ma dang / khu bcud dang sha khu gang yang rung ba dang ldan par bza' ba rnams rim bzhin du bya'o/ /mkhris pa las gyur pa'i dmu rjings la ni/ thog mar 'jam rtsi sman ro mngar ba'i phye ma dang mar skol ba 'thungs la/de'i 'og tu shing nye rong dang / 'bras bu gsum gyi phye ma mar gyi nang du skol ba'i bkru sman btang ngo / /yang na shing n+ya gro dha la sogs pa'i sde tshan skol ba'i khu ba mar dang skol la mar nyi tshe lus pa sbrang rtsi dang kha ra dang sbyar bas bkru sman drag po mas gtang ①bar bya ste/ de yang sngar 'jam rtsi mas btang ba dang ldan par bya'o/ /'jam rtsi mas btang ba ni/ n+ya gro dha la sogs pa'i sde tshan skol ba'i khu ba'i nang du sman gyi sde tshan de nyid kyi phye ma dang / til mar dang lhan cig tu bskol te/ til mar nyi tshe lus pa btsags pa btang ngo / /de nas 'bras kyi 'o thug bska ④bas bcing ba'i dugs bya ste①/ kha zas kyang sman sbi ra la sogs pa'i sde tshan skol ba'i khu ba 'o ma dang bskol la 'o ma nyi tshe lus pa dang ldan par bza'o/ /bad kan las gyur pa'i dmu rdzings la ni thog mar 'jam rtsi pi pi ling la sogs pa dang sbyar ba'i sman mar sngar bshad pa btang nas dugs byas pa'i 'og tu/ shing snu ha ga shi ri dang / skol ba'i mar gyi bkru sman btang ngo / /de nas sman mu ska ka la sogs pa'i sde tshan skol ba'i khu ba til mar dang / ba gcin dang / tsha ba gsum gye phye ma rnams dang sbyar ba'i bkru sman drag po mas gtang ④bar bya zhing / 'jam rtsi mas btang ba'i cho ga yang bya ste/'jam rtsi mas gtang ba ni 5sman gyi sde tshan gong ma nyid skol ba'i khu ba dang (6/til mar dang / tsha ba gsum gyi phye ma lhan cig tu bskol te til mar nyi tshe lus 120—— —553

pa btsags pa btang ngo / /de nas phabs dang / la phug gi sa bon dang /yungs kar rnams sbyar re bas bcing ba'i dugs bya'o/ /kha zas ni rgya sran gyi khu bcud dam 'o ma tsha ba gsum dang ldan pas dpag cing bza'o/ /'dus pa las gyur pa'i dmu rdzings la ni/ rlung las gyur pa'i dmu rdzings la sogs gong du sgos pa rnams kyi cho ga sngar bstan pa de dag thams cad kyang sbyar bar bya'o/ /yang na 'di la ni/ bog dang / shaṃ ki ni'i phye ma dang mar lhan cig tu skol ba'i bkru sman yang btang ngo / /mcher ①ba'i dmu rdzings can la yang /'jam rtsi dang / dugs dang / /bkru sman la sogs pa'i cho ga byas la/lag pa g.yon pa'i gru mo'i nang gi rtsa yang gtar bar bya'o/ /bye dang ga dang /kru trug tres dang / rgyam tsha dang / bye dang / shu dag rnams cha ma chom du brdungs la mar gyis bskus ④te/ snod kha sbyar gyi nang du bsnos ④nas/ zhib tu btags la 'o ma dang sbyar te 'thungs na yang skran dang mcher 0pa'i dmu rdzings sel to/ /yang na le sham dkar po skol ba'i khu ba/ rgyam tsha dang /kru trug tres dang / pi pi leng rnams kyi phye ma dang sbyar ba'am/ yang na na le sham dkar po skol ba'i khu ba ⑤shing ba la sha'i thal ba dang / nas tshig 'khus pa'i thal ba dang sbyar te blud do/ /ro nyi ta ka dang / a ru ra'i phye dum ba gcin nam/ chu'i nang du spangs te/ 'thungs na yang dmu rdzings thams cad dang / mcher dzeepa'i nad dang / gcin snyi ba'i nad dang / gzhang 'brum dang / srin bu dang / skran sel to/ /yang na rgyam tsha 'am skenya phyibs bsregs pa'i thal ba 'o ma dang sbyar te tshod ran par btung bar bya'o/ /yang na 'cher ⑫pa'i dmu rdzings la/ pi pi ling gi phye ma 'o ma dang sbyar te blud do/ /120—554

/de— /de—— —mtsher pa'i dmu rdzings gso ba'i cho gar bstan pa de thams cad ni mchin pa'i dmu rdzings la yang gtang 6bar bya'o/ /yang na mchin pa'i dmu rdzings la ni/lag pa g.yas pa'i gru mo'i nang gi rtsa gtar bar bya'o/ /dmu rdzings rnams la ni phyi sa la sogs pa lto'i dri ma shas che bas ni/ bkru sman lan mang du bya bar bstan to/ /de nas de'i 'og tu dmu rdzings kyi spyi'i cho ga zhes pa yang bstan par bya ste/ dmu rdzings la ni e raspyo'i mar 'o ma dang ba gcin gang yang rung ba dang sbyar te lan mang du btung ⑤/bar bya'o/ /yang na til mar shing kun dang /swa rtsi ka'i thal ba dang sbyar ba'am/ sman bye ti ka'i phye ma 'o ma dang sbyar ba blud do—/ /mar srang sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / 'o ma mar gyi brgyad 'gyur gyi nang du/snu ha kṣi ri srang gcig dang / shing nye rong gi phye ma srang drug bskol la/ mar nyi tshe lus par byas te/ btsags pa las ran par 'thungs na yang dmu rdzings dang skran sel to/ /'bras bu gsum dang / bya rnu dang / pog dang / shi drod dang / shu dag dang / khyi lce ba dang / spa ma'i 'bras bu dang / pu tse shel dang / shing nye rod dang / rgyam tsha dang / pi pi ling gi phye ma ba gcin dang / chu skol ba dron mo dang / sha khu rnams las gang yang rung ba dang sbyar te 'thungs na yang skran dang / dmu rdzings dang / mtsher pa'i nad dang /mje dang / gzhang 'brum dang / khrag tshad dang / skrangs pa 'or thabs rnams kyis nyam ④thag pa thams cad sel to/ /sman big sha la dang / shing khi ni dang / danda'i rtsa ba dang / shing nye rong dang / shing dong dang /'bras bu gsum dang / yung dang / bye dang ga dang / rka bi bye ka rnams kyi phye ma/ ba gcin dang sbyar te 'thungs na yang dmu rdzings sel to/ /zhag 120—555

bdun gyi bar du kha zas dang skom gzhan mi bza' mi btung bar/ ma te'i gcin dang 'o ma sbyar ba 'ba' zhig btung ngam / yang na zla ba gcig gi bar du kha zas dang skom gzhan mi bza' mi btung bar/ rnga mo'i 'o ma 'ba' zhig 'thungs na yang skrangs pa 'or thabs su skrangs pa dang dmu rdzings sel to/ /yang na dmu rdzings can la pi pi ling gi phye ma shing snu ha'i 'o ma zags pa'i nang du sbangs pa las ci ran par btung ngo / /yang na dmu rdzings zhi bar bya ba'i phyir/dbye mong dang / danda'i rtsa ba dang / kru trug tres dang / bye dang ga dang /tsha ba gsum rnams kyi phye ma 'o ma dang sbyar ba'am/ yang na thang shing dang /kru trug tres kyi phye ma 'o ma dang / sga skol ba'i khu ba gnyis las gang yang rung ba dang sbyar ba 'am/ yang na dbyi mong dang / bca' sga'i phye ma 'o ma dang sga skol ba'i khya ba gnyis las gang yang rung ba dang sbyar te btung bar bya'o/ /nas tshig 'khus pa'i thal ba dang / swa rtsi ka'i thal ba dang / kru trug tres dang /tsha ba gsum dang / shi dong dang / lan tshwa rnam lnga rnams kyi phye ma mar khu dang sbyar te 'thungs na/ skran dang dmu rdzings thams cad sel to/ /dmu rdzings so cog bsal ba'i phyir/ sman byi sha la dang / shing ki ni dang / danda'i rtsa ba dang / shi dong dang / byi tsher rnams kyi phye ma ba gcin dang sbyar te btung bar bya'o/ /mdor na dmu rdzings so cog ni/ phal cher nad gzhi mang po 'dus pa las byung bas na/ de'i phyir dmu rjings so cog la rlung la sogs pa'i nad gzhi rnams zhi bar bya ba'i cho ga bya'o/ /rgyu ma rdol ba'i dmu sprungs dang /chu'i dmu rdzings dang / gzhang 'gags pa'i dmu rdzings 'di gsum la ni/sman pa cho ga shes pas so shi rdo bar dam bcas la lta dbug pa dang dral ba'i cho ga 120 556

— —/de —— /de — ——— yang bya'o/ /dmu rdzings rnams kyis nyam thag pa'i kha zas su ni/ /'bras sā lu rnams dang / nas dang / mon sran sde'u dang / 'o ma dang / srog chags rnams skam sa na gnas pa'i sha khu rnams nyams /nastobs las dpags te dal ①zhing btung bar bya'o/ /dmu rdzings can la ni chu btung ba dang nyin par gnyid log pa dang / kha zas phyi ba dang / bad kan bskyed pa'i bag dang drag shul gyi bag mi bya'o/ /bzhon pa la zhon pa rnams yongs su spang bar bya'o/ /dmu rdzings gso ba'i le'u ste bcu pa rdzogs so// //de nas gcin snyi ba'i nad gso ba bshad par bya ste/ kha zas mi 'phrod pa zos pa dang / 'dug nyal la sogs pa gnas pa'i nyes pa las/ gcin snyi ba'i nad rnam pa nyi shu 'byung ④ bar bshad de/ de yang gcin snyi ba'i nad du gyur phyigacin snyi ba'i nad yin no zhes drang srong thub pa rnams kyis gsungs so/ /gcin snyi ba'i nad des thog mar 'debs pa'i mtshan ma ni/ so la sogs pa shin tu dri ma che bar 'gyur ba dang / rkang lag tsha ba dang / lus kyi mdog dmar por gyur pa dang / skom dad che ba dang / khar mngar ba bro ba rnams yin no/ /de la bad kan las gyur pa'i gcin snyi ba'i nad kyi ming ni/ chu 'dra ba zhes bya ba dang bu ram shing gi khu ba dang 'dra ba dang / chang 'dra ba dang /'bras phye 'dra ba dang / phye ma 'dra ba dang bska ba dang / 'bred pa dang /lan tshwa 'dra ba dang / dbu ba 'dra ba dang / khu chu 'dra ba zhes bya ba dang rnam pa bcu'o/ /mkhris pa las gyur pa'i gcin snyi ba'i nad kyi ming ni ljang ser zhes bya ba dang / sngon po dang / btsod kha dang / thal kha dang / khrag 720 557

'dra ba dang / sgyur ba tshos pa zhes bya ba dang rnam pa drug go/ /rlung las gyur pa'i gcin snyi ba'i nad kyi ming ni/ mar khu dang 'dra ba zhes bya ba dang /sbrang rtsi 'dra ba dang / glang po che'i gcin 'dra ba dang / zhag 'dra ba zhes bya ba dang rnam pa bzhi'o/ /gcin snyi ba'i nad 'di dag thams cad kyi mtshan ma ni/so so'i ming du smos pa'i don bzhin du lta'o/ /de la bad kan las gyur pa rnams ni gso sla bar bshad do/ /rlung las gyur pa rnams ni/ gsor mi rung bar mthong ngo / /mkhris pa las gyur pa rnams ni/ kha zas dang / sman gyis gso tsam du 'jog nus so/ /de las bad kan las gyur pa'i gcin snyi ba'i nad yod pa la ni/ sman la la phud dang / padma'i rtsa ba dang / sle tres dang /a ru ra rnams lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / ba tha dang / skyer pa dang / bye dang ga dang / yung dang / ardzu na dang / byi tsher rnams lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / bye dang ga dang / yung dang / skyer pa dang / a ru ra dang /rgya spos lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / shing sā hu)la dang / ardzu na dang / ka dam pa dang / skyer pa dang / la la phud rnams lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang /tsan dan dkar po dang / a ka ru dang / ru rta dang / thang shing rnams lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / katpa la dang / gla sgang dang / pa tha dang / ti ri ta dang / a ru ra rnams lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / saṃ dzupa rja dang /seng ldeng dang / skyer pa dang / armi 7mand+ra dang / 'bras bu gsum po rnams lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / sman gyi sbyor ba bdun po 'di rnams las/gang yang rung ba skol ba'i khu ba bsgrangs la/ sprang rtsi dang shas cher sbyar te blud do—/ /mkhris pa las gyur pa'i gcin snyi ba'i nad yod pa la ni/ pa ṭo la 120—558

dang / nisbra'i lo ma dang / sle tres dang / skyu ru ra dang / gla sgang rnams lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / a ru ra dang / skyu ru ra dang / pu shel tse dang /ni la ba ri dang / gla sgang rnams lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / padma'i rtsa ba dang /shug pa dang / gla sgang dang / a ru ra dang / dug mo nyung rnams lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / u di hye stidang / dha ta ka'i me tog dang / seng phrom dang /ka le ya ka rnams lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / utpa la dang / pu shel tse dang /seng phrom dang / ardzu na dang / tsan dan dkar po rnams lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / sman gyi sbyor ba lnga po 'di rnams las gang yang rung ba skol ba'i khu ba bsgrangs la sbrang rtsi dang sbyar te blud do/ /gcin snyi ba'i nad la/ rlung gtso bor gyur la/ bad kan dang / mkhris pa gnyis las/ gcig grogs su gyur na/ gang grogs su gyur pa rtogs par bya ste/ bad kan grogs su gyur pa la ni de dang 'phrad lapa'i sman ro tsha zhing drod che ba'i mthu dang ldan pa rnams kyi bye ma til mar dang / sman gyi khu ba til mar gyi bzhi 'gyur gyi nang du bskol te/til mar nyi tshe lus pa las ci ran par blud do/ /mkhris pa grogs su gyur pa la ni—/ de dang 'phrod chapa'i sman ro mngar zhing bsel snyeba'i mthu dang ldan pa rnams kyi phye ma/ mar dang / sman gyi khu ba mar gyi bzhi 'gyur gyi nang du bskol te mar nyi tshe lus pa ci ran par blud do/ /sle tres rlon pa'i khu ba btsir ba'am—/ skam po skol ba'i bsgrangs pa la sbrang zhertsi dang sbyar te 'thungs na yang gcin snyi ba'i nad thams cad sel to/ /sgyu ru ra rlon pa btsir ba'i khu ba'am/skam po btsos pa'i khu ba bsgrangs pa'i nang du yung gi phye ma dang sbyar ba'am/yang na 'bras bu gsum dang / thang shing dang / skyer pa dang / gla sgang 120——559

rnams skol ba'i khu ba bsgrangs la/ sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba'am/ yang na dug mo nyung gi shing sapta rṇa dang / skyer pa dang / kru trug tres dang / 'bras bu gsum po rnams bskol ba'i khu ba bsgrangs pa sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba 'thungs na gcin snyi ba'i nad sel to/ /shing sā rmi1la dang / spuska ra dang / shaṃ bi ka rnams kyi phye ma zho gnyis gnyis skyu ru ra'i khu ba dang sbrang rtsir sbyar te 'thungs na yang gcin snyi ba'i nad thams cad sel ba'i mchog yin no/ /yang na 'bras bu gsum gyi phye ma sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba'am/ brag zhun sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba'am/lcags kyi phye ma sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba'am/ a ru ra'i phye ma sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba'am/ /sman gyi lde gu gcin snyi ba'i nad bzlog pa'i phyir bza' bar bya'o/ /seng phrom dang / sug smel dang / kru trug tres dang / danda'i rtsa ba dang / pa tha dang / gandha pa tra dang / shing tsha dang / nā —ga ge sar dang / gla ba dang / ma nu dang / tsha ba gsum dang / rtsa mkhris dang / thang shing 5/dug mo nyung dang / bi shal dang / bong nga dkar po dang / bgi dang /ru rta dang / mu rwa dang / gandha thra yo 6 ku dang / byi dang ga 7dang /'bras bu gsum dang / pu tse shel dang / dbyi mong dang / pi pi ling dang /rtsa ba dang/ la la phud rnams kyi phye ma zho gnyis gnyis chu phul gang la srang brgyad du brtsis pa phul drug cu rtsa bzhi'i nang du bskol te/ chu bzhi cha gcig lus nas bsgrangs te btsags la/ sbrang rtsi sman gyi khu ba gdus pa de'i phye dang sbyar nas/ bum pa mar snod du byas pa'i nang du drugs te kha bcad la zla ba phyed kyi bar du nas kyi nang du bzhag pa'i sbrang chang 'di las nyin re bzhin srang gnyis gnyis 'thungs na yang gcin snyi ba'i nad sel zhing / pho ba'i nad dang /120—560

skya rbab kyi nad dang / gzhang 'brum dang / mdze dang / yi ga 'chus pa rnams 'joms par byed do/ /gcin snyi ba'i nad yod pa'i kha zas ni/ tshod ma kha ba'i bag dang / skam sa na gnas pa'i ri dwags sha bkra'i sha dang / bya sha dang / nas las byas pa'i kha zas dang / mon sran sde'u dang / 'bras sā 7lu dang / zhag drug cu smin pa rnams dge'o/ /skom du ni bu ram dang /rgun chang dang / seng ldeng gi snying po la sogs pa skol ba'i khu ba dang / sbrang chang dang / rtswa ku sha skol ba'i khu ba dang / 'bras bu gsum skol ba'i khu ba rnams gcin snyi ba'i nad la bsngags pa yin no/ /gcin snyi ba'i nad kyi rkyen gyis phol mig rnams mang po 'byung ste/ thog ma 'byung ba'i tshe ni rtsa nas khrag dbyung byubar bya'o/ /phol mig smin pa ni brtol la rma gso ba'i cho ga bzhin du bya'o / /gcin snyi ba'i nad gso ba'i le'u ste bcu gcig pa rdzogs so// //sman dpyad gces pa grub pa zhes bya ba bam po bzhi pa'o/ /de nas mdze nad gso ba'i le'u bshad par bya'o/ /mdze nad ni sdig can dang / kha zas ngan pa zos te nad gzhi gsum 'khrugs nas/ pags pa dang / sha dang /khrag dang / chu ser rnams ma rung bar gyur pa la mdze nad rnam pa bco brgyad du 'gyur te/ mdze nad u dusthā 4ra zhes bya ba/ u dusthā chora'i 'bras bu 'dra ba dang / sha gzi gu zhes bya ba dung gi kha dog 'dra ba dang / ka ka na zhes bya ba 'ol ge ma se'i 'bras bu smin pa dang 'dra ba dang / pags pa shul grub ces bya ba glang po che'i pags pa 'dra ba dang / padma dkar po zhes bya ba rang gi ming gi mdog 'dra ba dang / ri dwags ri sha'i lce 'dra ba zhes bya ba rtsub po dang /120—561

/derma kha brgya pa zhes bya ba 1rma mang po dang / khyab pa rdul med ces bya ba dang /pags pa myags pa zhes bya ba pags pa zad pa dang / rkang pa zhigs pa zhes bya ba rkang pa ser ga mang po 'gas pa dang / mdze nad rnam pa bcu po 'di dag ni gsor mi rung ngo / /lhag ma brgyad ni gsor rung ba yin te/ mdze nad gya mo 'dra ba zhes bya ba mdog gnag cing rtsub pa dang / me dbal zhes bya ba rma kha chen po dang / 'brum bu phra mo zhes bya ba sha rmen ⑤'dra zhing / mdog sngo skyar 'dug pa dang / shu ba zhes bya ba 'brum bu mang po phyogs gcig nas 'bud pa ①dang / sha bkra zhes bya ba ku ba'i me tog 'dra ba dang / zig le zhes bya ba mdog sdum zhing 'byang dka' ba dang / g.yan pa zhes bya ba 'brum bu mdog dkar zhing dmar ba dang / rkang shu zhes bya ba 'brum bu 'dzag pa rnams so/ /de la rlung las gyur pa'i mdze ni/ mkhrang zhing mdog sngo skyar 'dug pa dang dmar zhing rtsub la mi bzad par na ba yin no/ /mkhris pa las gyur pa'i mdze ni lus tsha zhing shin tu myags la khrag 'dzag pa yin par bshad do/ /bad kan las gyur pa'i mdze nad ni lus rul zhing pags pa stug la g.ya' zhing mdog sgrum pa dang dkar zhing lci ba yin no/ /de la nad gzhi gsum las gyur pa'i mdze nad kyi mtshan ma ni tshul thams cad dang ldan pa'am/ nad bla gnyan mang pos thebs pa gang yin pa de ge ni spang bar bya'o/ /mdze bo cog ni phal cher nad gzhi gsum char 'dus pa dang / khrag rgyas pa las 'byung bar bshad pas na/mdze nad 5/tshabs chen po nyams stobs yod la sngar yang snum bcud btang ba la ni rtsa gtar zhing khrag dbyung bar bya'o/ /mjo nad tshabs chung ngu la ni zhal zhal gdab pa dang / rngab rus gzhibs ()pa dang / ku bas khrag drang ba dang /120—562

srin bu pad pa la 'jib tu gzhug ①go/ /nad gzhi ci 'dra ba las skyug sman dang bkru sman yang btang ngo / /mdze nad gtar ga byar mi rung ba dang /tshor ba med pa bem bem po la ni sman mu ka'i thal ba dang / til gyi sog ④ma'i thal ba la sogs pas gdab bo/ /mdze tshor ba med pa bem bem bor gyur pa dang / pags pa mkhrang por 'dug pa dang 'byang du mi btub pa rnams la ni/mda' dug la sogs pas sngags dang ldan par bya ste lus la bsku bar bya'o/ /pa to la dang / 'bras ①bu gsum dang / a riṣṭa dang / sle tres dang / dha ba ni dang / ba sha ka dang / ka rañdza rnams btags pa'i phye ma dang chu mar gyi bzhi dhi'agyur gyi nang du bskol te/ mar nyi tshe lus pa btsags pa'i ming ni rdo rje can zhes bya ste/ de las ran par 'thungs na mdze nad sel to/ /kha ba chen po ci khrugs zhes bya ba'i mar ni/ rtsa mkhris dang / 'bras bu gsum dang /pu shel tse dang / pa ṭha ⑤dang / a riṣṭa dang / gla sgang dang / bye tsher dang / shing mngar dang / thal tres rnam gnyis dang / pu tse shel dang /khyi lce ba dang / tsan dan dkar po dang / sle tres dang / pi pi ling dang /shug pa dang / shu dag dang / pi sha la dang / dug mo nyung gi 'bras bu dang /ba sha ka dang / murba dang / pa to la dang / dong ka dang / sro ( lo dang /bong nga dkar po dang / yung dang / ba mkhal dang / nye'u shing gi rtsa ba dang / 'di rnams kyi phye ma spyir mar gyi bzhi cha gcig dang / skyu ru ra'i khu ba mar gyi nyis 'gyur dang / chu mar gyi brgyad 'gyur dang / 'di rnams mar dang bskol te mar nyi tshe lus par byas nas btsags te/ de las ran par zos na yang rlung dang mkhris pa las gyur pa'i nad drag po dang / mdze dang /120 —563

'bras dang / skya rbab rnams sel cing / rims dang spyo ba dang / 'bras kyi phreng ba rnams med par byed do/ /mkhris pa dang / khrag shas ①che ba'i mdze nad la ni/ mar pa ṭo la'i phye ma dang skol ba'am/ skyer pa'i phye ma dang skol ba'am—/ seng ldeng gi phye ma dang skol ba'am/ nim pa'i phye ma dang skol ba'i mar blud sdedo/ /yang na sman a brta ka'i phye ma srang brgyad mar srang sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / chu srang brgya'i nang du bskol te/ mar nyi tshe lus pa las ci ran par rtsabs dron po dang sbyar te 'thungs la sman khong du zhu ba'i 'og tu zas su ko dra ba'i chan bza' bar bya ste/ zhag bdun gyi bar du nyin re bzhin cho ga de ltar byas pa'i 'og tu zhag gsum gyi bar du sman mi btang bar mthun zhing 'phrod pa'i kha zas zos la/ yang zhag bdun gyi bar du sman gyi cho ga snga ma ltar bya ba de lta bur ma sos kyi bar du byas na/ mdze dang / skran dang / dmu rdzings dang / mtshan par rdol ba'i nad rnams las thal bar 'gyur ro/ /yang na dzā ①ti ka'i 'bras bu dang / sna ma'i me tog dang / tsha ba gsum pa rjornams btags la/ 'bru mar dang sbyar ba'am/ yang na ldong ros dang /na le sham btags pa'i til mar dang / shing arga'i lo ma rnams ⑤lus la bskus na yang mdze'i nad do pecog sel to/ /a ru ra dang / ka rañdza dang /yungs kar dang / yung dang / bal guñdza dang / rgyam tshwa ⑦dang / byi dang ka /rnams lhan cig tu btags la ba gcin dang sbyar te lus bskus na yang mdze nad sel to/ /ru rta dang / a raṇḍa gedang / e da ga dza rnams lhan cig tu til mar ram/ ba gcin dang sbyar te lus la labaskus na yang mdze nad thub po—/ /seng phrom dang / skyer khaṇḍa dang / rgyam tshwa dang / phra puṇḍa rnams 120 564

kyang bsku ba'i rnam grangs su bshad do/ /ru rta dang / rgyam tsha snedang /yungs kar dang / byi dang ga dang / e da ga dza rnams lhan cig tu btags la rtsabs dang sbyar te bskus na yang shu ba dang mdze zig le zhes bya ba sel to/ /mu zi dang / ba bla dang / ldong ros dang / ru rta dang / sman ka li dang /pu shel tse dang / gandha pa tra rnams btags la chu dang sbyar te bskus na yang sha bkra ②la sogs pa mdze'i ①nad do cog sel to/ /garnya pa tra dang / na le sham dang / nag tshur dang / ru rta dang / ldong ros rnams kyi phye ma til mar dang sbyar la/ khar ba'i snod kyi nang du zhag bdun gyi bar du bzhag ste lus la bskus na yang sha bkra ④dang / sha gzi gu med par byed do/ /mu zi dang /nas tshig 'khus pa'i thal ba'am/ chu shing gi thal ba'am/ shing kha ra'i me tog gi thal ba gang yang rung ba til mar dang sbyar te lus bskus na yang sha bkra sel bar byed do/ /sman da ku na nyi rma bya'i mkhris pa dang sbyar ba'am/ sman pa la ka'i thal ba rma bya'i mkhris pa dang sbyar ba'am/ sna ma'i me tog glang po che'i rdul las sbyar ba rnams las gang yang rung bas lus la bskus na yang sha gzi gu med par byed do/ /ru rta dang / sman a shu mar dang / shing arga'i shun lpags dang / rgyam tsha rgyadang / pu shel tse dang / kru trug tres rnams kyi phye ma ba gcin dang til mar gyi nang du bskol te til mar nyi tshe lus pa lus la stibasgus na yang mdze nad sel to/ ru rta dang / a shwa mar dang / bhing ga ra dza dang / arga dang / rgyam tsha ⑦rnams kyi phye ma ba gcin dang / shing sgru laha'i lo ma dang / til mar gyi nang du bskol la til mar nyi tshe lus pa'i nang du mda' dug cung zad tsam btab ste lus la bskus na yang shu ba dang / rkang shu 120—565

la sogs pa sel to/ /btsod dang / 'bras bu gsum dang / rgya skyegs dang /yung dang / ldong ros dang / ba bla ①dang / mu zi rnams zhib tu btags pa'i phye ma til mar dang sbyar te nyi tshan gye drod kyis bsros pa lus la skebaskus na yang g.yan pa sel bar byed do/ /sman ka ka na si ka dang / u dusthā ①ra dang /nispa dang / gla sgang dang / tsha ba gsum dang / bye dang ga rnams kyi phye ma nidza skol ba'i khu ba dang sbyar te 'thungs na ④yang pags pa'i nyes pa'o cog sel to—/ /sle 5༄tres skol ba'i khu ba dang / 'bras bu gsum skol ba'i khu ba dang /ba gcin skol ba dron mo rnams las gang yang rung ba gu gul dang sbyar te zla ba gcig gi bar du 'thungs na yang pags pa'i nyes pa dang / rma dang lus skem pa rnams sel to/ brag zhun dang / yung dang / skyer khaṇḍa rnams las gang yang rung ba sbrang rtsi dang ba gcin gyis sbyar te zla ba gcig gi bar du 'thungs na yang / mdze dang skya rbab kyi nad sel to/ /zhag bdun gsum gyi bar du khang pa dron po 'am/ nyi ma tsha ba la 'dug cing / sman tsha ba skol ba'i khu ba dron mo dang / sman pa ku ci'i khu ba dang sbyar te 'thungs la kha zas 'o ma dang ldan par zos na yang mje las thar ④bar 'gyur ro/ /ba ku ci'i phye ma mar sar dang sgrang rtsir sbyar ⑦te zos la/ de'i rjes la dar ba 'thungs shing / kha zas kyang dar ba dang spags te zos na mdze nad kyi 'jigs pa med do/ /til dang / mar dang / 'bras bu gsum dang / sbrang rtsi dang / tsha ba gsum dang / go bye dang / kha ra dang / rnam pa 'di bdun cha mnyam ste sbyar ba'i ming ni bdun cha mnyam pa zhes bya ste/ de las ci ran par zos na ro tsa zhing yid gzhungs par byed la/ mdze nad sel te 'di la cho ga bsrung ba med do/ /120——566

byi dang ga dang / kru trug tres dang / kha ra dang / sgyu ru ra dang / lcags kyi so dog dang / pi pi leng rnams kyi phye ma til mar dang sbyar te zos na mdze'i /3nad do cog shin tu tshabs che ba yang sel bar 'gyur te/ a ru ra dang /til dang / go nyabye rnams kyi phye ma bu ram dang sbyar te brdzis pa zos na yang mdze nad sel to/ /go bye dang / byi dang ga dang / so ma ra tsi ka rnams kyi phye ma bu ram dang brdzis pa 'am/ bye dang ga dang / 'bras bu gsum dang /pi pi ling rnams kyi phye ma sbrang rtsi dang brdzis pa zos ①na yang / mdze dang /srin bu dang / gcin snye ba'i nad dang / rma 'khyims pa dang mtshan par rdol gyi nad rnams sel bar byed do/ /pags pa'i nyes pa zhi bar bya ba la dug mo nyung gi phye ma mar khu dang sbyar ba yang btung bar bya'o/ /yang na til dang /so ④ma ra dza ka'i phye ma cha mnyam ste sbyar ba cho ga bsrungs bzhin du lo gcig gi bar du bza' 'o/ /seng ldeng dang / brag zhun dang / sbrang rtsi dang /zhun mar dang / byi dang ga rnams sbyar te zos nas lacho ga bzhin du bsrungs na/skrangs mdze dang / skrangs pa'i nad ring po mi thogs par 'byang bar 'gyur ro/ /seng ldeng gi rtsa ba bsregs pa'i khu ba bum pa'i nang du bzags pa/ sgyu ru ra'i khu ba dang mar dang sbrang ke rtsi dang sbyar te zos na yang mdze nad sel zhing sman bcud kyis len du 'gyur ro/ /seng sdeng skol ba'i khu ba bsgrangs pa sbrang rtsi dang skyer khaṇḍa dang sbyar ba'am/ yang na 'bras bu gsum dang / byi dang ga'i phye ma mar dang sbrang rtsir pesbyar te zos na yang mdze nad sel to/ /seng ldeng skol ba'i khya bas lus la (8bsku ba dang / lus la ()dril ba dang / khrus bya ba dang / btung ba dang / kha zas g.yo ba'i chu la sogs pa rshasrud cing rtag tu 120—567

'thungs na mdze nad pags pa'i nyes pa thams cad sel to/ /ji ltar seng ldeng mdze kyend bzlog pa'i cho gar sbyar ba ①bzhin du/ shi ①sha ba dang / dong ka dang / a riṣṭa dang / skyer pa dang / shing ro hi ta ka dang a sa na rnams kyang de bzhin du bya'o/ /mjo gend can la ni kha zas su 'bras sā ⑤lu dang /ko dra ba dang / gro dang / nas dang / mon sran sde'u la sogs 0gang bu can rnying pa rnams dang / tshod ma ro kha ba'i bag dang / ri dwags skam sa na gnas pa'i sha )dang sbyar ba rnams phan zhing 'phrod pa yin no/ /mdze nad gso ba'i le'u bcu gnyis pa rdzogs so// //de nas gzhang 'brum dang / mtshan par rdol gyi le'u bshad par bya'o/ /de nas gzhang 'brum ni nad gzhi gsum re re las gyur pa dang / kun 'dus pa las gyur pa dang / khrag ⑧nad las gyur pa dang / thog ma nas lhan cig skyes pa dang rnam pa drug yod de/ gzhang ka'i gnyer ma gsum ⑨yod pa'i gnas su 'byung bar rig par bya'o/ /de la rlung las gyur pa'i gzhang 'brum gyi mtshan ma ni—/ 'brum bu chung zhing ma rgyas pa dang / skam pa dang / rtsa dmar zhing sngo skyar 'dug pa 4 snadang / snum bag med cing rtsub pa dang / 'brum bu rnams mtho dman yod cing mi mnyam pa dang / na zhing 'gag par byed pa la sogs pa rlung gi tshul thams cad dang ldan pa yin no/ /mkhris pa las gyur pa'i gzhang 'brum gyi mtshan ma ni/ mdog dmar zhing ser la gnag ste reg tu mi bzod cing / 'jam la khrag 'dzag cing chu ser can la mgo 'khor zhing lus tsha ba la sogs pa mkhris pa'i /1tshul rnams dang ldan pa yin no/ /bad kan las gyur 720—568

pa'i gzhang 'brum gyi mtshan ma ni/ mdog dkar ba dang ser skyar 'dug pa 3dang / 'byang dka' ba dang / snum zhing 'byil ba dang / 'brum bu che zhing tshor ba med pa dang / bad kan gyi tshul rnams dang ldan pa yin no/ /kun 'dus pa las gyur pa'i gzhang 'brum dang / thog ma nas lhan cig skyes pa'i gzhang 'brum gyi tshul ni thams cad kyi mtshan ma dang ldan pa yin no/ /khrag las gyur pa'i gzhang 'brum gyi mtshan ma ni mdog dmar zhing khrag 'dzag pa yin par bstan to/ /de la nang gi gnyer ma'i gnas su 'byung ba dang / nad gzhi (nagasum 'dus pa las gyur pa dang / thog ma nas lhan cig skyes pa 'di gsum ni spang bar bya'o/ /lhag ma gzhan rnams ni gso dka' bar bshad6/ gzhang 'brum can la nad bla thabs su ④skyug pa dang / mod mod pa'i nad dang /du shing na ba dang / skom dad che ba dang / rims dang / snying na ba dang /chu so na ba dang / khar 'brum pa 'byung ba dang / gzhang kar 'brum pa phre'u 'byung ba dang / sha zad pa rnams spang pebar bya'o/ /yang na gzhang 'brum ni rnam pa gnyis su 'dus te/ gzhang 'brum skam pa ni bad kan dang rlung gnyis 'dus pa las gyur pa yin no/ /mkhris pa dang / khrag nad 'dus pa las gyur pa ni/ gsher zhing 'dzag pa yin par shes ( )par bya ste/ de la thog mar gzhang 'brum skem pa'i dzeecho ga bshad par bya ste/ gzhang 'brum zhi bar bya ba la/ba lang gi phyi ba'i dugs dang / zan dron gyi dugs dang / la phug gi dugs dang / shu ta'i dugs rnams gang yang rung bya ba nizhing / gso ma skol ba'i khu ba blugs pa dang / sgrul nag po dang / byi la dang / rnga mo dang / phag dang / srog chags dza du ka rnams gang yang rung ba'i tshil bsregs pa'i dud 120—569

pas bdug pa dang / yang na yung gi phye ma shing snu ha'i 'o ma dang sbyar te bsku ba dang / yang na pi pi leng dang / yung gi phye ma ba lang gi mkhris pa dang sbyar bas bsku bar bya'o/ /yang na swardzi ka'i thal ba dang / danda'i rtsa ba dang /lung ga la'i //)rtsa ba dang / kru trug tres rnams kyi phye ma ba gcin dang / pi pi ling dang / shing shir sha'i sa bon dang / shing arga'i 'o ma dang / ru rta dang / rgyam tsha /snyernams lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / yung dang / bya gag gi rtug pa dang / 'ol tsam se'i 'bras bu dang / pi pi ling rnams kyi phye ma ba gcin dang sbyar ba dang / bsku ba'i sman rnam pa 'di gsum ni/ gdon mi za ba yin te gang yang rung bas bskus na gzhang 'brum med par byed do/ /danda'i rtsa ba dang / a shwa mar dang / nag tshur dang / byi dang ga dang / ba bla dang / kru trug tres budang / rgyam tsha rnams kyi phye ma shing arga'i 'o ma dang /til mar gyi nang du bskol te/ til mar nyi tshe lus pa btsags pas bskus na yang gzhang 'brum sel te⑤/ yang na/ a ru ra bu ram dang sbyar ba'am/yang na a ru ra zhag gcig gi bar du ba gcin gyi nang du sbangs pa'am yang na a ru ra dang pi pi ling mar gyi nang du brngos pa'am/ yang na a ru ra dang /shing nye rong dang / danda'i rtsa ba rnams sbyar ba bza' bar bya'o/ /yang na go bye btags pa'i phye dang dar ba sbyar ba'am/ yang na rjodar ba dang / phye kru trug tres dang / la la phud btags pa'i bye ma dang sbyar ba'am/ yang na dar ba dang / phye bca' sga dang / bilba dang sbyar ba nan tan du byas te btung ngo / /yang na rdza ma kru trug tres kyis bskus pa'i nang du zho mnan de langs nas zho 'am dar ba gang yang rung ba btung ngo / /yang de nyid kyi cho ga bzhin du/ birga 120—570

dang / po ta dang / sle tres rnams kyis rdza ma bskus pa'i nang du zho mnan la zho 'am dar ba gang yang rung ba btung ngo / /yang na dbye mong dang / kru trug tres ①phye ma chang dang sbyar te rtag tu 'thungs na gzhang 'brum sel to/ /yang na bca' sga dang / kru trug tres rnams kyi phye ma bu ram dang chang dang sbyar te btung ngo / /yang na gzhang 'brum can la/ danda'i rtsa ba dang / go bye dang /kru trug tres dang / 'bras bu gsum dang / 'di rnams cha mnyam pa dang /rgyam tsha cha nyis 'gyur rnams snod kha sbyar gyi nang du brngos la/ tshig mar gyur pa'i phye ma kha zas gzhan dang sbyar zhing bza' bar bya'o/ /nyil nag po zho gnyis gnyis nang par bzhin zos la chu grang mos phul na yang gzhang 'brum zhi bar 'gyur zhing so brtan la sha skyi ②bar 'gyur ro/ /mar dang / shing pa la sha'i thal ba'i khu ba mar gyi chu sum 'gyur gyi nang du tsha ba gsum gyi phye ma bskol te/mar nyi tshe lus pa las sneran par 'thungs na yang the tshom med par gzhang 'brum 'byang bar 'gyur ro/ /'bras bu gsum dang / rtsa ba bcu dang / kru trug tres dang / danda'i rtsa ba rnams kyi phye ma srang re re chu phul gang la srang brgyad du brtsis pa phul drug cu rtsa bzhi'i nang du bskol te/ chu bzhi cha gcig lus pa btsags la bu ram srang brgyad dudang sbyar te mar snod kyi nang du blugs la/ zla ba gcig ⑤gi bar du mnan pa'i ming ni/ danda'i rtsa ba'i chang zhes bya ste/'di las ran par 'thungs na/ gzhang 'brum dang / yi ga 'chus pa dang /rtug skam khyadang / pho ba'i nad dang / skya rbab kyi nad rnams sel to/ /bi sha la dang / ka pittha dang / kru trug tres dang / pa tha rnams las srang gnyis gnyis dang a ru ra dang / sgyu ru ra srang sum cu rtsa gnyis gnyis dang /120 — 571

—'di rnams kyi phye ma chu phul brgya nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi nang du bskol te/ chu bzhi cha gcig lus pa btsags la bu ram srang brgya dang sbyar te mar snod kyi rdza mar blugs 1 la—/ zla ba byed kyi bar du mnan pa'i ming ni 'bras bu'i chang zhes bya ste/'di las ran par 'thungs na pho ba'i nad dang / gzhang 'brum dang skran sel to—/ /gzhang 'brum na zhing 'khru ba la ni/ rlung las gyur pa'i 'khru ba'i cho ga sngar bstan pa bzhin du bya'o/ /gzhang 'brum na zhing phyi sa skam ste 'byung du mi btub pa la ni/ rtug skam gyi cho ga 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin du lan mang du bya'o/ /shu ti dang / bilba dang / pi pi ling dang / kru trug tres dang / shu dag dang / shing mngar dang / thang shing dang / ma nu dang / li zur ba dang /ru rta dang / po son cha rnams btags pa'i phye ma nyil mar dang / 'o ma til mar gyi bzhi 'gyur gyi nang du bskol la/ til mar nyi tshe ②lus par byas te/btsags pa las ran par 'jam rtsi mas btang na/ rlung dang 'phrod cing /phyi sa be (kyesnabs su 'byung ba dang / gzhang 'brum dang / gzhang na ba dang gcin 'gag pa rnams sel ④to/ /pu tse shel la sogs pa'i sde tshan dang / rtsa ba bcu sngar bshad pa 'di gnyis las gang yang rung ba dang / po son cha dang /shing mngar dang / shu ti dang / ru rta dang / garnya pri yang ku 5)dang / gla sgang dang / rgyam tsha rnams kyi phye ma/ mkhris pa dang / rlung gang las gyur pa'i nad kyi skabs dang sbyar te/ mar dang / til mar gnyis las gang 'os pa zhig dang / 'o ma chu'i nang du bskol te/ mar ram/ til mar nyi tshe lus pas/ bkru sman drag po mas gtang bar bya'o/ /gzhang 'brum na ba la khrag 'dzag par rtogs na khrag lud pa'i nad kyi cho ga bzhin du bya zhing thog mar 7120 572

sman dang / kha zas la sogs pa kha ba'i bag las sbyar zhing zos na me'i drod bskyed cing nad gzhi tshos par byed do①/ /khrag nad kyi gzhang 'brum can la tshos par byed pa'i sman pu shel tse dang / ya ri ta dang / skyer pa'i shun pags ②rnams lhan cig tu skol ba'i khu ba bsgrangs pa'am/ yang na bca' sga dang / tsan dan dang / rtsa mkhris dang / bye tsher rnams skol ba'i khu ba bsgrangs pa blud de①/ yang na skom ⑦pa'i nad dang khrag nad zhi bar bya ba'i phyir/nidza'i shun lpags dang / dug mo nyung gi 'bras bu dang / skyer khaṇḍa dang /bong ⑤nga dkar po rnams kyi phye ma/ sbrang rtsi dang 'bras bkrus dupa'i khu ba dang sbyar ba blud do/ /sa rma ga dang / utpa la dang / chu shing gi 'bras bu dang /ti ri ta dang / til dang / tsan dan rnams kyi phye ma ra'i 'o ma dang sbyar te 'thungs na yang gzhang 'brum khrag 'dzag pa sel to/ /yang na khrag nad kyi gzhang 'brum can la/ kha zas ra'i 'o ma dang ldan par bza' zhing / sman dug mo nyung gi shun wags dang / sbrang rtsi dang / bu ram gyi sbra ba rnams sbyar ba'am—/ yang na sman ⑦ma yur ka'i phye ma/ sbrang rtsi dang / 'bras bkrus ⑧pa'i khu ba dang sbyar ba'am/ yang na padma'i ze ba sbrang rtsi dang / mar sar dang sbyar ba'am/ yang na padma'i ze ba kha ra dang sbyar ba zos na/ gzhang 'brum khrag 'dzag pa bde bar 'gyur ro/ /dbyi mo'i lo ma dang / bal bu'i lo ma dang / na le sham rnams las srang re re dang / pi pi ling dang / pi pi ling ⑨gi rtsa ba srang gnyis gnyis dang / dri sna bzhi zhes bya ba/ shing tsha ⑩dang /sug smel dang / gandha pa tra dang / nā ga ge sar rnams dang / pu shel tse dang / 'di rnams las zho gnyis gnyis dang / bca' sga srang gsum dang /120—573

————bu ram sman spyir bsdoms pa'i sum 'gyur dang / 'di rnams sbyar te ri lur byas pa'i ming ni/ bal bu'i ri lu zhes bya ste/ 'di las ran par zos la/chang dang / khu bcud dang / sha khu dang / 'o ma dang / zho kha chu dang /rtsabs rnams las 1gang yang rung bas nad gzhi gang shas che ba dang sbyar te phul na / me'i drod bskyed cing gzhang 'brum thams cad dang / skyug pa dang /snying na ba dang / lud pa dang / skran dang / rims rnams sel to/ /cho ga de rnams kyis kyang zhi bar ma gyur na/ sman pa mkhas shing sngon byed pa mthong bas / nad pa rkang pa dgug cing bcing ba la sogs pa ci nas kyang gzhang ltar snang ba'i thabs byas te/ 'brum bu ga la 'dug pa brtag na/ rwa 'am/lcags kyi sbubs 'jam po/ ba'i nu sor gyi dbyibs 'dra ba/ kha'i sbubs skesor bzhi/ srid du sor lnga yod par byas la/ glo logs su phu bachen po gsum tsam byas te/ rkub tu brdzangs la/ glo'i bu gud 'brum bu ga la yod pa'i thad kar gtad 4 de/ 'brum bu sbubs kyi nang du byung ba la/ rlung dang / bad kan las gyur pa'i gzhang 'brum zhig yin na/ 'brum bu mtshon gyis bcad la 'phro lcags kyis bsreg go/ /yang na mi bcad par bsreg go/ /yang na gzhang 'brum rnam pa drug po gang yang rung ste/ 'brum bu gang gi nang du byung ba la/sman mu ka ka'i thal ba phrad dar sbyar bas bsku bar bya'o/ /gzhang 'brum na ba la ni mdor na gang ci yang rung ste/ mi'i stobs bskyed pa dang / rlung dang 'phrod pa'i sman dang / kha zas dang / btung ba gang yin pa de 'ba' zhig las tshabs che chung dang sbyar zhing gtang 5bar bya'o/ /gzhang 'brum can gyis ni nad gzhi so so'i 'khrug par 'gyur ba'i kha zas dang / stan mkhrang po la 'dug pa dang /720——571

/de— —tsog tsog pur 'dug pa dang / phyi sa dang / gcin phro bzhin du mnag 1pa dang /rta la sogs pa zhon pa rnams spang bar bya'o// //da ni mtshan par rdol /naba'i bye brag bshad par bya ste/ rkub kha nas sor gnyis kyi tshu rol gyi glo logs su nyam da thag par byed pa'i phol mig 'byung ste/de rdol ba'i ming ni mtshan par rdol zhes 5bya ste/ de yang rnam pa lnga yod par bshad do/ /de la rlung las gyur pa'i phol mig gi ming ni/ rma kha brgya pa zhes bya ste/ mdog dmar la mi bzad par zug cing na ba yin no/ /mkhris pa las gyur pa'i ming ni/ rda me mgrin zhes bya ste mdog dmar la me 'bar ba bzhin du tsha ba yin par bshad do/ /bad kan las gyur pa'i ming ni/ kun tu 'dzag pa zhes bya ste/ mdog dkar la g.ya' ba yin par bshad do/ /nad gzhi gsum 'dus pa las gyur pa'i ming ni/ dung 'khyel ba zhes bya ste/thams cad kyi mtshan ma dang ldan pa yin no/ /kha zas zug rngu dang bcas pa zos te/ gcin 'ong ba'i sbubs su zug pa las gyur pa'i ming ni/ log par song ba zhes bya ste/ 'di rnams las nad gzhi gsum 'dus pa las gyur pa dang /zug rngu zug pa las gyur pa gnyis ni spang bar bya'o/ /lhag ma rnams ni gso dka' ( ba yin no/ /de la phol mig dang po byung ste ma byun pa la ni/ de'i nyen 'khor ram rtsa nas khrag dbyung 8 ba dang / nan rtsis bsku ba dang /nad gzhi gang las gyur pa dang / 'phrod pa'i sman skol ba'i khu ba grang dro gang 'os pas steng du blugs pa dang / til mar dang / nad dang 'phrod pa'i sman sbyar nas (bsku zhing mnye ba dang / bsku sman btang ba'i bar du cho ga rim 120 575

——bzhin du bya'o/ /rdol /1bar gyur pa'i cho ga yang bshad par bya ste/ dang por rdol naba'i rma zabs ci tsam yod pa dang / srol gang logs su byung ba/beegs kyi thur ma 'jam pos brtag pa dang / rma'i srol gar gyur par dral ba dang / sman muska ka la sogs pa'i thal bas gdab pa dang / bsreg pa la sogs pa go rim bzhin du mthar gyis byas nas rma gso ba'i cho ga bzhin du/nad gzhi gang las gyur pa dang yang sbyar zhing mthun mthun sman bya'o/ /de la rma gso ba'i cho ga ni/ dong ga ①dang / yung dang / rgya shug gi 'bras bu rnams kyi phye ma mar dang sbrang rtsi dang sbyar te/ gcin 'dzag pa'i rma mtshan par rdol ba gi)la bskus na/ rma sbyor zhing mi mched par 'gyur ro/ /shing nye rong dang /te dzo ba ti dang / danda'i rtsa ba dang / btsod dang / yung dang / skyer pa dang / skyer khaṇḍa dang / nisba'i lo ma ⑤rnams sbyar bas bskus na yang rma 'khyems pa sel to/ /mtshan par rdol ༷gyi nad la/ ka ra bi ra dang / yung dang / danda'i rtsa ba dang / lang ka'i ⑦li dang / rgyam tsha dang / kru trug tres dang / kha lung dang / arka ⑧dang / dug mo nyung rnams ⑨skol ba'i khu ba dang / til mar gyi nang du/ sman de dag ⑩nyid kyi phye ma bskol la/ til mar nyi tshe lus pa btsags pa rma la bsku bar ⑪bya'o/ /mtshan par rdol ⑩gyi nad yod pa'i mis ni/ rma sos pa'i 'og tu yang lo gcig gi bar du phyugs zhon pa dang / nyal ba ke/)dang / stobs 'gyed pa dang / brtsal ba dang / kha zas phyi ba rnams shin tu bsgrims te spang bar bya'o/ /gzhang 'brum dang /mtshan par rdol ba gso /7ba'i le'u ste bcu gsum pa rdzogs so// //120—576

de nas skya rbab kyi nad gso ba'i le'u bshad par bya ste/ skya rbab kyi nad ni/kha zas la sogs pa rno ba dang / sgyur ba dang / lan tshwa dang / sngon ma goms pa'i kha zas dang / sa zhag rnams las ha cang mang du zos pa las skya rbab kyi nad du 'gyur te/ de yang nad gzhi gsum so sor nas gyur pa dang /kun 'dus pa las gyur pa'i bye brag gis rnam pa bzhir 'gyur ro/ /de la rlung las gyur pa'i skya rbab kyi mtshan ma mi ①lus kyi mdog gnag la/ rlung gi mtshan ma dang / rlung nad kyi bla gnyan rnams dang yang ldan pa yin no/ /mkhris pa las gyur pa'i skya rbab kyi mtshan ma ni/ mkhris pa las pa rnams 'byung zhing /mig dang / pags pa dang / phyi sa dang / gcin rnams ser ba yin no/ /bad kan las gyur pa'i skya rbab kyi mtshan ma ni/ mdog dkar la bad kan las gyur pa'i nad rnams dang ldan pa yin no/ /nad gzhi gsum 'dus pa las gyur pa'i skya rbab kyi mtshan ma ni/ thams cad kyi mtshan ma dang ldan par shes par bya'o—/ /de la skya rbab kyi nad yod la/ khrag zad pa dang / glo 'grams pa dang / sha zad pa dang / skyugs ②pa dang / skom ①pa la sogs pa'i bla ④ gnyan yod pa dang / mdog ser zhing snang ngo cog dkar por mthong ba ni 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /skya rbab kyi ⑤nad thams cad la/ dang por ni sman mar btung bas khong 'jam por byas la/ de'i 'og tu nad gzhi dang sbyar zhing /gyen du skyugs ( stepa dang thur du bkru ba'i sman rnon pos sbyar bar bya'o/ /de'i sman mar ni mur ba dang / pu tse (peshel dang / yung dang / byi tsher dang /pi pi ling dang / tsan dan dang / sro lo dang / khye lce ba dang / dug mo nyung dang / rtsa mkhris 8/dang / pa to la dang / gla sgang dang thang shing rnams 120—577

/de—— — /de — — — — ———— — ———/de kyi phye ma zho gnyis gnyis/ mar srang sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / 'o ma mar gyi bzhi 'gyur gyi nang du bskol te/ mar nyi tshe lus pa btsags pa las ran par 'thungs na/ skya rbab dang / rims dang / 'brum bu dang / skrangs pa dang / gzhang 'brum dang / khrag lud pa'i nad rnams sel to/ /'bras bu gsum dang / sle tres dang / ba sha ka dang / pu tse shel dang / rtsa mkhris dang / nidza rnams skol ba'i khu ba bsgrangs pa sbrang rtsi dang sbyar te 'thungs na yang / skya rbab kyi nad dang mig ser can yang ①sel to/ /yang na skya rbab kyi nad yod pa la/ a ru ra ②ba gcin dang sbyar ba btung zhing / kha zas 'o ma dang ldan pa bza' bar bya'o/ /yang na lcags kyi phye ma ba gcin gyi nang du yun ring du sbangs pa bza' zhing 'o mas dbul lo/ /'bras bu gsum dang /kru trug snyetres dang / gla sgang dang / byi dang ga dang / tsha ba gsum rnams kyi phye ma dang / lcags kyi phye ma dang / sman de rnams spyir bsdoms ④pa'i tshad dang mnyam pa dang / 'di rnams sbrang rtsi dang mar dang sbyar te zos na yang /skya rbab dang / mig ser dang / skrangs pa dang / gcin nad sel to/ /til dang / tsha ba gsum dang / rgya shug gi 'bras bu dang / drub mar cang rnams kyi phye ma dang / lcags kyi phye ma/ sman de rnams spyir bsdoms pa'i tshad dang mnyam pa dang 'di rnams sbrang rtsi dang sbyar te ma brdzis pa las ran par zos na yang / skya rbab kyi nad drag po dang skrangs pa sel to/ /mig ser gyi nad ni/skya rbab 5kyi nad yal bar bor ba las/ mkhris pa 'khrugs nas/ mig ser gyi nad du 'gyur bas na/ de yang skabs 'dir bshad de/ de'i mtshan ma ni/mig dang lus kyi mdog ser ba yin no/ /mig ser chen po zhes bya ba yang /720 578

/de— —— /de/de —— —mig ser kyi nad la dang por nad /3tshabs chen por gyur pa las 'byung ste/ de gnyis la ni snum pa'i bkru sman btang ngo / /ba la dang / yung dang / nidza dang / 'bras bu gsum dang shing mngar rnams cha mnyam ste btags la 'o ma dang / ma he'i mar dang skol nas mar nyi tshe lus pa btsags pa skelas ran par 'thungs na yang mig ser gyi nad sel to/ /sle tres dang / 'bras bu gsum dang / skyer pa dang / nidza rnams gang yang rung ba'i khu ba sbrang rtsi dang sbyar te nang par bzhin rtag tu 'thungs na yang / mig ser gyi nad sel to/ /lcags kyi phye ma dang / yung dang / skyer pa dang / 'bras bu gsum dang /pu tse shel rnams kyi phye ma sbrang rtsi dang mar dang sbyar te zos na yang mig ser gyi nad sel to/ /sgyu ru ra dang / lcags kyi phye ma dang / tsha ba gsum dang /yung rnams kyi phye ma sbrang rtsi dang mar dang / kha ra dang sbyar te zos na/ mig ser tshabs chen po yang myur du sel to/ /pi pi ling dang / pi pi ling chen po dang / pi pi ling gi rtsa ba dang / kru trug tres dang / la la phud dang /na le sham dang / rgyam tsha dang / byi dang ga dang / 'bras bu gsum dang /'u su'i 'bras bu dang / rgya shug gi 'bras bu dang / go stod dang / nu shing gi 'bras bu rnams kyi phye ma srang re re dang / shing nye / rong gi phye ma dang /til mar srang brgyad brgya dang / skyu ru ra'i khu ba srang dgu bcu rtsa drug dang /bu ram srang lnga bcu dang 'di rnams lhan cig tu skol ba'i ming ni/ sman gyi lde gu dge ba zhes bya ste/ 'di las ran par zos na yang / skya rbab dang /mig ser dang / gzhang 'brum dang sbyar ba'i dug rnams sel cing / gcin nad dang / mdze dang / rims dang / dbugs mi bde ba dang / pho ba'i 120—579

nad rnams med par byed la sman bcud kyi len du yang 'gyur ro/ /mig ser gyis nyam thag pa ni/ sman dron pu shi ba'i khu ba'i mig bzang ngo yang na yung dang / btsag dang / sgyu ru ra'i phye ma zhib mo sbyar bas kyang bsku bar bya'o—/ /yang sman karko ta ka'i rtsa ba'i phye ma'am/ dza li na'i 'bras bu'i phye ma snar blugs so/ /yang na mig ser ①gyis nyam thag pa la/ e raṇa ②dang /pi pi ling dzu)gi phye sbyar ba snar blugs so/ /nad ljang gu kha zhes bya ba ni/ rlung dang mkhris pa las ④'byung ste/ de'i mtshan ma ni/ lus kyi mdog ljang gu khar 'dug pa dang / sngo sangs dang / ser ba dang / rims kyis 'debs pa dang / skom dad che ba dang / me'i drod chung bar byed cing sgyid lug pa dang snyom pa rnams yin te skya rbab kyi nad yod pa la 'byung ngo / /de ni kha zas dang / skom mngar bag dang / rlung dang mkhris pa sel ba'i sman rnams kyis thub par 'gyur te/ mig ser dang / skya rbab kyi nad kyi cho gar bstan pa bzhin du/ nad ldang ⑤khu kha 'di la yang sbyar bar bya'o/ /skya rbab kyi nad gso ba'i le'u ste bcu bzhi pa rdzogs so// //de nas skyigs bu'i nad dang / dbugs mi bde ba'i nad gso ba'i le'u bshad par bya ste/ skyigs bu dang / dbugs mi bde ba la ni/ rlung dang rjomakhris pa'i nad las 'das te/ bad kan gyi rjes su 'brang bar 'gyur ba ⑦las/skyigs bu dang / dbugs mi bde ba drag po skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de gnyis re re la yang rnam pa lnga lnga yod do/ /de la skyigs ④bu'i nad rnam pa lnga ni/skyigs bu chen po zhes bya ba/ sgra che zhing shugs drag la gnad la gnod pa dang /120 580

skyigs bu'i nad zab mo zhes bya ba/ lte ba'i phyogs nas ldang zhing sgra zab tu 'byung ba dang / skyigs bu'i nad btud ma zhes bya ba/ byags bu gnyis gnyis btud cing shugs drag tu 'byung la mi bzad par na zhing mgo 'dam par byed pa dang / skyigs bu chung ngu zhes bya ba shugs dal la/ brang dang /nam tshong nas ldang zhing 'byung ba dang / skyigs bu zas las 'byung ba zhes bya ba/ha cang mang du zos zhing 'thungs pas ①rlung gi gnas dog par gyur pa las 'byung ba rnams yin te/ 'di rnams kyi nad ni ②skyigs bu chung ngu dang /zas las 'byung ba zhes bya ba gnyis ni gso sla ba yin no/ /lhag ma rnams ni srog gcod par bshad do/ /dbugs mi bde ba rnam pa lnga la/ sgra chen po zhes bya ba/ dbugs che zhing ran pa dang / snying dang / lta ba rnams log par bsgyur zhing / snga ma pa zhes bya ba gyen du lta zhing / dbugs drag tu 'byung la/ pyos par byed cing snying dang rtsib logs su zug ①pa dang /skabs su 'chad pa zhes bya ba/ dbugs skabs skabs su 'chad cing / drag tu 'byung ba gang yin pa dang / rmugs byed ces bya ba/ cham pa drag pos 'debs shing snying myos la/ nam langs pa'i tshe lhag par tshabs che bar 'gyur ba dang / dbugs chung ngu zhes bya ba mi dga' ba las 'byung la dal zhing gnod pa mi byed pa rnams yin te/ de dag gi nad ni dudabugs chung ngu zhes bya ba la gso sla ba yin no/ /rmugs byed ces bya ba ni/ kha zas dang / sman gyis sos dhitsam du 'jog nus so/ /lhag ma rnams ni 'chi bar byed pa yin te spang bar bya'o/ /de la skyigs bu'i nad dang / dbugs mi bde ba'i nad kyis thebs pa la ni/ dang por til mar gyis lus bsku ba dang dugs /byas na 120— 581

bzang ngo / /nyams 3stobs yod pa la ni gyen du skyugs 9pa dang thur du bkru bas sbyang bar bya'o/ /rid cing nyam chung ba la ni zhi bar bya ba'i sman ①rgya shug gi tshig gu dang / skyer khaṇḍa dang / 'bras yos ④rnams lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / pu tse shel dang btsag lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / pi pi ling dang /sgyu ru ra dang / kha ra dang / bca' sga rnams lhan cig sbyar ba dang / nag mtshur (shedang / pog dkar po lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang shing pa ṭa la'i 'bras bu dang me tog lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / pi pi ling dang / 'bra ( stego'i yal ga'i thor to dang lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / sman gyi sbyor ba rnam pa drug po 'di rnams las gang yang rung ba sbrang rtsi dang sbyar la sman byi lde gur byas te zos na/skyigs bu'i nad sel to/ /shing mngar dang sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba dang / pi pi ling kha ra dang sbyar ba dang / bca' sga bu ram dang sbyar ba 'di gsum las gang yang rung ba snar blugs na yang skyigs bu'i nad sel to/ /sbrang ma'i rtug pa bud med kyi nu zho'am/ le brgan rtsi'i khu ba gang yang rung ba dang sbyar ba'am/yang na tsan dan dkar po bud med kyi nu zho las brdar ⑦te/ snar blugs na yang skyigs bu'i nad sel to/ /yang na skyisas bu'i dand 'i/ bar bya ba la/ldong ros dang / ba lang gi rwa dang / ru rta dang / sra rtsi ⑨pog dang / rtswa ku sha rnams las gang yang rung ba mar dang sbyar te/ snod kha sbyar gyi nang du bsregs la/ 'u'i nang nas dud pa drang zhing / kha snar brngubs ⑫na yang skyigs bu'i nad sel to/ /mar bzang po srang gnyis bzhu ste tshos par byas la/rgyam tsha srang gcig dang sbyar ba'am/ yang na nas tshig 'khyas pa'i thal ba mar bzang po bzhus te tshos par byas pa'i nang du btab pa 'thungs na yang skyigs 120 582

/de—— sde/de/de—bu'i nad kyis nyam yo/thag pa sel to/ /dbugs mi bde ba'i nad gso ba'i cho ga ni—/ byi tsher dang / pi pi leng dang / rgun dang / bu bran shing dang/a ru ra rnams zhib tu btags la/ sbrang rtsi dang mar ①sbyar te zos na/dbugs mi bde ba dang / lud pa dang rlung nad rmugs byed rnams sel to/ /bu ram dang / na le sham dang / yung dang rla rna dang / rgun dang pi pi ling rnams btags la til mar dang sbyar te zos na yang dbugs mi bde ba'i nad drag po sel to/ /yang na sbrang rtsi dang / mar dang ga bra'i rtsa ba dang / shing mngar gyi phye ma sbyar te bza' bar bya'o/ /a ru ra dang / rtsa mkhris dang /pi pi leng dang / bye tsher rnams kyi phye ma sbrang rtsi mar dang sbyar te zos na yang dbugs mi bde ba'i nad sel to/ /shing ram bha dang / kunda dang / shi ri rnams kyi me tog dang / pi pi ling rnams btags la/ 'bras bkrus pa'i chu dang sbyar te 'thungs na yang dbugs mi bde ba'i nad sel to/ /yang na skyigs bu'i nad dang / dbugs mi bde ba'i nad la ga bra'i rtsa ba dang / bca' sga'i phye ma chu skol ba dron mo dang sbyar te btung bar bya'o/ /yang na bca' sga dang / kha ra dang ga bra'i rtsa ba dang / kha ru tsha ①rnams kyi phye ma chu skol ba dron mo ④dang sbyar te btung bar bya'o/ /yang na shing tsha dang / sug smel dang /za la ka dang le zur ba dang / bca' sga dang / dzi bandi dang / ma nu dang /dzha ta dang / bca' ba dang / a ga ru dang / pi pi ling dang / gla sgang dang / byi'u rug pa dang / spang spos rnams cha mnyam ste btags pa'i phye ma dang kha ra sman de rnams spyir bsdoms pa'i brgyad 'gyur dang sbyar ba'i phye ma'i sman 'di zos na/ skyigs bu'i nad dang / dbugs mi bde ba'i nad sel 120 583

zhing / lud pa dang / rims dang / snying na ba dang / rtsib logs su zug pa rnams med par byed do/ /rma bya'i rkang pa'am sgo'i rtsa ba gang yang rung ba bsregs pa'i thal ba/ mar dang / sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba'am/ yang na bye thur gyi sha bsregs la/ mar dang sbrang rtsi dang sbyar te zos na yang skyigs bu'i nad dang / dbugs mi bde ba'i nad sel to/ /skyigs bu'i nad dang /dbugs mi bde ba'i nad kyis shin tu nyam thag pa'i skom du ni rtsa ba bcu pa skol ba'i khu ba'am/ thang ①shing skol ba'i khya ba'am/ chang rnams las ran par 'thung bar bya'o/ /skyigs bu'i nad dang / dbugs mi bde ba'i nad yod pa la/ sman pas tshabs che chung la sogs pa'i bye brag shin tu phyed par bya ste/ bad kan dang rlung sel ba'i kha zas dang btung ba'i cho ga sbyin par bya'o/ /skyigs bu'i nad dang /dbugs mi bde ba'i nad gso ba'i le'u ste bco lnga pa rdzogs so// //de nas lud pa'i nad gso ba'i le'u bshad par bya ste/ lud pa ni nad gzhi gsum re re las gyur pa dang / glo 'grams pa las gyur pa dang / nad khong skems las gyur pa dang rnam pa lnga yod de/ de dag kyang rlung rnam pa lnga po/dbugs rgyu bar byed pa zhes bya ba dang / ngag 'byung bar byed pa dang /legs par 'jog pa dang / skyod pa dang / dri ma 'byin pa zhes bya ba rnams 'khrugs pa las 'byung ste/ snying ga dang / brang dang / phrag pa dang /gog ma la sogs pa nad 'dru zhing / rko ba ni lud pa zhes bya'o/ /de la rlung las gyur pa'i lud pa'i mtshan ma ni/ snying na ba dang / klad pa na ba dang /rtsib logs su zug pa dang / lud pa skam zhing 'gogs su mi btub pa dang /120— 584

skad 'gags pa rnams yin par bshad do/ /mkhris pa las gyur pa'i mtshan ma ni—/ skom dad che ba dang / lus tsha ba dang / khar tshwa yo/bro ba dang /skyugs pa'i ro tsha zhing mdog ser la tsha ba rnams yin no/ /bad kan las gyur pa'i lud pa'i mtshan ma ni/ lus phyi zhing mchil ma mang du 'ong ba dang /cham pas 'debs shing yi ga 'chus pa rnams yin no/ /glo 'grams pa las gyur pa'i lud pa'i mtshan ma ni/ lud pa khrag tu 'ong ba dang / ru shing na ba dang /dbugs mi bde ba dang / glo las rnag 'byung ba rnams yin no/ /nad khong skems ②las gyur pa'i lud pa'i mtshan ma ni/ lud pa khrag dang rnag tu 'byung zhing / nad gzhi gsum 'dus pa las byung ba yin no/ /de rnams kyi nang na glo 'grams ①pa las gyur pa'i lud pa ni kha zas dang sman la sogs pas sos ④tsam du 'jog nus so/ /nad khong skems las gyur pa'i lud pa ni mi 'tsho'o /lhag ma gsum po rnams ni gsor rung ngo / /de la gso ba'i cho ga ni/ bca' sga dang / bye tsher dang / bu bran shing dang / rgun dang le zur ba dang /kha ra rnams btags pa'i phye ma/ til mar dang sbyar te zos na/ rlung las gyur pa'i lud pa mi bzad pa sel to/ /li zur ba dang / bu bran shing dang /pi pi ling dang / ga bra'i rtsa ba dang / gla sgang dang / byi tsher rnams kyi phye ma bu ram dang til mar dang sbyar ba'i sman gyi lde gu 'di'i ming ni gzhan gyis mi thub pa zhes bya ste/ rlung las gyur pa'i lud pa sel to/ /kon ti dang /rgyam tsha ⑤dang / tsha ba gsum dang / bye dang ga dang / ru rta dang / shing kun rnams kyi phye ma mar dang sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba'i sman gyi lde gu 'di ni lud pa'i nad dang / skyigs bu'i nad la bsngags pa yin no/ /mkhris pa las gyur pa'i 120—585

——lud pa'i nad yod pa la ni/ pi pi ling dang / kha ra dang / spyig rkang dang /'bras yos dang / sgyu ru ra dang rgun rnams kyi phye ma lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang /shing mngar dang / pi pi leng gi rtsa ba dang / murba dang / rgun dang /bca' sga rnams kyi phye ma lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / pi pi ling dang / 'bra 1 go dang / spyig rkang dang / gze ma rnams kyi phye ma lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang /sman gyi sbyor ba 'di gsum las gang yang rung ba/ mar dang / sbrang rtsi dang sbyar la sman gyi lde gur bya ste bza' bar bya'o/ /bad kan las gyur pa'i lud pa'i nad yod pa la ni/ gla sgang chen po dang / a ru ra dang / skyu ru ra dang / pi pi ling dang / ta malka rnams kyi phye ma lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang /a ru ra dang / pi pi ling dang / gla sgang dang / thang shing dang bca' sga rnams kyi phye ma lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / kru trug tres dang / pi pi ling dang /pi pi ling gi rtsa ba dang / pi pi ling chen po rnams kyi phye ma lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / sman rmi sbyor ba rnam pa 'di gsum las gang yang rung ba/ sbrang rtsi dang sbyar la sman gyi lde gur byas te zos na bad kan las gyur pa'i lud pa'i nad sel bar rig par bya'o/ /btsod dang / skyer khaṇḍa 'dang murba dang / kru trug tres dang / pā thā dang / pi pi ling dang / yung rnams kyi phye ma sbrang rtsi shas bskyed de sbyar ba zos na glo 'grams pa las gyur pa dang / nad khong skems pa las gyur pa'i lud pa'i nad sel to/ /thang shing dang ba la dang / ra sna dang 'bras bu gsum dang / rtsa ba gsum dang / shug pa dang / byi dang ga rnams kyi phye ma kha ra sman de rnams spyir bsdoms pa'i tshad dang mnyam par 4/sbyar ba'i phye ma'i sman 'dis ni/ lud pa'i nad rnam pa 5/lnga char sel to/ /a 120—586

gas ste zhes bya ba'i sman gyi sde gu sbyar ba'i thabs ni/ sman shang ka pu shi ba dang / srad ma tsho.adma gupta dang / kru trug tres dang / rtsa ba bcu dang / li zur ba dang / ba la dang / rgya shug gi 'bras bu dang / ga bra'i rtsa ba dang / shing a pa marga dang / pi pi ling gi rtsa ba dang / ma nu rnams las srang gnyis dang /a ru ra 'bru brgya dang / nas gephul bu bcu drug dang / 'di rnams lhan cig tu chu nas kyi lnga 'gyur gyi nang du bskol la/ nas legs par tshos nas phyung ste btsags pa'i khu ba'i nang du/ a ru ra de rnams bu ram srang brgya dang mar srang brgyad dang / til mar srang brgyad dang / pi pi leng gi phye ma srang brgyad dang / lhan cig tu me mi che bar yang bskol te/ nur nur po skyabs drang du rung ba tsam du gyur pa phyung ste bsgrangs pa'i nang du sbrang rtsi srang brgyad blugs te sbyar ba'i sman bcud kyi len 'di las nang re bzhin a ru ra 'bru gnyis gnyis/sman gyi lde gu dang bcas te zos na lud pa'i nad thams cad dang dbugs mi bde ba'i nad dang nad khong skems rnams sel cing pho ba'i nad dang yi ga 'chus pa dang / skyigs bu'i nad dang / gzhang 'brum dang / rims dang / snying na ba dang / skrangs pa rnams sel te'-i)/ kaṇḍa ka ri skol ba'i khu ba'i nang du/ ra sna dang / ba la dang / tsha ba gsum dang / gze ma rnams kyi phye ma mar dang lhan cig tu bskol dute/ mar nyi tshe lus pa btsags pa las ran par 'thungs na yang lud pa'i nad rnam ④pa lnga char sel to/ /ldong ros dang / ba la dang /a ku ta dang / shing mngar dang / gla sgang dang / spang spos rnams bsregs pa'i dud pa kha snar bdug cing / de'i rjes la bu ram dang 'o ma sbyar ba 'thungs te/thabs de ltar zhag gsum gyi bar du byas na yang lud pa'i nad thams cad sel to//120—587

lud pa'i nad gso ba'i le'u ste bcu drug pa rdzogs so// //de nas sgyug pa'i nad dang skom pa'i nad gso ba bshad par bya ste/ de la skyug pa'i nad ni nad gzhi gsum 'khrugs pa re re las gyur pa dang / gsum char 'dus pa las gyur pa dang / mi sdug cing yid du mi 'ong ba dang / rul zhing myags pa la sogs pa mthong ba dang reg pa dang / snom tsopa dang gtam thos pa dang / bsams grupa rnams las gyur pa dang / rnam pa lnga yod de/de dag gi mtshan ma bstan par bya'o/ /de la rlung las gyur pa'i skyug pa'i mtshan ma ni/ sgyugs 1pa'i ro bska chozhing dang la mdog gnag pa dang / dbu ba can dang / shugs drag cing na ba rnams yin no/ /mkhris pa las gyur pa'i mtshan ma ni/ skyug thupa tsha zhing ser ba dang / dmar ba dang ljang gur 'dug la lus tsha ba rnams yin no/ /bad kan las gyur pa'i mtshan ma ni/ sgyug 5pa 'byil zhing ro mngar la grang zhing bska dzeeb rnams yin no/ /kun 'dus pa las gyur pa'i mtshan ma ni/ mtshan ma thams cad dang ldan par shes par bya'o/ /mi sdug cing yid du mi 'ong ba las gyur pa'i mtshan ma ni/ dul ba dang / mi sdug pa dang / sems gdungs pa la sogs pa thog ma bskyed pa'i rgyur smos pa de dag nyid las rtogs par bya'o/ /de la sgyug bye pa khrag dang bcas par 'byung zhing / zhag tshig tshig po yod la sha zad de nyam chung ba dang / nad bla gnyan gzhan gyis kyang thebs pa ni mi 'tsho ste spang bar bya'o/ /skyug nad thams cad ni ma zhu ba'i gnas pho ba las 'byung bas na/ rlung las gyur pa'i sgyug tsusnapa ma gtogs par dang por smyung ba'i cho ga byas la des ma zhi na phyis bkru sman btang 120—588

ngo / /rlung las gyur pa la ni dang por de dang 'phrod pa'i sman gyis zhi bar bya'o//de la bkru sman ni a ru ra'i phye ma sbrang rtsi dang sbyar te sde gur byas pa'am yang na bkru sman zhim zhing yi gar 'ong ba gzhan yang gtang ①bar bya'o/ /nyams ④stobs yod pa la ni/ skyug sman dang bkru sman bya'o/ /rid cing ④nyam chung ba la ni zhi bar bya ba'i sman gtang rjobar bya'o/ /de la rlung las gyur pa'i sgyug pa'i nad zhi bar bya ba'i cho ga ni/ rgyam tshwa dang mar sbyar ba btung ba'am/yang na rgyam tsha ⑤dang / kha ru tsha dang / rtsabs rjoru tsha ba ⑦dang / tsha ba gsum dang / 'di rnams kyi phye ma mar dang sbyar te btung bar bya'o/ /mkhris pa las gyur pa'i sgyug pa'i nad zhi bar bya ba la ni/ ba la dang / btsag ⑧gi bye ma 'bras bkrus pa'i khu ba dang sbyar ba'am/ pu shel tse'i phye ma 'bras bkrus ⑨pa'i phye ma dang sbyar ba 'am/ yang na pu shel tse'i ⑩phye skyu ru ra'i khu ba grang mo dang sbyar te btung bar bya'o/ /bad kan las gyur pa'i skyug pa'i nad yod pa la ni—/ byi ⑪dang ga dang / 'bras bu gsum dang / nisbra rnams kyi phye ma sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba'am/ yang na bye dang ga dang gla ba dang bca' sga rnams kyi bye ma zang rtsi dang sbyar te bza' bar bya'o/ /shi ra phi ⑫la dang / sle tres dang /murba rnams las gang yang rung ba skol ba'i khu ba bsgrangs pa sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba'amaske/ yang na murba'i phye ma 'bras bkrus pa'i khu ba dang sbyar te 'thungs na/rlung las gyur pa dang / bad kan las gyur pa dang / mkhris pa las gyur pa rnams kyi skyug pa'i nad sel to/ /pi pi ling dang / na le sham dang / ldong ros rnams kyi phye ma dang / de rnams spyir bsdoms pa'i tshad dang mnyam pa'i 'bras yos kyi phye ma dang / sbrang rtsi rnams ka pittha'i 'bras bu dang / kha lung 120—589

gi 'bras bu skol ba'i khu ba grang mo'i nang du blugs te 'thungs na yang skyug pa'i nad sel to/ /rgya shug gi tshig gu dang / pi pi ling dang / sgyu ru ra rnams kyi phye ma dang lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / 'bras yos dang / 'bras bu gsum dang / bca' sga rnams kyi phye ma lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / rtsa byu ma ka dang /skyer khaṇḍa dang / gla sgang dang / rgya shug gi rus pa rnams kyi phye ma lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / sbrang ma'i rtug pa dang / kha ra dang / pi pi ling rnams kyi phye ma lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / pi pi ling dang / na le sham dang / ka pittha dang / ba la rnams kyi phye ma lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / shing tsha dang / sug smel 3/dang / garnya pa tra rnams kyi phye ma lhan cig tu sbyar ba dang / sman gyi sbyor ba rnam ①pa drug po 'di rnams las gang yang rung ba sbrang rtsi dang sbyar te/sman gyi sde gur byas pa zos na yang skyug pa'i nad sel to/ /skyug pa'i nad ring du lon pa la ni dge ba zhes bya ba'i sman mar dang / 'o ma'i sman dang ro tsa bar byed pa'i sman dang / sha'i khya bcud la sogs pa rlung sel ba'i cho ga rnams bya'o//skom pa'i nad kyang / nad gzhi gsum so so las gyur pa dang / zas ma zhu ba las gyur pa dang / glo 'grams nas ②nad khong skems su ④gyur pa las 'byung ba dang rnam pa lnga yod de skom pa'i nad do cog gi gzhi ni/ shas cher rlung dang mkhris pa gnyis yin pas na/ skom pa'i nad la thog mar de gnyis bsal ba'i cho ga bya'o/ /de la skem zhepa'i nad yod pa'i skom du ni sbrang rtsi char pa'i chu dang sbyar ba'am/ de ma rnyed na chu tha mal pa dang sbyar ba btung bar bya'o/ /yang na bong pa bsregs pa chur bcug pa'i khu ba 'bras brngos pa'i bye dang sbrang rtsi kha ra dang sbyar ba btung bar bya'o/ /yang na kha ra dang / nā ga ge sar dang /120—590

pi pi ling dang / ba ①be dang / bal po se'u rnams kyi phye ma sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba'i sman gyi lde gu'am pi pi ling dang / shing 'o ma can gyi myu gu sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba'i sman gyi lde gu ④gang yang rung ba la zos na yang skom pa'i nad sel bar 'gyur ro—/ /yang na shing ba ta'i yal ga'i thor to dang / ru rta dang / 'bras brngos ①pa'i phye dang / utpal sngon po dang / 'bras bu gsum rnams kyi phye ma sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba'i ri lu khar bzhag na yang skom pa'i nad myur du sel to/ /rgun dang bu ram shing gi khu ba dang / 'o ma dang / sbrang rtsi rnams kyi nang du shing mngar dang / utpala'i phye ma blugs te 'thungs na yang skom pa'i nad gdon mi za bar byed do/ /'o ma dang / bu ram shing gi khu ba dang / rgun chang dang / bu ram chang dang / bu ram chab dang / sbrang chab dang / star bu'i khu ba dang / rtsabs skyur po rnams gang yang rung ba/ kha ra yun ring du bzhag cing / phyir pho na yang rkan skams pa sel bar byed do/ /skyug pa'i nad dang / skom pa'i nad gso ba'i le'u ste bcu bdun pa rdzogs so// //bam po lnga pa'o/ /de nas gcin sri pa'i nad gso ba'i le'u bshad par bya'o —/ /rjogacin sri ba la sogs pa'i nad narjo/ kha zas la sogs pa shin tu rno ba za zhing 'thung ba dang / shin tu mang bar za zhing 'thungs pa'i gnod pa las gcin sri ba'i nad rnam pa brgyad du 'gyur te/ de la ④rlung las gyur pa'i gcin sri ba'i nad ni shin tu mi bzad par na ba yin no/ /mkhris pa las gyur pa ni gcin nyid tsha rab tu 'ong ba yin no/ /bad kan las gyur pa ni chu so'i phyogs phyi ba bem por 'dug cing skrangs pa yin no/ /nad gzhi ⑦'dus pa las 120—591

gyur pa ni ma rungs pa yin no/ /khrag nad las gyur pa ni gcin khrag rtsa ①'ong ba yin no/ /khu chu las gyur pa ni khu chu 'gags pa las 'byung ba yin no/ /gcin rde'us 'gags pa ni rlung gis ②khu chu dang bad kan bsgangs dzeenas rdo 'dra bar gyur pa yin no/ /gcin bstus pa ni chu so lgang ba'i kha mi bzad par na zhing rde'u zhig pas gcin 'gags par gyur pa yin par bshad do/ /de dag gso ba'i thabs ni sman mar dang / til mar gyis lus bsku ba dang / sman mar btung ba dang / dugs bya ba dang / bkru sman drag po mas btang zhing /de'i rjes la 'jam rtsi mas gtang dub rnams bya'o/ /de la rlung las gyur pa'i gcin sri ba la ni/ rtswa ku sha la sogs pa'i sde tshan nam/ sman ti ⑤ri la sogs pa'i sde tshan gang yang rung ba skol ba'i khu bas btsos pa'i sha khu dang ldan par kha zas bza' 'o/ /mkhris pa dang / khrag nad las gyur pa la ni/ skyu ru ra skol ba'i khya ba'i nang du skyer pa'i rtsa ba'i phye ma dang sbrang rtsi blugs pa'am/yang na e la ba lu ka'i sa bon dang / shing mngar dang / skyer pa rnams kyi phye ma 'bras bkrus pa'i khya ba'i nang du btab pa btung bar bya'o/ /bad kan las gyur pa'i gcin sri ba zhi bar bya ba la ni/ sug smel zhib tu btags pa'i phye ma/ba gcin dang / chang dang / chu shing gi khu ba btsir ba rnams las gang yang rung ba dang sbyar te btung bar bya'o/ /khu chu 'gags pa las gcin sri bar gyur pa la ni/ brag zhun sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba'i sman gyi lde gu bza' bar bya'o/ /yang na ro tsa bar bya ba'i sman gyis lus zungs 0bdun brtas la/ na chung bzang mo dang nyal po bya'o/ /gcin sri ba'i nad rnams la/ le brgan rtsi'i sa bon btags pa'i phye ma ⑦sbrang rtsi dang / 'bras bkrus pa'i khu ba dang sbyar 120—592
