༄ga /'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa'i man ngag zab mo bzhugs/①༄4/ /srid pa gsum gyi bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa klu sgrub zhal snga nas/ /bkod par gyur pa rtsa ba'i mdzod/ /sems can kun la rjes brtse bas/ /bdag gis rab tu brjod par bya/ /ka na ka pañtsaṅgi blangs nas a lam bu ṣa dang / chang gi sa bon dang / sge'u gsher dang / pi pi ling gi sa bon dang / 'di rnams kañdzi ka dang btags nas briṣa ṇa la byugs na/ ku raṇḍa ⑤sel bar byed do/ /ma he'i mar sar dang nas kyi phye dang / nā ga ba la dang / shu dag dang / a ti ba lā dang / ba lā dang / 'di dag thams cad gcig tu byas nas nyed par byas na sgom por byed pa'i mchog go/ /gtun shing lta bur 'gyur ro/ /mar sar dang / shu dag dang / ru rta dang / ba lā dang / nā ga ba lā rnams kyis nu ma mchog tu mnyes na de yis bum pa lta bur 'gyur ro/ /na maḥs ba rā rde ha ri dra swā hā/ so rtsi la lan bdun bsngags 120—696

pa byas nas gang la byen pa de dbang du 'gyur ro/ /tshangs ma dang / shu dag dang / bā ma dang / pi pi ling dang / sbrang rtsi dang / rgyam tsha dang /seng ldeng rnams mtshan mo bdun gyi nye bar sbyor bas ngag mi gsal ba dag par 'gyur ro/ /bye dang ①ga'i snying po srang gcig /a ru ra srang gcig /ba ru ra srang gcig dang / bu ram srang drug ste 'di dag mnyam pa chu dang bcas pa zos na/ rlung nad ma lus pa sel bar the tshom med/ tshangs pa'i dbyug pa dang / shu dag dang / ru rta dang / pri yang ku ②dang / nā ga ge sar rnams—/ so rtsi dang bcas pa bud med la byin na gzhan gyis dbang du byed par 'gyur ro/ /skar ma rgyal la myos ba san ④tso byed kyi 'bras bu blangs te/skar ma skag la shun pa dang / skar ma me bzhi la 'dab ma dang / skar ma nag pa la me tog dang / skar ma snrubs la rtsa ba rnams blangs te/ 'di rnams phye mar byas nas sbrang dang lhan cig ril bu byas te/ ras kyis bcings nas dril te brdungs ④nas phye mar byas te/ so rtsi dang mnyam du gang la byin pa de thams cad mod la dbang du 'gyur ro/ /sthā rgyu bi kṛ tā na na rtsu hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/sngags 'di 'dab ma la bris nas gang la byen pa de'i nyin gcig pa dang / nyin gnyis pa dang / nyin gsum pa dang / rims mi bzad pa sel bar byed do/ /na mo ratna tra yā ya/ na ma arlu ⑤ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwa ya/ ma hā satā duya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tarya thā/ oṃ ka ri ka ri/ bi ka re stam bha ni bi ka re stam bha ni/ sarba ro ga pra sha ma ni swā hā/ sngags 'di lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas te/ kha la byabs shing / gos la mdud pa byas nas rgyal po'i pho brang du zhugs na rgyal po khros pa rab tu dang bar 'gyur ro/ /ba lang gi so 120—697

dang bya rog gi brun mnyam par btags te/ gang gi mgo la gtor ba de thams cad dbang du 'gyur ro/ /yungs kar ①dkar po dang / shi ba nirmā lha/gang gi khyem du bzhag na de sgod par byed do/ /sā kho ṭa ka'i rtsa ba dang / ba ru ra'i rtsa ba gcig tu byas nas gang gi khyim du bzhag na de'i khyim du rtag tu 'thab mo 'byung ngo / /lga dang / pi pi ling dang / pho ba ris dang /'jam 'bras dang / yung ba dang / skyer pa dang / rgyam tsha dang / ri'i bilba dang / rgya spos kyi rtsa ba dang / saṃ khya nā bhi ste/ 'di dag thams cad chu la btags te mig sman byas na/ rab rib ma lus pa sel bar byed do/ /wā ku dzi kā bri gang dang / rgyam tsha dang / ra'i 'o ma cha mnyam pa byas nas/ ba lang gi chu dang mnyam par sbyar te zangs kyi snod du bzhag nas/ de lus la dril phyi byas na mdze nad ma lus pa sel bar byed do/ /lcags kyi phye ma dang / oṃ sā kaṣṭa dang / de bzhin du skyu ru ra'i 'bras bu dang / khu ba srang bcu dang /khya ba des bsgos nas nyi ma la bzhag ste/ slar yang wā gu dzi kā'i phye ma zho gang byas nas dkrugs te/ rgas pa 'o ma'i bza' ba dang lhan cig zos na zhag bdun gyis mdze nad sel bar byed do/ /de yang gal te las kyi dbang gis na mi 'grub po/ /de bzhin du skyu ru cha bcu dang / bye tang ga cha lnga dang / a ru ra cha bcu dang / tsi tra ka cha lnga dang / wā gu dzi cha bdun dang / lcags phye cha brgyad dang / ra mo shag cha dgu dang / til mar bsres pa zla ba gcig gis skra dkar 'joms so/ /'di ni byug pa mdor bsdus pa'o/ /bye'u khañdza rī ṭa'i rus pa dang / sbrul gyi mgrin pa'i bags pa dang / shing gang la sbyin pa'i bdug pa de shing de'i drung du mnyam par dor ro/ /bye'u khañdza rī ṭa'i sha 120—698

dang sbrang rtsi lhan cig sbyar te/ bya ba'i dus su skye gnas la byugs te/ bud med gang la skyes bu mngon par bsgod ①par byed na de dang po bzhin du skyes pa de'i bur 'gyur ro/ /dgon pa'i 'ug pa bzung ②nas de'i mig dang pi pi ling gis byugs te/ de'i rdul lhung bas mig la mig sman byas na/ de sbas pa de mi mthong ngo / /sā spru ti ta byā dha tra ro parghaṃ ①pra yatstshati/ nas kyi phye ma dang /yung ba'i phye ma dang / ba'i chu dang / mar dang / spos dkar dang /shing mngar rnams mnyam par sbyar te/ gdong la dril phyi byas na/ gdong padma lta bur 'gyur ro/ /rkang pa dag padma'i 'dab ma lta bur 'gyur ro/ /bud med thams cad rgyal po'i pho brang du mdzes shing sdug par 'gyur ro/ /yang shing mngar dang btags te ril bu sbyar nas chu'i bum par bcug na/ bsil bar 'gyur ro/ /oṃ ma hā ba le dza ye swā hā/ gos la yongs su bzlas te bsgos na skal ba bzang por 'gyur ro/ /rig pa 'dzin pas spre'u'i mjug ma blangs te sgrang dang btags nas lte ba'i phyogs su byugs ④na ling ga gyen du 'gyur bar the tshom med do/ /drurba ⑤dkar po dang / shu dag dang / ru rta dang / paṇḍi ta ga ra'i rtsa ba dang / srin lag gi khrag rnams mnyam par sbyar te/ dur khrod kyi thal ba dang 'di dag sbyar bas skyes pa dang bud med dbang du byed do/ /thang phrom dupa dang / shu dag dang / ru rta dang / kaṇḍa ⑦ka ri dang / sa tā ba ri dang / 'di dag cha mnyam par byas nas til mar gyis smin par byas pa'i til mar des/ liṅga nyed par byas na sbom par byed pa'i mchog tu 'gyur ro—/ /lce'i dri ma dang / shu dag dang / ru rta dang / nirma la cha mnyam par phye mar byas nas gang la byin pa de dbang du 'gyur ro/ /a ga ru dang /120—699

gu gul dang / she ①ba shu ṣka dang / utpal sngon po dang / bu ram sbyar bas bdug pa byas nas bdag nyid rgyal po'i pho brang du song ②na mchod pa chen po thob cing btsun mo rnams kyis dri snom par byed do/ /bye'u khañdza rī ṭa'i ④brun blangs te—/ si ri sa'i sa bon byugs pas 'chi ba sel to/ /bya rog gi lce dang /shu dag dang / ru rta dang / pi pi ling dang / 'bras thug po che bdun dang /bdag nyid kyi khu ba sbyar te gang la byin pa de dbang du 'gyur ro/ /shu dag dkar po'i rtsa ba dang / gi wang lhan cig btags te de'i thig le byas nas gang la bltas pa de dbang du 'gyur ro/ /daṇḍi dutpa la'i rtsa ba dang / sgrang rtsi lhan cig btags te ril bu byas nas gang la so rtsi dang lhan cig byin pa de dbang du 'gyur ro/ /oṃ bā ra su mu kham driṣṭa bā larka sa ma te dza sā/ tsa turja kasbra hā ghor ma kṣ-i bra me ba bra ta ⑤su ti/ sngags 'di gro ga'i 'dab ma la bris te lag pa la btags na dhirims nyin bzhi pa phral du nyams par byed do/ /bā gu dzi ka'i 'bras bu'i phye ma dar ba dang lhan cig btags nas de dril te/ dar ba'i zan dang / skyur ba thams cad dang lhan cig zos na gzhang 'brum dang / rkang 'bam dang / 'brum phran dang / mdze dang / mtshan bar rdol ba dang dug rnams sel bar byed do/ /bā gu dzi ka'i 'bras bu dar ba dang lhan cig btags nas de dril bas mje thams cad dang / bi tsartsi ka la sogs pa sel bar byed do/ /bā gu dza ga bye gang dang / seng ldeng zho gang mnyam par byas te/ chu bre brgyad dang bskol ⑦bar bya'o/ /de ni cha phyed lus pa na btungs te/ bya rog gi lce dang / shu dag dang / ru rta dang / bilba'i 'dab ma dang /gur gum dang / bdag nyid kyi khrag dang mnyam par sbyar bas shing yang dbang 120—700

du byed do/ /oṃ pi shā ṭī rū ①bee ṇa liṅga ya tsusba ya/ bha gi sartse ②yanya swā hā/sngags kyi tshig 'di chu khyor ba gang la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas te nyal ba'i dus su rig ma gang gi ming smos nas btab na/ zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig gis mi'i dbang po'i btsan ①mo yin na'ang dbang du 'gyur na gzhan lta ci smos/ khrag sgod pa'i rtsa ba/ karma raṅga'i rtsa ba dang sihra'i lo ma dang / 'di dag mnyam par byas rkang pa'i mazil la byugs na sa bon 'ching bar byed do/ /a ru ra dang /zhu mkhan dang / lung thang gi 'dab ma dang / dha du ra dang / se 'bru'i shun pa dang / sa kha khya naṅga pra ma do mā rmā tā ye paji dus si khaṃ ⑤ka ro ti/ oṃ ra tsaṇḍi ma hā daṇḍa ya swā hā/ sngags 'dis bdun du mngon par bsngags nas gos la sogs par mdud pa byas na bya ba ma lus pa 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /na maḥsākshi⑦ཿka pā la mā li thā hā/ gzhan yang bye la'i khrag blangs nas/ 'jam 'bras til mar gyis bsgos te/ padma'i skud pas sdong bu byas nas dbang phyug gi mdun du dud pa 'chags par byas te mig la byugs ⑦pa tsam gyis mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /oṃ ci ti te te/ sngags 'dis chu dkrugs te mig la byugs na je tshom med par grub par 'gyur ro/ /bya rog gi khrag dang / ce spyang gi mkhris pa dang / 'ug pa'i rus pa dang / 'di dag cha mnyam pa'i ④phye ma zhib mor byas te/ rgyu skar nabs so la btags te/ mig la byugs na mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /sā la paṇi lag pa la bcings nas/ sa ma re kāspyo zlog par byed do—/ /na mabyuṇḍa badzra pā ṇa ye ma hā yakṣa se nā pa ta ye/ tarya thā/ o badzra trispyi spaṭa/ rig sngags 'di lan cig brjod cing / oṃ saṃ tso re ste bha ya swā hā/kā la simbi ka'i rtsa ba dang / ga pur dang / padma ge sar dang / 'di dag cha 120—701

mnyam par byas nas/ chu dang btags te ril bu byas nas grib ma la bskams te—/ ril bu de la yang dag par reg pa'i skyes bu'i lag pa g.yas par padma 'dab ma brgyad pa kun nas bris te/ lag pa des bud med kyi lag pa g.yas pa bzung ①na bud med de mod la dbang du 'gyur ro/ /dri bzang chen po'i rtsa ba rked la bcings na khu ba rengs par byed pa'i mchog tu bstan no④/ /ba rā ha kānta'i rtsa ba chu dang btags te rkang pa'i mthil la byugs na khu ba rengs par byed do—/ /na maḥsarba sidha ①bhyaḥsedherbha ba tra me swā hā/ sngags 'dis ④mngon par bsngags te/ ba bla dhidang / ldong ros dang / spang spos dang / ru rta dang / musta ka ste thams cad gcig tu cha mnyam par byas nas/ zhib tu btags te bud med kyi mgo la bsnun na/ mngag gzhug tu 'gyur ro/ /na maḥkriṇḍa sarba rā ya ma sa kā rmā kuṇḍi bsnya dhimi swā hā/ ji srid nyi ma shar rmi bar du/oṃ rakṣa rakṣa rakṣa swā hā/ sngags 'dis chu khyor ba gang la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas te/ phyogs bzhir gtor na/ sbrang bu rnams spyosgod par byed do/ /ka ra bī ra dmar po'i rtsa ba la lan bdun bsngags te bud med kyi mdun du gtor na bud med sgede'i mod kho na la dbang du 'gyur ro/ /brahma daṇḍi ⑨dang / shu dag dang / lo ma rnams sbrang dang lhan cig btags nas leṅga la byugs nas 'dod pa byas na bdag po gzhan 'dod par mi byed do/ /pa ⑩tsa ka'i mig blangs nas dzwa ti dang surnya dang lhan cig gcig tu byas nas phye ma des mig sman byas na/ skyes bu dbang du 'gyur ro/ /be tsa ka'i snum blangs nas ba'i mar dang lhan cig gcig tu byas nas dud pa dbab par bya'o/ /des mig sman byas nas 'byung po dang sha za rnams kyi dbus su rtse bar byed do/ /be tsa ka'i snying 120—702

blangs nas chang dang lhan cig lus la byugs nas 'dod pa spyad ①na bud med thams cad skyes pa'i dbang du 'gyur ro/ /tshangs pa'i shing gi rtsa ba khar bcug na khu ba rengs par byed do/ /lda dang / pi pi ling dang / na le sham dang /rgya skyegs ④dang / zi ra dang / zi ra nag po dang / shing kun dang /sgog pa dang / lan tshwa dang / shing tsha dang / 'dab ma dang / ku ṭa rnams chang dang btags te/ phra hā rosbi te na/ a sheṣā dzi rṇa tasgo bā shwarya ro bya④ཿ thams cad nyams par byed do/ /gang zhig su byu bcu gnyis 'thungs/ /bad kan tshogs ni 'joms byed cing / /rlung yang nye bar 'dren par byed/ /a dzirṇa dzir ④sarya su spru ha ⑤masgo da ka ni saṃ/ a dza mo da rangadaga' ba tsha ba gsum/ /rgyam tsha zi ra rnam gnyis dang / shing kun cha brgyad mnyam par bzung / /'di yi phye ma mar sar dang / /skye bo gang zhig za byed pa/ /rlung gi nad ni sel bar byed/ /rū la ma yastu pu na bhu rjob yaḥ bi ba ti kṣi ra ṇa ba pra tya tsurṇa byugya gu ḍo sa ma ⑦hi ta ba to jo rte ya ṣaṣṭa ⑧se naḥtī rmā ⑨gophopi sa dzā ya tophortsi ta rpā dzee haṃ ⑩send+ra kurnya pra sgo/ mā so ni badhi ⑪ra ju barṣa ba ya sā mu khyo dza rā byā bye bhiḥ.a ru ra srang gcig /ba ru ra srang gcig /skyu ru ra srang gcig /tsi tra ka srang gsum/ bee ⑫srang gcig /pi pi ling srang gcig /na le sham srang gcig /nā ga ge sar gyi phye ma zho bzhi/ pho ba ris dkar po zho do/ sdig srin rwa zho do/ dug zho do/ 'di dag thams cad phye ma zhib mor byas nas bu ram srang lnga bcu rtsa lnga dang bsres te gang gis zos pa de me stobs su 'gyur ro/ /thos pa 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /mdze nad bco brgyad nyams par 'gyur ro/ /thang byed kyi nad dang / glo dang 'bugs spyodang / de bzhin du/ mchin 120—703

nad dang / skya rba ba dang / 'bras dang / rlung nad dang / sbrul dang /srin bu khru ta dang / dug nad sel bar byed do/ /de bzhin du brtan pa dang g.yo ba 'ang ngo / /stobs glang po che dang mnyam par 'gyur ro/ /shugs rta lta bur 'gyur ro/ /zla ba gcig gis mer 'gyur ro/ /rna ba phag lta bur 'gyur ro/ /mig bya rgod lta bur 'gyur ro/ /'di thams cad kyis mi 'phrogs ①par 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa rgyal ma zhes bya ba'i ril bu yongs su rdzogs so// //na mo ratna tra yā ya/ na mabyaṇḍa sdebadzra pā ṇi ye ①ma hā yakṣa se na pa ta ya④/tarya thā/ oṃ dzwa ra gri rjorku dzwa ra gri rjorku gardza gardza/ tstshardu tstshardu/ muñtsa muñtsa/nyin gcig pa dang / nyin gnyis pa dang / nyin gsum pa dang / nyin bzhi pa dang / rims mi bzad pa rnams/ a ṭa ha ṭa phyag na rdo rje'i bka' bzhin du/ hu ru hu ru/ byu na byu na/ bi dhu na bi dhu na/ se ri muñtsa ka hūṃ muñtsa twa zhi ⑦da yi muñtsa muñtsa/ ḍa ⑧da ram̐ muñtsa/ ka ṭi muñtsa muñtsa kaṣṭha muñtsa/haste muñdza/ bā do muñtsa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ⑨phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa che ge mo'i rims nyams par gyis shig swā hā/ rims bzlog pa'o/ /dbang po'i nas dang / zhu mkhan dang /pu she tsi dang ma ⑩sar/ spos dkar/ pa masngospe/ bī tā/ ni phaṭa'i ⑫'dab ma rnams gcig tu byas nas btags te gdong la byugs na gdong zla ba lta bur 'gyur ro/ /kā ma yā'i rtsa ba gtsug tu bcings na gnyid du 'gyur ro/ /ku dzre rastsorja'i spertertsa ba khar bcug na ral gri la sogs pa zlog par byed do/ /a lo mu ṣā'i rtsa ba rna ba gnyis la bcings na rims nyin bzhi pa nyams par byed do/ /dur khrod du skyes pa'i dro ṇa putpa'i khu bas mig bkang na mig gi me tog sel bar byed do/ /kyu dag i ⑩ni ka'i rtsa ba dang / gi waṃ lhan cig btags nas thig 120—704

le byas na rgyal po'i sgor mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /shri ①gā la bstu kā'i (gertsa ba rna ba la bcings na mig nad sel bar byed do/ /sa kho ṭa ka'i rtsa bas mgul nad sel bar byed do/ /bhu mi tsam pa ka'i rtsa ba btags nas btungs ②na lto ba'i zug sel bar byed do/ /dka' thub pa'i chu 'ongs pa dang / 'bras sā lu ④ dang / 'bras thug po che dang / ka ra dkar po dang lhan cig btungs na bud med rnams kyi khrag 'bab pa sel bar byed do/ /tri shu li ka'i rtsa ba khar bcug na glang po che dbang du 'gyur ro/ /thra ha tī dkar po'i rtsa ba 'bras thug po che'i chu dang btags nas btungs na rde nad sel bar byed do/ /su bāṇḍa se pā le ka'i rtsa ba dar ba dang lhan cig btags nas byug pa byas ⑤na khye rngo sel bar byed do/ /mngon par bgrod pa'i dus su aldi bstu ka'i rtsa ba khar bcug na mod la bud med dbang du 'gyur ro/ /a la mu ṣā'i rtsa ba ko dzi ka dang btags nas mgo bo la byabs na mgo'i nad sel bar byed do/ /arka dkar po'i rtsa ba dar ba dang btags nas btungs na mig ser sel bar byed do/ /nā ga lam dzā ⑥ti'i rtsa ba khar bcug na mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /'o ma dang lhan cig zos nas chags par byas na bu skye bar 'gyur ro/ /sgo dza nañtsa e ka ba ⑦la yā dughi na sa ha kā ra dang sge/ mkhan pa'i rtsa ba dang / dro ṇa putpa'i rtsa ba dang / yung ba dang / 'bras thug po che lhan cig byas nas/ dril phyi byas te/ chus bkrus na gsal por smra bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du nā ga ge sar dang / stha la kusbyi dang / nā ga da ma na ka dang / da ma na ka puṣa pa rnams kyi rtsa bas dril phyi byas te chus bkrus na/ klu nor rgyas kyi bu'ang dbang du 'gyur ro/ /na ma:ṇḍa badzra pā ṇa ye ma hā yakṣa se nā pa ta ye/ tarya thā/ a na le a na le tu tu swā hā/120—705

sngags 'di tsha ba'i til mar la brgya rtsa brgyad mngon par bsngags par byas te rkang pa gnyis la byugs na dpag tshad du mar mi ngal bar 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /sngon du bsnyen pa 'bum byas pas so/ /mkha' 'gro dhirnams kyis phyag rgya 'byed par 'gyur ro/ /bcings pa grol ba las bzlas par bya'o/ /na maḥku su mā li kā ya hi ma ra dru re sa ba ri swā hā/ byi ba sgrib par byed pa'i sngags so/ /a pā marga'i rtsa ba la bdun bsngags pa'i srad bu yongs su bcings na rims nyin gcig pa sel bar byed do/ /pa rā ha krānta'i phagaganon pa rtsa ba lag pa la bcings na lang tsho nyams pa la'ang bu 'byung ngo / /daṇḍi tpa la'i rtsa ba dang / gi waṃ lhan cig btags nas thig le byas te rgyal po'i pho brang du zhugs na/ rgyal po'i pho brang la sogs pa yul 'khor gyi skye bo dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /ka ko la'i rtsa ba phrad par byas na so'i zug rngu sel bar byed do/ /ta da ②sthā kṛm yaḥnā sha ya ti/ bhri ga rā ④dza'i rtsa ba dang / a pa ra dzi ta'i rtsa ba dang / me tog phyungs te mgrin par bcings na sgog 'bras sel bar byed do/ /bstu ka'i rtsa ba bā sa'i chu dang bcas pa btungs na skya rbab kyi nad sel bar byed do/ /tikta la shu'i rtsa ba kañdzi ka dang btags te spyi bor byugs na mgo bo'i zug sel bar byed do/ /su barṇa se pā li ka'i rtsa ba sbrang rtsi dang lhan cig btungs na/ dri chu 'gags pa sel bar byed do/ /sidzdza'i rtsa ba bu ram dang lhan cig zos na gnyid du 'gyur ro//baṭa'i rtsa ba btags nas byin na mig ser sel bar byed do/ /kaspyo kā ④ra'i rtsa ba rked pa la bcings na mig nad sel bar byed do/ /srum ⑤patta dang / bhañdza na'i rtsa ba btags nas bee'i khu ba dang / rgyam tsha dang / til mar lhan cig bsres te rna ba bkang na rna ba'i zug rngu sel bar byed do/ /kriṣṭa dusā ka'i rtsa ba 120—706

btags na so'i zug rngu sel bar byed do/ /guñdza'i smarumago nag rtsa ba dum bu bdun du byas nas srad bu bdun rked par bcings na gzhang 'brum gyi nad sel bar byed do/ /na ba ma li'i rtsa ba ma bkrus pa bya rog ma grag ①pa'i dus su bde bar phyung nas srad bu bdun dang bcas pa rked par bcings na tsi tū ④na sel bar byed do/ pa tyā'i la ka'i rtsa ba'i so shing zos na mig ser sel bar byed do//sba'i rtsa ba bskol ①nas btungs na mdze nad sel bar byed do/ /skyu ru ra dang nidza'i lo ma lhan cig btags nas zos te/ sā kho ṭa dhika'i rtsa ba dang / kañdzi ka btags nas byugs na rlung / 'bras sel bar byed do/ /sa ṇa'i rtsa ba so ⑤rtsi dang lhan cig thos rjon dbang po'i nad 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /'dab ma dang bcas pa'i da ma na ka'i rtsa ba btags nas btungs na yongs su 'gyur ba'i zug rngu sel bar byed do/ /su warṇa se phru li ka'i rtsa ba khar bcug na rgyan rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /ba so rta ra'i si pha phyung nas lte ba'i phyogs su bcings na bud med bde bar btsa' bar 'gyur ro/ /yang dza yarnyi'i rtsa ba khar bcug na tha snyad las rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /ba rā ha krānta'i rtsa ⑦ba lag pa la bcings na tha snyad kyis mi thub par 'gyur ro/ /a pa ra dzi ta'i rtsa ba skar ma rgyal la phyung nas ras bal la snum byugs te dud pa dbab par bya'o/ /des mig sman byas na skye bo thams cad dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /kunda'i rtsa ba skar ma rgyal la byung ste/ pra sā ra ka'i gnas su bzhag na tshong rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /ma yu ra si khā'i rma bya'i gtsug phud rtsa ba rang gi khu ba dang btags nas sor mo la byugs na bud med 'dzag par the tshom med do/ /rnya ma dā ⑧ti'i rtsa ba 'dab ma dang bcas pa btags nas se pha la byugs na bud med 'dzag go/ /nā ga ge sar gyi yu ba/ a sho 720—707

ka'i rtsa ba dang / so rtsi dang chang gang la sbyin pa de'i a matstsha ka zhi bar byed do/ /su ri dang su nā la so rtsi bcos pa zos na/ khu ba rengs pa'i mchog tu 'gyur ro//jiṅga rā dza' dmoshartsa ba rang gi khu bar ①btags pas mig sman byas ④na/ gang dang gang mthong ba de dang de dbang du byed do/ /rang gi khrag dang gi waṃ gis thig le byas na bud med gang mthong ba de dbang du byed do/ /byi tang ga dang /bhasthā ta ka dang / tsi tra ka dang / a bha yā dang / sa nā ga rā dang mnyam pa'i ril bus mar sar ①lhags na gang ngal bar 'gro ba'i skyes bu de rlung dang mtshungs par 'gyur ro/ /bud shing gi khu ba dang / 'bras bu gsum dang /lcags kyi phye ma dang / 'dam gyi padma dang / bhriṅga'i khu bas kyang ngo / /arma pa bhu than mos ba niṣṭi/ rañdza ti ke sha ka pā la na santa ④haṃ/ guñdza dkar po'i rtsa ba skar ma rgyal byung nas/ te na daṣṭa ka gya na saṃ ⑤pā ma nā dhisi kā yaḥpra ṭi pra dorte ⑦tsabyu te/ guñdza dkar po'i rtsa ba rked pa la bcings na bdag nyid kyi khrag sel bar byed do/ /de'i rtsa ba skye gnas la byug par byen na mngal bsdams pa bca' bar byed do/ /guñdza ⑧dkar po'i rtsa ba phye ma zhib mor byas nas ma he'i 'o ma la bcug na zho smin par 'gyur ro/ /sā kho ṭa ka'i 'o ma zigs ⑨pa gnyis bcug ste/ legs par smin pa nyi ma gsum pa la bsrubs pa'i mar gsar blangs te/ dar ba/ ta krañtsa ⑩dza hwa sā pa ⑪ya/ me tog dkar po gtor ⑫bya'o/ /nyi ma gzhan la de'i me tog nag por 'gyur ro/ /mar sar des thod par mig sman du 'gyur ro/ /rdza ⑫bī ra'i rtsa ba btags na/ dza: ka'i nad sel bar byed do/ /pand+rag pa ti ka'i rtsa ba btags na bems po'i nad sel bar byed do/ /ṛ ④tu bī tī'i spyo'abyung po'i nyi ma bzhi pa la nā ga ge sar gyi 120—708

lo ma dang / kha dog gcig pa'i ba'i 'o ma btungs na/ nyi ma bzhi pa la skyes bu'i mdze nad sel bar byed do/ /sgyu ru ra ge sar las skyes pa'i khu ba dang lhan cig lcags kyi sdod du btags te mig sman byas na rab rib sel bar byed do/ /snyu ①narna wa'i rtsa ba dang / so so bhañdza na'i rtsa ba dang / 'bras thug po che'i chu dang btags nas de nyid btungs na mkhris pa sel ba'i mchog go/ /tand+ra li kā'i ②rtsa bas mkha' 'gro ma'i gdon dag gis bzung ba'i snying gi zug rngu sel bar byed do/ /kañtsa nā'i rtsa ba dang / shun pa dang / dar ba mnyam par btungs na zas kyis brnangs pa sel bar byed do/ /āo shwa ra'i rtsa ba dang kañdzi ka btags nas byugs na gdug pa'i rma sel bar byed do/ /de bzhin du gdug pa'i rma'i gnas su byug par yang bya'o/ /tro sru li kā'i rtsa ba btags nas byug par byin ④na/ dug nad sel bar byed do/ /taṇḍa li kā'i 'dab ma dang bcas pa'i rtsa ba dang / aghi bstu ka'i rtsa ba'i khu ba btags nas lus la byugs na bcud skam sel bar byed do/ /su darsha ka'i rtsa ba btags nas byugs rjon mig nad zhi bar byed do/ /go dzi tī'i rtsa ba ras bal la bcings na tha snyad las rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /a shwa garnya'i rtsa ba mar dang lhan cig btungs na mngal brtan par byed pa'i mchog go/ /su ra bha ti ⑤ga ra'i rtsa ba btags nas byugs na srin bu lca ta'i dug sel bar byed do/ /gi rī dhikarnyi ka'i rtsa ba btags na sgog 'bras sel bar byed do/ /utpal sngon po dang / gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i rtsa ba so rtsir byen na dbang du byed pa'i mchog go/ /a pā mārga'i rtsa ba dang /rgyam tsha dang / ga ma dzi ka lhan cig zangs kyi snod du sbyar nas mig sman byas na mig tshag pa sel bar byed do/ /dza yanta'i rtsa ba nyil mar gyis smin par byas 120—709

nas zos na bcud nyams par byed do/ /ka rañdza'i rtsa ba dang / ma hā kā la'i rtsa ba dang / ta rku ①la'i chu btung bar byin na sa'i ②dug sel bar byed do/ /de bzhin du bu narna bā dkar po'i rtsa ba phyung nas sna bug tu byin na gdug pa'i dug sel bar byed do/ /pā tha'i snertsa ba dar ba dang lhan cig btungs na tshad pas 'khru ba sel bar byed do/ /mand+ra rā'i rtsa ba 'o ma dang lhan cig btungs na rlung nad sel bar byed do/ /arka'i rtsa ba dang / ri ṣi dhipū ṭo li ka'i rtsa ba sa bon dang lhan cig cha mnyam par byas nas chu dang btags te bshang lam du byugs na gzhang 'brum sel bar byed do/ /dri sru li ka'i rtsa ba 'o ma dang btags te gi waṃ dang lhan cig zangs kyi snod du bzhag nas mig la byugs na/rab rib sel bar byed do/ /a ru ra dang / zhu mkhan dang / lung thang gi 'dab ma dang / shing kun dang / shu dag ⑤rnams chu dang lhan cig btags nas gal te sos btab na 'chi ba de'i tshe yang 'di byin na rnal du gnas par 'gyur ro/ /ko ki lākṣa'i rtsa ba dang / ku ḍū tsi dang / ba sha ka dang /dbyug pa'i utpal dang / su wartses 0rā li ka'i sa bon dang / bri ⑦ha ti'i rtsa ba dang / cha mnyam par byas nas yungs kar gyi snum dang lhan cig btungs na rkang 'bam ⑧dang rlung nad sel bar byed do/ /go dzi tra'i ⑨rtsa ba dar ba dang lhan cig btungs na rked pa'i nad sel bar byed do/ /utpala'i rtsa ba ba'i mar dang lhan cig btungs na priṣa ⑩ṇa'i rlung sel bar byed do/ /ku dza ṭa'i rtsa ba phye mar byas nas sbrang dang lhan cig byin na rtsa'i rma sel bar byed do/ /pa ra me swara'i rtsa ba dang shu dag byugs ⑪na 'bras sel bar byed do/ /suṇḍi kā'i rtsa ba dang / lga dang lhan cig lag pa la byugs na mi rengs par byed do/ /bantu 120—710

ki'i rtsa ba snar byen na sna nad sel bar byed do/ /bā ①rā ha krānta'i rtsa ba yungs kar gyi mar dang lhan cig khar bcug na/ skye bo thams cad kyi mig 'ching bar byed do/ /pra ④ju mā lo/ oṃ khaṅga wā ri bhā swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags kyis kha la btab nas mtshon bza' bar bya'o/ /a ga ru dang / gu gul dang / shrī wā sa dang / tsan dan dang / ṣpe pā li kā'i 'dab ma dang / nirmās rnams bu ram dang lhan cig cha mnyam par byas nas bdag nyid bdugs te/ rgyal po'i pho brang du phyin na skye bo thams cad kyis de'i dri snom par byed cing / thams cad mngag gzhug tu 'gyur ro/ /til nag po dang / skyu ru ra dang / jiṅga ①rā dza dang / 'di dag cha mnyam par byas nas mar dang lhan cig zos na skra dkar dang / rab rib dang / skya rbab rnams sel bar byed do/ /kā ka dzi rjogha'i rang bzhin bshad par bya ste/ sman chen po kā ka dzi gha a ti bā khā/ de bzhi du ba la khaṃ dang / ba raṇḍa'i 'dab ma dang / khu ba dang / yungs kar dkar po dang / maṇḍa ka'i ril ma rjobre gang gis smin par byas te/ 'dis rtsa ba bkrus na chu klung gi shugs kyang zhi bar byed do/ /kā ka rdza ghā'i khu ba blangs te/'di'i rtsa ba dang btags nas rma la btab na rma gso ba'i mchog go/ /'di'i 'dab ma dang / 'bras thug ⑥po che'i chu dang btags te bkrus shing bskams nas rma til ⑦mar gyis bkang na rtsa gso ba'i mchog go/ /'di'i 'dab ma'i khu ba dang / ba lang gi chu lhan cig khas bzung na kha'i nad sel bar byed do/ /kā ka rdza ghā dang / skyu ru ra dang / ba ru ra dang / jiṅga rā dza' khu ba blangs nas—/ ⑧til mar gyis smin par ⑨byas na khi nya 'phel bar byed do/ /thos pa rengs pa sel bar byed do/ /sbrang dang lhan cig gis sgog 'bras tukyesel bar 120—711

byed do/ /bhalbā ta ka dang / lhan cig zos na mdze nad sel bar byed do/ /mar sar dang lhan cig gis skyigs tshosnabu'i nad sel bar byed do/ /spos dkar dang lhan cig gis mtshan bar rdol ba sel bar byed do/ /khaṇḍa dang lhan cig gis kha nad sel bar byed do/ /ba'i chu dang lhan cig gis me dbal sel bar byed do/ /'phags pa rtsa ba'i mdzod sman chen po'i rim pa slob dpon dpal ldan 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa yongs su rdzogs so// //pri yo ku 2dang / ka ko la dang / shu dag dang / ru rta dang /yungs kar dkar po dang / nā ga putpa dang / spos dkar rnams kyi bdug pa byas na myur du tshong 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /sgog pa zos na 1a ru dang / ku ṭa btags na dri ma med par 'gyur ro/ /chang btungs nas durba btags na dri ma med par 'gyur ro/ /pa ro byā'i khu ba btab na chang dkar por 'gyur ro/ /yang / so so bī ra btab na rang bzhin du gnas par 'gyur ro/ /kā ra sum kha dkar po'i rtsa ba dang rma bya'i gtsug phud kyi rtsa ba dang / gzhan kyis mi thub pa dkar po'i rtsa ba rnams snyegacig tu byas nas btags te grib ma la bskams pa'i ril bu khar bcug cing sa/ lus la byug pa du byas na g.yul las kyematshon cha bzlog par byed do/ /skyu ru ra'i rtsa ba dang / me tog phyung nas khar bcug na g.yul las snomatshon cha rengs par byed do/ /udha dha ga '-i tai ba nā ni sikta mṛnti rmā kṛ khya dasto da ra ma bye pratī su ya ta kṛ ha phaṭa la sthā yeta/ ta tra i྾ kā ya tinta/ tsa turda dhyā/ ba hu bā ra brikṣa tsugya dakṣi ṇa sā khaṃ kṛ khya ka ra yi tā shriṅga kyem tīthra sha dasni11/ tāhūṃ tai/ phug ron gyi brun dang / lham bu chu gsher kyi chu dang /gu gul dang / shing tsha dang / na gi dang / ru rta dang / ga na ka'i sa bon dang /120—712

bsdur 'bras re'u migasna tshogs/ (125)120—715

༄/ /tshe'i rig byed mtha' dag gi snying po bsdus pa/hūṃ༄go/ /bla ma dang sangs rgyas sman kyi bla drang srong tshe'i rig sne byed 'dzin pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thog mar nad kyi mtshan nyid brtag pa ni/pho ba'i nad rnams rlung la brten/ sems 'khrul pa dang za du zir 'byung ba mkhris pa la brten/ rang bzhin gyis 'khrul pa bad kan la brten/ tshad pa ma 'ju ba la brten/ rlung gi tshad pa'i nad yun gyi tshad zhag bdun/ mkhris tshad zhag bcu/ bad kan tshad pa zhag bcu gnyis/ rlung tshad kyi brtag sdepa ni/tshigs rnams brdungs pa lta bur na/ g.yal stong 'byung zhing bya snyeng byed snying 'dod / grang shum shin tu che/ lus kyi ba spu ldang / mgo dang chu rgyus rtsib tre logs mur gong rkang mthil rnams lhag par na/ sgreg 9pa yang yang 'byung /rna ba 'on/ kha la ro bska/ mig dang sen mo shin tu dmar/ lus la rdul 'byung / de rnams tshang ba'am shas che na nges par rlung dang ldan pa'o/ /120—716

rtags de rnams shas che zhing rtsar mkhris pa dang bad kan gnyis ka 'dug na 'dus pa'i rtags so/ /mkhris tshad kyi rtags la/ chu yang yang 'tshag snying 'dod cing btsags tshe na zug kyang cung zad 'byung / lus drod shin tu che/mchu skam/ kha'i nang dang lce sogs la thor pa chung ngu mang du 'byung / sna khrag 'bab/ mig mnan pa lta bu 'degs dka'/ gos gon 'bud byed snying 'dod—/ mig dang sen mo mdog ser/ kha nas dri ngan pa 'byung / khar ro kha/ de rnams tshang ba'am shas che na mkhris pa ldan pa'o/ /rtags 'di rnams shas che zhing rtsar rlung rtsa dang bad kan gnyis ka 'dug na 'dus pa'i nad kyi rtags so/ /bad kan kyi rtags la/ lus dang shes pa phyi bas gang yang byed mi 'dod pa/ dang she7kha 'gags shing zas gang la'ang bro ba med/ mig mnan pa lta bur lci ba/ lus rtse ba yang 5byed/ lus la drod cung zad yod pa/sems rtsa 'khrug /nyal snying 'dod/ kha la ro skyur/ mchil ma mang du 'byung zhing sgyur dgos pa/ lus mdog mdangs med thal kha dang tshi che/mig dang rngusen mo'i mdog ljang / de rnams tshang ba'am shas che na bad kan yin zhing / gong gi rtags rnams phal cher tshang la rtsar rlung dang mkhris pa gnyis ka ldan pa 'dus pa'i rtags so/ /gzhan yang 'dus pa'i rtags la gtam chal chol smra/ gnyid che/ mig dmar zhing mchi ma 'dzag /lce 'gags so/ /nad glo bur ba'i rtags la/ mig mdongs rnyinas blta nan che zhing g.yo 'gul nyung / lus sdod mi tshugs so/ /de ltar rtags dang rtsa mthun na rkyang pa dang / dper na rlung gi rtags la mkhris pa'i rtsa/ mkhris pa'i rtags la rlung gi rtsa lta bu 'dug na mkhris rlung ste des rigs bsgres te shes par 120—717

bya'o / /rtsa la brtag pa la/ rtsa ba rlung mkhris bad kan gsum gyi rtsa/ de las gyes pa bcu bzhi ste/ rlung gi gnas su rlung / mkhris pa/ bad kan dang nye ba'i rlung / mkhris pa'i gnas su mkhris pa/ rlung / bad kan/bad kan dang nye ba'i mkhris pa/ bad kan gyi gnas su bad kan/ rlung /mkhris pa/ mkhris pa dang nye ba'i bad kan te bcu gnyis/ gsum ga'i gnas su rgyu ba'i khrag dang chu'i rtsa ste bcu bzhi'o/ /de la rlung gi rtsa ni sbom la mgyogs / mkhris pa'i rtsa ni bye grims la mgyogasarkye/ bad kan kyi rtsa ni 'ulhod la dal ba yin la/ de yang zhogs pa lus ma 'khrugs shing zas gang yang ma zos gong du blta ste mkhrig ma'i gnyer ma dang po nas rim bzhin nam mkha'/rlung / me/ chu/ sa lnga las nam mkha' dang sa'i gnas bor ba'i rlung me chu gsum gyi gnas mtshon kan chag gsum gyi 'og tu rim pa ltar rlung mkhris bad kan gsum gyi gnas su bzung la/ rlung gnas rang gi rlung / mkhris pa'i gnas kyi rlung / bad kan kyi gnas kyi rlung gsum/ de yang rlung gnas rang gi rlung rtsa sbrul sarbagyi 'gros lta bur 'phar/ mkhris gnas kyi rlung bya rog bha ipa gi 'gros ltar 'phar/ bad kan gnas kyi rlung rma bya'i mayur 'gros ltar 'phar/de bzhin du mkhris gnas rang gi mkhris rtsa sreg pa laba'aphur ba ltar 'phar/rlung gnas kyi mkhris rtsa shig rdzugi 'gros ltar 'phar/ bad kan gnas kyi mkhris rtsa 'bab chu pāṇiltar 'phar ba/ bad kan rang gnas kyi rtsa ngang pa'i rgyal po'i haṃ sa rā dza 'gros ltar 'phar/ rlung gnas kyi bad kan gye rtsa srin 'bu padma can dzo luka gyi 5'gros ltar 'phar/ mkhyes gnas kyi bad kan gyi rtsa sbal pa'i maṇḍaka'agros ltar 'phar/ khrag la'ang gsum ste rlung gnas kyi khrag rtsa nya'i mtshali'agros ltar 720—718

'phar—/ mkhris gnas kyi khrag rtsa bye'u'i ciriskad ltar 'phar/ bad kan gnas kyi khrag rtsa phu ron kabyutragyi 'gros ltar 'phar/ chu la gnyis te rlung gnas dang mkhris gnas kyi chu'i rtsa rta'i rewa'agros ltar 'phar/ bad kan gnas kyi chu'i rtsa khyim bya'i kukluṭi'agros ltar 'phar la/ rlung gi gnas su sbrul gyi 'gros ltar 'phar na rang gnas su rang 'gros te nad med kyi rtsa/ sreg pa'i 'gros ltar 'phar na mkhris rlung gi nad tshan che zhing bcos dka'/ zu'i 'gros ltar 'phar na 'bring / shig gi 'gros ltar 'phar na mkhris rlung yin kyang tshan chung la bcos sla/ go rim de bzhin ngang pa'i rgyal bo sbal pa srin bu padma can gye 'gros ltar 'phar na bad rlung che 'bring chung gsum/ nya'i 'gros ltar 'phar na khrag rlung yin kyang tshan chung / bye'u ltar 'phar na khrag rlung 'bring po/ phug ron ltar 'phar na khrag rlung gi nad babs lci/ de bzhin du rta'i 'gros ltar 'phar na rlung gi chu gso sla①/ khyem bya'i 'gros ltar 'phar na gzhi che/mkhris pa'i gnas su sreg pa 'phur ba ltar 'phar na rang gnas su rang ste nad med kyi rtsa/ sgrul dang rma bya'i 'gros bya rog gi skad gsum rim pa ltar mdzas rlung che 'bring chung gsum/ ngang pa'i rgyal po srin 'bu padma can/ sbal pa gsum gyi ①'gros ltar 'phar na bad mkhris che 'bring chung gsum/ bye'u'i skad ltar 'phar na khrag mkhris chung ru / nya dang khyem bya'i 'gros ltar 'phar na khrag mkhris tshan che/ rta'i 'gros ltar 'phar na chu dang mkhris pa gzhi ①chung /khyem bya'i 'gros ltar 'phar na gzhi che/ bad kan gyi gnas su ngang pa'i rgyal po'i 'gros ltar 'phar na rang gnas su rang ste nad med/ sbrul dang bya rog rma bya gsum rim pa ltar bad rlung che 'bring chung gsum/ sreg pa shig chu gsum 120—719

bad mkhris che 'bring chung gsum/ nya bye'u phug ron gsum bad khrag che 'bring chung gsum/ rta'i 'gros ltar 'phar na chu dang bad kan shas che/ khyem bya'i 'gros ltar 'phar na chu dang bad kan yin kyang shas chung ngo / /de yang mtshon gyi mas sgor mkhris rtsa dang / dkan gyi yas ①ster rlung rtsa/ dkan ①gyi mas sder bad kan gyi rtsa dang / chag gi yas sner mkhris pa'i rtsa 'phar na nye ba'i gnas yin pas skyon chung ngo / /rlung gi gnas su mkhris rtsa shig gi 'gros ltar 'phar na rlung mkhris yin kyang bcos na myur du bde zhing ma bcos kyang 'tsho'o/ /rlung gnas su bad kan gyi rtsa srin bu padma can gye 'gros ltar 'phar na mgo na/glo dgog pa sogs 'byung zhing skyon chung yang ④ma bcos na ngang pa'i rgyal po'i 'gros ltar song dogs pa'i nyen yod do/ /'phral du nad zug gzer che yang rlung gi gnas su khrag gi rtsa nya'i 'gros ltar 'phar na bcos kyang myur du bde zhing ma bcos kyang mi ring bar 'tsho ba'o/ /rlung gi gnas su chu'i rtsa rta'i 'gros lta bu 'phar na dbugs kha mi bde ba/ mig dmar zhing mig 'dag mang ba sogs 'byung / mkhris pa'i gnas su rlung rtsa bya rog gi 'gros ltar 'phar na kha skam skom dad che/ tshags ④tshigs sogs khol bur na yang gso bee⑤/ mkhris pa'i gnas su bad kan gyi rtsa sbal pa'i 'gros ltar 'phar na mgo bo na/ kha nas mchil ma yang yang 'bo dgos shing mdzas pa'ang cung zad skyug go/ /mkhris dhipa'i gnas su khrag gi rtsa bye'u'i skad ltar 'phar na lus la rtse yas byed ci ④nas khrag cung zad 'dzag pa dang / thor pa chung ngu 'byung / mig gi mdangs dmar ser du 'ong ngo / /mkhris pa'i gnas su chu'i rtsa rta'i 'gros lta bur ⑧'phar na dwangs ma 'dzag /lus 'khyolas shing 'khor/ mig na zhing mig chu 120—720

'dzag go/ /bad kan gyi gnas su rlung gi rtsa rma bya'i 'gros ltar 'phar na lus grang shum byed cing rkang lag gi mgo drod med/ mdog snum/ zhag chung zhing skya thal pho ba sbos pa dang 'khrog pa 'byung ngo / /bad kan gyi gnas su mkhris pa'i rtsa 'bab chu'i 'gros ltar 'phar na glo dgog /brang tsha/ 'grim zhing dbugs mi bde/ bad kan gyi gnas su khrag gi rtsa phug ron gyi 'gros ltar 'phar na lus drod che/ rngul 'bab/ 'og sgor khrag cung zad 'dzag /'phongs lug pa sogs 'byung / bad kan gyi gnas su rtsa khyem bya'i 'gros ltar 'phar na tshigs na zhing cung zad skrangs pa①/ lus kyi mdangs mi gsal zhing tshi che/ lus dri mi zhim mo/ /rlung gi gnas su mkhris pa'i rtsa sreg pa 'phur ba lta bur 'phar na/dngas ma 'dzag /rked pa na/ lus drod che/ lus las charngul mang du 'dzag /lus gyong / mkhris pa skyug /mig ser/ chu ser por 'bab pa sogs 'byung zhing 'di ni mkhris rlung gi gtso bo ste bcos la bzab bo④/ /rlung gi sa ru mkhris pa'i rlung gi rtsa bya rog gi 'gros lta bur ④'phar na/ lus brdungs pa ltar na/ pho ba sbos/ rna ba 'on/ lus la thor pa dang shu ba sogs 'byung ngo / /rlung gi gnas su mkhyes pa'i bad kan gyi rtsa sbal pa'i 'gros ltar 'phar na/lus 'dar zhing g.yo/ gos gon mi 'dod/ cung zad 'thur (snyedu 'khru/ bya snyong ༷dang / g.yal stong byed/ pho ba 'khrogs ⑦pa sogs 'byung / rlung gi gnas su mkhris pa'i khrag gi rtsa bye'u'i 'gros ltar 'phar na/ lus la za phrug (shebyed—/ tshags tshigs dang mgo bo na/ mig na ba sogs 'byung / rlung gi gnas su mkhris pa'i chu'i rtsa rta'i 'gros ltar 'phar na/ so rnyil skrangs shing chu ser dang khrag 'byung / mkhris tshad bskyed/ dbugs mi bde/ gnyid che/120—721

lus phyi ba sogs 'byung ngo / /rlung gi gnas su bad kan gyi rtsa ngang pa'i rgyal po'i 'gros ltar 'phar na lus brdungs shing gcus ①pa ltar na/ mgo bo 'khor/ dang kha 'gags①/ lus khol bur na/ chu gtong dka' ba sogs 'byung zhing 'di ni bad rlung gi gtso bo ste bcos la bzab snebo/ /rlung gi gnas su bad kan gyi rlung gi rtsa rma bya'i 'gros ltar 'phar na pho ba gcus rjopa ltar na/rtsa gtong dka'/ rked pa dang chu rgyus na/ rlung skran sogs 'byung ngo / /rlung gi gnas su bad kan gyi mkhris pa'i rtsa 'bab chu'i 'gros ltar 'phar na brang tsha—/ grang bsil che/ kha skom⑤/ mig dang sen mo'i mdog ljang khur rjosnang ba—/ dwangs ma 'dzag pa sogs 'byung ngo / /rlung gi gnas su bad kan gyi khrag gi rtsa phug griron gyi 'gros ltar 'phar na/ rngul 'dzag /shu ba dang thor pa 'ong / mig dmar zhing 'byed 'dzums ⑧nyung ba sogs 'byung ngo / /rlung gi gnas su bad kan gyi chu'i rtsa khyem bya'i 'gros ltar 'phar na mig 'grib/pags pa gyong / chu gsog 'byung / rtsa 'bur mor dod/ za 'phrug long ⑨zhing brad pa dang chu ser 'dzag /pho bar srin 'bu 'phel ba sogs 'byung ngo / /mkhris gnas su rlung gi rtsa sbrul lta bur 4kye 'phar na/ lus kyi tshags tshigs brdungs pa ltar na/ chu 'tshag dka' zhing zug che/ kha skom ⑪zhing thor pa mang / grang bsel che/ skom dad che/ pho ba na ba sogs 'byung zhing 'di ni mkhris rlung gtso bo ste bcos la bzab ⑫pa gces/ mkhris gnas su rlung gi mkhris pa'i rtsa shig gi 'gros ltar 'phar na/ tshad pa bskyed⑫/ lus skam zhing drod che/ mig mi gsal/ kha rlungs dang rkang mthil drod che ba sogs 'byung /mdzas gnas su rlung gi bad kan gyi rtsa srin bu pad ma can ltar 'phar na/ spyi 120—722

bo na/ le lo dang gnyid che/ mchil ma mang / khar ①ro kha ba sogs 'byung ngo / /mkhris gnas su rlung gi khrag rtsa nya'i 'gros ltar 'phar na/ lus mdog dmar zhing ba spu'i bu ga nas khrag kyang cung zad 'dzag /mig chu mang ba sogs 'byung ngo / /mkhris gnas su rlung gi rtsa ⑤rta'i 'gros ltar 'phar na/ pho ba sbos—/ yan lag skam zhing tshigs dang gdong skrangs/ dri chu khrag ltar bab pa sogs 'byung / mkhris ①gnas su bad kan gyi rtsa ngang pa'i rgyal po'i 'gros ltar 'phar na khar ro mngaradhi/ khong du srin 'bu ⑤'phel/ khog par zo ba'i zho drag dhichags pa lta bu 'byung ngo dzee/ /lus kyi gting drod cung zad che gzhing tshags tshigs sogs khol bur na/ mkhris skran 'cha' ba sogs 'byung ste bad mkhris kyi gtso bo yin pas bcos la gzab pa gces so/ /mkhris pa'i gnas su bad kan gyi rlung gi rtsa rma bya'i 'gros ltar 'phar na/ nyin res 'jog tu na/lus la rngul 'byung zhing dri mi zhim/ mig gi mdangs dkar por 'gro/mchil ma mang ba sogs 'byung / mkhris pa'i gnas su bad kan gyi mkhris rtsa chu'i 'gros lta bur ⑨'phar na/ gnyid che/ lce 'gas/ lus gyong / khrag cung zad skyug pa sogs 'byung ngo / /mkhris pa'i gnas su bad kan kyi khrag rtsa phug ⑩ron gyi 'gros ltar 'phar na/ sna khrag 'bab/ khrag skran 'cha'/ lte ba gcu ⑪zhing gzer/ me lce 'khor lo 'byung / mkhris pa'i gnas su bad kan gyi chu'i rtsa khyem bya'i 'gros lta bur 6)'phar na/ dang 0 kha mi bde/ me drod 'chor/ ma 'ju ba'i nad dang 'gro 'dug dka' ba sogs 'byung /bad kan gyi gnas su rlung gi rtsa sbrul gyi 'gros ltar 'phar na/ rkang spestepa na/'grims—/ kha dri mi zhim/ mgo bo 'khor/ chu'i mdog ser ba sogs 120—723

'byung ste 'di ni bad rlung gi rtsa ba yin pas gzab bar bcos/ bad kan gyi gnas sa ①rlung gi mkhris rtsa shig gi 'gros ltar 'phar na/ dwangs ma 'dzag lus stobs nyams/ ngas chad pa sogs 'byung / bad kan gyi gnas su rlung gi bad kan gyi rtsa srin bu pad ma can gye 'gros ltar 'phar na/ be snabs ④skyug cing glo che/ skya rbab ①dang mig 'dag mang ba sogs 'byung ngo /④ /bad kan gyi gnas su rlung gi khrag gi rtsa nya'i 'gros ltar 'phar na/ pho ba 'khrog cing na/dwangs ma skams pas lus stobs nyams/ srod long 'byung / nyin re mos kyis 8na ba'o/ /bad kan gyi gnas su rlung gi chu'i rtsa rta'i 'gros ltar 'phar na/pags nad khol bu na ④ba sen mo btab kyang reg pa mi tshor ba/ yan lag skam/dwangs ma 'dzag /lus mgo mjug thams cad na ba sogs 'byung / bad kan gyi gnas su mkhris pa'i rtsa sreg pa 'phur ba ltar 'phar na/ nyal na ldang 'dod—/ ldang na nyal 'dod/ zas skom mi 'dod pa dang chu skyur skyug /lus drod che ba sogs 'byung ste/ 'di yang bad mkhris kyi gtso bo yin pas bcos la bzab/ bad kan gyi gnas su mkhris pa'i rlung rtsa bya rog gi 'gros ltar 'phar na/ gsus pa sbo/ mas rlung gyen du ldog /gzhang 'brum 'ong ⑦ba sogs 'byung / bad kan gyi gnas su mkhris pa'i bad kan gyi rtsa sbal pa'i 'gros ltar 'phar na/ khrag 'grims/ be snabs sgyugs⑧/ lus dri mi zhim pa sogs 'byung / bad kan gyi gnas su mkhris pa'i khrag gi rtsa bye'u'i skad ltar 'phar na/ chu sogs ⑨'byung / brang tsha/ rtsib 4)logs dang mchin pa na/dang ①gekha mi bde zhing zas mi 'ju ba sogs 'byung / bad kan gyi gnas su mkhris pa'i chu'i rtsa rta'i 'gros ltar 'phar na/ mig kyong du rdib⑫/ chus lus 120—724

skrangasaske/ kha 'grig /tshigs re mos su na ba sogs 'byung ngo / /mkhris pa'i gnas su mkhris par nga gi rtsa sbal pa'i 'gros dang khrag rtsa bye'u'i skad ltar dang ①/ rlung gi mkhris rtsa shig gi 'gros gsum res 'jog tu 'phar na 'dus pa ste kha skom ①zhing 'grig /skom dad che/ lus phyi/ shes pa mi gsal na de ni myur du 'chi zhing mi 'dango/ /bad kan gyi gnas su bad kan rang gi rtsa ngang pa'i rgyal po'i 'gros dang rlung gi mkhris rtsa shig gi 'gros so①/ /mkhris pa'i bad kan gyi rtsa sbal ④pa'i 'gros gsum res 'jog tu 'bar na/ de yang nad gsum 'dus pa ste mi 'dango/ /lus 'khru ba/ sgyugs rjopa/ mgo dang tshags tshigs na ba/ so dang lce nag por song ba/ pho ba dang stod la gzer ba sogs nad rlung mkhris bad kan gsum ga'i rtags tshang zhing / rlung gi gnas su bad kan gyi rtsa ngang pa'i rgyal po'i 'gros ltar 'phar na/ de ni nges par mi 'a/'o—/ /rlung mkhris bad kan gsum ga'i gnas su 'gros rnams nges med sna tshogs su rgyu na nad yun ring zhing 'tsho bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rlung gi gnas su rlung dang / mkhris pa'i gnas su 'ang rlung rtsa 'phar na ma 'ju ba'i nad ste gso sla'o—/ /de ltar rtsa'i dbye ba rnams ma nor bar gtan la phab ste nad gang yin ngos zin pa dang / de'i sman dang spyod lam rnams bya ba ni gnad do/ /zhes drang srong chen po da nand+ra ④ste sbyin pa'i dbang pos ⑦mdzad pa'i rtsa ba rtag ①cing gtan la 'bebs yopa'i rab tu dbye ⑩ba rdzogs so// //120—725

dze /mtshon 'og 'byung ba rlung gi sa rlung gi gnas so//bā da/ pi ta/ ka pha/ bā da/ sarba/rlung mkhris pa bad kun rlung sbrulardzu/ dza lu ka /rakta/shig srin bu padma can khragapā ṇi/ ma tsha li/ re ba/chu nya rtamyu/ zas dang spyod lam bstan pa ni/ rlung gi nad mtha' dag la/ dro sar dal bar 'dug /me la sro zhing byug pa byed/ rtsam pa dang mar/ sha dang de'i khu ba gtong / mkhris phyapa'i nad la bā la dang shri khaṇḍa gnyis zhib par btags la chur sbyar ba'i byug pa byed/ grang sar bsdad/ nad tshabs khyache na lto bkag gtong / gzhan pag thug kho na bsten no/ /bad kun la grang dro ran par byas la dal bus 'chag /sran rtsam ⑦/sogs zas yang zhing 'ju ba'i rigs bsten/ bcud can dang lci ba'i rigs 'dzem dumo/ /dngul chu 'dul lugs la/ rdo gzhong gi nang du dngul chu zho nyi shu rtsa bzhi blug /de dang rdza rnying pa'am so phag khyor gang tsam dang mnyam du nyin gnyis kyi bar du nyed/ de nas chu gtsang mar bsrings te dngul chu dang sa rang sar phye/ chu khog ma phyed tsam blug de la 'bras bu gsum dang rgya gar stod ja zhib par btags phyosnapa khyor gang tsam zhig blug /gong gi dngul chu ras gtsang mas dril la skud pas kha 120—726

bsdams te chur sor bzhi tsam ma reg par ①khebs gcod la gtags te kha legs par bsgrigs ②nas rlangs pa mi 'chor ba byed/ nyi ma'i bzhi cha gcig tsam me btang la rlangs pas btsos/ chu grang thag chod pa dang bton ①te rdo gzhong legs par bkrus pa'i nang du blugs la shing sgo wa kwa ra'i shing gzhogs ④dang mnyam du nyin gsum gye bar grib ma la brdung ba dang nyi ma la bsro ⑤ba chu tshod re tsam gyi bar re mos su byed/ de nas shing che la chang gar mas ⑥khu ba byas nas nyin gsum gyi bar la nyed cing / 'di nas gzung ⑦nyin rer nyi mar 'jog thengs gnyis tsam las sngon ma lugs kyi re mos mi dgos/ de nas skyes pa'i chu dang ra'i 'o ma/ ba'i 'o ma/ ba sar pa'i chu rnams dang mnyam du rim pa bzhin nyin gsum re nyed/ de nas nyi ma me tog gi lo ma logs su brdungs pa'i khu ba/ sgog skeskya rdzogs pa'i khu ba/ ba sar pa'i chu rnams dang mnyam du go rim bzhin nyin re nyed/ de ⑨nas mu zi ser po zho nyi shu rtsa bzhi zhib par btags—/ lcags snod du ba mar sar pa bskol ba'i btsag chod pa dang btab la me cung zad btang nas ba'i 'o ma'i nang du dal bus blug la snyigs ⑩ma ma shor ba byed cing / 'khang pa dang / mar dang 'o ma gnyis 'dres nas mu zi gting du 'khyar ba ltar chags yod pa de dang gong gi dngul chu gnyis bsres nas cung zad nyed/ rdo gzhong zhig tu su ma la zho phyed bzhir ra'i 'o ma cung zad re blug nas nyed/ yang skam pa dang phrugs pa sogs nyin gsum gyi bar byed/ba sar pa'i chu dang 'o ma so sor rim bzhin nyin gsum re'i bar gong bzhin skam 'thag byas la tshar ba dang gong gi dngul chu dang mu zi'i zla la bsres/ rdo gzhong nang du rgya tsha ⑪zho do skyes pa'i chu dang mnyam du skam 'thag gong bzhin nyin gsum 120—727

gyi bar byas nas dngul chu'i zla la bsres pa de rnams rdo gzhong gi nang du nyin bdun gyi bar du skam nyed byed/ de nas bzhu shel gyi dam pe ras kyis dril la 'jim pa byugs/ de skams pa dang yang ras dang 'jim pa rim pa bdun gyi bar dril ba'i nang du gsum gnyis tsam gang ba blug /lcags kyi skya ba dam per bcug /rdza'i khog ma gnying du bye ma sor gsum tsam gting ba'i steng du bzhag ste kha 'tshams (she)par bye mas stems②/ dam pe'i nang du zha nye zho phyed do blug ste/lcags mdas dal bus dkrugs ④pa dang nyi shar nas nyi ma rgas tsam gyi bar me gtong / de nas lcags mda' bton ④la kha rgya tsha ⑤btags pa'i chus brdzis dupa'i 'dam gyis bcad/ de steng bye ma bkab ste khebs rgyab la nyin zhag phrug gcig gi par ⑦me shin tu tsha ba mtshams ma chad par btang / de nas bye ma grang thag ma chod ring tho ma btang bar bzhag /grang ④nges pa dang bton ⑨la dal bus dam pe bcag la phyung bas dngul chu dug bral lhad med du yod do/ /༈ yang lugs gcig la/ dngul chu zho do/ /mu zi ser po zho do/ /shing a dha dza ri gsum/ na kā tsa le tshom pa re/ tu la pa'i khu ba rnams sgang sgogs ⑩nang du blugs/ 'jim pa spyin ⑪pos kha legs par bcad/ de nas ras bdun brtsegs par 'jim pa dang bcas gril ⑫lugs gong ltar byas la khog ma'i nang du bye ma blugs nas bye ma dang bcas me gtong lugs gong 'dra'i nyin zhag phyed kyi bar btang la grang ba dang bton ⑫te sgo nga dal bus bcags pas dngul chu dug bral lhad med du 'byung ngo / /yang lugs gcig la dngul chu zho bdun dang pi pi la'i pipilingashun pa nyag gang bcas rdo gzhong du nyin bdun gyi bar du nyed/sgo ga re'i thang chu blug la slar yang nyin bdun nyed/ de nas rdza sa'i bar du 120—728

skam thag legs par chod pa'i nang du li shi zho do dang bcas blug la kha legs par bcad bar du 'jim pa blug pa'i ras rim pa gsum gyis dril/ khog ma bye mas brgyangs 4par kha bcad de me gtong lugs sogs gong bzhin nyin zhag phrugs wīgacig gi bar byas te grang ba dang bton (— —pas kyang dug bral lhad med du 'byung / zha nye raṅkadakar po/ zha nye nyi shu nag po/ kha sarba lha/ ti tsha yang zer—/snye gsha' (༄tshe gsum mang nyung ji ltar byed kyang cha bsnyams la khog ma'i nang du blug /de la me btang ste zhu ba dang snod gzhan zhig tu ba mar sar pa btsags legs par bcad/ de nas lcags skyogs chung ngu zhig gis mar nyung zad re blug la dkrug /mar blug pa'i du ba yal ba dang yang mar drugs thupa sogs lan bdun gyi bar byas/ de nas byā ṭa'i lo ma dang dhu ti gnyis cha mnyam zhib par btags pa'i phye ma gsha' thudakar sogs mi mngon par 'debs shing dkrugs / de nas kha bcad la nyi ma'i bzhi cha tsam gyi bar la me shin tu che hūṃb btang / de nas me thag bcad de grang ba dang bton la/ se ba bzhi nas phyed gsum gyi bar nad babs lci yang dang bstun te btang bas rlung mkhris bad kan gsum ka la phan zhing nā ga ra sa ste pede dang ka ra bsres nas zos 7na dwangs ma 'dzag pa la mchog tu phan/ a ru ra bsnan nas btang na mgo bo na ba la phan no/ /rdza'i par bu'i nang du zha nye dkar po nyag gang blug /de la me btang nas zhu ba dang dngul chu nyag phyed te7blugs la me mtshams ma bcad par gtong zhing skya bas dkrug pa dang mnyam du ba bla btags pa nyag phyed rim bzhin btab ste gsum ga legs par 'dres 15pa dang par bu'i kha bcad rlung mi 'chor bar byahūṃ5/ de nas ras dang rdzas khrag gang rigs kyis basprus shāzipa'i 120—729

'jim pa byugs shing yang ras dkri ba sogs rim pa sum brtsegs ①su byas/de skams pa dang nyin zhag lnga me mtshams ma chad ④par btang / de nas grang thag chod pa dang bton④/ ba'i zho ras la btsags te khu ba legs par bton pas brdzis pa ④srab 'thug sor gang tsam yod pa'i sgor mor btang la ras kyis bdun brtsegs ⑧tsam dril nas skud pas bsdams te dugaci ba'i me'i dkyil du bcug la ras tshig tsam gyi tshod bzhag /de nas grang ⑦thag chod pa dang bton ⑧la phye mar nyes pa dang zhos khu ba byas nas brdzis te bsreg ⑨pa sogs gong ltar lan nyi shu'i bar byas pa ni baṅge shwa ra zer te stobs bskyed dang / nad tsha grang ⑩gsar rnying thams cad la phan zhing / nad gzhi che ba la gtong na thun tshad sran ma tsam dang ⑪/ gzhi chung ba dang nad med la 'bras nyis 'gyur tsam re gtong ngo / /'di'i phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab po/ /dambha/snye zangs mang nyung ci 'dod pa sbrang gshog legs par brdungs/ rdza snod kyi nang du ba'i gcin la chu cung zad bsres par kha ri lu ṇa dang mnyam du btab la nyin phyed kyi bar du me btang la btsos/ de nas bton ⑫la sdod bkrus pa'i nang du beer yang saṃ baṃ li'i 'bru chur btab pa'i nang du nyin phyed 'tshed⑫/ de nas chu de pho la snod bkrus te sgyu ru ra chur btab pa'i nang du nyin phyed ⑫'tshed/ de nas ba'i dar bar kha ri lu ṇa btab pa'i nang du zhag bdun gyi bar du 'jog cing 'di skabs me gtong ⑫mi dgos/ de nas zangs gshog ⑩ston la legs par bkrus te mu zi ser po dang cha mnyam bteg lhortepa phye mar byas la rdza'i par bu'i nang du mu zi banying / de steng zangs gshog spyogacig bzhag /yang mu zi bting / de steng zangs gshog tu)'jog pa sogs kyi zangs gshog ( rtegrangs du yod par 120—730

brtsegs ①la kha 'grig par bcad de rlung mi 'chor bar byas/ de ras kyis gtums shing 'jim pas 'byug pa sogs sum ②rim tsam byas la slar yang phyi 'jim pas legs par gtums ①la skam thag chod pa dang / de nas sa dong brus par gci ba'i me'i nang du nyin gcig gi bar du bsregs/ thal ba grang thag chod pa dang bton rjol rdo gzhong gi nang du nyes nas phye mar byas la thun sran ma bzhi tsam gyi tshod re btang bas grang ba'i rigs dang / rlung / bad rlung /dang ⑤kha 'byed pa/ lus stobs bskyed pa/ rked pa na ba rnams la phan/ mi thi/—yang sho mos zho gang phye mar btags pa dang gong gi zangs thal se ba bzhi bsres dhipa thun re byas btang bas yan lag zha 'khums ⑦la mchog tu phan no/ /kho ḍa yon/—su ma sogagaser gser zho do dang se ba brgyad la sbrang gshog 'than⑧/mtshal se ba bco lnga dang bil ba'i nang gi 'bru gnyis zhib par btags par chu cung zad kyang blugs pa'i skyo ma gser shog la byugs/ de nas gser shog sgril la bil ba'i nang du bcug kha legs par bcad de ras kyis dril la 'jim pa sor phyed tsam byugs/ skam thag chod pa dang sa dong brus par gci ba'i me nang du nyin gcig bsregs la grang ⑨thag chod pa dang bton ⑩te phye mar byas la 'bras nyis 'gyur tsam kyi tshad bee ser dang mnyam du zos na glo nad dang dbugs mi bde ba g.yal ba rnams la phan zhing skyug ⑪pa chod/ ba'i gci ba'i thal ba dang mnyam du zos na dang kha dang skom ⑫nad la phan/ lga dang mnyam du btang na skran—/ shu ba'am ⑫khye rngo / pho srin/ rlung skran rnams rtsa ba nas 'byin par 'gyur ro/ /lcags lutaphye nyag gang la dngul chu nyag phyed bsres te zhib par nyes/ chu la shing gi (stewa kwa ra'i khu ba blugs nas gar sla zho tsam byas la/120—731

rdo gzhong nang du nyi mar nyed cing skams pa dang khu ba gar sla sogs gong ltar byas pa lan brgya dang brgyad kyi bar byed/ de nas rdza'i par bu'i nang du blug /kha rlung mi 'chor bar ①legs par bcad/ de nas 'jim pa dang ras spel mar lan bdun gyi bar sgril bskam thag chod pa dang rdza'i khog ma che ba mthil du bug pa rgya khab kyi rtse tshud pa tsam yod pa zhig bye mas brdzangs ④pa'i dkyil du bcug /kha legs par bsgrigs ①te rlung sogs ye mi 'chor ba byas te nyin zhag bzhi'i ring me shin tu tsha ba mtshams ma chad pa gtong / 'di skabs las byed mi ma gtogs 'grul gcod/ de nas grang ④thag chod pa dang bton ⑤la thun tshad 'bras tsam re byarjo/ 'di ni spyi 'joms chen mo ste/ rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa rims sogs nad gsar rnying gang dang gang la yang 'dis mi phan pa med pas sman thams cad kyi rgyal po lta bu'o/ /zha nye nag po nyag phyed lcags snod kyi nang du bzhu⑦/ sa ser zhib par btags pa'i nang du blug /yang bton ⑧la bzhu ba sogs lan nyer gcig gi bar byed/ ldong ros ⑨na ma si la dang tsha la sohāganyag re bsres la zhib ⑩par btags/ rdza snod du zha nye blug la me btang ste zhu (speb dang gong gi tsha la sdong ⑫ros bsres pa'i phye ma cung zad re 'debs pa dang mnyam du skya bas dkrugs/ legs par 'dres nas thal bar song ba dang shing gi wa kra ra'i khu ba blug ste skya bas dkrug cing nyin phyed ⑫kyi bar me btang / thal bar song ba dang kha legs par bcad la nyin mtshan lnga dang nyi ma'i bzhi cha gcig gi bar me btang / de nas grang ba dang bton ④la thun tshad sran ma nyis 'gyur tsam sbrang rtsi dang mnyam du btang na rlung gi nad gsar rnying thams cad la phan/ ka ra dang mnyam du btang na khrag gi rigs la phan/ lda 120—732

dang mnyam du btang na bad kan gyi rigs dang ma 'ju ba sogs pho ba'i nad la phan/ a ru ra'i phye ma dang mnyam du btang na mkhres pa'i rigs la phan/pi pi ling dang mnyam du btang na dang ①kha 'byed/ khrag dang rlung la brten nas dwangs ma 'dzag ①na bu ram rnying pa dang mnyam du btang / mkhris pa la brten nas 'dzag na a ru ra dang mnyam du btang / ba mar gsar pa dang mnyam du zos na stobs skyed ①par byed/ gcong gis zin pa'i nad lus shin tu rid dun gur gum dang mnyam du gtong zhing gzhan yang nad tshod ⑤dang bstun te kha bsgyur byas te dubatang bas kun la phan par 'gyur ro/ /ti tsha'am gsha' ⑦tshe nyag gang rdza snod du bzhu la pa ra ④ki ri nyag phyed dang / so ra tshazenyag phyed bsres te zhib par btags pa'i phye ma cung zad re 'debs/ shing lcags kyi gzar bu ⑨chung ngu'i ltag pas nyed cing dkrug ⑩nyin phyed kyi bar byas pas 'dres te thal bar song ba dang khed sa rgyab la nye kṛmema'i bzhi cha gcig me btang tu)/grang thag chod pa dang bton la phye ⑫mar byas te dar la btsags/ de nas phye ma de dang / li shi/snyelawaṃg/ dzā tusteti dzayiphal gsum se ba re po ris snyem ri tse/lgaske/ —shurī/ pi pi ling skobapaligasum se ba gsum re rnams zhib par btags/sbrang rtsis rta byas la ril bu sran ma nyis 'gyur tsam sgril la ril bu re btang bas byis pa 'khru ba'i nad dang 'cham pa la phan zhing gnyid ma khug ⑫par btang bas kyang gnyid du 'gro/ a ru ra dang bsres nas btang na dbug sa mi bde ba la phan—/ mgo bo na na ril bu chur brdar la sna bug tu blug pas phan par 'gyur/ga bur dang bsres nas btang na kha'i dri ngan pa rtsa ba nas 'byin/ zho dang mnyam du btang na skran thon/ kha ru tsha dang mnyam du btang na ma 'ju ba'i nad 120—733

sel lo/ /zangs mang nyung gang byed kyang sbrang gshog legs par 'then la jem rtses she)chung ngur gtubs pa dang mu zi ser po zangs che chung gang yin gyi phyed mar gtang ba dam pe'i ①khog par blug la skyu ru ra dang ṣpem bu'i chu blug la kha legs par bcad de nas kyi dkyil du zla ba gcig bzhag /de nas bton snel phye mar byas te thun tshad se ba bzhi'i rtsis chu grang gis 'phul la btang na dug dang mkhris pa'i nad 'phral du skyugs nas phan zhing srin nad la btang na yang 'khru sgyug ④yong la/ gzhan yang skyugs kyis ⑤phan pa'i nad gang la 'ang btang bas sgyug rjosman gyi mchog go/ /kha paso dha ti tsha'am gsha' tshe nyag phyed brdar ba'i phye ma dang /mu zi ser po nyag phyed/ dngul chu spor gang gsum rdo gzhong du nyi ma'i bzhi cha gcig gi ring zhib par nyes la gi wa kwa ra'i khu bas gar sla 'o/ tsam byas pa nyi ma dang grib ma phyed khyer du nyes/ skam thag chod pa dang slar yang khya ba lugs pa sogs nyin bcu gsum gyi bar byed/ bzhu shel byi dam per ras dang 'jim pa spel mar byugs pa bdun brtsegs byas pa skam thag chod pa dang blug la kha rdzas spyin ⑦po mgar ba'i so rdog /a ra ka /bu ram/ rgya gar stod ja rnams cha mnyam pa zhib par btags pa ba'i 'o mas brdzis ⑧la 'dam btags nyin gcig byas pa'i 'jim pas dam pe'i kha shin tu dam par bkag /de ras kyis gtums la gong gi 'jim pas dam pe yongs rdzogs la 'byug /de skam pa dang khog ma che ba zhig gi nang bye ma'i dkyil du bcug la kha legs par bcad de nyin zhag bzhi'i bar me mtshams ma chad par btang / de nas grang ba dang bton ⑨la nad babs che na sran ma gcig tsam nas nad med la 'bras nyis 'gyur gye bar 'os 'gab btang bas nad ngos zin ma zin gsar rnying gang la yang phan zhing /120—734

nad med kyis zos na rgas kha sra ba dang stobs bskyed pa la sogs pa phan yon bsam mi khyab po/ /zha nye dkar po nyag gang lugs kong du bzhu la legs par bzhu ba dang snum gyi dkyil du blug /de 'khang pa dang yang bzhu blug khya)gong ltar lan gsum gyi bar du byed/ de nas snod che ba zhig tu bzhu la 'bras bu gsum zhib par btags pa'i bye ④ma thal 'debs pa ltar rim bzhin btabs nas thal bar ma song bar lcags skyogs chung ngu'i ltag pas nyed/ de nas kha legs par bcad la nyi ma'i brgyad cha tsam rmi bar me btang / grang ④thag chod pa dang bton ④la zho ras la btsags te khu ba legs par bton pas brdzis te srab ma rjothug sor gang tsam yod pa'i sgor mor btang / de ras kyis rjobadun brtsegs tsam dril la skud pas bsdoms/ gci ba'i me'i dkyil du bcug la ras tshig tsam gyi tshad bzhag /de nas me shi zhing grang thag chod pa dang bton ⑦la zhib par btags/ yang lugs gcig la/ gsha' ⑧dkar srab mthug ⑨shog bu tsam brdungs ⑩la/ bod kyi so ma ra tsa'i lo ma zhib par 'phur ⑫ba/ ras kha gang las phad bu ⑫bzos pa'i nang du so ma ra tsa bting la/ gsha' ⑫dkar sbrang gshog de'i steng du rim brtsegs su bzhag pa'i bar mtshams su so ma ra tsa sor gsum yod pa byas la kha btsems ④te/ steng 'og thams cad la phyi ba ser kha ma sor bzhi re yod pa'i dkyil du bcug ste me chung ngu btang shing phyi ba tshig pa dang grang du ⑫bcug /de nas lci thal bsal ⑩te so ma ra tsa'i dkyil du tshal dkar me la bsregs (rtepa ltar 'ong ba 4)de gzhan dang ma 'dres par 'don/so ma ra tsa nyung ba dang me tshas na gsha' ⑪dkar thig bur 'dril 'ong 0 bas ran pa gal che/ de ba sernyi ⑫baṅga zer te thun tshad se ba gsum nas bzhi'i bar nad 720—735

gzhi che chung dang bstun nas gtong / de kha bsgyur byed lugs ni/ ga pur cung zad dang mnyam du zos na kha'i dri ngan pa sel/ dzā ①nyi nyis 'gyur bsres nas btang na lus kyi stobs 'phel bar 'gyur/ yang ba mar dang mnyam du btang kyang nus pa gong dang 'dra/ tul pa'i lo ma'i thang chu dang bsres nas btang na dwangs ma tsha grang gang gis 'dzag pa yang chod/ shel dkar dang mnyam du btang kyang nus pa gong dang 'dra/ ba mar sar pas rta byas btang na mkhyes pa sha ser dang grang rlung la phan/ ra ma'i chus rta byas btang na rlung gis ①lto ba sbos pa sel/ tsha la mer bsregs ①pa'i phye ma dang mnyam du btang na khrag skran thon par 'gyur/ yung ba dang mnyam du btang na khrag mkhris thon par 'gyur zhing grang mkhris la duphan/ bye kar dang mnyam du btang na bad kan smug po la phan/ pā na dang mnyam du btang na dwangs ma 'phel pi pi ling dang mnyam du btang na dang kha 'byed/ 'o mas rta byas btang kyang gong dang 'dra—/ a ru ra dang mnyam du btang na steng rlung dang dbugs kha mi bde ba la phan—/ sa mu dra pha la dang mnyam du btang na sna'i nad la phan/ li shi dang mnyam du btang na pho nad la phan/ gla rtsi dang mnyam du btang na rdo rje las su rung zhing 'dod pa spyod nus par 'gyur ro/ /yang khang byil gyi brun chur sbyangs la lte bar byugs te sman zos kyang nus pa gong dang 'dra/ go yu'i phye ma dang mnyam du btang na ma 'ju ba'i nad sel/ sgog skya dang mnyam du btang na yan lag gum pa la phan/ ba dar dang mnyam du btang na mig ser la phan/ se ⑤'bru'i anārashing gi lo ma dang mnyam du btang na skyug busman gyi mchog tu 'gyur te zas spyod skabs dang sbyar ro/ /daṇḍa'i ⑦rtsa ba/ 'u su'i rtsa ba/ sle tres/snyegu 120—736

ru tshi/ gla sgang / purna na ba/ lda rnams cha mnyam gyi thang chu sum spriganyis la bsdus ④te btang na dzu)rlung la brten pa'i nad thams cad la phan/ gla sgang /lga / kuṭa ki/ tig ta/rkori④rayar/ 'u su'i 'bru rnams cha mnyam gyi thang gong bzhin btang na mkhris pa la brten pa'i nad thams cad la phan/ 'ba' zho rgun 'brum li shi /pi pi ling / a ka ra/snyedakar/ lga/ la la phud chung ba rnams cha mnyam/ ṭī rā ya ta cha gnyis bcas chur btab la sum spyoganyis bsdus pa'i thang zhag gsum gye bar du btang na tshad pa'i nad rigs kun la phan zhing gos kyis byibs la rngul kyang 'don no/ /shing kun cha gcig /zi ra dkar rjopo dang bee cha gsum re/ kha ru tsha cha gnyis rnams chu la bsdus pa'i thang btang na rlung dang pho ba'i nad la tsha log byed pa zas ma 'ju ba rnams la phan/rgya skyegs/ 'u su/ la la phud rnams cha mnyam chur zhag gcig spangs pa'i thang ka ras rta byas tho rengs btang na lus drod me ltar 'bar ba la phan/ 'u ⑦su dang kha ru tsha ⑧mnyam pa'i thang btang na rlung dang pho ba'i nad la tsha log byed pa zas ma 'ju ba rnams la phan/ a kaṭwā ra/ la la phud/ ku ba/ spyo) kha ru tsha⑩/ lga rnams cha mnyam gyi thang gong bzhin bsdus la btang na bad kan la brten pa'i nad thams cad la phan/ sle tres/ gla sgang / u tī sa'i rtsa ba/'u su'i 'bru/ lda/ ku ba rnams cha mnyam gye thang gong bzhin bskol nas btang na 'dus pa'i nad thams cad la phan no/ /gur sum̐/ gla rtsi/ gi waṃ—/ snyesgo/⑪ ga pur/ shrī khaṇḍa tsanda kar po rnams cha mnyam phye mar btags la chus khu ba byas te ⑫lus la bsku mnye ⑫byas na/ rlung mkhris bad kan la brten pa'i sha drod che ④ba lus rngul 'dar shing ba spu sgreng ba/ shes pa 'khrug shing 'gro sdong sna 120—737

tshogs byed pa/ gdon gyis zin pa lta bus ①mig 'bur tshugs su blta zhing ②/mig sngar sna tshogs mthong ba/ nyin gnyid mi ④thub cing shes pa zi brjo/gos yang yang 'bud pa sogs nad glor bur ba la phan no/ /spyi 'joms mu sa la'i (5sbyor ba ni/ mu sa ya rjordza snod gsar pa'i nang du blug par ba'i 'o ma lhad med sor gang tsam gyis mtho ba blug /kha legs par bcad de rlung mi 'chor bar ⑦byed—/ me chung ngu yun ring pos khya ba rang thim khrupar 'tshed/ de nas grib bskams 6byas la skam pa dang zhib par btags pa dar la btsags pa nyag gang /la waṃ ga lishidang dza yi pha la dzātizho bzhi re⑪/ mi ra tsa phorisadang su tha⑪/—lda/pi pa la pithalingagasum zho bcu gnyis re rnams zhib par btags la ba'i chus rta byas nas btang na chu bsags ⑫la phan zhing gzhan yang rtag pa'i rims dang khrag bshal ⑫ba dang / chu lam du khrag 'dzag pa rnams la mchog tu phan no/ /chu grang gis rta byas la btang na rims nyin gcig pa dang gnyis pa dang gsum pa dang bzhi pa dang rims drag po dang / rlung nad kyis lus drod med pa rnams la phan no/ /sbrang rtsis rta byas la btang na tshad pa gsar rnying spyodang mkhris pa sha ser la phan no/ /nim bu'i khu bas rta byas nas btang na mkhris pa mig ser la mchog tu phan/ li shi bsnan spyote zos na glo la phan/ ba mar sar pa btsags ⑩bcad pas rta byas nas btang na lus stobs shor nas spyod mi nus par dwangs ma 'phel bar 'gyur/ lasu na brdungs pa'i khya bas rta byas te ril bu dril bas btang na skad 'gag pa la phan zhing skad sman yang yang ngo / /chang gis rta byas nas btang na byis pa btsa' ma thub pa myur du btsa' bar 'gyur/ ku me ḍā'i ⑩sgog skya khu bas rta byas nas btang na chu rlung gis lto ba sbos pa sel/ dzā spyomu ṇa'i 120—738

'bru dang pags pa brdungs pa'i khu bas rta byas nas sna bug la blug na mi rga stizer ba'i mgo bor 'bu yod pa'i nang chu/ me/ nyi ma/ 'od can sogs mthong bas rkyen byas nas rgyal zal ②lta bu zhig long ba de la phan no/ /rgya gar stod ja dang mnyam du btang na pho dbang las su rung bar 'gyur ro/ /ba tsa shudagadang mnyam du btang na tsha ba'i skom dad kyi rigs dang srod long la phan/ mu zi ①ser po dang cha mnyam btags la btang na rlung gis rna ba 'on pa dang mig gis mi mthong ba la phan/ gong gi mu sa li'i gcig po dang / pho ril/ pi pi ling / lga bzhi cha mnyam btags la sman thun che phyogs gnyis kyi rtsis chu grang gis 'phul nas btang na rgyu dang mi rgyu/ sbyar dug sha dug sogs dug rigs kun la phan te 'di yan mu sa lir kha bsgyur ④byas pa'i spyor sde'i 'phros don yin no—/ /nad gzhi che ba'i rigs la sbyong gtong ba'i shal sman ni/ mbin drug /mgo /rgyal/ mchu rnams kyi zla ba la/ dzee pa la danarog se ba bcu gnyis/hā ḍa ḍa se ba ni/—aru ra/ mi ra tsa phorisazho gang / tsu ka se ba nimabu'i chu phyed gsum zhib par btags la ril bu lnga byas/ thun tshad ril bu rer 'amar sar gyis dril la mid/ de'i rjes su chu bskol hub gsum tsam re btang pag dund ro rnams sbyangs nas mang du bshal ④bar 'gyur/ sbyangs zin nas gcod sman a phri ma/ dzā ⑧ti/ ambha ki ko li/—sha 'bras kyi nang / bi dzaya so mar tsa rnams cha mnyam thog mar dzā ⑨ti dang a shī ma gnyis mar sar chung ngu dang mnyam du btags—/ de nas bzhi ga chabs cig zhib par btags la bye kar ram sbrang gang ⑩rigs kyis rta byas la ril bu sgyu ru ra'i 'bras bu tsam sgril nas ril bu re btang / des 'grim pa'i rigs gang yin kyang chod do/ /yang na dzā ((ti'i 120—739

khog brus pa'i nang du a shī ma sran ma nyis 'gyur tsam zhig blugs ste kha bcad ①la gro zhib kyi pag gis dril la gci ba'i me du ba yal ba'i dkyil du bsregs/ bag de bag leb tshos pa tsam gyi ①tshad du sleb pa dang bton la dzā ④ti de nas thun tshad sran ma nyis 'gyur tsam re zos pas nges par chod do/ /yang na zla ba gong gi bzhi po la spyongs sman/ dzee pa la/snyedanarog /pā ra/snyedangulachu/ garnyakasnyemu zi ser po/ mi ro tsa/snyephorisarjo/ pipal/—pipiling/ lda/—shubyu ⑤rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags/ thun tshad sran ma nyis 'gyur tsam re chu skol ༷gyis phul nas btang na ⑦nad ro sbyong bar 'gyur ro/ /de gcod lugs gong dang 'dra'o—/ /yang na dzi pa la danarog se ba bcu gnyis/ mi ra tsa phorilazho do/ tsa yo la 'brasa'abru lnga bcu rnams zhib par btags pa skyu ru ra'i 'bras bu'i tshod tsam re mar sar gyis dril la btang / de'i rjes su chu skol hub gsum tsam re 'thung /yang na se hūṃ ḍa/—shrikhaṇḍa/ du ba ral pa/ rbha rā ḍa/ ha ra ta ka'i tshig gu'i nang gi snying po rnams/ cha mnyam btags la thun tshad sran ma nyis 'gyur tsam re bu ram gyis dril la btang / de rjes chu skol phul gang tsam re 'thungs pas bshal ④sgyug gnyis ka 'byung / yang na dzee pa la danarogapags pa bshus pa zho brgyad kyi tshod tsam ras dri ma med pas gtums la skud pas kha bsdams/ sdod gang rigs ⑨su 'o ma bye do tsam blugs ⑩la gong gi ras thum ⑪de sor bzhi tsam 'o mar ma reg pa skud pas khebs gcod spyol btags/ de nas khebs rgyab la rlangs pa mi 'chor bar gtums ⑫nas 'o ma de phyed tsam skam tshod kyi bar la me btang / de nas sman phyung gshags spyol lce bton/ de dang shwa ta dzi ra/—zir dkar po/ a dze ba ṇa/snyelalaphud/ miratsa/—phoril/ pi pa le pipilingalnga cha 120—740

bsnyams ①la btags/ de nas gong gi 'o mas ④khu ba byas nas ril bu skyu ru ra tsam dril/ ril bu re btang la de nas chu skol 'thung ngo / /dbo/ nag pa/nya—/ sgon/ chu stod/ dbyu ①gu rnams kyi a ram ḍa'i daṇḍadu'abras bu/ dzi pa la/—danarog /ṣi ra/ tsa yo la/snye'abras/ sernya/—rgyatsha/⑤ tsir tsa pho ris rnams cha mnyam btags la bod kyi thun tshad che phyogs tsam chu grang gis rta byas gtong / zla ba'i khyad ma gtogs phan yon dang nus pa 'dra/ yang na dzee pa la dan rog btul ma/ pi pa la/ mi ra tsa/snyepho ris/ shweta dzi ra/snyezi ra dkar po/tsuka rnams cha mnyam btags/ lda'i chu'i nang du zhag gcig sbangs lag nas snon te rdzogs nas ras kyi khung du bcir ba'i khu bas rta byas la ril bu skyu ru ra tsam sgril/ ril bu re chu grang gis rta byas nas gtong ngo / /yang na dzi pa la dan rog chu khol thengs re la brje thengs re byas pa lan brgyad kyi bar btsos de nas lce btonaX/ de dang a ga ra/—araskya/ khaṇḍa ⑦bye kar gsum cha mnyam la zhib par btags thun tshad bod dang 'dra ba chu grang gis rta byas la btang ngo / /yang na/ ni la ka waṃ gis brdungs pa'i ⑧khu bar skyu ru ra zhib par btags pa btab nisru'i ⑨chu cung zad blug lcags skyogs kyi nang du zhag gcig bzhag /skra dang sma ra dkar por song bar zhag gsum gyi bar/ nyin re la 'khru jengs ⑩re la byugs thengs ⑪re byed/ sla dkar nā gong bzhin byed/ me la ka rā sa/bud med kyi 'o ma gsum sbyar la lte sa byugs pas kyang phebs so/ yang na/sum̐ ḍa/ kā ka ḍa siṅgi / rnya ba ra'i me tog gsum cha mnyam la bu ram gyis dril la btang thun tshad gong dang 'dra'o/ /gcod sman gong dang 'dra/ bse dug gi sman la/ pi lo wa/snyem nu khrag can/ adzawa ṇa/snyelal phud/ bu ram rnying 120—741

pa gsum zho bcu gnyis re cha mnyam btags la/ dngul chu se ba bzhi bsres de la ril bu dgu bcos la nyi ma dgu'i bar re re khyur mid byed/ de'i bar pag dang thug pa tshwa sdor med pa ma gtogs gzhan ma za btung thams cad 'dzem/des 'phral du phan par 'gyur ro/ /yang na ha ra ḍa/snye arur/ mi ra tsa/— pho ris| ni la tho tha thag①pan gsum cha mnyam zhib par btags te sman tshags la btsags la ba mar sar bar sbyar nas rma gang 'dug la byugs pas 'phral du phan par 'gyur zhing de yang gdon①/ chu 'tshag pa sogs nas 'gos pa yin na phan sla'o①/ /yang na pā ra/ dngul chu/ garnya ka muziser po/ gro zhib dar btsags—/ bu ram rnams cha mnyam la zhib par btags/ a dha dzha ra chu ru sbangs pa'i khu bas rta byas la ril bu skyu ru ra tsam sgril la ril bu re khyur mid byed do—/ /ldongarjoros/snyeyang na ma na se la/ hā ri ta la/— ba ⑤bla/ ku ṭha/snye ru rtadu/ha la da/snye yungab/ gu ṇi putstsha'i khyungasder sgyug po rtsa ba rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la ba'i chus rta byas nas khong du gtong / sman de ⑦ra'i 'o ma la sbyar nas rma gang yod la 'byug go/ /yang pā rā/snye dngul chu/ garnya kasnye mu zi ser po/hā ri ta la/snye babla/ dza yi pha la/— dzāti/ /dza mu ṇa'i pags pa'i laḍaphye ma rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags sbrang gis rta byas la ril bu sgyu ru ra'i 'bras bu tsam byas te mid par bya'o/ /yang na/ pā ra se ba bzhi/— dngulachu/ ha la da se ba bzhi—/ — yungab/ a dzā⑧wa ṇa se ba bzhi/snye lalaphud/ ṣi ra se ba bzhi/ bil wa mnu khrag can zho gang / gu ḍa buramase ba bcu drug rnams zhib par btags la ril bu skyu ru ra tsam byas nyi ma bdun gyi bar la re re za zhing sman zos ⑨nas ma 'ju bar la dro bcos byed do/ /yang pā rā/snye dngulachu/ nyil nag /garnya kasnye le la nu ring po/120—742

la la phud/—a dza waṇa/ su ①ṭha/snyelda/ gu ḍa buram rnams se ba bzhi re/ bil wam nu khrag can zho do se ba brgyad rnams zhib par btags/ oṃ gā chu la sbangs pa'i khu bas rta byas la ril bu sgyu ru ra'i 'bras bu tsam dril la gtong zhing de bar zas 'bras dang 'o ma ma gtogs 'dzem/ so rnyil dang rke la sogs pa skrangs kyang sman lngar chags su btang bas grol bar 'gyur ro/ /yang sgyug ma'i lo ma'i rtse—/ saṃ bhā lu'i lo ma/ oṃ gā'i lo ma/ swe ta dhū pa'i lo ma/ tiṅga la mtshal rnams se ba bzhi re cha mnyam pa btags la thun bcu bzhi bzo la thun re gang sa gsar pa lta bur 'than ②nas mgo lus gtums te du ba rma gang yod la 'bung /de'i bar la dro bcos dang rlung ma 'phog ①pa gal che'o/ /yang / dza hu'i me tog zhib par btags pa ngar la btsags bu ram dang cha mnyam la ril bu sgyu ru ra tsam dril ba nyin bdun gyi bar re re khong du btang / pā rā/—dngulachu/ ni ba gnyis se ba bzhi bzhi zhib par btags/ nimbu'i thang chus 'khar sder gyi nang du sbrus la rkang pa dang lag pa la sman za ba dang mnyam du byugs/ de'i bar gyi dri chu rdza snod lta bur bsags pa'i chu'i nang du gong gi dngul chu se ba'i grangs grangs rjogang btang ba de yong zhing de 'phral phan par 'gyur ro/ /'di'i rjobar la bag thug dhilas dngar sgyur sogs 'dzem/ gzhang 'brum gyi nad dang mtshan bar rdol pa la/ pi pi la'i pags pa zhib par btags pa thur mgo do tsam pa'i zho phul gang tsam la btab ste 'thungs pas myur du phan/ yang na—/ nad pa mgo zhabs bzlog dzeeste rkang pa gdung ma lta bur btags la ba'i gci bas rtsa lam nan cher bkrus/ de nas ma nu khrag can gyi khrag bton ④la byugs—/ de steng u ⑨da zhib par btags pa'i phye ma chus sbrus pa'i pag gis 120—743

bkab—/ de'i thog tu sol me lta bu me rdog chung ngu zhig chu tshod gcig tsam gyi bar bzhag /de nas me bsal la de shul ①du su ma la sro ma ②tsam zhig chu tshod gcig tsam gyi bar bzhag /de nas bag dang bcas pa bsal bas 'bu mang du thon 'ong ①zhing phan no/ /yang na bu ram dang pi pi leng cha mnyam ④la pi pi ling zhib par btags pa bu ram gyis rta byas ril bu go yu tsam re zos na phan par 'gyur zhing 'di khyad par byis pa chung ngu la phan no/ /yang na lcags snod nang mar gsar pa'i nang du a ru ra sol bar ma song tsam btsos/ de nas bton ⑤te zhib par btags pa'i phye ma slar yang gong gi mar de la btab nas ril bu dzā ⑥ti tsam re zos pas kyang phan par 'gyur ro/ /yang na⑦/ nyil/bil ba(she/ ang ḍa/ gu ḍa/ tsi tā rnams cha mnyam la zhib par btags/sbrang rtsis rta byas la ril bu skyu ru ra ⑨tsam byas nas zos na yang phan no/ /yang na—/ ha la da yungabazhib par btags pa dang ni/ hūṃ shi khaṇḍa ⑩cha bsnyams ⑪pa rtsa lam gyi khung ⑫btab khams kyis bsdams te bzhag pas kyang phan no/ /yang 'phongs lugs ⑫gci ba'i me du ba med pa'i steng du sbrul gyi pags pa brjes pa btab pa'i du ba bdug sa na 'phral du phan/ dzā dzā spyoku sha ste ⑫rims 'phrog lcags kyu'i spyor ba bdun pa ni/ dan rog dug bral/ dngul chu dug bral—/ btsan dug /pho risaspyo/ pi pi ling / lda/ tsha la bsregs pa rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la thun tshad sran ma tsam bu ram kyis ril bu byas nas btang na grang rlung sogs grang ba'i rigs thams cad la phan zhing cung zad thur ⑩du'ang 'khru'o/ /btsan dug phyung la mu zi bsnan ⑫te thun tshad sran ma nyis 'gyur tsam bye dkar rmis ril lu byas btang na khrag tshad/ mkhris tshad/120—744

rlung tshad/ bad kan gyi tshad pa sogs tshad pa gsar rnying thams cad la phan no//dan rog dug bral/ /dngul chu btul ma/ mu zi ser po/ tsha la bsregs pa'i thal ba/ mtshal rnams cha mnyam btags pa nimbu'i khu bas ril bu sma ru mgo nag tsam sgril la btang na rlung mkhris bad kan sogs nad kyi rigs gsar rnying gang la yang phan no/ /dan rog dug bral/ dngul chu btul ma/ mu zi ser po/ mtshal①/ ba ru ra/—lingang/ a ru ra rnams cha mnyam btags pa bye dkar gyis rta byas nas ril bu sma ru mgo nag tsam dril la btang na tshad pa gsar rnying pa dang mkhris pa dang tsha ba'i rigs ④la phan/ dan rog dug bral/dngul chu btul ma/ mu zi ser po/ mtshal/ zangs phye btul ma/ tsi tā/pi pi leng / a ru ra/ ba ru ra/ sgyu ru ra amalarnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la/ jiṅga rā dza' chus sbrus la skam thag chod pa dang phye ma thur mgo re tsam btang bas rims tshad kyi rigs mtha' dag la phan no/ /dan rog dug bral / dngul chu btul ma/ mu zi ser po/ pho ris pi pi ling tsha la rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la bye dkar dang mnyam du ba mar gsar pas sgril la btang na khrag tshad/ mkhris tshad/ rlung tshad/ bad kan gyi tshad pa/ rgyu tshad/ cham ①tshad/ 'khrugs tshad/ rims tshad de tshad pa brgyad la mchog tu phan no/ /dan rog dug bral dang daṇḍa ④se ba bcu gnyis/pho ris/ tshal bsregs pa'i thal ba/ pi pi ling gsum se ba bzhi re rnams zhib par btags/ jiṅga rā dza' khya bas sbrus la ril bu sma ru mgo nag tsam byas pa thun tshad ril bu gsum re btang ⑤bas rims tshad kyi burigs mtha' dag la phan no/ /des rims 'phrog ⑦lcags kyu'i sbyor ba bdun pa rdzogs so// //120—745

go yu supa ri mu sa li/ 'jam 'bras kyi 'bru/ pi pi ling dang pi pi ling gi rtsa ba/ lga/ po ṣa ra'i rtsa ba/ pho ris/ la la phud/ seṅga ḍa/a shwa ①garnya/ byi thang ka /la la phud chung ba/ bye gi rnams zho bco lnga re cha mnyam zhib par btags/ bi ra kan dhu dugamo nyung zho bzhi zhib par btags te chus ②btsos la gar sla bag tsam du song dus sman rnams dang bsregs/ so ma ra tsa go mu'ibazhi 'gyur zho brgyad cu/ chu khar khal gcig tsam gyi nang du btab la chu bre gsum tsam du skam skam par gdus grang ba ①dang ras la btsags rjopa la gong gi sman btab nas 'dres par byas/ de nas ba'i 'o ma lhad med khal gcig tsam snod du mer ma gar ba byas gdus nas sum ⑤gcig tsam du lus dupa dang /de la blug ste skya bas dkrug cing skyo ma gar ba tsam du 'dus pa dang ta'u ṣi ra btab la dkrug cing zan dron tsam du sleb pa dang me thag bcad de grang du ⑦bcug la ril bu skyu ru ra che phyogs tsam re btang bas 'di ni go yur brten pa'i spyi 'joms chen mo ste rlung mkhris/ bad kan/ 'dus pa/ tshad pa gsar rnying / dug gi rigs/ skran/ dmu sgechu/ khrag sogs mdor na nad kyi rigs gang la'ang 'dis mi phan pa med do/ /yang gong gi ril bu dang mnyam pa'i shel kar ⑨lcags snod du chu cung zad blugs ⑩la sgor/ chu thag chod nas/dzā ⑪ti/ li shi/ dzā ⑫ti'i me tog /sug grel ⑫bzhi shel kar ⑫gyi bcu cha re zhib par btags pa dang gong gi ril bu btab la cung zad sgor te ril bu sgyu ru ra nyis 'gyur tsam sgril la tho rangs zas ma zos pa'i gong du ril bu re rgyun du bsten spyon stobs 'phel zhing rgas kha sra ba/ lus yang ba/ dong ⑩kha bde ba/rtsal che ba/ blo rno ba/ mig gsal ba/ rna ba gsang ba/ so brtan pa/120—746

skra dkar gnyer ma mi 'byung ba/ 'dod pa spyod nus pa/ nad dkon pa sogs phan yon bsam las 'das so / /①chu bsags tsha grang gang la'ang bi sa lo tsa na/snyecugang/ se ma la khā ra dkar po dang ser po/ rgya gar stod ja/bi la wa mnu khrag can rnams cha mnyam pa zhib par btags pa na'i khu bas zho sla ba tsam byas pa nyin gsum gyi bar rdo gzhong gi nang du nyes te bag tsam song ba dang ril bu sran chung tsam byas pa skrangs che na ril bu gnyis dang gzhan la re ste ②ba mar gsar pa btsags bcad pas 'phul la btang / sman gtong ring pag thug dang mar gsar ma gtogs gzhan 'jem/ nad ji ltar tshan che yang thun bdun gyis nges par thon no/ /somar/— hūṃ ga dang ṣā ḍa byekaracha mnyam la phye mar btags so④/ /ba'i zho phul gyi sum ④cha tsam la btab nas 'thungs na yang phan par 'gyur zhing / bcos byed ring ⑤dmar skyur dang kha tsha rul sums dhi'adzem—/ so ma ra tsa dang bye kar cha mnyam pa zho hub gang la sbyar nas btang na khrag mkhris las gyur pa'i chu nad thon zhing mkhris pas 'grim pa yang tshod do/ /yang tshod dang rgyas par ④dus kyi rtsa ba gang byas khog ma'i nang du blug la de ④ltar yang khebs gcod rgyab la rlangs pa mi 'chor ba byas pa'i chu sum gnyis bsdus pa'i khu ba tshan ⑨mo phor pa gang btungs la gos kyis byebs la rngul thon par byed pa gnad du che'o/ /tsan ⑩dan dmar po dang btsag rdo getuganyis cha mnyam pa zhib par btags la chus rta byas ril bu go yu'i 'bru tsam dril te (sprebatang bas kyang phan no/ /'u su lo ma 'dru ⑫bcas rdzogs pa'i khu bas bsku mnye ⑫byas kyang skrangs pa ⑫'phral du 'joms par 'gyur ro/ /sa mu dra pha la mang nyung ji tsam yod kyang ra'i gcin gyi kha phrus spyonyin re la lan gsum re btab pa/ de bzhin 120—747

ba'i 'o ma/ bhriṅga ra ①dza' khu ba rnams kyis nyin bdun re skem bkru byed/ de nas zhib par btags la thun tshad sran ma gsum nas gcig gi bar nad babs che chung skabs dang bstun④/ ra ma'i gcin gyis khu ba byas nas mgo dzeephyed na bar gang na ba'i phyogs kyi mig la 'byug pa'am sna la blug pas phan zhing mig la byugs pas mig ser por song ba la yang phan/ bye ma ka ra dang mnyam du btang na tshad pa gsar rnying thams cad la phan/ ba'i dar bas rta byas te 'thungs na rlung rgyu mkhris kyi nad zug bzhin du rjoche ba la phan/ hiṅga shingakunadang mnyam du btang na mkhris srin skye thur gzugs dang srin leb srin 'bu chung ngu sogs len ⑤nas bde bar 'gyur ro/ /sgrang rtsi la sbyar nas bse dug gi rma dang thor ba la bskus na 'phral du phan par 'gyur zhing / lce dig pas gtam yun ring mi thon pa dang pho ba sbos pa la khong du btang bas phan/ yung ba rjodang mnyam du btang na skyug sman gyi mchog tu 'gyur⑦/ rang chu 'am ra ma'i chus rta byas btang na ma 'ju ba la phan zhing sbyongs ④kyang phebs par 'gyur ro/ /jiṅga rā dza' khu bas ril bu byas la btang na mig ser la phan/ pi pa la'i pags pa dang mnyam du zos ⑨na mas rlung gyen ldog dang rlung rgyu mkhris la mchog tu phan no//yang ra ma'i chus rta byas btang na skya rbab ⑩la phan/ a jo dzā ḍa'i khu bas ril bu byas btang na dwangs ma 'dzag pa la phan no/ /la la phud dang mnyam du btung na rims nad nyi ma re mos kyis na ba la phan no/ /ba'i 'o ma dang mnyam du btang na stobs bskyed par 'gyur ro/ /lga dang mnyam du btang na dwangs ma 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /a ka la ka ra phye mar byas pa dang mnyam du btang na khong pa'i srin 'bu ⑪thams cad phyir 'thon ⑫nas bde'o/ /nim bu'i khya ba dang 120—748
