mnyam du btang na 'dus pa'i nad la phan no/ /rang chu khyor gsum gyis 'phul te btang bas ni nā bī ①zer ba'i rkang lag gi sor mo dang sna gang la thebs kyang chad 'gro ba zhig yong ba de la phan/ yang nad de la sngags byed na/ sang bcos kha byed rgyu'i do nub nad pa'i lus bkrus la mal bde bar nyal bcug sang zhogs ②sngags mkhan gyis phyin la nad pa las 'dom do tsam gyis 'gyangs byas la bsdad—/ rkang lag gang na ba de bstan la 'og gi sngags 'dren pa dang mnyam du 'bras sirtsu ra bsres pas nad pa brab/ rkang lag gang yin kyang mi gnyis tsam gyis zin kyang mi thub par sngags mkhan gyi sngar ①sleb yong bas khru gang tsam du sleb pa dang gris 'phred la re khā gsum 'then/ gang na ba de 'bras btsos pa'i zan dang sirtsu bur bsres pas ⑤gtums la bzhag pas phan no/ /sngags ni/oṃ gā rdza ta gho rata ā ba tā tsha ra tshe du u tā ra ta a ba tā ha ya/ na ba nā ri ba ha tra ko ṣṭha su ṣa ba ra tā ā ba ta ha ya/ kā hā te ā ba ra ha ya ga sgye ga ya ni te ā ba tā ha ya/ kā ba ru ko ko ta bā la di rjolī ko pa ta sā ha/ se ṣa se lā ra ru ru ka ni ke pu ta ma ha ma dā pi ra mant+ra pa rnyo ta/ ba dhi 6 rā sa na bhe bye bhu ta rpā bye pre ta rpā dhi de ba rpā bye dā no rpā dhi/ ma ri yā ma sā na bī dhi kā la bye ro rpā dhi/aṣṭa bhe ra ba rpā dhi lo ha ro ha bo nā si dha ⑦sha dha paṃ dhi pā na phu la ko rpā bye/ te la ta le ko rpā dhi bhā ta du dha ko rpā dhi/ ka ra na ka ra tu ti ko bā dha ṣi ⑧ram̐ ṣe ram̐ ṣe hra pā la rpā bye/ a zo ta ra so bhā nā i rpā ⑨dhi bā rā su ma sān rpā bye te rā gya ka ru bā rpā dhi/ tso dā mya sgo sā su ra rpā dhi saṃ ṣa rī ḍi ka bhā rpā dhi pa ta/ tsha nī rpā dhi bhe ⑩ga na rpā dha to bā bā ā da ma tī do hā yī/ bi bi phru ta mā ki du hā yī su ba ra mu ra ḍā⑪/ pi pi phru ta mā ki dā ba na gi ra/ na ba lā ṣa a si ha dzā ra pi ra 120—749

pi rka ba ra bā bye ḍa ri/ a ba de kho re ma ha ma dā ①pi te re manta ki saṭī/ u ta ra ko u ta ra rpā dhī④/ da tsha na ko da tsha na rmā bye pa ṭī ma ko pa tshi ma rpā dhi/purba ko purba rpā dhi/ kā ṭha tī ro ṭi rpā dhi phi re ma ha ①ma dā pi rjorā se ṣa si la ra pasgye ta mant+ra/ bā dhi ḍā rī me rī bhaspri gu ru tī sikta ⑤phu ro mant+ra sī swa ri bā tsā/ zhes pa'o—/ /rā sa rā dze shwa ra te bcud len dbang phyug rgyal po'i sbyor ba ni/dngul chu dug bral/ mu zi ser po/ /mṛ ta sā ra/snye chu shing nag pos go chod tsam/zangs phye/ tā la ka /btsan dug /tshal dkar/ si oṃ la/ ldong rjoros/rgya tshwa/ lcags phye/ zha nye dkar po'i phye ma/ dzā duti/ bong nga dmar po nyi risnyi si (shenang / ljang gu/ mu sa li/ dza ba ṣa ra/ nī ba/ pa ya bi raṅga/skyer pa/snye datuha ri dra/ a ka la ka ra/ pi pi ling gi rtsa ba/ gur gum/ nā ga ge sar chung ba/ tsu ka /ru dha/snye kuṭa/ kā ka ra seṅgi/ ma la kā na⑨/gu ni/ bong nga dmar po/snye ririrnyisi/⑨ la la phud/ khu ra sa ni a dza wa na/mu shasbra ra/ sa mu dra pha la/ bee/ pi pi ling / pho ba ris/ 'bras bu gsum—/ zi ra nag po tāraṭī ra rnams cha mnyam dang ga pur kuṣasanyis 'gyur/de thams cad dang dan rog dug dbyung tshar ba bsnyams par btags la dar la btsagasaske/ bhiṅga rā dza' khu bas sbrus ⑪la zhag nyer gcig gi bar btags te ril bu pho ris tsam sgril/ ril bu re jiṅga rā dza' khu bas rta byas btang na rlung tshad gsar rnying thams cad la phan/ bye kar ⑫dang mnyam du btang na mkhris tshad gsar rnying thams cad la phan zhing zas gang zos kyang 'grims 'gro ba la btang na yang chad par 'gyur ro/ /chang la pi pi ling phye ma btab pas rta byas btang na bad kan la brten pa'i tshad pa 'joms par 'gyur ro/ /ra ma'i 120—750

gcin gyis rta byas nas btang na pho ba'i nad mā la dzwa re dang ga mi bde ba dang lcags dreg ky-ibyegi nad la phan/ oṃ pha gosnyodadang pho ris bsnan ④la btang na tshad pa'i rigs thams cad la phan/ skyu ru ra dang ba'i mar bsnan bu la btang na pho ba na zhing dbugs mi thon pa la phan/ nī ba'i lo ma dang mnyam du zos na i ka'i skyigasadhibu'i nad la phan/ jiṅga ra'i khu bar sbyar te mig la byugs na mig ser la phan no//oṃ pha dang la la phud bsnan dhite byin na bud med kyi bu ⑥btsas pa'i rjes su sked pa dang tshang ra na ba la phan/ ka ra dang mnyam du btang na zas skom tsha grang ⑦ gang 'grims pa gcod par 'gyur ro/ /pā na dang mnyam du btang na mkhris pa'i nad la phan/ ba'i mar ⑧sar dang mnyam du zos na bud med mngal chags nas mi gnas pa gnas par 'gyur ro/ /ra'i 'o mas rta byas btang na dwangs ma 'dzag pa chod do/ /skyu ru ra'i khu bas rta byas te btang na dmu ⑨chu 'jog pa la phan par 'gyur ro/ /nim bu'i khu bar sbyar la sna bug tu ⑩blug na mgo phyed na ba la phan zhing mig la byugs na 'byung po'i gnod pa la phan/ 'u ⑩su ni nyaṭa dang ba mar bsnan ⑫nas btang na sbrul gyi dug la phan/ lda'i khya bas rta byas nas btang na sdig pa'i dug la phan/ nā ga putpa (steglasgang dang mnyam du btang na gnyid chung ngu 'gro'o/ /ma ⑫la kaṅga ni dang mnyam du btang na lus stobs 'phel lo/ /gong gsal ⑫rnams nyin bdun re'i bar gtong zhing zas spyod ⑩nad so so'i skabs thob sbyor/ spyi sman go ra tso le'i spyor ba ni/ le shi/dzā ⑩ti'i dzelab tri me tog /sman chen/ ku ṭa ki/ mu sa li/ sug sme la/snye.a la tsi/ ba ya pi raṅga / ma nu khrag can/snyezhophyedaganyis/ gi waṃ⑫/ ko ra/ ma ra ha ṭi/ dngul chu/ bong nga dmar po/snyebong nga dkar po bcag nas dkyil ljang khu yod pa 120—751

gnyis| mu zi ser po/ ba ①bla/ dan rog dug bral rnams zho gsum re dang /la la phud zho bco lnga rnams zhib par btags pa dar la btsags⑤/ jiṅga rā dza'i khya bas sbrus la rdo gzhong nang du nyin nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar nyed cing skabs skabs su nyi mar cung zad bstan/ sa ha de pa'i ④khu bas sbrus la nyin gsum gyi bar nyes la ril bu sma ru mgo nag tsam sgril zhos rta byas nas btang na chu ser rlung ldan la phan/ nyin bdun gyi bar btang ngo / /danda ④araṇḍiphye mar btags—/ gong gi ril bu las sum 'gyur gyis che ⑤ba bcas btang na sbyongs phebs so/ /ba mar gsar pas khu ba byas nyin rer ril bu bzhi re nyi ma bdun gyi bar btang na rlung gi bund dang me drod nyams pa mig gi rab rib la phan no/ /jiṅga rā dza'i khu bas rta byas nyi ma gcig la ril bu bzhi btang na rlung rigs 'dar bu la phan no/ /ra'i ④'o mas rta byas nas btang na dwangs ma 'dzag pa tsha grang gang la yang phan/ pa'i chus rta byas te btang na nas ④pa gong dang 'dra'o—/ /yang dwangs ma chu dang mnyam du 'dzag cing nad zug byed na go yu dang mnyam du btang bas phan no/ /yang khrag tu 'dzag na a ba la'i skyu rurakhu bas rta byas btang na phan par 'gyur ro/ /nim bu'i khu bar sbyar la mig la byugs ⑨na 'byung po gang gis kyang glags mi rnyed do/ /'bras bu gsum gyi phye ma thur mgo gsum tsam dang ril bu bzhi mnyam du btang na mas rlung gyen log dang stod rlung sogs rlung rigs dang yan lag zha ba la phan/ yang zi ra dkar po dang mnyam du btang na yang mas rlung gyen log dang stod rlung sogs rlung rigs la phan no/ /a ma li zho gang dang ril bu bzhi mnyam du btang na chu 'tshag rgyu chen po med pa la yang yang 'tshag dgos shing btsags pa dang na tsha chen po yong 120—752

ba la phan/ sho mo sa mithidang mnyam du btang na dwangs ma 'phel zhing 'dod pa spyod nus par 'gyur ro/ /zi ra nag po dang mnyam du chur brdar nas so na ba'i thad kyi phyi la byugs na zug gzer ①'phral du zhi'o/ /thang phrom ④dhadhur gyi lo ma nyung zad dang ril bu re btang na grang mkhris kyi nad la phan/ si bā ra chu dar sngon po dang lhan du brdar nas bse dug gi rma dang shu ba la byugs na 'phral du phan/'bras chur sbangs pa'i khu bas rta byas btang na btsan dug sbyar dug gyur dug sogs dug rigs thams cad la mchog tu phan no/ /bod spangs kyi khya ba la sbyar nas lus la bsku mnye ⑦byas na 'dus pa'i nad la phan no/ /bhriṅga rā dza'i khu bas rta byas khong du btang kyang 'dus nad la phan no/ /phag brun mer bsregs pa'i thal ba dang bong bu'i gcin la ril bu brdar nas sna la lanagasum gyi blug na mi rgi'i mgo la 'bu yod pa'i me chu nyi zla sogs 'od can la bltas nas rgyal zer gyi 'gyel 'gro ba'i dund la mchog tu phan/ chang gis rta byas nas btang na ⑤par 'gyur ro/ /shing a ka la ka ra'i phye ma dang mnyam du btang na bad kan skya smug mtha' dag la phan no/ /zangs kyi snod du ba'i zho khyor gang tsam blug par ril bu btab ste legs par bsnur la khong du btang na ma 'ju ba'i rigs thams cad la phan no/ /bye kar ( pedang mnyam du btang na mkhris pa la phan/ sbrang rtsi dang mnyam du zos dun lus stobs bskyed par 'gyur ro/ /pa thu ba'i lo ma brdungs pa dang mnyam du btang na mkhris pa sha ser dang rdel nad la phan/ ma nu khrag can chung ngu dang mnyam du btang na gseb dri sogs lus kyi rngul chen po'i dri dang chu rtags kyi dri ngan pa bganidril nas za la phan/ sle tres dang mnyam du btang na 7grang ba 'dzag pa tsha grang mtha' spyo dag la phan/ nye shing pa dang mnyam du btang 120—753

na rlung gis na ①zug byed pa dang ba byi ba sogs la phan/ la la phud shu dag gnyis phye mar btags pa dang mnyam du btang na rked pa na ba la phan/ chus rta byas nas lo gsum zla ba gsum zhag gsum nyi ma'i sum cha gsum gyi bar dril ②bu re bar ma chad par bsten ④na lus kyi nad gsar rnying thams cad 'byang zhing lus stobs 'phel ba dang rgas kha sra ba sogs phan yon bsam las 'das so/ /nad par gtong skabs zas spyod sogs nad babs dang bstun rjote skabs dang sbyar ro / /⑤skran gyi sman la danda'i durtsa ba zho bzhi/ lga dang kha ru tsha se ca la lo ṇa zho phye )do re/ shing kun se ba lnga rnams chu phor pa gsum la btab la cha gnyis gdus ⑧pa'i phor gang khong du btang na rlung skran 'phral du zhig par 'gyur ro—/ /yang 'gron ⑨bu mer bsregs pa'i thal ba pho ris pi pi ling /lga—/ tsi tra⑫/ kha ru tshwa rnams zhib par btags pa dang la btsags la thur mgo do tsam chu skol ⑫gyis rta byas btang na skran gyi rigs thams cad la phan no/ /shing kun cha phyed/ zi ra dkar po/ lda/ kha ru tsha/ 'u su ⑫dha ni nya rnams cha re bcas thang thun tsam chu phor pa gsum gyi nang du btab/ cha gnyis gdus ⑫la btang na mkhris skran zhig par 'gyur ro/ /kā ka ra seṅgi/ dha ba ra'i me tog /lda/ bu ram rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags pa'i ril bu ba ru ra tsam re btang na pho skran zhig par 'gyur ro/ /rgya tshasngoste/snye serngo/ kha ru tsha()/tsi tra⑫/ bee/ pi pi ling gi rtsa ba rnams cha mnyam dang shing tsha phyed bcas zhib par btags la thur mgo do tsam chu skol gyis rta byas btang na skran gyi rigs mtha' dag la phan/ ke la ka'i rtsa ba/ danda'i lhortertsa ba/ lga/ tsi tratu)/rgyam tsha skyernams cha mnyam dang shing kun cha phyed bcas dang ⑥thun tsam chur gdu ⑥120—754

lugs gong bzhin byas btang na rlung la brten pa'i ma zhu ①ba'i skran zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /a ru ra dang lda cha mnyam la shing kun cha phyed bcas zhib par btags pa thur mgo do tsam chu skol gyis 'phul te btang na me drod nyams pa'i skran zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyam tsha①/ kha ru tsha④/ bee/ tsi tra④/ ba ru ra/pi pi ling gi rtsa ba rnams cha mnyam pa dang shing kun cha phyed bcas zhib par btags la thun tshad gong bzhin chu skol gyis 'phul te btang na khrag la brten pa'i ma 'ju ba'i skran zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /'gron ⑤thal/ lga/ pi pi ling /li shi/ dzā dhiti/ kha ru tshwa rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la chu skol gyis 'phul ⑦btang na rlung skran zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /pho ris/ pi pi ling lga/la la phud/ zi ra nag po rnams cha mnyam dang shing kun cha phyed bcas phye mar btags la chu skol gyis ⑧'phul nas btang na chu skran zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /pho ris/ pi pi ling / lga/ la la phud/ rgyam tsha/ tsi tra⑨/ zi ra nag porka/ shing kun rnams cha bsnyams ⑩pa zhib par btags la chu skol gyis 'phul nas btang na skran gyi rigs thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /lga/ tig ta/pi pi ling / la la phud/ a ka la ka ra/ li shi/ khu ra sha na/snyelang thang rtse/pi pi ling gi rtsa ba rnams cha mnyam thang thun tsam chu sum gnyis gdus ⑪pa'i khu ba phor gang btang na mkhris skran zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /pho ris/ pi pi ling / bee/rgyam tsha⑫/ tsitāyata/ la la phud rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la ba mar btsags ⑫bcad pas rta byas gtong zhing cung zad lus la byugs na bud med bu btsas pa'i rjes su khrag mkhris kyi skran byung ba la phan no/ /sbrul sha dang lda cha mnyam zhib par btags pa dar la btsags te se ba bcu drug re chu bskol gyis rta 120—755

byas btang na dmu stichu/ skya rbab ②kyis skrangs pa/ mkhris pa/ rlung /mgo na ba/ pho ba na ba sogs nad gsar rnying mtha' dag la phan/ sbrul gyi pags pa brjes zhupa me la bsregs pa zhib par btags pa mig la byugs na mig gi nad thams cad la phan zhing mig gsal bar 'gyur ro/ /sbrul shun dang ba'i 'o ma mkhur bkang byas na so'i nad thams cad la phan no/ /sbrul shun zhib par btags pa ba zho btsags pas sbrus la ril bu sran ma nyis 'gyur tsam sgril la khong du btang na za 'phrug la phan/ gnyen 'bur gyis skrangs par sbrul gyi khrag byugs na myur du phan/ rma bya'i sgo mdongs me la bsregs pa'i thal ba chu grang gis 'phul nas btang na khrag sogs skyug pa'i rigs chod par 'gyur ro/ /sdig pa rnyitshulimer bsregs pa'i thal ba sran ma tsam chu grang gis rta byas btang na rdel nad 'phral du sel zhing bud med kyi nu ma skrangs pa la yang phan no/ /sdig pa mer bsregs pa'i du ba khong dhipar btang na srog chags kyi gnod pa mi 'byung /mi thod zhib par nyes la chur sbyar te byugs na 'bras bu skrangs pa la phan/ mi thod mer bsregs la thur mgo do tsam re khong du zhag bdun gyi bar btang na 'bras bu skrangs shin tu che ba la phan no/ /rkang ⑤lag gi sen dumo gog pa'i nad la khang byil tsiḍigyi klad pa byugs na 'phral du phan/ gdong la gro thig dzha ming ⑦yod par khang byil gyi brun chu la sbyar la nyin bdun gyi bar du byugs na med par 'gyur ro/ /spyi ther sogs mgo la skra med par rta'i klad ghorag na pa nyin bdun gyi bar du byugs na skra skye bar 'gyur zhing rgya dang sma ra/ sogs 'dod kyang gong blu'adod par byugs pas skye bar 'gyur ro/ /ma he'i ra ⑨mateka siṅga skyu ru ra dang mnyam du chu la btsos tshos pa dang bton spyol mer bsregs pa'i thal ba gong 120—756

gi chur btab ste mgo bor byugs na skra shin tu bzang ba skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i rjes su pags mtshams la chu ser 'phel ba'i rtags byung na rwa snum gyi dkyil du btsos la byugs pas zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /pags nad khol bu ba sen mo btab kyang reg ①pa mi tshor ba dang skom pa la bye ba'i brun chur brdar ba byugs pas phan no—/ /mdze'i bcos thabs ni/ thog mar mdze la rigs rnam pa bdun te/lu ta kuṣṭha/snyechu rlung thabs ②la brten pa'i mdze/ sarba①dhwa tu kuṣṭha/snyemakhris rlung la brten pa'i mdze/bi tsi kuṣṭha/snyegrang rlung la brtan rjopa'i mdze/ lā la kuṣṭha/snyekhrag ⑤la brten pa'i mdze/ su ya kuṣṭha/—khrag mkhris la brten pa'i mdze/ tsand+ra kuṣṭha/—grangamadze/ ṣaṣedhri kuṣṭha/—sha bkradu/rnams te de yang chu rlung gi mdze la thog mar sha lpags khol dzeebur za zhing brad na chu ser mang du don yong / mkhris rlung la gzhan ma gong dang 'dra ba la drod shin tu che zhing mdog kyang cung zad dmar la brad na khrag kyang 'byung ba'o/ /grang rlung la thog mar lus khol bur skrangs shing mdog kyang khra bor yod la rjes su tshigs che chung thams cad skrangs shing chu ser 'dzag pa'o/ /khrag mje la yan lag dang rna ba sna sogs kyi rtse chad cing rnag khrag 'dzag cing mdog kyang dmar por 'ong ngo / /khrag mkhris la brten pa gzhan ma gong dang 'dra ba la drod shin tu che ba'o/ /grang mdze ⑧mdog dkar zhing rnag khrag chu ser mang du 'dzag go/ /sha bkra la rtogs ⑨par sla ba'o/ /de dag gi sman ni/ a ru ra gser mdog dang nag chung /snyesnarita ra ḍa/ btsod/snyenañdziṣṭhakṛ)/ du ba ral pa/rkogre khya byu ra sta/btsan dug /ka na bi ra'i rtsa ba rnams zhib par btags la ba'i chus sbrus ⑪nas nad gang yod la byugs na chu rlung gi mdze dang mkhris rlung gi mdze la phan no//zangs kyi par bu'i nang du/ mu zi ser po/ tsha la/ yung ba/ a ma ba'i sha 120—757

'bras kyi skogs khyapa 'bras bu rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la tsi tā'i ②shing gong gi cha gcig dang / gi wa kwa ra'i shing cha gsum bcas blugs la kha legs par bcad—/ de rdza'i khog ma che ba ①zhig gi nang du bcug la kha bsdams te thab me rtag pa'i thab gong du zla ba drug gi bar du bzhag /de nas bton bul phye mar byas te ra'i 'o ma dang sbyar nas byugs pas grang rlung gi mjes tshigs skrangs pa 'phral du zhi'o/ /mu zi ser po/ thang phrom ⑤gnyis til snum gyi nang du bskyur dul ma tshig par me btang / de nas grang ⑦thag chod pa dang byugs pas mkhris rlung la brten pa'i mje la phan no//snye kon po dang pags pa se ko ltar sang ⑧ba'i za phrug la phan/ mu zi ser po/ /'bras bu gsum/ ma nu khrag can/ sgron tsiḍame shing gi 'bru mngar ⑨skyur gnyis yong ba'i skyur ba/ til nag rnams cha mnyam z-iṅga rā dza' thang chu dang mnyam du btags la byugs na khrag mdze la phan no/ /hi rim bi bong nga dmar po nang ljang gu cha gcig /pho ris cha gnyis/ mi thod bsregs pa'i thal ba cha gsum rnams zhib par btags la thuramago do tsam la chu grang gis rta byas btang bas mdze nad kyi rigs thams cad la phan no/ /khyung sder smug po/skyi gu ri bu cha/dong ga'i 'bru/snye rādzathrakṣa/ nī ba/ bā ya bi raṅga/ pi pi ling / tsi tra⑫/mu zi ser po/ bong dmar nang ljang rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la thun thur mgo do tsam re chu grang gis rta byas btang na yang mdze rigs kun la phan/ldarka/ pi pi ling / pho ris/ dong ga'i 'bru/ bong dmar/ skyu ru ra/ba ru ra rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la ba'i zhun mar la sbyar te byugs na chu rlung la brten pa'i mdze la phan/ sgog skya/snye labun/ rtswa ba/ tsi tra⑪/ ba bla—/ mu zi ser po/ ka na bi ra'i rtsa ba/ sargya/snye sad⑫kha/ ru dha/ sho 120—758

mo sa lcags btul ma rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la chang gis khu ba byas nas rdza snod du blug kha legs par bcad/ gci ba dang rta sbangs rnyid pa'i dkyil du zhag nyer gcig gi bar bsnyal/ de nas bton ①la byugs na grang rlung la brten ②pa'i mdze dang khrag mkhris la brten pa gnyis la mchog tu phan/kha ru tsha④/ dan rog /sma ru mgo nag rwatihūṃ gha tsi rwa de steng rjogo ra tsi li'i sbyor ba dang po'i ril bu rnams cha mnyam pa zhib par btags pa grang mje'i rma gang yod la gtsags ⑤bu rnon pos rtsa bas de la btab pas phan no/ /mu zi ser po/'bras bu gsum/ ma nu khrag can/ tig nag /sgon me shing gi 'bru rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags pa jiṅga rā dza' khu ba dang sbyar nas byugs na yang grang mdze zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /dan rog /sma ru mgo nag /tsi tā rnams cha re/rdo ṣa ra — rigs lce 'thags pa lta bu cha gsum/ lda cha bzhi/ — ba cha lnga rnams zhib par btags chu la sbyar nas byugs na yang grang mdze zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /dong ga'i 'bru/ til nag /bee/ bu ram rnams cha mnyam la zhib par btags pa ril bu skyu ru ra'i 'bru tsam byas btang na grang mdze dang sha bkra bul phan no/ /sman de rnams gtong ba'i ring pag thug ma gtogs dkar skyur dmar gsum thams cad 'dzem/ ya ma'i bcos la yang rigs gsum ste/ a da se si/snyeya ma dkar po mgo bo gzhogs phyed pa/ pinā sa/snyeya ma khra bo sna dmar por 'gro/ ya ma nag po/snyen thu ra rnams so//—tshagardol rgyab yod/ de rnams kyi sman ni/ phag tshil/ bu ram/lug gi mar gsum cha mnyam mer bskol la grang ba ⑦dang snar blugs na ya ma dkar po la phan no/ /bye karadhi/ kuṅga/ ba mar/ gsum cha mnyam pa mer bskol ba grang ba ⑨dang snar blugs kyang phan par 'gyur ro/ /yang na/120—759

shing mngar1/ dzenya snyemadhu/ pi pi ling gi rtsa ba gnyis zhib par btags pa'i mar btsags 1bcad pa dang sbyar la snar blugs kyang phan no/ /pho ris 'bru gsum / a tu sa'i lo ma'i khu ba dang mnyam du nyes la snar blugs kyang phan no//khra bo la/ tsha la/ pi pi ling / shug pa/——rebadhwa rmahūṃ/ dzo ṣa ra/ danda'i thurtsa ba rnams cha bsnyams pa zhib par btags/ lcags snod du snum la btab ste btsag chod pa dang grang du thubacug la snar blugs na phan no/ /——ya ma nag po/yang na/ yung ba/ mu zi ser po/ tsha ba gsum/ zi ra dar/ bye kar/a ma li'i 'bru/ ru rta du/ shu dag /tsan dan dmar po/ a shwa tsogadzha rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la ba'i chu dang sbyar nas snar blugs na sna nas 'bu don yong zhing phan la mgo 'khor la yang phan no/ /yang pho ris bu ram gnyis cha mnyam btags la chang skyur la sbyar nas snar drugs kyang phan no/ /——mgo gzhogs 4snaphyed na ba la/ 'bras bu gsum dang pi pi ling cha mnyam btags la sbrang rtsis ril bu byas te khong du btang zhing / sbrang rtsi chur sbyangs pas rta byas snar blugs kyang phan zhing sna kyekhrag 'dzag pa dang kha'i dri ngan pa la phan no/ /nag po la/ sgyu ru ra zhib par btags la ba mar dang mnyam du bskol te gang na sar byugs pas phan/ se yo'abru'i me tog dang dru rmyeb gnyis kyi khu ba ra'i 'o ma dang bsres la snar blugs pas phan no/ /snye yamanag po la/ yang pi pi ling /sum̐ ha'i 'bru/ bā 3ziya bi raṅga/ byithangaka /pho ris rnams cha mnyam btags la ba'i chu la sbyar nas snar byug ⑫cing cung zad sna'i nang du btang bas kyang phan zhing sna khrag 'dzag pa yang chod do/ /bye kar dang sbrang rtsi gnyis pa'i 'o mar sbyar nas snar blugs na phan no/ /yang bal po kha che/— kusum bha ba/⑫ se 1 sna'abru'i me tog 120—760

dru ba rnams kyi khya ba ra'i 'o ma dang bsres la snar blugs na phan/ dza mu na'i 'bru/ dru ba/ se ①'bru'i me tog gsum gyi khu ba snar blugs na phan zhing sna khrag kyang 'chad do/ /yang na/ bee dang daṇḍa'i ②rtsa ba chang skyur la sbyar nas gang na sar bsku mnye ④byas na phan/ yang lga zhib par btags la ba'i 'o mar sbyar nas snar blugs na phan no/ /jiṅga rā dza'i thang chu dang 'bras bu gsum zhib par btags pa chu skol gyis rta byas btang na yang phan no/ / yung ba dhicha gcig / se 'bru'i skogs ⑤cha gnyis/ gu 0ra'i 'bras bu skogs ⑦gsum/ star bu cha bzhi rnams btags pa ril bu byas/ ba'i chu dang sbyar te dpral bar byugs kyang phan no/ /des ya ma dkar nag khra gsum gyi bcos rdzogs so// //tsu ka / se 'bru'i skogs④/ spos dkar/snyesmi⑨ra la/ la la phud/dzā ⑩ti/ a shī ma/ li ga dur sagan ba de rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la thun tshad thur mgo do tsam chu grang gis rta byas btang na rgyun du khrag 'grims pa 'phral du chod par 'gyur ro/ /gla sgang / spos dkar/ sha 'bras kyi skogs/nā ⑪ga ge sar gyi thang chu/ ma dzu'i 'bras bu/ bil ba'i ṣpelakanang gi 'bru/dha ya'i me tog /dzā ⑫nyi/ so ma ra tsa/ a shī ma/ li ga dur/ ke la me tog /ka ka ṇa ⑫siṅga / le shi/ la la phud rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags pa dar la btsags te thur mgo do tsam re ba'i zho dang mnyam du btang na 'grims ④nad tsha grang yang 'phral du chod do/ /pi pi ling gi shing gi pags pa/ po ṣa ra'i rtsa ba/ dha wa'i me tog /mu sa li/ sha 'bras kyi skogs ⑫/ tri gu ḍa'i rtsa ba/ zi ra dkar po/ rgya gar stod ja/ a shī ma rnams cha mnyam 120—761

btags pa dar la btsags/ thun tshad gong 'dra sbrang rtsi dang mnyam du btang na khrag 'grims ①pa gcod do/ /a phri ma/ ke la'i me tog /pho ris/ la la phud rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la chu grang gis rta byas btang na yang nus pa gong dang 'dra'o/ /drag shul la brten pa'i lte ba'i rtsa 'phyus pa'i nad gang zos pa dang khrag rgyun par 'grims shing nad zug yod sar 'phar ba zhig yod—/ de'i bcos la/ sa 'bras kyi shing gi pags pa/ nā ②ga ge sar gyi thang chu/ a shī ma/ la la phud/ li ga dur/ pa ṭa ka ḍi rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la dar la btsags pa thur mgo do tsam sbrang rtsi dang mnyam du btang na myur du phan zhing gzhan yang khrag 'grims pa la phan no/ /yang gong gi lte ba 'phyus pa'i nad de la nad pa rang gis rgyab tu lag pa g.yas kyis rkang pa g.yon gyi mthe bong zin/ lag pa g.yon gyis rkang pa g.yas kyi mthe bong zin/de nas mi zhig gis lag pa bsnol mtshams nas lan bdun gyi bar du btegs pas kyang 'phral du phan zhing nad par 'phral du zug gzer sdeche bar yod yang de la tshad mi dgos so/ /dzā duti/ a shī ma/ ga bur/snye ka spur⑤/ glartsi/snye kastu duri| thang phrom④/ so ma ra tsa rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags pa dar la btsags pa thun tshad skyu ru ra tsam sbrang rtsi dang mnyam du btang na zas mdog dang khrag sogs gang 'grims pa'i rigs gsar rnying tsha grang kun la phan/ tshad pa sogs skom nad sel ba'i sman ni/ 'bras bu gsum/ rgyam tshwa/ la la phud rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la thur mgo do tsam re chu phor gang gi nang du blugs la phyed tsam skam ④pa dang grang thag bcad ras la btsags te khong du btang na phan no/ /yang mkhris tshad la brten pa kho nas skom na/ pho ris 120—762

dang bye kar cha mnyam zhib par btags pa ka ka ra siṅga'i khu bas rta byas btang na phan/ chu bsgrims ①pa la/ tsha la mer bsregs pa'i thal ba thur mgo do tsam ba dar gyis rta byas btang na myur du phebs so/ /rgyam tsha ②dang kha ru tsha zhib par btags la chu bcus nas zhag gcig song bas rta byas btang na yang phebs so—/ /byi ba'i brun ba'i dar bas khub byas brdar la rdo rje dang 'bras bu gnyis dang mgo bo'i mchog ④ma la byugs khong du yang cung zad btang bas myur du phebs nges so/ /kamatsha/—'jam 'bras kyi snying po zhib par btags shel kar ④dang mnyam du chus rta byas la btang na yang phebs so/ /lha mo dbu mas lha dbang phyug chen po la gsol pa/ kye lha yi lha mchog dbang phyug che/ /khyed ni 'jig rten byed po ste/ /nad kun zhi zhing blo 'phel ba'i/ /sman mchog bdag la bstan du gsol/ /zhes gsol pa dang / dbang phyug gis bka' stsal pa/nyon cig ri sras dpal chen mo/ /nad 'joms blo 'phel yon tan gter/ /sman mchog ma la rmā gu ni'i/ /bsten dhithabs phan yon bshad par bya/ /de la dang por bshal skyugs kyis lus dag par bkrus la nyin dang por ma la rmā gu ni'i 'bru gcigadu /gnyis par gnyis/ de nas rim bzhin nyin bdun gyi bar ⑦'bru re spar/ nyin bdun nas bzung ⑧zla ba gcig dang zhag bcu'i bar 'bru bdun re bsten/ de bar zas gang la'ang tshwa ba'i ⑨rigs 'joms pas rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa sogs tsha grang gsar rnying thams cad rtsa ba nas 'byin par byed cing / lus brtan pa dang / gzi brjid che ba dang / nad dkon pa/mig gsal ba/ stobs 'phel ba sogs yon tan mtha' yas shing / khyad par blo gros padma kha phye ba ltar gyur nas blo rno ba/ 'dzin bzang ba/ rig pa 120—763

gsal ba/ brjed mi 'gro ba/ rtsod ①pa bzang ba sogs blo 'phel gyi mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /yang tshes bco lnga dang gza' nyi ma 'dzom pa'i mtshan mo ma la hūṃ gu ni'i sgrum gyi sgron me sbar/ de la rkun po'i thod pa bkab nas du ba chags su bcug pa de mig la byugs na mig chus ma dag par lha 'dre mi gsum gang gis kyang mthong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /yang gza' lhag pa yod pa'i nyi ma ⑧hūṃ gu ni'i snum khol ma rnying pa'i nang du chu blug /de steng ma la rmā gu ni'i zhing par btags pa btab la bskol ba grangs su bcug pa'i snum kha zhag ltar yong ba zos la rting par byugs na mdze rigs kyis ①yan lag chad 'gro ba sos ④par 'gyur zhing gdong mdzes shing mdangs dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /nyin nyer gcig gi bar snum se ba bcu gnyis re khong du ⑤btang na mdze'i rigs mtha' dag rtsa ba nas thon par 'gyur ro/ /yang gza' nyi ma yod pa'i nyin snod gtsang mar ba nag mo'i 'o ma bskol/ de la ma la rmā gu ni'i rjozhib par btags la btab ste ru ma dang bcas zho bsnyal/ de dkrogs te mar bcos la 'bras ba nag mo'i 'o mar bcos pa'i ⑦mar de nas se ba bcu gnyis re btab pa zla ba gcig dang ⑧zhag bcu'i bar zos na/ skra dang sma ra dkar por song ba slar yang ⑨nag por 'gyur ro/ /gza' mig dmar yod pa'i nyin ba nag mo'i mar btsags ⑩bcad la phyed tsam grang bar ma la rmā gu ni'i 'bru dang til nag cha mnyam phye mar btags pa blug ste nyin dang por se ba bcu gnyis/ gnyis par zho gang se ba bzhi sogs nyin bdun gyi bar du cha re spar/ de nas rgyun du bsten thub na rab de min zla gcig dang zhag bcu'i bar du bsten na tshe shin tu ring bar 'gyur zhing gong ⑩du 'gro yang mgyogs ⑫bul rta dang mnyam par 'gyur ro/ /zhes lha dbang 120—764

phyug gis lha mo dbu mar gdams pa rdzogs so// //a shwa garnya zhib ①par btags pa'i bye ma zho gsum/ ba dkar rkyang nag rkyang lta bu sru mdog gang yin kyang mdog gzhan ma 'dres pa'i kha gtsang gi mar btsags ②bcad pa'i nang du btab ste 'khang pa dang bud med dus bab ①kyi zla mtshan 'dzag nas tshad pa'i nyin khong du btang na bud med phru gu mi yong ba'ang nges par sbrum dupar 'gyur ro/ /yang sau gha ḍa/ lga/ bha ṭa ka ṭi ya/ pi pi ling / nā ⑤ga ge sar rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags pa dar la btsags pa thur mgo gsum pa mdog gcig gi 'o ma khyor gang tsam la btab ste dus gong mtshungs la byin na'ang nges par mngal dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /ma la chags kyang mi gnas par 'jig na/ lnga la rjoka ma la'i rtsa ba ba'i 'o mar btsos/de nas beer yang ba mar gyi nang du btsos la zhib par btags la gong gi ba mar bzhu ba dang mnyam du btang na zhag bdun nad kyang grag 'ong ④'jig par mi 'gyur ro/ /yang bilba'i 'bru dang smyug ma'i lo ma cha mnyam zhib par btags la chus rta byas nas nyin bdun gyi bar btang kyang mi 'jig go/ /mig sman gyi sbyor thabs ni/surma—/ ldong ⑧ros/ sa mu dra pha la rgya mtsho lbu ba/snyes mudraphe na/ mu tig /byi dang ga bsdu ba ṣa pa ri ya⑨/ phaṭa ki ḍi/ byu ru/ lo dha/ pho ris rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags dar la legs par btsags/ 'khar snod du tsan dan dmar po'i skya ba'i mjug zangs dmar gyis gtums pas nyin phyed tsam skam nyed bya/ de nas bcus nas zhag gcig song ba'i chu cung zad blugs la nyi ma'i bzhi cha gcig tsam bsnur la ril bur dril/ skam pa dang rdo 'jam po'i ngos su chu dang lhan du brdar nas mig la byugs na ling tog /steng 'og gi 120—765

'gribs—/ sha 'dzer/ mig chu 'dzag pa/ rgyang mig mi gsal ba sogs mig gi nad mtha' dag la phan no/ /ki ka ra'i me tog /rgya gar stod ja/gla sgang khi rnyi'i 'bru/ pha ṭa ki ri rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags pa dar la btsags—/ ra'i 'o mas khu ba byas la ril bu sgril ba zhos khu ba byas brdar nas mig steng 'og gang rigs kyis bsgribs ①nas mi mthong bar byugs na mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /ri phyugs kyi gci ba ser kha ma me ②la bsregs pa'i thal ba zhib par btags/ der chur blugs la ras sam dar la tshags ①thengs gnyis byas/de nas chu de dwangs su bcug la dal bus pho bas mthil du chags pa'i thal ba de skams pa dang / 'khar snod du pang kha'i snum ④dang lhan du tsan dan gyi skya ba zangs gtums can gyis nyi ma gsum gyi bar bsnur ba chung ngu re mig la byugs na sha 'dzer dang / dmar por song ba sogs khrag la brten pa'i mig nad thams cad la phan/ bdud rtsi mig sman gyi sbyor ba ni/ surma/ gser rdo/—so na makṣi/ldong ⑤ros/ big pan/ pa 3 ṭi ka ṭi nyirma dzi/ pi pi ling / pho ris/ rgyam tsha⑦/ku ru pā la/ ba ru ra'i 'bru'i nang gi snying po/ ṣa pa ri ya rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags pa khrudar la btsags/ rdo gzhong shin tu 'jam po'i ⑨nang du chu bcus nas zhag gcig song bas gar sla zho tsam sbrus pa skam thag ma chod par nyed thengs gcig /de nas nyi mar cung zad cig spyobazhag /yang bud med bu skyes pa'i 'o mas gar sla gong tsam byas pa ma skam par nyed thengs gcig /de bzhin du ba'i 'o mas jengs gcig /ra'i ⑪'o mas thongs ⑫gcig sbrus pa'i ma skam tsam la ril bu sgril la skam thag chod pa dang sbrang rtsis rta byas brdar nas mig la byugs na rlung la brten 7pa'i mig nad thams cad la phan/ ra'i 'o mas khu ba byas nas 120—766

byugs na srod long la phan/ bud med kyi 'o mas khu ba byas nas byugs na khrag rlung la brten pa'i mig nad thams cad la phan/ ba'i gcin gyis khu ba byas nas byugs na mig tsha zhing mig rnag ①mang du 'dzag pa la phan/ 'u ②su'i khu bas rta byas byugs na sha 'dzer dang mig dmar por song ba la phan no①/ /de rnams ni bdud rtsi mig sman gyi sbyor ba kha bsgyur dang bcas pa rdzogs so// //ni ra ma li/ ra tan dze ti kayiphal zer skyur ba gnyis cha mnyam zhib par btags 'o mar sbyar te byugs na rgyang mig mi gsal ba la duphan/ du ba ral pa zho gang / dngul chu zho gang / rdo thal/ dan rog brgya tham pa lce ston/pho ris brgyad cu/ danda dudrug cu tham ⑦pa rnams zhib par btags nimbu'i khu bas 'dam btags byas la ril bu dril te pad kha tsam re chu la sbyar nas byugs na 'byung ngo / /sha za yi dwags la sogs pa gnod ⑦pas mig na ba la phan no/ /'khar sdod du nisru'i chur sma ru mgo nag dkar po zhib par brdar te steng glang po che'i rmig pa nyis 'gyur gyis mang ba zhig tu brdar/ de steng ku ④kum sma ru mgo nag gi gsum cha gnyis tsam brdar/ de rnams legs par 'dres pa dang mig la nyin gsum nas bdun gyi bar gang rigs 'byug cing sman zhag gang 'byug gi ring phyir mi 'don/ khyad par rlung gi rigs ma phog pa byas pas ling tog /rwa—/ sha 'dzer/ 'gribs sogs mig nad mtha' dag la mchog tu phan no/ /surmaske/ mi'i skra/ yung ba chung ngu bcas brdar la mi'i 'o mas khu ba byas nas mig la byugs na khrag gis mig dmar por song ba dang sha 'dzer la phan/ hong len bab ra na ser po dang gla rtsi sbyar la byugs na tsha 'khrug mig chu 'dzag ste za phrug ( /120 767

byed pa rnams la phan/ rgya mtsho sbya ba/ a shī ma/ se ra sa'i 'bru rnams se ba bzhi re'i rtsis zhib par brtags/ ba gsar pa'i chu bye gsum lcags snod nang du skya ba'i mgo zangs kyis gtums pas dkrugs ①pa dang me btang la chu phyed tsam skams pa dang / gong gi sman btab ste skyo ma gar phyogs tsam byas slar 'byug skabs pa'i chus klad la byugs na bar 'grib chu 'dzag pa za 'phrug② /dzee ma mig la zug pa sogs mig gi nad thams cad la phan no/ /ka ye pha la zhib mor ④btags pa chur 'omathang gis dhisbyar te byugs na srod long la phan no/ /rwa ⑤ling shin tu che bas khebs shing na na ni mbu'i khu bar rgya tshwa yungs 'bru tsam re brdar nas ra ling gi thog tu nyin gsum gyi bar blugs pas 'phral du zug gzer cung zad 'byung yang myur du phan par 'gyur ro/ /yang mig la ra ling gis cher na na kadzdzabazhu shel snying po rjopho ris tsam re zhib par btags la chur sbyar nas nyin gsum kyi bar ⑦blugs na nyin dang por zug gzer ⑧cung zad ldang /gnyis par mig skrangs po shin tu che zhing zug gzer ⑨kyang 'byung / nyin gsum par zug gzer skrangs po ⑩zhi ba dang / mnyam du rwa ⑪ling gang yang med par 'gyur zhing 'og 'grib kyis mi mthong ba yang gsal bar byed do/ /mig gangs phyid ⑫kyis na ba'i zug gzer 4nyeche na chu grang gtsang ma snod gang yang rung bar blugs la mig ma btsums spyopar gdong chu'i nang du bcug la zug gzer spyom chag par bdugs pas myur du phan par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin yan lag kha bas phyid 7pa yang chu grang mo'i nang du bdugs ⑫pas phan no/ /dpang /)sdong gi thang chu/ ha la dha/ phaṭa ki ri rnams cha mnyam ste ⑩ni sba'i khu ba byung na rab de min chur sbyangs mnas mig gi phyi nang la byugs pas mig 'bras chen por song 720 768

zhing mig sprin dmar ba nyin mtshan gnyis kar ①nad zug shin tu che ba la phan/ka ni ya ra'i rtsa ba/ mtshal/ tsha la/ ni la tho da/ pi pi ling pi pi ling gi rtsa ba/ pho ris/ lga bzang po rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags/lga bzang ba chur sbangs pas khya ba byas nas ril bu sran ma tsam dril la btang bas khrag la brten pa'i tshigs na ba thams cad la phan/ 'o ma bu'i rtsa ba/rko dzhayu/lcang nag madzhanagi rtsa ba dang lo ma/ skyi pa'i myubartsa ba sdong po lo ma 'bras bu/gze ma gosharurnams cha mnyam la 'om bu dang lcang nag gi rtsa ba cung zad mang ba bcas gzhogs ①la khog ma che ba mthil du bug pa nas shong ①ba tsam yod pa zhig gi nang du blugs/ khebs gcod rgyab la rlangs pa mi 'chor ba kha legs par bcad de mtshams rdza sa'i 'jim pas gtums rjoras kyis dril yang 'jim pa 'byug ⑤pa dang ras kyis dril ba sogs lnga brtsegs tsam byas/ sa rjodong brus pa 4 khog ma cung zad chung ba zhig bcug la sas stems/ de'i khar gong gi khog ma bzhag /khog ma gnyis kyi mtshams legs par bsgrigs la 'jim ④pas rlung mi 'chor bar byas/ de nas khog ma che ba shing dang gci ba'i dkyil du bcug la nyi ma'i bzhi cha tsam zhig me shin tu tsha ba btang / de nas grang ⑨thag chod pa dang bton spyopas khog ma chung bar gsham du chu dang khar snum spris ma ltar chags yod pa de bton ⑪la thur mgo re tsam bee dang mnyam du btang na bse dug min pa'i rlung la brten pa'i nad tsha grang thams cad la phan/ li shi dang mnyam du btang na grang ba la brten pa'i nad thams cad la phan/ yung ba tshostedang mnyam du btang na khrag la brten pa'i nad gsar rnying thams cad la phan/ rtsam pa'i pag dang mnyam du btang na bad kan gyi rigs thams cad la phan/ gzhan 120—769

'dres med pa'i mkhris pa rkyang pa'i nad dang 'grim pa gnyis por ba'i gzhan ma nad gang la yang mi 'grib med cing khyad par yan lag zha ba skams pa rnams la khong du btang zhing snum byugs pas nad med lta bur sos ①par 'gyur ro/ /phug ron/snyekabur ra/ khyemabya/snyesurko/ khang byi la/snye tsiri/ ri bong /snyeshasha/rnga mong uṭa rnams kyi brun gang legs par byas pa'i skam po khog ma steng shod ②du ldugs lugs sogs gong ltar byas pas snum bton ①la a ka ra ka ra/ lda bzang ba/ pi pi ling gi rtsa ba/ pi pi leng ⑦/ la la phud chung ba/ so ma ra tsa rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags pa dar la btsags/ de thams cad dang cha mnyam pa'i sgrum blugs la ril bu skyu ru ra tsam dril la btang na/ rlung /bad kan/ khrag grang ba/ chu ser rnams la phan zhing lus stobs rgyas pa dang khu ba 'phel bas ⑤'dod pa spyod dunus pa/ dngalgekha 'byed pa sogs la phan no//ri phyugs lo gcig tsam 'gro ba'i phyi ⑧ba/ ra'i ril ma gnyis skam thag bcad cing gang legs par byas/ khog ma steng shod ⑨du me gtong lugs sogs gong ltar byas pas sgrum 'byung ba sbrang rtsi dang yung ba ⑩gang rung dang mnyam du khong du btang zhing snum rgyang pas phyi ma bsku mnye ⑪byas pas chu pags 'grams/ za phrug⑫/tshags tshigs na ba sogs chu ser gyi nad thams cad la mchog tu phan zhing mig la byugs kyang rlung chu ser la brten pa'i mig nad la phan no/ /gro dang skyer pa ḍaru ha la da mang nyung mnyam pa dang / shu dag de'i sum ⑫cha tsam bcas pas snod du blugs la sgrum 'don lugs gong ltar byas pa se ba bzhi tsam re khong du btang na'ang nad tsha grang gsar rnying kun la phan pa'i spyi 'joms so zi tsha⑫—sor/rgyam tsha/spyo pha ṭa ki ḍi rnams cha mnyam bzhu shel gyi dam pe 'jim pa dang ras 120—770

bsnol mar lnga brtsegs byugs pa zhig gi nang du phyed tsam gong ba ①blugs/rdza snod che ba zhig gi phyed tsam gci ba'i mes bkang ba'i nang du gong gi dam pe gyen bsregs ④nyal stabs su bzhag /khardza snod kyi phyir 'ong ④ba byas la steng du'ang me btang ④/ khog ma de rdo'i sgyed pu gsum sgram ⑤lta bur bzhag pa'i mthil nas kyang me cung zad gtong / khog ma'i phyir bzhu shel gyi dam pe gcig bzhag la dam pe gnyis kyi kha sprad pa'i mtshams la lhang tsher rjobakab la phyir 'jim pa byugs te rlung mi 'chor ba byas/ me nyi ma'i brgyad cha tsam zhig btang bas—/ dam pe phyi ma'i nang du sdum 'ong ⑦ba de thigs ④pa gsum tsam re dang /la la phud se ba bzhi tsam zhib par btags pa dang mnyam du btang bas nad tsha grang gsar rnying thams cad la ni mi ⑨phan pa med do/ /ze tshaspyo/ rgyam tshatute/pha ṭa ki ḍi/ su ma la dkar po dang ser po/ dza ba ṣa ra/ mtshal cog la ma rnams cha mnyam btags pa bzhu shel gyi dam per blugs la snum 'don lugs ⑫gong mtshungs byas pa'i snum de mdze'i rma'am⑫/ shu pa gsar rnying ⑫/ phol mig sogs la byugs na phan no/ /a ru ra/ tsi tra spyo/ pi pi ling / rgyam tshatu)—/ a ru b.lashabasregs pa rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags pa dar la btsags—/ lda sbangs pa'i chus sbrus la ril bu skyu ru ra tsam sgril ba ril bu re btang na glo dang mgo bo na ba la phan zhing dang spyokha 'byed do/ /ma ru rtse'i 4)'bras bu zhib par btags la chu grang gis rta byas btang na glo ba'i rnag thon par 'gyur ro/ / sbyi bzhur ⑪brdungs pa'i khu ba khong du btang na phyi nang gi rtsa 'phyus pa'i rigs la phan no/ /tha ram brdungs pa'i 'byar khyes rmugs pa'i rma la dkris na phan/ lung kha ri/snye lpatshayin/ zhes pa'i sman tshad par phan/720—771

dkar sha/ shing sha sogs sha mo'i rigs gang rnyed bye kar dang mnyam du sbyar ba'i thang khong du btang na mkhal nad gzer ①zug 'phral du gcog /mkhan pa na ru ba brdungs pa'i khu bar pho ris zhib par btags la btab ste khong du btang na khog pa'i srin nad kun la phan/ mkhan pa'i dugs ②byas na pho long 'khrog pa myur du zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /spa yag pas skrangs po dang rma la phan/ la la phud cha lnga/ tsi ta ④cha bdun/ a ru ra cha drug rnams zhib par btags la chu skol gyis rta byas btang na ma 'ju ba/ me drod nyams pa/ glang thabs rnams la phan no/ /tsituwa tu ṭi/snyebadamar ma zhing chu la sogs la yod pa'i srog chags dmar po chung ngu zhig yod dang bu ram sbyar ba chus 'phul la btang na sha ser dang mig ser la phan no/ /ba dmar lga ser gyes khu ba byas la steng grib kyi nad mgor thebs rjon rna bar blug cing lus gzhan la thebs na khong du btang bas gza'i rigs mtha' dag la phan no/ /de yang gza' nad la/ rā hu'i dug 'phog pa yin na lo phyed gsum/spen pa'i dug phog na lo lnga/ ke tu'i dug phog na brgyad de de bsgral nas gza'i ④nad kyis 'tsho 'chi gang byed las mi gnas so/ /rgya khur dhuridang bye kar ⑦dang cha mnyam sbyar ba khong du btang bas mi phyugs gang gi yang chu 'gags pa sel lo/ /a ru ra gnyis sbrel mgo gzhogs phyed na ba la gang na phyogs su bsdams pas phan zhing sna khrag kyang chod la ya ma'i 'bus na ba sel lo/ /tsan dan dmar po dang /btsag pezhib par btags khong du'ang cung zad btang zhing gang na sar byugs pas me lce 'khor lo la phan no/ /tsan dan su ra zhib par btags la chu skol gyis 'phul nas btang na khrag la phan no/ /tsha la bsregs pa'i thal ba zi ra dkar po/ kha ru tsha (8rnams zhib par btags la thun tshad thur mgo do tsam 120 772

re btang na pho bar na zug byed pa rlung dang ma 'ju ba'i rigs kun la phan zhing dang ①kha 'byed do/ /la la phud cha gnyis/ kha ru tsha rngucha gcig /tsi tra zhu cha gsum—/ pi pi ling cha bzhi/ bee dmar po cha drug /a ru ra cha drug rnams zhib par btags dar la btsags te/ thun tshad gong bzhin btang bas ldan 'dus kyi ④nad gdong ser po dang dmar por song ba mig mi gsal shed chung ba'i mgo bo 'khor ba rnams la phan no/ /a ru ra byedachatsam mer bsregs pa'i thal ba/ tsi tra⑤/ pi pi ling / kha ru tsha9 / a ru nag chung rnams zhib par btags la lga'i khu bas ril bu sgyu ru ra tsam byas la gong du btang krun glo nad kun dang pho bar rlung zhugs pa khrag skran rus tshad/ dang 3kha 'gags pa rnams la phan/ phag brun bsregs ⑨pa'i thal ba bong bu'i gcin gyis khu ba byas nas sna la blugs pas ya ma klad gzer nya 7 la phan/ ka rañdza ba'i 'o mar btab pa'i khu ba khong du btang bas khog srin dang gzhang hwa/ srin kyi nad la phan/sha 'bras dang bye kar cha bsnyams skyopa zhib par btags la zho dang sbyar nas btang na tshad 'khru ⑫ chod par 'gyur ro/ /'gron bu bsregs pa'i thal ba mi'i 'o mar sbyar la rna bar blugs na rnag 'dzag pa chod do/ /dza mu ni zhib par btags pa chu la sbyar nas byugs na grang thor rgyab pa la phan/ skyu ru ra a rag gi nang du sbangs pa'i khya ba byugs na skra tshan che bar 'gyur ro/ /phur mong nag po sha'i srubs ④rnams la rdzongs ⑫na 'bu mi 'byung zhing shing kun dri mas kyang thub bo/ /a ru ra/ pi pi ling / kha ru tsha 1nyagasum cha mnyam zhib par btags la chu skol gyis rta byas btang na pho ba dang rked pa na bar phan/ ku ṭa ki hong len cha gnyis/ pho ris cha gcig /tshwa cha phyed rnams zhib par btags 120—773

pa chur sbyar te byugs na so rtsa dam zhing brtan par 'gyur ro/ /la la phud mer bsregs pa'i du ba kha la btang na so srin na ba la phan/ pa ṭa ki ṭi i'i ①'bru'i du ba 'then pas so srin la phan/ rgun 'brum da'ikhadakar po mkhris pa dang lce skam pa la phan/ ma nu khrag can gyi nang gi khrag rkang lag gi ser kar byugs kyang phan zhing spos dkar gyi phye ma btab kyang phan no/ /bil ba'i nang gi 'bru / ma dzu pha la/ bee gsum cha mnyam sbrang rtsir sbyar ba btang na khrag 'grim pa'i rigs chod do/ /mtshal/ ldong 1 ros/ dngul chu/ shu dag dkar po/ /btsan dug /mu zi ser po rnams cha mnyam/ pho ris nyis 'gyur bcas zhag brgyad tsam gyi bar zhib par btags la 'bras tsam re rgyun du bsten na lus stobs rgyas/ dang ④kha 'byed/ drod che/ rlung rnams 'joms so/ /bu kar myu la/ shu dag /pho ris/ kha ru tsha/ mtshal thu/li shi/ dzā ti⑥/ a ru ra rnams zhib par btags te ba mar dang sbyar nas skyu ru ra tsam re khong du btang na rlung khrag bad kan sogs 'dus pa'i nad kyis pho long gi yul zug gzer ⑦che ba rnams 'joms shing phan la sman bsten chering la 'o ma/ 'bras pag thug rnams las gzhan mi za'o/ /ka ma la ḍo ḍa'i che chung ril ma las che tsam mdog sgrug snum phreng ba byed pa de yin dkyil gyi ljang gu de bzhi lnga re nyin ltar gyis zos na bad rlung mgo 'khor dang mig mi gsal ba la phan no/ /dngul chu/so ma la kha ra/ mu zi ser po/ zi ra dkar po rnams cha mnyam phye mar byas pa lugs kong nang du blug ste kha dam par bcad la rlung mi 'chor 17bar byas/de steng ras dang 'jim pas lan gsum gyi bar du sgril la me nyor kyi nang du zhag bdun gyi ring bzhag /de nas sa dong brus la me shin tu tsha pas nyin phyed kyi 120—774

bar bsregs la grang ba dang bton gyete jiṅga rā dza' khu ba sbyar te lus la bsku mnye ⑤byas na kong po dang za 'phrug shu thor sogs la phan no/ /ka ye pa la'irakta na dze ti yang zer pags ①pa dang bye kar cha mnyam btags la btang na dwangs ma tsha grang gis 'dzags kyang phan par 'gyur ro/ /yang ka ye pha la'i pags pa dang rgya gar stod ja gnyis cha mnyam zhib par btags pa gri khye sogs rma gsar rnying gang la 'ang btab ste ras kyis bsdams la zhag gsum gyi ring kha ma phye bar bzhag des phan nges so/ /'bras dang shu ba gang la thuyang thog mar sa bhu ṇa'i glangaklad khu bas shin tu dag par bkrus/ de nas — la tho tha'i phye ma btab la nyin gcig bzhag /nyin phyi ma bee la tho tha dang spos dkar cha mnyam zhib par btags pa nyil gyi snum dang bsres te cung zad nyed/ de nas chu cung zad re blugs pa dang lhan du nyin phyed tsam gye bar du nyes pas mdog shin tu dkar ba zhig 'ong bye la de byugs pas myur du phan no/ /gnyan 'bur gyis skrangs par ba'i gci ba dang snum bsres pa'i skyo ma drod ma yal ba skrangs pa spyogang yin la byugs/ de ras kyis bsdams grang ba ⑦dang yang brje ba sogs byas pas myur du rnag tu smin par nus shing smin pa de brtol ba la lda ser mer bsregs pa chur brdar la gang brtol sar bug che chung ji ltar 'dod kyi rgyar yang yang byug pas myur du rdol 'ong ngo spra tshil bzhu ste phyaras la btsags/ de steng ba mar btsags ⑨bcad pa blug ste dkrugs pas legs par 'dres pa mchu dang rkang lag gas par byugs na 'phral du phan no/ /tshigs pa drug pa'i phan tshun du sor bzhi re gzhal sar rtsa hrang nge ba yod pa de'i nang 'debs su me btsa' bzhag pas rlung khrag gis mgo bo na ba dang rtsa dkar la phan/ tshigs pa bco brgyad pa'i g.yas g.yon du sor gsum 120—775

re gzhal ba'i sa dang bco brgyad rang gi steng ste gsum du me btsa' re bzhag pas rlung / grang ba/ rked pa na ba/ mkhal rtsa bral ba rnams la phan/ tshigs pa lnga pa drug pa bdun pa gsum dang mdun gyi dkar nag mtshams su me btsa' re bzhag pas khrag gis brang tsha ba dang stod na ba sogs la phan zhing stod 'tshangs la de steng rke stong bya ra khung du'ang gcig bzhag pas phan no/ /steng steng rtse dbus su bzhag pa'i rgya gram sor gsum bsregs pas mkhris pa bad kan mchin skran rlung rnams la phan/ rke stong bya ra khung du me sgor mo a long lta bu bzhag na khrag skyugs tshopa dang khrag rlung la phan/ me nyams gsang gi g.yas g.yon mtshon re gzhal ba'i sar tshugs re bzhag pas rlung khrag dang khrag skran la phan/ pus ②mor tshigs chu 'khor na gre long ru bzhir tshugs re bzhag pas khrag rlung chu ser sogs sel zhing khyad par rkyang bskum snye mi thub pa la phan/ zas 'grangs ltogs ༄ma snyoms pa'i po ma 'ju glang thabs la mthil bzhir beegs leb me la dmar por song ba bsregs pa'i 'od ma reg tsam dang ras kyis dar ba 'byug bye pa res 'jog tu byas pas dri shin tu ngan pa zhig don yong zhing de nas myur du phan par 'gyur ro/ /nywa log 'khru skyugs kyi nad la zhag bzhi tshun du lag pa'i mkhrig ma gnyis sam de 'og bsgrad mkhyid gang gis/ dpung 'og gi nywa gnyis sog ⑦ pa'i mthil gnyis/ brla'i nang gi nywa kyeganyis/ phyin dkyil kyi nywa kluganyis rnams la lcags mda' sor gsum pa zhig gis ser mdog thon tsam bsregs pas phan zhing tshan che na ltag khung spu 'khyel gyi thad kyi ltag pa'i chu leb gnyis dang rkang mthil gnyis bsregs na des phan nges so/ /sngar spyod kyi skyon yon rnam pa gzhan du 'gyur ba dang lus kyi gzi mdangs bzang ba ngan pa dang ngan pa bzang 120—776

bar 'gyur ba byung na klu gdon gyi nad zhugs pa'i rtags 1yin pas sor mo nyi shu'i sen snying gi mtshams dang skra mtshams su 'phred la sor lnga ser mdog thon tsam bsregs pas de'i nad sel lo/ /rdo thal chu la sbyangs pa dang so phag rnying pa bsregs pa'i khu ba gnyis gang rung gi gdus du thang btang bas nywa log 'khru sgyugs kyi skyug pa sogs sgyug pa'i rigs mtha' dag chod do / myu/ /rngushrī ga ṇa shā ya na maḥ dpal tshogs kyi dbang phyug gi gdams pa/ phyogs gang du 'gro yang lam du nad gdon gnod pa sogs nyer 'tshe gang yang mi 'byung zhing / bya ba gang dang gang yin pa de bde blag tu 'grub pa dang / zas gos gnas mal sogs 'bad med du 'byung bar 'dod na/ oṃ sthā kau/ dmā pongu/ /hūṃ hūṃ/zhes pa 'di thog mar yan lag lnga khrus byas/ gu gul sogs spos kyi dud pa sngags bzla ba'i bar rgyun ma chad pa dang bcas zhag nyer gcig gi ring nyin rer brgya rtsa re ma chag par bzla ba bsnyen pa dang / de nas las spyor nye ring gang du 'gro ba'i dus tshar bdun re'am tha na'ang tshar re bzlas nas phyin na gong du smos pa ltar gnod pa med cing bsam pa thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ba sogs yon tan bsam las 'das pa 'byung nges so/ /na masmra ra ste/ 'phags ma dbyangs can ma'i bden tshig gi sngags/ ye ye/ sa paṃ/ bye yā bi duḥ ma haṃ sthā/ bā ge shwa rī/ shrī ma hi ta no shatta/ pra tso da ya ta/ ces pa 'di gza' mig dmar gyi res dang gnam gang nam byung la dri bzang po'i dud pa dang bcas tshar bdun re bzlas na bsam pa'i re ba thams cad 'grub par 'gyur zhing / khyad par blo rno ba dang shes rab che bar 'gyur ro / /⑤oṃ ā de sha gu ru sa ha ra kā ba ru/ kā mi kṣu de bī/ ta ha bā sha/ a dza rpā rā ṇi/ a dza 120—777

rpā rā ddhā ke pu tra/ sā ta ko na ko na/ tā ba bsgo/ tī dzā ri bsgo/ e rmā ta ra bsgo/ be haṃ ka rā brjo/ na dī brjo/ nā la brjo/ nā le kā ka nā rā badhehūṃ / /i sa gha ṭa/ paṇḍi ra ha to/ a dza rpā rā byā/ lā dza me ri bha spyu/ku ru ki shatta/ a dze pā la yo gi la dze phu ro/ mant+ra yī shwa rī bā tsā/ zhes pa'i sngags khye'adi lan bdun bzlas te nas la phu btab/ tshad pa'i rims nyin gcig pa/ gnyis pa/ gsum pa/ bzhi pa rnams gcig ⑦la phyi ma phan/ ④pa'i tshad rims rnams kyis na bar/ zla bo zhig gis thog mar nad pa'i mgo bo ras kyis bsdams te bzung la rang gis sngags 'dren zhing phus btab pa'i nas des mgo bo brab/ de nas nad par nad ga na 'dug dris la mgo bo phan na skye/de nas stod/ sked pa sogs rim bzhin ras kyis bsdams pa spo zhing nas kyis brab pas mthar rkang pa'i mtheb mo'i bar byas pas nges par phan par 'gyur zhing slar yang mi 'byung ba'i ched du srad bur mdud pa bdun/ mdud pa rer sngags tshar re bzlas thupa'i phus btab pa rke rngol btags so/ /shin tu zab/grong dang grong rdal ④ gang la'ang mi phyugs kyi rims bsrung bar 'dod na thog mar lcags kyi gzer sor bzhi pa gzer mgo can bzhi/ de'i gdan gro gar chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs bris pa bzhi/ bya pho nag po gcig /chang bum pa gang / nas/ gro/ sran chung ma/ sran ma/ 'bras/ pad kha/bra'o / /gzhan 'bru sna gang 'dzom tshon pa re rnams sta gon byas/ tho rengs shin tu snga bar rang gi mchan khung g.yon du bya pho kha phyir bstan la bcug /lcags gzer dang dril bu lag g.yon gyis 'khrol zhing bzung khye/ lag g.yas kyis 'bru sna 'thor zhing ngag bsdams la 'og nas 'byung ba'i sngags 'dren/ zla 120—778

bo zhig la chang bum bskur la des ku sha lta bus rang gang 'gro'i rjes la chang 'thor zhing yong / thog ma grong khyer gyi shar du slebs pa dang grogs ①chos 'byung gi re khā can sar bzhag /de steng 'bru sna cung zad blug cing chang gtor te chos 'byung gi dkyil du lcags gzer ②'debs shing sngags tshar gcig 'don pa slar yang 'bru sna dang chang cung zad blugs nas bzhag /de nas lho/ nub rnams rim par gzer 'debs lugs sogs gong ltar byas rjes byang du sleb ①pa dang gzer chos 'byung gi steng du nyal stabs su bzhag la sngags 'dren zhing 'bru sna dang chang blug /sngags tshar gcig song ba dang / gro ga /gzer/'bru sna'i lhag /chang dang bcas khyer la lung stong mi med sa zhig tu phyin la bya pho kha phyir bstan la slong / de rjes su chang dang 'bru sna'i lhag pho la khyim du log /thog ma khyem nas thon nas nang du ma sleb bar ngag dang phyir mig ma shor ba gal che zhing / nad log pa byung na slar yang 'dab bo/ /'dis ni mi phyugs gang gi yang rims sogs 'gos nad kyi rigs bsrung ba mi thub pa mi srid pa rjoshin tu zab po/ /sngags ni/ o a saṃ ku bu tra bradmā ki wa tsa bī tsa ḍi/ nā ba ni ram̐ ta rabha ye/ rāsna bā ḍi kā ra na ka re ni ta ṣā dza la ga be/ a tsa la dī khre sta ba na mi khre ba ma ba na/ pha la to ḍa ṣa i/ i ka ḍa bī ka ṭi tsa ḍa ṣa ye/ tso ta tse ta ri de byā bi ra ha na ba tā ā ye/ me rī sa ka ta/ gu ru tī bhatta phu ro masgo yī swa rī bā tsā ka ṭa si re tī pā pi ḍa ⑤ga dza ma tī na ko hā ra pa tyā ni gā lī pa tyā ṭi lo ka ki ya/ dza har lo ka kā ko ṭa sa sum̐ dra ki ṣā yī bhā ga bha ga si ka nī ḍa rjoka ni na bha ga ta ba bī ra ha na baṃ ta shī do hā yī/ zhes pa'o / /(pedagra jag rkun ma sogs kyis glags 'ami rnyed pa'i thabs ni/ oṃ na mo brahma yī sa ri ra rakṣa ṭha ṭha/120—779

ca 'khor lo 'di gro ga la gur gum gyis bris/ gu gul gyi dud pas bdugs srad bu sna lngas bcings te mgul par btags na dug ①rigs thams cad thub nges so//nyi 〈sde 〉〈snar 〉〉 〈pe〉༈ 'khor lo 'di gro gar dri brgyud kyis bris la/ mgul la btags na 'byung po dang yi dwags gang gis kyang gnod pa mi 'byung ngo //wa ge— ཿ pho ba'i skran gyis na ba la/ gang na ba'i thad der 'be ta chus bkang ba bzung / de steng du 'khor lo 'di shog bur bris pa mes bsregs/ thal ba chu nang du 'bab pa byas/ chu de phyir pho/ de ltar nad ma drag par byas pas skran nad thon nges so//120—781

gyis tshar lnga bris te bsrung bya de'i zur bzhi dang / dbus su re re sbas na byi ba gnas gzhan du 'gro zhing / 'khor lo sbas pa'i nang tshun la gnod pa mi 'byung nges pa yang dag pa'o// / ya ma sogs mgo bo phyed na ba la 'khor lo 'di gza' nyi ma yod pa'i nyin gro gar dri brgyad kyis bris te skud pas bcings la mgo bor btags na myur du nad de las grol bar 'gyur ro// ༈ 'khor lo 'di tā la'i lo mar dri brgyad kyis bris la khrom gyi gang 'dug sa'i gdan lta bu'i 'og mnan na tshong gang 'dod pa de thogs med 'ong ①zhing rang rgyal bar 'gyur ro//〈pe 〉〉〈sde 〉〉 〈snar 〉〉༈ bza' mi rgyun du mi 'cham par 'thab mo khon rgyag par/ 'khor lo 'di gro gar gi haṃ dang gur gum gyis bris la srad bus bcings te skyes pa'i lag pa g.yon dang / bud med kyi lag pa g.yas la btags na 'khrug pa med par shin 120wa 783

ma ldog na 'khor lo 'di shog bur bris la nyin bdun gyi bar nyin re bzhin 'khor lo re gang du song ba'i lam der 'phangs na nges par myur du 'ong ①bar 'gyur ro//sgo/ma༈ sbrum ma btsa' ma thub par 'khor lo 'di li sder la bris/ de thog mar bud med kyi mig la bstan/ de nas snum gyis 'khor lo bkrus te pho bar byugs na myur du btsa' bar 'gyur ro//17 /pe rwa/〈sde )〉 〈 〉〈snar 〉 rardo )/ rdo //zherten / rten pha 84 zur3 7 3༈ 'khor lo 'di gza' nyi ma'i nyin snag tshas shog bur bris la skud pas bcings te mgul la btags na rtsa dkar gyi nad thams cad la phan zhing khyad par yan lag dang ske rengs pa dang / 'dar ba dang / skam pa rnams la nges par phan no//〈pe //〈sde 〉〉〈snar 〉1 khrag skyugs nas ma chod na/ nad pa'i lag pa g.yon gyi mthil du 120—785

'khor lo 'di bris/ de'i dbus su so ma ra tsa thun tshad chung phyogs tsam zhig bzhag /de la sngags ni/ oṃ hri/ hūṃ ldu swā hā/ zhes pa 'di brgya rtsa gcig bzlas la phus btab ste nad pa'i khong du btang na myur du chad nges so//〈rdosardo /〉 〈pe 〉〉| mi phyugs gang gi yang chu sris nas na ba la 'khor lo 'di snod gang rigs la snag tshas bris/ sma ru mgo nag dkar po mi la gcig dang / phyugs la gnyis chu dang mnyam du brdar ba'i khu bas 'khor lo bkrus/ de khong du btang bas myur du phebs par 'gyur ro// ca nad pa tshad rlung 'thab pa sogs kha nas gang lab med pa byed pa sngangs ①sogs smyon pa lta bu 'chol zhing mtshan mo gnyid mi khugs pa sogs la/grong bdun nas sol ba rdog po bdun gzhan gyis ma mthong ba byas la bslang ②/phyogs gang rigs nas rde'u bdun sgrugs te lam rgya gram yod pa'i 'dzom ③du rde'u re la sol rdog res gong gi 'khor lo zur gsum pa de 'dra re bris/ shar nas brtsams te phyogs bzhir rde'u re bor/ rde'u gnyis lam rgya gram gyi dbus der sbas / gcig khyer te nad pa'i sngas 'og tu sbas na sems dran pa zin zhing gnyid kyang khug /nga)par 'gyur ro/ /gong gi de dag byed skabs mis ma mthong 120—— 786

ba gal che'o// (sde// na nare/ rdordordor sa re 〈pe / ra sa༈ mi nad cher med cing lus kyi zungs rims kyis zad pa'i 'chi la thug pa lta bu'i gcong gis zin zhing / sman pas kyang nad gang yin ngos mi zin pas bcos ka gang byas kyang mi phan na/ de ni bzang ngan gang rung gi mi kha phog pa'i nad yin pas de'i ②bcos la/ 'khor lo 'di ④shog bur tshar gnyis dang li sder lta bu'i ngos su tshar gcig bris/ shog bur bris pa gcig pa gcig khang pa'i phyi'i sa gang 'os su me la bsregs/ gcig nad pa'i mgul du btags/li sder la bris pa de chus bkrus te khu ba khong du btang / de nas rkang lag gi sor mo bcu'i sen mo dang / spyi bo'i gtsug tu lcags tshugs re bzhag pas nges par phan no//5sde 〈/pe / 〈snabyed ༈ skyes pa'i sgo ba skrangs pa /7dang / mi phyugs gang gi bu snod lugs shepa la 'khor lo 'di lag mthil gnyis la bris/ lham ⑥gang rung gi mthil me la bsregs pa'i thal ba dang snum bsres pa lag mthil du phur te sgo ba'am bu snod 120—787

gang yin la rag la cung zad btsir bcir byas pas phan par 'gyur ro//(nga sang /ste/ byenge /khye/ ca/rdo /chen /rig/rje/ /rnge/ 13 /(1 kau ga la sha ra ① nad bas ba byung na ra ma la du 'a ra lo 'di snag tshas bris de'i nang du chu blug /de la nad pa bltar ②bcug /them mi gcig pa bdun nas nas kyi sogs ma rkad re bslangasal/ rim bzhin sog ④ma re la me sbar te nad pa'i mgo bor lan gsum re bskor ⑤te chu nang du skyur bas chu'i mdog snum lta bur 'gyur 'gro zhing nad de phan par 'gyur ro//〈pe /no//rje ཿ/lnga/ /ji/ / (1 /)(1 /jishe༈ lam bzang ngan sna gas mang du sa na/ 'a ra 'a gza' nyi ma'i nyin gro ga la dri brgyad kyis bris te rked ⑦par btags na rmi lam sna tshogs rmi bar mi 'gyur ro/ ༈ /oṃ na mo ā de sha ya gu ru kum pa wa ni duru pi/ añdza ni / dzā yo pu ta ha na wanta/ dri'/ mu ṭha/ tatha/ tī dzā ri/ e kānta rā / be taṅga rā/ ḍa wa ru/ dzā nī dzā gha bā la/ ne kā la/ e te u/pa ra ka ri/ ta kha/ dza la/ ba la/ bha'i bhu ta/ me ri bhakta/ gu ru ki shasti / phu ra mant+ra/ pha ṭu swā hā/ rkang lag sogs gnyan nad kyis spangs 'bur gyis na bar sngags 'di tshar nyer gcig bzlas la phus btab cing /ste///| 1rdordo /|/ 1de/ snye/rdo /ninge /rje/rma bya ma ngas sa byabs/ sa bal skud rkang bdun ga ga tu la bar 120—788

mdud pa bdun byas mdud pa re sngags tshar re btab ste nad pa'i mgul du ①btags na myur du nad de las grol bar 'gyur ro/ ༈ /o na mo ā de sha gu ru ko/si nā pū ra parba ta/ ta hā ba se/ dho dzñā rā tī/ rā ka shā tī ke/ tsā ra su tra te/ ko na ko na/ anda su la/ dza la su la/ rākta su la/ bā yu su la/e te u pa ra/ ka re ta wa/ dza la/ ba la/ me ②ri bhakta/ gu ru kyi shasti/phu ro mant+ra/ pha ṭu swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags 'di la la phud mang nyung cha lnga la tshwa cha gcig tsam bsres par btab pa khog par btang / de rjes chu skol hub gang tsam 'thungs bcug na/ srin nad/ glang thabs/ ma 'ju ba/ zas phog byung ba sogs pho ba'i nad glo ①bur ba phral du phan par 'gyur ro//〈sde 〉〉 〈pe 〉 〈snar 〉〉༈ 'khor lo 'di gza' nyi ma'i res la gro gar lga ser gyis bris/ oṃ na mo ā de sha gu ru ko gaṅga / ya mu nā/ sā dha sa ti/ gi tsa rā khe/ gau bya'o kha ṣa dza ti na a we/⑤ mu kha/ na pā ke/ ṣā re/ lā la/ go khā la ki/ bā tsa phu rī/ me ri bhakta/gu ru tī sha sti/ phu ro mantakwa/ pha ṭu swā hā/ zhes pa 'di lan bdun bzlas la 'khor lor phus btab ste phyugs ra'i dbus su sbas na kha tsha gor sogs phyugs nad thams cad thub/ de yang nad ma byung gong du byas na bsrung thub/ phyugs ⑦nad byung nas byas na de zhi zhing slar 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ ༈ /oṃ dzha swā hā/120—789

shrī yo lasmri na rā ya ṇa mant+ra/ sa ha ra kā wa ru/ ka mi ghra de wi/ te ti sa ko ṭa de wa tā / ba sunta rī/ marte mā sa ṣpe/ ru ṣe/ bṛ ṣi/ hā ḍi/ bā ḍi/ e te rakṣu ka ra bhā/ṣpe na yo gi bhā tī do hā i/ ke hu ka ho/ a ro/ /sī ka ho/ ba ro sbo ka ho/ pi sha la he/ bi sa wa la ho/ ṭo na ho/ ṭā ma ṇa ho/ yī ṭha ho/ dī ṭha ho/ mu ṭha/ e ti rakṣu ka ra ṇi/ ṣpe nā yo ge nā tī do 3spyo/ zhes pa'i sngags 'di skud pa nag po la mdud pa bdun btab pa la bsngags khute ske la btags na mi kha'i rigs thams cad dang / mtshan mo gnyid la har lang dred langs sogs la phan nges so/ myu/ /kā tsa ka ḍa wa/ bha re a/ ka pu ra/ rakṣu bā bā a da ma hā dzu ra/ bā bā ā da ma ki tshu rī/ pha ra dzanta kā bā na/ me ri mu kā i/ nā mu ka sa/ ta ba gu ru/ go ra ṣa tī do hā yī/ la ma kā kā ko ṭa/ sa mu dra tī khā i/ phru ṭa pha ṭa na phru ṭa sa ta ba rā dza rā ma tsand+ra kyo 1do hā i/ phu ro mant+ra yī shwa rī bā tsa/ sngags 'di ba lang gi gci ba'i thal bar bsngags la skrangs pa pyagang yod sar byugs na gnyan 'bur mtha' dag la phan zhing khyad par rke na khrub la mchog tu phan no/ myu/ /oṃ ga dzanta/ gho ra ta / a wa ra/ tsha ra tshi du/ u tā ra ta a wa tā ha ya / na wa nā ri/ bā ha tra/ko bye/ su ṣa pa ra ta/ ā wa ta ya/ kā 5ha te ā wa ta ha ya/ ga bye ga ya mbi te/ā ba ta ha ya/ kā wa ru ko/ ko ta wa la/ de li ko pā/ tā sā ha/ se ṣa se khā ra/ru ra ka ni ke pu ta/ ma ha ma dā/ bee ra mant+ra ba dha ta/ bā bye khu rā sā na bhe bye/ bhu ta bārnyi/ bye ta bārnyi/ de wa bārnyi/ dha no bārnyi/ ma ri ya ma sā na bārnyi/ kā la bee ro bārnyi / aṣṭa bye ra wa bārnyi/ lo ha ro/ ba ḍo nā setta sa bha bārnyi⑦/ pā na na phu la ko bārnyi / te la ta le ko bārnyi/ bhā ta du ⑤ta ko bārnyi/ ka ra ṇa ka ra ru ti ko bārnyi/ṣe ram̐ ṣe re kṣe tra pā la bārnyi/ a zo ta ra so ni nā i bārnyi/ bā tā su ma sā na bārnyi⑫ /120—790

te ra gya ka ru wa bārnyi/ tso ①ha gya bhersā su ra bārnyi/ saṃ ṣa ni/ ḍi ka ni bārnyi/ pa ta kṣa ni bārnyi/ be ga na bārnya to bā bā ①ā da ma ki do hā i/ bī bi phra ta mā ki do hā i/su wa ra mu ra dā ra/ bi bee pha ta ma ki dā pha na gi re/ na wa khā ṣa/ a se hā dzā ra/pi ra pe kasbra ra bā dhi ḍa ri/ a wa de kho ro/ ma hā ma dā pi ra te re mant+ra ki shatta/u ta ra ko u ta ra bārnyi/ dakṣa ṇa ko dakṣa ṇa bārnyi/ pabye ma ko pabye ma bārnyi/ pūrba ①ko pūrba bārnyi/ kā ṭha ki ro ḍi bārnyi/ phi re ma ha me dā rpā ra/ se ṣa si lā ra pa dha ta mant+ra—/ bā bye ḍā bī me ri bāste/ gu ru tī shatta phu ro mant+ra i shā rī bā tsa/ sor mo'i nad dang lba ba la sngags 'di su dhihrug dmar por bris shing / 'bras zan dang 'o mar yang btab ste/ de nas lba ba dang sor mo gang yin la su ⑤hrug des dkri sa 'o ma dang 'bras zan bsres pa des brab na phan no/ ༈ /oṃ na mo ā de sha gu ru rku/oṃ kā ra binda dhisakta/ ni ryadhya yarnyi yo ge shwa re/ kā ma raḥ mo kṣa daste wa/ oṃ kā rā ya na mo na maḥ na ma ste ṛ ṣa ya de wā na ma ste tsa su ra ga rja/ na rā nā ma phya/de wa su na dukā rā ya na mo nā maḥ ma hā de wa/ ma hā ta mā ni/ ma hā yo gi ma te shwa ra/ ma hā pa ta ka /ha re de wa ma kā rā ya na mo na maḥ shi wa sārghaṃ dza gand+ra rja/lo kā dzñā shārnyi ka ra khaṃ/ shi ba me ka pa re de waṃ/ sha kā rā ya na mo na maḥ bā ha rna bri ṣa bhabye wa bā su ki kaṣṭha bhu sha rna/ bā ma shatta dha ro de waṃ/ ba kā rā ya sken mo na maḥ ya tra ta tra/ tra ya de wā bhra dmā bistu/ ma te shwa re/ ya ga ta kā ra tā/ dza gand+ra baṃ ya kā rā ya na mo na maḥ oṃ kā re mu la tsakra/ na kā re nā bhi maṇḍa le/ ma kā re z-i da ya stha na sa kā re/ kaṇḍa me wa tsa/ ba kā re ba kra stha la/ ya kā re pu dzo ti ya ga traḥ zhes pa yi ge drug la brten pa'i sngags 'di stan bde ba la 'dug ste rang gis rgyun du bzlas na lus kyi nad thams cad la phan zhing / khyad par rlung mkhris 120—791

gang yin la phus btab pas myur du phan par 'gyur ro/ ༈ /'khor lo 'di gza' nyi ma'i nyin gro gar dri brgyad kyis bris la sker btags/ tshad rims ma byung ba la 'byung bar mi 'gyur zhing / byung ba la yang myur du drag par 'gyur ro//〈sde 〉〉 〈pe 〉〉 〈snar 〉〉/ mes tshig pa la/ oṃ ma tī ṣa/ bā sa ni/ ma hā bibya①/ dzambha ya/mo ha ya/ u tshe da ya/ ā ghi/ st+waṃ bha ya/ ṭhaḥṭhaḥ zhes pa 'di gang mang bzlas la phus btab/ 'byor na til phye ②mar btags pa 'o ma dang sbyar nas byugs pas myur du phan par 'gyur zhing / til ma 'byor kyang sngags kho nas zug gzer ②drag par 'gyur ro/ /mi phyugs gang yin kyang chur shor nas khog pa chus gang ste 'chi bar thug pa la/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ ru drwa ya dza lo st+waṃ bha ya/ṭhaḥṭhaḥ zhes pa 'di gang mang bzlas la rkang pa nas yar phus btab na 'phral du skyug par 'gyur zhing chu nad kyis duzin pa la sngags 'di bzlas la rma bya'i sgro la bsngags ⑤te mgo bo nas mar byabs pas phan par 'gyur ro/ ༈ /'khor lo 'di shog bur rgyal dang phur bu 'dzom 0pa'i nyin bris/ tsan dan dkar po/ /gla rtsi/ gur gum/ gsum byugs/ tshon ④skud sna lngas bcings la sker btags na tshe ring ba/ nad med pa/ longs spyod 'phel ba gzhan gyi yid du 'ong ba la sogs pa yon tan dpag tu med cing / khyad par rang la brnag 0pa'i dgra gang yin pa de dbang du 'du bar 'gyur ro//120—793

༵—sder rdoca rar 〈pe/〉 — ཿlnga/ gshin 'dre'i gnod pa la/ 'khor lo 'di gshin 'dre de'i 'chi sa gang yin gyi sa rtsad chod na de dang / bsrung bya gang yin de'i phyi sgo la sispyo ra'i khu bas bris na khyem de'i mi nor gang la'ang gnod pa mi 'byung nges dag pa'o//rngu/ pho mo gang la'ang 'dra ste zha 'og skrangs ①nas na ba la/ oṃ re tsho ram̐ ram̐ oṃ ram̐ tsho ram̐ oṃ/ zhes pa'i sngags yig 'bru bcu pa 'di gci ba'i thal bar bsngags thute byugs na myur du phan par 'gyur ro/ myu/ /rkang lag gi tshigs chen sogs rus pa na zhing khyug la gzer na/ badzre tī ྾ bi 1lo he kā ko ṣā/ i shwa ra ku tsi/ bradmā tā laḥ yī sa piṇḍa ha mā re pa ya ṭha/ i sha paṇḍi ku/ dza tī go ra ṣa rakṣa ba la/ zhes pa'i sngags 'di rma bya'i sgro mdongs la bsngags te lan bdun byabs na phan par 'gyur ro/ myu/ /khyi smyon gyi bcos la/ hā kā tse khā/bra sa kā/ gha ḍa ྾ lu/ sī ba ka ru/ la ka ḍi/ dī li pi le/ ka pa ḍi/li yā brahma kā/ dreṣa/ ltu haṃ/ tshoṇḍa dzwa/ ga phi ra mu kha kā de sa/ zhes pa'i sngags 'dis sbyin po'i 'dam bag lag gnyis kyis snol zhing sngags tshar gsum re bzlas nas phus btab la nad pa'i mgo bo nas rkang pa'i bar byabs/yang gong bzhin sngags bsgrangs la 'jim par phus btab nad par byabs/ de 'dra lan kha yar byas nas 'jim pa bcad la bltas pas khye dkar pos 'changs pa yin na khye spu dkar po dang / nag po yin na nag po sogs khye gang yin gyi mdog dang mthun pa'i khye spu 'byung la/ de yang khyi spu grangs bdun nam byung 120—794

bar bldabs ①nas bya/ bdun byung ba dang 'jim pa chur skyur bas nad de las nges par grol lo/ myu/ /so na ba la/ shog bur nad pa'i ming bris/ de ka ba'am gdung gi logs la sbyar/ lcags gzer sor gsum pa zhig ming yig gi steng du bzung la/ oṃ na mo ā de sha gu ru rku/ ha ḍi/ ku ha ḍi/ la ga ki ḍa/ a se bhaste ki/ basmyo pi ḍa/ ki ḍa dza re/ pi ḍa mā re/ sa ma ya la—/ dzo gi ki/ bā tsa/ me ri/ baktathu/ gu ru ki shatta/ phu ro mand+ra/oṃ na mo ā de sha/ zhes pa'i sngags 'di tshar re bzlas la lcags gzer la tho ba cung zad re brdeg /tshar bdun song ba dang sor do tsam gyi bar stem pas myur du phan cing / gzer ma bud bar slar yang na bar mi 'gyur ro//〈rdodzi ///) 〈pe 〉myu/ 'khor lo 'di gza' zla ba'i nyin gro gar gi haṃ dang gur gum gyes bris la / mgul du rngubatags na bkra shis shing bsam ④pa'i don thams cad 'grub bo//myu/ lha mo dbu mas dbang phyug la gsol pa/ 'jig rten kun gyi byed po dbang phyug che/ /kun la phan phyir 'chi med che'i bcud len/ /bskal pa bskal par rdo rje ltar gnas pa/ /nga yis 'dri yi khyod kyis bshad du gsol/ /zhes gsol pas dbang phyug gis bka' stsal pa/ nyon cig lha sras yid 'ong ma/ /kun phan 'chi med che'i bcud len/ /karko ṭi yi cho ga rnams/ /legs par bstan gyis yid la zung ⑤/ /de la karkoṭi yod sar phyin gza' nyi ma yod pa'i dus la 120—795

lus legs par bkrus te/ oṃ na mo ma he sho ri sidhi shwa ra ①brnya brnya hu hu phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags 'di bzla ④zhing rtsa rtse ma lus pa brkos snete gtsang sar grib bskam bubya/ bskams pa dang zhib par btags pa se ba bzhi tsam ba'i 'o ma dang sbrang rtsir sbyar/ nang 'gol sar mtshams bcad/ 'bras btsos pa dang ba'i 'o ma cung zad re las gzhan za btung gi rigs mi byed cing khyad par tshwa ma shor ba gal che zhing tho rengs thang re gtong ba zla ba drug gi bar bsten pas zla ba bzhi song ba dang / skra/ kha spu/ ba spu sogs/ lus kyi sru thams cad byi 'gro zhing / de nas zla ba phyed gnyis tshun la skra dang kha spu sogs gsar pa shin tu legs pa skyel/ skyes pa dang zla ba phyed gnyis kyi ⑤bar karko ṭa'i rjo'abru kho na zhib par btags pa thun tshad gong bzhin sbrang rtsi dang bsres pa zos pas lus yang ba dang / gzi brjid che ba dang / sems bde ba dang / nad med pa sogs 'byung zhing / bya rog gnyis kyi tshe tshad ste lo stong gnas par 'gyur ro—/ /de nas zla ba gnyis dang zhag nyi shu'i bar 'bras bu mar dang bsres pa bsten ⑦pas bya rog gnyis kyi tshe tshad ste lo nyis stong thub cing nyis stong du slebs pa dang gnyid du song ba lta bu'i lus sems ma bral kyang smra brjod sogs mi thub pa zhig 'ong skebs karko ṭa'i 'bru dang dngul chu/ mu zi ser po gsum cha mnyam bhriṅga rā ⑨dza' khya bas rta byas nas gtong lugs slob ma lta bur bslabs la bzhag /de nas dran pa rnyed pa dang de ga'i mu 'thud la lo gcig gi bar zos pas lo bzhi stong thub cing / de nas kyang mu 'thud du zos pas chu la mi 'bying /mkha' la bya ltar 'phur ba dang / lus la me chu mtshon la sogs pas mi thags ⑩te—/ de ni lus rdo rje dang 'dra ba'o/ /kye rigs sras lha mo/ /'di'i nus 120—796

pa dang phan yon ni tshul bzhin du ngas kyang brjod par mi nus mod/ 'on kyang cho ga sogs rags pa tsam zhig bstan zin gyis snying dang 'dra bar chongs la 'gro ba'i don gyis shig ces gdams so///(1 711 :delnga// /rdo/ /bye/31( /sdigo 1(1'a ra 'a ga 'am ga bu la ba mas sa la srad bu dkar sa /ce) /rten 1)rdo //bye /)spro /rdo/rdo 1(sneb ngas btags na nad mas thams cad thub nga da la 'a da pa 'grub / /()(khedakri'on/bo ces :de :re 61 dres khrage theg mtho rdoge ca 'a ra 'a tā 47la ma'am ga la mu ra sa sa la btags na shin tu mgyogs pas rkang pa na bar mi 'gyur ro//ri kau tsakra 'di gro ga la gi haṃ gis bris la srad bu dkar pos bcings te btags na rgyal po dang blon po dbang du 'gyur ro//120—797

ling cha mnyam pa zhib par btags pa bod kyi thun tshad gsum tsam re khong du btang bas khrag chod cing nad kyang phan no/ /zhum bu'i lce grib skam byas la zhib par btags la se ba bcu drug tsam re btang na ma'i khong nas smra mi shes pa'i lkugs pa kha 'bye bar 'gyur zhing dbang po yang gsal bar 'gyur ro/ /zhum bu'i khrag ma rul ba grib bskam byas te ①zhib par btags la mig la btab na sha 'dzer ling tog sogs mig nad mtha' dag la phan no/ /mgo bo sman gang btang kyang mi phan par na ba la ①zhum bu'i pags pa'i zhwa gyon na phan par 'gyur ro—/ /skra dang rgya kha spu sogs med par 'dod na thog mar legs par bzhar/de nas pha wang gi klad pas bsku mnye thengs ①gsum tsam re byas na phyis nas skye bar mi 'gyur ro/ /pha wang gi phrug gu'i ro ma me la bsregs pa'i thal ba mig la byugs na/ steng 'grib/ bar 'grib/ sha 'dzer/ ling tog /skrangs pa sogs mig nad mtha' dag la phan no/ /sbrul gyi khrag dang byi ba'i khrag bsres pa sna mdog dmar por 'gyur zhing za phrug gis na ba la ④byugs na myur du phan par 'gyur ro/ /bud med sbrum ma btsa' ma thub pa dang bu ro ma thon par sbrul gyi klad pa mo mtshan gyi nang du byugs na myur du thon par 'gyur ro/ /sbrul gyi pags pa mer bsregs pa'i thal bas mig dmar por song zhing na ba la 0phan no//rnga mong gi klad pa se ba bcu drug tsam re khong du btang na rlung gi nad mtha' dag la phan zhing mig shed duchung ba'ang che bar 'gyur ro/ /rnga mong gi spu mer bsregs pa'i thal ba sna bug gi nang du phus btab na sna khrag ma chod pa myur du chod par 'gyur ro/ /gos dar bsregs pa'i thal ba snar btab kyang nus pa gong dang 'dra/ yang na chu ba la sngon po spyi bor bkab kyang chod do/ /yang chu 120—800

bal dang shing kun mnyam du btags la chur sbyar ba'i skyo ma mer bsros ①pa'i dron mo so gang na sar byugs na phral du phan par 'gyur ro/ /ni la ka wang gi rtsa ba—/ lo ma/ rkang rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags pa cha gcig /shing kun dang snum cha bzhi bsres pa lte bar byugs na sbos khrog rlung gi rigs mtha' dag la phan/ phur mong ka ra dang bsres nas khong du btang na mkhris nad la phanaske/ su ṇa ṇa ba 'am/ sa kra/ ghaṇḍa pu ṇa zhes ming gi rnam grangs/ra'i ④mar dang sbyar na mig gi ling tog la phan/ sbrang dang sbyar na mchi ma 'dzag pa la phan/ til snum dang sbyar na mig gi za phrug la phan/ chu dang sbyar na mig gi mthong snang skar ma 'dra ba la phan no④/ /zho'i chu dang sbyar na srod long la phan/ zha nye'i brag gcig kyang khong par btang na bcud len gyi mchog zhun mdog dkar ba 'o ma 'dra ba mchog /gzhan brag zhun gyi rigs gang byung yang de'i khu bas yan lag la sogs mtha' dag la phan no/ /zi ra dkar po/ /yung ba zho bzhi—/ mudha sang ste lo phaṭa ki zho re/ gla sgang a phim pho ris rnams rim pas cha bskyung rjo/ de rnams thang tsam brdungs/ grang 'thag ④mig la bdugs pas tsha ba dang / mig chu 'dzag pa dang / dmar por song ba la phan/ shi la dzu yi kharnya gdus rjopa'i thang / /khong ⑦du btang bas yan lag rtsa 'dar rnams—/ /bhi kha snum la btsos pas phyi la byugs/ /phyi nang ltag sprad ④byas pas nges par phan/ /mgo dang yan lag rus chag la sogs dang / /rtsa rgyus 'khum ⑫chad gsar rnying rma rigs la/ /shi la dza dhu gdus ⑩pa'i thang de ni/ /phyi la byugs dang khong du btang ba yis/ /de rnams kun la phan pa pyong bas grub⑫//shi la dza byu gdus ⑫pa thang du btang / /bu btsas sked pa na dang pho na 'joms//120—801

dug nyung phag brun sbre ro byunganarab ma nyid brun/ /cha mnyam nus ldan bsregs ①pa snum dang sbyar/ /khong btang phyi la byugs pas zha grum ②nad/ /gsar rnying kun la btang bas 'joms par nges/ /glang chen phyi ba'i dud pa mngal na btang / /bu dang sha ma phral du thon par nges/ ༈ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grub thob chen po gorga nā thas gsungs pa'i dri chu'i rtags la nyin re'i legs nyes brtag ①pa ni/ dge slong lta bu khrims ldan la shin tu bden cing / khyem pa'ang brtag ④rung ba ste/ de yang tho rangs kyi dri chu thog ma la brtag (snyepa byed rgyu'i dgongs nyal po drag shul chang 'thung ba sogs spang zhing / srod 'khor tsam la dri chu lan gcig dor/ de nas sang lus kyi ba spu mthong ba tsam la dri chu dor la de la brtag pa duste/ gsang gnas kyi kha nas dri chu g.yas ngos su 'khyogs nas 'gro na de'i nyin bkra shis shing bde legs dang ldan la bya ba gang brtsams kyang 'grub pa sogs shin tu legs so/ /gzhogs g.yon du 'gro na 'thab mo dang rtsod pa dang 'phrog bcom ⑦sogs 'byung zhing bya ba brtsams kyang mi 'grub la/ gtam mi snyan pa thos pa sogs 'byung ngo / /chu byeng ④thad kar 'gro zhing gsar gnas kyi mtshams nas 'og tu thigs ⑨pa babs na zas gos sogs yid dang mthun pa'i nor zhing nges par rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /gsang gnas kyi mtshams nas chu rkang gcig la de nas gnyis su gyes shing slar gcig tu 'dril nas 'gro na nye du mdza' bshes sogs yid dang mthun pa'i mi phyogs su song ba zhig nges par 'khor zhing 'phrad par 'gyur ro/ /thog mar 'dril zhing de nas leb mo srab por 'gro la slar yang 'dril nas 'gro na rgyal po'i chad pa'am rku jag stor spyob sogs nor la god kha 'byung ngo / /chu 120—802

bying ①sbra ba dang bcas nas 'gro zhing 'og tu thigs ②pa yang 'bab la sar babs pa rnams kyang 'khor zhing lda ba dang bcas na char chen po 'byung ngo / /sgra dang bcas te byung na mi 'gyangs par snebyes su 'gro dgos 'byung ngo / /dgo ru ltar g.yon du gcus nas thad kar bu'agro na de nyin nor stor ba rnyed par mi 'gyur ro/ /chu phar mi 'gro ba gyen du tshur log nas gsang gnas kyi steng du 'bab na zhag bcu gsum song ba'i nyin nges par 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /g.yas su gcus ⑤nas 'gro na nor stor ba'ang zhag khungs 'dzol ba lta bu ma rnyed pa zhig rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /de rnams rnam dpyod dang ldan pas ma 'khrul bar brtags dhinas so sor bshad pa'i 'bras bu nges par 'byung ba ni myong bas grub pa'o —/ ༈ /spyozhi ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dga' byed kyi bden pa'i gtam rang gi ⑧lus kyi grib mar legs nyes brtag ⑨pa ni/ tshes bco lnga'i mi khye'i skad sogs sems can ⑫mi gnas pa'i rkyen med pa'i gnas dben par nam mkha' sprin dang khug rdul sogs kyi ⑪grib ma med pa'i shin tu dwangs pa'i skabs brtag ⑫ste—/ lus gcer bur phyung la lus drong ⑫por bsrangs te langs lag pa gnyis cha mnyam du brkyangs/ zla ba rgyab tu khur te brtags ⑫la/ de yang thog mar sa la shar ba'i grib ma'i mthe bong nas rim bzhin gyen du 'dzegs te mig dang thad mnyam gyen phyogs kyi nam mkha' la grib ma sprin lta bu zhig 'char la/ de yang nam mkha' 'char ba'i grib ma der lus kyi dbyebs med par zla ba nya lta bu'i bzo dbyibs la shin tu dkar ba zhig snang spyon tshe ring nad med snyug bsngal mi 'byung / bsod nams dang longs spyod mnga' thang rgyas/ grags pas sa steng khyab pa sogs shin tu legs so/ /lus gzhan mi gsal bar mgrin ⑩pa gcig 120—803

po mthong na sems la sdug bsngal chen po 'byung ngo / /lus thams cad tshang ①zhing de yang skrangs pa'i dbyibs lta bu sbom por mthong na myur du nad drag po 'byung ngo / /tshad dbyibs sbom phra sogs rang gi lus dang mtshungs par mthong na nad mi 'byung zhing legs so/ /lus bying gsal la mgo bo med na zla ba drug nas nges par 'chi'o/ /lag pa gnyis mi gsal na rang la yang nad 'byung zhing spun zla gcig nges par 'chi'o/ /kha dog nag por snang ②na nor la god kha chen po 'byung ngo / /brla g.yas g.yon gang rigs la bug pa 'dug na chung ma nges par 'chi'o/ /lte ba'i thad du bug pa 'dug na 'thab ①mo dang kha mchu rtsod pa sogs 'byung ngo / /grib ma shin tu ring zhing mgrin pa mi mthong na/ yul gyi rgyal po sogs mi chen po zhig 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /sol ba'i mdog lta bu nag por mthong na/ sa zhing dang nor rdzas la sogs pa longs spyod gzhan gyis ⑦'phrog par 'gyur ro/ /ser por mthong na gzhan gyi mi kha 'bab po/ /dkar ༷por mthong na nad med cing longs spyod thob pa sogs mchog tu legs so/ /mig mi mthong na yid dang mthun pa'i mdza' grogs 'chi ba'am nor stor rjob sogs kyis ⑦sems la sdug bsngal 'byung ngo / /lus kyi cha shas thams cad tshang zhing gsal la kha dog dkar zhing bkrag dang ldan na lo drug tshun chad du 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa med cing nad drag po mi 'byung ngo / /longs spyod dang snyan grags 'phel zhing bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa thob par 'gyur ba 'di yang dag pa'o //④zhes phyi nang drang srong gi tshe'i rig ⑨byed rgya mtsho lta bu'i nang nas mang dag yul dbus 'gyur 'chang du gtsug lag gnyis pa shes pa'i mkhas mang la bsten ⑩nas dar rgyas su yod pa'i sman dpyad la mkhas pa kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir du ma 120—804

zhig 'ongs tshod du 'dug rung paṇḍi ta smṛ ti phan tshun skad kyi brda ma 'phrod ①pas rta nag tu lug rdzi mdzad pa'i lo rgyus ltar ci yin cha ma 'tshal bar rang yul du phyir ldog ste gzhan phan gyi 'phrin las ma byung ba dang / la las che'i rig byed shes pa'i rna thos tsam go yang bod kyi gso rig pas chog shes pas/ legs bshad rin po cher/ tsan dan gser las rin che ba/ /blun pos sol bar byas la ltos/ /zhes pa ltar shes bzhin khyad gsod kyis dor ba'ang mchis rung rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing 'brug gi lor shākya mu ṣpe'i pho brang chen po'i mdun phyogs rgya gar ba'i mi rigs du ma tshogs khrod du sman pa mkhas pa zhig yod dam zer ba'i gtam thos pas rkyen byas 'dar pa lo chen dri mol ②byed du bcug pa 'phags yul nub phyogs ma ho ra'i sa'i char bram ze gtsang ma'i rigs su skyes pa saṃ n+ya se go da ra rastso ra ste khyim spangs sa spyod ces bya bas rgya gar dbus/ shar/nub—/ lho/ byang / ṣpe pā la dang bcas pa chu bzhin myul nas slob dpon go ta ma bhabee/ utta ma gi ri/ u kā ra bhabee sogs gus pas bsten pa'i mkhas pa chen por rtogs te 'dar pa paṇa chen gyis lo tsā bgyis dar mo sman rams par babeeb tu bcug par gso rig gi lag len ngo mtshar ba du ma byung rung phyogs 'dir mi rnyed pa'i sman gyi rigs 'tshol bar rgya bal phyogs su phyir bteg /bal po yam bu'i rgyal blon la rogs dan dgos tshul gyi sde pa'i hung rgya'i mtshams sbyor song ba la brten sman gyi rigs rnam grangs shin tu mang ba dang bcas me mo sbrul lo'i dbyar 'byor pa'i rgya bal gyi slob dpon mkhas pa rnams kyi zhal gye bdud rtsi las 'ongs pa'i tshe'i rigs ①byed kyi man ngag gnad kyi snying po bsdus pa 'di nyid mi chos gnad phreng las/ sngon dus bod 'di srin po'i rgyal khams 120—805

'dra—/ /ding sang dus su rgya gar 'phags yul 'dra/ /bsams kyin lo tsā bod la dka' ①drin che/ /zhes dang / sa skya ④paṇḍi tas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gzhung lugs bla na med/ /zhu chen sgyur byed mchan bu'i gnas thob pa/ /skad gnyis smra mkhas lo tsā de dag ni/ /de dag bdag cag rnams kyi mig bzhin gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ pā ṇi byā ①ka ra ṇa sogs sgra mdo chen po bzhi la blo gros kyi lang tsho mchog tu rgyas pa se dkar rigs kyi thig le 'dar pa lo tsā ngag dbang phun tshogs lhun grub kyis bsgyur cing gso ba rig ④pa'i gzhung lugs la slob dpon mkhas pa bcu phrag tsam bsten nas sbyangs pa'i yar stod dar mo sman rams pa blo bzang chos grags kyis 'bad pa chen pos gtan la phab pa'o dhichu gter slar yang ma bsrubs rjosngon med pa'i/ /rig byed bdud rtsi'i bum pa thob pa'i tshe/ /mes pos dran pa'i gso dpyad dbyar skyes kyi/ /rnga gsangs ⑦de la mos pa cung zad lhod/ /ti ⑧se'i mdangs ltar rab dkar lhag pa'i yid/ /lus can tshogs la rjes chags kunda'i tshal/ /'dzum pa'i cho ga gtong min sems bskyed kyi/ /bsel sbyin mkhan po'i cha shas nye bar dgang ⑨/ /phyogs brgyar zegs ⑪ma 'thor ba kahphu ra'i/ /dad pas tsha gdung bcil ⑪la mtshar 'dzin na/ /yongs grub brgya dang rtsa gcig bro nad gnyen/ /sman gyi dpag bsam 'khri shing 'di sus bskrun/ /ris su ma chad 'gro ba ⑫'jigs bral ba'i—/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin rdzogs rgyal sras kyi/ /rlabs chen spyod la 'jug rnams sangs rgyas zhes/ /grags can bgrod dka'i sa de mi ring snyam/ /bzod min tshor ba drag po'i nad gnod dang / /de rgyu sgrib gnyis lus pa med 120—806

bcas pa/ /'joms pa'i sman pa ches ①mchog rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'grub pa'i skal ba bzang por bdag 'gyur shog /tsan dan 'byug dang te'us brdeg ②pa la/ /snyoms par zhal 'che'i ①thugs rje snyigs dus 'dir/ /bskul na 'jig rten gsum gyi duḥkha rnams/ /mkhyen brtse nus pas pha mthar mdzad du gsol/ /'gro mang srog zungs bcud len bdud rtsi'i gter/ /myangs pa'i 'bras bu nam mkhas gzhal dka' ba'i/ /dge tshogs ma lus mtha' bral sems can kun/ /bla med byang chub 'thob dupa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /zhes tshe'i rig byed mtha' dag gi snying po bsdus pa'i glegs bam gyi che brjod bsgyur byang smon lam byi rim pa 'di ni za hor gyi bande tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rjes dmar ser can gye lo khrums kyi zla ba'i dkar cha'i rgyal ba dang po'i tshes la rgyal khab chen po po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas babyis pa dza yantu// //120—807
