tshugs pa sogs 'byung ngo / /'tsho ba dang mi 'tsho ba'i mtshan nyid brtag pa ni/lte ba/ rkang lag bzhi'i mthil/ sna rnams drod dang ldan pa dang / snas dri bzang ngan thams cad tshor zhing zas ro dang ldan la/ gnyid bde zhing za zi ①med pa sems bde ba sogs byung na nges par 'tsho bas/ rtags de rnams dang ldan na sman gyis bcos par bya/ de las ldog cing khyad par nye ba'i rtags/rlung gi gnas lte ba/ mkhris pa'i gnas mchin pa/ bad kan gyi ④gnas brang rnams yin la/ rlung ①mkhris pa'i gnas su 'phos pas lte bar drod med/dumakhris pa bad kan gyi gnas su 'phos pas de'i rkyen gyis ⑤bad kan o stong du 'pho bunas phyi dbugs nang du mi 'gro/ mtshan nyid de dag dang ldan na myur du 'chi bas sman dpyad la sogs pa bor te dge ba'i las la 'bad par bya'o/ /yang 'tsho 'chi ba rtag thabs kyi man ngag la/ snod gtsang mar chu blug /de'i steng du mar dang snum bsres pa bskol nas bsgrangs ⑦pa blug ste legs par dkrugs la/ de'i shenang du nad pa'i gzugs 'char du bcug ste bltas khyapas lus byengs kyi grib ma shar kyang mgo bo'i grib ma med na myur du 'chi zhing /lus tshang ma'i grib ma 'dug na nges par 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar legs par brtags ⑩nas/ nad de rnams zhi bar byed pa'i sman gyi sbyor ba bstan pa nirka/ tshad pa spyi 'joms legs 'dzin grub pa chung ba'i sbyor ba ni/ shubyu/snyelga/riṅga ni/ pū ha ka ra mū la/— khamasakyi ru rta/ ka ka ra siṅgi / ka ṭa ki/ka tsu ra/ bha ba ṣpe ṣṭha/——sma snasperu mgo nag gi shing / gubya/ — likhri/ asbra la/snyemyu ru ra/ha la dhi/——ldaser/ pithral/ drodasman/ ma ri tsi/ phoris/ ka la uñdzi/ pi ta ba pa ra/ pra tra dza/ a ga ra/ a ka ru/ dzabs/ kuṣṭa/ sha phoru rta/ ba 720—847

la lo tsa ṇa/ ta dza/snye shing tsha/ a ti sa/ de ba da ru/snye shugapa/ na ga ra mo tha snye ma nu gla sgang 3/ pa ṭo la/ a dza wa ni/snye lal phud/ tsi ta/ pibee la mu la thapi ling gi rtsa ba rnams cha mnyam pa nyag gang dang / tsi ra yi ta spor do bcas zhib par btags la thun tshad che phyogs tsam re chu grang gis rta byas btang bas mkhris tshad/rlung tshad/ bad kan la brten pa'i tshad pa/ 'khrugs tshad/ 'grams tshad/rims tshad sogs tshad pa gsar rnying thams cad zhi bar byed cing / gzhan yang skya sbab/ grang rlung / mig ser/ dbugs mi bde ba rnams la phan no//rims 'phrog kyelcags kyu chen mo'i sbyor ba ni/ shurji/rko sga/ ma ri tsi/snye pho ris—/ pibee la drod sman gsum zho brgyad re/ kanda kasnye mu zi ser po/ bi ṣa/— sman chen—/ pa ra dngulachugasum zho do re rnams zhib par btags la/ dha dru (kyer/snye thang phrom—/ bāṅga /—— so ma ra tsa/ sga rlon pa rnams kyi khu bas 'dam btags legs par byas nas ril bu sran ma che shos tsam re sgril la sga'i / )khu bas rta byas te ril bu re btang bas rlung / mkhris pa/ bad kan/ tshad pa/ gsar rnyings(snye—/ rims drag po/ rims nyin gcig pa/ rims 6)nyin gnyis pa/rims nyin gsum pa/ rims nyin bzhi pa/ rtag pa'i rims/ ma 'ju ba rnams la mchog tu phan no/ /rims 'phrog lcags kyu grub pa'i sbyor ba ni/shaṅga )bha sma dung thal dang ha ri ta la bablaganyis zho brgyad re/ nī la tho tha big pa na zho do / gi pa ko ṭi zho gsum rnams zhib par btags pa slar yang gi ba ko ṭa'i tre)khu bas 'dam btags byas nas bgangs / de rdza snod gsar par blug ste kha legs par bcad nas rlung mi 'chor ba byas/ de sa dong khru do gru bzhi gting la'ang khru do yod pa zhig brus la gci bas bkang ba'i dkyil tshad du bcug par me 120——848

sbar te me shi nas grang ①thag ma chod par bzhag /de nas bton la dma' ru mgo nag re tsam re bye dkar thun tshad tsam re dang mnyam du btang na tshad pa'i rigs gsar rnyings ②gang la'ang phan nges shing / gzhan yang nad kyi rigs tsha grang gsar rnying ①thams cad la phan pas bye 'joms chen mo'o/ /rlung mkhris bad kan gsum ka 'dom (gepa'i tshad pas drag ⑪tu na na/ pibee la/snye drod sman/ma ṇi si la/snye ma ṇi tsha la ldong ros/ nisba pha la nisbra'i'abras bu gsum cha mnyam zhib par btags la/ ka re li'i khu bas ril bu skyu ru ra tsam sgril la chu grang dang mnyam du btang bas myur du zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /mkhris tshad kyis dun na/ pi ta pa pa ra zho gang zhib par btags la/ chu cung zad blug ste 'dam btags byas—/ de slar chu grang phul gang tsam la sbyangs nas btungs na myur du phan par 'gyur ro/ /yang mkhris tshad la/ ba la lo tsa na/ na ga ra mo tha/snye ma nu gla sgang / tsan dan dkar po/ pi ta pa pa ra/ shubyu/snye lda/ b.la'i/snye ka ta ra ki dza ra rtsab rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la bod kyi thun tshad che ⑦phyogs tsam chu grang gis sderta byas btang bas phan par 'gyur ro/ /bad kan gyi tshad pas na na/ shubyu/— bee/ ma ri tsi/snye phoris/ ka yi pha ra/ pibee la drod sman rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la chu grang gis posterta byas sna bug tu blug na phan no—/ /rlung tshad kyis 6 nan na/ shubyu/snye lda/ pañtsa/snye kharu tsha/ pithra la/— drod sman / ma ri tsi/— phoris/ tsi ra yi ta/snye tigata/ ka ṭa ki/ ha ri ta ka a rur rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la bod kyi thun tshad che shos tsam re chu skol gyis 11rta byas btang bas phan par 'gyur ro/ /ma 'ju ba'i tshad pas na na/ a dza mo dha/snye lal phud chung ba/ ha ri ta/ arur/ sañtsa ra lo ṇa kharutshwagasum cha mnyam 120 849

zhib par btags la thun tshad che shos tsam chu skol gyis sna rta byas btang bas phan par 'gyur ro/ / 'khrugs tshad kyis thun na/ til mar gyi snum gyis bsku mnye legs par byas la/ de rjes chu dron mos lus bkrus te gos 'thug pos byibs nas cung zad cig bzhag na phan no/ /mthong tshad 'di'i nad rtags lus byeng sedrod med la mig drod shin tu che shing mabo bo dang mig la zug khol bur ldang ba zhig yod gsung kyis na na/ pibee la/ drod mi na— ma ri tsi/ pho ris/ tha she ra yi ta/ tig ta/ shurji/ — bee/ hiṅga shing kun mer bsregs nga rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la thun tshad che phyogs tsam chu grang gis rta byas btang bas phan par 'gyur ro/ /'dus tshad kyis ) na na/cisajug zab chen/ rgya mtshal/ mtha lngange byu1/ pho ris/ lnga lnga/ 'ab/ drod sma na/ lnga tang/ sma na chen/swāṅga tshalarnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la sga'i khu bas ril bu dma' ru mgo nag tsam sgril ba btang bas phan zhing / gzhan yang rlung gi nad grang ba/yan lag zha grum sogs la'ang phan no/ /yang 'dus pa'i nad la/ yid bzhin nor bu'i bcud kyi sbyor ba ni/ garnya ka/ mu zi ser ngo// pa ra/ dngul chu/ma ri tsi/ pho ris// shwe ta zirdo ra/ zi ra da7ra ngo / ka la jig ra/ zi ra nag po/sernya / rgyam/ tshwa9 / 'o/ ṇa/ satso 'o/ ṇa/ kha ru tshwa/ saṃ ba lnga/ 'o/ ṇa/ lan tshwa/ kha lnga/ lbatshwa rigs gnyis lo ṇa rigs gnyis/ sa zirdo kha ra/ zitshwa/ ya ba kha ra/ byi tsher ba/ sa mu dra kha ra/ bi ṣa/ sma nachen/ a wa ra ka lhangatsher/ shubyu lga rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la pā ni'i khu bas ril bu sran ma tsam bsgril skye te btang bas zhi bar 'gyur zhing / sbos khrog /khrag 'grim pa rnams la yang phan no/ /yang 'dus nad kyi sman la/ ma ri tsi/ pho ris/ pibee la/ drod sman/ shubyu/ — lda/bi ṣa/ sma na chen/ gandha ka mu zi ser po/ pa ra dngul chu rnams cha mnyam zhib par 120—850

btags la ras la btsags/ de nas rdo gzhong nang du thang phrom '-i)gyi khu bas gar sla zho tsam byas pa ma skam par nyed(kye/ beer yang gong bzhin nyin gsum gyi bar mtshams ma chad par byas la/ de nas ril bu dma' ru mgo nag tsam byas la tho rangs ril bu re btang bas phan zhing / gzhan yang bad kan/ grang rlung / rus pa khol bur na ba/ dang kha mi bde ba rnams la phan no/ /yang dhwa ni/— 'usu/ na ga ra mo tha/snye ma nugla sgang / tsir yi ta/snye teg ta/ kuṣṭha/— sha pho ru rta/ind+ra ya ba/snye dugamonyung / de wa da ru/snye shugapa/ shuṇḍa/snye lda/ ga dza pibee kong po na yod pa'i drod sman la rnams cha mnyam zhib ①rtsing dang thun tshad bod kyi thang tsam chu phul brgyad la btab nas chu cha bdun ma bskam ④par skol la/ de nas dro ⑤'jam tsam la btungs bas 'dus pa'i nad/ 'dus tshad/ ig gu'i ⑥skyigs bu/skyug ⑦pa/ stod du 'tshangs ④pa rnams la phan no/ /tri ko ṭa/snye tsha ba gsum/tri pha la/snye 'brasabugasum/ hiṅga/snye shing kun/ ba tsā/snye shu dag /sernya lo ṇa/ rgyamatsha⑨/kuṣṭhaske/ snye sha pho ru rta/ sa ri oṃ/rko pang khang / 'bru'i 'bru/snye si ra'i sa pha la rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la ra'i chus khu ba byas nas beer yang brdar te mig la byugs na/ mig gi 4 kend/ sems g.yo zhing 'khrug pa/ mig rab rib/mtshan mo gnyid mi yong ba rnams la phan zhing 'dre gdon gyi gnod pa'ang thub po//kuṣṭha—/ snye sha pho ru rta/ la waṅga/snye li shi/ pibee la/ — drod sman/ a ka ra ka ra ha rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la sga'i tsho1khu bas ril bu skyu ru ra tsam sgril la btang bas/ bad kan/ 'dus pa/ mgo bo na ba/ sdang ba /lornams la phan no/ /rgyu tshad kyis na zhing khrag 'grim nyagepa sogs la mchog tu phan no2 / /li la ba ti ba ṭa'i sbyor ba ni/ ma ri tsi/ phoris/ masta ki/ da ḍi ma/ se'abru/ waṃ 120 85/

sha lo tsa na/ cu gang / asba/ an 'bras/ lo da/ ma ra ha ṣṭha/ dha tro/ dha ba ka sdo/ 'ab/— sna ba ka'i me tog /chab(bye 'a/ 'ab/ ma dzu'i 'bru/ ci/hā/ —sde/ ma nu rta rkang / ṭa/ṣṭha/ sha pho ru rta/ dza yi pha la/ dzā rte ti/ ba bu ra ka ba la/ ba bu ra'i 'bru/ kha yi ra/ — rgya gar stod ja/ ko ha ḍa ka bi dza koha ḍa'i 'bru rnams cha mnyam 2zhib par btags la ras la btsags te thun tshad che phyogs tsam po sta ka'i halokhu bas rta byas btang bas phan zhing / sman gtong ring zas spyod 'bras zan ba'i dar ba dang mnyam du cung zad re btang / gzhan ma bza' btung gi rigs mi gtong / rgyu tshad spyi 'joms bridha shaṃ gā dha ra'i 'phelaba'am ka 'dzin spyor ba ni/ na ga ra mo tha ma nu gla sga nga / sdo/bye// bee/ yin zab yi// dha ba ka phu 'a / dha ba'i me tog /nges ba/ bil ba/a ti sa/ mo tsa rā sa/ ma nu rta rkang ri thang chu/ lo dha/ la ja ru/ phyagasba/ ka bi dza am 'bras/ kuṇḍa/ sha pho ru rta/ yi/nd+ra sa/ ba/ dug mo nyung / ba 'a/ 'o/ 'a na rnam sa cha mnyam zhib par btags la thun tshad che phyogs re 'bras skam po bkrus pa'i chu phul phyed sbrang ba ru ra tsam re dang mnyam du btang bas 'khru ba chod cing myur du phan par 'gyur ro/ /yang la gu gaṅgā dha ra'i gaṅgā 'dzin chung ba sbyor ba ni/ shurji/ lda/dha ba ka phu la/ dha ba'i me tog /mo tsa ra sa ma nu rta rgang gi thang chu rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la thun tshad che phyogs tsam re ba'i dar ba phul phyed kyis rta byas btang bas kyang nus pa gong dang 'dra/ yang rgyu tshad gsar rnying gi nad 'a/ / tha mbi bi ja / ama'abras/ ja sku) pha 'a / dzā ti/ bee 'ang/ — bilab/ kha yib zang dza / rgya gar stod ja/ a phi ma rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la chu grang dang sbyar te lte ba'i mtha' skor du sor gsum gyi rgya tsam la byugs pas kyang zugs gzer chag 4cing 'khru ba chod do/ /yang rgyu tshad la na ga ra bye'i grong khyer las lhag pa 120—852

thang gi sbyor ba ni/ shubyu/snye lda/ kuṣṭha/snye sha pho ru rta/ a tis/ hiṅga/snye shing kun/na ga ra mo tha mnugla sgang rnams cha mnyam zhib rtsing dang thun tshad bod kyi thang tsam chu phul brgyad la btab nas chu cha bdun ma skam par skol la/ de nas dro 'jam tsam la btungs pas phan par 'gyur ro/ /yang rgyu tshad kyis khrag kho na 'grim pa la/ ba la lo tsa na/ kuṣṭha/snye shaphoru rta/ a ti sa/ na ga ra mo tha/rko ma nu gla sgang / be la thalab rnams cha mnyam zhib rtsing dang thun tshad sogs gtong lugs gong bzhin byas pas myur du chod par 'gyur ro/ /yang / lo dha/ind+ra ya ba/snye dug ce spyang ①/ mo tsa ra sa/snye ma nu rta rkang gi thang shing / na ga ra mo tha snye ma nu gla sgang / be la/snye bilab/ dha ba ka phu la dhaba'i me tog rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la bu ram gyis rta byas ril bu ba ru ra tsam sgril la btang bas kyang chod do—/ /yang rgyu tshad kyis ④khrag dang ser po gnyis ka 'grims na/ senta lo ṇa—/ snye rgyam tsha/sne sañtsa ra lo ṇa/— kharutshwa/ hiṅga/snye shing kun/ ba tsa/snye shudag④ /ha rī ta kā/—lnga/ a ti sa rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la thun tshad che phyogs tsam re chu skol gyis ④rta byas btang bas myur du chod cing phan par 'gyur ro/ /pho ba'i me drod nyams nas rjozas gang zos kyang mi 'ju bar 'grim zhing sbos nyams byed pa ⑦la/ dang kha mi bde/ lus shed ⑧rim bzhin chag pa'i nad la/dha ni ya/snye 'usu/ na ga ra mo tha/snye mnuglasgang / shuṣṭha/— lda/ rū li ka bi 6stedza la phug gi 'bru rnams cha mnyam byi thang tshad dang bsdu lugs gong bzhin btang bas phan par 'gyur ro/ /yang na/ na ga ra mo tha/— ma nuglasgang / shuṣṭha/snye sga/ a ti sa/gi lo hi rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la thun tshad che phyogs tsam re chu skol gyis rta byas btang bas kyang phan no/ /yang / lo dha/ pa bye/ la dza ru/120 853

na ga ra mo tha/rko ma nu gla sgang / be ma/snye thal ba/ shubyu/— lda/ dha ni ya/snye 'u su/a ti sa/— likhri/ guza/snye likhri/ ba la lo tsa na/ kuṣṭha/snyeshaphoru rta/ dha ba ka phul dha ba'i me tog ①rnams cha mnyam gyi thang tshad dang bsdu lugs gong bzhin byas btang bas phan par 'gyur ro/ /gzhang ①'brum gyi nad la/ ma ri tsi pho risazho gang / shurji ldazho ①do/ tsi ta zho brgyad/ su ra ṇa zho bcu drug rnams zhib par btags la ril bu skyu ru ra las che tsam re btang bas phan zhing / sman gtong ba'i bar la ro mngar ba/ kha ba/ lug gi sha rnams mi za'o yang /yi/ ra lu/ tsi ta/ ind+ra ya ba/snye dugamonyung / shubyu/snye lda/ sernya 'o/ ṇa/snye rgyamatshwa/be la beelab rnams cha mnyam ④zhib par btags la thun tshad che phyogs tsam re ba'i dar ba phul res rta byas btang na phan par 'gyur ro/ /yang gzhang 'brum gyi nad kyis ⑤khrag 'dzag pa la/ dru 0di ba ṣṭha dang la lishimewasgo rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags pa mang nyung zho bdun rer thun re bcad pa ba mar btsag bcad pas rta byas zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar du btang bas nges par phan no/ / mtshan bar rdol ba'i ⑧nad la/ ha la bye lda⑨seradang / alnga la skyururaganyis chu'i nang du brdar la gar sla zho tsam rma khar byugs tu kel ras kyis khebs bkab nas bzhag pas phan par 'gyur ro/ /yang bi la yi ka ha ḍa zhum bu'irus pa zhib par btags pa 'bras bu gsum gyi khu ba dang mnyam du legs par brdar la gar sla zho tsam byung ba dang rmar byugs te ras bkab pas phan no/ /yang senta lo ṇa—/ — rgyamatshwa/ shubyu/— lda/ ha la bye/— ldatu)ser/ bha ṭa pa tra shing bhaṭa'i lo ma gu rtsi 'bri dza ya tri 12dzā1sheti'i me tog rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags pa zho la sbyar nas rma khar byugs te ras bkab pas kyang phan par 'gyur ro/ /pho skran gyi nad la/ sañtsa 120 854

twa tsa/— shingagikhru'iḍa pa/ kha yi ra/snye rgya gar stod ja/ kuṣṭha/snye ru rta①/ ba yi bi raṅga byi thang ka rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags ②la ba'i chus rta byas btang bas phan par 'gyur ro/ /pho ba rlung gis ①sbos nas na na/ sañtsa ra lo ṇa/— kha ru tshwa/hiṅga—/ shurji/ gsum cha mnyam zhib par btags la thun tshad nyis 'gyur tsam re chu skol gyis ④rta byas btang na phan no/ /yang na/ ma ri tsi/snye pho ris/pibee ⑤la/snye drodasman/ shusgyu/snye lda/ hiṅga/snye shinakun/ sendha lo ṇa/snye rgyamatshwa/ dzir do / snye zi ra dkar nag /a dza mo da dbyimong rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la chu skol gyis (brta byas btang bas phan par 'gyur ro/ /yang na/ pithral/— tha tha ⑦ling /shurji—/ snye lda/ ha ri ta ke/snye a rur/ sañtsa ra lo ṇa/snye kharutshwa/ ti bi rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la chu skol gyis rta byas btang bas phan no/ /yang na/shuṇḍi—/ snye lda/ ma ri tsi/— phoris/ pithra la/snye pipiling/ sasto kha ra zetshwarnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la chu skol gyis ⑧rta byas btang kyang phan no/ /skya sbab dang mig ser gyi nad la/ ga da purṇa/ tri pha la/—— 'bras bu gsum/ kuṣṭha/— ru rta⑨—/ tsi turter yi ta/snye tig ta/ u ru sa/ nisba/ gurtsa li khri rnams cha mnyam gyi thang tshad dang bsdu lugs snga ma bzhin la/ bsdus tshar ba'i steng /sbrang ba ru ra tsam zhig btab ste btungs pas myur du phan par 'gyur ro/ /yang na—/ tri ku ṭa/— tsha bgasum/ ha la dhi/ — sgaser/ phyagasba la/snye myurur/ tha/ ha ka tsurṇa lcags phye rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la thun tshad che shos tsam re ba mar ba ru ra tsam bzhu bar sbrang de nyis 'gyur gyi tshad tu7tsam bcas btab la legs par 'dres pa dang btang na mchog tu phan no/ /mig ser kho na'i nad la/tri pha la/— 'bras bu gsum/ kuṣṭha/snye ru rta⑫/ ha la dhi/ — sgaser/ dā ru ha la dra skyer 120—856

pa rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la sbrang dang mar gyi sbyor lugs gong ltar bzos pas phan no/ /yang na/ ge ru/— btsag /ha la dhi/— sgaser/ asba la sgyu ru ra gsum cha mnyam zhib par btags pa nyuchu la sbyar nas mig la byugs pas phan no/ /glo 'grams kyi nad la/ a sa garnya/— basprupa/ shubyu/—— bee/ pibee la—/ drod sman/ la waṅga /— li shi/ shel dkar/—— mi sri rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la chu grang gis thurta byas btang bas phan par 'gyur ro/ /yang na/ya 1ka ba akab de'i me tog na ka phu la dang la waṅga lishi gnyis cha mnyam zhib par btags la chus ril bu sran ma nyis 'gyur tsam sgril te btang bas phan no/ /yang na/ tri pha la/ — 'brasabu gsum/ shuṇḍi④/ — lda/ ba yi bi raṅga /snye bye thang ka /ma ri tsi/— phoris/ pibee la/— drod sman/ na ga ra mo tha/ ma nu gla sgang / pibee la—/ ka mu la/ pi pi ling gi rtsa ba/ la waṅga shi/—— lishi/ de ba da ru/— shug pa/e la ya tsi/— kakol/ te dza pa tra/ ma dhu/—— sbrangartsi/ nā⑤ga ge sar nā ga ge sar rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags pa'i cha gcig dang / shel dkar de'i 'u nyis 'gyur dang bcas ⑦thun tshad nyis 'gyur tsam chu grang gis dārta byas btang bas phan no/ /g.yig gu'i skyigs bu'i nad la/ ma ni tsha la/snye ldongaros/ ha la dhi sga ser ma ri tsi/ pho ris/ :she sri/ sheladakar/ la 'a ṅga lishirnams cha mnyam byu/ba par btags la thun tshad nyis 'gyur tsam sbrang ba ru ra tsam dang mnyam du zos pas myur du phan no/ /yang g.yig gu dang skyug yorte pa gnyis ka 'dom nas na na/ she ta tsan dan/snye tsandan dkar po/ na ga ra mo tha/— ma nu gla sgang / e la yartsi/ ka ko la/la dza ru/ pibee la/ — drodasman/ la waṅga / — lishi/ bee ri ki ga ri ka ma la ka ṭa—/ — chid pa kha'i 'bru'i snying po/ ga dza ke sa ri rnams cha mnyam gyi cha gcig dang / sbrang 120—857

dang shel dkar gnyis kyi cha gcig byas te ril bu ba ru ra tsam re zos pas myur du phan no/ /yang na/ la dza ru/ ha ri ta ke/ la waṅga / lishi/ ka ma la ka ṭa/ e la ya tsi khrekol rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la sbrang rtsi dang mnyam du zos pas kyang phan no/ /dbugs mi bde ba'i nad la/ shubyu/ bee/pibee la/ drod sman/ ka ka ra seṅgi / su ka ra mu la/ khams kyi ru rta1 / ka tsu ra / sga skya/ bha riṅga / a rur/ na ga ra mo tha/ ma nugla sgang / ma ri tsi phorisarnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la thun tshad che phyogs re chu skol gyis nasgyurta byas btang bas phan no/ /yang na/ raṅga ṇi/ su ka ra mu la/ khams kyi ru rta / a ru sa / shuṇḍi/ bee/ ku la tha/ rgyasran/ rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la chu skol gyis 4rta byas btang kyang phan par 'gyur ro/ /dbugs mi bde zhing glo drag tu lang na/ shubyu/ bee/ be 5ḍa ha/ b.rur/ pibee la/ drod sma na/ da ka ra seṅga /bha raṅgi / ki 6pa ko ri rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la chus ril bu skyu ru ra tsam sgril te btang bas myur du phan no/ /glo drag 7tu ldang zhing lud pa mi gog na/ a ru sa/ shurji/ bee/ pibee la drodasma na rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la sbrang rtsis rta byas ril bu sgyu ru ra tsam sgril te btang bas phan no/ /yang na/ a ru sa/ shurji/ bee/ pibee la/ drod sman/ tsa sa/ ka ṭa ri rnams cha gnyis zhib par btags te chu skol gyis 9 rta byas btang bas phan par 'gyur ro/ /zas mi 'ju zhing dang kha mi bde ba la/ pibee la/ drodasman/ ti bi/ha ri ta ke/ — arur/ shuṇḍi/ bee/ sañtsa ra la tso ṇa kha rutshwa rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la chu skol gyis 1 rta byas btang bas phan no/ /yang na/ senta lo ṇa / rgyam tsha/ ha lnga/ ta te// — a ru ra/ lnga lnga/ 'a// drod sman/ byu1 ta rnam sa 'a 120—858

mnyam zhib par btags la chu skol gyis ṭwārta byas btang pyabs phan par 'gyur ro/ /yang na/ tro pha la/ — 'bras bu gsum/ tri ku ṭa/— tsha ba gsum/ satso zab lo na/ kha ru tsharngu/tiṅga—/ — shing kun/ a dza wa na lalaphud rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags pa'i cha gcig dang / bu ram gyi cha gcig byas pa'i ril bu skyu ru ra tsam sgril te btang bas lnga/nga phan sgo / /nga nga na/ sendha 41 ṇa/ rgyam tshwa/ satso rab 'o ṇa/ kha ru tshwa/ba yi bi raṅga /—— byi thang ga ma ri tsi/ pho ris/ pibee la/—— drod sman/ shuṇḍi/ — lnga/ha lngari ta te// — a ru ra/ nges sha ha/ ba ru ra/ phyagadza 'ab/— skyu ru ra/ ti bi/'a 'a ṅga / lishi/ byu1 tra ka hiṅga / shing kun me la bsregs pa/ yinaja 'a na/snye la la phud/dzi ra do/ — zi ra dkar nag /na ga ra mo tha mnugla sgang rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la star bu'i khu bas zan tsam brdzis pa skem thengs krugasum byas pa'i phye ma thun tshad nyis 'gyur tsam re btang bas phan nges so/ /'bras bu skrangs pa'i nad la/ shwe ta dzi ra/— zi ra dkar po/ sernya lo ṇa/snye rgyamatsha⑤/ hiṅga shing kun rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la pang ⑥kha'i snum me la bsros par btab ste byugs pas myur du phan no/ /yang na/ 'bras bu gsum gyi phye ma ba'i chus rta byas btungs ⑦pas zhag bdun nam yun ring yang bcu bzhi'i khongs su drag ⑤go/ /yang na/ so ma pha gosnyodazhib par btags pa thun tshad che phyogs tsam re ba mar sgyu ru ra nyis 'gyur tsam dang pang zukha'i snum sgong skogs rngo7 phyed tsam sros par btab ste nyin bdun kyi bar btungs pas phan no/ /yang na/ shwe ta dze ra/—— zi ra dkar po/ ces raṇḍa sdo/ṣṭha/— daṇḍa ru rta/ ba tha / shudag /hu 'a hu 'a hu lu hu la'i 'bru ka pa ⑪dza rnams cha mnyam zhib btags pa/ chu bye do tsam gyi nang du 'bras rtsam kṛ5 pa ltar btags pa bye gang tsam zhig blug nas rnge mdag gi steng du zhag 120—859

gnyis gsum zhig bzhag nas chu de skyur mor song ba dang / de la gong gi sman rnams btab ste byugs pas myur du skam par 'gyur ro/ /dwangs ma 'dzag pa la/a na ra se'abru'i me tog ki ka li dang shwe ta kha yi ra stodajadakar po gnyis cha mnyam zhib par btags pa'i cha gcig dang / shel dkar cha gcig bsres te thun tshad che phyogs re tho rangs dang dgongs mo zhag bdun gyi ring star chags su btang na chod par 'gyur ro/ /yang na/ e la yi rtsa stisug smel dang shel dkar cha mnyam zhib par btags la thun tshad nyis 'gyur tsam re zos pas phan zhing / sman gtong ring ro skyur ba dang la phug sogs mi bza'/ yang na/ saṃ kha hu li/ e la yi tsa/ — sugasmel/ se la dzi ta gsum cha mnyam zhib par btags pa'i cha gcig /shel dkar gyi chocha gcig byas la thun tshad nyis 'gyur tsam re chu grang gis kyi rta byas btang bas kyang phan no/ /yang chu dang mnyam du na zug dang bcas te 'dzag na/ e la yi tsa/— sugasmel/ a ru sa/ gho 6ra/ gzem④/ ba ma ṣpe ṣṭha—/ snye dma' ru mgo nag gi rtsa ba/ pibeel/ drod sman/ e raṇḍa danda rnams kyi thang thun tshad dang bsdu lugs gong ma rnams dang 'dra ba byas la/ de steng se la dzi ta dang sbrang cung zad re btab ste btung bas ⑤myur du phan par 'gyur zhing rdel nad kyang thon par 'gyur ro/ /yang na/ /e raṇḍi/ dandaphyu/ a ru sa/ e la yi tsa / snye sug smel/ po sta ka bi dza halo'i'abru rnams zhib par btags la ba'i zhos rta byas nas btang na yang phan no/ /chu 'gags pa la/ mu sa ka bhiṣṭa bye ba'i brun zhib par btags la chu zho tsam sbyar ba me la bsros thote lte 'og nas spu dkar nag yan la byugs na myur du phan nges so/ /rdel nad dang chu 'gags gnyis 'dzom nas na na/ sgo ṣa ra/snye gzem/ dza ba sa/ ha re 3ta ka— aru ra/ pa kha na bee da brag 120—860

zhun / rnams cha mnyam gyi thang tshad dang bsdu lugs gong dang 'dra ba byas la/de steng sbrang cung zad tsam zhig btab ste btung bas ①kyang phan no/ /yang na/thog pha 'a /—— 'bras bu gsum/ se/rnya 41 ṇa/ rgyamatshwa/ 11 ṣa zab/— gzem/ ka ze) lngas gser me tog rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la thun tshad nyis 'gyur tsam re chu skol gyis phul nas btang bas rdel nad chu 'gags gnyis ka la phan no/ /yang rdel nad chu 'gags bcos thabs zab gnad khyad par can ni/ swa ha ga mer tshal bsregs pa'i thal ba chu 'gags zul phye ma cung zad re gsang gnas kyi nang du blugs pas de phral chu 'bab cing thun tshad chung phyogs re chu skol gyis phul ste khong du btang bas/ rdel nad myur du zhi ba myong grub khyad par can no/ /mjo'i nad gang la yang / tri pha la/— 'brasabu gsum/ a ru sa/ nisba/ pa ra ba ra ka la harngu/ kha la ④ra/snye stodaja/ gurtsa li khri rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la chu grang gis rta byas te btang bas phan par 'gyur ro/ /yang na/ tri pha la/ 'bras bu gsum/ masbyo/ ṣṭha/—— btsod/ gurtsa/ li khri/ ka ṭa ki/ nisba/ ha la bye/—— lda ser / ba tsa/—— shudag /da ru ha ri dra/ skyerapa/ ba yi bi raṅga / bye thangaka /a ru sa—/ de wa da ru shugaparnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la thang thun chung phyogs tsam re chu grang gis ⑤rta byas zhag nyer gcig gi bar la btang nas phan na dang / ma phan tshe zhag zhe dgu'i bar la btang bas phan la/ de'i bar rtsam pa dang 'bras kho na las zas gzhan mi gtong la/ sman 'di za phrug la yang phan no / /khrag shas che ba'i mdze nad la/ mdzi ⑥ṣṭha/snye btsod/ tri pha la/snye 'bras bu gsum/kuṣṭha—/ ru rta/ ha la dhi/snye sgaser/ de ba da ru/ shugapa/ ba tsa shu dag rnams kyi thang tshad dang bsdu lugs sngon ma rnams dang 'dra ba byas nas btang bas kyang 120—861

phan par 'gyur ro/ /mdze dkar po la/ guñdza①/—— dma' ru mgo nag /nidza/kuṣṭha / ru rta3/ ba tsa/ shudag /tsi tra ka /cha 1mnyam zhib par btags la/gong 'bras bu skrangs pa'i skabs su bstan pa'i 'bras phye btang ba'i byachu skyur mo des khu ba byas nas gar sla zho tsam rma gang 'dug la byugs pas phan no/ /yang na / ma ṇi tsha la/—— ldongaros/ tsi tra ka /ba ku tsi/ beeṅga na bha sma be ga na'i thal ba rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags te gong gi chus rta byas nas byugs na yang phan no/ /za phrug gi nad la/ ma ri tse dang sespyo ra gnyis cha mnyam zhib par btags la mar la sbyar nas byug ⑤pa byas na sel bar 'gyur ro/ /za phrug /g.yan pa/ shu ba gsum la/ ha la dhi/ sga ser/ ba ku tsi/ nisba da la—/ nisba'i lo ma/ asba la skyu rur rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la ba'i chus rta byas la nyin bdun gyi bar du btang bas phan no/ /yang na/ gandha ka mu zi ser po/ba ku tsi/ ba yi bee raṅga / — byi thang ka /kuṣṭha/ ru rta'u/ siṅga ra pha/— rgyamatshal/ha la dhi/— sga ser/ tsa ka ba ḍa/ thaladakar rdo rje/ sespyo ra rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la/ dha krutu ra/— thangaphrom/ nisba/ pā na gsum gyi khya bas sbyar nas byugs na phan no/ /yang na/ du ba dang ha la bye gnyis zhib par btags la chu la sbyar nas byugs kyang phan no/ /yang na/ du ⑧ba/ ba ku tsi/senta lo na/—— rgyam tshwa/klu se ba/ — a ru ra/ tsa ka ba ṭa thal dkar rdo rje rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la gong gi chu sgyur mos sbyar te byugs kyang phan no/ /me lce 'khor lo la/ shwe ta tsan dan/snye tsan dan dkar po/ kuṣṭha/ ru rta6ste / sambha lu/ka ma la ka ṭa/snye kamala'i 'bru/ nisba rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la chu la sbyar nas byugs pas phan no/ /gnyan 'bur la/ sa /kṣeru ba nyabyubasame la phyed 120—862

tsam bsregs pa'i thal ba ba'i zhos rta byas thun tshad che phyogs tsam re nyin bdun gyi bar btang na phan par 'gyur ro/ /grang rlung gi nad la/ a sa garnya/— baspru/shuṇḍirka/ snye ka/ ka la ti la tilanag rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags pa'i cha gcig /shel dkar gyis cha gcig byas pa thang thun chung phyogs tsam re ba mar btsag bcad par btab ste btang na phan par 'gyur ro/ /yang na/ pibee la/snye drod sman/ tsi tra ka /a sa garnya/— basprub/ ba yi bi raṅga /snye byithang ka /a dzabā na/— la la phud/ shubyu/snye lda/ ka la bañdzi/ pithra la ka mu la tha pi ling gi rtsa ba rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags pa cha gcig /bu ram gyi cha gnyis byas pa'i ril bu skyu ru ra nyis 'gyur tsam re btang bas phan no/ /yang na/ bāṅga/skyi so ma ra tsa/sambha lu/ bāṅga ra/ muṇḍi rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la chu skol gyis dhirta byas btang kyang phan no/ /yang na/ shubyu/rko lda/ a raṇḍi②/snye daṇḍa/ rā sa na/de ba da ru/— shugapa/ gurtsa li khrirnams cha mnyam gyi thang bsru lugs gong ma rnams dang 'dra bar byas nas btang na phan par 'gyur ro/ /grang rlung la brten pa'i yan lag na zhing zha grum ①skrangs pa sogs la/ po sa ka bi dza/snye na lo'i 'bru/ dha tu ra ka ra sa/— thang phrom gyi thang chu/ guñtsa/rko dma' ru mgo nag /bi ṣa/snye sman chen thang phrom dugyi 'bru/ dha tu ra kasnye sman chen thang phrom gyi 'bru/ /bi dza rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la nyil mar skol bar btab ste byugs na phan par 'gyur ro/ /stong sgyugs dang zas gang zos kyang sgyugs na/ e la ya dzi /— ka ko la/ ka ma la ka ṭa/snye ka ma la'i 'bru/ tshu ba ra kha sur pa ni gsum cha mnyam zhib par btags la chu grang gis rte )rta byas sgyug pa 3ma chod bar du yang yang btang bas phan par 'gyur ro/ /bad kan la brten pa'i glo drag tu lang na/120— 863

ke sa ra/snye gur gum/ ma ri tsi/— phoris/ pithra la/— drodasman/ tasba ma ra/snye zangs btul ma/ la waṅga lishirnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la 'byor na pā ṇa dang mnyam du bza' zhing ma rnyed na chu dro 'jam gyis phul la btang na phan zhing dbugs kha mi bde ba la yang phan no/ /yang na/ pibee la/snye drodasman/ raṅga ni/la waṅga /snye lishi/ pa raṅgi / shuṇḍi karnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la chu skol gyis ①rta byas btang kyang phan no/ /phol mig gi nad la/ pibee la/snye drod sman/ ka tsa na ka ca na ①ra'i sogs pa ba ki bha ka li tri pha la 'bras bu gsum rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la ①chu skol gyis rta byas btang na bsos par 'gyur ro/ /yang na/ ba raṅgi dang / shuṇḍi gnyis cha mnyam 'bras bkrus pa'i khu ba dang mnyam du gar sla zho tsam brdar la rma gang yod la byugs pas myur du bsos so /kha nad la/ nyi khu ra/— tharams/ e la ya tsi/snye kakol/ kha yi ra stodajagasum ④zhib par btags la chus ril bu skyu ru ra tsam sgril la khar bzung ⑤na phan no/ /so rnying nas khrag 'dzag na/ a ru sa/ na ga ra mo tha/snye ma nugla sgang / kha yi ra stod ja kuṣṭha/snye ru rta/ lo rda/ maz-iṣṭha pya btsod rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la so rtsar btab pas phan zhing so brtan par 'gyur ro/ /so srin byis ⑦na na/tri pha 'a /snye 'bras bu gsum/ da kha/snye rguna'abrum/ gurtsa/snye le khri/ tha ste le tsam bi li'i lo ga ke pa ta/ da ru ha ri dra skyeraparnams kyi thang gi 'di khu ba thon tsam las gong ma lugs bzhin gdu mi dgos 'du ba steng du sbrang rtsi cung zad re btab la khar bzung ①zhing pho bas phan no/ /sna ya mas skrangs nas na ba dang rnag gis 6)za ba la/ ku susba/snye bal bo kha che/ha ri ha ke/snye a rur/ a na ra ga phu la/snye se 'bru'i me tog /rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags pa chu grang gis ⑩sbyar nas spyozhag drug tsam gyi ring snar blugs ⑫120——864

pas phan no/ /yang na/ ma ri tsi phorisardog gcig dang so na ka sa ra ki bi dza/ — so na ka ra'i 'bru/ til 'bru tsam zhig chur brdar la sna nang du blug pas kyang phan no—/ /mig na ba la/ ra sa ba ti/ senta 'o/ ṇa/— rgyamatsha / ha ri ta ke/ aru ra—/ ge ru/— btsag /ha la da sgaserarnams cha mnyam zhib par btags pa chu la sbyar te mig gi mtha' skor la byugs pas phan par 'gyur ro/ /mig na mi na thams cad la phan pa'i mig sman ni/ ni ram li dang dza sta shadakar gnyis me ha ri'i khu bas rta byas brdar nas mig la byugs pas na zhi zhing gsal ba bstan rngu pa sogs 'byung ngo / /mig la srod long byung na/ su ra ma dang ha la dhi lda seng gnyis dza ba tro'i dzāti'ime tog khu bas khar ba'i snod du brdar la mig la byugs pas phan no/ /mig dmar por song zhing na na/ ma ri tsi/—— phoris/ ge ru/—— btsag /khi ri lo ṇa lba tshwa gsum cha mnyam zhib par btags pa chu la sbyar nas mig gi phyi'i mtha' skor la byugs na phan par 'gyur ro/ /khrag la brten pa'i mig na na/ sernya lo ṇa rgyamatshwanas tsam ra snum la brdar nas mig gi nang la byugs na phan no/ /rlung la brten pa'i mig mi gsal zhing / khyad par rgyang mig mi gsal ba la/ pa ra/—— dngul chu/ dzasta/— sha dkar/ siṅgi mi sri/ mukta ka—— mutig / u ṭi zhuka dam ta/ — rngamong gi so/ a ru sa rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la khar 5 snod du ra'i 'o mas khu ba byas la khyelegs par brdar nas mig nang du byugs na phan par 'gyur zhing / mig gi 'grib la yang phan no/ /yang na/ mṛ ta tasba/ zangs btul ma/ dzasta/— sha dkar/ — la tho tha/snye big pan/pha ṭa ki ri/ sa mu dra phe na rgyamatshophru ⑥ba rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags/ de nas khar sdod du ba'i mar dang mnyam du legs par snur la mig nad la byugs 120—865

—/de—— — ——/de————— —pas kyang phan no/ /yang mig na ba la/ shwe ta dzi ta/ ziradakar po/ pha ṭa ki ri/tri pha la/ 'bras bu gsum/ sba ba/ ra sa pa ti/ ha le ma/ ha la dhi/ sga ser / lo dha rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags/ ras dri med pa'i nang du gtums la chu gtsang ma cung zad bcug la / de nas mig la bdugs na phan no/ /yang mig gi rab rib la/ su ra ma/ sendha lo ṇa/— rgyamatshwa/ shaṅka / — dung /ma ni 'a la/— ldong ros/ tri ku ṭa/ — tsha ba gsum/ ni ra ma li/ siṅgi mi sri—/ sa mu dra phe na rgyamatsho1 ye ba rnams zhib par btags la khar snod du ra'i 'o ma dang mnyam du snur la de nas mig nang du byugs pas phan zhing ling tog la yang phan no/ /yang mig 'grib pa/ ling tog /sha 'dzer/ rab rib la sogs pa 6mig gi nad thams cad la phan pa'i spyi 'joms chen mo ni/ si zhanye sa bzhus pa ba dar zhag lon pa skyur mo'i nang du blug /de khengs /5pa dang slang 9 yang bzhu nas lugs thengs re la dar ba brje / —thengs re byas pa lan bcu'i bar byas/ beeng 11 yang de bzhin gi ba ko ṭi'i khu bar lugs thengs bcu byas / a ka ba na'i khu bar lan bcu/ bhaṅga ra'i khu bar lan bcu/ ba'i chur lan bcu/ tri pha la'i 'bras bu gsum khu bar lan bcu/ ba'i 'o ma'i spyir lan bcu/ ba'i gabyu ba zlon skapar lan bcu/ ba'i zhor lan bcu/ til sgrum la lan bcu/ ba'i 'o mar lan bcu/ ba'i mar la lan bcu/ nisba'i khu bar lan bcu rnams bzhu lugs rim par byas/ slar bzhu ba'i nang du dngul chu zha nye rang dang ljid 1 mnyam pa zhig blug /de nas 'khar snod gla rtsi dang mnyam du ra'i 'o mas khu ba byas nas brdar te mig la byugs pas kun la phan zhing mig 'grib zin yang bye bar 'gyur ro/ /rna ba na ba la/ a ka ka 720 866

ra sa/— a ka'i khu ba/ sgog skya'i khu ba/— la su ṇa ka ra sa/ ka la ti la tilanag gsum cha mnyam bsres la rna bar blugs pas phan zhing rna ba 'on nas lo mang po ma song bas kyang lkuthos par 'gyur ro/ /yang na/ de wa da ru/ — shugapa/ ba tsathu/ shu dag /shubyu/ lda/ sernya lo ṇa/ rgyamatsha1/ satso lo na kharu tsha ④rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags pa pera'i chu la btab ste cung zad skol byerna bar blugs na'ang nus pa gong dang 'dra'o/ /rlung la brten pa'i mgo bo na ba la/ de wa da ru—/ snye shugapa/ shuṇḍa/ — rurta⑦/ ka yi pha la/ a raṇḍa ka ta la dudanda'i⑨ snum rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags pa bzo lugs gong du bstan pa'i 'gros byas nas ⑩drug pa'i chu skyur mo des khu ba byas te shā1mer cung zad skol la mgo bor byugs pas phan no / /bad kan la brten pa'i mgo bo na na/ e raṇḍa/— daṇḍa⑫/ ra sa ni/kuṣṭha / — ru rta⑫/ mañdziṣṭha/— btsod/ ba tsa/ — shudag bee ba ra/ na ga ra mo tha mnu gla sgang rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la chur gar sla zho tsam sbyar me la cung zad bsros te mgo bor byugs pas phan no/ /mkhris pa la brten pa'i mgo bo na na—/ shwe ta tsan dan/ tsan dan dkar po/ se ba/ — a rur/ du hūṃzib/ ka ta ra mi/ ja 'ab/— b.la'i rtsa ba/ yinasba 'ab/ skyuru ra/ ka ma 'ab ka ba/— kamala'i 'bru/ hu tha/ hu lu bi dza hu lu lu la'i 'bru rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la mgo bor byugs pas phan no/ /yang rlung mkhris bad kan sogs gang la brten kyang mgo bo na ba'i spyi sman ni/ kuṣṭha/— rurta⑫/ ma ri tsi/ — phoris/ ka yi pha la/ e raṇḍa ka dza la rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags nas gar bee zho tsam chur sbyar la mer cung zad bsres te mgo bor byugs pas mgo nad kun la phan nges so/ /yang na/ pibee la—/ snye drod sman/ ma ri tsi/snye phoris/ ha ri ta ke/ arur/ rnams cha mnyam 120—867

zhib par btags pa gong gi chu sgyur mos gar sla zho tsam sbyar la mgo bor byugs pas phan no/ /skra dkar nag por gtong na/ lu ha tsarṇa/ lcags bye/ ni la tho tha / big nga na/ tri pha la 'brasabu gsum rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags/ de nas lcags snod du/ bhaṅga ra sa'i khu ba dang 1 mnyam du nyin gsum gyi bar legs par snur la gar sla zho tsam byung ba dang ra'i chus gar sla dang ba tsam sbyangs la srod la skra rgya sma ra sogs gang 'dod la bsku 2mnye legs par byas rjes ras bkab ste bzhag /sang nyi ma shar ba dang chu dro mos bkrus pas nag por 'gyur nges shing / slar yang dkar po byung na gong bzhin byas pas phan no/ /bud med kyi mngal khrag mang du 'dzag nas na na/ ga dza ke sa re/ ti khu ra/ tha rams shwe ta tsan dan tsan dan dalar ngo/ ba la lo tsa na rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la/ 'bras bkrus pa'i khu bas rta byas btang na chod par 'gyur ro/ /yang na/ ga dza ka sa re dang si ta theladakhrer gnyis cha mnyam zhib par btags pa thang thun chung phyogs tsam re 'bras bkrus pa'i khu bas gar bee zho tsam byas btang kyang phan no/ /yang bud med zla mtshan mi 'dzag cing phru 4 gu mi yong ba la/tumbi ka bi dza/ ku ha'i 'bru/ ya ba kha ra/ bye tsher ba/ ghu ra/ bu ram / pibeel/ drod sma na— me na pa la/ me na'i 'bras bu/ ha la bye rnams lngaser 5cha mnyam zhib par btags la se hu ḍa ka du dzas sbyar la ras lder byugs nas mtshan mar bcug pas zla mtshan dang ldan zhing mngal 'dzin par 'gyur la/ sha ma ma thon pa yang thon zhing mo nad dngos gzhi 6la yang phan no/ /yang na/ se ra sa ka pa ta/ si ra nga 'i lo ma/ ja ye pha la/ dzā snye ti'i lo ma/ sa mu dra pha na/ rgyamatsho'i lbu /ba/ ba ye bi raṅga / byi thang la /e la ya zirdo/ karko la/ ga dza ke sa ra rnams cha mnyam zhib 720—868

par btags pa thun tshad zho re chus ril bu sgril la ba mdog dkar rkyang ngam nag rkyang ①sogs kha dog gang yin yang mdog gzhan 'dres pa ⑤med pa be'u pho skyes pa'i 'o mas rta byas btang bas mngal dang ldan par 'gyur la/ sman gtong ring 'bras la ze ma cung zad btab pa/ mar/ sbrang rtsi ja 'jam po rngutshwa med rnams las bza' btung gzhan mi gtong / yang na/ ma ri tse④/——pho ris/shubyu—/ snyelda/ pibee la/ —drod sman/ ga dza ke sa ra/ raṅga na rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la ba mar bzhus pas 'urta byas btang kyang mngal dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /yang na/ ga dza ke sa ra/ a sa garnya/——ba spru ba/ seta/snyeka ra/go lo tsa na gihangarnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la ba mdog gcig ma bee'u pho skyes pa'i 'o mas rta byas btang na yang sbrum par 'gyur la/ sman gtong ring 'bras za zhing 'o ma 'thung ngo / /yang na/ ga dza ke so ra zhib par btags la ba mar bzhus pas ⑥rta byas nas btungs kyang gong dang 'dra'o/ /yang nges par phrug ⑦gu yod pa'i sman pyong grub ni/ lakyu ma na'i rtsa ba zhib par btags la ba mdog gcig ma bee'u pho skyes pa'i 'o mas rta byas te hrabatang na nges par mngal dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /zas spyod gong dang 'dra/ bud med phrug gu 'jur nas mi sdod na/ dha ba ka phu la/——dhaba'i'abru/ ka ma la ka ṭa/——ka ma la'i 'bru/ba ma ṣpe ṣṭha/— dma' ru mgo nag gi rtsa ba/ la dza ru rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la/ 'bras bkrus pa'i khu bas rta byas btang na 'jur bar mi 'gyur ro//sbrum ma btsa' ma thub pa la/ se hu ḍa'i 'o ma rkang lag gi sor ⑨ mo rnams dang lte bar byugs na myur du btsa' nges so/ /yang na/ muṇḍa'i rtsa ba bud med kyi mkhrig ma g.yon la bsdams na yang btsa' bar 'gyur ro/ /bud med kyi mtshan 120—869

ma chung ngu gtong na/ ba hi/ ka se la/ pha ṭa ki ri/ lo dha/ kaspu ra—/ — gapur/ be ra dza re/ ka na ya la'i pags pa/ ma dzu'i 'bras bu rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la/ mtshan ma'i nang du blugs pas ①chung ngur 'gyur ro—/ /yang na/ ma yi/ dha ba'i me tog /pha ṭi ki ri/ ma dzu'i 'bras bu/lo dha/ be ra dza ti/snye chipakha'i rtsa ba/ rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la mtshan ma'i nang du blugs na gong dang 'dra'o/ /yang na/ tri pha la lo dha—/ snye 'brasabu gsum/ dha ba'i me tog /dza mu ni ka twa rtsa ②dza mu na'i pags pa rnams zhib par btags la sbrang dang sbyar te byugs kyang gong dang 'dra'o/ /yang na/kastu ri dang /snyeglaci/ kuṣṭha ru rta ①gnyis cha mnyam zhib par btags la/ sbrang rtsis ril bu skyu ru ra tsam sgril ba mtshan mar bcug pas kyang gong dang 'dra'o/ /bud med kyi nu ma chung ngu gtong na/ a sa garnya/— basprub/ do na ga dza ke sa raske snye mkhanadupa dkar po/ pithra la/snye drodasman/ ka se la rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la ⑤slar yang chu blug ste brdar la gar sla zho tsam nu mar byugs na chung zhing mdzes par 'gyur ro/ /yang bud med kyi nu ma skrangs na/ gi wa ko ṭa'i shun pa me la bsros nas nu mar slan na 'phral du zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /pho rtags rjosbom ring mkhrang ba sogs 'dod na/ somaratsa/snye baṅga dang dha du ⑦thangaphrom ⑧ra cha mnyam a ma pha ⑨la'i khu ba dang mnyam du 'dam btags legs par byas te/ril bu sgril la grib mar skams/ de nas skyes pa gzhan dar ma'i chur zho tsam brdar la ring bar ⑩pho rtags kyi rgyab dang / sgom ring mkhrang gsum ka 'dod na—/ sgyer lo man yongs rdzogs la byugs pas ji ltar 'dod pa 'byung ngo / /yang pho rtags ⑩a sa garnya/snye basprub/ pa ra/snye dngulachu/ ga dza pisba ⑫drodasman la ha 120—870

la bye/ sgeser/ ha ri ta ke arurarnams cha mnyam ①zhib par btags la skyes pa gzhan gyi chus zho tsam sbyar la pho rtags kyi sgyer lo man la byugs pas las su rung bar 'gyur ro/ /yang 'dod pa spyod mi nus pa la/ la dza ru/ se dzu'i khu ba dang / ra'i 'o mar brdar la rkang lag gi sen mo/ rkang mthil/ lte ba rnams la byugs na 'dod pa spyod genus so/ /yang dwangs ma 'phel zhing ro tsa bar 'dod na/ ta la ma kha na/ mū sa ri kanda/ shusgyu/snye lda/ go kha ru/— gze ma ra mgo/ ka ba tsha ka bi dza/snye ka ba tsha'i 'bru/ a sa garnya/snye basprub/ sasbra ①ri phu la—/ snye padma ge sar/ pa la lo tsa na/ sa ta ba ri/ mo tsa ra sa'i mnurta rkang thang chu rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la thun tshad nyis 'gyur tsam re shel dkar mang nyung de dang 'dra ba re dang mnyam du ba'i 'o ma phor gang tsam la btab nas nyin bcu bzhi'i bar btang bas stobs bskyed cing pedwangs ma 'phel la ⑤'dod pa ci 'dod spyod nus par 'gyur ro/ /yang na/ kudkum/snye guragum/ siṅga ra ba— — rgyamatshal/ dza ye pha la/snye dzā⑥ti/ ta la ma kha na/ ka ba tsha ka bi dza/snye ka ba tshe'i 'bru/ta dza masta ki/ a ka ra ka ra/ tusba lu/ la waṅga /snye leshi/ te dze pa tra rnams cha mnyam gyi cha gcig /a phe ma cha gcig khu ra sa ni a dza wa ni la la phud chung ba cha gsum rnams zhib par btags/ de nas so ma ra tsa'i (4khu bas ril bu sran ma nyis 'gyur tsam sgril la nyal gdong ril bu re zos pas ci 'dod spyod nus so/ /lus kyi bse dri med par 'dod na/ na ga ra mo tha/ ma nu gla sgang /bee la ka bi dza/— bil ba'i 'bru/ ha ri ta ka/— a ru ra/ asba li ka pha la aspe li'i 'bras bu rnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la chur /8 sbyar nas mchan khung 'og la yang yang byugs pas med par 'gyur ro/ /kha dri mi zhim pa la/ be la/snye bilab/120——871

na ri be re'i'abras bu'i nang a ra ki ga ri/ i la ya tsi/snyekakol/ dza ye pra tri/snyedzra①ti'i me tog /ta dza/ ga dza ke sa ra/ dza ye pha la dzatirnams cha mnyam zhib par btags la sbrang rtsis rta byas ril bu sgyu ru ra tsam sgril ba nyal gdong khar bcug nas gnyid du ②nyal na dri ngan pa med par 'gyur ro/ /rlung gi nad rigs brgyad cu rtsa bzhi la thengs ①pas chog pa'i spyi 'joms 'chi med ril bu'i sbyor ba ni/ tsi tra ka dang ha ri ta ke aruraganyis zho sum cu re/ ganta ka zho muzi ser po nyishu/ shurji/snyesga/ pilpal/—drodasman/ pithra la ka mu la pi pi ling gi rtsa ba gsum zho bcu re/ kuṣṭha/snyetusta/ na ga ra mo tha/snyem nugla sgang / elaya tsi/—sug smel/ bi ṣa/snyesmanachen/ a ka ra ka ra ta/ ta dza rnams zho lnga re bcas zhib par btags la bu ram rnying pa zho sum cu so brgyad kyis rta byas ra'i chu cung zad cig rjoblug ste ril bu skyu ru ra tsam sgril la btang bas rlung la brten pa'i nad tsha grang gsar rnying gang la yang 'dis mi phan pa med do/ /sman gtong ring ro skyur ba'i rigs dang la phug mi za'o/ /rig pa 'di ni rgya mtsho dang mtshungs te/ /mtsho las dbul sel rin chen mtha' dag 'byung / /'di nyid las ni skye dgu'i tsha grang nad/ /zhi byed bdud rtsi ma tshang med par 'byung / /'di don rtogs shing khongs su chud gyur na/ /rang gzhan kun la phan bde ma lus pa/ /ster ⑤ba'i nor bu rin chen gzhan na med/ /tshul der 'bad pa drag pos 'jug par rigs—/ /mes pos tshe rigs rjomatha' med rgya mtsho las/ /snying po'i bcud bsdus legs bshad g.yo ba can/ /ji srid nam mkha' gzugs su ma grub par//dar rgyas skye dgu'i sdug bsngal sel gyur cig /ces tshangs pa'i rig ⑦byed rgya mtsho'i yan lag 'dzin pa g.yo ba can zhes bya ba bram ze'i rigs las tshe'i rig sge120—872

byed rgya mtsho lta bu'i pha rol tu son pa sarba ha tī mṛ ta datta ste kun phan bdud rtsi sbyin zhes bya bas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/845 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad 'gyur ro/ /shel dkar dang mnyam du btang na bud med bu btsas pa'i bang tshad sel bar 'gyur ro/ /ra'i chus rta byas btang na mkhris pa'i nad thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /ba'i dar ba dang mnyam du btang na pho ba na zhing sbos na 1sel bar 'gyur ro/ /a dza wa na lalaphud dang mnyam du zos na dug rigs mtha' dag la phan no/ /hiṅga shingakunadang mnyam du zos na srin nad zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /ha ri tal babalabatul ma dang mnyam du zos na mdze dkar po thon par 'gyur zhing rma gsar rnying thams cad la phan no/ /nimbu'i khu bas rta byas btang na pho ba'i gzer zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /nimbu'i 'bru dang mnyam du btang na mkhris pa'i nad thams cad la phan no/ /ha la bye sgaseradang mnyam du btang kyang phan yon gong dang 'dra/ ra'i chus rta byas btang na lus stobs che zhing mdangs dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /kubyu guragum ma'i khu ba dang mnyam du btang na skya rbab 3la phan no/ /yang gur gum gyi khu bas rta byas khong du btang zhing rna bar yang drug na rna ba 'on pas thos par 'gyur ro/ /ra'i chu la brdar nas mig la byugs na srod long sel lo/ /ra'i chus rta byas btang na dbugs stod du 'tshangs pa — sel lo/ /ni ra guṇḍa'i khu bas rta byas zos na bud med dbang du 'dus so/ /sbrang rtsi dang mnyam du btang na lce'i dog sel lo/ /ko ci la 'bras tsam re dang mnyam du btang na skra rgya sma ra sogs dkar por song ba slar yang nag por 'gyur ro/ /ni ra guṇḍa'i khu ba dang mnyam du zos na skya rbab 4sel bar 'gyur zhing chu nad tsha grang gang la yang phan no/ /ha la bye sgaseradang mnyam du btang na khrag mkhris kyi nad zhi bar byed do/ /ha la bye sgaseradang mnyam du ba mar la sbyar nas lba ba la byugs na skem par 'gyur ro/ /ba mdog 120—878

gcig ma'i mar la sbyar nas mig la byugs na 'dre gdon gang gis kyang gnod pa mi 'byung ngo / /til mar la sbyar nas mig la byugs na mig gi nad thams cad la phan zhing gsal bar 'gyur ro/ /ni ra guṇḍa'i khu bar sbyar la snar blug na ya mas mgo phyed na ba sel lo/ /ba dar gyis rta byas btang na dmu rjings kyi sna nad sel lo/ /tu la se ka tulase'i me tog pa ta dang mnyam du zos na tsha ba'i nad thams cad sel lo/ /tsa ra tsi ri dang mnyam du zos na stobs glang po dang mnyam par 'gyur ro/ /ka ro dha/ raṅga ni/ bai ri gsum gyi khu ba zho bzhi re dang mnyam du zos na dwangs ma 'phel zhing lus stobs che la mdangs gsal zhing gzhon sha chags pa sogs phan yon dpag tu med do/ /de rnams ni sa mu dra pha la kha sgyur dang bcas pa'o/ /bhaṅga ra/ saṃ bha lu'i 'bras bu/ lo ma/ gurtsa/— li khri—/ ha ri ta ke/snye aru ra/ ba yi ra/ ba rur/ asba la/ skyu rur/ tsi ta'i 'dru/ shun pa rnams so sor zho drug cu re gnyis re/ nag ri mu sa ri zho lnga bcu nga dgu/ tsa ka ba dza ga zho nyi shu rtsa drug /dā li shingatshakwatsi ni zho bco lnga rnams zhib par btags la/ bu ram zho drug brgya dang mnyam du 'dres par snur la legs par 'dres pa dang ril bu sum brgya bsgril la/ da nas snga 1dro zas gang yang ma zos pa'i sngon du ril bu re nyin ltar gyis zla ba gcig gi bar zos na khog nang gi nad thams cad zhi bar 'gyur la/ zla ba gnyis kyi bar du zos na lus yang bar 'gyur ro/ /zla ba gsum gyi bar du zos na mdangs gsal/zla ba bzhi'i bar du zos na stobs 'phel/ zla ba lnga'i bar du zos na skra dkar por song ba skra ④nag por 'gyur/ zla ba 1drug gi bar du zos na lus rgyags par 'gyur/ zla ba bdun gyi bar du zos na gla ba'i mig ltar gsal bar 'gyur 120—879

la / zla ba brgyad kyi bar du zos na sems dran pa gsal zhing sngar brjed pa rnams kyang dran par 'gyur ro/ /zla ba dgu'i bar du zos na rgyang ring po yang mig gis 1mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /zla ba bcu'i bar du zos na sa 'og gi co gter mang po rnyed par 'gyur ba sogs yon tan mtha' yas so/ /ha ri ta ke/ a rur/ba yi ra/— ba rur/ adza la/— skyu ru ra/ tsa ka ba ḍa/— thal dkar rdo rje/ tsa ra tsi ri/ gurtsa/ likhri/ bhaṅga ra rnams so so nas srang bco lnga re/ zitsha/— sadzha khar dang lu ha tsurṇa lcags phye gnyis zho bcu gnyis re/ te dza ba la zho gsum/sesba ri mnurtarkang zho bzhi rnams zhib par btags la bu ram rnying ba srang drug cu dang mnyam du snur la legs par khu'adres pa dang ril bu sum brgya bsgril thul de nas snga dro lto stong la ril bu re nyin ltar gyis zla ba gcig gi/ bar zos pas khong nang gi nad dang mi gtsang ba mtha' dag dbyung ste lus shel gong ltar 'gyur ro / /zla ba gnyis kyi bar zos na mdangs gsal bar 'gyur/ zla ba gsum gyi bar du zos na lus stobs dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /zla ba bzhi'i bar du zos na bad kan gyi nad thams cad rtsa ba nas thon par 'gyur ro/ /zla ba lnga'i bar du zos na skra dang kha spu dkar por song ba slar nag por 'gyur ro/ /zla ba drug gi bar du zos na so don pa slar ⑤skye bar 'gyur ro/ /zla ba bdun gyi bar du zos na mig shin tu gsal zhing ⑪rgyang ring po'ang mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /zla ba brgyad kyi bar du zos na mjo'i rigs thams cad rtsa ba nas thon par 'gyur ro//zla ba dgu'i bar du zos na dwangs ma shin tu 'phel zhing lus gzi brjid dang ldan la 'dod pa'ang ci 'dod spyod nus par 'gyur ro/ /zla ba bcu'i bar du zos na mngon par shes pa thogs med 'byung ba sogs phan yon bsam pa'i ra ba las 120—880

'das so/ /pa lag sha la brten pa'i man ngag khyad par can kun la med pa'i khyad chos/ slob dpon ha ri ha ri bha dzi'i ①gdams pa zab mo ni/ pa la sha ba dze'i palasha'i 'bru sgrum legs par bton ④la/ snum se ba phyed/ sbrang rtsi se ba phyed gnyis/ ba mar se ba do ①ste yongs sgril se ba bzhi'i rtsis re grangs dultar chags rgyun du zos na nyin mo'ang skar ma thams cad mthong / tshe ring thung lha dang mnyam/ gzhan gyis mthong na lus shin tu ring zhing sbom pa blos mi 'khyud pa tsam du mthong / gzi brjid nyi ma dang mnyam pas gzhan gyis glags lta bar mi nus/ lus mdzes shing blta na sdug pa 'dod lha dang mnyam/ gang 'dod du bsam pa tsam gyis sleb/ glo ⑤gros phur bu dang mnyam/ gang smras kun gyis dubaden par 'dzin zhing nyan pa dga' byed dpa' bo dang mtshungs/lus la gzhan gang gis kyang gnod pas mi tshugs/ rang nyid lus 'dor bar 'dod na ma gtogs ⑦stobs rtsal dang ldan par bskal pa grangs med kyi bar du gnas par 'gyur/ yang tho rangs gong bzhin la/ phyi dro pa la sha'i rtsa ba/shing / lo ma/ me tog /'bras bu lnga cha mnyam zhib par btags pa se ba bzhi—/ ba mar dang sbrang rtsi se ba do re bcas zos na sa gzhir ⑧rkang pa khru gang tsam ma reg par bar snang la 'gro/ lcags dang zangs me la bsregs par dri chu bran na gser du 'gyur/ lus la grib ma mi 'byung ba sogs yon tan dpag tu med pa thob/ de yang thog mar sman btang nas lo bcu gnyis tshun gong gi rtags de rnams rdzogs par rim can du 'byung ngo / /thog ma sman spyor ba dang za ba gnyis ka gza' skar legs pa la byed do/ /nad gsar rnying tsha grang gang la'ang sbyongs 'gro ba'i rigs la gtong na/ bi da ra zhib par btags la zho 120—881

gsum chu skol gyis phul la btang nas lus ma 'khyags pa byas/ de nas ma dag par chu skol gyis lcag 4rim bzhin rgyab la gcod mtshams su sleb pa dang rkang lag chu grang mos bkrus par chod la/ rjes kyi zas spyod sogs sbyong spyi /khyadang 'dra'o/ / /phyag ja sna da/ dbyemong / byu/ ta/ ma lnga/ byu1/— phoris/ pibee 'a / drod sman / ba yi bi raṅga / — byi thang ka /de ba da ru/— shugapa/ sandha nghru /lo ṇa/ rgyamatsha④ /pibee la ka mu la/ pi pi ling gi rtsa ba/ shurji/ — lga/ si la dza 2 ta rnams srang re/ha ri ta ka ⑪arur srang lnga rnams zhib par btags la bu ram srang bco lngas rta byas ril bu sgyu ru ra tsam sgril la chu skol bzhi cha bsdus pa tsam gyis ④phul nas tho rangs btang bas pho ba mi bde ba/ tshad pa/ bad kan/ rlung skran/srin nad/ gzhang 'brum/ lte ba'i rlung gzer/ tshags tshigs na ba/ pho ba sgos 'khrogabye /kha dri mi zhim pa/ rlung 1snagi rigs/ 'dus pa rnams la mchog tu phan zhing dang 1 kha 'byed par 'gyur ro/ /ka ka dzee gi'i rtsa ba nad pa'i chu la brdar nas rma gang yod la byugs pas mda' gri phog pa sogs rma gsar rnying kun bsos rte1shing khrag kyang chad do/ /khyi smyo ba dang ma smyo ba gang gis rmugs kyang / tsa ra tsi ri'i lo ma phyed dang gsum/ bu ram ba ru ra tsam de dang mnyam du khong du btang zhing / lo ma chur brdar ba rma khar yang byugs pas rma myur du bsos zhing khyi dug gi gnod pa 1— yang mi 'byung ngo / /gsha' /snyedakar/ gsha'altostedakar la sogs pa btul ma 'di rnams sman sbyor gang dang gang gi skabs su de dang de btul dgos pa byung na so so'i kha sgyur rnams dor te btags parahu5/ rgya mtshal/ lhang tsher/ zangs/ beegs sogs/'dul thabs las/ gsha' khodakar 'dul lugs ni/ chang 7zho bcu bzhu ba'i hu5nang du dngul chu zho/ sa tshepa dang rdza'i spar bu lta bu khebs ldan gye nang tshwa 720—882

zhib mos brgyangs pa'i dkyil du bcug nas kha legs par bcadalku/ mothug nas phyed tsam gyis gtumasaldu/ de nas sa dong khru gang tsam zhig brus la ra'i 1ril mas bkang ba'i dkyil du bcug /de la me sbar te me ma yal byatsam la slar yang ril ma bsnan te zhag gsum gyi (1sgroba'i khu ba srang lnga dang mnyam du blugs la kha legs par bsdams nas kha mtshams 'jim 'upas byugs la rlung mi 'gro bar rngu byas te nyin phyed tsam gyi bar shing gi me mtshams ma chad par btang /de nas bton la grang zuthag chod thog kyirdo gzhong gi nang du zhib par btags/thog mar gro tsam re dang / de nas sran ma tsam re dzā ⑪ ti'i bzhi cha re dang mnyam du btang na lus stobs 'phel/ dang tso7kha bde/ gzhon sha chags pa sogs yon tan mtha' yas pa 'byung ngo / /rgya mtshal 'dul thabs ni/ siṅga ra pha rgyamatshalasrang do bil ba'i 'bras bu'i kha nas mjeb gang tsam ma chags tso5pa sgor ba'i nang du nyu5blug /de nas sgor ba des kha bcad/ ras brdungs pa bsres pa'i 'jim pa sbyin po'i srab mthug 1zinas gang tsam gyis gtums ⑫/ de nas sa dong brus la ra'i ril ma'i nang na rnge gtong lugs yun tshad sogs gong bzhin tshar ba dang bton/ 'jim ⑩pa la sogs gang legs par byas rjes rgya mtshal bil ba dang dbyer med song ba de rdo gzhong gi nang du legs par sgrur la sran ma tsam re li shi rdog bzhi tsam btags pa dang mnyam du btang kyang yon tan gong dang 'dra'o/ /lhang tsher 'dul thabs ni/ a bha ka lhangatsher srang lnga/snum bton pa'i ro ma ba chu srang bcu dang mnyam du legs par brdungs te srab mthug shābye bag leb tsam byas la skam thag chod pa dang gci nyunaba'i me'i dkyil du nyin phyed tsam gyi bar bsregs/ de nas bton la grang thag chod pa dang gi la nyu 7120—883

ko ṭi'i khu ba dang mnyam du rdo gzhong nang du nyin gcig gi ring brdar te slar yang srab mthug shebag leb tsam bzosakye/ de skam thag chod pa dang gong bzhin gci kyiba'i me nang du nyin phyed kyi bar bsregs/ ma he ri'i khya bas nyin gcig gi bar nyed pa dang bag leb tsam bcos nas gci ba'i mer bsregs pa sogs sngar bzhin byas/ ban bu ṣṭha'i khu ba dang mnyam du nyed pa sogs gzhan ma gong dang 'dra ba la gci ba'i byeme nang du nyin gcig gi bar bsregs la/ de nas grang thuthag chod pa dang bton la rdo gzhong nang du zhib par btags la ras la btsags / de nas 'bras tsam re li shi bzhi tsam brdungs pa'i phye ma dang mnyam du btang bas lus rgyags pa/ brtan pa/ gzi mdangs che ba/ rgas — snasra ba/'dod pa spyod nus pa sogs stobs bskyed kun gyi mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /zangs 'dul thabs ni/ talba zangasamang nyung ji ltar 'dod pa sbrang gshog legs par 'then te 3mer bsregs/ de snum gyi dkyil du bcug /yang mer bsregs / snum nang du 'jug pa sogs lan bdun gye bar byas/ de bzhin du rim pa ltar/ dar ba/ ba'i chu/ ba'i zho star ldubu'i khu ba rnams lan bdun re byas rjes/ de nas rdza sgod du ra'i chu zangs mang nyung dang bstun pa'i snod kyi phyed tsam gang ba blug la me btang ste/ chu de skam thag chod pa dang chu gtsang mas legs par bkrus/ de nas dngul chu zangs leb gang yod kyi phyi nang tshang mar mdog dkar por ma song bar byugs/ de steng bhaṅga ri'i khu ba legs par byugs/ de nas zangs dang ljid lakyemanyam pa'i mu zi ser po btags pa zangs brtsegs pa'i srubs la khod ⑫snyoms yod pa byas nas khog ma gsar pa'i nang du bcug /khog ma'i kha dam par bcad de kha mtshams 'jim pas 120—884

gtums gye7nas rlung mi 'gro bar bya lge/ de lcags sgyed lta bu'i steng du bzhag nas nyin gnyis dang mtshan gcig gi bar me mtshams ma chad par btang / de yang nyin dang po la me cung zad chung ba btang / nyin mtshan phyi ma gnyis la shin tu tsha ba btang / de nas grang 1thag chod pa dang ras kyi khud du gtums ④nas chu gtsang mar 'jug 'don thengs lnga tsam byas/ de rjes skam thag chod pa dang rdo gzhong du zhib par btags/ de nas 'bras tsam re nam zla grang dus li shi dang / dro ⑤dus ka ko la dang mnyam du btang bas pho ba'i me drod ches 'u cher bskyed de zas gang zos kyang 'phral du 'ju bas dang ⑦kha shin tu bde la lus gzi mdangs dang stobs rtsal che zhing gzhon sha chags pa sogs yon tan dpag tu med pa 'byung ngo / /lcags 'dul lugs ni/ lu ha lcagasamang nyung ji ltar 'dod pa srab 'thug 6nas phyed tsam brdungs pa sor bzhi gru bzhi tsam pa bcos/de rdza snod kyi nang du bi sa kha pa ri'i khu ba dang mnyam du blug la nyi ma gang tsha sar zhag nyi shu'i bar khu ba skam rim bzhin blug nas bzhag /zhag grangs thim pa dang bton la slar yang gong bzhin la phug btsir ⑨ ba'i khu ba dang mnyam du zhag nyi shu'i bar bzhag /de nas bton la sol ba'i me nang du skam pas bzung la dmar por tshig pa dang ba'i chu'i nang du bcug /slar yang sreg 'jug gong bzhin lan lnga'i bar byas la/ de nas rdo gzhong nang du zhib par btags la nas tsam re nam zla grong dus bee dang / dro dus ka ko la dang mnyam du zos pas bya dwangs ma 'phel zhing lus stobs bskyed la/ mu sa ba ra dang mnyam du zos na dmu rdzings ⑪dang skya rbab ⑩sel/ a ka ra ka dang la baṅga lishicha mnyam btags pa se ba phyed do dang / gong gi lcags phye se ba phyed bcas btang na dang ⑫kha mi 120—885

bde ba/ glo/ mig ser rnams la phan no/ /zha nye nag po 'dul thabs ni/shi sha zhanyenag po mang nyung ji ltar 'dod pa srab mthug rmyeras tsam brdungs pa sen mo tsam du gtubs 'u/ de dang ljid ①mnyam pa'i pibee la drodasman dang mnyam du rdo gzhong nang du nyin gnyis kyi bar skam nyed zhib par byas/ de nas ras la btsags pa se ba phyed shel dkar dang li shi cha mnyam du btags pa zho re dang mnyam du btang na/ lus shin tu rid cing shed krumed pa sogs la mdangs dang lus stobs mchog tu bzang bar 'gyur ro/ /gsha' 5tshe 'dul thabs ni/sa ta gsha' 6tshe ji ltar ⑦'dod pa lcags snod du bzhu ba de dang ljid ldu mnyam pa'i bku tsi zhib par btags pa thug thal ltar 'debs shing dkrug /de legs par 'dres nas nas khangs pa dang rdo gzhong nang du zhib par btags la ras la btsags pa se ba phyed shel dkar dang ka ko la cha mnyam du btags pa se ba bzhi dang mnyam du btang na tsha ba'i nad rigs thams cad la phan no/ /bab la 'dul thabs ni/ ha ri ta la ta ba ki bab la bcag na cig khya bu ltar shun pa 'bye rgyu yod pa zhig yod srang nyi shu zhib par btags la ras la gtums ( )khog mar gong gi 'bras chu skyur mo'i nang du bcug la ras khog ma'i mthil la ma reg pa'i ngos ras thum ⑪ chu dkyil du yong ba'i thi gu ri thung 'tsham ⑫pa btags pa'i shing tshag khog ma'i khar 'jog /khog ma lcags sgyed lta bu'i steng du bzhag nas me nyin phyed kyi ring bar ma chad par btang / de nas bton la rdo gzhong nang du a bye pa la srang do dang mnyam ras shing gi rtsa bas khu ba byas la nyin gsum gyi bar du snur/ de bzhin du pa la sha'i khu ba/ baṅga ⑫ri'i khya ba/ da dhu ra'i khu ba/ ku ha ḍa'i khu ba/ba ṭa ku i'i khu ba rnams kyis rim pa bzhin nyin gsum re'i bar snur la/ de 120—886

nas srab 'thug bag lo chotsam byas la skam/ de nas khog ma'i nang du pa la sha brdar ba'i phye mas khog ma'i phyed brgyangs pa'i snyesteng du bzhag /de steng du yang shing phye khengs par blug la kha gcod legs par 'grig pa'i mtshams 'jim pas gtums ④nas rlung mi 'chor ba byas/ de lcags sgyed kyi steng du bzhag la thog mar nyin phyed kyi bar me chung ba rta ma chad tsam re btang / de nas nyin phyed kyi bar de las che tsam btang / de nas nyin mtshan gnyis kyi ring me shin tu tsha ba btang / de nas grang thag chod pa dang bton la rdo gzhong gi nang du zhib par btags la ras la btsags pa se ba phyed dang hla bye beeserazho do dang mnyam du zos na khrag mkhris kyi nad sel lo/ ba yi bi raṅga byithangaka zho gang ha la bye zho do bcas zhag snyenyi shu rtsa gcig gi ring zos na skom pa'i thund sel bar 'gyur ro/ /tsa ra tsi ri'i thang chu zho lnga dang sendha lo ṇa rgyamatshazho gang bcas pa zla gcig zhag bcu dgu'i bar zos na mdze dkar po'i rigs rtsa ba nas thon no/ /pibee la drodasman zho do dang a ja wa ṇa lalaphud zho lnga bcas pa zhag grangs gong 'dra zos na pags nad shu 'gram sogs sel lo/ /ba ku tsi dang na gi zho gsum re bcas pa zla gcig zhag bcu dgu'i bar zos na mdze nag po'i rigs rtsa ba nas thon no/ /dza ya pa tri dzati'ime tog dang khu ra sa a dza wa lalaphug chung ba ni zho re bcas pa zhag grangs gong 'dra zos na sha bkra'i nad sal dzwalo/ /ni ra guṇḍi'i khu ba zho gsum—/ la baṅga lishizho lnga dang bcas pa zla ba shāgacig zhag bcu dgu'i bar zos na mdzes sor mo gum pa dang yan lag zha ba sogs sos so/ /shwe ta su ba ri go yu bcag na kha dog dkar po yod pa dang ma ri tsi phorisazho re bcas pa zhag grangs gong 'dra zos na khrag la brten pa'i mdze la phan no/ /pibee la'i drodasman pags pa dang dza 120—887

mu ni'i pags pa zho gsum re bcas pa zla gcig zhag bcu dgu'i bar zos na mdzes sor mo 'am yan lag chad pa dang / sna chad pa zhom pa sogs sos lkuso/ /pa la lo tsa ṇa dang pa na zho re bcas pa zhag grangs gong bzhin zos na rlung la brten pa'i yan lag zha grum/ grang lde/ba sogs bsos par 'gyur ro/ /sbrang rtsi dang mnyam du zhag thubacu bzhi'i bar zos na 'dus pa'i nad sel lo/ /la waṅga se ba lishibazhi dang mnyam du zhag grangs gong 'dra zos na bse dug gi nad sel lo/ /pibee la drodasman dang sernya lo ṇa rgyatshazho re/ la waṅga lishizho do dang bcas zla ba gcig zhag bcu dgu'i bar zos na dmu rjings kyi ④nad thams cad sel bar 'gyur ro/ /ke la'i khu ba/ pibee la/——drod sman/ gurathuramagasum zho do dang bcas pa zhag grangs gong bzhin zos na mgo gzer gyi nad sel lo/ /shuṇḍi dang a sa ganta basprub zho re dang bcas pa zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar zos na khong nang gi rlung skran zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /dza la kumbi zho gsum/ hi ra bi'i khu ba zho gang dang bcas pa zla gcig gam chozhag bcu dgu'i bar du zos na mdze rigs khuthams cad rtsa ba nas thon no/ /pithra la drodasman dngad dhu ra'i thangaphrom⑦ khu ba zho re/ pa na dum tsam dang bcas pa zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar du zos na sgrags pa dang 'byin pa sel lo/ /e raṇḍa'i daṇḍartsirtsa ba dang rnguyi bi raṅga zho bye thang do re/ dza ye pha la dzā⑫tizho gang dang bcas pa nyin bcu bzhi'i bar zos na srin nad rtsa ba nas 'byin no/ /na ga da ba ni'i rtsa ba/ ka pa dza/ shuṇḍi ldagasum zho do re dang bcas pa zla gcig zhag bcu dgu'i bar zos na rtsa 'dar gyi nad sel lo/ /baṅga na'i khu ba zho do dang mnyam du zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar zos na sna'i nad sel lo/ / ti ta lkub ro la'i ⑫ gser me 0/ khya ba zho do/ raṅga ni'i khya ba 120—888

zho drug dang bcas pa nyin bcu bzhi'i bar zos na mtshan bar rdol ba'i nad sel lo / /nimbi'i pags pa zho do/ a dza wa ni lalaphud zho brgyad dang bcas pa zhag nyer gcig gi bar btang na gzhang 'brum gyi nad sel lo/ / pibee la'i 1khu ba zho do dang mnyam du zos na mri gi'i nad sel lo/ /tsa ra tsi ri'i khu ba dang /shuṇḍi lhazho gsum re dang bcas pa zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar zos na za phrug gi nad sel lo/ /sbrang rtsi dang raṅga ni zho gsum re dang bcas pa zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar zos kyang phan yon gong dang 'dra'o/ /de rnams ni bab la btul ma kha bsgyur 2snadang bcas pa'i phan yon te/ sman de rnams gtong ring ro sgyur ba dang la phug mi bza'/ khyad par mdze nad kyi rigs la gtong skabs zas gang la'ang cha —bsrung dgos so/ /gsha' 4dkar ram zha nye dkar po 'dul lugs ni/ gsha' dkar 7raṅga srang phyed gsum srab mthug khyeshog bu tsam brdungs pa sen mo tsam du gtubs/ a dza wa lalaphud ni dang be ḍa ha bturaganyis srang nyi shu re so sor zhib par btags la gci chesgyub khru gang gru bzhi tsam brtsegs pa'i steng du ras bting / de steng gong gi la la phud kyi phye ma'i phyed stoms par brdal de steng ba ru ra'i phye ma'i phyed stoms par bting / de steng gong gi zha nye dkar po bkram/ de steng la la phud kyi phyi ma phyed po brdal/ de steng ba ru ra'i phye ma phyed po brdal la gci ba'i kyime sbar te me ma yal tsubar bzhag /grang thag chod pa dang zha nye dkar po rnams sgrugs la rdo gzhong du zhib par btags te ras la btsags pa se ba gang / e la ya 1 tsi se ba gang dang shel dkar zho gang bcas zla ba gcig gi bar btang na lus rgyags pa/ brtan pa/ gzi mdangs che ba/ yang ba/ rgas kha sra ba sogs yon tan dpag tu med cing 120—889

—/de/de/de /deri batta/ pho re mant+ra i shwa ro ba tsa/ zhes pa'i sngags 'di dag par bzung la thog mar nyi zla gang rung gza' 'dzin yod dus mdun du mar me/ spos/lug sha tshon tsam/ chang phud bcas bza' 1'dzin ma grol bar bsnyen pa gang 'gro skyel/ de rjes rang bsrung na gang dgos dus bzlas shing / gzhan 'dre gdon gyis gnod pa la phus btab pas/ sha za/ yi dwags/ 'byung po sogs 'dre gdon gang gis kyang glags mi rnyed do/ /yang / ha tha kha pa ra ka re re ka pa la/ ma ri ma sa ni hūṃ byu dro mo hi ra khe ma ha ma gā la/ a de bai ro ki rakṣa/ u ka de bai ro ki rakṣa/ yo ga rakṣe yo gi shwa ra/ ka ya ya gerakṣe bye sa su ra/ se sa ra rakṣe sī ta la/ nyi yo rakṣe ba ma ha rede/ ba ma rakṣe kṣe tra pā la/ na bo na ri ba ha tra ko ṭha ra rakṣe ba ra bi ra/ kau na bi ra ha nu minta bi ra / rā dza bā ma tsand+ra ke pa yi ka /ma he sha kuṇḍi ki ba ha na/ sī tā ke sa ho da la/ me ri bhaste/ ku ru ki sasti/ pho ri masto i shwa ro ba tsa/ zhes pa 'di dag par bzung gel rab mig dmar gzar nam yod dang / de min zla ba rer mig dmar yod pa'i tshes grangs gang yin la ngo ma stongs tsam re khrus byas/mdun du ras gtsang ma'i steng gro phye/ mar/ dkar 0gsum bsres pa'i ril bu bya sgang etsam gcig /de'i steng du sind+ra ra tshon tsam/ mar me/ spos dang bcas bzhag la tshar gsum las mi nyung ba'i gang spyogs re bzlas na gzhan gyis sngags/ rdzas/ ting nge 'dzin sogs kyi sgo nas ngan byed byas pa thams cad byed po kho rang la bzlog pa las glags rnyed par mi 'gyur zhing 'dre gdon kyi gnod pa'ang mi 'byung ngo / /a de sha gu ru gum purba de sha yo gi ni/ pa tshi ma ni ra dha ra/ basmyo khaṃ ḍa pā haṃ pra dha ra/ i shwa ra ma hā de ba/ ru pe pā u/720 894

so du ri me saṃ ga tsa dha li/ a tra a tra dha da tsu re/ ru saṃ baṃ ho i/ ka ma ru ka mi kṣa ki do ha yi/ ru i baṃ ga do ha yi/ gra ru gorṣa na tha ki do ha yi/ me ri bhatta gu ra ki satta/ phu re mant+ra ṣpe na yo gi smi ba tsa/ zhes pa'i sngags 'di yid hūṃl bzung la g.yul la 'jug skabs sogs nam dgos dus tshar bdun bgrangs nas ldulas gang rigs la btab ste lus la byugs na gri ring thung gang gis kyang glags mi rnyed do/ /u rnguhi pa ra ba ti la ka ri maṅga yi/ so la ka ri haṃ ma tsu le dzee dza ra dzee bu/ dza ra ka dzee bu/ dzee bu ma gal ta thi/ dza ra ta te la gi/ hu ka ra yi tham bu/ tram̐ ④bi sa ka ram sa khi/ dzo hūṃ dze hūṃ te la ba re / se ra u ba ra go ra ke se ra sa thi/ phu re mant+ra e shwa ro ba tsa/ sngags 'di blo la bzung la/ snum dkrug snyeskabs tshar bdun bgrangs la lag par phus btab la dkrugs kwa pas lag pa tshig par mi 'gyur ro/ /ha tha pa kha ru/mu kha do sum̐/ ḍi ḍa ke ba rdu ba ra/ rā dza te ka sum̐ bar dza/ na rkyehā tha te rga 4snasum̐ se a ra sa du ba e bee bye/ siṅga bha shyini ka sum̐kṛ ༷/ dzisto ka re dzi bya tsa re/ba ⑩bye na ra seṅga dzi gi mu ha ni/ ra hi dza ga tra mo tsha mite/ de kho na ra seṅga ki satta / me re bhatta/ phu re mant+ra i shwa ro ba tsa/ zhes pa'i sngags 'di tshar bdun bgrangs la chur phu btab /5nas kha lag gdong gsum bkrus te phyin na/rgyal po/ rgyal phran/ blon po/ gtso bo sogs kyis dgyes par brtse bas skyong zhing rang gi 'dod pa gang yin ster mul gang smras bden par 'dzin no/ /ka thu su ba ri tsu ṇa/ i ste skyeka pe tha dhe/ pa zo wīho i la ge ma re to ma sa na ho i/ i ⑩dza ga dzi bai ho ta ra ba tsa tre/3/ me ri bhasti gu ra ki satta/ phu re mant+ra i shwa ro ba tsa/ zhes pa'i sngags 'di go yu phye mar btab pa la lan sum cu 120—895

bgrangs te bsngags la dza ra btab ste bud med gang 'dod la sbyin na rang gi dbang du 'dus nas ci zer nyan par 'gyur ro/ /sbrang bu zi ma pho mo sngon la phur ba pho dang rjes la phur ba mo'o gnyis gza' nyi ma yod pa'i nyin zin la dur khrod du pho mo ma nor ba me la bsregs pa'i thal ba ma nor ba so sor tshags byas/ de'i pho'i thal ba bud med kyis skyes pa la ①byen na skyes pa ④dbang du 'du zhing / mo'i thal ba skyes pas bud med la byin na bud ①med de dbang du 'gyur nges so/ /a ra dza ra ko ni da ba re/ a ra dza ra go ra pa dur ba ti ni da ba re/ do ta i ha nu mand+ra kai/ me ri bha tta gu ra ki satta/ phu re mant+ra i shwa ra dhib tsa ya mas mgo bo phyed na ba la mi zhig mgo bo na ba nas 'dzin du 'jug rang gis sngags 'di tshar bdun ma song bar gri rtses sa la ri mo mig mangs ris gang mang bris/sngags grangs tshar ba dang gri rtse ri mo'i dkyil du btsugs la nad gang na 'dug drisaske/ gzhan du 'phos 'dug na de nas zin la sngar ltar byas pas zug gzer rjo'aphral du chag ⑦nas nad med bde bar 'gyur ba ni myong grub zab gnad can no//de ltar shin tu zab pa'i man ngag gi tshogs 'di rnams kyang 'phags yul dbus 'gyur ma thu ra'i rgyal rigs kyi sman pa ra gu nā tha los dar mo sman rams pas rnyed pa'o// //120—896

bsdur mchan/892 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉ltar bkod/ ②〈〈snar 〉〉bzhan/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉badhe/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tha ra/⑤〈〈pe 〉〉bi/ du〈〈pe 〉〉du/894 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gza'/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉waya/ ②〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉ri/ ④〈〈snar 〉sngagazung / ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kar/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgong /895 ①〈〈pe 〉〉blo/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wanas/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skyi/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉te/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bkrugarjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bkrugs/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉ma/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉po/ po)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉gsum/ 6)〈〈pe 〉〉bo/⑫〈〈pe 〉stan/ ⑫〈〈snar 〉〉bteb/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagater/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉skyi/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉pi ṣṭha/ 〈〈snar 〉〉pi tha ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉wami/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tre/896 ①〈〈pe 〉〉kyi skyes par/ 〈〈snar 〉7) skyes pa la/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 de/ ③〈〈snar 〉〉bu/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉warapa/⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ro/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉zer/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉cags/bsdur 'bras ze'u migasna ཿdzags/ (13༷)120wa 897

༄༅/ /tshog 'byed mabong ba don ldan bzhugs so//1༄7/ /rgya gar shā dzang gi sman pa yul ba ri pu ra nas 'ongs pa'i ma na ho'i lag len zin bris su dgod khyepa ni/ de la sman dpyad zas spyod bzhi la/sngon 'gro/ /dngos gzhi/ rjes/ rten 'byel/ sngags thurnams so/ /dang por dgongs mo nyal nas sang mig mi 'byed kyi bar du zas skom gyi rigs bkag /sprin med nyi ma dro sar nad pa dang sman pa gnyis stan bde bar bsdad④/yo byad la/ dkar yol gtsang mar chu/ me hrag khyedu ba med pa/ ras dkar dri med/ sren bal/ gtsags bu/ thur ma/ phyi'i mig sman yung ba/nang gi mig sman la bya phur leb 'dra ba/ shing sman gaṇḍa pa ṭa gsum/ rnga mong gi ko lpags kyi rngar/ rdza 'urngar 'jam pa rnams bsags rjes/ nad pa dang sman pa gnyis kyi lham phud/ sman pa'i lag pa gtsang bar bkrus/ nas phud gnyis ka'i lag tu thogs nas gsol 'debs bden bdar brjod nas nas 120—898

'thor①—/ yung ba brdar nas chu dang sbyar bas mig gang 'byed kyi smin ma'i ltag la byugs/ de rjes mig g.yon ma lta bu 'byed na sman pa'i pus mo g.yas pa basbang zhing ②/ nad pa'i lag pa spar 'dzings kyis ①bzung / de'i rjes mig gi 'grib kyi thad g.yon phyed dhin g.yon zur/ dkar nag nas gang gi mtshams su gtsags bur dar dkar gyi skud pas sked bcings byas pa'i steng du rgya gram brgyab pa'i rtse nas nas phyed tsam mthong ba des bsnun nas pags pa phigs pa byas rjes thur ma bra bo 'dra bas tshad dar skud kyi mtshams su sleb pa rgyal mor btang / de nas rten 'byel byi sog ⑤ma dkar po gcig gi sked pa gtubs nas nad pa dang rang nyid kyi bar la sog ma lag g.yas kyi de g.yon dang g.yon gyi de g.yas la bskyur rjes/ lag g.yon gyis rjomig lngags yar 'then pa dang / g.yas kyis ⑦thur ma rgyal mo'i sgrib byed 'phan ltar bsgril bas thur mar sgrib byed 'khril nas rgyal mo nag sing nge byung ba dang thur ma'i sgab nas bteg bteg byed pa dang lag g.yon rmis mig gang 'byed kyi tshog sgang du sdeg sdeg byas pas 'grib log byung na sngar ltar bsgril nas bzhag /de nas mig gi mthong byed du rdzas kha dog sna tshogs pa che ba chung ba'i bar rim par bstan pas phra rags so sor dbye 'byed thub pa yod/ de rjes mig la srin pa la chur sbyangs pa bkab/ me mdangs kyi bsros ⑧pas 'grib byed thon bee ba 'ong / de nas thur ma tshur bsgril nas bton/ thur rtse yung ba'i chur bcug pas sgring ⑨byed thur mar 'khril nas dngos su mthong ba yong / de nas bya 'phur sbeb ⑩'dra ba rgya gar skad la rnyo ⑪don dzo nyi/ shin ⑫sman giṇḍa nimā'ipa ṭa rnams chu thigs spyoganyis gsum rdo 'jam po'i steng blug par rim bzhin brdar ba'i skyo ma sngar gyi thur ma 120—899

brgyab par bslan/ de'i rjes srin bal chur sbyangs bkab de steng ras dkar yung ba'i khu bar bcug pa bkab/ rgyal mo dmar nag byung na dar dkar tshwa snum bsres par spags pa bkab/ dkar po byung na mtshal dkar ma btul ba dang dung gnyis brdar ba'i skyo ma gong ltar bslan/ de nas srin bal chur sbyangs yung ba'i chur ras spags pa rim par bkab steng ras dkar gyis mig 'bras ①bkab/ rdzas la/ byu ru/ gla rtsi/ gri chung / dngul gsum po mi gcig gis (gemago thog tu bzhag nas/ sngags 'di brjod do/ /khaṅga rā khaṅga rā/ sā ta saṃ burnya ra/ pa la/ gaṇḍa/ go ra①/ smo re/ mā le/be se pā niḥ/ zhes pa tshar gsum bzlas la mig gi steng du phu gsum rgyab pas mig gi nad zug dang bgegs sogs zhi bar byed pa yin/ gri chung nad pa'i rkang 'og tu 'dren/ yang mig rus dang mig na na/ tsan dan dmar po dang yung ba/ rgya gar gyi btsag yug brdar ba'i skyo ma na sar byugs/ zas skom chu grang gi zan bya sgong tsam dang / rtsam pa sman tsha btab ④pa'i tsha ba brdi ba nyin re kha skom na thug pa phor pa gsum re tsam gang dgos gtong / zhag gsum byi bar zas ⑤skyo ma 'di ma gtogs mi byed/ spyod lam nyin mo gnyid mi nyal/ldan pa g.yas g.yon phab nas mi sdod/ dgongs dumo nyal sa steng shod ⑦la 'gro dgos yod tshe dal bus ⑧phyin nas nyal zhing rkang pa brkyangs chog /de nyin nas bzung zhag gsum gyi bar mig sman mig 'byed pa'i dus dang dgongs ⑨ja khar mig kha phye nas rdzas phra rags bstan pas gsal bar yong / de'i rjes mig sman re brgyab nas dkris ma sngar bzhin byed/ rlung rtags kyis ⑩mgo dang mi rus la sogs na ba byung na snum bskol ba la/ ga bur/ gla rtsi/ li shi/120—900

pi pi ling / dzā ①ti/ btsag yug rnams rim cha bskyed nas btab byugs pas phan zhing / gzhan yang log gnon/ 'gram pa/ 'grib pa/ zhar ba/gzer ba sogs rgyud ④ltar shes par bya'o/ /kye ma shar phyogs rin chen shel gyi gzhal yas na/ /bde chen padma dkar po'i gdan khri la/ /sku yi rigs kyi drang srong 'khor dang bcas/ /deng 'dir zhi ba'i dbang dang byin rlabs /de/ /lho'i drang srong ④ser po/ kye ma lho phyogs rin chen gser gyi gzhal yas nas/ /bde chen padma ser po'i klong dkyil na/ /yon tan rigs kyi drang srong 'khor dang bcas/ /deng 'dir rgyas pa'i dbang dang byin rlabs /de/ /nub kyi drong srong dmar po/ kye ma nub phyogs rin chen mchong gi gzhal yas nas/ /bde chen padma dmar po'i dkyil dbus na/ /gsung gi rigs kyi drang srong 'khor dang bcas/ /deng 'dir dbang ldan dbang gi byin rlabs stsol/ /byang gi drang srong ljang gu/ kye ma byang phyogs rin chen g.yu yi gzhal yas nas/ /bde chen padma ljang gu'i gdan steng na/ /'phrin las rigs kyi drang srong 'khor dang bcas/ /deng 'dir 'phrin las dbang dang byin rlabs /de/ /dbus kyi drang srong mthing ga /kye ma dbus phyogs rin chen beeḍūr gzhal yas nas/ /bde chen padma mthing ga'i klong dbus su/ /rigs ldan thugs kyi drang srong 'khor dang bcas/ /deng 'dir bsam tshad lhun grub dbang mchog /de/ //da kyi bu brgyud slob brgyud thams cad la/ /drang srong rigs lnga sman skyong srung ⑦mar bcas/ /bskal pa ma stongs par du byun gyis rlobs/ /kye rin chen sna lnga baiḍūr gzhal yas khang / /dkar ser dmar ljang mthing ga padma'i steng / /rigs lnga pho brang 'ja' tshon 'khrigs ⑤pa'i dbus/ /mtshan dpes rab brgyan 120/de901

sangs rgyas sman gyi bla/ /ye shes lnga ldan sku lnga gsal bar sprul/ /re re'i 'od la 'khor rmi drang srong dang / /lha dang drang srong phyi nang sde bzhis bskor/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag lhun grub rnam pa lnga'i/ /sman gyi bu mo rnam lnga gnas 'dir byon//dri bzang me tog gru gar du ma bcas/ /drang srong rnams la phyag dang mchod pa 'bul—/ /khaṅga ra khaṅga ra/ sā ta saṃ burnya ra/ pa la/ gaṇḍa/ go ra/smo re/ mā le/ bi pe pā ni/ lan gsum bzla/ shing kun srang gang / li shi srang gang / dzā ①ti zho drug /sug smel srang gang / pi pi leng zho drug /rgya gar gyi la la phud zho drug /kha che zho do/ 'jam 'bras pags pa med pa zho gsum—/ shing tsha ②zho gsum/ a ru ra rus pa med pa zho drug /shu dag zho gsum—/ ru rta zho drug /thal dkar rdo rje zho drug /kong po'i sga zho drug /sha 'bras zho gsum/ ga bur zho gsum/ zi ra nag po zho drug /pho ba ri zho gsumaske/ dom mkhris zho gsum/ sum cu tig zho gsum/ gla rtsi zho gsum/gi haṃ zho gsum/ sle tres zho drug /byi thang ka zho gsum/ ba ru ra zho drug /sgog pa 'khar ④nyag gsum/ btsod ④nyag gang / dha du ra zho gsum/btsan dug zho gsum/ sa min pha la zho gsum/ ko bye ⑤la zho gsum/ tsi tra ka zho drug /dngul chu zho gang / gzi yod pa'i so ma ra tsa zho gsum/pad ka dmar po'i snum nyag drug /til nag gi snum nyag gsum/ zar ma'i snum nyag gsum/ nyungs kar gyi snum nyag drug /nya tsho ba dkyus mtho gang lhag tsam bcu drug gi khu ba/ phag tshil nyag gsum/ spyang ki'i tshil nyag gang /rgod kyi tshil spor do/ /sman sbrul sgor mo bubs gcig btsos pa'i khu ba/ phug ron gyi sha rul sums rjomed pa bubs gcig btsos pa'i khu ba/ 'bri mar lo 120—902

bcu gnyis song ba nyag lnga/ lug mar nyag do/ ra'i 'o ma phul gang sbyar ba rnams kyi byug ) pas/ grum bu'i nad/ rtsa dkar/ dreg /rlung 'bam/chu ser/ me dbal/ za 'phrug /skam mdze/ khe ma/ 'brum thor/ shu ba sogs chu ser grang ba la brten pa'i rigs mtha' dag la phan/ nyi ma byung na dang de min me la bsros pa'i 'byug jengs — gnyis byed/ srong 1phyed re nad gzhi gang yod la bsgu mnye jezhib 'them byas pa'i lo gcig song na zhag bdun tshun la drag /na ba'i lo gnyis song na zhag bcu bzhir drag /gsum song na zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig la drag /'di khong du gtong rgyu'i sman nya phyis zho drug /la la phud zho drug /pi pi ling zho gsum/ tsi ta ka zho gsum/ kong sga zho drug /gser mdog rus med zho drug /ba ru ra zho gsum/ sle tres zho gsum / tikta zho phyed do/ /sug smel zho phyed do/ /dzā deti zho phyed do/ /li shi zho phyed do/ /so ma ra tsa zho gang / 'jam 'bras zho gsum/ gla rtsi zho phyed do/ /gi haṃ zho phyed do/ /pho ril zho phyed do/ /'di rnams kyi khar bye dkar spar ba 6gang btab pa'i ril bu kham bu skam po tsam tho rangs chu skol dang yal gyes )rta byas btang ngo / /zas la rtsam pa/ sha gsar/ rus gsar gyi thug pa tsha phyed tsha/ ja la mar dang 'o ma med pa'i tsha phyed tsha ma gtogs zas kyi rigs mi gtong / phan yon mgo dang rna ba yan lag ma gtogs 9khong nad kyi rigs la phan/ rgya gar gyi skad la sa mu dra phe na/ bod skad la rgya mtsho'i sru 7 ba dngos/ sgog pa se'u gsum/ li shi/ dzā 11ti gsum cha bsnyams 1 pa'i phye ma snum skol 1nabar btab pa'i khu ba rna bar thigs pa gsum ri 15gnyis re blugs pas te rna ba'i nad tsha grang kun la phan/ ba'i 'o ma phul do/ snum phul 120—903

gang / rgya gar gyi dha du ra zho drug zhib par btags snum dang 'o ma gnyis skol bar btab pa lus la byugs pas chu bsags/ pho ba sgos pa na zug che ba'i rigs la phan/ zas spyod rtsam pa dang skom li shi 'bru bdun tsam chu phor gang la sbangs pa'i khu ba grang mo gtong rmye/ gong gi sman rnams nyin re la 'byug thengs gnyis re byed/ nyin bdun tsam la grag 'gro/ sman chen ser po dang dung me la bsregs pa pho ril gsum zho la bteg zupa'i ril bu pho ril tsam sgril ba khong du btang bas cham pa/ tsha ba/ za ma ma zhu ba rnams la bsngags③/ sman ma zhu na dug ril ltag pa sbrad ces byepa yang 'di yin/ 'khyags pa sogs grang ba'i nad rigs kun la phan/ rgya gar gyi la la phud chu la thun che bar 'ubatab la skol ba'i khu ba phor pa do gsum tsam btang bas shal skyug thugang rigs byung na phan / grang ba yun ring lo 'das 'grim pa la ko ci la rnge la bsregs pa lanadadang la la phud shu dag pyagasum khram khrum brdungs pa thun che ba gsum zos pas phan/rtsam pa rtsam thug mdzo zho'i chu ras la btsags pa btang bas phan/ pho pa 'bras bu gsum sdom chung ba la thag btang ba gcig zhib par btags pa'i khu ba mgo bo gzhogs 2/phyed na na gang na'i mig tu dar la btsags ⑨pa'i khu ba blug pas phan/kro ma seng ge/ tsan dan dmar po/ lga ser/ btsag kyirnams brdar ba'i khu ba bal mchu la byugs pas phan/ so ma ra tsa brdar ba'i khu ba mig gi mtha' la byugs pas na zug che ba la phan/ ma skyel drod dugs byed/ ha ha tha gha ru la gha ru ra yi ke ke ma tsu li/ saṃ ge skyohe saṃ gha sa ma i zhes lan gsum thal ba la sngags btab na /)kha rlang gi dug la phan no// //rngu 120—904
