sngag /'phrul gyi me long dgu skor zhes bya ba'i rtsa 'grel bzhugs/hūṃ—༄go/ /kun mkhyen nyid la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnal 'byor lta ba'i spyi 'grel khyebardeg /log rtog byarngo chub yul snang ba'i/ /chos kun2 sems su gcig mi gcig /lhurde gyis grub pa gang la bgyi/ /de nyid snang ba 4yod dam med—/ /ye nas sangs rgyapre yin nam min/ /khams gsushā sems can ji ltar 'khrul/ /'khrul shā nyid ni don ci lags1/ /rnal 'byor bye ba'i ngo bo gang / /de rdeg dogs ④pa'i the tshom gang / /de rnams khyad par ji ltar che/ /'phrul gye me long dgu skor skyebazhin/ /gsal byed 'phrul tshig dgu yis ston/ /sgyu ma rnam gnyis spyod du yul ni/ /sems kyi chos nyid ngang du gcig /de yi de nyid ji lta ba/ /mkha' dang gzha' snang ji bzhin du/ /log rtog sems rgyud tha dad kyang / /rigs rgyud med phyir dbye ba dka'/ /sems nyid nor bu 120—907

rin po che/ /ji ltar dmigs shing sems par snang / /'gro la sems hūṃrgyud gnyis su 2'char/ /de ni dngos med kun gyi gzhi/ /log rtog mun pa'i yul snang kun/ /sems phyir mtha' la rtsod pa med/ /gang la yod med med pa ltaji //rtog pa'i smra bsam 5yul las 'das/ /de ni de phyir rgyal 'gro zhes/ /ris su bcad 6snapa med pa la/ /gtsang dang mi gtsang dngos gcig bzhin/ /phyogs su bltas na nor ba'i blo/ /ji snyed 'jig rten 'khrul pa'i sems me long g.ya' 7dang mkha' sprin bzhin/ /rig dang ma rig gnyis med pas/ /phyogs gcig rkyen gyi dus su 'khrul/ /'jig rten brtan g.yo la sogs pa/ /snang ba nyid na rang bzhin med/ /rang byung phyi nang med snang phyir/ /de dus rang bzhin nyams pa med/ /'jug pa'i rnam shes de lta bus3/ /shes rab thun mong spyan yin no/ /rang byung ye shes tshogs kun bdag /shes rab can gyi mchog yin no/ /rdo rje yid ni dbang mchog phyir/ /lta ba med phyir rang spyi chos / /dbyer med phyogs lta'i 'dod bral ba'u/ /ma nor rang gi mtshan nyid rtogs / /gsum gnyis gcig gis ma spangasalku/ /dang po dngos dang gsal ba dang / /snga ma sangs rgyas sems can dag /so so sems rgyud tha dad pa/ /gcig na bdun la snga rtogs hūṃskye/ /de bzhin sems rgyud brgyad la za/ /tha dad zhe na ⑫bdun gyis 'gal/ /de bas dgag dang sgrub med pas⑫/ /gcig dang du ma med pa'o/ /gsum pa'i snga ma rtog skyon dgu/ /phyi ma med pa'i the tshom dag /skyon gyi dngos po bcu gnyis shes④ / /mi mkhas mkhas pa'i bsam pa ni/ /mi mkhas shin tu mi mkhas pa/ /shin tu mi mkhas mthar lta ba'ipa/ /mi mkhas yod rnged rtsod ⑩byed cing / /dgag dang sgrub ⑩pa gang byed pa/ /de de de la 720—908

chags sdang skye/ /mkhas dang shin tu mkhas pa ni/ /mkhas pa phal pa dgag sgrub can/ /sgrub pa'i don la brten par byed/ / byis pa'i gzung —skye'adzin dbang gyur pa'i/ /ma nor lam dang bral ba dzu yin/ /shin tu mkhas pa thams cad la/ /sems phyir dgag dang sgrub snyepa med/ /de dang ④ rang rig rang snang ⑤phyir/ /dgag sgrub bral la yid mi rton⑥/ /de phyir so so dgag sgrub klu can—/ /sgrub pa'i phyogs la zhen pa'i phyir/ /de de med pa ga la mthong / /de bas rang gi brtags mthong yin④/ /de de skas gdang ji lta ba rmye/ /khyad par grangs dang dor ba med/ /cha yod dug la mi 'thung bzhin/ /log lta gnyis su ga la 'gyur/ /gnyis po de ltar de nyid la/ /grub pa'i tha snyad ji ltar mtshon/ /ma grub grub na nges tshig med/ /de ma grub na de bzhin no/ /de bas srid dang mi srid kun/ /lcun grub phyogs su grub pa med/ /bzhi pa'i ṅkusnga ma skyon drug gnyis/ /de bzhin phyi ma rjes su mthun⑪/ /gnyis med zhe na dus gsum lahurte/ /'byung zhes bya ba'ang gnyis med dang / /sman nyid phan gnod bdag gnas ltar/ /ngo bo 35tha dad 'gyur ba med/ /phyogs las logs pa'i tha dad med/ /lnga pa 'khrul gzhi yod med pa'i/ /skyon 6ni gsum pa ji bzhin grangs/ /mig yor gsum la dngos med 'dra'i/ /chos yod bzhin pas rang sems la/ /de dngos med kyang rgyu rkyen drug /rang bzhin lhun grub 1snyedapag bsam bzhin/ /so sor snang ba dus gsum du/ /rgyun du 'khrul la lhun grub pas/ /'gro 'ong ⑫'byung 'jug med snang bzhin/ /gzhi yod med ⑫dang dbyer med mtshungs/ /drug pa de ltar de bden na/ /de la skyon du bya ba bdun/ /thams cad 'ching 'grol dbyer med la/ /gnyis 120—909

mthong 'khrul bar blta ba 'khrul/ /de bas blang dang dor ba med/ /bde sdug gnas su ris ma blta/ /bdun pa rang rig can yin na/ /de la skyon bcu 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin nyid kyi ye shes 'di/ /mi lnga'i bdag po kun gyi sems/ /rang spyi ji snyed ji lta ba/ /rang yul med par nges gsal ba/ /nam mkha' sprin mthongs lku'od bzhin du/ /rab rib gang dag shes rab snang / /brgyad pa nges mthong sgrib pa'i grangs/ /brgyad pa bsnyad pa yan lag bcas/ /phyag rgya bzhi yi gzhir (5gyur pa/ /nges par ngos srizin bya bar bsnyad/ /ma rig pa nyid ye shes gsal/ /je tshom nyid kyang nges pa'i spyan/ /log rtog nyid kyang ma nor lam/ /de la mi mthun shes dang bral/ /dgu pa 'das dang 'jig rten pa'i/ /theg pa'i lta ba gral dgod sa rmye/ /skas gdang lta bur bstan pa dag /kun kyang bdag dang bral ba'i phyir/ /'jig rten shes 'phags ci smos te/ /de dag nyid ni dgag dang sgrub/ /rim pa yod med khyad par dang / /ltos pas phye ba'i khyad par ni/ /bdag spong bdag med sgrub pa dang / /gzugs spong phyi steng 'usgrub pa dang / /don 'gog sems tsam sgrub pa dang / /mtha' spong mtha' bral sgrub pa dang / /dri spong dag pa sgrub pa dang / /mtshan 'gog mtshan med sgrub pa dang / /blang byudor 'gog med sgrub pa dang / /rtsol spong rtsol bral sgrub pa dang / /de dag kun kyang yod med phyir/ /dgag sgrub rang gis mi byed pa'o/ /rim par phye ba'i khyad par ston/ /mthong ba dag dang ma dag pa'i/ /rim pas don gcig khyad par snang / /mthong ba dge ba'i kyekun mthong 'di/ /sna tshogs jeg pa'i lta ba dang / /ji snyed bsdom pa'i bya ba rnams/ /sbyang bar bya ba ma yin yang / /ma 'dres sheyongs 120—910

su rdzogs par gsal/ /kun shes bzhin 'dra rab rib dri ma nyid/ /bstan pa'i me long mjong goms rang dag sar/ /'gyur bas ma 'ongs don gyocan ched bgyis pa'i/ /dge rtsas bdag dang mtha' yas 'gro bar bsngoske/ /'phrul gyi me long dgu skor ①rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/9༷7 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉ltar bkod cing / 〈〈snar 〉skal 'phrul gyi me long dgu skor zhes bya ba rtsa 'grel bzhugs so//zhes 'khod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skorabyel/ ①〈〈pe 〉zad don ci lags/ 〈〈snar 〉don dan ci la/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra gos/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thaskor/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra/pyod/9༷8 ①〈〈pe 〉ra kyi/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉/desu/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thartsod/ dhi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra/ra/ tshu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sams/ ④〈〈pe 〉/gcad/ ⑦〈〈snar 〉sngagayo'/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ma / ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rabs/⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉med the tshom yang / ⑪〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉masag ⑫〈〈snar 〉da dang / ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra 'i/⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉shing / spyo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra / ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thartsod/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉cing bsgrub/9༷9 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skadas pa'i bzung / ②〈〈snar 〉sngag ①〈〈pe 〉ra sgrub/ 〈〈snar 〉〉sgrub/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skal/⑤〈〈snar 〉〉mang / ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉/ston/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sgrub/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7yi/ ⑨〈〈snar 〉〉bo/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ma / ⑩〈〈pe 〉marathun/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ma nga / ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bos ④〈〈pe 〉〉rkyen/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ma grub/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉dpa/ 'grol/ 〈〈snar 〉dpa/ 'gra yo/ ⑩〈〈snar 〉/demed/91༷ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thamathong / ②〈〈pe 〉ma bzhir/ 〈〈snar 〉ra bzhin/ cha〈〈pe 〉ra/sa/ ④〈〈pe 〉migod sa/〈〈snar 〉ra gongs/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉/stong / rjo〈〈snar 〉〉glang / ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanag pa/ la〈〈snar 〉skaradris/911 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉de/ la〈〈pe 〉shesal bar bsngo/ 〈〈snar 〉shesal bar bsngod/ 1༄〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thaskor/120—911

na682dag /'grel pa bzhugs/①༄spro/ /rnal 'byor rigs pa'i me tog 'phrul gyi me long la dbu zhabs su bsdus pa'i don bzhi ste/ phyag 'tshal mchod pa'i lung dang / dam bca' sdom pa'i lung dang / gzhung lugs rtsa ba'i lung dang / sna ④tshogs kyi lung dang bzhi'o/ /kun mkhyen nyid la phyag 'tshal nas/ /shes pa gang gis gang ltar phyag btsal ba'o/ /rnal 'byor lta ba'i spyi 'grel brdeg /ces pa lta ba'i rim pa spyi'i shan dbye ba'i phyir 'grel pa ste/ the tshom gtar ka dzugand du brdeg par dam bca' ba'o/ /lung bsdu ba bstan pa la gnyis te/ dris pa'i lung dang lan no/ /dris pa ni dgu ste/ log rtog byang chub yul snang ba'i/ /chos kun sems su gcig mi gcig /ces pa 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 4 /'das pa'i spyod yul byang chub sems su gcig mi gcig dris pa dang po'o/ /lhun gyis grub snyepa gang la bgyi/ /dris pa gnyis pa'o/ /de nyid snang ba yod 120————913

dam med/ /ces pa lhun grub snang stong gang yin dris pa gsum pa'o/ /ye —nas sangs rgyas yin nam min/ /zhes pa chos kun gzhi yi sangs rgyas pa yin nam ma rgyas pa yin dris pa bzhi pa'o/ /khams gsum sems can ji ltar 'khrul zhes pa lnga pa'o/ /'khrul pa nyid ni ①don ci lags/ /zhes pa 'khrul pa'i grub mtha' dris pa drug pa'o/ /rnal 'byor lta ba'i ngo bo gang zhes pa bdun pa'o//de dag dogs lapa'i the tshom gang / /zhes pa skyon dris pa brgyad pa'o/ /de rnams khyad par ji ltar che/ /bdun po theg pa gzhan las gang dpag ①dris pa dgu pa'o/ /'phrul gyi me long dgu skor dubazhin/ /zhes pa mtshon pa rjodagus mtshon du btub pa'o/ /gsal byed 'phrul rjotshig dgu yis ston/ /zhes pa don dris pa lan zung dgu yi tshig gis gsal bar ston pa'o/ /lan dang po bstan pa'i phyir/ /sgyu ma rnam gnyis spyod yul ni/ /sems kyi chos nyid ngang du gcig /ces pa log rtog sgyu ma'i sems can dang / ye shes sgyu ma'i sangs rgyas kyi spyod /yul 'khrul lam ma 'khrul gnyis/ sems kyi de kho na nyid chos kyi dbyengs kyi ye shes su gcig par lan gdab po/ /de'i dpe ni/ de'i de nyid ji lta ba'o/ /mkha' dang gzha' snang ji bzhin du/ /zhes pa gzha' tshon snang ba dang rang bzhin stong pa dbyer med pa bzhin no⑧/ /gtan tshigs ni/log rtog sems rgyud tha dad kyang / rig rgyud (med phyir dbye ba dka'/ /zhes pa log rtog gi rgyud so sor rtog pa dang / 'du shes tha dad pas/ tshor ba dang / 'du byed de lta ba dang / rgyal ba'i thugs gsal ba rtags kyis tha dad pa las mi mthun pa ni rgyal ba dang / 'gro ba la rig rgyud spyortag par nges pa med pa'i phyir/ gcig ces dgos ched nya1gnyis kyi phyir brjod kyis ngo bo 120 9/4

gcig dang tha dad las grol ba'i ngang du dbyer med pa la de skad brjod pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sems nyid nor bu rin po che/ /zhes pa lhun grub kyi dpe'o/ /ji ltar dmigs shing bsams par snang / /zhes pa khrun gyis ①ma grub pa dang ma grub pa'i chos thams cad du sems so sor snang ba'o/ /'gro la sems rgyud gnyis mi 'chang / /zhes pa sems kun gyi sems kyi chos nyid kyi gzhi 'am dngos po zhes pa skad gcig dzeem ni bsam pa'am blo zhes rtog pa dang mi rtog pa'i sems rgyud gnyis pa 'gro ba gcig la med do①/ /skabs kyis mi brjod pa'o/ /de ni dngos med kun gyi gzhi/ /zhes pa sems can byu sems gcig pa de ni dngos po brtag dka' ste/ dgos 'dod bskong ba'i nor bu lta bu la gcig la gcig ④ma grub pa dang / lhun grub kyi ngo bo la ni phyogs gcig pa'i lhun grub tu khas blangs pa'o/ /lan gsum pa ni/ log rtog mun pa'i yul snang kun/ /zhes pa 'gro ba so so'i ma rig pa'i snang ba tha dad pa bsdu'o/ /sems phyir mtha' la rtsod ⑤pa med/ /ces pa snang ba yod med kun bdag nyid chen po'i gtan tshigs kyis dbyer med pa la yod med sgo skur tu rtsod /spyopa byes pa'i blo/ dpe ni/gang la yod med med pa ltar/ /ces pa dngos po gang la phan pa 'ba' zhig yod ce'am/ gnod pa'i mthu 'ba' zhig yod ces phyir ni mi btub ste/brtags na mi dmigs par/ bsam na phan gnod so sor snang yang dbyer med pa ltar/ rtog pa'i smra bsam yul las 'das/ /zhes pa 'khrul pa'i snang ba yod med dbyer med pa ni thun mong chen po'i smra bsam ) las 'das pa ste/don dam dngos po'am gzhi la med/ /kun rdzob blo 'am bsam pa la yod ces spra ba dag mi mkhas pa'i shes pas/ 'di skad du/ sems 'di yod do med do 120 915

zhes—/ /byis pa rnams ni rtsod ①par byed/ /zhes pa la sogs pas gsal lo/ /lan bzhi pa ni/ de ni de phyir rgyal 'gro zhes/ /ris su bcad pa med pa la/ /sems snang stong dbyer med pa'i lhun grub de ni/ tshig snga ma gtan tshigs su gyur pas ye sangs rgyas pas rgyal ba zhe'am/ 'gro ba 'khor ba yin zhes gsungs pa'i tshig gnyis kar/ sems 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa dbyer med la mi bsam mi brjod do/ /gtsang dang mi gtsang dngos gcig bzhin//zhes pa gnyis su med pa'i dpe ste/ la la'i gtsang ba la la la'i mi gtsang bar snang bas gtsang mi gtsang dngos po gcig ste/ gzhi la nges pa bzhin de kho na ji snyed pa'i ji bzhin pa sems kyi chos nyid sangs rgyas sems can dbye ba med pa la/phyogs su bltas na nor pa'i blo/ /zhes pa gzhi 'khrul 'khor med pa'o/ /rnam dag phyogs gcig tu bltas te/ gzhi med pa la bsam blos blo bur du blta ba dag ni/ kun nas nyon mongs pa dag dang / tha snyad la skur ba 'debs pa'i lta ba ste/ gnyis med ngang la gsal ba 'dus par brjod pa nyid kyis mkha'i lta ba khas blangs pa'o/ /'dir gnyis su yod med nyid kyang dbyer med pas thun mong ②ma yin pa'i gnyis su med pa ste/ 'di skad du/ gnyis med gnyis su med min zhing / /zhes pa dgos byed gnyis kyi phyir brjod pa tsam mo/ /lan lnga pa ni/ ji snyed 'jig rten 'khrul pa'i sems/ /zhes pa log rtog tha dad pa'i sems bsam yas pa'o/ /me long g.ya' dang mkha' sprin bzhin/ /zhes pa ma rig pa dang sems ye shes gnyis su med pa'i dpe'o/ /rig dang ma rig gnyis med pas/ /zhes pa lhan cig skyes pa'i ma rig pa med pa min pa'i phyir/ye shes dang ma rig pa dbyer med kyang / phyogs gcig rkyen gyi gedus gsum 120 916

'khrul / /zhes pa phyogs gcig nas ltos pas 'khor ba'o1/ /de'i rgyu ma rig pas rkyen las dang nyon mongs pas dus gsum thog mtha' med par rgyun chags su 'khrul pa ni/ thag sbrul tho mi sab rtas mtshon nas gzhi med pa las 'byung bar smra ba lta bu ma yin te/ sgo sgur dang bral ba'i ngang las 'khrul pa'o/ /lan drug pa/ 'jig rten brtan g.yo la sogs pa/ snang ba nyid na rang bzhin med/ /ces pa brtan g.yo blo brtags kyi rang bzhin bsam pa la yod la gzhi la med par smra ba ni rang bzhin la skur bye —ba ste/ 'dir 'khrul pa snang bdo ba'i dus nyid na mkha' sprin ltar rnam pa'i mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa chen po la rang bzhin yod med dbyer med la dgos ched kyis brjod pa'o/ /rang byung phyi 4 nang med snang phyir/ /zhes pa bdag nyid chen po'i gtan tshigs kyis kyang chu nyid rlabs lta bur 'gro 'ong med par snang ba'o/ /de dus rang bzhin nyams pa med / /ces pa 'khrul pa de snang ba'i dus na rang bzhin stong pas ji bzhin nyid las ma nyams rang bzhin thun mong yem yin pa'i 'khrul pa ste/ 'di skad du / 'khor ba nyid na bde gnas 6so/ /shes pa dang rang bzhin nyid las nyams pa med/ /ces gsungs so/ /lan bdun pa ni/ 'jug pa'i rnam shes de lta ba/ /shes rab thun mong 7spyan yin na/ /zhes pa lta ba'i ngo bo 'og ma bdag yid kyi rnam par shes pa de bzhin nyid la dmigs pa'i phyir/ 'du byed kyi shes rab dang mtshungs par thun mong gi lta ba lam du rigs pa'i shes pa la lta ba zhes brjod do/ /'dir/ rang byung ye shes tshogs kun bdag /shes rab spyan gyi mchog yin no/ /zhes pa tshogs brgyad rig 8rgyud gzugs mtshan gnas kyis tha dad med par 'od gsal ba'o/ /rkyen dang rgyu med par ma 120—917

'gags par ye rang gsal bar rang byung ye shes te/ bltas pa med par de kho na nyid du gsal ba lta ba'i phul lo/ /lta ba'i ngo bo des ji ltar mthong snyam pa la/rdo rje yid ni dbang mchog phyir/ /zhes pa yid ye shes rdo rje ni shes rab kyi dbang po mchog ste ①gtan tshigs ④lta ba med pa rang spyi'i chos/ dbyer med phyogs lta'i 'dod bral ba/ zhes pa yul du lta ba med de rang rig phyi nang med phyir ro/ /rang dang spyi'i mtshan nyid kyi chos su snang ba yang shes pa dang rnam pa tsam du dbyer med pas/ nang phyogs nas phyi ru bltas pa'am/ phyi nas nang du blta ba'i 'dod chags dang bral bas de kho na nyid yul med par rig pa rang gsal ba'i gdeng rnyed ④pas thams cad mkhyen pa la zhes pas/ zhe 'dod du med pas/ ma nor rang gi mtshan nyid rtogs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de la g.yo theb brtan mthar phyin pa'i lam du gyur pa'o/ /lan brgyad pa ni/gsum gnyis gcig gis ༷the tshom spangs/ /zhes pa dris lan bdun pa'i tshom dris pa rjes su bsam pa'i phyir/ dang po dngos dang gsal ba dang ⑤/ /zhes pa tshig lngas gtar ka gnyis kyi gegs bsal ba la/ /snga ma sangs rgyas sems can dag /so so sems rgyud tha dad pa/ /gcig na bdun la snga rtog skye/ /zhes pa spyir sangs rgyas dang sems can rnams phyogs gcig pa'i gcig pa yin na bka' lung la mi snang ba dang / don dang 'gal ba dang / gtan tshigs kyis mi rgyas pa dang / rig ⑥pas mi 'thad pa dang / chos brtags pa bzhi ⑦dang 'gal ba bdun po kun la 'byung mod kyang / skabs gnyis kyis gsang sngags ni spyi dang 'thun par rigs pas mi 'thad pa'i skyon brjod do/ /sangs rgyas kyi thugs dang sems can gyi sems phyogs gcig pa'i ldog pa dang bcas pa 120—918

yin zhe na/ rgyal ba bzhin du 'gro bas kyang thams cad mkhyen par 'gyur ba dang / rtog pa med par 'gyur ba dang / /nyon mongs pa'i sdug bsngal mi 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang / lam gyi chos la rag las mi dgos pa dang /rgyal ba yang 'gro ba bzhin thams cad mi mkhyen pa dang / rtog pa can du 'gyur ba dang / nyon mongs pa sdug bsngal myong ba dang / skyon bdun 'byung ngo / /'gro ba drug gi sems can tha dad gcig na yang / de bzhin sems rgyud brgyad la za/ /zhes pa chos tha ma'i skyon 'byung ste/ 'gro ba drug po kun sems rang byung gi ye shes su gcig na yang / 'gro ba gcig sangs rgyas na kun sangs rgyas par rigs pa dang / gcig rtsang ༷/na kun lhung ②bar rigs pa dang / gcig shes pa che na kun che/ gcig shes pa chung na kun chung / gcig 'du shes rgya che na kun che/ gcig 'du shes chung na kun chung / gcig rno na kun rno/ /gcig rtul dhin kun rtul④/ gcig dog na kun dog /gcig yangs na kun yangs—/ gcig tshor ba gsal na kun gsal/ gcig mi gsal na kun mi gsal—/ gcig dran pa gsal na kun gsal/ gcig gi gsal na kun mi gsal—/ brgyad po de ltar the tshom za ba/ tha dad zhe na bdun gyis dhi'agal/zhes pa sangs rgyas kyi thugs dang 'gro ba'i sems tha dad na yang / sangs rgyas sems can gnyis rang bzhin tha dad du 'gyur/ ngo bo tha dad du 'gyur bas 'brel pa med pas don byar mi btub/ 'gro ba sangs rgyar mi btub/nyon mongs pa spang ( )zhing sgrib pa byang du mi btub/ rgyal ba bsten ④pa la dgos pa med/ so sor rtog pa'i mthar 'gyur ba dang bdun no/ /sems can kun gyi rang gi ye shes tha dad na yang / rang byung gi ye shes so so na yod 120—919

pa'i phyir/ gcig gis gcig reg 1na gzhan 'byung du 'gyur ba dang / nges tshig med/ gcig gis 1gcig ma rig na/ ye shes su mi 'gyur ro/ /yul med par rig na dam bca' nyams/ shes pa'i rnam pa ye shes gzhan du snang ngo zhe na/ bdag gzhan gyi phyogs nas rnam pa cha gnyis yod pas gzung 1'dzin du 'gyur ro/ /ye shes la rig rgyud ④la sogs pa tha dad pa bdun 'ong bas du ma'i mthar 'gyur ro/ /de gsal ba ni/ de bas dgag dang sgrub med pa'i/ /gcig dang du mar bral ba'o/ /zhes pa sangs rgyas dang sems can gcig dang du ma'i mtha' ma bkag la bral ba sgrub tu med pa ni rig pa rang byung gi ye shes nyid gcig dang du ma dang bral ba dang ma bral ba kun yin pas/ bral ma bral dbyer med pa la shugs snang la dgag sgrub ⑤ltar snang yang zhes 'dod la lhag pa'i dgag sgrub ④med pas skyon de dag mi 'byung ngo / /gsum pa 'khrul snang gzhi la yod med ston pa'i phyir/ gsum pa'i snga ma rtog skyon dgu/ zhes pa 'khrul snang gzhi la yod na gzhi 'khor ba rang rgyud rtog ⑦pa'i skyon gyis sgrib pa mi 'byong ⑧/ 'ching bu dpes sangs mi rgya/ rgyal ba dang / 'gro ba rig rgyud ⑨tha dad 'byung / bstan pa gsungs pa la dgos ched med/ mya ngan 'das pa'i snang ba 'gag /'khor ba mthar 'gyur/ 'grel pa med pas don byar mi btub⑩/ gzhi'i chos dri ma can du 'gyur ba'o/ /phyi ma med pa'i the tshom dag skyon gyi dngos po bcu gnyis gzhi'o/ /zhes pa gzhi la 'khrul pa med pa yin na'ang / lhan cig (speskyes pa'i ma rig pa med pa'i skyon dang / rang bzhin chad pa'i skyon dang / mya ngan las 'das pa mthar 'gyur/ 'khrul snang 'gag gzhi med pa la 'khor ba snang na/ 'khor ba la thog ma 'byung / rgyud 120—920

dag pa yang 'khor sgrib pa sbyang mi dgos/ bstan pa la 3dgos ched gred/ye nas gzhi la med pa las snang na/ mu stegs chad pa'i snang bar 'gyur/snga na med pa'i skyon dang / gcig la gcig med pa'i skyon dang / ye nas med pa dang bcu gnyis 'byung ngo / /gzhi ni 'khrul snang yod med gnyis su med pa'i don dang 'gal/ bka' lung las mi snang ba/ gtan tshigs kyis ma rgyas pa/ de ltar rigs pas mi 'thad ②pa'o/ /zhor la shes pa'i khyad par bstan pa ni/ mi mkhas mkhas pa'i bsam pa ni/ zhes pa dbye na/ mi mkhas shin tu mi mkhas pa/ zhes pa mi mkhas pa'i bsam pa la gnyis te/gang zhe na shin tu mi mkhas mthar lta ba'o/ /zhes pa mu stegs pa dang skye bo dag go—/ /mi mkhas yod med rtsod ④byed cing / /dgag dang sgrubalgepa gang byed pa//de de de la chags sdang skye/ /zhes pa ltos pa'i mi mkhas pa dag ni/ tshad ma tshul yod la rtsodarjo/ sems tsam pa rnam pa yod med la rtsod ⑦/ dbu ma snang ba yod med la rtsod pa byed cing / rig ⑦pa ma yin pa'i shes pa'i yul ched du 'gegs / rig ④pa'i shes pa'i yul sgrub par byed pa de ni/ sgrub pa'i don la blo chags/ dgag bya la zhe sdang bskyed pas/ blang dor med pa'i don ma mjong ba'i phyir mi mkhas pa'o/ /'o na mkhas pa gang zhe na/ mkhas dang shin tu mkhas pa ni/ zhes pa mkhas pa'i bsam pa dbye ba nye bar bstan pa'o/ /mkhas pa phal pa dgag sgrub ⑨can/ /sgrub pa'i don la brten par byed/ /ces pa theg pa chen po dbu ma dang sems tsam pa'o/ /de yang gsang sngags la ltos na 'khrul pa'i phyir/ byas pa'i gzung spyo'adzin dbang gyur pa'i/ /ma nor lam dang bral ba yin/ /zhes pa'o/ /ched du dgag sgrub byed pa'i nges pa 120—921

'jog pa'i rtog pa skyes pas/ gsang sngags kyi lta ba dang bral ba'o/ /gsang sngags ni/ shin tu mkhas pa thams cad la/ sems phyir dgag dang sgrub pa ①med—/ /ces pa gsang sngags pa ni shin tu mkhas pa'i bsam pa ste/ bdag nyid chen po'i gtan tshigs kyis dgag sgrub ched du mi byed pa yang rtogs byed kyi thabs dam pa ste/ zhor la dgag sgrub can gyi lta ba 'gegs pa dang / dgag sgrub med pa'i don sgrub pa yod mod kyang / dgag sgrub med pa'i phyogs gcig pur khas mi len te/ don ni/ de dang rang rig rang snang phyir/ /dgag sgrub bral la yid mi rton②/ /zhes pa dgag sgrub yod med kyi chos thams cad rang rig pa yin pas/ dgag sgrub med pa'i don ched du dmigs pa yul du mi byed do/ /dgag sgrub gtan la 'bebs pa'i dus dang / mnyam pa la bzhag pa'i dus gnyis ka ched du byed pa 'khrul pa'i phyir/ de phyir so sor ①dgag sgrub ④can/ /bsgrub pa'i phyogs la zhen pa'i phyir/ /de de med pa ga la mthong / /de bas rang gi brtags mthong yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /lan dgu pa zhar la bstan pa'i phyir/ de de skas gdang ji lta ba/ khyad par grangs dang dor ba med—/ /zhes pa rgyu'i theg pa de snyed ⑤'bras bu de skas gdang ltar khyad yod pa'i grangs mi 'dor bas/ bdun po'i skyon rgyu'i theg pa la grangs ji ltar brjod pa ltar 'byung gi/ 'bras bu'i theg pa la skyon mi 'byung bar smos pa'o/ /dgos ched ni/ cha yod dug la mi btung stebazhin/ /log lta gnyis su ga la 'gyur—/ /zhes pa des de bzhin du rang bzhin log pa dang / ltos pa'i log pa ltar gsang sngags mi 'gro ba'o/ /gnyis pa the tshom bsal peba'i phyir/gnyis po 8/de ltar de spyo/nyid la/ /zhes pa grangs kyi gnyis pa de lta bur lhun 120 92 2

grub dris pa/ grub pa'i tha snyad ji ①ltar mtshon/ /zhes pa lhun gyis grub pa phyogs gcig pa'am/ phyogs med pa gang yin dris pa'o/ /ma grub grub na nges tshig med/ /ces pa phyogs med na grub pa'i ngang la rta la glang ma grub pa la sogs pa yang grub pas/ grub pa gcig pu'i nges tshig med par 'gyur ro/ /de ma grub na de bzhin no/ /zhes pa ma grub par grags pa'i chos lhun gyis ma grub na'ang / ma grub pa'i chos ma rdzogs pas nges tshig med do/ /gzhan yang ①ma grub pa phyogs gcig par 'gyur bas yod mthar lta ba dang / bden pa ①mthong ba yang 'khor ba dang / zhen pas 'tshang rgya ba dang / dge sdig 'bras bu bsnol mar 'gyur ba yang grub dgos pa'i skyon du 'gyur ro/ /de bsal ④ba'i thabs ni/ de bas srid dang mi srid kun/ /lhun grub phyogs su grub pa med—/ /ces pa lhun grub kyi gtan tshigs kyis dge bas mtho ris su srid pa la sogs pa dang / dge ba ngan song du mi srid pa kun yod med grub ma grub dbyer med pa la dgos ched kyis lhun grub tu brjod kyis/ don grub grub por brjod pa med pas/ lhag pa'i lhun grub la skyon de dag mi 'byung / bzhi pa'i snga ma skyon drug gnyis/ /zhes pa ye sangs rgyas pa phyogs gcig pa cig rin chen gling dang / nyi mas mtshon pa sgra ji bzhin du brtags na/ mya ngan las 'das pa mthar 'gyur/ sangs rgyas rig rgyud ⑤can du 'gyur/ sgrib pa sbyang mi dgos/ rgyal bas don byar med/ sgrub pa'i gang zag med pas lam mi dgos/ bstan pa gsungs pa la dgos ched med/ 'khor ba'i snang ba 'gag /gal te na brgyud pa yang 'khor/ 'khor ba la thog ma 'gyur/gzhi la 'khor ba med la blo la yod na blo dang gzhi tha dad pa'i skyon 'ong / tha mi 120—923

dad na blo la yod pa bzhin du gzhi la yang yod par 'gyur/ de nyid dang gzhan du brjod du med pa yin zhe na/ de nyid ma yin pas gzhi la med kyang /gzhan du brjod du med pa'i tshul gyis gzhi la yod par 'gyur/ sgrub sngags gnyis pa des ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i phyogs kyang min no/ /de bzhin phyi ma rjes su mthun①/ /zhes pa gzhi sangs rgyas ma yin par 'khor ba yin zhe na/ skyon grangs phyi ma'ang snga ma'i rjes mthun te/ gzhi 'khor ba'i mthar 'gyur/ gzhi dri ma can du 'gyur/ 'gro ba rang rgyud par 'gyur/ don byed pa po med par 'gyur / mya ngan 'das pa 'gag /gal te mya ngan 'das pa la thog ma 'byung / 'khor ba mtha' ma 'byung ste/ mtha' stong par 'gyur/ sgrib pa mi 'byangs ④par 'gyur/ 'khor ba rtags pa'i skyon dang / 'byel pa med pas don byar med pa dang / bstan pa gsungs pa ④la dgos ched med/gzhi la 'khor ba yod na/ zhen blo dang khyad mi 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang bcu gnyis so/ /gnyis med zhe na dus gsum la/ /zhes pa ye sangs rgyas pa yin min ④gnyis ka ma yin na'ang / phung po gsum pa dang / lung du ma bstan pa dang / 'gal ba 'dus pa 'byung ngo zhe na/ de gsal ba ni gnyis med dang / /zhes pa rang rig pa ni sangs rgyas dang sems can dbyer med na'ang / 'di skad du/ bcings med rnam par grol med pa'i/ /ye nas lhun rdzogs sangs rgyas chos/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don la/ dpe/ sman nyid phan laganod bdag gnas ltar/ /ces pa sman gcig (9kyang phan gnod gnyis ka'i ngo bor gnas pa ltar/ ngo bo tha dad 'gyur ba med/ ces pa sems rgyal 'gro gang gi phyogs su ma gyur pas/ yin min lung du ma bstan pa'i skyon mi 'byung ngo / /120—924

lnga pa tsaste'akhrul gzhi yod med pa'i/ /zhes pa chos nyid ngang la 'khor gzhi yod med gnyis/ gnyis med dang gsum la gsum pa mtshon pa sgo so sor bstan kyang / don la gcig par ma shes pa dag yod pa rang rgyud pa dang / med pa rnam dag phyogs gcig pa dang / phyogs kyi gnyis med la 'khrul par smra na/skyon ni gsum pa ji ltar grangs/ shes pa 'khrul snang yod med skabs su bshad pa dang mthun par bgrang ngo / /de bsal lab ni/ mig yor ( gsum la dngos med 'dra'i/ /chos yod bzhin pas shes pa 'khrul tu btub pa'i dpe ni/tho yor dang som 4mo dang thag pa la/ yang dag pa'i rta sprul gyi sha khrag med kyang / mi rta sbrul dang 'dra ba'i chos yod pas 'khrul du btub pa'i rkyen bzhis (snyebatub pa bzhin/ rang sems la/ de dngos med kyang rgyu rkyen drug /rang bzhin lhun grub dpag bsam bzhin/ /so sor snang ba zhes pa/ sems la 'khor ba rang rgyud med kyang me long gi g.ya' bzhin 'khor ba'i rgyu gnyis rkyen bzhis gnas pas snang du btub la/ dpag bsam shing la bsod nams che chung gis peso sor snang ba ltar/ dag dang ma dag pa'i spyod yul du snang ngo / /gzhi ma rig pa yang dag par rang snang ba dang / lhan cig 8skyes pa'i ma rig mtshungs par yod pa dang / yod med dbyer med pas 'khrul gzhi med do yod do gnyis su med do zhes pa bstan pa don gcig go/ /dus gsum du/ rgyun du/'khrul pa lhun grub pas/ shes pa dus dang 'khrul gzhi'o/ /'gro 'ong 'byung 'jug med snang ba/ /gzhi yod med dang dbyer med mtshungs/ /zhes pa chu rlabs kyi tshul du 'gro 'ong med par 'khor bar snang ba'i gzhi yod med dbyer med du gcig pa la skyon med de/ drug pa de ltar de bden na/ de la skyon du 120—925

bya ba bdun/ /zhes pa gong du 'khrul tshul bstan pa ltar bden te/ yid husnamed phyogs can las 'khrul tu btub na/ tho yor la rta ru 'khrul/ sam mo la mir 'khrul/ thag pa la rtar 'khrul par rigs/ mi srid pa'i chos gzhi 'byung bar rigs te dpe skyon bdun no/ /de bas 'khrul pa'i rang bzhin 'khrul pa nyid du rtog na'ang / 'khor ba gzhi la grub nas/ 'khrul pa'i rgyu rkyen gnyis la rag mi lus pa'i skyon gnyis/ 'khrul pa mi sangs pa'i skyon/gang zag dgos pa rtsan du 'khor ba la mtha' mi 'ong / bden pa mthong du mi btub chos nyid du ma 'dus shing ma khyab pa'i skyon 'byung ngo / /de bsal ④ba'i thabs/ thams cad 'ching grol ⑤dbyer med la/ /zhes pa gzhi la 'khrul ma 'khrul yod med kyi sgro skur shi med pa'o/ /gnyis mthong 'khrul par blta ba'o/ /'khrul zhes pa rang bzhin ma nyams par blta ba'o/ /'khrul pa'o/ /de bas blang dang dor ma byed/ /bde sdug gnas su ris ⑦ ma blta/ /zhes pa don gnyis med la lta spyod kyi gdams ⑤ngag dag go/ /bdun pa rang rig can dūyin na/ /de la skyon bcu 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa rang byung ye shes lta ba'i ngo bo yin na/ /rang byung ye shes gcig pas gcig gis rtogs na kun gyi ⑩skyon 'byung / skye mi 'byung / rgyal ba dang 'gro ba khyad par med par 'gyur/lam chad/ da lta nyid nas thams cad mkhyen par thal/ gzhir thal/ sgom mi dgos/ tshig dang yi ge la la dgos pa med/ gtan skyel dbab mi dgos/mngon shes ma bsgom par 'char bar 'gyur ba dang bcu'o/ /de bsal ⑫ba/de bzhin nyid kyi ye shes 'di/ /mi lnga bdag po kun gyi sems/ /zhes pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / mi gnas pa dang / rang byung 120—926

dang / lhun gyis rdzogs pa'i ye shes dang lnga'o/ /ngo bo 'gro ba kun gyis sems so/ /rang spyi ji snyed ji lta ba/ /rang yul med par nges gsal ba/ /zhes pa lta ba'i don no/ /dpe ni/ nam mkha'i sprin mthongs 'od bzhin du/ /zhes pa sprin gang dag pa na/ nyi ma'i 'od dang nam mkha' gsal ba ltar/rab rib ①gang dag shes rab snang / /zhes pa log rtog tha dad pa'i bsam rgyud gang dag pa la rim par rang byung ye shes snang bas/ stobs rdzogs ma sdogs kyi skyon med do/ /brgyad pa nges mthong sgrib pa'i grangs/ brgyad pa bsnyad pa yan lag bcas/ /zhes pa don mthong ba la sgrib pa'i the tshom ñtshaste/ de'i rtsa ba bdun la skyon gyi grangs brjod zin pa de bsdu na/ phyag rgya bzhi pa'i gzhir gyur pa/ /nges par ngos zin bya bar bsnyad/ /ces pa 'di skad du/ bka'/don / gtan tshigs/ rigs pa gzhi/ snang dang / mi 'gal/ rgyas/'thad sbyar zhes pas don ngos gzung ngo / /la bzla du ba ni/ ma rig pa nyid ye shes gsal/ /the tshom nyid kyang nges pa'i spyan/ /log rtog nyid kyang ma nor lam/ /de la mi mthun shes dang bral/ /zhes pa gsum po rim pa rang snang phyir/ de dag gnyis su med par bstan pa la 'gal ba 'dus par brtag tu med pa'o/ /dgu pa 'jig rten 'das dang 'jig rten pa'i/ /theg pa'i lta ba gral bgod pa/ /skas gdang lta bur bstan pa dag go/ /kun dang bdag dang bral ba'i phyir/ /'jig rten shes 'phags ci smos te/ /zhes pa nyan thos yan chad ④kun 'jig rten pa'i bdag nyid med par 'phags mod kyang / de dag nyid ni dgag dang sgrub zhes pa/ zeg pa che chung nad pa gol ba man chod la yod pas khyad par ni/ rim pa ⑤ yod med khyad par dang / /ltos pas phye 120—927

ba'i 1khyad par ni/ /zhes pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i theg pa rnams lta ba rnams lta ba 27gtan la 'beebs pa'i tshe/ 'di skad du/ bdag spang 1bdag med bsgrub pa dang / /gzugs spang pyaphyi stong bsgrub pa dang / /don 'gog sems tsam bsgrub pa dang / /mtha' spong mtha' bral bsgrub pa dang / /dri spong dag pa bsgrub pa dang / /mtshan 'gag hphumatshan med bsgrub pa dang / /blang dor 'gag 3med bsgrub pa dang / /rtsol spong rtsol bral bsgrub pa dang / /de dag kun kyang yod med ⑦phyir/ /dgag bsgrub rang gis mi byed pa'o/ /rim par phye ba'i khyad par ston/ /mthong ba dag dang ma dag pa'i/ /rim pas don gcig khyad par snang / /zhes pa lta ba ma dudag pa'i byis pa gnyis so/ /ltos pa'i ma dag pa'i rjes su rnal 'byor man chad ⑪do/ /'o na dag pa chen po gang zhe na/ mthong ba dag pa kun mthong ba 'di/ zhes pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i lta ba'o/ /de yang 'di skad du/ sna tshogs theg pa'i lta ba dang / /ji snyed bsdom pa'i lta /— —ba rnams/ /spyad par bya ba ma yin yang / /ma 'dres yongs su rdzogs par gsal/ /zhes 'byung bas/ ngo bo rang byung thams cad mkhyen pa dang / /rang bzhin lta ba thams cad dang / /mtshan nyid lta ba gang dang yang ma 'dres pa dang / rtsal lta ba'i sgrib pa kun bcom pa dang / byin rlabs lta ba kun 'byung ba dang / yon tan lhag pa'i lha dang / sangs rgyas thob pas go 'phang bla na med pa'o/ /bsngo ba tshogs kyi lung ni/ kun shes bzhin 'dra rab rib dri ma nyid/ /ces pa 'gro ba kun gyi shes rab kyis rang gi bzhin rang gis ma mthong ba ltar/ ma rig pas sgrib pa ni/ bstan pa'i me long mthong bsgom rang dag par/ /'gyur bas ma 'ongs don kyecan ched bgyid ⑫120—928

pa'i—/ /dge rtsas bdag dang mtha' yas grol bar bsngo/ /zhes pa bzhin la me long bstan pas dri ma mthong nas 'dag par byas pa bzhin/ 'phrul gyi tshig dgus bstan pa'i tshig gi sgon mas/ lta ba rtogs pa la bsgoms pas sgrib pa 1'dag par 'gyur bas/ ma 'ongs pa bdag bas blo dman pa'i don du/'phrul gyi me long brtsams pa'i dgos kyi sbyin pa'i dge rtsas/ mtha' yas pa theg pa chen po'i chen por grol bar dmigs pa'o/ /⑨'phrul gyi me long dgu skor ①la/ rig pa'i me tog gis 'grel pa'o/ /slob dpon chen po bi mā dzñā na'i yin par bzhed las mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/913 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉ltar bkod cing / 〈〈snar 〉〉la 'grel pa bzhugs so/ /zhes 'khod/ snye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasngo ba/ lku〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉raka'/ ④〈〈snar 〉7las/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgrub/914 ① 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rini/ /khya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ragos/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༄gas/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thaskor/⑤〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7'i/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉dkukhrul/ skye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rapyod/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7no/ kye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉/gas brgyud/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉/gas rgyud/ 〈〈snar 〉〉/gas brgyud/ skye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉/ces/915 sti〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyi/ khya〈〈pe 〉༅ga ñtsha 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉8/ ④〈〈pe 〉༅ga la cig 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brtsod—/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thaskur tu brtsod/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasams/916 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thartsod/ rngu〈〈snar 〉〉mongs/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyis/917 rmye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha'i/ du( 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thakur/ kru〈〈snar 〉〉phyin/ khya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mongs 6sna〈〈pe 〉〉gnyis—/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mongs/ dā〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉/gas/918 ①〈〈pe 〉8/ (kye〈〈pe 〉ṅkaso/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tharnyed/ pya〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉lke/ cho〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉ridang /⑥ 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉/gas/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉razhi/919 ①khu〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thalhung / blu④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thartul/ ⑤/〈〈pe 〉ra// ⑥〈〈pe 〉7ngas/ ⑦ 〈〈pe 〉〉120—929

bsdur 'bras re'u migasna tshogs/ (133)120wa 931

༄༅/ /thugs kyi sgon ma bzhugs/1 ༄gro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi 3rdo rje'i bdag /chos kun rdzogs pa'i thugs rdo rje/ /sems dpa' che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spyan mchog dbul ba'i shi sha'i phyir/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud dag las / /'khor lo dag mchu'i tshul bzhin du/ /sgyu 'phrul thugs kyi sgol ma de/ /'dzin pa'i dbang gis shesdug bsngal bas/ /g.yo 'dzin gsum dang mi g.yo ba'i / /'dzin dgu log lta de bzhin pa'i/ /rnam gnyis spang phyir gnyen por brjod / /bsam mi khyab dang de bsdus cepa/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong da 5lta bas/ /gnyis bsdus nges bzhi 'bras bur gcig /thun mong spyomachog gi lam lnga po/ /'dod pa'i yul la zhen pa dang / /bsam gtan snyoms 'jug 'du shes med/ /rtag tshad bcu gsum zhen pa rnams/ /ring du gtong ñdzul mi mthun pa'i/ /spyod pa nyi shu rtsa gcig la'ang / /dang po phyed spong gcig gtang dusnyoms/ /120—932

byed pa'i zhen pas gzhi byed dang / /'phra zab dngos lta'i zhen pa dang / /phyogs stong de bzhin phyogs 'dzin pa'i/ /rgyud 'dzin zhen pa bden pa gnyis/ /rigs 'byed zhen pa'i stong pa can/ /'jig rten ngan song khams su rtse/ /zhi ba phyogs las nges 'byung dang / /rgyu 'bras rten 'byel ①'byung ba'ang / /phyi pa dag lha gnyis rjes 'brang / /mtshan med 'od gsal nges zhen pa'i/ /spong len nges 'dzin bdag 'dzin gzhidro/ /theg mchog lam gyi 1stegs gyur kyang / /rang rang nges pas bsgribs pa min/5/ /mchog gi gzhung lugs gdeng ma gyur/ /de bas rnal 'byor chen po'i lugs/ /bcu gnyis gcig gi zhen pa dag /mi spong gnyis med blang ba med/ /thabs kyi rang bzhin bral mngon byed/ /de bzhin pa yi lugs mchog 'di/ /rgyud dang rnal 'byor gsum rim pa de las kun nas spags pa'i don/ /yang rab rnal 'byor blo la gsal/ /de gang zhe na gdod khya bsams pas/ /dug lnga dngos dang yul shes bcas/ /sems phyir cho 'phrul snang ba la/ /gsum snang zhen pa'i yul med par/ /rgyud ⑦drug shes pa rkyen bcas kyis/ /yul med mi dmigs phyir mi mthong / /mthong shes dbang bcas rang ma mthong / /de bzhin pa yis lnga nyon mongs/ /rjes 'brangs stobs gyur 'gro lngar smin/ /mi mthun bde sdug myong gyur bzhin/ /lam bral dus dgras bcom pa dang / /thar med yang dag lam ston dgos/ /de phyir mi gtsang ⑦ rus spyod dang / /sab rta thag sbrul mtho mi ltar/ /mi bden shes snang phyir rdzun pa'ang / /mi spong mod kyang bden pa med/ /rang byung ye shes mtha' dbus med/ /mi g.yo rang gsal 'dzin bral la/ /tshad med bzhi dang bsam gtan bzhi/ /rim par so nyasor bdag rtog ⑨cing / /120—933

gzugs rnams kun la bdag rtog pas/ /gsang ba'i bden gsum mnyam ma mjong / /thams cad mkhyen ldan 'bral ba yis/ /'du shes med lta sho bar pa//mnyam pa gsum la mdongs pa yis/ /mi g.yo snyoms 'jug bzhi 'dzin can/ /thal 'gyur ①ting 'dzin lus zhig na/ /ya nga'i 'bras bu ldung yod phyir/ /dran pa nyams pa'i nying 'dzin te/ /yid brtan chabya ba'i yul ma yin/ /rang bzhin 'das dang 'khor ba dag /gnyis med lhun grub brjod bsam yul/ /'das dang sngon bzhin ma mthong bas/ /'khrul yul gzhir mthong ltar ①blo 'khrul—/ /g.yang sa mtho dman lam zhugs pas/ /zad par bde sdug myong bar 'gyur/ /'dod pa'i 'bras bu ga la yin/ /de phyir gsum la khyad par med—/ /drug gnyis ston pa'i rjes 'brangs pa'i/ /rigs min lta ba bsam yas pa/ /gnyis bsdus rjortag dang chad pa dngos/ /log lta'i gtso bo ya nga'i rgyu—/ /lnga pa ril po 'byed lta ba'ang / /snga ma dran pa'i byed lta ba'i/ /rigs bzhi nges 'dod rang blo log /de la kha dog dbyibs yod na/ /gzugs su thal bas mang nyung gis/ /'gal dang dran pa skye mi 'gyur/ /rnam smin myong ba ga la rung / /'on te gzugs kyis shes myong thal/ /des na ril po rdzun par nges/ /byed pos byas pa'ang de bzhin te/ /de kho gal te bden zhe na/ /byed por grub pa su yis byas/ /byed po rdul (gelas 'grub 'gyur ram//'on te las kyis byed 'byung zhe'am/ /byed po nyid la byed yod dam/ /rang bzhin nyid kyis 'byung bar 'gyur/ /byed po stes (spyonadabang tsam du zad/ /byed la byed yod thugs med skyon/ /rdul na byas 'dra rag lus med/ /las yin kho bo'i 'dod pa med(7/ /rang bzhin stes /dbang byas pa'ang thal tsha 120—934

rims a bras chod pa'i mig /'bag sogs snang ltar ga la bden/ /cis shos nya shing btsos ①bsregs pas/ /mi skye brlag ④'gyur rigs pa yin/ /snga phyi med par bden lta ba'ang / /mi bden da lta sha 'brug ltar/ /stes dbang snang du btub zhe na/ /snga phyi 'ang stes ①dbang cis mi 'byung / /de mi 'byung na da lta'ang / /mi 'byung de min smos ci dgos/ /da ④ltar de na bdag dang gzhan—/ /stes ⑤dbang snang ba dus gsum du/ /rgyun brtags med pa zhes ④pa 'gyur—/ /gzugs la rung yang ming bzhis so/ /de ltar bden na rmi lam gyi//shes pa'ang nya shing mtshungs brlag 'gyur/ /rmi lam btags ldang zhing rgyun brtag na/ /gzugs phung zhig kyang de 'dra mod/ /'on te da lta yod pa bzhin//snga phyi yod pa smos ci dgos/ /rtag chad gnyis kar blo zhen na/ /don gyi ⑦snying po mchog las gol/ /rang rig snang stong yul min par/ /rig pa rang gsal bsam brjod 'das/ /de phyir gnyis dang der mi 'dzin/ /de la blang dor phyogs 'dzin med/ /de dag so so zhen yul bcas/ /blos bzhag med a yod brtags pa/ /spong byed chad du byas spong ba'ang / /lnga yi bye brag mi mthun pa/ /mos pa tha dad phyir gsungs pa/ /bye brag mdo tsam bshad par bya//theg pa dang po bcu drug 'gran8/ /gnyis pa bzhi yi lta spyod bsrungs/ /gsum pa bcu gnyis nges par bstan/ /bzhi pa bden pa rnam 1pa gnyis/ /lnga pa gsang ba 'ang phyi ba'ang / /dang po rang rig rnam par dag /gnyis pa snga phyi rjes su 'brangs/ /gsum pa dbyengs nyid 'od gsal ba'i/ /sa bdun rim par bkod pa yang / /gsang ba'i snying por 'gro ba'i lam/ /theg pa bzhis yis nges 'byung la/ /theg pa gcig gis / 'bras bur gnas/ /tha 120——935

ma'ang bste lngaganas mthar thug ste/ /tha ma'ang gtso mchog 'dir bshad do/ /de la spong thabs mi mthun pa/ /'dod dang 'gog spang sbyong sol byed/ /'bras shes btang snyoms dag byed dang / /phyogs spyod dang len da ro la/ /bdag phyir blang dor med pa yis/ /che bas skas gdang lta bur 'gyur/ /brgyad gnyis bcu spyod theg sogs pa/ /thun mongs 5lam brjod rnam 4dgu/ /srid pa dang po dngos lta ba/ /rnal 'byor g.yeng drug gis bral yang / /rgyu 'bras shes pas ya nga spong / /bste 5gnas dang po smin par 'dod/ /log rtog nyid la nyid spyod de/ /gzhan du g.yo ba ci yang med/ /bsam gtan snyoms 'jug pa brgyad po/ /'dod spyod sdig sogs spyod pas 'dor/ /dang po'i g.yeng drug bsam pas 'dor/ /'dzin pa phra bas ting nge 'dzin/ /dor ba gnyis mthun 6dor ba yis/ /sa stegs rtsa gcig thob byed pa'o/ /log lta bzhi po gnyis mthong bas/ /log pa'i lam zhugs ya nga'i 'bras/ /lam rim dang po dngos 'dzin gzhi/ /'khor ba'i lam bzhi zag bcas 'bras/ /de dag mchog gi gsum la rmongs/ /de phyir ma rtogs log rtogs pa'o/ /spang 7 bgegs byed pa'i byis pa gnyis/ /tshul khrims bslab pas dngas ri 'gog cing / /mthong goms shes rab ting 'dzin gyis/ /spong bgegs med smra ting 'dzin lta/ /zab phra'i gzung 'dzin bya ba bar/ /brtag dngos 9snazhags pas bcings pa yi/ /log par rtog pa tsam nyid las/ /phra zhing zab pa'ang yod min te/ /lhag par drug gnyis phyi stong 'dod/ /phyogs stong zhen pas bsgribs pa stespyo/ /rmi lam rten 'byel gzhi nyu2snang bas/ /mi bden rang byung ye shes skal/ /bshed med theg pa'i gzhung gnyis pos/ /rdul dang rten 'byel bzhir 'dod pas/ /120/de936

phyogs gcig tu)'das mtha' lam zhugs pas/ /bste ②gnas dang po 'bras bu tsam—/ /bla na med pa'i theg pa pa/ /bslab pa gsum gyis spang bya dag /sol sbyong dag pas thob 'dod pa/ /rnam rig rnal 'byor mdo sde'o/ /dang po rang byung ye shes don/ / mi dmigs phyir ①na rang sems la/ /rnam pa yod med rtsod pa byed/ /gang ltar rtsod kyang 'khrul pa'i mtha'o/ /'khrul snang yul gyi ④rnam pa can/ /rang bzhin 'khrul mthong yod ma myong / /rnam pa med pa'i rang rig pa/ /'od gsal shel ltar dag pa 'ang/ /rgyu rtag skad cig mi rtag pas—/ /skye 'gag med pa'i ye shes la/ /nam yang reg par mi 'gyur te/ /rnam par 'gog par thug pa'i mtha'o/ /rnam dag ye shes rnam bral ba/ /sems can rgyud re de yin te/ /rgyud 'dzin yul med gzung (snye'adzin can/ /g.yo med rtsod pa 'khrul par zad/ /byis pa mkha' la rtsod dang mtshungs/ /rnam pa yod med kun bdag skal/ /shes rgyud bzhi la rtsol ba'i lam de dang thun mong sangs rgyas de'i 'bras bur/ /byed kyi lhag pa'i gsum ma mthong //dam pa'i shes pa 'ang brdzun bupa'o/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa'ang de 'dra'i phyir/ /snga ma'i dam pa rgyu rkyen la/ /rang lus zhig dang skyes dang skyes/ /de bas brdzun lta dam par ni/ /thams cad sems te de ma dmigs/ /ma skyes stong pa smra bsam 'das/ /mtha' la dben pa'i don du lta/ /rnam pa yod med rtsod dang bral/ /shes pa ma skyes phyogs lta ba/ /mtha' dang bral ba thug pa'i mtha'—/ /skye med phyogs gcig ⑦mtha' dang bral/ /de kho mchog lta'i zhen pa can—/ /gnyis med dbyer med ma mthong bas/ /sems stong bzhi pa dka' spyod lam—/ /'bras bu sngon bzhin 'das pa'i mtha'/ /grub mtha' nor rtog shes 120—937

rab kyis/ /'bad pas brtan thob de yi ①phyir/ /de mi bden pas de mi bden—/ /mdo sde pa yi gzhung lugs kyang / /kun brtags snang ba'i spyod yul 'di/ /dam pa gzhan dbang sgyu ma tsam/ /shes snang ma yin 'du snang yin//dam par skye med smra bsam 'das/ /rten 'brel gcig ④dang du ma med/ /rdo rje gzigs ma rnam bzhi dang / /mu bzhi skye 'gag la sogs pas/ /mtha' yas sdebye brag sel byed cing / /de 'dra bsam gtan 'das chen cing / /snang ba yod dang med pa dang / /rig ④pas 'grub dang ma grub sogs/ /de dag la rtsod mtha' tshol ba/ /snyed nas nges 'jog gzung ④'dzin can/ /bden gnyis ngo bo gabyug rjomi gcig /rtsod cing gcig ④la bden dang rdzun/ /rigs lta cha shas (/༄zhen pa can/ /gcig na rdzun mthong bden thal 'gyur/ /yang na bden mthong brdzun par 'gyur/ /brdzun zhen ⑨bden par bslu sogs ldar—/ /thal 'gyur bden bzhin brdzun pa'ang / /skye 'gag med sogs bzhin thal 'gyur/ /yang na mnyam gzhag ⑩tshe na'ang / /bden gnyis dus gcig ⑪mthong bar rigs/ /bden brdzun phan tshun spangs pas 'gal/ /tha dad gyur na sgyu ma la/ /brten nas don dam mi rtogs shing / /sgyu mar 'bad pas 'ang tshi tshad 'gyur/ /dam pa btsal ba'i gnas med cing / /'grel ba med pas mi 'gyur⑫/ /gang ma skyes pa'ang / /skye ba med par 'grub mi 'gyur//zhen spong gnyen po mi btub cing / /de nyid rang rgyud can gyur pas/ /gang la phan gnod med 'gyur ro/ /de ltar rtog cing the tshom za/ /khas blangs med sgra phyogs la zhen/ /de bas bla med theg pa pa/ /don dam du ni dbyer med de/ /kun rdzob tsam du thams cad la/ /dag dang ma dag gnyis kar 120—938

'dzin—/ /thabs kyi theg pa chen po ni/ /don dam du ni kor bdun no/ /kun rdzob tu ni mnyam rdzogs so/ /rnam par byang dang sdug bsngal dag /kun rdzob tu'ang dbye rigs ①te/ /lta ba mtho dman de tsam mo/ /de nyid 'bras bu'i mtshan nyid la/ /don dam ngo bo nyid kyi rgyu/ /lhag pa'i bden par mtshan brjod do/ /cir yang snang ba'i ye shes nyid/ /mtshan mar ma 'gag ②cir yang snang / /ngo bo ma nges don mdzad dang / /rtag pa gnyis las ring ba dang / /rnal 'byor dam pa'i yul mthun ④dang / /snang la skye 'gag med pa'i phyir/ /lhag pa'i kun rdzob zhes su grags/ /thams cad kun gyi rang bzhin pas/ /ye shes snang ba'ang rgyu rkyen med/ /skye 'jig med do lnga 'bras bu/ /dbyings dang ye shes rdzogs mi dmigs/ /phyogs med re skong 'phrin las ni/ /kun nas mtshams pas don mdzad de/ /ched du byas pa'i rtag pa'ang bral/ /rang bzhin mtshan nyid ngo bo dang / /yon tan 'phrin las rtogs dupas dben/ /chos drug ldan phyir lhag par bsgrags/ /de bzhin rang bzhin 'bras bu dang / /ye shes gsum phyir don dam pa'ang / /shes don nang nas mchog gyur pas/ /don gyi ming du 'grub pa yin/ /de'ang ma skyes dbyings kyi don/ /gzhi yis nges la khyad gyur pa/ /log rtog spyod yul las ⑤sogs pa/ /kun gyi rang bzhin phyogs bkol med/ /ngo bo bdun rdzogs dmigs pa med/ /mtshan nyid kun grol kun bdag la/ /phyogs stong chad par yod pa med/ /kun byin ldan pa'i brlabs snang la/ dngos po gnyis kyi ngo bo'i rgyur/ /gyur pas ci yang mi 'gog ste/ /rgya mtsho'i chu dang rlabs ④bzhin no/ /yid bzhin nor ltar re skong (leba'o/ /yon tan kun rdzogs phyir 120—939

snang ba'o/ /thun mong dam pa'i yul min te/ /phyogs gcig stimatha' bral ma yin te/ /dpe dang gtan tshigs thun mong bas④/ /gtan la 'bebs pa ma yin te/ /bdun sogs ngo bor gnas pa'i phyir/ /lhag pa'ang grangs mthun nyid du brjod/ /rnal sogs spyod yul ma yin no/ /gzhi rtsa med pa'i sems nyid ni/ /pho mo ma yin ma ning min/ /mtshan med ma yin rig ①rgyud med/ /kha dog ma yin dbyibs ma yin/ /gnas su ma yin gang yang med/ /de bzhin nyid dbyings ye shes te/ /thabs kyi phyag rgya kun byu rgyu/ /phyogs bcu ma lus thams cad la/ /rang byung chen pos kun tu khyab/ /rang byung de nyid dngos med pas/ /chos dang gang zag bdag med pa/ /kun gyi phyag rgya'i rgyu yin no/ /ma skyes bzhi la bgrod ④pa'i lam/ /gang spangs gang thob de'i 'bras bu/ /dngos po ji bzhin mi mthong bas/ /'bras bu btags pa'i sangs rgyas tsam/ /de ltar nges 'byung bye brag gi/ /rgyud nas nges pa'i gsang ba'ang / /dang po rgyu 'bras dbye byed pas/ /'bras bu lam du byed ce'ang slo/ /phyogs gcig dag pa'i ( kyechos nyid la/ /lta zhing de las lha drug sogs/ /dmigs pa gsum dang yan lag gis/ /sgom gebyed 'bras bu gzung (she'adzin can—/ /lta spyod ya cha'i zhen pa yis/ /bdag nyid chen po nang mi mthong / /dag pa'i sems zhi rtsol ba'i lam/ /rdo rje gsum gyi sa 'dzin pa/ /rmus kyelong 'dri mkhan dang mtshungs te/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i thugs rje'i yul/ /gnyi ga ba yi bya ba dang / /rnal 'byor rjes su lta spyod 'brang / /gnyis po ya cha sngon bzhin te/ /de nyid bzhi yi zhen pa can/ /de'ang phyi rol pa la gnas/ /rnal 'byor ting 'dzin zhen pa can/ /dam par rang rig 'od gsal ba/ /120—940

dbyengs nyid rnam dag ye shes la/ /kun rdzob byin rlabs ①dkyil 'khor dag /ye shes snang smra de la dmigs/ /de phyir lta dgongs phyi rol 'gyur/ /de rtogs khas len gtsang smrar len/ /chu yi ral gri phyis pa bzhin/ /spyod par mi phod 'dzin pa can/ /de nyid sgo nas phyi rol spyod/ /shin tu nang don ma gtogs pas/ /phyi rol cha yis bcings pa yin/ /'od gsal bzhi las mtshan mar g.yo/ /snang stong res slob lam lnga yis/ /thob pa dam pa'ang bsnyi zhuba'i gnas/ /phyi rol gnyis sogs 'bras bu'i phyir/ /mching ①bu rin chen ji lta bar/ /lam 'bras ma 'byel 'khrul par zad/ /gtso mchog bshad par khas blangs pa/ /rgyas par gdams kyi gdeng rjodu bgyis/ /rnal 'byor chen po lta ba'i don/ /yod las btsal na sgos btags te/ /med las btsal na skur ⑤btab 'gyur/ /yod med gnyis las btsal 0byas na/ /de ni lung du ma bstan ④'gyur/ /de la gzhan yang ⑧'brel med pas/ /nam yang rnyed sgo)par mi 'gyur te/ /mtha' la rtsod kun de lta bas/ /gsum bral phyogs gcig spyomatha' bral ba/ /rang blo 'khrul pa snang ba yin/ /de bas mthar thug ltos yod pa/ /kun kyang mtha' yis bral ba'ang mtha'/ /yin phyir nges pa'i blo mi bzhag /gnyis med smras bsam bral ba ltos/ /tshig dang sgra mthun 7tha dad pa/ /lta spyod log par drangs thabs su/ /gsung phyir rdo rje theg chen po/ /sgra gcig don gyi ⑫khyad par rtogs/ /dang po chos kun gnas bubs nyid/ /dang por mtshan cing dngos bzlog dang / /gnyis par yang dag bden bral don//mtshon phyir ma skyes de bzhin nyid/ /stong pa nyid dang snang ba med/ /gnyis su med dang mnyam pa nyid/ /ci'ang min dang smra bsam /7'das/ /mi gnas 120 941

mi dmigs mi rtog dang / /mtha' bral rnam par dag pa dang / /mtshan med smon pa med pa dang / /chos nyid chos kyi dbyings nyid dang / /spros bral 'gro 'ong med pa dang / /snang dang 'gag med thob pa med/ /grol dang thar dang thob pa dang / /kun rdzob don dam bden pa dang / /ma chags pa dang rang bzhin dang / /dngos med zhen med rig ①pa dang / /bdag med gzhan med spyod yul med/ /lta ba rig pa ye shes sogs/ /mtshon pa'i sgra grag ②chos rnams kyi/ /rang rang don rnams tha dad pa/ /khyad par ma 'dres gsal bya'i phyir—/ /rig pas mdo tsam phyogs brjod pa/ /dang po rgyun gyis log rtog chosarka/ /bkag bsal phyogs gcig ①ma skyes dang / /dri mar ma skyes mtshan mar min/ /ched du byas pa ma skyes rnams/ /skyes spong ma skyes 'dod pa yis/ /srin bu bal bzhin bcings par zad/ /ji snyed tha dad chos rnams kun/ /gnyis med blang dor med pa yis/ /ltag pa ma go rjodon mchog ni/ /skyes pa nyid na skye ba med/ /dbyengs phyogs ma skyes de bzhin nyid/ /rig pa nyid dang yod ye shes 'dod/ /blang dor med pa'i de bzhin nyid/ /gnyis med ma byas ma bcos pa/ /smra bsam ⑤'das pa'i gtso mtsho skyesakhye)/ /de bzhin stong nyid zhen pa'ang / /phyogs stong gsal stong la sogs las/ /rnam pa'i mchog ldan stong chen po/ /yod pa nyid ni stong pa nyid/ /yod dang med dbus smra bsam 'das/ /ngo bo rang bzhin mtshan nyid dang / /byin rlabs ④la sogs khyad par 'phags/ /snang ba med ces brjod pa yang / /ma rtogs pa dang log par rtogs/ /snang la med lta bus pa med/ /phyogs gcig 6snang med phyogs ris sa med/ /badzun pa gsal ba snang med dang / /snang ba dri ma med 120 — 942

pa dang / /mtshan snang med pa la sogs pa/ /ched byas snang rtags kun par zad—/ /sna tshogs snang ba dang bcas pa'i/ /snang ba rnged pa'i mchog 'di ni//snang ba yang ①med dbyer med pas/ /'di ltar snang zhes bsam du med/ /gnyis su med par bstan pa yang / /phyogs stong gnyis med yul sems med/ /phyogs gcig ①bral ba'i gnyis med pa/ /de kun gnyis pa'i gtso mchog go/ /don dam ①'dod pa yod phyir ro/ /rgyu 'bras gnyis su med pa yang / /bya ba rnal 'byor don dam par/ /gnyis med dang du len pa'ang / /res 'jog ltos pa'i phyogs gcig ༷pa'o/ /gnyis par grags pa'i chos so cog /ldan bzhin gnyis su med pa yis/ /lhun grub blang dor med pa dang / /gzugs brnyan nor bus mtshon pa'o/ /tshe phyir mnyam nyid gsungs pa dang / /'dra ba'i mnyam pa mi mnyam chos/ /mi mnyam bral ba'i phyogs mnyam ni/ /mnyam pa'i mtha' la gnas pas log /gsang chen mnyam pa chen po ni/ /mi mnyam chos kun bdag nyid la/ /mnyam dang mi mnyam cha shas med/ /mnyam pa kun gyi yang rtse yin/ /gzhan sel don du gnyer ba'i phyir/ /ci 'ang min par bka' stsal pa'ang / /rig ⑤pas ma yin shes pa la/ /yin par snang la skyon lta bar/ /mtha' sel phyogs gcig dum yin dang / /dmigs pa ma yin kun kyang mtha'/ /blang dor med sogs mi gsum ldan/ /ci'ang min zhes brjod pa'ang / /ci'ang yin pa'i dngos gzhi can/ /yin min dbyer med cha shas bral—/ /phyogs su thug lapa 'di la med/ /rma bya'i mdongs rtse kha dog 'dra/ /dgos ched sngon bzhin smra bsam 'das/ /bden pa phyogs gcig 7de bzhin pa/ /mkhur ⑨bar chu blugs bzhin 'dod la/ /phyogs chos smra bsam yul las 'das/ /120 —943

rtog ge'i yul du nga smra'o/ /mi gsum ldan pa'i don mchog ni/ /smra bsam kun dngos smra bsam dka'/ /blo ngan yul du ma gyur las①/ /nam mkha' 'di zhes dka' dang 'dra/ /log rtog phyogs rigs rnal 'byor dang / /phyogs gsal mi gnas rten pa can/ /phyi pa 'ang 'dzin pa'i gzhi can/ /gnas pa'i gtso bor bdag gis ②brjod/ /blang med dor med mi gnas pa/ /bsgom bya sems phyir rten ①bral ba/ /gnas dang mi gnas sgong len med/ /ci la'ang yid rten mi 'cha' bas/ /mi gnas nyid la gnas mi byed/ /rten dang rten can med pa ni/ /mi gnas chen po mchog yin te/ /nam mkha' lta bu rten dang bral/ /gang gi mi dmigs shes brjod pa'ang / /log dang 'jig rten ting 'dzin dang / /'gog gnyis phyogs gcig dul gnas dang / /dbu ma ba ⑤dag mi dmigs gsum/ /'dod las gsel ba'i dmigs pa can/ /phyogs gcig dhirten med dmigs pa'o/ /dmigs pa kun bdag mi dmigs la//mtshon chen can du de brjod kyang / /mi dmigs 'dod pa'i chags pa med/ /dmigs spo zhe sdang phrag dog med/ /gnyis su med par mi dmigs la/ /mkha' la 'di zhes dmigs bral 'dra'o/ /rnam par mi rtog brjod pa'ang / /'jig rten zhen pa'i rnam mi rtog /log par sgom pa mi rtog dang / /byes pa dgag sgrub mi rtog gnyis/ /phyogs 'dzin gsal ba mi rtog pa/ /rnam dag gsal ba mi rtog rnams/ /bzhi la rtog pa med smra zhing / /mi rtog mi mthun bgegs lta bas/ /dgag sgrub blang dor byed pa de/ /nges mchog bzhi yi rtog pa can/ /thabs chen rnam par mi rtog pa/ /rtogs tshogs ming tsam ye shes phyir—/ /rtog pa nyid nas ma skyes pas/ /skyes brda'i 'du shes dbye ba med/ /120—944

dgag dang sgrub ①med mi rtog pa/ /mi rtog nyid du'ang rtog med pas/ /me long nang la rtog med bzhin/ /grol rtogs bya phyir mtha' bral ba mtha' zhes thub par grags pa rnams/ /log pa'i mtha' gnyis bral gzugs med/ /skye 'gag cha shas bral ba dang / /rang rig mtha' brgyad bzhi gnyis bral/ /mtha' la skyon du rtog byed cing / /mtha' bral yon tan len byed pa/ /ltos pas thub pa yod pa'i phyir/ /mtha' bral nyid kyang mtha' yi gtso/ /kun rdzob shes yul byed pas 'khrul/ /yang dag mtha' bral shes pa'ang mtha' brgyad la sogs grags pa rnams/ /rang rig ye shes snang ba'i phyir/ /spros pa thugs rje'i dus nyid na/ /ming tsam der red med pa'i phyir/ /mtha' dang bral ba gnyis su med/ /sman zhes bya ba'i ga bur dus/ /grang ba'i dug dang gnyis med ltar/ /bral rjes brjod pa de kho na/ /thug pa'i mtha' dang dbyer med la/ /gang du'ang thug pa med pa'i phyir/ /mtha' bral bla mar bshad pa yin—/ /rnal 'byor dag pa sbyang bya dag /mthong sgom lam gyi spang 1bya zhing / /sngags dang phyag rgya spyor rim dag /dag 'dod dri med chags pas bcings/ /thug pa'i rnam dag zhen pa can/ /rang rang kun tu btags ①pas non/ /'og mas smad pa'i dri ma rnams/ /dri ma nyid na rnam dag cing / /blang dor gnyis su med pa la/ /dag dang ma dag ris med pas/ /jeg pa kun gyi yang rtse ste/ /'dam skyes padma ji bzhin no/ /mtshan ma med pa'i rim pa yang /grags pa'i mtshan med 'dod pa yis/ /spang ④dang spel bas phyogs gcig ⑤ pa//'du shes yul la skyon lta zhing / /de med pa la mchog gzhol byed/ /'dod dang zhen pa'i gzung bu'adzin can/ /phyi yi bya ba rnal 'byor kyang / /de phyogs 120—945

mthun mtshan phyir na brdzun/ /mchog gi mtshan ma med ces pa/ /'du shes kun bdag rang rig phyir/ /yul med de la 'dzin pa med/ /de nas phyogs kyi mtshan 'dzin bral/ /de bzhin smon pa med pa yang / /blo chung ltos pa'i smos byed dang / /bsal dang len dang smon med gsum/ /'dod pas zhen pa smon pa yin/ /smon pa kun rdzogs rang rig nyid/ /lam dang 'bras bu dngos gzhi'i 3snaphyir/ /'phrul dga'i longs spyod tshul bzhin du/ /gzhan du re smon skye ba med/ /chos nyid dbyings zhes brjod (zhe7pa'ang / /spyod yul 'di dag med stong zhing / /gsal bral stong pa'i chos dbyings dang / /rang rig dag pa'i chos nyid dang / /mtshan nyid med pa'i dbyings sogs pas/ /zhen yul chos can mtha' las ril/ /stong nyid mu mtha' med sogs smra/ /rang rig rtags mthong dbyings shes bya/ /gsang sngags chen po'i chos nyid dbyings/ /chos can ma gol dmigs pa'ang med/ /byar 1med byas med bslad pa'ang med/ /'di dang 'di zhes ris med pa/ /chos nyid dam pa de kho na'o/ /kun 'byung mu med brda ④ khyab med/ /gang yang ma spangs bkol ba med/ /phyogs tshad med de blos rig med/ /de phyir gsang ba'i dbyengs zhes bya/ /rnam srangs ⑤chos de nam mkha' dang / /mthu yod phyir na nyer sbyar ba'o/ /spros bral shes par bya ba'ang / /log rtog zhe na spros pa rnams/ /skyon shes khyesel ba'i phyogs gcig 3pa/ /phyogs gcig 37spros pa'i mtha' thub ⑨bcings/ /rang rig ye shes spros pa'ang / /spong len byed na spros pa'i mtha'/ /thig le kun nas bzlum pa ltar/ /spros pa lhun 'grub spros bral ni/ /ji snyed spros pa sems nyid phyir/ /rgyu 'dzin med pa'i byang chub sems/ /ming lnga ldan pa'i ye shes ni//120—946

de nyid chos dbyings rang byung ste/ /mi gnas shes pa lhun 'grub pa/ /de kho de bzhin nyid dam pa'o/ /yul dang ngo bos spros med phyir/ /spros bral kun gyi blor ①'gyur yin/ /'gro dang 'ong ba med pa 'di/ /zhen log 'gro 'ong dam par med/ /thun mong phyogs gcig 'gro bye 'ong med/ /dag dang 'od gsal 'gro 'ong med/ /'gro 'ong phyogs la smod byed cing / /'gro 'ong med phyogs rjes 'brangs pa/ /shes bya shes byed ya cha ba/ /dam pa'i lam du gang la 'gyur/ /'gro 'ong kun dang gnyis med pa'i/ /'gro 'ong med pa chen po'orngu//'gro 'ong nyid na med pa'i phyir/ /'ong dang mi 'ong yod med med/ /rgya mtshor 'byel ④pa'i 'bab chu bzhin/ /yod med mtha' yi mo pa med/ /rtag pa 'khrul snang log snang dang / /phra rab stong 'khrul rnam snang dang / /sgyu snang ltar snang rim pa dag /yod snang la sogs 'dus snang dang / /bdag rig rang bzhin rkyen bslangs pas/ /lhag snang 'dod pas 'khrul mthong yin/ /snang med snang ba kun bdag nyid/ /rang rig ye shes cho 'phrul ni/ /rgya mtsho chu dang rlabs bzhin dukru/ /byang chub sems nyid kun tu shar/ /'gag pa med pa'i bye brag ni/ /med na mi 'gyur 'gag med dag /blo bur tsam snang mi 'gog dang / /'bras bu rdo rje'i 'gag med gnyis/ /'gag spong de dang bral 'dod na/ /'gag med mtha' la zhen par zad/ /gnyis med 'gag pa med pa ni/ /rang byung ye shes rang snang phyir/ /'gag pa nyid na 'gag med pas / /nam mkha' lta bur skye 'jig med/ /'dod pa zhen pa thob pa dang / /spangs thob sbyangs thob bgrod 'u pa dang / /bdag yin las rung thob pa dag /'dod pas spangs thob phyir na rdzun/ /thob pa med pa'i thob pa ni/ /mtshan 120—947

ldan long ba mig phyed bzhin/ /thabs la rten pa'i shes rab nyid/ /'bras bus 5 shar bar zad/ /gzhi tsam nyid la spang thob med/ /ched du phyed ①pa'i thob med gnyis/ /lan cing chags pa yod pa'i phyir/ /thog med zhen pa lcags sgog can/ /bdag nyid chen po thob med ni/ /'bras bu kun bdag rang rig la/ /gnyis phyir thob bya'i chos med de/ /dbul mo gter dang phrad ④nor bzhin/ /byed pos bgrol dang skag grol dang / /sbyangs pa grol ba phyogs gcig ①pa/ /thun mong ④min pa'i bltas ⑤grol ba/ /'ching grol gnyis su bltas dhipas bcings/ /bdag nyid chen por dbyer med pa/ /sus kyang ma bcings bcings med de/ /bcings par bya ba med gnyis grol/ /mkha' la 'dud med ji lta bu'o/ /ma rig ④nyon mongs las sdug bsngal/ /chu bo bzhi las thar pa'ang / /shin tu ring dang rgyud pa dang / /bkag spangs gsal bas thar pa dang / /zil gnon sbyor bas thar 'dod pa/ /'dod pa'i rgya mtshor chud pa'i phyir/ /rtsol ba'i chu rgyun phyogs cha khyer/ /mchog dang ring ba'i log lta can/ /chu bo bzhi nyid lam 'bras phyir/ /thabs dang shes rab las nyid kyi/ /chu bo nyid la rol spyod pas/ /brgal ba med par rnam par thar—/ /chu la nya chen 'phyo ba'am/ /sman sngags ldan pa'i dug nad 'dra'o/ /log pa'i kun rdzob rnam gnyis dang / /'khrul pa gzhan dbang kun rdzob rnams/ /rig ④pa bzhis bcus bden lta ba'ang / /yon tan rlabs ⑨'byung lha yi 'khor//tshul mthun rig ⑩pas 'bras bur lta/ /lhag pa kun rdzob don dam gnyis/ /bshad pa bzhin du shes par bya/ /thun mong ⑩don dam bye brag kyang / /bshad pa cha yis shes par bya/ /rgya mtsho dwangs par ⑫gza' skar bzhin/ /bden 120—948

gnyis snang stong dbyer med pa/ /phyogs blta'i mthar thug med pa ni/ /de ka rang bzhin rgyud nyid do/ /zhen pa'i yul la ma chags pa'ang / /tshim dang snying bo bar chad sogs/ /chags med 'khrul dang log pa dang / /bkag spangs phyogs gcig 1chags pa dang / /bzlog dang gtang 2stoms chags med dang / /bzhi po chags med chags pas bcings/ /chags med blang dor med pa ni/ /chags pa nyid na chags med pas/ /thabs dang shes rab gdeng ldan pas / /padma la ni dze de bzhin no/ /kun brtags 4rang bzhin chos rnams ni / /rgyud spangs phyogs gcig 5rang bzhin med/ /phyogs gcig dzimatha' yi rang bzhin dang / /chos nyid mtshan nyid la sogs pa/ /rang bzhin yod 'dor med bsgrub phyir/ /spong len mthar gyur rang bzhin can/ /nam mkha' dwangs pa'i ⑫ dus nyid dang / /'ja' sprin tshogs kyi rang bzhin lta/ /brtags pa'i rang bzhin thams cad pa/ /de nyid snang phyir gnyis med pa'o/ /de bzhin dngos po med pa dang / /zhen pa med cing grags pa rnams/ /ye med snga la gcig rnged gcig la gcig /med dang zhig med 'dod lta ba/gzhi la gnyis pa med 'dod pa/ /mi srid gzhi 9yi dpes mtshon par/ /'dod pa snang ris mi mthun par/ /lta ba sngon bzhin rgyu rim bzhin/ /de nyid 'bras lta'i rim pa gnyis/ /drug po 'das pa'i mthar zhen cing / /phyogs gcig gzhi la gang lta ba/ /sna tshogs snang ba'i gzhi 1 mi rung / /de des shemar me gsal dus na/ /mun pa ma sang ( sgrol med de/ /gsal nyid gnyis su med par lta/ /dngos zhen ma rig ye shes pa/ /spangs dang mi gnas 'gal ba med/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i yon tan ltar/ /dngos gnyis 120—949

lhun grub cir yang snang / /chos kun gzhi zhes de phyir bya'o/ /rdzun la sogs pa'i rig pa ni/ /rgyu yi gzhi 'dod bden lta ba/ /phyogs gcig stiyin gyi nges 'jogamo /'byung ba'i gzhi rtsar the tshom med/ /thams cad ye nas dbyer med la//rig dang ma rig blang dor med/ /gnyis med ston pa'i lung man ngag /rig ④pas 'tsham pa go 'byed pa/ /dpa' bo'i lag cha ji bzhin du/ /rnam grangs kun kyang rtogs pa'i thabs/ /rig pa med kyang thabs kyi phyemachog /yin min chos la rtsod mi byed/ /chos dang gang zag bdag med pa/ /dngos lta'i bdag med nyan thos pas/ /phyogs tsam stong pa'i chos bdag med/ /rgyun snang don 'gog bdag med dang / /gsal ba phyogs gcig thubadag med dang / /rig ༄ ⑩ snang bdag med ye shes snang / /gsum gnyis spong len byed pa'i phyir/ /bdag tu 'dzin pa'i gtso bo yin/ /phyogs bcu rang byung ye shes la / /rang byung 'di 'dra'i dngos med pas/ /chos dang gang zag yod ma yin / /la lar nyi ma'ang mun rkyen ltar/ /bdag med ye shes bdag kun ldan—/ /gnyis med bdag med bdag nyid che/ /med mthar thug pa 'di la med / /gzhan med spyod yul med pa yang / /phra bas gzhan pa'i yor po med/ /zab pas rtags pa'i dpyod byed med/ /gzhan pa stong pas med pa dang / /'khrul pas med pa'i du rdzun pas med/ /rig phyir med dang ye shes phyir/ /gzhan med pa'ang de bzhin no/ /de bral 'dod phyir lcags kyi dkris/ /sngon bzhin thams cad ye shes la/ /ngo bo gcig phyophyir cha shas med/ /gcig mtha' med pas kun tu shar/ /gnyis su med pas phung gsum med/ /de la smras bsam med pa'i phyir/ /gzung kye'adzin lcags kyis bsdoms skye pa med/ /120—950

lha rig gnyis kyi sngon brjod pa/ /'dod pa tha dad yul mthong ba'o/ /shes rab spyan gyi ngo bo ste/ /khyad par bshad pa nyid du zad/ /mthong ba'i lam du gcig 6smra ba'ang / /bshes gnyen rkyen phrad sngags mthong gi/ /de med rang gi mngon shes kyis/ /mthong na bcu pa'ang thob par rigs/ /lta ba'i sgrib pas phye ba'i phyir/ /las dang 'bras bu'i khyad par che'o/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i ye shes la/ /bcu drug gnyis su 'dod pa dang / /bzhi dang gnyis su gnas 'gyur 'dod/ /rig pa bzhi dang lngar 'dod pa/ /rang rang rtogs hūṃpa'i don mthong phyir/ /mun pa'i rab mchog yin zhes brjod/ /brgyad drug tshogs bzhi snang bcas pa/ /dpyod yul dngos po snang ngo cog /rig snyepas dbang bsgyur bzhin snang dang / /so so'i ji ltar brtags snang dang / /ngo bos nges pa red med phyir/ /sems nyid 'ba' zhig snang ba yang / /'khrul dus rang bzhin ma 'khrul dang / /so so shes pa brgyad chos phyir/ /ming gsum ldan pa'i shes gcig snguste/ /gcig dang du ma kun dngos pas/ /ye shes kun gyi bdag nyid pa/ /cha yi lnga dang brgyad brjod pa/ /rtsa ba rang byung ye shes so/ /ye nas shes pa'i bdag nyid pas/ me long blta 5ba'i tshul bzhin du/ /snang stong chos su grags pa kun/ /kha dog dbyibs sogs rang snang ba'o/ /rtag chad phyin ci log pa'i grangs/ /dngos dang ther zug skad cig rgyun/ /mi nyams ngo bo nyid rtag pa/ /tha ma theg mchog bzhed kun dang //zhig med ye nas chad pa dang / /rkyen gyi ring chad la sogs pa/ /med bzhin sngon bzhin gsungs khupa yang / /ched du byas pa'i rtag snang zad/ /sum cu brgyad sogs mtha' rnams la/ /spong len bral 'dod zhen chags can/ /120—951

bdag med smra ba'i blang dor mkhan/ /blang dor mtha' la mkhan po gnas/ /mchog 'dir mtha' yi grangs de'ang / /'du shes bzlog phyir brjod pa las/ /de dag nyid du 'dod pa med/ /sems phyir mi sgong rkun bu yang / /so so phyogs kyi ma reg pas/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i ngo bo la/ /thams cad dag ces bya ba yang / /dngos po bsal dag ma yin te/ /snang spyod nyid na rnam par dag /de phyir lhag pa zhes su brjod/ /rang bzhin sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i don/ /sangs rgyas sems can thams cad kun/ /ngo bo gcig ①pa'i de kho na/ /de ni gcig sdegi mthar thug 'gyur/ /cir yang snang ba'i ye shes nyid/ /bcos med nges pa'i de kho na/ /lhag pa'i ye shes sgyu ma de/ /byas 'gro med par ci yang 'khrul/ /nam mkha'i cho 'phrul mtsho rlabs bzhin/ /snang ba'i dus na snang med de/ /dbyer med pa la rim mi byed/ /de phyir gcig ①ces mtshon thabs brjod/ /de kho 'dra ba'i mchog yin no/ /tha dad spong ba'i gcig ④'dod pa/ /gcig gi mtha' la zhen pas nor/ /dag pa'i 'og tu gcig pa las/ /ma dag glo ⑤bur snang 'dod pa/ /sa bon med pa'i 'bras 'dod pa/ /sab rta mtho dumi thag sbrul ltar/ /smig rgyu chu zla ltar med pas/ /snang zhes rig ⑦pas bsgrub pa ⑧pa yang / /'khrul te de na ri bong rwa'ang / /'byung ba nyid du the tshom med/ /gzhi la 'dra 'khrul chos yod phyir/ /'di 'dra 'khrul ba'i chos med ltar/ /lhun 'grub dbyer med ngang la snang / /'khor 'das snang yang grub pa med/ /yod pa sun 'byin chos 'di la/ /med par smra ba byis pa'i blo/ /med par sun 'byin chos dag la/ /yod lta yin zhes smra ba'ang log /dbus 'dzin sun 'byin chos dag la/ /gcig ⑨tu lta bur ⑩byed pa'ang 'khrul/ /mtha' 120—952

bral 'dzin pa sun 'byin pa/ /dri mas bgos 'dra nor ba'i mig /kun gyi 'byung gnas byed pa'o/ /de yis ma byas gang yang med/ /kha dog dbyebs rigs kun dngos dang / /kha dog dbyibs rigs gang yang min/ /shin tu brtag ①dka' sus mi rig /rig med dang la ②thams cad snang / /byang chub sems zhes brjod pa ni/ /skad byug kun dngos rgyud med phyir/ /gang nas ma 'ong gar mi 'gro/ /rtog med rang rig kho na'o/ /shes byar gyur pa'i chos so cog /rig pa ye nas rang gsal phyir/ /rang rig shes bya dmigs skye med/ /dngos yul tsam yang 'dod ma yin/ /byang chub sems kyi thig le ni/ /kun la khyab cing mi gnas pa/ /kha dog gnas dbyibs ris yod min/ /yon tan mchog gi snying po ni/ /rtog ge'i spyod yul de ma yin/ /mnyam pa'i don nyid ji lta bu/ /mnyam nyid rang bzhin gang yang min/ /gnyis phyir min zhes brjod pa las/ /phyogs gcig ①min pa smra brjod 'das/ /zhen pa bzlog phyir rkyen bshad ma rtogs pa/ /chos kyi ngang la tshig med brjod med pa'ang / /spangs bsal rjomed phyogs log gsum blta ba ste/ /rang bzhin ngo bo mtshan nyid mchog las gol ba ni/ /'og mas spangs pa'i bog rtog ⑤grangs/ /mtha' yas mi spong rang rig phyir/ /len pa'i chos rnams blang du med/ /blang dor med pa'i don mchog ni/ /zhen bral mtha' 'das 'ching grol busogs/ /blang bya kun gyi mchog yin te/ /de nyid bdag yin bla med pa/ /nyams su blang ba'i thabs mchog yin/ /sus kyang ma bcings bcings med de/ /bcings par bya ba yod ma yin/ /bcings med rnam par grol med pa'i/ /ye nas lhun rdzogs sangs rgyas chos/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i yon tan ltar/ /120—953

bden gsum don kyang de ltar snang / /don du bden dang mi bden zhes/ /gnyis pa'i rtog pa ngang gis med/ /de mthong shes rab mchog gi spyan/ /dmigs pa'i yul gyis blta ①'dod pa/ /gzung ④'dzin lam du zhugs pa'i phyir—/ /nam yang lhag pa'i don mi mthong / /rtog pa'i yid dang rdo rje'i yid/ /snga ma mi spong mi len te/ /de sogs brgyad po'i rigs med phyir/ /brgyad bzhi'i tshogs rnams gcig ①yin te/ /rang rig tshogs gcig ④dbang drug mchog /so so'i rgyud du dbyer med de/ / brtags pas tha ⑤snyad snang dus na/ /ngo bo gcig dhipa rdo rje yin/ /yul med rang gsal shes rab spyan/ /shes pa spyod yul gnyis su med/ /shes dang shes par bya med pa'i/ /ye shes sgon me sbar ⑦bar ni/ /rgyu med rgyun tu rang shar bas/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing khams thams cad mthong / /thams cad mkhyen pa'i shes rab can/ /go tshim myong rag ⑧rig sogs chos/ /mid grangs drug bzhi gnyis su grangs/ /de ltar nges pa'i lta ba la/ /zhen pa'i lam du 'gro sa med/ /'jug pa'i dus na gcig po nyid/ /nges par rang gsal mi g.yo la/ /rtog ge pa dag de lta na/ /bogs dang yon tan dgag 'gyur zhes/ /som nyis za gzhi'i ⑨yul min pas/ /gnyis su babeebs pa gces par ⑩bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod yul te/ /blo rtsol ⑪rab kyis rtogs 'gyur cing / /brjod bzhin shes pa des skye phyir/ /zab brjod zab mor nges par skye/ /zab mo'i tshe na blo can gyis/ /rang gi mtshan nyid mngon rtogs phyir/ /'dod pa med par zhor bogs sogs/ /'byung ba nyid na g.yos pa med/ /rnal 'byor thabs dang shes rab lam/ /rim par mngon byas stobs 'gyur na/ /dpag bsam shing dang rin chen ltar/ /120 9 54
