pa'i u pa ṅgā'i tsaṇa la thung ngu nyid do zhes pas thung ngu nyid do/ /mtshungs pa ma phyis na yang ba la in dang tsaṇa pha rol la san bzhin no zhes pas san bzhin du 'gyur ba'i phyir e ①nyid do/ /yang ba'i ring po'o zhes pas ring po nyid do/ /kā ri ta dbyi'o/ /a ṭī ka rad/ de bzhin du/ a dzre ha ra ta a pa'i pa ṭha ta—/ a pa'i pa tsa ta/ a dzi dza ya ta/ a rpā pa ba ta/ a lī la la ta/a yi ya ba ta/ shu/ sru/ dru/ pru/ blu/ sgong rnams kyi yang na bar brjod par bya'o zhes pas yang na i nyid do/ /a shi shra bta/ a sha shra bta/a shu shra bta/ a se sra bta/ a su sra ba ta/ a di dra ba ta/ a du dra ba ta/ a pi pra bta/ a su pra bta/ a pi sra bta/ a pu bee bta/a tsi tsu bta/ a tsu tsu bta/ ṭu o shi/ shwa ya ti'i yang na'o zhes pa 'jug bzhin pa la/ kā ri ta la'ang san dang tsaṇa dag la'o zhes pas/ yang na saṃ pra sā ra ṇa'o/ /a shi shwa yata/ a byu sha bta/ dhwa ④nya/ hwa ya ta'i rtag tu'o zhes pas saṃ pra sā ra ṇa'o/ /a dzu ha ba ta/ twa ra sogs rnams kyi yang a'o zhes san bzhin du 'gyur ba'i dmigs bsal/ a ta ru bsgyur ro/ /a ta twa rata/ a sa sma rata/ a da da rata/ a pa pra thata/ a ma mra datarka/ a ta sta rata/ a ba spa shata/ beṣṭa bkra shis pa la'o/ /tseṣṭa/g.yo ba la'o/ /biṣṭi nadang tseṣṭi dag la yang na'o zhes pas yang a ta ru bsgyur ro//a bi beṣṭata/ a ba beeṣṭata/ a tsi tseṣṭata/ a tsa tseṣṭata/ ga ṇa/grangs la'o/ /ga ṇa'i yīṇa 4'ang ngo zhes pas yang na a sgyusa'i nyid do/ /a jo ga ṇata/ a dza ga ṇata/ mtshungs pa phyis pa la san bzhin du 'gyur ba med do/ /a tsa ka thata/ bar 'dod pa la'o/ /a ba ba rata/ ing /120 1127

in la san dang tsaṇa dag la'o zhes rnam par bshad pas ga ru bsgyur ro zhes kha cig go/ /'dir ni in la san dang laṇa dag la yang / gā ya ti'i glog ①par byed pa la 'jug go/ /a dhyā dzi ga pa ta/ id/ a dhyā bi ba ta/ a ṭi zhes pa gnas pa la in la mtshungs pa zhes sogs kyis thung ngu nyid do//dbyangs dang po las gnyis pa'i 'o zhes pas gnyis brjod do/ /phyi nas a yig gi ā yig go/ /ā ṭi ṭa ta/ mā dang māsma sbyor ba la ma yin no zhes pa'i dgag pa las a ṭa la sogs pa rnams mi 'gyur ro/ /mā bha bān ṭi ṭa ta/ na ba dar rnams brtsegs pa'i dang po rnams la ma yin pa la ma yin no zhes pas na yig dang ya yig dang ba yig dang nga yig dang re pha rnams gnyis brjod par mi bya'o / /undi/ slas pa la'o/ /dbyangs dang po rnams kyi dang po'i 'phel ba'o zhes pas dang po'i 'phel ba la'o/ /63 data/ urja/ gnam pa la'o/ /yoñdzi dza ta/ a bhā/ mngon par sbyor ba la'o/ /a rnyi ḍa ta aspyo/ mchod pa la'o/ /ādhri tsa rata/ dṛ byu/ mṛ dzñā/ kṛ pū/ 1 ta/ in dang tsaṇa la ri yig gi ṛta'o zhes kha cig go/ /'dir ni yon tan gyi ming sngon ma can gyi phyir ro/ /kātrī i ṣa dag gi tta'o zhes shes par byed pa'i rtag tu ba ma yin pa nyid kyi phyir na yon tan no/ /yang na tīrbhe ru bsgyur ro/ /a bhi dṛ dha ta—/ a basmyota/ a mbi mṛ dzata/ a ma ma brdzata/ a ṭī kṛ pata/ a tsa kalpata/ a ṭī kṛ tata/ a tsi tīrtata/ shā su ṛta rjes su 'brel pa rnams / ṭu bee thra/ ṭu yā—/ in la mtshungs pa phyis pa min pa'i u pa dhwa'i tsaṇa la thung ngu'o/ /thob pa la shā su dang ṛta rjes su 'byel pa rnams kyi ma yin no zhes pas bkag go/ /a sha shā sata/ a pi pe pata/ a ya yā tsata/120—1128

kā ra yā mā sa/ kā ra yāsba byu ba/ shwasta rī/ kā ra yi ta/ ā shiḥ kāryata/kā ra yi ྾ṣṭa/ bha bi 6rnyi/ kā ra yi byu ti/ kri ①yā ti pa dhiḥ a kā ra yi 6 ta/de ltar in mtha'i yul bstan pa'o// //in mtha' dang san mtha' brjod par bya'o/ /kā ra yi tu misbyi ta/ san 'oske/ gnyis brjod do/ /san la a yig gi'o zhes pas sri nyid do/ /tsi kā ra yi ṣa ti/ dzi hā ra yi ṣa ti/ dzi ghra pa yi ṣa ti/ /dza dang mthar gnas dang /pa sde pha rol gyi u yig gi a yig la'o zhes pas a sgyu sa'i i nyid do/ /li khā ba yi ṣa ti/ pi pā ba yi ṣa ti/ bī snebhā ba yi ṣa ti/ shwa ya ti'i yang na'o zhes pa ②rjes su 'jug bzhin pa la/ /kā ri ta la'ang san dang tsan dag la'o zhes pas saṃ pra sā ra ṇa'o/ /shi shwa ya yi ṣa ti/ shu shā ba yi ṣa ti/ dhwanya/ hwa ya ti'i rtag tu'o zhes pas saṃ pra sā ra ṇa'o/ /dzu hā ba yi ṣa ti/ ing /in la san dang tsan dag la'o zhes rnam par bshad pas gā ru bsgyur ro zhes kha cig go/ /'dir ni/ in la san dang tsan ④dag la yang gā ya ti'i glog ⑤par byed pa la 'jug go/ /a dhi dzi gā pa yi ṣa ti/ ing / a dhyā pi ba yi ṣa ti—/ tse 1 yi ta'i mtha' las kyang sana'o/ /lo khru yi ṣa te/ po pū yi ṣa te/a sgyu sa med pa'i zhes pa'i tshig las/ gnyis brjod pa byas pa'i sbar yang gnyis brjod par mi 'gyur ro/ /de ltar san mtha'i yul bstan no// //ming gi byings brjod par bya'o/ /pū tra mitstsha ti zhes pa ming las bdag nyid 'dod pa la yin no zhes pas yin rkyen no/ /i yig dang na yig kyang /in la a yig gi'o zhes pa'i khyad par gyi don to/ /der gnas rnam dbye rnams dbyi bar bya'o zhes pa rnam dbye dbyi'o/ /gang dang gang gi rtags kyi rnam 120 1130

dbye phyis pa yod pa la/ de dang de'i snga mar yod pa'i rang bzhin kho nar 'gyur ro—/ /de las/ in la a yig la 3gi'o zhes pas a yig gi āo nyid do/ /pu ṭī ya zhes pa gnas pa la/ de rnams byings rnams so zhes pas byengs kyi ming yod pa/ byings las rkyen pha rol tu 'gyur ro/ /lhag ma las/ byed pa po la pa rasmi'i tshig go/ /byed pa po la ana'o/ /pu ṭī ya ti/ ku ṭī ya ti/kadza lbo ya ti/ mā bā rī ya ti/ kha ṭwā mitstsha ti/ kha ṭīya ti/ na dbyi ba'ang ngo zhes pas na yig dbyi'o/ /rā jo ya ti/ ta kṣu ya ti/ rta dang 'o ma dang glang dang lan tshwa rnams kyi bdag dga' ba la suka ā ga ma 'dod par bya'o/ /rta dang glang dag gi 'khrig pa 'dod pa la/ a shwa gya ti ba ḍa bā/ thra ṣa bya ti goḥ gzhan la/ a shī ya ti/ thra ྾ ya ti/ 'o ma dang lan tshwa dag thob par 'dod pa la/ spyi ra pya ti bā laḥ la pa ṇa pya ti goḥ gzhan la/ spyi ri ya ti/ la ba bee ya ta na/ tshig so so ba can thams cad rnams las/ za bar sred pa rnams la/ as brjod par bya'o/ /da dhyā 1bee ti/ ma dhwa pya ti/'ga' zhig sogs 4par 'dod pas/ su brjod par bya'o/ /da dhi pya ti/ ma dhu pya ti/ zas 'dod par byed pa bza' ba dang / chu 'dod par byed pa 'thung ba dang / nor 'dod par byed pa sred pa zhes pa'i ngag nyid la/ a sha nā yang dang / u da n+ya dang / dhra nā yā rnams ni/ bkres pa dang /skom pa dang / 'dod pa rnams la/ tshig phrad du grags so zhes pas ji lta bar rigs pa la/ ā nyid do/ /ka'i yang na nyid do/ /a dbye ba yang tshig phrad du bya'o/ /a sha nā ya ti/ u darya ti/ dha nā ya ti/ gzhan la/zas 'dod par byed pa sbyin pa ni/ ā 5sha mbi ya ti/ khrus chu 'dod pa ni/120 113 1

u da kri ya ti/ nor 'dod par byed pa sbyin pa la/ dha mbi ya ti/ 'dir ni/a sha nā ya'i byings/ bkres pa la'o/ /u da n+ya/ skom pa la'o/ /dha nā ya/'dod pa la'o/ /zas 'dod par byed pa bza' ba zhes pa la sogs pa'i ngag nyid la yan mngon par brjod par bya'o/ /kā mya yang ngo zhes pas/ kā mya rkyen du 'gyur ro/ /'dod pa'i don la'o/ /pu tra mitstsha ti/ pu tra kā mye ti/i da mitstsha ti/ i rda kā mya ti/ swa ṛtstsha ①ti/ swaḥ kā mya ti/ nye bar 'jal ba las kun spyod la'o zhes pas yin rkyen no/ /bu lta bur kun tu spyod par byed pa ni/ pu tri yā ④ti/ mā ṇa ba rka/ byed pa po la ā yis te/ sa dbyi ba yang ngo zhes pas ā yis rkyen te/ sa dbyi ba yang ngo / /khra lta bur spyod par byed pa ni/ ā yi'i mtha' las kyang ngo zhes pas ādma ṣpe'i tshig go/ /byu nā ya te/ sā ra sa i bā tsa pa ti/ sā ra sā ya te/ si yig dbyi'o/ /mo dza ya te/ a beer ya te/ pa/ yas las ni rnam par bshad pas sa yig dbyi'o—/ /pa yā te/ pa ya pya te/ de la yang na'i sgra'i 'dod pa'i don gyi phyir ā li'i ya dbyi'o zhes kha cig go/ /bong bu lta bur kun tu spyod par byed pa ni—/ garta bha ti/ a shwa ti/ de bzhin du yang gsungs pa/ o dzas dang aspa ras las rtag tu'o/ /pa yas las ni rnam par bshad pa'o/ /ā yi dbyi ba yang rnam par shes par bya/ a shwa dang gardi bha ti la yin pa yang ngo zhes so/ /galha dang khro ba dang ho ḍa rnam par bshad pa'i zhes kha cig go/ /ru tsa sogs nyid las ādma ṣpe'i tshig go/ /galha te/ galha ya te/ kli tshu)ba te/ khri ba ④yā te/ho nā (5)te/ ho ḍā ya te/ de bzhin du/ rtswa'i don la j-i sha sogs las ta dang sa dag gi dbyi ba yang ngo zhes pas ā'i rkyen no/ /ta da sa dag gi dbye ba 120——1132

yang ngo / /lhag pa ma yin pa lhag par 'gyur ba/ j-i shā ya te/ uṣṭha nā ya te/durma nā ya te/ pe ha ta/ pe hā ya te/ sha shwa te/ sha shwa ya te/ yang na'i tshig las rtswa yang 'gyur ro/ /ji ①shī bha ba ti/ lo nyi ta la sogs pa rnams las rtswa'i don la ḍātsa'o zhes pas ā'i rkyen no zhes kha cig go/ /'dir ni pa ṭatpa ṭaska ro ti zhes pa'i tshig la/ mi gsal ba'i rjes brjod byed pa'i ḍātsa'o zhes pas/ ḍātsa'i yu la la gnyis brjod do/ /ta dbyi ba yang 'dod do zhes pas ta dbyi'o/ /phyi nas mi gsal ba'i rjes brjod byed pa las dbyangs gcig ma yin pa las a ni ti la/ ḍātsa'o zhes pas ḍātsa'i rkyen no/ /tsa yig ni ma ②gsal ba'i rjes brjod byed pa'i ḍātsa'o zhes dang / ḍa yig ni ḍa rjes su 'byel pa la mtha'i dbyangs la sogs pa dbyi'o zhes pa'i khyad par gyi don no/ /'di nyid kyis mtha'i dbyangs la sogs pa dbyi'o/ /snal bu snam bu lta bur kun du spyod par byed do zhes pas byed pa po la ā yis te sa dbye ba yang ngo zhes pas ā'i rkyen no/ /ya dza la sogs pa phal pa'i tshogs nyid kyi phyir gnyi ga'i tshig go/ /pa ḍa pa ḍā ya te/ tsha ma ṭa/ tsha matstsha mā ya nyi/ tsha matstsha mā ya te/ ṛ ①ṇa ta/ṛ ④ṇa ṛ ṇa ya ti/ ṛ rjoṇa ṛ ḍā ya te/ dmar po lta bur kun tu spyod par byed pa ni/ lo hi tā ya ti/ lo hi tā ya te/ kaṣṭa ya kra ma ṇi kra bum ti/kaṣṭa ya te/ de bzhin du/ pā pā ya te/ ka kṣu ya te/ sand+ra ya te/ ga ha nā ya te/ sdig pa'i 'jug pa rnams las gzhan la mi 'gyur ro/ /kaṣṭa ya ta pa sa krā ma ti/ ro masgo brta ya ti goḥ rlangs pa gyen du 'byung bar byed pa ni/pāṣka ya te/ de bzhin du/ sprudmā ya te/ phe nā ya/ bde ba la sogs pa rnams la rig par bya ste/ su ṣā laya te/ de bzhin du/ duṣṭha ya te/ sgra 120—1133

la sogs pa rnams byed pa ni/ shasthā ya te/ de bzhin du/ bai ①rā yā te/ka la hā ya te/ a sgyu ya te/ kaṇḍa geya te/ me ghā ya te/ su di nā ya te/durdi nā ya te/ nī hā rā ya te/ na mas dang ta pas dang pa ri pas rnams las ni yina'o/ /phyag 'tshal bar byed pa di/ na ma su ti/ de bzhin du/ ta pa gya ti/ ba ri mib gya ti/ na dbye ba 'ang ngo zhes pa'i nges pa las 'dir rnam bcad du mi 'gyur ro/ /tsi tāng / ngo mtshar ba la'o/ /nga yig ni ādma ṣpe'i tshig gi don no/ /ngo mtshar ba la ri mor byed pa ni/ tsi ṭī ya te/ kaḍū la sogs pa rnams las yaṇa'o/ /karjanya/ g.yan pa byed pa ni/ nya yig rjoni gnyi ga'i tshig gi don no/ /ṇa yig ni yon tan med pa'i don no/ /karja ya ti—/ garja ya te/ ma tīng / pa tī ya te/ zhes pa la sogs pa rjes su 'brang bar bya ba rnams so/ /ha lo/ ka bo 'dzin par byed do zhes pa la/byengs don la in te kā ri ta'o zhes pas in rkyen no/ /na yig ni/ in la rtags kyi zhes pa la sogs pa'i khyad par gyi don to/ /ha la ya te/ ka la ya te/de bzhin du/ kṛ ta ya ti/ baṇḍi ya ti/ twa tsa ya te/ tūstu ni bi harnyi/bi tu sta ya ti/ ke sha na bir lī ka ra ti/ sgra rnams la grol bar byed do zhes pa'i don to/ /gos kyis kun tu 'gebs par byed pa ni/ saṃ basthā ya ti/go cha gyon par byed pa ni/ saṃ band+ra ya ti/ phye mas kun tu 'joms pa ni/a ba tsūṇḍi ya te/ de byed pa dang de'i tshe smras pa la'o zhes pas ina'o/ /mgo bo byed pa ni/ muṇḍa ya ti/ de bzhin du/ mi shra ya nyi/ shra kyā ya ti/ la ba ṇa ya ti/ sru tra ya ti/ brtul zhugs las zas la dang / de ldog pa la'ang in rkyen du 'gyur ro/ /ba yo bra ta ya ti/ longs spyod zhes pa'i don 120—1134

no—/ /thra ṣa lānda pra ta ya ti/ mi za'o zhes pa'i don no/ /des 'da' bar byed do zhes pas ina'o/ /glang po che'i ①rim pa las 'da' bar byed pa ni/a ti'i sgra sngon ma ni tshig phrad do/ /a ti hasta ya ti/ byed pa po dang byed pa'i don la/ pi waṃ gis nye bar glu len par byed pa ni/ u pa bī ṇa ya ti/shing bal rnams kyis nges par 'gugs par byed pa ni/ a ba tū la ya ti/tshigs su bcad pas ④nye bar bstod par byed pa ni/ u pa shlau ka ya ti/ sde yis mngon par 'gro bar byed pa ni/ sthā dang se ni zhes sogs kyis ṣa nyid do/ /a bhi ṣe ṇa ya ti/ 'ga' zhig gi tshe mthong ba la/ rū paṃ pa byu hi①/ rū pa ya ti/ mang po 'di rnams nges par mthong ngo / /i ni da/ yan lag mi gnas pa la yang ngo / /yan lag mi gnas pa'i don la i nid rkyen du 'gyur ro//hasto ni ra su ti/ hasta ya te/ de bzhin du pā da ya te/ mi gnas pa la yang ngo zhes yang gi sgra mang po'i don nyid kyi phyir/ rnga ma las 'degs pa la/butstsha mutrī pa ti/ u tyātstsha ya te/ de bzhin du/ rnga ma yongs su g.yob par byed pa ni/ pa ri putstsha ya te gaḥ④ snod kun tu sogs par byed pa ni/ saṃ bhāṇḍaya te/ chos gos la yang dag par nyug par byed pa'am yongs su 'jog par byed pa ni/ saṃ ṭī pa ra ya te ddhākṣuḥ shwe ta a shwa dang a shwa ta ra dang ga la (peḍi ta dang / a hwa ra ka rnams kyi a shwa dang ta ra dang ita dang ka dbye ba yang ngo / /yang yig gis byings don la in ning yang dag par bsdus par 'dod do//rta dkar po brjod pa la/ de yis 'da' bar byed pa'o/ /yang na'o/ /a shwa'i dbye'o/ /shwe ta ya ti/ rta mchog brjod pa la/ ta ra'i dbyi'o/ /a shwa ya te/ gā lo ḍi ta brjod pa la/ i ti'i dbyi'o/ /gā lo ḍa ya te/ ā 120—1135

hwa ra ka brjod pa la/ ka dbyi'o/ /ā hwa ra ya te/ mang po nyid las ina'i rkyen la yang ngo / /shwe ta ya ti/ a shwa ya ti zhes pa la sogs pa'o// //mantu babye bin rnams kyi 'jig pa la yang ngo / /'dir beer yang a nid bshad par mi bya'o/ /yī sha /mchog gi dbang phyug la'o/ /yī sha na la yīṭa'o—/ /saṃ pa da la sogs pa nyid las kre ①sra'o/ /'di'i yod pa la yīṭa'o zhes pas lhag ma rnams mantu 'dod do zhes pa'i tshig las mantu rkyen no/ /de idmadhe brjod pa la zhes pas byengs don la in byas pa la mantu 'jig go/ /rgyu mtshan gyi dngos po med na rgyu mtshan can gyi yang dngos po med do zhes pas rang bzhin gyi rang gi ngo bos nges par gnas so/ /āo sha ya ti/ ldan par brjod pa la/ ga ba ya ti/ srusbadhe brjod pa la/ dhuṭa'i mtha' las mantu 'jig go//sru tsa ya ti/ mā yā dang sne dhwa dang sra dza las bin 'gyur ro zhes pas/ srasbi rṇa brjod pa la/ sra dza ya nyi/ pra sha su shra'o/ /pra sha su la/ brjod pa la zhes pas in byas pa la shā ru bsgyur ro/ /dbyangs gcig pa rnams kyi ata'i mtha' rnams kyi 'ang ngo zhes pas ā pa ā ga ma'o/ /shā pa ya ti/ thrarnyi'i ④yang bye'o/ /yang yig las pra sha su'i yang ngo / /'phel bar smras pa las/ pra sha su'i yang na'o—/ /ina'o/ /dza ya ru bsgyur ro/ /snga ma bzhin ā ba ā ga ma'o/ /dzñā pa ya ti/ arnyi ka dang / ba bhā dag gi ṣpe dang sā dha dag go/ /arnyi rka brjod pa la/ ina'o/ /ni da ru bsgyur ro/ /ṣpe da ya ti/ bā bye brjod pa la—/ ina'o/ /sā dha ru bsgyur ro/ /sā dha ya ti/ yu ba dang alnga dag gi kan yang na'o/ /lang tsho ldan pa brjod pa la/ ina'o/ /kan du bsgyur ro/ /ka na ya ti/ phyogs gcig la/ sna la dang / dru ra dang / yu ba dang kṣi pra 120— 36

zhes sogs kyis mthar gnas la sogs pa dbyi ba dang yon tan yang ngo ya ba ya ti/ chung ngu brjod pa la/ ka na ya ti/ phyogs gcig la/ alpa ya ti/snyu kyel dang / du ra dang / yu ba dang / kṣipra tresnadang kṣu dru rnams kyi mthar gnas la sogs pa dbyi ba dang yon tan yang ngo / /sbom bor smra ba la yīn nano//mthar gnas la sogs pa dbyi ba dang / nā min gyi yon tan yang ngo / /sbra ba ya ti/ thag ring bar smra ba la/ da ba ya ti/ lang tsho dang ldan par cesmra ba la / ya ba ya ti/ myur bar smra ba la/ kṣi pa ya ti/ phra bar smra ba la/kko pa 5ya ti/ ba hu'i ya la sogs pa dang bhū yang ngo / /mang po smra ba la zhes pas ya yig ḍa dang ina'o/ /ba hu'i yang bhū ru bsgyur ro/ /byu ya ya ti/ thra 6ya dang sbir dang spru ra dang / u ru dang gu ru dang / ba hu la dang tro pra dang /dīrgha dang hra sba dang / dṛ dha dang thrand+ra ra ka rnams kyi pra dang / sgra dang spa dang ba ra dang ga ra dang baṃha dang / tra ba dang dru gha dang hra sa dang barṣa dang dṛnda rnams so/ /dga' bar smra ba la ina'o/ /pra ru bsgyur ro/ /āb/ā ga ma yang ngo / /pā pa ya ti/ de bzhin du sbi re smra ba la/ sthā pa ya ti/mbi ri smra ba la/ spa ba ya ti/ u ru smra ba la/ pa ra ya ti/ lci bar smra ba la/ga ra ya ti/ mang por smra ba la/ ba ha ya ti/ tre bye smra ba la/ tra pa ya ti/ring por smra ba la/ dru gha ya ti/ thung ngur smra ba la/ tra sa ya ti/ z-iddhā smra bal / parja yan 7ti/ tshogs pa smra ba la/ dṛnda ya ti/ bden pa dang don dang rig pa rnams kyi mthar ā pa ni kā ri ta nyid do/ /bden par smra ba la/ina'o / /'di yis ā ba'o/ /sa tyā pa ya ti/ de bzhin du arja ba ya ti/pa dā pa ya ti/ dbyangs gcig pa rnams kyi ata'i mtha' rnams kyi 'ang ngo / /120—1137

shā ba ya ti/ kā ri ta nyid do zhes pa'i tshig las 'dir mi 'gyur ro/ /greṣṭhaḥgre mā—/ gre yān zhes pa'o zhes pa mkhan po dga' ba'i grags pas mdzad pa'i tshig gsa'ab jo/gas ses// //'di ni dpyal lo tsā kyeb dpal chos kyi bzang po'i phyag dpe'i rgya dpe las/shākya'i dge slong dharmā byeshrī bha dras mkhan chen lo tsā rngub chen po bu ston zhabs kyi bka' drin las bod kyi skad du bsgyur ba'i gnas ni/ paṇḍi ta dī paṃ kā ra shrī dzñā nā'i cebyin gyis brlabs pa'i chos gnas chen po ri phug go// //bsdur mchan/975 hūṃmatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa/ ltar bkod/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha/ hūṃ〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dngu'i/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ke nyi'i/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉risten/976 lku〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tharta/ thu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ta/977 7ri1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7bu/ tre〈〈pe 〉〉taspru/ ༄ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shes/ je〈〈pe 〉ra/ dhe/ 〈〈snar 〉ra/ sgyi/ snye〈〈pe 〉lte/sgyu ma te/ 〈〈snar 〉med snga ma nyi/ tre〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra rta/978 hūṃthu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉8/ zu〈〈pe 〉8/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dkusta/ pye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra/ tre〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rasmi / (chos tshan 'di'i nang du rasmi'i zhes pa/ rnams 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngal rasmi zhes 'khod kyang bsdur mchan du bkod med/) lnga〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉phrodhe/ rje 〈〈snar 〉rabu/ rmye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dhe/979 nyu〈〈pe 〉〉lham/98༷ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dbyer/ 5〈〈pe 〉༅/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ripa/ thu〈〈pe 〉shesan/ snye〈〈pe 〉mdza/981 rte—〈〈pe 〉shes/ snye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thacad bya ru/ snye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉lke/ je〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra/ tha/ snye〈〈snar 〉〉brang / hūṃ 〈〈pe 〉〉gyi/982 hūṃ〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༅sa/ 3sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉lke'i/ rmye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rasto'i/ hūṃ〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉med/ phyo〈〈pe 〉tsā/6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ṣa'i/983 khye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mo / 2〈〈pe 〉7go/ / 3 〈〈snar 〉〉thig ce〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rasad/120—1138

3690༄ga /mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos sna tshogs gsal ba zhes pa ming gzhan mu tig phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ a bhi dhwa na shā nt+ra bi shwa lo tsa na mi tya sa rā bhi dhwa na mukta ba lī nā ma/ bod skad du/ mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos sna tshogs gsal rab ④zhes pa ming gzhan mu tig phreng ba zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das dang de'i chos rgyal bar gyur cig dbyangs can rab tu dang bar mdzod/ /skye 'gro rnams la bde ba 'byung zhing dregs dang mi dge ba las drang bar mdzod/ /bdag gis gang zhig legs par sbyar ba'i bum pa mchog las byung ba'i chu 'dir yang / /ci zhes lhags ka )par byed pa don ④la mkhas pa rnams kyis kun tu 'jug par mdzod/1/sde tshan don du mtha' dag snying stobs la dad dpal/ /dpal ldan snyan ngag mkhan po thub pa'i sde zhes byung / /bdag gi rig pa'i gnas ni tshig ldan ngag snyan bcas/ /grags ldan bstan bcos mtha' dag las ni rjes su bsdus/2 /120—1150

de phyir ngag gi rang bzhin ma lus pha rol gzigs gyur pa/ /sa gzhi la gnas 'dren pa rnams kyi yid brtan snod du gyur/ /dpal ldan dpal 'dzin gyis ni snyan ngag mkhan mchog mtha' dag gis①/ /sbyar ba'i de nyid bdud rtsi'i btung ba 'chi med dbyangs can ldan/ 3 /de ni phul byung snyan ngag mkhan gyi lam skyes brling ba can/ /blo yi mig ldan bla mas bstan pa'i mig dang ldan pa yis/ /sna tshogs snyan ngag mkhan dbang gis bkod mngon brjod mdzad ②rnams las/ /drangs te mig dang 'dra ba 'di ni sgron me'i mdzod lta bu/ /rtog ge dang bcas snyan ①ngag mkhan byu lung skyes brling ba rnams/ /kun tu snang byas rig gnas rnams kyi grong du nges gnas shing / /spobs pa ldan pa rnams kyi blo yi lam dang 'dres byas pas/ /da ni 'di yis skye ngan rnams kyi tshig kyang bcom par 'gyurarjorka/ 5 /'bad pas ngal bar gyur dang ma gyur ma lus rig pa dang / /rig pa 'dzin pa stobs ldan rnams kyi blo la nges sbyar ba/ /dri med rin chen kaustu bha sa te 'dir slar yang zlom dor nas/ /dpal mo'i dpal yon bzhin du rgya chen kho lag mchis ⑤'di la'o/ 6 /klu yi dbang po yang dag gnas pa'i mdzod gyur rgya mtsho'i dbus/ /sna tshogs snyan ngag mkhan dbang kha yi nya phyis las byung ba/ /mkhas pa 'chi bumed kyis sprul dar gyi srad bu la brgyus nas/ /mu tig phreng ⑦ba bkod 'di snying la yang dag gzhag ⑧par mdzod/ 7 /'dod chags bral ba'i dri bzangs kyi/ /snyan grags me tog ra ba ni/ /bsten las 'di yi zhabs gnas pa—/ /gang yang klu shing lta bur ⑨lhags/ 8 /gang zhig sgra la mkhas pa rnams dang mngon brjod 'dzin pa rnams dang 'jig rten pa/ /de dag gis kyang deng nyid mthong na yid la dga' ba lhag par skyed par byed/ /des na bdag gis 120—1151

'bad pa 'di de lhag par gzhan gyi ched du bstan par 'gyur①/ /bdag gis rgol ba rnams ni dga' ba'i ched du dregs pa 'joms byed byas par gyur/ 9 /dang por mang du mkhyen rnams kyis/ /sgra la 'bras bu gang bzhed pa/ /de 'dir 'chi med lugs rnams kyis/ /bdag gis sgra rnams nges par dgod/10/ mtho ris ②la ming sum cu/ mtho ris mi zad gnas bzang dang / /gzhi gsum pa dang / gnam dang / mkha' ④nabha/ /rol sa dudang ni/ bde ldan—/ mkha' rodasī/ /'bras bu 'byung dang / dal 'dzin dang / lha yi gnas dang / kun tu skye/ skyo med/ skabs gsum/ mtho ris dang / /mkha' dang / dbang po'i gnas/ /bde 'gro/ /dga' byed/ lhas rtsen/rol pa'i sa/ /steng gi 'jig rten lha yi grong / /lha yi 'jig rten/ so ri ka/ta bi ṣa dang / tā bi ṣa/ /ri rab steng dang / mkha' gnas so / 30 /⑤lha la ming lnga bcu rtsa gnyis/ de nas lha dang / yid bzang dang / /bde 'gro can dang / 'dod gzugs can/ /legs bris/ tshigs mda'/ mis byin dhiskyes/ /tshigs bzang dang ni tshe ring dang / /tshogs bzang bcud ldan rmi lam med/ /bi na swanta/ gzhal med can/ /skabs gsum pa dang /ṛ yig skyes/ /bsgrub bya/ 'chi med/ bdud rtsi a mṛtarnya pa zas/ / mis byin ⑦bu dang/ a di'i bu/ /sum rtsen dbang dang mkha' khyim can/ /bdud rtsi skyes dang mkha' la gnas/ sbyin sreg swāhā bhu dza za dang mchod sbyin za/ /mkha' na bhaḥs daḥ'agro mkhar gnas gnam la gnas/ /rnam ⑧sad dang ni bdud rtsi za/ /na lismra dang rgas matur med dang / /dge skyes mi 'chi sbyin a ma raḥdā na bā ri ⑨skyes dgra—/ /mkha' spyod sbyin de—ridagra gzhi gsum gnas/ /me zhal lha las 120—1152

skyes dang lha debata/ /mtho ris gnas dang mig mi 'dzums1/ /pū dzi 2khā dang ma mchodahi la 'dzin/ /bu bā nā dang ba bu nā/ /bai tā matūtalha dang rje btsun zhabs/ /dang po'i lha dang / rgyal byed dang / /tshangs pa 'phrog byed rdo rje can/ /nyin mo'i/ 'byung gnas bar ma gsum/ /gnyid swa lha las skyes zhes zer/ /nyi ma sna tshogs/ nor rghaṃ dang / /dga' ldan ldang ni rgyal ya/ che/ /grub kau rlung lha 'od galdul dang / /drig po 'di rnams tshogs kyi lha'o/ /chu skyes rig 'dzin mi 'am ci/ /dri za gsang ba pa sha za/ /gnod sbyin srin po 'byung po dang / /grub pa 'di rnams lha las byung / /ṛ zhes bya ba dang mi sbyin ma/ /lha yi rmi'o sngon skyes pa/ zla ba'i sbugs gnas mtshon cha bkod/ /bdud rtsi 6zas dang mtshun gyi ni/ /gzhon nu lha mi phozer ba 'dra la sogs de rnams kyang / /lha ma/ yin la ming bco lnga/ sbyin skyes dang ni mchod sbyin dgra/ /sngon gyi lha dang sbyin ma'i bu/ /sbyin skyes dbang po'i dgra sbyin byung / /pa sangs slob ma sa 'og gnas / /bcud mi ldan dang lha la dmod/ /kai ke ya dang ku tsa dang / /de 4te skyes dang pra gha ṣa/ /iṣṭi yu zhes de rnams so/ 15 /sbyin ma sbyin skyes ma dang ni/ /sbyin skyes skyong 5ma di ti'o/ /sangs rgyas la mtshan bdun cu rtsa gnyis/ /kun mkhyen bde gshegs ston pa dang / /gnyis med gsung ba de bzhin gshegs/ /kun tu bzang po rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /thub pa sangs rgyas thub pa che/ /dpal stug thugs rje mdzad pa dang / /bdud 'dul rgyal ba 'jig rten 'dul/ /skyob pa thub dbang bcom ldan 'das//mngon shes drug ldan rnam par 'dren/ /byams pa'i stobs mnga' stobs bcu 120—1153

mnga'aske/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug rgyal ba dang / /mchod 'os bcu pa spyan bcu gnyis—/ /thams cad gzigs pa stobs chen mahāb la ldan/ /chags bral skyabs gsum sku gsum pa trimutri/ /'og min bzhugs dang chags 'joms dang //chos kyi rgyal po mun pa 'joms/ /mkha' mnyam pa dang mi mnyam pa/ /rtogs ldan yon tan 'byung gnas dang / /rnam shes tsam pa mkhyen lnga pa/ /chos sku chos dbyings chos 'khor ba/ /shin tu nges pa bde chen pa/ /stobs ①chen sems chen stobs chen pa mahābal/ /rgyal ba'i dbang po 'ba' zhig pa/ /rdo rje can dang yang dag sbas/ /dgra bcom pa dang bzod mang ba/ /'jig rten mgon po dus gsum mkhyen/ /pha rol phyin bcu 'chang ba dang / /nam mkha' mtshungs dang tog dkar po/ /byang chub sems dpa' legs gsung ba/ /gnyis med pa dang rtsod pa bral/ /sku gsum yon tan 'byung gnas dang / /dri ma mi mnga' byams chen ldan/ /byang chub pa dang sa bcur son/ /thams cad rtogs dang dgra las rgyal/ 72 /ston pa thub pa la mtshan bcu drug /shākya seng ge go ta ma/ /zas gtsang sras dang shākya thub/ /rdo rje gdan pa sa 'tsho'i bdag /don kun grub pa don grub dang //bla ma lha mo sgyu 'phrul sras/ /lhas byin rnams ②dang sgyu 'phrul sras/ /nyi ma'i rigs 'khrungs nyi ma'i gnyen/ /don thams cad pa dge sbyong che/ 16 /'di yi longs spyod rdzogs bstan sras/ /grags 'dzin skyes dang sgra gcan 'dzinasde/ 1 /gtsug ④ni lhas byen sgyu 'phrul ma/ /lha mo sgyu 'phrul lumbi rtswa/ 3 /rang sangs rgyas la mtshan drug /bse ru lta bu rang sangs rgyas/ /legs 'dul dang ni gcig 'apur spyod/ /rang byung dang ni bse ru rgyal/ 6 /nyan thos slob ma'i 120—1154

—————ming can no/ /byams pa la mtshan bzhi/ 2byams pa rgyal tshab dpal ldan dang / /de bzhin sangs rgyas mi pham pa/ /spyan ras gzigs la mtshan nyer ①gsum/ 'jig rten dbang phyug chu skyes can/ /phyag na padma mkha' spyod pa/ /ral pa 'dzin dang brtse ba can/ /'jig rten mgon dang spyan ras gzigs/ /rdo rje nyi ma brtson 'grus che/ /'jig rten dbang dang padmas mtshan/ /bdud rtsi'i char ldan yid bzhin nor/ /gzugs mang ha la ⑤ha la dang / /bde ldan dbang phyug bu mo dgyes/ /'od dpag med pa'i thod can dang / /za ma tog bkod mnar med gzigs/ /gru 'dzin ri la dgyes pa dang / /yon tan rin chen 'byung gnas so/ 23 /sgrol ma la mtshan bco brgyad/ sgrol ma sgrol ma zhi ba dang / /sgrol ma dpal chen oṃ mdzad ma/ /rgyal ma 'jig rten dbang sras mo/ / yangs pa dzeecan ma sgrol ma che| /bzang mo mtha' yas yid 'ong ma/ /mkha' la ring du bzhugs ma dang / /legs sbyin ma dang dung can ma/ /dpal mo dang ni dbyangs can ma'o/ 18 /spyan gsum ma dang spyan ma'o/ 2 /nor rgyun ma dang nor sbyin ma/ na /'od zer can ma la mtshan brgyad/ 'od zer can ma zhal gsum ma/ /rdo rje phag mo dkar mo dang gorā/ /rdo rje nag mo rdo rje nag badzra kā li kā badzra ka li/ /rnam gcigs phag gi shing rta ma ngo tri ra thā/ /'jam dbyangs la mtshan nyer bzhi/ 'jam dbyangs 'jam dpal 'jam mgon dang / /'jam pa'i rdo rje 'jam pa po/ /de bzhin rdo rje 'dzin pa dang / /gzhon nu dang ni gtsug phud 'dzin/ /'khor lo rtsibs brgyad ldan pa dang / sngon gyi 120—1155

rgyal ba gaṇḍis brgyan/ /byis pa'i brtul zhugs ral gri can/ /ye shes me long blo yi bdag /zur phud lnga pa ngag dbang phyug /smra ba'i rgyal po shes rab sku//utpal sngo ldan rgyal chen dang / /seng ge sngon po bzhon pa can/ /brtan pa'i 'khor lo seng ge rtsan①/ 24 /dza la la mtshan drug go/ /nor bu bzang po rmugs 'dzin dang / /sngon gyi gnod sbyin chu'i thub pa/ /chu yi dbang po chu la gnas/ 6 /kye rdo rje la mtshan dgu/ dpal ldan khrag 'thung kye rdo rje/ /rdo rje gri gug nye ru ka /he ru rol pa'i rdo rje dang / /de bzhin dpyid dang ri khrod pa/ /ru la ru la zhes pa yang 9 /bde mchog la mtshan bcu gcig /bde mchog 'khor lo sdom pa dang / /dpyid dang dpa' bo ri khrod pa/ /zla ba'i thod can te ru ka /lha dang rdo rje thod pa can//rdo rje mkha' mgro snenges gnod mjes/ 11 /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /gsum po 'di ni dkon mchog gsum/ /mi yi srid pa pa rnams la/ /de dag nor gyi rin chen gsum/ /dge slong la ming drug /dpal stung / dge sbyong / dge slong dang / /phyag 'os—/ bsam 'os/ chos gos can/ 6 /shra ma ṇa ri/ tsa lu ka 2/gnyis po 'di dag rab tu byung dge slong dang dge tshul zhes/ /dge bsnyen chen po go mi'o btsunapa/2 /bdun sbyar ba dang / don byed pa/ /rma bya'i mjug ma can pa'o/ 3 /bsnyen gnas dang ni gso sbyong ngo / /'khar gsel khaji rā dang ni/ /khi khāer ka khe khāe ra ka /'ga' zhig 'khar ba sgra ldan zer/ /dge sbyong rnams kyi khri la ni/ /rkang gsum pa dang chos kyi khri/ 2 //tsho0 //56

tshangs pa la ming lnga bcu rtsa gnyis/ byed ①po rnam byed padma'i gdan/ /kun byed sna tshogs sgrub byed dang / /bde skyes nyes can skye dgu'i bdag /dbyig gi snying po yang mes po/ /mes po rig byed 'dzin skyes dang / /rang byung tshangs pa bdag skyes dang / /mchog gnas lha rgan tshangs pa'i ming gdong bzhi pa/ /pad skyes ma skyes 'byen byed dang / /'jig rten dbang dang padmas mtshan/ /rig byed snying po rig byed dbang / /sna tshogs shes dang rnying pa dang / /sngon du gnas dang sna tshogs bzo/ /'gro ba'i byed po sna tshogs gtong / /sna tshogs byed dang lte ba skyes/ /sngon skyes dga' ba brgya pa dang / /chu skyes brgya 'dzin mig brgyad pa/ /byed po pad can ngang pa bzhon/ /sna tshogs sgrub dang skyon can dang / /bde 'byung gnas byed srog byed dang / /rna ba brgyad pa snying stobs can/ /bde shes ngang pa'i shing rta tshangs/ 12 /dbyangs can ma la mtshan dgu/ tshangs pa'i bu mo ngag lha mo/ /tshangs ma dkar mo shā ra ④dā/ /dkar mo chen mo dbyangs can ma/ /so maglu ra'i rgyas byed ma/ 7 /khyab 'jug gi ming brgya don lnga/ de nas rang skyes skra can gsod/ /sbrang rtsi'i bu dang mi 'dzag dang / /khyab 'jug lag bzhi nab so skyes/ /'phrog byed nye dbang glang rdzi dang / /rdeb byed 'gro 'joms gom gsum gnon/ /g.yung drung can dang dpal gyi bdag /dpal gnas bhānibā yadakar ldan goriḥdapal be'us mtshan/ /dpal gyi lag pa dpal phagaṭībārā haḥsnepa/ /dpal 'dzin shrīdharaḥ④sa gzhi 'dzin pa dang / /sngon gyi skyes bu rwa gzhu can/ /a shwattha thos rtul ⑤mo'i bu/ /tha gu'i lto can dbang po'i dbang / /mkha' lding rgyal mtshan skra can gsod/ /sbyin skyes dgra bo pad dkar mig /na rā ya ṇa sred med bu/ /me tog phreng 6120—1157

——— ————/deldan stobs ldan 'joms/ /'khar 6ba'i sgra dang bri chaṣāka piḥ/ /sna tshogs sde dang be con can/ /'dug gnas lha dang nor lha'i bu/ /swa ya mu na sna tshogs 'gengs/ /shes gsal 'dul dang skyes bu dang / /skye mchog dga' ba brgya pa dang / /rtag tu dga' dang dga' byed dang / /lha mo dga' byed gang dga' byed/ /gnas sbyin mchog sbyin lha min dgra/ /padma'i lte ba sbrang rtsi'i sgra//rtag tu sbyor ldan dbyug rtse skyes/ /thig le drug pa dbang gzhan skyes/ /gser gyi thig le 'og dbang skyes/ /gos ser ①can dang 'khor lo'i lag /ma pham pa dang 'dam bu'i dbang / /dbyig gi lte ba mchod 'os bcu/ /dpal gnas gzhan gyis mi ④thub dang / /sbyor ba brgya pa dmyal ba 'joms⑤ /chur nyal sgra gcan lus 'joms dang / /dpal be'u can dang dpal gyi gter//zla ba'i snying po dpal gyi snying / /yā da ba dang mthon po'i lha/ /'gro mgon dus kyi mu khyud dang / /'phrog byed/ brtan pa/ gzhung phyed rjodang / /ngang pa can dus/ char pa'i snying / 2 /rgyal dka'/ skye ba'i dus—/ sngo chen/ /'dam bu'i lte ba rab gsal dang / /mun 'joms/mdas 'dul/ 'bigs byed dang / /rnam 'byed dzeestobs ldan bslu ba dang //e ka pā dā dhi skelas dang / /sbyor gsum/ phyogs gsum/ gom ⑨gsum pa/ /rarnyi'i lha dang / me tog bzhad/ /chu gnas khyu ⑩mchog lto ba dang / /spyan dmar/ mu kurnya/ legs bzang / /phyag dar khrod kyi dra ba can/ /sna tshogs gzugs can 'gro ba'i tog /mdung thung sar ldan/ 'og gi khang //mi gsal skye bo'ajigs pa pāṇḍa pa 'jigs dang / /kau stu bha ldan/ pāṇḍi'i bu/ /rgyal byed/ sngon spyorabs/ sa li ka /sa mi ti rgyal/ mārdza dang / /120 1158

/de—— —— — ———— /de—— — ——/de/de—— —— — /de———mā rañdza ra/ sa 'dzin 'joms/ /smong skyes/ mtha' yas/ gser mdung tecan/ /mkha' la gnas dang / zhi bar grags/ /skra grol brtan pa/'dzin byed dang / /sems skyes/ chu sbyin/ bkod sbyin dang / /ko ba sind+ra'i 'bras/ char 'bras/ /dgra bo/ mi yi seng ge dang / /gtsang byed/'jo ba/ a riṣṭa/ /skra can/ rdul 'dzin 'joms byed dang / /rwa gzhu can dang / dung gi lag /'phel byed dang ni mi zad pa/ /rta dang kau sru bha 'chad 'gyur/ /rtse byed dang ni dga' ba 'dzin/ /rwa gcig 'khyil pa brgya pa dang / /rdul phran lus dang / ser skya dang / /dga' ba'i dbang po dpung bzhi pa/ /rtag pa sbyor ba brgya ldan dang / /ba zla smin can dad gshin rje ya ma na'i dgra/ /char skyes/ mda' dang / gtong byed dang / /gzugs mang can/ dang kun la lta/ /kun shes pa dang / thams cad mig /lnga skyes 'dzin dang / rgyal byed dang / /thos pa'i snying po skyes bu mchog /mi yi seng ge/ mchod sbyin skyes/ /rgya mtsho'i zla ba/ ri bong thig /mi'u thung / nyajug pa bcu pa dang / /dang po'i/ phag dang /dang po'i lha'o/ 175 /'di yi pha ni nor lha khyab 'jug gi pha'i ming sogs ste/ 1 /dund+ra ra dang / a na ka /dund+ra bhi dang / byu kā'o/ /rnga bo che dang bug can no/ /shing ldan dang ni/ shing rta 'dren/ 2 /blon po/ rgod dang / rlung nad can/ /shi ni'i tsha bo bden pa can/ /brag skyes/ yu yu ṅgā na'o/ na /khyab 'jug 'khor lo legs mthong ste/ /be con ko mo da ki'o sa bdag byed/ /gzhu ni rwa gzhu gri dga' byed/ /dung ni lnga skyes/ rgyal ba'i dbyangs/ /'di yi nor bu mtha' byed lag /de ni ko gestu bha ru bshad/ /120 —1159

— — — — — — —/de—— —— — ———————khyab 'jug gi phu bo'i ming sum cu so lnga/ stobs bzang dang ni rab 'phyang gsod/ /stobs lha gshol 1mtshon gos sngon can/ /thod ldan ha yi gshog can tā las mtshan—/ /gtun shing can dang stobs can dang / /nam gru dga' byed/dga' ba can/ /'dod skyong / sbrang rtsi dag pa 'a)dang / /legs 'gugs dang ni thod pa'i lag /legs dga' mthong ldan/ tā la 'dzin/ /rna rgyan gcig pa sngon rabs pa/ /gshol ldan gser can 'joms 'jigs byed/ /mchog sbas dang ni snar ma skye / /mi 'dzeg ston skyes kun dga' dang / /bzang stobs/ gshol 'dzin/ gshol la dga'/ /kā ④li: 'joms/lhag ma dang / /kā li: 'gugs mtha' yas so/ 35 /'di yi chung ma nam gru ma//sbrang rtsi dmar ser can ma'o/ 1 /'joms byed pa dang thong gshol la/ 2 /legs dga' byed pa gtun shing brjod/ /bdud 'dod lha'i ming brgyad cu gya dgu/ yid las ⑤skyes dang / myos byed dang / /chu srin rgyal mtshan yid las byung / /me tog gzhu can kusum tsā ba/ dga' ma'i bdag /me tog mda' can/ gzhan min skyes/ /mi bzad mda' dang /zhi mthar byed/ /bde 'joms/ 'dod chags bsgyur byed dang / /gshol gyis rtse bar 6'dod pa dang / /rol rtsed dga' ba/ rtsed mo can/ /'dres byed gsod byed 'dor byed dang / /dga' byed/ dran pa/ tshangs bcom dang / /dregs byed/ lus med/ rab stobs dang / /me tog gzhu can—/ duḥdha na/ me tog tog /'dod chags zam pa dga' ma'i bdag /bdag skyes/ mi zad/ nag po skyes/ /mda' lnga pa dang / sbrang rtsi dga'//padma can dang / lang tsho 'byed/ /thams cad 'dul dang / rgas byed dang / /120—— 1160

— ——/de/de/de/de —————————— /de— — — —'dod chags phye ma/ dka' thub dgra/ /yid sred 1yid las skyes pa dang / /lus 'khogs gzhi dang na tshod skyes/ /'chi bdag gtsug phud snying la nyal/ /dbang phyug bde skyed yon ②skyes dang / /'dod spyod dga' —ma'i bdag skyes dang / /i ming can dang kun sbyor can/ /sbrang rtsi'i kha lo ma khyo sā ra thiḥnyi ma'i mda' rabī6ཿ/ /mi bzad mtshon cha mtshon cha'i gzugs/ /sbrang rtsi'i sgron ma rnam byed dang / /'dod pa dang ni 'dod pa'i lha/ /gzugs mang po dang rab dga' byed/ /mtshon cha lnga pa bdud lnga padu/ /'gro rtsen 'gro ba'i shing rta dang / /bdag gi skye gnas/ kun rtog skyes/ /sgeg pa'i skye duganas/rgyal dka' dang / /nya'i getshigs rgas ⑦byed/ 'jigs byed dang / /nyin byed dgra dang / 'dres byed dang / /dus rtsen/ dga' byed/ sgrib bya dang / /sred byed pa ṭu ṭa gzhon ④dang / /sgra byed dga' ma dga' byed dang / /yid la nyal dang / sdom pa'i dgra/ /chu srin mtshan pa lus skyes dang / /'khor ba'i bla ma/ kun rtog byung / /yid la skye ba rnams yin no/27/'di yi bu ni tshangs spong dang / /sna tshogs tog dang / ma 'gags pa/ /u ṣā'i bdag dang / nya yi tog /⑫bu yi dga' ma/ dga' byed 'dod/2/'dod pa'i mda' ni lnga yin te/ /kun tu rmongs byed brgyal bar byed/ /smyo byed/rgod byed/ sred byed do/ 5 /dga' ma/ rtse byed ma/ rtsen ma/ /sgeg pas 'gro ma/ re nā dang / /'dod chags 'khri shing / 'dod ma dang / /i bcas—/ dran pa'i ba khru ba/ 9 /'di yi sring mo gnas tshogs ma/ /dar du ra sa zhes pa yang 2 /khyab 'jug chung ma'i ming bcu gnyis/ 'phrog byed dga' ma dga' byed ma/ /dpal mo/120 —1161

pad gnas/ padma ma/ /mi g.yo/ g.yang mo/ dbang mo dang / /chu gter skyes ma/ chu rgyan ma/ /sā dang ṣā zhes bya ba'o/12/'dod ma/totsa/ thraṣā/ka pā yī/ /rdo rje 'o ma'i chu gter ma/ /g.yo byed ma dang skyod byed ma/ /sred ma/ send+ra skyes ma dang / /rgya mtsho'i bu mo rnams yin no/7/bden pa'i bhā ma / bhā mā dang / /bden bcas ma zhes bya ba'o/ /khyab 'jug gi bzhon pa'i ming so gsum/ rnam 'dul skyes dang dug 'joms ldan/ /mkha' lding / 'dul skyes/ skar mig bu/ /mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug /klu mthar byed/ /khyab 'jug shing rta bdud rtsi za/ /'dab chags seng ge pakṣi saṃ snya//'dab bzang dang / /gser 'dab shāsmra lī la gnas/ /u phru ti'i bdag ltos 'gro zas/ skya rengs nu bo/ zhing bzang skyes/ /rnam gsal rnam 'dren/mig yangs dang / /bcud len za dang / dug 'phrog dang / /'dod pa'i tshogs gnas/ rdo rje'i mchu①/ /ri la gnas dang / klu yi dgra/ /'dab ldan / dpal chen/ gser gyi ①lus/ /phreng ldan/ 'dab bzang ma yi bu//lha rgyal 'dul dang / 'od srungs skyes/na3/'di yi chung ma u lca ti/1/bu ni bzhin bzang zhes par dran/ 1 /rgyu skar 'di 'byel med pa brtags ji bzhin zhes bya ba/ /rgyal byed ming ldan de'i mtshan mo/ /yud tsam rnam rgyal zhes bya ba/ /gang la skyes pa 'gro ba 'joms/ /aṣṭa karma pa ti dhrasgo phordarnyo dzi nabyusaḥ/ /dbang phyug gi ming brgya nyer drug /zhi ba skyo med gzhu can dang / /'phrog byed dbyeg ldan bde byed dang / /ri dbang / ri rmod ral pa bcings/ bde 'byung u mā'i bdag po dang / /mdung can tshim byed/ dbang phyug che/ gtsug na zla brgyad las yongs 'joms 'os 'os rgyal ba yang de ba thod pa 'dzin/ /mig gsum/ gnas 120—— 1162

/de —/de— ——— — — —byed / du byed dang / /phyugs bdag dang ni zla ba 'dzin/ dbang po/dbang phyug /dbang ldan dang / /'byung po'i dbang dang / tsandan 'od/ /ri nyal thod ldan/ dgra sta'i dum/ /bha ga lī bskalabazang phreng ①dang rab 'joms bdag /'chi las rgyal dang stag gos can/ /srid pa 'jigs dang / mig gsum pa/ /kun mkhyen me yi khu ba dang / /ral pa'i khur can sngon dmar can—/ /dpal mgrin drag shul grong khyer dgra/ /mgul nag nam mkha'i skra can lakunda ladang / /gaṅgā 'dzin dang / bran 'joms dang / /rgyal byed grong gsum mthar byed dang / /g.yon gyi lha dang / lha chen po/ /sna tshogs mig dang ga las g.yo/ /ri yi gzhu skyes/ long ②ba'i dgra/ /khyu mchog rgyal mtshan| mchod sbyin 'joms/ /nam mkha'i skra byamake sha can/ tā las mtshan/zla ba 'dzin dang gar mkhan che/ /srid bsrung 'dzin dang skra sbas dang / /'jigs byed 'byung po can bhaṅga/ /mgrin nag /mi zad/ thun mtshams su| /gar byed pa dang / gar la dga'/ /rka ka ṭī ko/ bha ru dzo ①ṭī/ /dmar ser mig dang / dzo ṭi ka④ /char 'bebs/ i ḍi hā rṇa dang / /lus srul ga se⑤sha mig sman/ /ka ṭā ṭi ga ral pa can/ /ral pa'i tshogs can ral pa 'dzin/ /dal 'bab/ nor bu/ u linda/ /gzugs mang po dang gar bas bskor/ /phur bu/ rnam 'jigs ༷mtho ba'i dbang / /mig gcig /tshangs 'joms/ 'gro la 'tshe/ /mtshams smra snying byed/ rkang gcig dang / /steng gi khu ba mi zad mig /gzhan gyis 3mi thub gdong lnga pa//gsang ba'i bla ma/ rab byed dang / /gtsug phud rgyal mtshan/ sbrul 'ching dang / /sbrul gyi gdub can ri khrod pa/ /sbrul gdug rna rgyan/ dpral mig pa/ /120 / /6 3

zhi 'dzin/ mchod sdong / byin 'phrog dang / /rtsub po/ steng 'phur dbang po dang / /mig rus phreng ldan/ tshogs kyi dbang / /nyiṇḍa kānta glang rdzi dang / /mig yangs/ zhi bar gnas/ sprin zhon/ /mun sel/bzang po gcod byed dang / /khyu mchog ser skya khyu mchog tshigs/ /rtag tu 'byung dang / 'byung po 'dzin/ /dam pa'i don ni gsal byed dang / /klu yi lus sbyin ri la gnas/ /las byed pa dang / 'gro ba 'dzin/ /skya bo/bzang po'i dbang phyug dang / /long ba 'joms 3mkhas phyogs gos can/ /'tsho byed khyu mchog mig sman dang / /'chi ba bslu dang / dga' ba 'phel/ /rig byed 'don dang / nag po che/ /khyab bdag /g.yon dang / brtan pa dang / /rgyal dka'/ bde skyes/ lha'i nor bu/ /khyu mchog mchog ldan ba lang bdag /mig gsal kun 'gro blo ldan dang / /dpal mo'i bu dang /g.yung drung ba/ /dus kyi rga dang / dran 'joms dang / /rtsegs byed/chos kyi gzhon pa can/ /rab tu rgod dang gad rgyangs can/ /grong 'joms grong gi yan lag sbyin/ /'byung po'i mgon bo 'byor pa ldan/ /nam gru skyes dang / yang mes po/ /grong gsum bsreg 2dang ha ming can/ /shaṃ ku/ phur bu/khyu mchog mtshan pa dang / /khri rkang can dang u ra bee/ /khyu mchog zhon dang /mig gsum pa/ /mgrin pa khra bo rnams yin no/126/ral pa bcings pa ka parta/ /khyu mchog rgyal dka' can dang mkhas/ /a dza ka rgyald7'a zhes bya ba'o/ 3 /gzhu ni skyo med/ 'gro ldan no/ 2 /bde ba'i khu ṇa/ kha ṭī ga /phyag dar khrod dang / rngon pa'i gos/ /sil snyan/ cha lang / ḍā —ma ru/ /'khor ni 'joms byed 'byung po'i tshogs/ /ma mo rnams ni tshangs ma dang / lus ngan 120—/164

ma dang / khyab 'jug ma/ /dbang mo dang ni/ drag mo dang / /phag mo dang ni gzhon nu ma'o/ /phra dang / yang ba/ rab thob dang / /rab 'dod/mchod 'os/ dbang phyug nyid/ /dbang du gyur dang / 'dod dgur bsgyur//dbang phyug 'byor pa rnam brgyad gyur/ /de nas j-isgo ri ti tshodang / /j-isgo dang ni/ pags pa can/ /tī kā sha yi lus can dang / /z-isgo rī ṭa/ sham dang / /'dam bu'i hadzīlus saṃ tsadang / zhi bar grags/ 8 /dga' ba'i dbang phyug dga' ba can/ /sgo srung thu/ dga' byed dbang phyug dang / /shā laṅgā yan sgo yi dpon/ /gar mkhan phreng ba can rnams so/ /de nas grol ribum / rol rtsed mkhan/ /tshogs bdag dga' ba rnams yin no/3/nag po chen po lus chen po/ /thraṣā ṇa ka 'jigs byed che/ 4 /dbang phyug gi chung ma'i ming dgu bcu go gsum/ dka' bzlog ka ti'i bu mo dang / /dkar mo/ ri skyes/ ri'i bu mo/ /rtag ma dang ni lo ma med/ /dga' ba'i bu mo/ rig byed 'don/ /gtum mo/ ma ma zhi ba ma4/ /gsod ma seng ge'i shing rta ma/ /kun la bkra shis/ ser nag ma/ /dus kyi dga' 5ma/rgas byed ma/ /dbyig ma/ gtsug phud gnas 'o ma/ /srid ma/ drag mo/'tsho byed ma/ /bzang dus can ma/ du byed ma/ /ser mo/ rgyal byed/grul bum ma/ /mang ldan/ sa ga skyed ma dang / /dakṣa'i bu mo/ srad khumed ma/ /rgyal ma/ shes gsal kaiṭabhā ṣpeṭa ji shes gsal ma/ /drug ldan hiṇḍi gser ldan ma/ /dbang phyug /dbang mo/ nga bhra 7ma/ /gsal ba'i bu mo/tshim byed ma/ /ma la yar gnas/ mchod ldan ma/ /grangs ༄ skyes/ rtse mo/tshogs gtso mo/ /thra poṣā'i sdig ldan/ rnam rgyal ma/ /zhi ba'i sring mo/ yā 720—1165

da bī/ /rdzongs ma nag mo/ sde gzhon ma/ /zhi ba'i pho nya phreng ldan ma/ /lha mo—/ sgra ①can/ tshul 'chos 'phreng / /go ta mbi dang / mtshan mo che/ /phreng ba ma tshogs/ gcig pu ma/ /cha shas med ma/ yon tan ma/ /stobs lha'i sring mo/ nus ma dang / /lha yi bu mo ma mo'i ma/ /mtha' yas ma dang durdu rā/ /rma bya'i rgyal mtshan/ mi ṣpe sbo/ /khyab 'jug sring mo/ kaza rī/ /—ras gos can/bung ba can ma/ ngan spong ma/ /'phyang ma/ dge ma/ gtum mo dang / /mi nā/—skra'adres ma/ ka yi sring mo dang / /ma dang gangs ②ri'i bu mo dang / /lha mo chen mo legs ldan ma/ /mun can ma dang be bā sau/ /dga' ma/ rig pa chen mo dang / /dug sel ma dang / gos gcig ma/ 73 /tsashrīrgan byed ma ④ka dang tsā muṇḍi/ /—gtum ma'i mgo/ rna ba chen mo 'jigs med ma/ /'dor ma byi la'i rna ba ma/ /'phrog byed rnam sgeg ma rnams so/ /go rī'i seng ge tā ma'i yi/1 /drag ④mo—/ rgyal ma/ rnam rgyal ma / 2 /⑤tshogs bdag la ming bcu bdun/ log 'dren bgegs rgyal bgegs byed dang /tshogs bdag byi ba gser ldan dang / /lto ba 'phyang dang / ha la gnas/ /glang po'i gdong dang / so gcig pa/ /ma gnyis pa dang / khams gsum pa—/ /lus gnyis pa dang / rdo rje'i mchu/ /bṛṣṭi'i rwa can glang po dang / /tshogs mchog rje dang dgra sta 'dzin /17/rjobyi ba 'dod pa'i lus can no/ 2 /smin drug bu la ming sum cu so gcig /smin drug bu dang / sde chen dang / /dmag dpon—/ me skyes/ skem byed dang / /ri sras dga' byed sa ga skyes/ /gtsug phud can zhon khrung khrung 'joms/ /gaṅgā skyes dang / 'dam bu skyes/ /gdong drug /ma drug /mdung thung 'dzin/ /rje bo sbad byed/ sgol 120—1166

byed 'dul/ /gzhon nu dang ni mang po skyes/ /rnam par rgyal byed/ bde byed bu/ /lha yi dmag dpon/ grub pa'i sde/ /sde dpon/ byis pa'i spyod pa can/ /tshangs par spyod ldan/ rnam par gnas/ /bcu gnyis mig ldan gaṅgā'i bu/ /bya gag rgyal mtshan/ gzi brjid che'o/ na1 /de lta bu la sogs pa lha'i rab tu byed pa'o// //brgya byin gyi ming brgya dang bcu gnyis/ dbang po lha bdag /grong khyen 'jig /lha yi rgyal po char sprin can/ /rgyal byed stobs 'jigs/ rgyal ba dang / /skyo med mgon po pa tya n+ya/ /dbyeg ldan/ lha dbang / dbang chen dang / /gnas kyi bdag po/ brgya byin dang / /bcud ldan bdag dang / legs brjod bdag /pā bī na brdi/ ra hi rnyita/ /mchod sbyin can dang / lha ldan dang / /mchod sbyin brgya pa/ pā bī'i bdag /khyab stobs/ rgyal po/'phrog byed dang / /'phrog byed can dang / 'phrog byed zhon/ /'phrog byed/rta can yang dag bu/ /char 'bebs pa dang / rdo rje can/ /rmugs byed 'joms dang / stobs ldan dgra/ /pu lo ma'i dgra mchod 'dzin dang / /gtsang byed mgon po mtho ris rgyal/ /gzhan snyems ①gsod dang / sprin la zhon—/ /dka' thub skyes dang / bzod dka' dang ②/ /byun pa 'joms dang / kau shi ka /kun 'joms mig stong / shis brjod ldan/ /legs stobs gha nā/ gha na dang / /ri 'joms dang ni rgan la nyan/ /grol med 'joms dang / rta ser skya/ /ki ṇi lā ta mchod sbyin mchog /mchod mchog /ri ①skyes/ 'phel 'joms dang / /'phel ba gzhu mchog /gang bo 'bod/ /gtsang ma'i mchod sbyin la khā ma/ /mdo 'dzin/ mchod 720—1167

sbyin brgya pa dang / /so mang bu dang / so mang skyes/ /lha yi rnga can legs bris gtso/ /bde ldan/ 'joms byed/ grags mu khyud/ /brgya 'dzin 'chi med grong gtso bo/ /pha rol mu khyud/ bcud ldan che/ /gang po skems byed/phyag 'tshal ldan/ /mi dbang dang ni/ glang po can/ /ba di ri dang / rdo rje'i lag 42 /'di yi dga' ma pu lo skyes/ /dbang mo/ chu nyu'adzin/ pu lo'i sras/ /mchog brgya ma dang dbang chen ma/ /legs brjod ma dang /brgya byin ma/ /rgyal ba thob ma rnams yin no/7/khang bzang rnam par rgyal byed dang / /grong khyer 'chi med ldan pa ste/ /sngon gye skad dang / lha lha mo/ /bā ma rā dang / legs mthong ngo / 9 /chu klung mtsho dang / rtse ba'i mtsho 2 /tshal ni 'dres tshal rtsub 'gyur dang / /mkha' 2rgyan dga' tshal dga' bas brgyan / 5 /rgyal ba dang ni 'gro ba'i rgyud/ /rgyal byed dang ni smin par 'joms pūrba bhā ṣṭha su ta ngu ri/ 4 /dbang po'i bu ni rgyal byed do/ 1 /nor ni dbang skyes/nor char 'bebs/ 2 /lha yi 'dun sa chos bzang po/ 2 /lha yi dmag dang /legs brjod bu/ 2 /glang po che sa srungs la ming bcu gsum// sprin gyi glang po/ sa srungs bu/ /sprin glang /legs dul sa 'tsho ciskyes/ /so bzhi pa dang / rtag tu sbyin/ /sgra chen/stobs ldan glang po dang / /glang po'i rgyal po/ brtul bzang dang / /nyi ma lto bcas/ gnyis 'thung dkar/13/mā ta li dang khalopa/ rta 'gugs so/2/brgya byin gyi rta'i ming /mthor thos dang ni rta dkar dang / /thraṣa ṇa dang bi la'o4/brgya byin gye rdo rje'i ming nyer drug /rdo rje sgra sgogs/ lag nyal dang / /za byed/rdo rje'i thog /sgra ldan/ /bde byed sgrogs zhum/ rtse brgya pa/ /'bigs pa/720—1168

'bigs byed/ 'bigs ldan dang / /skabs gsum/ mtshon cha rtsibs brgya pa / /dbyig lus/ za ldan thog ris 'joms/ /dbang skyes/ sprin skyes/yu ba can/ /ri 'gems/ brgya 'dzin/ dbang bo'i mtshan/ /gcod byed ces pa rnams su 'gyur/ 26 /'di yi 'bar ba dang po 'jigs/ 1 /gzhal gred khang dang mkha'i theg pa/ /mi sbyin bu lha'idrang srong dang ma mtshan dang / /tumbu ru dang / rgyas pa dang/ /mchu las skyes dang lha'i drang srong / /brgya byin kyi sna'akhor thub pa mi sbyin bu dang rtse byed dang / /lha yi tshangs pa/ ca co byed/ ka re ṇa skyes glang mo/ shu na khyidang / /ka pi ba dzha/ rnam byed bu/ /bde 'byung rtsod dang / tshogs skyong dang / /'byung gnas thub pa slob ma rtsod/ 12 /kun 'gyed gzhon nu/ rnam byed skyes/ 2 /lha yi sman pa/ tha skar bu/ /tha skar sna skyes byen ma skyes/ /ga dā ga dā/ tha skar skye/ /mchog mthar byed dang /rgod ma skyes/ /sbyor ldan lha yi gso dpyad pa/ /gzhon pa mchog ldan sna skyes dang / /sman pa'i gos can rnams su 'gyur/13/bi shwa karma/ lha'i bzo bo/ sna tshogs byed/ /las bzang can dang / lha'i bzo bo'o/gadri za lha yi glu mkhan dang / /dbyangs sgogs pa dang / dri za skyes/ 2 /dgra ngan spangs driza'ibye brag dang/dbyangs ldan dang / /sna tshogs shing rta/ dga' byed dang / /sa skyes/mi sbyin skyes dang po/ /sna tshogs dbyeg dang / sgo ldan dang / /mtho ris gnas pa rnams su 'gyur/ 10 /rig 'dzin 'dod pa'i gzugs can dang / /mkha' la spyod swahādang lang tsho rtag huhu/ /phreng thub la dga'/ dga' bas myos / /mkha' spyod brtan pa'i na tshod can/ /dbang chen ma lha'i'adod ma dang me na kā/ /'dab ma'i ri mo/ chu shing ma/ /thig le mchog ma/ zla ba ma/ /120—1169

ri bong ldan ma/ legs brjod ma/ /gtsang ma/ dga' ma/ myos rtsen ma/ /dbyangs 'jam ma dang / gnas grol ma/ /skra sdum ma dang skra bzang ma/ /pad dkar ma dang / rang 'od ma/ /yun du legs la/ shing rta bzang / /dpung bzang / 'phyang ma/ rab 'joms ma/ /dbus bzang ma dang /smig rgyu ma/ /dran pa'i snye ma rnams su 'gyur/ 15 /kha na ma tho med sogs 'di//mtho ris smad 'tshong legs myos skyes/ /chu skyes/ reg dga'/ dga' bas dregs / /mtho ris chu klung / nam mkha'i klung 1/ /dal 'bab nam mkha'i gaṅgā dang / /mtho ris gaṅgā bcud ldan rigs/ /zla ba'i rgyun dang /bdud rtsi 'bab/ /sbo tā dkaramodang ni/ lam gsum 'gro/ 10 /bdud rtsi'i ming / mar sar rgya mtsho btung mchog dang / /bdud rtsi bde/'thung lha yi ni/ /btung ba dang ni skabs gsum zas/6/lha yi ri bo ri rab dang / /lhun po dang ni gser gyi ri/ /rin chen brtsegs dang / lha yi gnas/ /lnga po 'di rnams lha yi shing / /dpag bsam/ rkang 'thung mand+ra nar/ /legs khyab / yongs 'du/ sa brtol dang / /ha ri tsandan 4zhes pa'o/ 5/lha yi skyed mos tshal rnams ni/ /rnam rgyal 'dres tshal belhadzidaga' ba'i tshal/ /shing rta sna tshogs tshal rnams su/ /byu ru/ rin chen rkang 'thung ngo / 22 /shar lho 'i phyogs bdag asmi me la ming brgya dang bdun/ 'khyog /'gro chung med/ a nalargyun med dang / /gtsang byed/ rten za/ rab mchod ldan/ /rlung gi grogs po gtsug phud can/ /shing 'phel bi shwa na re'i bu drangasrong me'i bu/ /'bar byed/dag sātihe ta byed/ byin za dang / /sreg za nor rgyal/ 'od nor can bi bhā bā su /'od can/ rta dmar/ rig byed skyes/ /'od bkra/ 'od kyi nor 120—1 70

can dang / /—rtsomapopa'irmos skyon/snye chu yi skye gnas sreg byed dang / /mtshun za/mtshun gyi thob byed dang / /chu mkhris/ dzi la batta ra chab mkhrisa.ashāpaste/ chu rnams mkhris sa sasgruti/ /gsal byed gyuwasbyin sreg /dga' ba dang / /rnyed za/parba ①ri ka dang / /'dor byed/ nor bu sel ba dang / /gser gyi khu ba 'od bdun pa/ /lam nag lus mi skyong ba dang / /rtswa ②zan/ skems byed/sbyin byed dang / /sbyin sreg za dang / snga dro song / /zhi byed/ mya ngan/'bar ba'i skra/ /'phrog byed/ sgrol byed/ byin za dang ba tri ho tra/ /sel byed / khri can/ gnyid sad dang / /grub pa/ sgrub pa ra snel zhon/ /slu byed/ 'gro byed/ mang po 'dzin/ /za byed/ 'bar ba'i lce ldan dang //sna tshogs za dang / 'od kyi tog /kun za/ lce bdun/ za ba po/ /za phodarka/ nag 'phro/ mun pa sel/ /sngags bdun/ mar ldan/ gsar ldan dang / /'bar byed/ rgyal byed/ 'tshol byed dang / /gtsug phud can dang / mun pa 'joms/ /pu gar 'gro dang / lha la rdeg /kha ba'i sgra dang / 'od byed dang / /'od kyi shing rta/ du ba'i tog /bzhon pa dkar po/ gnas byed dang / /skyed byed dang ni/ grang ba sel 'od byed dang ni/ rnam gsal byed/ /tsi tra ṭī re ku ṣa ku/ /char pa g.yo dang /sbyin sreg lag /ser po/ sbyor byed/ pra rā ku/ /gcod byed/ snang byed| snun pa 'dzin/ /gser 'bar/ nor skyes/ rdo las skyes/ /'gro 'dzin—/ mun gnas/ za byed dang / /dkar las gzhan 'gro/ gyen me lcerka/ /zhi bar gnas pa rnams su 'gyur/ 107/chags sdig can mang me ma dang //legs sbyin ma dang / me'i dga' ma/game yi rta ni/ gser rtsen ma/1/'ong me 120—1171

gzi brjid ldan pa bhā/1/de nas dbyig ma/ gser ma dang / /dmar nag ma dang / 'od bzang ma/ /gzugs mang ma dang / shin tu dmar/ /lce bdun ma dang / sbyin sreg lag 7 /rgod ma kha dang / brla skyes dang / /rgod ma skyes dang 1/ rgod ma'i me/ /bā shi skyes dang / pātā4bud shing can/ /byed pa'i rgyal mtshan/ chu'i bud shing / /sa 'og 'dir yang ma ning rtags/2/me yi phung po shing mchog sreg 2 /nags me/ shing skye shing sreg dang / /sreg byed / mi bzang / dzhai ki lā/ 6 /lci ba'i me dang / lci ba skyes/ /kadhū dang nitstsha ga ṇa.agatshar can/ 4 /sbur me dang ni me ma mur/ /ku ku la dang murmur/gartswa yi me dang mnyam sgol lo/ /rims kyi rnge dang lhag par sems/2/bya gag sreg byed skar mda' dang / /sum ka na dang / bya gag mer/ 4 /rlangs pa gyen 'phyur / a ba thu/ 3 /'bar ba'i me ni/ des sbyin sreg 1 /me lce/ rnyed za 'bar ba dang byuti/ /phur bu/ hi ti/ shi kha'o gtsusaphud do/ 5 /me stag /mkha' skyes/ me'i zegs nam/ 3 /mgal me dang ni/ sol ba 'bar 2 /kun tu gdung byed tshad rims so/ 2 /lus 'dzin 'usakyi me/ g.yo byed/ khu byug can / dra ba med pa zhes pa yang / /thal ba/ sbas ma/ bha ni ta1/ /sand+ra ṭa dang / attha ṭa/ /rakṣa4/ na ri/ 'gyur ba'o/ 6 /du ba mang po/du ba'i tshogs/ /du ba 'gro byed me mang skyes/ /me yi rgyal mtshan skra yi phreng / /rlung 'gro nam mkha'i ta mā la/ /g.yo byed sprin gyi bzhon 5pa'o/ 9 /lho phyogs bdag po la ming nyer drug /chos kyi rgyal po pha gshin bdag /'tshe ba'i dbang phyug gshin rje'i rgyal/ /zhi byed gshin rje mtshungs 'jug dang / /lho phyogs bdag po mthar byed dang / /grangs can/ byas mtha'/ tī nā sha /120—1172

— —— /de — — /de—— /de/dem he'i rgyal mtshan/ chad pa 'dzin/ /kun 'dod/ rnying 0)gnas/ gshin gyi rgyal—/ /dus 'dzin/ 'phrog byed/ yi dwags bdag /dbyug 'dzin lto bcas ka li:/ /nyi ma'i bu dang mtshun gyi lha/ /chad pa can dang dga' byed do—/ 26 /'di yi chung ma dud pas 'gegs/ 1 /grong ni yang dag 'gog ces byaske/ 1 /mdun pa'i ming ni nyi ma can/ /kā bhā ṭī ni rnam spyod pa/ /pañtsa ka twa dka' 'grel ni mchog dam pa sgrubs gri sand+ra lnga / 1 /sna spyo1gas sbas pa/ yi ge pa/ 1 /g.yog ni/ gtum po/ gtum chen dag 2 /bden bral phyogs bdag srin po ①la ming bcu gsum/ srin po'i dbang po sgra sgogs dang / /laṅka'i ①bdag dang gdong mang po/ /gdong bcu pa dang / mgrin bcu pa/ /dal 'dzin lto dga'/ dga' byed/ sgra/ /dal 'dzin nga rgyal 'od yangs bu/ /'od yangs skyes dang gnas bzhi pa/ /nor sbyin gcung po rnams yin no/ 13 /dbang po 'dul dang / sprin kyi sgra/ 2 /laṅka'i bdag po'i grong laṅka/ 1 /rtsed mo'i mtsho ni dra ba can/ /rtse ba'i sa ni 'chi med phrad④/ 1 /skyed tshal mya ngan med pa'i stobs/ 1 /ral gri zla ba dgod pa'o/ 1 /'di yi srun zla chung ba dag/bum pa'i rna ba 'jigs byed do/ 2 /dmag dpon sishitrashan lag mchog 'byang ⑤ ba po/ 2 /blon po 'gro byed dang ṣpe tso/ 2 /slob ma/ zhib ma/ mkha' rjes skyes—/ 2 /sring mo'i bdag po gser zhes bya/ 1 /'od zer/ gser gyi dga' byed do/ 1 /steng ka gser gyi padma can/ /'od zer skyed par byed pa'o/ 2 /srin po spyi'i ming zhe gnyis/ srin po ro zan sha rjen za/ /sha za dang ni/ gsod bdag skyes/ /mtshan mo rgyu dang mtshan mo sbyong / /sna tshogs mdog dang sha yi zas—/ /khrag 'thung palāshrīsha za sha za dang pa lhashaḥ/ /sha 'gugs dang ni/120—1173

thun mtshams stobs/ /mtshan mo za dang srod la za/ /srod la rgyu ba kun tu rgyu//'tshe ①byed/ phur 'debs/ khrag rgyun 'thung / /mi la 'tshe dang / 'gro ba 'dzin/ /bsod nams skye bo/ bden bral dang / /rjes su 'jug dang /srung ba pa/ /mkha' 'gro skyes dang mi la lta/ /zhi ba'i go 'phang / bi thu ra/ /sha 'dzin/ tshogs rengs/ gsod bdag bu/ /rab 'bab/ sha dga'/mtshan mo'i stobs/ /mgo gsum pa dang mchu ②dmar ba dzalaloti ta①/ /mgrin dmar—/ 'jigs med/ za byed do/ /'di yi 'dun sa lus nag mo/1/sha za kā pi sa skyes dang / /bum can skyes dang / chang bu can/ /chu lha la ming bcu gsum/ mchog sems mchog sbyin zhags pa can nub phyogs bdag po/ /chu skyes bdag dang / chu yi bdag /'brug sgra can dang lha min lha/ /bsel ba 'dzin dang / gzhan ④las rgyal/ /chu ldan dang ni/ baglu bha/ /nub phyogs bdag dang / nags tshal can/13/rlung bdag dbugs 'byin 'gro byed rlung / /yang dag rgyug dang / 'gro ba'i ngang / /nam mkha'i srog dang nam mkha'i dbugs/ /'gro ba'i srog dang / 'gro ba'i stobs/ /dri bzhon/dri min/ rlung dmar rlung / /thob byed/ 'gro byed/ rtag 'gro dang / /srog dang / dag byed/ rab 'joms byed/ /ma mos 'phel dang /mkha' la rgyu/ /myur byed/ rtag de⑤/ gnas med dang / /myur 'gro longs spyod mjes pa dang / /g.yo byed rdul gyi kha bo pa/ /rgyal mtshan rab g.yo—/ rdul rgyal mtshan/ /mtsho ldan dang ni/ mtsho byed dang / /stobs lha g.yo dang / mgul pa dang / /mtshon mi duzla ba/ stobs chen dang / /gtong ⑦byed/ 'dod byed/ 'gro byed dang / /reg ldan/ mi pham 'phrog 120—1174

—byed dang / /na gha ṭa dang / bu ga 'dzin/ /marka rtse mo/ kun tu rgyu kye/ /rgyun gyi stobs dang / rgyug byed do/ 52 /thra ṣarda ri snye'adi yi dha/ 1 /srog dang / thur sel/ mnyam gnas dang / /khyab byed dang ni/ gyen rgyu'i rlung / /'di rnams snying ga /bshang lam ste/ /lus/ kun dang ni mgrin par gnas / 5/rlung gi dkyil 'khoran/ pā tā li/ /bā tyā/ ā si gi mbi'o/ 2 /bā tu la dang / rlung phran no/ 1 /bā tyā dang ni/ rlung gi tshogs/ 2 /dha bi tram̐ ni/'degs pa'i rlung / 1 /ka ruḥgyen rgyu 'degs pa'i rlung / 1 /phu phru hra sa/sbrul gyi rlung / 1 /lha yi rlung ni/ ku the ra/ /dzhañdza ni la/ char 'bebs skyes / 1 /hi ma dzñā ni/ kha ba'i rlung / 1 /ma dhū/ ma ru ta dri yi klung je / /ma la ya rlung / bā santa dpyid/gagazhi las skyes pa/ rgyu ba'i rlung / /de la skem byed kun 'gro'i trerlung /2/rgyug dang / shugs dang / 'gros skyod byed/ /bang dang / rang 'gro/ mgyogs rta 'dra/2/mgyogs par la gor/ myur cig car shīsgyu/ /yang dang gīsra/ myur ba ashu/ /myur du 6g.yo/ myur tutaidang /myur ba ma thogs pa ruru/ /oṃ kyu/ —ardza sā/ skad cig /mi 'gor ba dang / dar tsam mo/ 16 /rtag tu/ rgyun du/ skabs med dang / /rgyun mi 'chad dang / rtag pa dang / /bar med pa dang / ltos med dang / /res 'ga' min dang bar ma chad/ 7 /de nas rab 'bad 7shin tu'i don/ /nges pa mtha' gcig /nges 'bad dang / /yongs thob/ tshad med/ shin tu lugs / /nges 'dod/ 'dod dang / rab 'dod dang / /rtag tu bor dang nges par dang / /nan tar/ brtan par/ shin tu gzhungs/ /shin tu drag por/ te por dang / /phul byung dang ni 'bad pa'o/ /dpal ster 720—1175

— — ——— — ——byang phyogs bdag po lus ngan kuṣperaḥ/ mi la zhon/ /rgyal po'i rgyal po gnod sbyin dang / /rna rgyan gcig pa nor gyi bdag /gnod sbyin rgyal po 'dod pa'i nor/ /nor sbyin mi yi chos ldan dang / /'od yangs/ tsha bo/ rnam thos sras/ /bsod nams skye bo'i dbang phyug dang / /lus ngan kudanudang ni mig gsum grogs—/ /nor rtsen dang ni sha za can/ /zhi ba/ mig skya i la'i rgyud/ /gter can/ mi'am ci'i dbang phyug /lto dkar bug ldan/ rtag bde byedaske/ /gsang ba pa'i dbang / byang phyogs bdag /nor bdag a b.ri nor ldan padmas mtshan/ /rin chen snying po snying stobs che/ /rtsa gsum pa dang mi ci'i rgyal/ 35 /'di yi pho brang lcang lo can/ /shing rta sna tshogs/ 'di'i skyed tshal/ /gzhal med khang ni/ me tog can/ /'di yi rtsed gnas/ kai 0lā pa/ /bu ni nā la ku be ra/ /rna ba'i snyan ngag /mi ci'i rgyal/ 2/lto ba ngan dang nyer bzhag dang / /des gnas/ stan 'dzin/ gter du gyur/ /dung dang padma padma che/ /'byen byed/ chu srin/ rus sbal can/ /rnga can/sngon po/ dga' ba can/ /'di rnams gter byi dbye ba dgu/ /nam mkha'i ming / mtha' med rgyas byed/ khyab 'jug gnas/ /kun 'gro/sgra sgogs/ lha yi lam/ /rlung lam/ sprin lam/ mkha'/ nam mkha'/ /bar snang / mi g.yo/ kun gsal dang / /rnam 'gro/ lus med/ mi 'gyur dang / /kun khyab/ gnam dang / 'gro med dang / /lhas rtsen/rol gnas/ rgyu skar lam/ /skye med gnas dang / gsal gnas dang / / de ri hā ṇaḥ④zhes pa rnams/ 25 /phyogs dang nyi ston/ gsal gnas dang / /kun khyab/ 'phrog byed/ ston byed do/ 6 /nyi ma shar las snga dro dang / /120—1176

gung dang / phyi dro'o/ /a bā tsi/ /lho'o/ /nub phyogs pra tī ṭī/ /de yang zla ba gnas pa'o/ /byang gi u dī tsi ru 'dod/ /'ga' zhig zla ba de gnas so/ /dmyal ba 'og dang / a bā ṭī/1/tshangs pa steng gi phyogs su dran/ 1 /u ba riṣṭa1 /u barmu steng/ /a bā ga dha a dhya steng 'og/ 2 / pā ṭī na shar/ a pa ṭī āoṃ lho/ /pra tī ṭī rgo rim pa bzhin/ /u dī ṭī rna/ a bā ṭī rgo/ /shar phyogs de dngos la gsum rnams/ /pā ka sharadang / a pāka lho/ pra tyaka nubasogs/ /yul phyogs dus las mi zad pa'o/ /de dngos brjod bya'i rtags rnams ni/ /ston la phyogs dngos gsum rnams so/ /pra dhyā shar/ a pā tsu lho/ pra tī tsu nub/ /de dngos u dī tsu bzhin gsum/ /de yis skad cig sogs bshad la/ /phyogs dngos bstan pa bzhin du 'gyur/ /shararam snga ra shar sogs kyi lhophyogs nubamagon po ni / /dbang po me lha gshin rje dang / /bden bral chu lha rlung lha dang / /nor sbyin bde byed go rims bzhin / / sa srungs phyogs srungs glang po bu dang pad dkar can/ /g.yon phyogs pa dang sa la dga'/ /gsal byed me tog so can dang / /sa kun sa dang legs grags dang / /brgyad po phyogs kyi glang po'o / 8 /glang mo rim bzhin sprin grol ma/ /dmar ser ser skya/ dpe med ma/ /zangs sna 4ma dang / so legs ma/ /yan lag mdzes dang gsal ldan ma'o/8/nyi ma dang ni ngan spong bu/ /sa skyes/ mtho ris snang byed dang / /nye skyes sgra gcan—/ phur bu dang / /lhag pa 'di rnams phyogs bdag gza'/ /phyogs bral phyogs par phyogs mtshams so/ 3 /bar dang / anta rā lo la'o/ /'khor 5yug dang ni dkyil 'khor ro/ 2 /sprin gyi ming / tshangs 6'joms/ char sprin/ dga' byed dang / /chu khur/120—1177

rgyun 'dzin/ chu 'beebs 1dang / /chu 'dzin/ chu 'gyed/ mkha'i rgyal mtshan / /du ba'i skye gnas/ nam mkha'i gling / /mkha' yi glang po mkha' la rgyu/ /'khrud byed/ sgogs byed/ chu sbyin dang / /glog 2—ldan/ nam mkha'i ta mā la/ /rgyun sbyin/ chu gnas/ chu'i bzhon pa/ /rgyas byed nam mkha'i du ba dang / /myos byed lha gnas rlung gi shing / /rlung gi shing rta chu 'dzin dang / /gsher 'dzin/ chu bskyod/ krā bā dang / /lags 1'dul/char ldan/ sa la 'bab/ /nags tshal skyed dang / chu g.yo'o/ /sprin bye brag nga 'i ming / gha na gha na stugadang stug rnged char ldan sprin/ /sgra ldan sprin ni padma bhā/ 1/sprin phreng dang ni/ sprin nag dang / /chu skyar gnas dang / kā li kā/ gagre yi lus sgrib kā li kā/ /sprin sgra bcas kyi ming / nges sgrogs/ chu 'thor—/ sgogs byed dang / /sgra sgogs / 'ur sgogs/ sgra ldan dang / /grags byed dang ni thog sgra can/ /bcud 'bebs ma dang / sgogs ldan ma'o/10/'khrud byed chu 'dzin rtags gsum pa'o/ /legs 'dul/ 'khyud byed/ skyod byed dang / /glog dang /g.yo byed/ nyams myong dang / /gnam gsal gnam lcags/ gsal ldan dang / /sa 'joms sa srungs/ se gol 'ong / /skad cig pa dang / skad cig 'od/ /'jug pa brgya pa sgra brgya pa/ /sprin gyi lcug ma/ sgogs byed ma/ /bde 'thung rnam bkra sna tshogs dang / /gzhi sngon skyes dang / lus phra dang / /mi brtan/ chu sbyin/ chu phran ma'o/36/thog gi sgra dang / rdo rje'i sgra/ 1 /sprin gyi me dang / chu 'dzin skyes/ 2 /sprin gyi thog ni/ ukkaḥ'o/ /nges 'joms nam mkha'i tho ba'o/ 1 /dbang po'i gzhu dang / rlung gi 'bras/ /120—/178

bu lo ma skyes bdag mo'i gzhu/ 3 /de nyid 'khyog pa ro hi ta/ /de nyid drang por sha ra lo/ 2 /'ja' tshon drang 'khyog gi ming / dbang po'i shing bal/ rgan po'i thig /rlung gi rgyal mtshan sos ga bzhad/ /ras bal rgyud dang / rlung gi bal/6/char pa zhod dang / char 'bab dang / /sa'i mar/ bdud rtsi g.yo ba'o/5/de'i nagegs / zen pa/ then 4chen dag 1 /thig le/ thra ṣad/ pho yin te/ /pi sruṭa/ bri ṣaṭa/ bud med do/ 4 /rgyun gyi myu gu char rdul dang / /nges 'dor/chu yi zegs ma'o/ 2 /ser ba'i rgyun ni drag char ro/ 1 /ser ba/ rdo char/sprin gye rdo ser ba'i ming / 7 ra 7/ /sprin gyi ka pha sprin me tog /sa la rgyun dang /sprin gong bu/ /sprin gyi ḍidzre/ chu ḍimbi/ /chu 'khrigs chu yi sa bon dang / /rlung gi 'bras bu/ sprin rus pa/ /bye blugs dang ser ba ka rā kaḥdang ka raḥlag pa/ dang ser ba dang / /rgyun gyi myu gu/ char sa bon/ /bzhi mdo'i phyag dar zhes pa rnams/18/rlung gi gudma/ chu yi 'khyil/ /zegs ma'i lto ba/ chu'i myu gu/ 2 /yul ngan sprin gyi rab rib 5dang / /nyin mo sprin rnams 'khrigs pa'o/ 8 /mun pa mi snang / thibs po 'thibs/ /sgrib6/ g.yogs/ mi mngon/ mi gsal dang / /kun khebs/ khebs dang / mi mngon pa'o/ /zhes pa phyogs kyi bdag po'i rab tu byed pa'o// 11 //bdud rtsi'i 'od dang / 'od dkar can/ /bsel zer can dang /sem byed dang / /tshes bdag /chags byed/ rgya mtsho dga'/ /mig gsum pa yi gtsug gi nor/ /mtshan mo'i nor bu mig gsum 'dzin/ /ga pur/dbang po/ mtshan mo'i bdag /chab 7gter/ mkha' mthong / mtshan 120—1179

mor byed/ /ba la/ kṣa gu phyogs skyes dang / /snar skyoma'i bdag dang / ri dwags mtshan/ /phyag 'os/ mthong dbang / bdud rtsi'i 2mtshan/ /ri bong can dang / yongs su 'grib/ /'phrog byed/ mchod sbyin bdag po dang / /rnam byed/ sman dbang / skar ma 'tshe/ /ku mud gnyen dang padmas mtshan/ /ri dwags grib ma 'dzin pa dang / /ri bong mtshan ma 'grib byed dang / /rdul gyi thig le dkar po dang / /shar gyi thig le/ gnyis skyes rgyal / /ri bong 'dzin dang / rgyal po dang / /gsal ba'i bu mo'i bdag po dang / /rgyu skar/ mu khyud/ rgyu skar gtso/ /gza' yi mu khyud 'tsho byed dang / /dkar ldan/ bsil ldan/ kha ba'i 'od/ /rgya mtsho'i mar sar/mun 'joms dang / /mun pa sel dang / tshigs ldan dang / /nam mkha'i rna ba byom/ tsam/ brtse ba can dayā/ /srid byed/ e ṇa pi z-i dang / /bdud rtsi spro dang /grib ma'i lus/ /rta dkar/ chu skyes nad can dang / /phyogs skye ba dang /rgyal po'i rgyal/ /rnam par snang byed/ steng 'phur dang / /sri sra/ rgyal byed / dka' thub can/ /gsum dga' gsher ldan/ bi ku shra/ /sna tshogs za dang srung byed dang / /kai ra bi bhā dga' ba dang / /blo bzang srid ldan na tshod can/ /'gro byed dang ni/ mu khyud can/ /ri bong grib ma/thos ldan dbang / /rgas ldan gcig skyes/ rang nad can dang 'greb byed sogs mar ngo'i cha la rtag nga/ra gsal lo/ /rgya mtsho skyes/ 84 /shing rta 'tshe ma'i dra ba can/ /dung rab gnas zhes bya ba'o/ 1 /ngan spang skyes ni dbyangs bcu pa pa bsangs phur bu gnyis 'od che bas zla ba'i blon po lta bur dgongs nas bkod pa 'dra/ 1 /lugs kyi dbyangs ni phur bu'o/ 2 /cha ni bcu drug cha shas so/ /gzugs can dang ni dkyil 'khor ro/ 2 /dum bu/120—1180

cha dang / zhogs ma dang / /dbye ba dang ni phyed ma'o/ 5 /phyed dang / mnyam dang / cha shas can/ 3 /ku mud can dang /zlaba'i'od kor gyi kai ra bī/ /snang ldan/bsel ldan/ zla ba yi/ /tog sga ming / rab zla 'od zla ba'i phreng / 7 /khang bzang rab tu dang pa'o/ 1 /mdzes dang / stug dang / dang ba dang / /grib ma legs dang /mngon par gsal/ /snang ba dang ni/ dpal rnams so/ 8 /legs mnyam ma dang / mchog mdzes ma/ 2 /mdzes ma dang ni/ dga' ma'o/ /mtshan byed/mtshan nyid/ mtshon pa dang / /rtags can aṅga mtshan ma can/ /mngon par shes byed rtags mtshan no/ 8 /ba mo dang ni khug rna dang / /char skya/ khu 'phang / gangs skyes dang / /sa can nam mkha'i rlangs pa dang / /mkha' yi chu dang / rdul gyi chu/ /dbang po'i me yi du ba dang / /rab rnyogs/mtshan mo'i na tshod skyes/ 12 /kha ba ldan pa/ kha ba'i tshogs/ 1 /ku dzha ṭi dang /ku hi kā/ /du ba can dang / du ba 'dzin/ /du ba'i btsun mo/ dga' ldan ma / /kha ba 'dus dang / kha ba'i 'dab/ /kha 'bab/ yul ngan/shin tu grang / /nyi ma'i gos can yul ngan grang / /nags kyi gos dang / pha rol 'tshe/ /nam mkha' rdul can/ ku hi rda/ 16 /grang ba'i ming / bsil ba'i 'gyur ba lhags pa dang / /lhags ngar/ lhags ngar / 'khyags pa dang / /bsel dang / grang dang / kha bas grang / 8 /skar ma brtan pa 'i ming / brtan pa/ rkang rten / nyal/ bza'i 4rten/ /snang ldan/ shing rta/ lugs bzang skyes/ /brtan pa'i ma ni lugs bzang ma'o / /srin po'i ma ni nges 'tshem/ /gsal ba'i ma ni drangasrong yid can ma/ /720— 181

khyung gi ma ni 'dul byed ma/ /klu yi ma ni ka dru'o/ /gza'i bu rsha ra ma/ ri byi'i ming bcu bzhi/ ri bye dang ni/ ri bos 'phangs sa la shaṃ sam bha ba bum skyes/ /kumbha sambha ba/ /mdza' skyob mbi bu/ me ltar gsal/ /me nyams 1dang ni me rlung can/ /rgya mtsho khyar chung byed pa dang / /dbang chen ma'i bu/ rlung thob 'joms/ /birmya kṛ ṭa/ rnam par 'char/ /chu lha'i bu dang thub pa che/ /rgya mtsho ser po lho phyogs bdag /gdung byed dang ni/thub pa'o/ 17 /de yi dga' ma mdzod ldan ma/ /zil gnon bodabha ba phyag rgya lho phyogs ma'o/ 3 /〉 ra ma/ spyi'i ming / mi ltung / 'gro byed/ 'od can dang / /skar ma dang ni/sgol ba dang / /'phur byed dang ni/ snang byed do/ 7 /gsal ba'i bu mo tha skar dang thaskar/ /rta ldan ma dang / rta spyor ma/ 4 /gshin rje ma dang / branyebra nye'o / 2 /smin drug dang ni mang po skyes/ 2 /snar ma/ skye dgu'i bdag lta skyes/2/ri dwags mgo can/ ri dwags mgo/ /ri dwags mgo ma/ ri dwags la //zla skyes/ mgo skyes lo'i thog ma'o/ 8 /lag dang / drag mo/ nag mo'o/ 3 /sbyin ma'i lha mo/ nabs so dag 2 /rgyal dang / grub pa/ tshim byed dang / /spyor ldan/ bla ma'i lha ldan no/ 5 /skag dang / gdeng can lha mo dag 2 /mchu dang / snyan ngag mkhan skyes dang / /pha mes lha las skyes pa rnams/ 3 /'tsho ba skyes/ gre/ skye gnas lha/ 3 /phyi ma nyi ma'i lha ldan/ dbo/ 3 /me bzhi / rig byed 'don pa'i lha/ 2 /nag pa dang ni/ brgyad ldan ma/ 8 /sa ri dang ni/ rlung lha mo/ 2 /rgyun ldan ma dang / sa ga dang / /me dang dbang po'i lha ldan te / 3 /mdza' bo'i lha dang / lha mtshams dag 2 /lha 120—1 182

dbang ldan ma dang ni spyon/ 2 /ṣa ṣpe ra ti/ rtsa ba snrubs/ 3 /chu stod dang ni/chu lha ldan/ 2 /chu smad/ sna tshogs lha ldan ma/ 2 /gro bzhin/ 'phrog byed/lha ldan ma/ 2 /mon gre dang ni thob ldan ma/ 2 /mon gru/ chu lha mo dang ldan / 12 /stod smad/ khrums 1dang / gnas rgyas ma/ /ra yi lha dang /sbrul 'ching ba'i/ /lha rnams dang ni/ rim pa bzhin/ /nam gru dang ni rgyas byed ma/ /gso ba'i lha mo 'di dag 'dra/ 3 /ri dwags mgo yi mgo phyogs su/ /gnas pa'i skar ma 'gro ldan no/ 1 /mig dmar/ lus dmar/ sa skyes dang / /sa las byung dang / sa yi bu/ /chu skyes/ sa las skyes bkra shis/ /nam mkha' steng 'gro rtsibs ldan dang / /'od zer dgu pa 'khyog po'o/ 12 /de nas gza' lhag zla ba'i bu/ /rgyal po'i bu dang snar ma skyes/ /sngo bsangs lus dang / gsal ldan dang / /mkhas pa rab dga'/ thos ldan skyes/ /lus gcig gser ldan tshim byed skyes/ 12 /dbo sngon song las byung ba dang / /'tsho byed/ smra mkhas/ lha'i bla ma/ /bla ma lha bdag /lha'i slob dpon/ /tshig bdag /blo ldan lha rnams bdag /nyi ma'i rigs skyes/ tshig gi bdag /shes ldan sna tshogs/ gtsug phud skyes/ /tshig ldan/ mig ldan/dpyod ldan dang / /rtsub ldan shin tu gsal ba'i gcung / /mtho ris thob dang / 'bar ba ldan/ /bcu gnyis 'od 'phro me bzhi skyes/ 13 /dkar po/pa sangs/ ngan spong bu/ /snyan ngag dang ni/ snyan ngag mkhan/ /lha min bla ma/ lha min bdag /ngan spong 'dzin dang / kun dzi ta/ /dkar po 'od ldan/ tshig brgya'i dbang / /bcu drug 'od ldan mchu las skyes/ 14 /spen pa rgyal ma'i bu/ kro ḍa/ /dal ba 'khyog bo/ dal 'gro dang / /su ta/120—1183

shu ba/ rjes skyes dang / /nag po/ tshangs skyes/ mi bzad mig /'od zer bdun pa/ gos sngon can/ /gshin rje'i ba dan/ nyi ma'i bu/ 15 /sgra gcan / gza' yi rna ba 'dzin/ /mtho ris snang byed/ bra nye skyes/ /seng ge mo'i bu/ mun pa can/ /mgo zlum/ lam nag /zla ba 'joms/ /nye bar 'phar 'gro/ sprin las ni/ /rnam rgyal dang rgo/ sha za'o/ 12 /du ba mjug rings 1sbrul can dang / /gtsug phud can dang / skra gnyis pa/ /skag las skyes dang / steng 'gro'o/ 1 /drang srong bdun te 'od zer can/ /rgyun shes/ 'od yangs/ yan lag skyes/ /bu la ha yi mchod sbyin dang / /gnas 'jog /sna tshogs/ gtsug phud can/ /khyim rnams 'char ba dus spyor dang / /khyem gyi sgo ste de dag ni/ /nyin dang mtshan du longs spyod pa/ /lug dang glang sogs shes par bya/ /grib ma'i lam dgutshigs 'dra'o dang lha yi lam //gza' yi mu khyud nam mkha'i gnas/ /'od gzugs/ nyi ma/ 'od 'byin dang / /nyin mo'i nor bu/ nyin mo'i 'dren/ /gsal ba'i nor bu/ nam mkha'i nor/ /so sor nyin byed/ nyin mor byed/ snang byed/ 'od ldan/ba ru ṇa/ /'od 'gro/ rgyas byed/ mkha' 'gro dang / /rnam bsgyur/snang byed/ pa ti ba/ /cha ldan/ nges bsreg /'od zer ldan/ /'od kyi rgyun dang / asriphyogs snang byed/gabaste/ /sgol byed/ sru ra/ sru ra ba/ /gdung byed/ tshang byed/ rnam snang byed/ /mun sel/ haṃ sa/ ma ga dang //'od stong byed dang / 'dzin pa dang / /lus skyob nyin byed 'dam skyes mtshan / /nyin mo'i bdag po/ padma'i bdag /phyogs bdag /mchog 'dod/ char 'bebs dang / /mchod ldan bdun gyi bdun pa dang / /120—1184

—gza' yi bdag po/ snang ba'i bdag /nyin 1mo'i bdag po/ 'bar byed dang / /'dzin byed/ snang ba'i mu khyud dang / /'od byed pa dang /rnam gsal byed/ /sna ldan/ mig gzugs/ rta bdun pa/ /rta ljang can dang / tsha zer can/ /'od 'gyed srudmabasten bya/ bdud las rgyal mā rta ṇḍa/ /ma zlu ma marta ṇḍa 'phrog byed rtsen pa dang / /phyogs dgod 4byed dang / gtum pa'i 'od/ /'od ldan/ 'od kyi skra can dang / /mi sbyin 5skyes dang /'gro byed dang / /snang ba'i mdzod dang / nor gyi mdzod/ /rgyu ba'i brtul zhugs / mdza' bshes 6dang / /sna tshogs shing rta/ sna tshogs 'od/ /mchod 'os/ 'od kyi nor can azadang / /'gro ba'i sgron ma/ bcu gnyis bdag /padma'i lag pa rtag tu 'char/ /rig byed 'byung dang las sna tshogs / /khyab byed/ nad med/ 'thung byed dang / /'od kyi phreng can/'od ldan dang / /'od snang 'od stong 'dzin pa dang / /'od gtsang long ba'i kha lo pa/ /lam ston/ srid byed/ shing rta mtho/ /dbyeg gi khu ba/ zlum po 'dzin/ /dus kyi byed po / bī ta ba/ /bī tha/ snga dro 'dul ba dang / /srub byed9/ rgyas byed/ chu'i chom rkun/ /'jig rten mig dang / nam mkha'i mig /'jig rten dbang po/ rtag tu 'gro/ /srung byed/ dus la dga' ba dang / /sru na/ gzugs ma lha kun spyod/ /nam mkha'i thig le/mkha' lam pa/ /nam mkha'i go la'i nor bu dang / /'od phur/ ta྾ nam mkha'i tog /'od gtsang ldan dang / gsal ba ldan/ /phyogs kyi nu/ khyud phan tshun byed/ /ser skya/ rab gsal skems byed dang / /las kyi dbang po mun pa'i dgra/ /lo yi shing rta skyong byed dang / /mun 'joms tshangs 120—1185

pa'i rta rnams so// 130 //nyi ma'i btsun mo rgyal mo'i ming / /legs 'dor ma dang / rdul bzang ma/ /'od skyes/ gshin rje/ kā linda/ /nam gru/ ma nu/ sbyin byed 1ma/ /skrag byed ma zhes bya ba'o/ 1 /nyi ma'i shing rta'i grib ma ni/ /sa skyes ma dang / gdung byed ma/ /spyod ma/ dal ba/ mdog bcas ma/ /ma ma/ dga' ma 'di rnams so/ /nyi ma'i yongs bskor gnas byed dang / /dmar ser dang ni/ dbyug pa'o/ 3 /nyi ma 'khyems pa yongs dkres dang / /nye ba'i nyi ma'i khor yug go/ /nyi ma'i rta ni rgyal po rtsen/ /mchog tu 'jigs dang lte ba sngo/ /yid mgyogs rlung sems/ sems dbang dang / /yid kyi zeg pa zhes bya'o/ 7 /de bzhin rtsen pa'i 'od la sogs/ /nyi ma'i rta rnams bcu gcig ste/ /nam mkha'i gru dang / gser gyi dbyangs/ /nyi ma'i shing rta ral gre'i phreng / 4 /re kha'i grib ma lcags mda' dang / /shing rta'i ba dan can zhes so/ 2 /nyi ma'i kha lo skya rengs dang / /brla med/ 'od srungs/ khyung sngon skyes/ /rdo ba 'dzin dang / sgra sgogs so/ 7 /skya rengs pho bo ral pa can/1/'dod chags snang ba/ 'od zer dang / /'od kyi tog dang phyogs su 'gro/ /mngon 'dod/ 'phro dang / /'bab pa dang / 'od skyarengs dang ni dang / 'od zer / gsal dang snang / /rang 'od/ 'bar dang / dang ba gsal/ /'od byed / gsal byed/ glog sgon me/ /smig rgyu/ u sa 'dam kha/ tīgo/'od zer spyi'i ming / zhes dang / skṛ ṇi j-iṣṭi/ me lce dang / / me dngas dang /gsal chen/ po tsi ṣi/ /me 'od/ rnam gsal/ brtsa sī/ /mdzes dang /rab 'dzin/ gyu nā dang / /nye bar 'dzin pa zhes rnams so/ 38 /snang byed/120—1 86

—snang gsal rab gsal dang / /snang ba/ ku gdung / shin tu gsal/ 6 /'od drag /nges sreg byed pa dang / /tshad pas1/ kun tu gdung ba'o/ /drod dang / rab tsha/ tsha drag rgo/ 4 /shin tu dro dang / tsha ba la mi bzad pa dang / gtum pa'o/ 2 /cung zad dro dang / bag tsam dro/ /'jam dro can ni/ cung dro'o/ 4 /tshad gdung rlabs ni/ dzha lā'o/ /ri dwags sred dang smig rgyu'o/ /char pa 'dor ba'i nyi 'od ni/ /brgya phrag /bzhi pa'i 'od du 'gyur / /ba mo brgya pa'i kha ba 'beb/ /re zhig tshad pa 'dor bar byed/ /'od zer rnams kyi char 'bab pa/ /'di dag thams cad bdud rtsi'o/ /kha ba 'bab pa sem byed pa/ /dkar pos tshad pa 'dor bar byed/ /dus dang bgrang bya nyer 'gro dang / /bstan bya/ slad byung / 'dor byed chos/ /gnas dang / sī ra/ baṣṭa dang / / yongs 'dor zhes pa rnams su 'gyur/11/tshes gcig /phyogs rtsa/ de sogs tshes/ /mun bsal / nyin mo/ bya spangs bsal/ /nyi bcas/ skabs yod/ gnas pa dang / /rnam bsal/ cha can / snang ba can/ /nyin mo rtse ba rnams su 'gyur/ 10 /tho rangs dang ni/nyi ma'i 4sgo/ /snga dang / nam langs/ nang bar zhogs/ /rab tu snga dang /'od chags dang / /'od bcas dang ni/ tho rangs sgo/ /rnam par sad dang /mtshan mo bral/ /sngar dang / tho rangs zhes pa rnams/ 14 /dus min pa dang / nyi ma nub/ /gtor ma bcas babamadang / nyin mo'i mtha'/ /mtshan mo rgyu ba can rnams so/ /srod dang thun mtshams sa sros dang / /pha mes rab tu rgyu rnams so/ 4/nyi ma 'das dang / phyi phyed dang / 25 /snga dro'i thun dang mtshan mo 'das / 2 /nyin mo'i dbus dang / nyi ma gung / 2 /thun gsum nye ba'i bi na bi/ /120—1187

— sdem/tshan mo'i ming / mtshan mo rdul ldan sngo bsangs ma/ /thun gsum ma dang rngel tshe ma/ /mun can/ nges nyal/ nyal byed ma/ /rgyal mo/ mthon mo/dal sbyin ma/ /mtshan mor byed ma/ gdan 1'dzin ma/ /bsam gtan ma dang / bya spangs ma/ /rnam sgom/ gnas ma/ gnas 2skyes ma/ /thun ma / dga' ma/ mun pa can/ /ngas zhi/ zla 'od mig brgya ma/ /skyon ma / gnas 'dzin/ bu mo ma/ /ri dwags mig ma/ gnas byed ma/ /drag mo/ zhi gnas ma nag mo/ /mi bzad/ sreg ma srung byed ma/ /skyed ma mang ldan/ spyor ldan ma/ /'khor po 'byed ma/ chu ldan ma'o/ 27 /nges gzhi gnas ma/ mtshan mo che/ /nges par kun nas nam phyed dang / /kun 'gro thams cad pa/ zhes pa'ang / 5 /zla ba mtho dang / mtshan mo'i smad/ 2 /thun dang / grel tshe zhes pa'o/ 2 /mtshan mo'i tshogs ni mtshan mo'i phyogs/ /srod dang mtshan mo'i sgo dag go/ 2 /zla 'od ldan pa snang ldan ma/ /mun pa can gyi mun ldan ma/ /'das dang ma 'ongs nyi ldan pa'i/ /mtshan mo'i de ni phyogs ldan no/ /tshigs mtshams bcad 4pa tshes gcig dang / /bco lnga'i bar gang yin pa'o/ /mtshan mos mtshan dang mang 'dzin dang / /nag phyogs dkar po nyi mas 5mtshan/ 2 /phyogs kyi mtha' dang bco lnga dag /tshigs can/dga' ba/ 'phel ba ste/ /de dag mchod sbyin dus su bshad/ /'byung po nag po'i bcu bzhi'o/ /zla ba/ gang ba/ 'jal byed rdzogs/ /nya gang ba dang chos gnas dang / /zla ba'i ma'o de nas ni/ /rā kā gang ba/ ri bong can/ /zla ba gang ba zhes pa'o / /cha yis dman pa rjes 'gro can/ /nyin dang de'i mtshan mo'o/ /gnam/ stong ji ming / gnam stong / gnam stong gnas pa dang / /mi mthong 720—1 188

nyi zla 'grogs pa dang / /gnam dang / gnam stong can dang ni/ /stong dang / zla ba stong pa'o/ /zla mthong / zla ba gzhon nu'o/ /zla ba nyams pa cha rnams so/ /nyer 'tshe dang ni gzas bzung dang / /sgra gcan reg dang gzas 'dzin no/ 4 /gza' 'di dag gis zla 1ba 'dzin/ /zos pa dang ni/me tog ldan/ /nye bar rgyug byed spangs pa dang / /me yis bsreg 2dang rang bzhin bsgyur/ /nyin mor byed dang / mtshan byed dag /gcig tu sbyor ba me tog lan/ /gza' yi rab tu byed pa'o// //mig 'dzums bco brgyad kaṣṭha 4ste/ /de sum cu la cha zhes bya/ /de sum cu ni skad cig ste/ /de nyid bcu gnyis yud tsam yin/ /de sum cu yis nyin zhag go/ /de dag bco lnga phyogs yin te/ /snga ma phyi ma'i phyogs dag ni/ /dkar dang nag po de gnyis zla/ /mgo sogs zla ba gnyis gnyis dus/ /de dag gsum gyis bgrod pa'o/ /lho byang gnyis su bgrod pa'i lo/ /nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i dus gnyis ldan/ /de yang nyi ma'i 'pho rim las/ /lug dang srang la shes par bya/ /rgyal dang ldan pa'i zla ba nya/ /rgyal gyi zla ba gang yin te/ /ming ni rgyal yin mchu dang ni/ /dbo sogs rnams ni rim pas so/ /mgo zla ba'i ming / ri dwags mgo dang bzod ldan ma/ /mgo dang lo yi thog ma dang / /bzod pa'o 5rgyal rgyal zla ba/ dang tshim byed dang / 2 /dka' thub zla ba mchu zla'o/ 2 /dbo dang dka' thub 'bras ldan dang / /snying po med pa sel ba'o / 4 /nag pa sbrang zla myos byed dang / /nag pa can dang dbo rjes skyes/ /dri zhim ldan dang yid srubs po/ 6 /sa ga sgrub byed sbrang rtsi skyed/ 2 /spyon zla 'dod 'phel rtsa ba can/ 2 /chu stod zla ba gtsang ba'o/ 1 /gro bzhin nam mkha' thos 120—1189

ldan ma/2/khrums dang nam mkha' rab gnas bzhi/ /bzang po'i gnas rnams mtshungs pa'o/gatha skar rta spyor der 'dod pa'o/2/smin drug zla ba smin drug can/ /mang po 'dzin dang sa ga skyes/ 5 /mgo skyes rnams so/ /de nas ni/ /dgun stod dang ni kha ba'i dus/ 2 /dgun smad dang ni grang ba'i dus/ /dpyid dang me tog ldan dus dang / /dri zhim drod phebs tsha ba'i dus/ / sos ka 1nges sreg tshad pa can/ /drod 'ongs drod can/ tsha gdung can/ 6 /dbyar la ming bcu/ dbyar dang chu 'bab/ char 'bab dang / /rab tu char 'bab sprin 'byung dang / /kṣa rī char ldan sprin skye'o/ 10 /ston ka mda' sbyin dus snga ba/ 3 /mgo sogs gnyis gnyis rim pa las/ /dus tshigs 'di rnams drug yin no/ /mchod ldan ma dang dbo srang la/ /sto na 'bring gi ming / lho ru bgrod pa bee sha tshigs/ /brgya ko dzā ga ra dang / /mda' sbyin gsal bar nyal ba dang / /ku mud dang ldan phyi ma'o/ /nag pa dpyid 'bring bi ldan dang sbrang dga' ston/ /dran pa'i dga' ston 'dod ma dang / /dpyid ldan chen mo dpyid bzang ldan/ /kurda ṣṭi zhes bya ba rnams/ 7 /phyogs kyi mtshan mo/ sbo yā li/ /dī sa shriṅga 'do zhes so/ 3 /phyogs kyi nyin mo'i ming / brgya byin dga' ston rgyal mtshan 'don/ 2/zla ba dang ni nyin zhag tshogs/ /dbugs skyes lo yi cha shas can/ /lo yi mdzod dang lo'i yan lag 7 /bgrang bya 'gro 'ong / 'dor byed lo/ /dus kyi gnas dang zla ba'i phreng / /dus kyi tshigs dang urba ṭa lo/ /batpa khodus kyi cha shas can/ /brla lo/ salba ra lo/ shā ra lo/ /mi bzad pa zhes bya ba rnams/ 10 /rdzogs ldan byas dus bde ba'i dus/ 3 /bi sadzee kā gsum ldan 'grib/ 3 /nyis 4ldan dang 120—1190
