ni mchod sbyin can/ 2/sdug dus las dus rtsod pa'i dus/ 3/zla ba gcig gi yi dwags kyis/ /nyin zhag lo yis lha yi zhag /lha yi dus ni nyis stong gis/ /tshangs zhag mi yi bskal pa gnyis/ /tshangs nyin shed bu'i nyin bcu bzhi/ /shed bu'i nyi ma bu la ni/ /lha rnams dus ni bdun cu gcig /de tshe dus des 'di yis ni/ /phyi ma'i dus su 'gyur ba'o/ /bskal pa'i mtha' dang /'jig bskal dang / /yongs 'gyur dang ni dpyad zin dang / /'jig dang dus mtha' cher 'jig pa/ /zad dang sbud dang gnyid log dang / /'gro ba zhig pa zhes bya rnams/ 11 /'jig pa'i ltas dang / nye ba'i rtags/ /nyer bsgyur nyer 'tshe mi bskyed dang / /lugs ma yin dang rtsa nas 'don/ 7 /rab tu nyams pa zhig pa'o/ 2 /zhes pa dus kyi rab tu byed pa'o// //sdig pa/'i ming / 'dres pa nag nog /sdig pa dang / /nyes pa/ ltung ba/rnyog pa dang / /nyes spyod/ nyes byas/ a gha dang / /saṃ ha/ dor bya/pra pre dang / /'dam dang / sā dmā sdogapazug rngu dang / /ru smadabyaste/ mun pa / mi dge ba'o/ 18 /chos dang / bsod nams/ legs pa dang / /legs byas dang ni/ khyu mchog go/ /dga' ba'i ming / rangs dang / rab myos/ dga' rab dga'/ /yang dag dga' dang / kun tu dga'/ /kun tu dga' 'gyur/ shin tu dga'/ /skyid sharmadang bde dang / shā ti shaṃ bde/ 12 /dge dang / bkra shis/ dge legs bzang / /ma tī/ shu sgo/ dgeb/bskal pa dang / /skal ldan/ legs ldan ku sha lo dgeb/ /bde ba/ mtho ris mtho ris gnas/ /zhi ba/ bharnye/shaṃ / bde legs/ 17 /sdig dang / bsod nams bde legs sogs/ /120—1191

kede dang ldan pa 'diming gzhan ya nga shes par bya/ /shin tu bzang dang / rab mchog dang / /ltad mo che dang / phul byung dang / /mchog tu gyur dang bsngags 1'os so/ /brtse ba/ dge ba/ byed 2'jug pa'o/ 1 /'dod dang / mi 'dod 'bras bu ni/ /rnam par smin pa zhes brjod do/ /gnam skos / lhas bstan/ skal ba dang / /dbang thang bsag rgyab/ sngon byas so/7 /rgyu dang byed pa sa bon dang / 3 /gzhi dang thog ma'i byed pa'o/ /bdag bi ming / gtso bo skyes bu/ zhing shes dang / /nang dang dbang phyug 'tsho ba bdag /gso ba gang zag rang bzhin dang / /rang dang yid 'dren/ā ba sha /kun spyod dang ni/ sems pa dang / /lus gnas dang ni/mchod sbyin spyor/ 17 /yon tan snying stobs/ rdul mun pa/ /khyad par dus can gnas skabs so/ /bskyed bya4/ skyed byed/ 'byung ba dang / /skye ba skye ba/ dzadma ma skye ba dzadma ma skye b.ru ṣe/ /dza na rna skyedapa/ zhes bya ba'o/ 7 /skye ldan/srog chags/ sems pa can/ /'tsho ba can dang / skye bo dang / skye ba can dang / lus can no/ 7 /sems dang / sems pa 5snying po/ snying / /nang gi byed pa li shu dang / /yid byed yid dang / rang ming 6ngo / 9 /shes rab / blo dang / nyal slong dang / /blo gros/ dpyod pa/ yid tshol dang / /blo yi byed pa/ burnyi/ mkhas/ /rig dang / rab mthong /kun tu rig /sems byed nyer dmigs/ kun tu sems/ /go dang dzha snyi/sems pa'o/ 18 /yang dag /rig byed/ tshor ba dang / /gsal gyur/so sor snang / nyams myong / /rnam par rig byed nye bar dmigs/ /rab tu gsal dang / yang dag tshor/ 9 /thar pa'i lus la khyab pa'i blo/ /ye shes 720—1 192

gzhan ni rnam shes te/ /bzo dang bstan bcos 'dzin pa'i blo'o/ /blo dang /gzungs ldan/ yid gzhungs dang / /kun rtog 1yid la byed pa'i las/ 5 /sems kyi rtsol ba yid la byed/ /rnam dpyod rnam par dpyod byed dang / /bgrang dang / dpyod dang / rnam rtog dang / /kun tu rtog dang gtan la 'bebs / 7 /rjes su 'jal dang / rjes su dpag /dpyod pa dang ni/rigs pa yang / 4/rtog dang / rtog byed lhag par rtog 3 /phyin ci ma log par shes pa'i/ /gtan la phebs dang / nges pa mtshungs/ 2 /ṣpem nur/yid gnyis dogs pa dang / /the tshom/ som nyi/ rnam par rtog /rnam par 'khor dang / gcig ma yin/ /bi tsi ka྾/ bi tarka/ 10 /phyogs snga ma dang / snga rgol lo/ 2 /grub mtha'/ gzhung lugs/ rtsod ldan dang / /byas mtha' nus pa/ rā dhwanta/ /phyogs phyi ma dang / yang dag bzung / /yang dag bzhag pa rnams su 'gyur/ 9 /dam bca' so sor mnyan bya dang / /khas len/ phyogs bzung / yang dag 'dzin/ /nges pa mnyan bya/ bdag gir byas/ /khas len/ so so'i shes pa dang / yang dag thos dang / mi bzad pa'i/ /maṅga ra dang / u ra rī/ /khru ri/ spru ra rī yang 'dod/ 15 /log par lta dang med pa pa/ 2 /gnod sems dang ni 'tshe ba'i 4sems/ 2 /'tshe ba a ba bā ra'o/ 2 /nye bar bzlos dang 'byed pa mtshungs/ 2 /thar pa grol ba zhi ba dang / /bsil bar gyur dang mya ngan 'das/ /mthar gyur 5legs pa nges 'byung dang / /ma 'dres pa dang tshangs pa dang / /nges par legs dang bdud rtsi dang / /rab tu tshim dang byang grol dang / /dga' ba chen dang yang srid med/ 16 /don dam pha rol sun dpung gnyen/ 3 /log pa'i blo gros 'khor 120—1193

dang 'khrul/ 3 /ma rig mi shes rig min dang / /nga rgyal blo gros rmongs pa'o 5 /so sor snang min shaṭwā'o/ /gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro/ /reg bya 'di dag yul rnams te/ /'dod pa'i yon tan dbang po'i don/ /dbang po'i gzung 1bya'i spyod yul lo/ /'dir ni yon tan mar gyur pa/ /dbang po yul dang yid byed do/ /las kyi dbang po lag pa dang / /rkang pa bshang lam nyer gnas dag /blo yi dbang po yid dang mig /rna ba sna lce lpags pa'o/ /ro drug sga ming / bska ba dang ni mchog tu bska/ 2 /mngar ba lañtsha tsha ba dang / /kha ba dang ni sgyur ba ste/ /'di rnams don ni drug rnams so/ /rnam nyed sbyang spos snying 'bab dri/3 /bzhon pa can dang kun smos dang / /shin tu ring nas 'gugs pa dang / /brjod bya'i rtags nyid yon tan las/ 2 /'gugs byed ring du khyab pa mtshungs/ 2 /dri bzang dang ni sna tshim byed/ 2 /'dod pa'i dri dang dri zhim mo / 2 /—kha la bgos pa'i ga pur dri/ /legs 'thul 5dang ni kha la chags / 2 /dri nga ba dang rul dri'o/ 2 /mi gtsang ba dang bsur dri'o/ 1 /kha dog bi ming / dkar po dge byed gtsang dang gsal/ /mdog dkar dang ba dkar snum dang / /skyong ba chos 'ching go ra dang / /stobs byed dag byed ardzu na/ /skya ser ser skya dkar skya'o/ 17 //cung zad skya dang 'ol kha'o/ /nag nag po dhyā ma/ shi ti dang / /snga ma mang 'dzin dkar ming dang / /nag lhang sngon po dhya ma la/ /kā la sngo bsangs dga' byed de/ 12 /ser po ser shang yung ba'i mdog /a ru ra mdog ser can no/ 5 /ljang gu ljang ser pā lā sha'i/ /mdog ste 'di dag ljang gur mtshungs/ 3 /dmar po utpal dmar ba'i snemadog/khrag mdog /ro hi lo hi ta/ 5 /mi gsal dmar ba skya rengs mdog /120—1194

dkar dmar 'dres pa pā ta 3snal/ /ser nag dang ni nag ser ro/ 2 /dmar nag dud kha mchin kha'o/ 1 /ser nag ser skya skyer kha dang / 3 /ka 3drug seṅga seṅga la / 3 /sna tshogs 'dres ma zal po dang / /khra bo sā ri shā ri ga /a ta dang ni sha ba la/ 8 /piñdza ra ni dmar ser ro/ 1 /pa la kṣa ni dkar sngon te/ /chu shing me tog lta bu'o/ /ardzu na ni dkar po dang / /nag po'i cha tsam ldan pa ste//ku mu da ltar dang ba'o/ /se tārdzu na rnam rgyas pa'i/ /ston ka'i sprin dang mtshungs shing gsal/ /pāṇḍa rā ni dkar ljang ste/ /mtshan mo'i ri bong can mtshungs pa'o/ /pāṇḍa ri ni dmar ser te/ /rdul ldan tho rangs zla ba bzhin/ /pāṇḍa ser po'i cha ldan dkar/ /ke ta kṣi yi rdul dang mtshungs/ /dhū sa ra ni dkar po la/ /ser po'i bag dang ldan pa ste/ /atpa la ltar dwangs pa'o/ /ma tsa ka ni sngo nag ste/ /zar ma'i me tog dang mtshungs pa'o/ /go ra kha dog dmar ser te/ /gi haṃ gsar pa ltar gsal ba'o/ /hi ra ta ni nag dkar ldan / /tā la'i 'bras bu ltar gsal ba'o/ /ro hi ta dang lo hi ta/ /dza ba'i me tog dang mtshungs pa'o/ /rakta thun mtshams ltar gsal ba'o/ /sho ṇa bantu'i 5me tog bzhin/ /ha ri tra ni dkar ngan ser/ /nye ba'i thun mtshams sprin ltar gsal/ /shā ba rang bzhin ser nag ste/ /thun mtshams sprin dang 'dra bar mdzes/ /dhū ma la ni nag dmar te/ /du ba dang ni sbur me bzhin/ /dkar ser dmar ljang ka ḍā ra/ /rtswa yi me dang 'dra ba'o/ /ljang gu'i cha yis dman gyur pa/ /de dang ldan pa pad rdul 'dra/ /ka drug ser mdog ltar gsal lo/ /kidhī ra ni dkar dmar ro/ /kalbā ṣa ni dkar nag go/ /karngu ra ni dkar sngon no/ /seṅga na ni dkar nag ste/ /chu yi rnam pa mtshungs shing 120—1195

gsal| /ka ba ra ni dud nag ste/ /dud ldan mar me'i 'od mtshungs pa'o/ /bā la dmar sngon dkar ser te/ /phyi ba'i thal ba lta bu'o/ /yon tan dkar po la sogs pho/ /yon tan rtags rnams de bzhin no/ /ri ①hi hā/ ro ⑦hi tāske/ rakta/ /lo hi ṇi dang / lo nyi ta/ ro hi ti kā/ lo nyi ti kā/ rā gā ko ṇḍa zhes pa yang / sho tī shi ṇḍa si shiṅgā/ /siṅgā lā dang ha ra ①hā/ /ha ri tā| zhes pa yang ngo / 2 /bye rī shya tā ṅga tā yang /3 /nī lā gos dang ldan pa'i ming //rī lī/ srog chags sman dag go/ /bye bhā/ ku mu da'i 'dab mtshungs/ /ṣpe tso'i mdangs 'dra ha ri tī/ /tshangs ldan bhā ra tī skad tshig /ngag dang brjod pa dbyangs can dang / /tshig dang / gsung dang / pā tsa dang / /bha ṇi nyi dang / pa tsa rna/ /pa tsa tha snyad smra ba dang / /smras dang / pākya/'chad dang / bshang / 17 /saṃ skṛ ta ni lha yi skad/ /pi ④shā tsi ni 'byung po'i skad/ /a pa/ rghaṃ sha /zur chag sgra/ /rjod byed bstan bcos sgra la ni//ting dang / supra kyi mtha' can tshig /bya ba'am ⑤ni/ byed ldan pa'o/ /pa ri sāṭa/ gsang tshig ste/ /rī ti tshig gi lam yin no/ /rab tu bcings dang / sbyar ba dang / /yang dag spel dang / rgyus pa dang / /sdud sbyor 'di rnams sbyar ba ste/ /sgra yi ma la ni gusbya rjoṣpe'o/ /thos dang rig byed man ngag dang / /sdeb sbyor dang ni/ kha ton lung / /rgyud dang / yal ga nges 'gro'o| 9/snyan tshig /khru kṣ-i/ dbyangs 'jebs ⑦dang / /der ni u pa ni ṣata rnams/ /rig byed dag ni gsang ba'i'o/ /chos dang nges par 'gro ba yang / /chos dang thos dang sgrub pa gsum/ /nges brjod dang ni snyan tshig dang / /mchod sbyin 'di gsum rig byed gsum/ /bslab dang brda spyod sdeb 120—1196

sbyor dang / /de bzhinaskar rtsis thos pa dang / /rtog pa dang ni yan lag go/ /dran pa dang ni chos dang bcas/ 2 /oṃ zhes bya ba rab bsngags dang / /tshangs pa yi ni 'gyur med sngags/ 3 /u dātta dang / swa ri ta/ /a nu dātta dbyangs gsum mo/ /de lta bu byung sngon gyi tshul/ 2 /sngon rabs mtshan nyid lnga yin te/ /rjes tshol ba dang lugs kyi rgyud/ /rtog ge/ sa bdag bstan bcos dang / /kun nang nye bar dmigs don no/ /bstan bcos rgyud dang / thos pa mtshungs| /'bel ba'i gtam dang / phan tshun bgro①/ /rab sbyor tshig dang gtam yin no/ 2 /gab tshig dang ni/ brda ②yis ston/ /dri ba'i pho nya shes dka'odzee/ 4/tshig bsdus pa dang bsdus pa'i don/ 2 /bsdus dang / legs par bsdus pa'o/ 2 /khyim pa'i gtam dang / skye bo'i brjod/ /log pa'i glu dang / smra ba'o/ 4/rab tu brjod dang / ci zhes smra/ /rjod par byed dang /skye bos thos/4/sgeg ldan skad dang / nyams ldan no/2/gtam brjod pa dang /de bzhin glu/ /lo rgyus dang ni kha skad do/3/ming dang 'bod phyogs/ mtshan nyid dang / /mtshon pa/ rigs dang kun gsal dang / /kun gsal nā ma dhe ya dang / /bya ba de sha tshig bla dwags/ /brda ④dang / 'phral sbyar/byas pa dang / /kun tu 'bod dang / mngon brjod do/ 25/gsal dang /grags dang / rab tu grub/ 3 /nye bar 'jal ⑤dang / dper brjod do/3 /nye bar dgod dang / smra ba'i sgo/ 2 /'di dang / rjes sbyor/ shes 'dod dang / /gtam dang / sgogs dang / rjes sbyor byed/ 5 /slar smra ba dang /lan ldon mtshungs/ 2 /log par mngon sbyor ngan brjod dang / /log smra/sun 'byin mngon sum spyod/ /spyo medang / khro ⑦tshig /rnam ⑧khros tshig 8 /120—1197

rnam par smra dang / tha snyad dang / /mna' dang / khro bor/ shā ba'o/na/legs smra dang ni/ rjes chags skye/ 2 /yang dag mkhyen ldan snyan grags dang / /tshigs bcad dang ni grags pa'o/ 4 /bstod pa nu ti/ stu ti dang / /na ba/sta ba/ sta tram̐ dang / /bsngags pa dang ni/ rnam par brjod/8 /smra dang rab tu bsngags pa dang / /mtho bar grags dang / dbyangs su byed/4 /skyor tshig dang ni gnyis gsum brjod/2 /mya ngan 'jigs dang rtse sogs las/ /cong skad dang ni/ yi ge bral/2 /skal ba mchog dang / yon tan lhag2 /'gran par byed dang / yang dag dga'/ 2/smod nyapa/ nye bar spyod pa dang / 2/ na ga gaspyo gaspyo khaṃ/ /mi bsngags/ dor bya nges smod dang / /yongs smod dang ni sgur 'debs dang / /pi tai ba dang / ngan bya pa/ /smod dang /smod par byed pa dang / /rtsod pa ni/ 1 rja'o/ 14 /de la g.yo ba gang yin pa/ /'khrig pa'i phyir du phan tshun smod/ /mngon par smra dang / tshig rtsub po/ 2 /spyo tshig /gnod tshig /bsdig —tshig go/ 3 /smod pa dang bcas nyer dmigs pa/ /sa ri bhā ṣa ṇa zhes so/ /u pā lambha rjes su spyor/ /mgron 5gnyer 'bod dang / 'gugs dang bod/ 3 /yang dag 'bod pa mang pos bos/ /tshogs pa'i sgra ni/ sī rā bi ṇi/ /sgra chen ko lā haṃ la'o/ /rjes su smra dang / yang yang smra/ /sbyo tshig dang ni/ don med tshig /'gal ba brjod dang / 'gog tshig go/ /mya ngan tshig dang smre sngags 'don/ /khams bde dang ni/ 'dri rmed do/ /shin tu smra dang legs par brjod/ /gsang tshig dang ni/ gsang ba'i gtam/ /a sa tna ba/ a badmem/ /a pa dzñā na/a pa hā ya/ /phal cher bsdus nas kun bshad pa/ /rkang ba las skyes rgyun 120—1198

chags yin/ /mjo bar brjod dang nges bcings so/ 2 /tu mu la ni 'khrugs pa'i sgra/ 1 /tshig gi ①skyes dang / tshig spring ②dang / /bstan pa dang ni yang dag smra/ 4 /tshig gi dbye ba phyi ma gsum/ /ngan smra dang ni/ ngan brjod mtshungs| 2 /sdig pa'i tshig dang / mi dge ldan/ 24 /dge ba dge ba'i bdag nyid can/ /snyan dang / shin tu zhi ba dang / /legs par smra dang snying dzeel 'bab/ 4 /tshig rtsub dang ni/ gya tshom ④dang / 2 /grong pa dang ni/tshul min pa/ 2 /myur bar brjod dang brtabs ⑤te brjod/ 2 /graste/ ngag tshig yi ge phyis/ 1 /mi mngon pa dang / mi gsal ba/ 2 /kla kkor gyur pa skad nyams pa/ /kun tu 'khrugs dang / nyon mongs gyur/ /phan tshun 'joms par byed pa'i tshig 2 /don med pa dang 'brel med pa/ 2 /yi ge bral dang brjod bya med/ 2 /chu 'thor gtam dang / mchil gtam mo/ /zegs 'thor ༷gtam dang gnyis brjod dang / /don stong tshig dang brdzun gtam dang //de nas bden dang dga' ba dang / /phyin ci ma log mi bslu ba'o/ 4 /bden sogs bden par smra ba dang / /bden pa de bzhin mi bslu ba/ /yang dag 'di rnams gsum de ni / /⑦sgra dang nges sgrogs grags ⑧pa dang / /lhang tsher/ ni swān| nint+ra ⑨na/ /ding 'ur/ nges smra/ nges sgrogs dang / /sgrogs pa ca co ku co dang / /dbyangs dang / grag dang / skad 'don dang / /hā sa/rā ba ba ra ⑩smos/ /ku ha ri nya/ brjod pa dang / /mngon par brjod dang rjod byed sgra/ /mgrin skyes/ mngon brjod/ nyams ldan yang / 26 /gi gā'i sgra ni madma na/ /ca co ko lā ha la'o/ /shwarbha ṭi dang / tsarba rī/ 2 /sgra ldan dang ni brag ca'o/ 2 /bā se haṃ ni/ dud 'gro'i sgra/ /gzhu yi sgra ni biswā 120—1199

ra / /rnga chen sgra ni ṭu ṭu ra/ /gos dang la ma'i marma ra/ /rgyan byu sgra ni pañdzi tai/ /pi wang sgra ni1/ ni kā ṇa/ /mi gsal rku ṇa/ ko ṇa sgogs/ /khog pa'i ka la ka la'o/ /phug ron dang ni dbyangs sbed do/ /glu dang glu dbyangs 'di dag mtshungs/ /pi wang sgogs pa la sogs la/ /pra kāṇa dang pra kwa ṇa/ /ka ṇa kā ṇa/ saṃ kwa khyo/ /saṃ ku ṇa dang / sru ku ṇa/ /a nu kwa ṇa la sogs so / 8 / 'khor nyan khyu mchog dri 'dzin dang / /drug skyes bar ma blo gsal dang / /lnga pa zhes pa 'di rnams bdun/ /rgyud dang mgrin las skyes/ pa'i dbyangs/ /'khor nyan gling bu'i sgra lta bu/ /blo gsal rta yi skad lta bu/ /dri 'dzin ra yi skad ltar 'tsher/ /drug skyes zla ba can sgra bzhin/ /khyu mchog ba lang sgra lta bu/ /bar ma khrung khrung sgogs pa bzhin/ /lnga pa me tog dus ldan1/ /rma bya sgrogs pa lta bu'o/ /'di rnams thams cad myos pa yis/ /sgogs byed de yang lnga pa'o/ /kā ka li ni phra ba'i sgra/ /mi gsal snyan pa ka la'o//zab mo'i sgra ni sngags yin no/ /shin tu mtho ba tā ra'o/ /cha lang pheg rdob sa masgo / /pi wang dang ni barṇa ki/ /rnam par spyod dang dbyangs ldan no/gapi wang rgyud ni lā su ki/ /rgyud rnams 4lha yi grangs rnams kyis/ /pi wang nyid ni yongs su bsgrags/ /pi wang srad bu ma ru rka/ /pi wang bu ga nā li kā/ /pi wang khog pa pra bā la/ /pra dre ka /rtse yi shing 'khyog /ko lasba ni lus yin no / /thag pa'i gnas dang 'ching ba'o/ /'dab ma'i rgyud rnams de yi dbus//pi wang la sogs rol mo yi/ /skad thabs ghu ghu ri kā'o/ /pi wang la sogs rgyud kyi sgra/ /rnga la sogs pa sbubs kyi sgra/ /gling bu la sogs bu ga'i sgra/ /sel snyan sgra ni cha lang sogs/ /rol mo rnam pa bzhi po 'di/ /bā ti/ tra 720—1200

mā ta zhes bya/ /sel snyan dang ni sel khrol lo/ /mā hā ti dang /a mā na/ /pa ṭa ha la sogs pa'o/ /ma hā na dang / marda ka /rnga zlum/rdza rnga a na ka /a ru ra 'dra'i rnga adhya / /nas kyi dbus 'dra uzlu ka /a lidhya ni ba lang gi/ /mjug ma'i dbyibs 'dra 'di dag gi/ /barma mu ra dza yin no//'khar rnga/ dzharsha pa dag mtshungs/ /shwekka/ cha lang marda la/ 2 /kā ha la dang sgra chen dang / /kā ha'i sgra dang / srubs can dang / /gtum po'i ku co zhes pa rnams/ 5 /señdza la dang / kā ha la/ 2 /de nas bhākka/ guñdza dang /bhākka rnam 1rgyal marda la/ /rgyang grags sgra can/ rgyang grags kyi/ /cha lang /snyan pa'i pa ṭa ha/ /go byed pa ṭa ha dang ni/ /lasthā pa ṭa ha ming can/ /ā na ka dang / ba ṭa ha/ /guñdza pa ṭa hi kā ya/ 4 /a na ka dang / mṛ di naka 2 /'jigs byed rnga dang rnga bo che/2/rol mo'i rab dbye 'di rnams te/ /ma ha na dang / /ḍa ma ru/ /muḍū/ ḍiṇḍi ma/ rdza rnga / /glu rnga / 'khar rnga /ka ra che/ /na pa/ raṅgi teṅga ri/ /g.yul du sel snyan sgra dang ni/ /rnga chung gnyis ka ḍiṇḍi ma/ /g.yul 'thab nyin mo'i sil snyan no/ /mi bdag rnams kyis bza' ba'i mthar/ /bza' ba'i sil snyan gang yin de/ /'jig byed zas kyi sil snyan te/ /rlabs kyi 'gros can yin zhes bya/ /byis pa'i sel snyan gang yin de/ /rab dga'i marda la zhes so/ /'tsho ba byung ba'i go byed pa'i / /sel snyan gaṇḍa'i sel snyan brjod/ /thig pa'i sil snyan dag dang ni//shing rta glang po gnyis ka yi/ /ḍiṇḍi kā dang / uṅga ra/ /grong khyer dbyangs dang / 'khor ba'i rlabs/ /mi bzad pa yi sgra rnams so/ /chu tshod bum pa/dbyu thugu'i rnga / /mel tshe 'dzin pa/ mel tshe'i sgra/ /thun gyi dbyangs dang /720—1201

thun gyi skad/ /dus kyi sel snyan du yang bshad/ 7 /zangs ma'i dbyu khyegu/chu tshod dbyug /bu ga'i tshad dang / dus 'dzin pa'o/ 4 /de nas sbubs can bum pa dang / /thun gyi tho ba/ dbyu gu'o/ 4 /de sgra thun gyi dbyangs dang ni/ /thun gyi tram̐ ga ra zhes kyang / 2 /shid byed yi dwags rnga dang ni/ /shi ba'i uṅga ra yang ngo / 3 /glang po myos pa'i taṅga rī/ /myos pa'i tram̐ ga ra zhes brjod / /na kā ta tram̐ ga ri kā ni/ /dbul po'i pa ṭa ha ru 'dod/ /khyu mchog dga' ston sel snyan gang / /ba lang rnga yi ming can no/ /bum ston 'khar ba'i sel snyan ni/ /'khar ba'i cha lang zhes par 'gyur/ /ku ṭu guñdza/shing rta'i sgra/ /lus ldan pa ṭa ha yang de'o/ /kha yi sil snyan/ kha'i cha lang 2/ga lwa sel snyan sgra chen po/ /ka ra rdi dang / pheg rdob po/ 2 /kyu rdza āoṃ ni/mig gsal sgra/ /tsa ṭu/ pa ṭu/ spya ba'o/ /gtam pa dang ni/gar 1pa/ /2re mos smra dang / rab myos pa/ /rig byed/ sel snyan/gā ta ri/ /glu len pa dang / glu mkhan ni/ 2 /gar pa dang ni/ rol rtsed pa / 2 /dal dang / myur dang / bar pa —la/ /ta stam/ e 5gho/gha rna rim/ /cha lang / myur rdeg /dus ma ni/ /la yo zhes sogs bya dus tshad/ /lag pa/ rkang pa/ dag dang ni/ /mig gis so sor blta ba dang / /'dren par blta sogs bya ba'i tshad/ 3 /ma la bya ba gang gzhan mo de//phan tshun/ la yaḥl yaḥdang / /sā mya zhes pa de 'dod do/ rki /tāṇḍa baṃ/ na ṭa ni/ /nā ṭa bye/ lā sum̐/ /raṅga / /na rta ni/ mo nī tram̐ zhes pa rnams su 'gyur / /bud rnged rnams kyi zlum po'i gar/ /hallī sa ka zhes par 'gyur/ /rnga gsum gar dang glu dang ni/ /rol mo gar bya 'di ni gsum/ /de nas bha 120—1202

kum bā dang ni/ /ju kum pa dang / ju kum bā/ /ji ku sa ni 'dra ba ste/ /'di dag skyes pas bud med kyi/ /cha byad bzung ba la brjod do/ /zlos gar la bshad rgyal mtshan ni/ /gzhon nu/ jo bo'i khye'u'o/ 2 /rgyal po rje btsun dang ni lha/ /bu mo rje'u'i 1khye'u mo/ /lha mo gang la dbang bskur ba/ /gzhan rnams la ni rje btsun ma/ /skyed byed pa ni/ ā bu ka /bhā ba mkhas pa'o mā ri ṣa/ /'phags pa asthā skyed ma'o/ /sring mo che ba arnyi kā/ /sring mo'i bdag 2po ā brti/ /rā dza swā la yul 'khor ro/ /tshogs can ma ni ārdzu kā/ /byis pa bā su zhes bya'o/ /haṇḍa/ hañdzi/ ha las 'bod/ /dman pa/ g.yog mo/ grogs mo'o/ /'phags pa'i bu zhes bod bya ba/ /bu mo rnams kyi lang tsho'i bdag /gzhan du yang ni 'phags pa mchog /rgyal po che dang mi bdag go/ /a pra hmargya bsang bya min/ /niṣṭha zin pa yin te mtshungs / /lus nyams lnga pa zin pa'o/ /aṅga hā ra/ yan lag bskyod/ /gsal byed dang ni/ tshul dag mtshungs/ /gsal byed la sogs gar la ni/ /snga ma'i yan lag gnas dbye ba/ /gar gyi gnas dang zlos gar gnas/ 2 /sgeg dang / dpa' dang / snying rje dang / /rmad byung rgod dang 'jigs su rung / /mi sdug drag shul mnyes pa/ shin 4pa/ /zhi ba zhes bya nyams bcu'o/ /sgeg pa/ nyams ldan/ gtsang dang 'bar/ /gsal ba can zhes pa yang ngo gasgeg pa'i dbye ba longs spyod rdzogs/ /pa pā lambha/ ting nge 'dzin/ /spra pa / 'phel ba dpa' ba yin/ /snying rje/ thugs rje/ brtse ba dang / /kṛ pā/ da yā rjes su brtse/ /rjes su chags dang / shu ka'o/ /ngo mtshar/'phags dang / rmad byung / mtshar/ 4 /hā sa ya 5ha sa/ hā sa'o/ 2 /120—1203

tsa maṭwā ra/ 'dul byed dang / /'dul du 'jug pa zhes pa yang 3 mi bzad / 'jigs byed/ dngangs byed/ 'jigs/ /drag po 'jigs rung / 'jigs par byed/ /so sor 'jigs dang / bhā mu rā/ /dī la/bye ra ba/ bha yā ba ha/ 12 /drag bo drag shul/ zhes pa dang / /mi sdug pa dang / bi bsgo/ /dngangs skrag /nyam nga / bag tsha dang / /pham par byas dang 'jigs pa'o/ /yid kyi rnam 'gyur dga' ba dang / /zhum dang khro sogs kyis bskyed pa/ /nyams su myong dang rnam 'gyur rtogs/ /de yang nyams myong longs spyod sdogs/ /thob pa'i bdag nyid can du 'gyur/ /der ni mig bzhi las byung ba/ /smin ma 'degs dang 'dzum rnams 'khor/ /bkra bar nyams myong dag la sogs/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i bdag nyid 'dod/ /mngon 'dod de bzhin bsam pa dang / /rjes su dran pa'i tshogs su 'dod/ /de bzhin spyo dang rnam par smra/ /smyo ba dang ni nad nyid dang / /dza bha 'dul byed kyang zhes pa/ /thob pa'i bdag nyid bcu yin no/ /dgod 1pa dga' bar byed pa ste/ /de bzhin gnyi ga spro ba'o/ /sbed dang ngo mtshar zhes bya ba/ /dngos po bzhag par rab tu bsgrags/ /dbang du byed pa rnam shes kyis/ /dngos/ po'i lam la skyes pa'i las/ /yid kyi mdud pa ngar sems te/ /nga rgyal sems ni mtho ba'o/ /snyems dang mngon pa'i nga rgyal dang / /ngar 'dzin / rgyags dang / dregs/ mngon zhen/ 6 /bsgyings —pa dang ni yang dag shugs/ /kun rtsom/ kun 'bebs/ yang dag bskor/ /rang dbang 'jug dang / kun nas ldang / 2 /mngon par ldang dang / zhe sar byed / /gus byed/ gus par nyan pa dang / /yongs su sbyong dang /120—1204

mchog tu byed/ /sten byed/ rab bsten dang ba dang / /nye bar byed dang /nye bar gnas/ /kun tu bsten dang / mnyen byed dang / /nye bar spyod dang / u pa sā rna/ 13 /ma gus/ yongs smod/ zil gnon dang / /ring byed/ mi rtsi byā 1kā ra/ /brnyas dang / kun brnyas/ zhum byed dang / /gus med/ brnyas byed smos pa dang / /pa ba rgo dang a ba li/ /a bhe bha bā zhes rnams so/ 12 /zhum byed/ ngo tsha 'dzem / mig dma'/ /tī/ na ti bi sha khrel yod/ 2 /bzod pa/ kṣa ma/ ti tikṣa/ /sa hibye tā zhes rnams so/ /gsod dang / rnam par 'tshe pa'o/ 2 /mi bzod pa dang /phrag dog go/ /yon tan la ni skyon sgro 'dogs/ /a sru ya zhes bya ba'o/ /rab skyon 'gebs dang / 'chab pa'o/ 2 /do ṣa dang ni ā dī na/ 2 /le lo/rmugs pa/ snyem las so/ 3 /yid lag cags dang / rjes su gcags/ /phyi nas gdung dang / rjes su gdung / /bgod 4pa'o/ /brnab 5sems gzhan nor chags/ 2 /nye bar longs spyod/ /nirbe sha 2 /a byā dhwa na/ nye ba'i rims/ 2 /'khon dang / 'gras dang / rnam par sdang / 3 /khon du 'dzin dang / der 'dzin pa/ 2 /yid gdungs6/ mya ngan gdung ba dang / /niḥs ma'o/ 4 /brtson 'grus dang / /sau ṭī rya dang ma dang / /su ṭī ra tā zhes pa'o/ /mi brjodage/ khong khro/ khro ba khro/ /ru rta krutta / bhā ma ko sa/8/yongs su gdung ba a ba tha/ 2 /'du byed dang ni/ bā sa nā/ 2 /ngal ba dang ni / thang chad pa/ 2 /ya mtshan dang ni/ ngo mtshar dang / /dge mtshan dang ni ltad mo che/ /skyo ba sangs pa zhes bya'o/ 5 /'dod rgyal/ rang 'dod / rgyu mtshan med/ 3 /yid ches pa dang / dad pa'o/ 2 /rab tu 120—1205

dad dang / dad pa mtshungs/ 2 /bud med rnams kyi 'jo 1sgeg dang / /rnam 'gyur/ rnam g.yo/ rol pa dang / /de bzhin bsgul dang zur kyis rte ston / /'di rnams sgeg pa'i bya ba'o/ /bud med rnams kyi sgeg pa la/ /yid kyi rnam 'gyur las skyes pa'o/ /bya ba so so so so'o/ /rtsed mo'i dngos skyes thams cad la/ /brtson par byas dang snying la bris/ 2 /bzhad gad/tshig 'don ca co dang / /bde phyin/ ku re/ bkyal ka dang / /bde ba'i dga' ston/ narma dang / /rtsod dang / rtsed mo rol pa dang / /saṃ sa dang / rkire ṇa kaḥ 13 /byes pa rnams kyis rtsed mo la/ /be khā/ kadru 4ka /1 ḍa/ /tūrda ni dang / la ḍa rna/ 5 /lag pa'i 'khrul 'khor/ chu rtsed dang / /lag 'khrul can dang / byā rtaspyi/ /ro ldan pa 'jo'i rtsed mo'o/ 2 /shing rta'i sgra dang ko ha lo/ 2 /zol dang / zur ston/ mtshon pa'o/ 3 /rang bzhin/bsam / bdun/ a sha ya/ 4 /skad smra/ rnam 'gyur sbed pa'o/ /'tshub pa/ stab stob/ 'tshub 5pa'o/ 3 /spyod dang / spyod pa/ rnam pa dang / /aṅgi/ asgo ta yin no/ /ga chad dgod 6dang / kun nas dga'/ /yid dgod7/ 'dzum dang / bar mar dgodan/ /tshang skyes/ rdul dang /nges gdungs dang / /nyis gdung / rab 'bangs/ lus kyi rlan/ 6 /ba spu ḍabyed dang / ba spu langs/ /pags pa'i myu gu/ pags me tog /bu la shaṃ dang / tsher ma can/ /ba su'i rnam 'gyur/ ba su dga'/ /uttarṣa khaṃ zhes pa rnams/ /g.yo dang / ldeg dang / 'gul dang / bskyod7/gangud mo/ cho nge / mchi ma 'dzag 3 /g.yal ba dang ni/ glal ba'o/ 2 /yid brtan pa dang yid rton pa/ 7 /'ching ba/ 'gog pa/ biṣka mbha/ 2 /gtam 120—1206

'gal ba dang / bslu ba'o/ 2 /raṅgi ṇa dang / 'dres pa mtshungs/ 2 /shes rab gsal ba/ gnyid sad pa/ /dzā ga ra zhes pa rnams so/ 4 /gnyid dang / nyal dang / gzims pa dang / /rmi lam legs phab ces kyang bya/ /stom 2las dang ni sgyid snyem mo2/ 2 /gnyid yur ba dang / mig 'dzums so/2/smin bsdus/ bzhin bsdus/ khro gnyer ro/ /khro bas blta dang /sdang mig go/ /phab nas blta 4dang / kun tu bltamu/ /ikṣa rde dang /darsha ni/ /nirba rṇa na ni bhā la āoṃ/ 6 /rang tshul dang ni ngo bo nyid/ /yang dag grub dang / rang bzhin dang / /nges chags bdag chos/ ngang tshul dang / /skye ba zhes kyang bya ba'o/ 9 /snyug bsngal 'jig rten/ srid pa dang / /'khor ba rul gnas btson ra'o/ 5 /nyin mtshan lo dang / skad cig dang / /dgod 6dang / dga' ston rnamanu/ la ni / 5 /7zhes pa dpal ldan dpal 'dzin sde yis bkod pa'i mngon brjod mu tig gi phreng ba ming gzhan sna tshogs gsal ba zhes bya ba las mtho ris kyi sde rdzogs so// //sa 'og /rkang 'og /stobs ldan/ gnas/ /bcung 'og /'og gnas/ klu'i 'jig rten/ 6 /bu ga /khung bu/ padma'i mig /nirgyatha āoṃ/ gsal mthongs dang / /bi ro ka dang / da re dang / /khong stong / stso tram̐ ku ha dzā/ /ra.āoṃ ba pā/ shu ṣi'o/ 13 /sa dong / garta baṭa dang / 2 /bu ga dang bcas shu ṣi ram̐/ /mun nag /snang med/ mun pa can / /mun pa nyin mo'i sgo nga dang / /nam mkha' 'byor pa nyin mthar byed/ /phyogs gos/ arghaṃ/ mkha'i lpags 8pa/ /mtshan mo klu gnas sgra gcan /sna120—1207

—gnas / /sngon po'i phung po mtshan mo'i lpags/ /ta ma sa 1dang / spyod skyo/g.yo / /mkha' dang / gan chags/ sa sgrib po/ 21 /kun khyab/ mun pa / saṃ tha maḥ/ /mun thug2 /anta/ ta ma saṃ/ /mun zad/ a ga ta ma saṃ/ /ri gnas ku dru'i bu rnams te/ /de ni 'jog po/ nor rgyas bu/ /lhag ma stobs rgyu dung dang ni/ a shwa ta ra/ kadza la/ /sngo chen/ pad chen/nor las rgyal/ /bzhin ngan/ bong bu'i spu can dang / /yul 'khor skyong dang stobs po che/ /e ra ba ta logs su gzhan/ /lhag ma/ mtha' yas de'i dbang phyug /nor rgyas bu dang sbrul gyi rgyal/ 2 /tshangs sbrul hā la ha la dang / /rta mchil sbrul rgyal bzhin gnyis pa/ /sbrul gyi sgra ldan zhes pa'o/3/gnyid mi sad dang nyal ba dang / /u khru ta dang / myur 'gro dang / /sbrul nag dug chen/ chu sbrul lo/ /ti ṅge/ glang sna/ ba lang sna/ /mā lu dhwa nā4/ mā tu la/ /khri can dang ni/ rkang bzhi dang / /rgyal rigs dug med sbrul dag mtshungs/ /khra 'dzin/ skra ldan/ khra bo can/ 3 /shun pa brjes 5dang / go cha grol/ /sgrul spyi'i ming / sa la 'khyog dang / sa la 'phye/ /lag 'gro/ sbrul dang /lag pas 'gro/ /mche ba'i dug can/ dug 'dzin dang / /'khyog 'gro/rnam 'dzin/ mig gis thos/ /gdengs can/ 'khyil ldan/ rgyab rings dang / /lto 'phye/ khyang nyal/ bya rog lto/ /zas ngan dang ni 'khor lo can/ /ba lang rna ba byu dzee ga /rkang sbas/ rlung gi zas can dang / /rkang bral/sa na ga /sgo gī/ /sa ma ko lā/ /dug mtshon can/ /lce sgril ba dang / lce gnyis pa/ /sbrul gdug byed dang / gdengs ka 'dzin/ /kha dug can dang /120—1208

sbal 1pa za/ /da rpā ka ra/ sārja ga /mche ba can dang / bum sna can/ /dong nyal/ pra ba khā tī dang / /zlum po can zhes pa rnams so/ 41 /sa la 'khyil dang / 'khums pa'o/ 2 /so sor sgo nga rul ba 'khyil/ 2 /sbrul las byung ba dug rus sogs/ /'gas byed/ dbye/ pa 2ṇa/ sgo ga /nirba pa ṇi / pags pa brjes/ /ro dang / 'ur sgogs/ shaṃ ra/ rno/ /dzaṅga lo/ga ta lo/ bi ṣe/ 7 /nag po brtsegs dang / kā ko la/ /'jam ster/snying po/ brgyad pa dang / /sha 4gam skyes dang / tshangs pa'i bu/ /rab gsal ha lā ha la dang / /bee'u'i lte bu/ rwa can dang / /me stag can de 'di rnams ni/ /dug gi dbye bar shes par bya/ 11 /dug gi rig 5sngags dug sel ma/ /dug dang / hā khā ha lam dang / /hā la ha lam dang yang ni/ /ha la 6ha la zhes pa'o/ 4 /dug gi sman pa dug sel ldan/ /sbrul 'dzin/ sprul kha sdig pa dang / /dug gi bee con/ gtam rab chags/ 5 /'di yi za ma tog la ni/ 1 /sbrul gye 'dun pa'i snod dang ni/ /bya gag 'dab ltar rgyas pa'o/ 2 /dmyal ba/ dga' med/ 'dod bral dang / /ngan 'gro de yi dbye ba ni/ /tsha ba rab tu tsha ba dang / /yang sos thig nag bsdus 7'joms dang / /mnar med ngu 'bod ngu 'bod che/ 2 /rab tu gzir bar byed pa'o/ 7 /ri dwags sems can dmyal gnas pa'i/ /srog chags rnams la 'byung ba'o/ 1 /chu bo rab med zhes bya ste/ /phun tshogs med dang bden pa bral/ 2 /dbang po/rna ba nag mo'o/ 2 /biṣṭi bzang po zhes bya ba/ /byed pa'i rgyal po 'di rnams so//gnod pa mi bzad tshor brnag 8dka'/ 3 /zug gzer9/ gsod pa/ sbug bsngal dang / /bya tha/ ā bā/ dha tshor gzir/ /bde med rtsod dang dga' 120—1209

med rlabs/ /bu btsas skyes dang / tshegs chen dang / /dka' ba dang ni 'jigs pa lan①/ 13 /dbye ba 'di dag gsum du 'gyur/ /rgya madku ming / rgya mtsho chu gter chu klung bdag /bā ri ri ṇi arna ②pa/ /katsi ①ga la/ swa ④rasta/ /bārti/ chu rnams bdag po dang / /a sāsbra ti/dug can gnas/ /gaṅgā 'dzin dang / chu sbyin dang / /chu ldan dang ni zla bas 'phel/ /pha rol 'khor dang / chu chen dang / /rin chen 'byung gnas sā tho dhi/ /chu srin ⑤'byung gnas brgal dka' dang / /arnyi dang ni/dba' klong 0'khrugs/ /chu yi phung po ti mi'i mdzod/ /'jal 'gro dang ni rlabs phreng can/ /rus sbal che ldan/ sirtse'i bdag /zla ba skyed byed/chu srin bdag /sa la 'gro dang / bsam bya dang / /ri yi thod can/sa mchod ma/ /ro ldan ma dang / dbang chen mtshan/ /bye ma can ma/'asgog 'gro skyes/ /ti mi'i grong dang / pha rol 'gro/ /'khrug 'byed ma dang /chu klung can/ /gling ldan chu srin/ rgyal mtshan can/ /chu yi bdag dang /zla ba'i grogs/ /sgon me ldan dang / bde ba'i mchog /de yi rab dbye 'o ma dang / /latsho mar gyi rgya mtsho dang / /mngar ba'i chu yi rgya mtsho dang / /zho dang bu ram chang gi mtsho/ 58 /bsrubs ⑦pa'i mtsho dang 'o ma'i mtsho kā la sha'i mtsho/ 'o ma'i chu/ /chu'i ming la zhe bzhi/ bdud rtsi smi ra btung bya dang / /'ju byed/ gnas byed/sprin gyi bcud/ /sprin gyi myu gu rgyas byed dang / /'tsho byed/ 'dod byed/skyong byed dang / /ngan sel/ 'khru phan/ nor ldan dang / /dug byed/ lus 'ching / mar dang gsher/ /da rka/ ba nā/ bā ri dang / /btung bya/120—1210

'dzag pa/ sgo kun 'gro/ /a paḥ sprin gyi me tog dang / /tī lā dang /bispa lo/ /gzhal ①'gro/ arṇa/ bde mchog byed/ /snying po/ bde 'ching / 'o ma byed/ /stobs byed/ kṛ bī ṭa/ /i rā dang ni bde byed dang / /mi zad byed dang / srog bslu ba'o/ 44 /ā sri/ asma yi so/ 2 /'bab chu/ gling ldan rgyu ldan ma/ /nya phyibs ldan ma/ skyong ldan ma/ /dba' rlabs ldan ma/ sil sgra can/ /sgogs ldan/ gzhol 'bab/ lha ldan ma/ /'bab ldan ma dang / bcud 'dzin ma/ /chu yi zegs ldan/lpags ldan ma/ /'jigs byed shing rta ma dang nadzee/ /zla ba'i lag ma gser ldan ma/ /sprin ldan lta ba'i brtul zhugs ma/ /skya nar ldan ma/ tshad ldan ma/ /sa srung ma dang chu dron ma/ /dbang chen/ grong gi phreng ldan ma/ 25 /chu klung dbye ba/ lha'i chu'o/ /dza ju'i bu snemo rgyun gsum ma/ /skal ldan shing rta lam gsum 'gro/ /khyab 'jug /rkang pa 'jigs byed skyes/ /chos kyi khu ma/chu sbyin ma/ /drag po'i thod gser ldan ma'o/ 11 /gshin rje'i sring mo/ ya mu nā| /nyi ma'i bu mo/ /gdung byed ma/ /gshin rje ma dang kā lirtswa/ /ri bo ka lindi bu mo/ /ka linda ka n+ya zhes so/ 8 /narma dā dang / re bā dang / /me la ka yi bu so dang / 5 /sngon gyi shaṃ gā zla ba skyes/ 5 /mu been lā/ mu rā la/2/lag chu dang ni/ rtag tu 'bab/ 2 /mang po sbyin dang / dkar po 'bab//srid sgrub ma zhes bya ba'o/ /shi ta dru dang sha ta parjo/2/gi gā phyed dang kā bee rī/2/gnas 'jog ma dang / go ta mbi/ 2 /ba yi mchog sbyin go lā'o/ 2 /dbyangs can dang ni/ shā ra tā/ 2 /zla cha/ zla cha las byung ma/ 2 /zhags grol ma dang / bi bā ṭa/ 2 /khrag 'bab dbyig gi dpung pa yin/ /drang chu/120—1211

lung chu/ byis pa'i chu/ /'dam bu can dang / ku sha can/ /shing dum can dang / 'bu can no/ /gzhan yang dbye ba chu 'dras 'dres/ /lha khang nas 'bab / shing chu gnyis/ /rba dang / dba' rlabs/ rlabs dang ni/ /steng 'byung / dal med/ chu'i 'khri hūṃshing / 6 /rlabs chen/ chu 'khrug /rlung gi gsos/ /steng du 'phar ba zhes pa rnams/ /dba' rlabs skyes dang /chu 'khor dang / /kho ga ti zhes bya ba'o/ 3 /de rab 'joms 2pa la ha ri/2/'khor lo kha la'i skosgra/ /chu g.yo ba ni ma nā shi/ /'khyel pa chu 'khrog rnam pa ste/ /chu 'khor dang ni/ 'khor chu'o/ /tā lu ra dang rlung gis bskyed/ /ka lo ku ra / zegs ma'i lte/ /'khyeg po paṅga zhes bshad de/ /rgyun 'khyog dang ni/ gya gyu 3'gros/ /yur ba dang ni/ rnang 6ma'o/ 2 /rgyun 'bab dang ni/ 'bab chu'o/ /chu rgyun/ pa bhā/ 'gro chu dang / /rab 'bab dang ni/ chu tshogs so/ 5 /sgol byed ku ṭa/ ḍūṇḍa bha/ 2 /sa rī ba ha/chu rngab pa/ 2 /khron pa rig 7par chu gnas pa/ /de ni shing dang dro sogs rgyun//lha yis byas dang / /ra ka'o/ 2 /pra tā lbo ni chu yi gnas/ /dhyā sā ri ṇḍi/zhes pa yang / /hiṇḍi ra dang mtsho'i ka ba/ /dbu ba chu yi gad mo'o/ 4 /chu bur dang ni/ dbu ba'i sprin/ 2 /chu klung rnams la chags pa yi/ /pe ni dang ni chu yi ma/ 2 /rab dang 'jug ngogs/ lugs dang / 'khrug /'grog byed / 'gram dang / rus sbal dus/ /dbus ni 'o ma'i rgya mtsho dang / /sa yo la sa zhes pa'o/ /chu 'phel ba ni gang ba'o/ /lugs ni chu gter 'khrug pa'o / /pha rol tshu rol phan tshun ngogs/ /de yi bar ni rgyun lam mo/ /gling dang / dza la kai ka dang / spre'u'i brtul zhugs bar gyi gling / 4 /mchu 120—1212

las thon pa de ni sgang / /bye ma'i ngogs dang / bye ma'i thang / /bzhi mdo'i phyag dar zhes pa yang / 3 /bā lu kā/ bā li kā/ 2 /'dab ma dang ni/ chu 'gebs dang / /rdzas dang / i ka /karba ṭa/ /'dam dang 'jim rdzab bā da dang / /dzambha rtel dang 'bying 'byed dang / /dzasgo dang chu rnyog go/ 7 /gru dang / sgol byed/ kau rnams so/ /gru'i ming / sgol ba rta ri/ no kā no2ཿ /shin tu rgyal byed/ sgol ba po/ /ta raṇḍi kā/ chu'i shing rta/ /bā da li ni zhes bya'o/ 7 /rkyal dang / chu rtsal gzings dang bee/ /ste la ka dang sgrol ba'o/ 5 /sgrol ba te ḍa/ mdung can dang / 3 /btung snod/ byed pa/ gru skya 4dang / /gru yi barṇa ṭa dag go/5 /bā da ra ba/ so li sdo/ /de nyid bar gyi stan yin no/ 3 /mgogs paṣṭa ti ram̐ tram̐ gā//gru skya dang ni/ g.yo byed dang / /chu skyong snod la chags pa dang / /sgol ba'i shing rta rnams yin no/ 5 /gru skya dang ni/ skyong byed do/ 2 /snod skyong ba dang khā dha ṭa/ 2 /gru sbyar shing gi tog tshi'o5/ /chu 'thor sgod dang / 'thor byed do/ 2 /shing gzhong dang ni chu yi snod/ 2 /rting 'jug shing dang bsgyur ba'i shing / 2 /gru btsas dang ni/ mnyan pa'i gla/ 2 /rna ba 'dzin dang /gdos pa 'dzin/ 2 /gling gzhan rgyu dang / gru'i tshong pa/ /gru 'dren pa zhes bya rnams so/ /gshin rje'i gnas dang / gting zab dang / /tshong gnas gshin rje'i 'og mthil reg 4 /rgyal chen nyal 'ching dra ba 'dzin/ /chu yi 'bangs dang nya pa dang / /nya rgya ldan pa rnams yin no/ 6 /tshogs kyi srad bu/gtsang byed de/ /dra ba dang ni nya yi dol/ 2 /'chil ma dang ni/ nya 'beegs so / /rgya mtsho can dang / rgya mtsho ba/ /gnying zab dwangs dang / gsal 720—12/3

ba dang / /dri bral/ rab gsal dri ma med/ 5 /rnyog pa 'dam can ma dwangs pa'o—/ /gting med gyur dang / mi zab pa/ /zab dang / gzhol dang /gting rings so/ /nya rgya dha rī/① ku be tī dang / ko ṭi'o/ 4 /sa la wa dang / pañdza ra/ /khe ṭaḥbee ba zhes pa dang / /khe ṭa/ pañdza ram̐ zhes so/ /phur bu ya/ 4 /sā ha ṭī rī/ 2 /mgrin gsum kaṣṭa ka ka ṭa/ 2 /nya dang /'gro ldan/ go cha can/ /rgyab rings/ dzha ṣa/ sgong skyes dang / /spru ka / rnam 'phyo②/ shun pa can/ /rnam 'phyo'i bdag dang / mchog bde dang / /kā ṭa tī ①dang mig mi 'dzum/ /shallī/ chur nyal/ balka bā na/ /za byed zhes pa rnams yin no/ /mche ba stong ldan khri can dang / /kun 'joms bkra ba bī ྾na dag 2 /nya yi rgyal por mtshungs pa'o/ /bha dulo ka dang ro hi ta/7/ikhra sha dang bye ma'i rgyal/ /rga gā skyes dang gseg ma'i bdag /gdengs ka can dang / /chu'i ga pur/ chu yi gdung byed dag tu brjod/ 7 /bi shaḍa dang pags chen no/ 2 /iñdza ka skyes iñdza ka /chu yi sdig pa rnams yin no /lda/⑤dkar po mtshan dang / kyu lā ṭa/ /bye ma'i bu ram zhes pa'o/ 3 /gdengs ka can dang gdengs ka bkra/ 2 /tsasthā skul byed/ gos ngan can/ /kā kā tsi kā/ ka tsi kā/ /ba ka ci: kā dang ni/ /bā kā tsi zhes bya ba'o/ 2 /go cha can dang / sog ge'i rgyab/ 2 /rgyal po'i sgeg pa maṅga ra/ /de yi dga' ma rwa rjocan ma/ /grong ni maṅga ra ldan ma/ /shā la/ sha ku la gaṇḍa/ /sha ku la yi byis pa dang / /ga ḍa ka zhes bya ba'o⑦/7/dug sel ring po baṅgā ṇa/1/char gsum yang pa'i banda ra/ /chu yi dben pa zhes pa rnams/ 3 /rgyal mo 'dra ba rgyal po'i mgrin/ /rgyags chen zhes pa rnams yin no/ 3 /rte dang ni shing 120—1214

tsher can/ 2 /'od can/ 'od ma'i 'dab ma can/ 2 /stobs ldan dang ni zlum po'i nya/ /dro ba'i nya dang / logs rgyas dang / /dkar po'i gzings zhes bya ba'o/ 3 /zla nya ba dang g.yo byed dag 2 /bong bu bde byed/shing steng skyong / /bong bu'i mig dang / gyen 'byung nya/ /gtong byed chen po zhes pa rnams/ 5 /tshangs ma 'dam gyi ga ḍi dag 2 /dbyug nga/'i nga rgyal phye rki dmar byed/ 2 /gaṇḍas 'gro dang / so gal rlung / /glo ba'i sgra can/rlung bug can/ /gos ngan dang ni/ sha za'o/ 6 /mkha' la nyal dang /mkha' nyal spyod/ 2 /kai ka skyob dang sko/ chus gzir ba/ /sa skyes/dbang 'dzin/ nya 'bu dang mo/ /mig lnga pa dang / skra skyed do/ 5 /sgo nga'i nya bran tshogs pa la/ /gru skyed dang ni/ chu'i sgong can/ /'khor lo spyod dang / gru 'dzeen dang / /ma nu'i sbrul dang / sgums nga/ can/ 2 /u khru bī dang / byes can mtshungs/ 8 /'od brtsegs dang ni/ ga hwar dang / /dmar por za dang sha ku ma/ /dga' ba 'khye'/ dang ti mi dang / /ti miṅgi la/rā gu'i bu/ /a gha rnams ni dbye bar 'gyur/ /yā dī sa/ ni chu'i skye bo/ /ming bzang de yi dbye ba ni/ /shaṃ ku sre dang chu srin sogs/ /chu yi gzugs brnyan chu srin dang / /ra'/ gre'i so can ma ro li/ /mtha' dag tshim dang nya 'debs dang / /de dbye chu srin ka ra'o / /chu srin dkar dang phyogs 'dzin dang / /'dzin khri lus kyi rgyud can dang / /chu yi sprin rings na kra'i rgyal/ /chu sgong can dang / chu'i bu za/ /ran kra chu yi zas can dang / /bā tuṇḍa dang / kurtswa ra/ /chu yi phag pa chu mgrin can/ /a pā da dang / nya zas dang / /'bab 'dzin chu yi 'bu zan dang / /chu yi lcer yang lta bar bya/11/go /20—1215

bye kā dbyid dang / ni hā kā/ /dza la/ gra ha/ zhes pa'o/ 3 /hūṃ dang chu yi bye ma dang / chur 'dzul/ /chu la rkyal ba dang / /nya 'dzin chu yi sre me'o/ 6 /byis pa gsod dang / byis pa can/ /ral gri'i mjug ldan pa la'aṅga / /chu yi rus sbal/ chu'i spre'u/ /skad cig dbugs dang / bdag po can/ /ba shā gha zhes pa rnams so/ 9 /rus sbal yan lag lnga pa dang / /ka ma tha dang katstsha ba/ /yan lag lnga sbas ko ḍa'i rkang / 5 /sa srin dang ni/ ghā rgyu rī/ 2 /karka ṭa dang / ku lbo ra/ /kha gyen phyogs dang / 'phrog byed mig/ti pa sha na/ lus sbas dang / /ba ḍi dang ni gya gyur 'gro/ 8 /glang po la sogs / thang la gnas/ /de rnams sngon ni chu las skyes/ /kiñtsa lu ka /sa srin ta la/ /sa yi 'khril shing zhes pa'o/ 3 /shī li dang ni sa srin mo/ 2 /sbal pa mo dang dbyar skyes ma/ 2 /rus sbal mo dang / du li mo/ 2 /maṇḍa ka dang / dardu ra/ /lus bral 'phrog byed/ bhe ka dang / /rma yi gnas dang /char skyes dang / /be ka dga' byed/ shā khru ra/ 'phar bar byed dang 'phar ba dang / /lce rnged dang ni bshang ba sbas/ 13 /chu srin/ chung ngu / ma kṣi kā/ /chu'i bu chu yi ma kṣi kā/ 4 /'gron bu/ pa ṭa/ hi ra ju/ /hi ra ṇa dang / rin thang kun/ /za ma tog can/ rus pa'i zong / /cho lo'i sa bon / zhes pa rnams/ /dung gi khyu dang dung can ma/ 2 /dung phran dung gi srin mo'o/ 2 /dung dang kambu ra/ chu skye/ /chu yi ka ram̐ ka dang ni/ /khab kyi kha zhes bya ba'o/ 5 /mu tig skyes dang 'gas byed dang / /bee shī'i mdzod dang nya phyis dang / /sa ṭā lu ka zhes pa'o/ 5 /ur zhes bya dang mdzod ring mo/ 5 /phu ṭa ṭi ka /'dam nya phyis/ 4 /chu yi nya phyis 'bu skogs dang / /spur ba'i 120—1216

bu dang / shambu ka /dza la ḍidza/ shi bu ka /kambu ra dang / baṇḍa ra/ /'dam gyi sbal pa zhes pa'o/ /srin bu pad pa dza lu ka1 /chu khyim/dza khā yu kā dang / /chu yi snang ba khrag 'thung dang / /chur 'gro/ chu 'thung de bzhin du/ /pe ṇi/ bobye nī dang ni/ /pa ṭa lu ka zhes pa'o/ 10 /chu nyal dang ni/ chu yi gzhi/ /de la gting med chu sgra sgogs/ /lteng ka 'khyel dang / chu skyang skyong / /nye ba'i khron pa chu nyal lo/ 2 /khron chu/ brus chu/ku pa dang / /btung chu/ dus mchog /kha 'chings can/ /gtsug phud can dang chu yi ma/ 8 /rnam 'thor dang ni/ tsū ḍa ka /tsuṇḍi/ 'dzag chu/tsaṇḍa'i 'dab/ /pa ṭa zhes pa rnams yin no/ /a ra ghaṣṭa/ khron pa che/ /rkang pa 'jug pa'i pa ṭa'o/ 3 /tri kā/ khron pa'i mu khyud te/ /bī nā hā ni kha 'chings so/ /gyen 'dren thum pa'i 'khrul 'khor dang / /chu gyen 'bab byed pra hi'o/ 3 /mun nag khron pa chu nyams pa'o/ /mun pa can dang 'bu srin gnas / 3 /rdzing bu dang ni brus chu dang / /mthil can dang ni khron chu can/ /'og gi gnas can zhes pa'o/ 5 /'og dang / tawaṃ/ bawaṃ dang / /tadzee kai zhes pa rnams so/ 2 /kuṇḍa/ lha yi rdzing bu'o/ /ā khā ny-i ni/ lhas bskos 4pa'o/ /rjing bu/ rdzing rings/ logs ngos can/ /mchod sdong can dang / nya sbal can/ 5 /'obs 5dang / yongs su brkos pa'o/ 2 /gzhi can gong 6du chu 'dzin pa'o/ /btsugs shing chus bskor bkrun 7shing dang //phyag dang / rdul skyes/ chu skyes 8dang / /ke dā ro dang / shrī tra ha/ /bya yis bskrun dang / bzhin 9can dang / /gnas can/ shi rtsa chu 'dzin pa'o/11/padma'i 'byung gnas/ mtshe'u 7dang / /chu yi snying po/ bzhad ldan 120—1217

mtsho / 5 /mtsho chung / rdzing mtsho/ lteng ka'o/ 3 /'dam skyes padma chu skyes dang / /mtsho las skyes dang / mtsho la skyes/ /'dab stong / 'dab brgya/ka ma la1/ /'dam la skye 2dang / tā ma'i bcud/ /rtsibs 'bigs dang ni/utpal che/ /dpal kyi 'dab ma/ ambu dza/ /baṃ ke dza dang / dza la dza/ /añdza ni dang / bā re dzi1/ /sa ra dzā dzee/ mtsho las skyes/ /sa ro du hathu/sa ro dzee/ /mi yi 'tsho ba/ dug rab 'joms/ /rgyas byed/ asgo ru na dang //ge sar can dang / sdong bu can/ /kañtsi/ dpal gos/ nā li rka/ 30 /padma dkar po/ chu skyes dkar/ 2 /utpa la dang / ku ba la/ /ku baṃ/ku ba la ya'o/ 4 /shaṃ sasgol/ nags utpa la/ 2 /chu skyes/ sngon po/dbang mchog dang / /'chi med/ dbang mo zhes pa'o/ 3 /utpal dkar po zla ba'i dri/ /ṣpe ra baṃ/ ku mu da/ ku mu ta/ /zla ba dga' dang / zla mdzes dang / /karnyoṣṭa dang / mtshan mo bzhad/ 2 / kṛṇḍi kandi5/ dpal gyi lag /utpal dmar po bung ba dga'/ /dpal mo'i khyim dang / ku muta dang / /ko ka na dang / mtsho skyes dmar/ 8 /ka ta lā ram̐ dang / dri bzang can/2 /thun mtshams ltar dmar ha phru shaṃ/ /dug gi lte ba pad rtsa can/ 4 /sdong bu can ma ni la mbi/ /rgyas ldan ma dang padma can/ /puṭa ki mbi zhes pa'o/ 7 /ku myu da yi nags tshal ni/ /ku mu di byā'o gzhan mtha' yas/ /kundi na la ri nī la sogs/ /sdong bu nā lā nā lo'o/ /padma'i rtsa ba tantu lo/ /pi se dang ni bi ṣaṇḍi/ /pad sogs tshal ni/ ka dadza/ /ka ra hā ṭa/ shi kā/ kanda/3/ze 'bru dang ni ge sar ro/2 /lte ba dang ni/ sa bon mdzod/ /gdugs kyi sa bon sakṣiṃ ram̐/ 4 /sasba rti kā/ 'dab ma gsar/2 /shā lu ni rka/ 'dab 'khrungs ldan/ /ka she ru 720—1218

dang / shā lu'i rgyal/ /'phags pa dge ba zhes kyang ngo / 3 /de nas shriṅga ṭa ka la/ /chu yi tsher ma/ chu'i sgur 1'khyog 2 /prasdi 2bum pa can dang ni/ /chu yi rtsa ba/ chu'i bzhi mdo/ /mkha' yi rtsa ba chu yi 'dab/ /'dab ma chu yi shun pa dang / /'di ni kadhri ṇi du'ang blta/ /dza la sru shaṃ/ sbubs can no/ /she bā lo dang / /chu bal dang / chu yi rngam/ chu'i len bu/ /kā tsā dzā dang / chu'i sngon mo/ /chu yi lus dang / chu yi rtags/ /chu yi skabs dang /chu'i dra ba/ /chu yi 'dab ma zhes rnams so/ 11 /rgya mtsho la sogs pa'i rab tu dbye ba'o/ /sa 'og gi sde sdogs so/ /snyan ngag mkhan po paṇḍi ta dpal ldan dpal 'dzin sdes rnam par bkod pa'i mngon brjod sna tshogs gsal ba zhes bya ba ming gzhan mu tig phreng ba las skabs dang po rdzogs so// //sa gzhi grong dang sa 'dzin nags/ /seng ge mi dang gnyis skyes sogs/ /rgyal rigs dang ni mi zad par/ /'di ni sde tshan drug tu byas/ /sa spyi'i ming drug cu rtsa gnyis/ brtan pa/ 'dzin ma/ nor 'dzin ma/ /dbyig 'dzin/ bha 4rā/ mi g.yo ma/ /sgo ṇi rgya mtsho'i ske rags can/ /i che/ kṣa mā5 dang ni/ hūṃ/ /srung byed/ zhag ldan/ mchod 'os ma/ /mchod sbyin byed ma/ 'gro ldan ma/ /sa gzhi 'dzin ma 'dzin byed ma/ /sna tshogs 'gengs dang / nor ldan ma/ /kṣi te/ kun bzod/ bzod ldan ma/ /mtha' yas bcud ldan/ 'dzin byed ma/ /yangs 5ldan rgya mtsho'i gos can ma//chu skyob sa dang / sa gzhi sku/ /rgyal byed/ 'byung po 'dzin ma dang / /dhī 6dī / chu ldan/ gling 'dzin ma/ /gling ldan ma dang 'od srungs byin/ /bhū 720—1219

mi yangs ldan ma/ udhī/ yangs can ma/ dri ldan ri yi rna can ma/ /rin chen snying mo/ klu yi gzhi/ /ri yi phur bu ma dang ni/ /mdzes chen ma dang /lus ldan ma/ /sna tshogs 'dzin ma/ bzod marte/ goḥ/ thang chen ma dang /baspru grelīmakha' thang / /mi'i gnas/ bar ma'i 'jig rten dang / /sa steng ro dang ro dang sī/ /chu gter mu khyud dri skyed ma/ /sa bon skyed dang / rang skyed ma'o/ 62 /sa bye brag pa/'i ming / sa bzang dang ni yid 'ong ma/ /rab dwangs/ mṛdmā1/mṛtru/ rna dang / /mṛtta/ kā zhes bya ba'o yida'ong/ /sa gshin/ 'bru kun skye ba dang / /ga ṇi/ ā ra putpa'o/ /tshwa sgo/ 'gyur byed/ sa can no/ /tshwa sgo can dang / ba tshwa ldan/ /da sha dang ni/ āo ri ṇi/ 4 /sa bye brag nga/'i ka tsa ga lā/ na liṅgā/ 2 /tha dad skye ba/ rjes su zos/ 2 /sa nag yul ni sa nag can/ /de bzhin sa skya la sogs pa/ /brjod bya'i rtags can gzhan shes bya/ /sgra la dang ni stha lī'o/ /spru 4ṇi la ni/ thang gi mtshams/ /rig pa'i thang mtshams/ bye ma can/ /ma ru dang ni/ /mya ngam thang 2 ma brkos pa dang / ma rmos pa/ 2 /skye 'gro/ 'gro ldan 'jig rten dang / /sa rten dang ni/ gnas rten no/ 5 /'jig rten 'di ni bha ra rta'i ngam ska bas /yul te/ hai ma ba ta'o/ /tha ra ta dang / mi yi sa/ /yi lā/ bṛ tai/tog gi phreng / /'phrog byed/ khyu mchog skyes bu'am ci/ /bzang po dang ni dbyig ring 5bzhin/ /byang gi sgra mi snyan rnams te/ /sa steng gi ni yul rnams dgu / 9 /ku sha /khrung khrung dzamyu shing / /padma/ shaka /shabee ming dang / /gling rnams su 'gyur/ kla klo'i yul/ /bhā ta nga yi mtha' 'khob po/ /120—1220

pra mā ga dang / sgra ngan zhing / /gangs ri dang ni/ 'bigs byed par/ /'phags 'khrungs/ bsod nams sa gzhi dang / /yul dbus dang ni dbus yin no/ /de nas 'dir ni ā dhwa ri/ /'bi dir ya ni 'ga' zhig 'dod/ /'beegs byed gangs ri dag dbus su/ /shar dang nub kyi chu gter ro/ /sha rā ba ti'i mtshams gang der/ /'phags pa'i yul la sogs pa rnams/ /yul ni shar dang / lho dang nub/ /byang dang / nub byang rnams yin no/ /lha yi chu bo'i bar gang yin/ /dbyangs can dṛ sa tha tī dag /de nyid sprul pa'i yul yin no/ /tshangs 'khrungs de dag pa ṭa'o/ /shaṃ gā ya mu nā dag gi/ /bar bar bzhi ni ri bong thang / /pra hā sa dang / zla ba'i 'gro1/ /batpa'i tshong rdal2/ kau shāsdi/ /goḍa'i mda' ris suṇḍa yin/ /puṇḍas mtshan pa ba rant+ra / /ka n+ya/ mchog sad ma/ kurja/ ghā dhī'i grong / /bu mo sgur 'khyog /ku sha'i thang / /char chen zhes pa rnams su 'gyur/ 5 /dzi sta ri dang nye ba'i thang / /'khor mo 4'jig dang zhi ba'i grong 5/ /gsal ldan 'gram dang rgyal po can/ 4 /rang byung skyes dang yul 'khor che/ /yul byi gnas zhes bya ba'o / 3 /me tog dang mogrong khyer dang / /skya snar 6bu zhes bya ba'o/ /gnas bcas dang ni ko sha lā/ /'thab med/ dga' mchog /mdzod 'dzin no/5/go 7ta ma zangs g.yog pa/'i / stobs kyi rigs/ /zangs byugs/ ta mā li kā dang / /dul ba byugs dang / 'phrog byed khyim/ /'khor lo gcig pa/gnod mdzes grong / 1 /glang po can dang / lag ldan can/ /glang pos mtshan dang / lag ldan grong / /glang po'i yan lag ces pa'o/ 5 /nags tshal bre bo/ rgyal byed grong / 2 /nags tshal dang ni/ khaṇḍa baṃ/ /ma ga dha 120—1221

—dang / ka ṭa dag 2 /brta ni dang shar gyi yul/ /bi ra dzā dang sdug bsngal —(brang / 'od ldan no/ 2 /yangs pa can dang / 'phags rgyal dang / /srung byed me tog ze'u can/ 4 /de yi skyed mos tshal gang yin/ /de ni me tog za ma tog /lha mo mkhar dang mda' yi grong / /ko ṭa'i yul dang / dka' bzlog nags/ /dmar po'i grong yang de nyid do/ 5 /grong khyer/ tsasthā/ phreng ba can/ 3 /sgo ldan/ nor can/ grong khyer dang / sgo can tshal dang /phreng ba can/ 4 /ga yā/ ga'i rgyal po can/ /tī ra/ bhu tta/ litstsha bī1/ 2 /lus 'phags grong khyer/ lus 'phags dang / /ka mi thi la zhes bya ba'o/ 3 /rnam par zhi byed/ sgra ngan zhing / 2 /mnyan yod/ chos kyi tshong rdal 4lo/ /grong gsum dang ni grong khyer ro/ 2 /'bu len dang ni/ 'bu yi grong / 2 /ma thu rā dang / sbrang can dang / /sbrang rtsi nye bar 'joms zhes so/ 3 /ku kusgo na/de yi grong / /legs mthong can dang / ku sha'i 5 thang /2 /skye dgu'i bdag skyes / pra yā ga 2 /gī ra dang ni/ dngha ka'o/ 2 /mtshon cha bzo grong bā tī kā / /dang gsum tri ga ri 7kā/ kasmre ra/ 2 /kā ma rū pa'i yul la ni/ /pāñdza to ṣā/ sthāñdza ྾ kā/ 2 /baṅgā/ seng be gtsan pa can haṃ ri ka la ya/ 2 /ma tā gi shwe/utpa la/ 2 /sha ka 9ma tra/ tu ru kṣa/ /ma kha dang ni nye ba'i nags/ 3 /da shes ra dang / kā mā ru skyes/ 2 /phreng ba can dang / srung byed do/ 2 /tī ra bhu tta/ lus 'phags dang / /litstsha bī yul shes par bya/ 3 /ḍa hā la dang / rta la brtse/ /mchod rten can zhes bya ba'o༄ / /kā ru ṣa dang / khyim chen po/ 2 /ya da bstu/ darsha rta/ /shā ⑩ ta dang / ku ku ra phyiyul/ /ku ru pa dang bha bye'i yul/ /skye bo dang ni/ pākhyo'o/ 2 /me ldan dang ni/ hā byā kka/ /120—1222

a ba dhwa ra/ kasbo dza/ /dzā larnya ra/ tī garta/ 2 /aṅga/ tsasbra nye mtshan nyid| 2 /mnga' ris dang ni/ yul ljongs so/ /rgyal khams yul dang /nye bar gnas/ 2 /gatstsha/ mi dang skye bo mang / 2 /'dam bu can dang 'dam bu mang / 2 /ku mud can dang / ku mud mang / 2 /sba yi tshal dang / ya mang can/ 2 /'dam rdzab can dang / 'dam can no/ 2 /ṣpe'u gsing can dang / rtswa ljang can/ 2 /gyo dum gseg ma can rmi yul/ /gseg mar bcas dang / gseg ma ldan/ /de bzhin bye ma ldan pa'o/ /yul gang char chus 'bru skyong ba/ /lha yi ma can zhes pa'o/ /chu klung chu yis 'bru skyong ma/ /de ni chu klung ma can no/ /rgyal po bzang dang / rgyal ldan yul/ /rgyal po med dang / rgyal ngan can/ ba lang / mang ba/ ba lang gnas/ /ba lang sngon bsdad/ ba lang lhas/2 /gral dang / kun spyod/ tshul dang ni/ /bsod snyoms len dang rgyun dang 'dzin/ 6 /grog ①tshang dang ni/ grog ②mkhar dang / /brgya byin skye ba⑦/ bsdi brtsegs/ /bā ma lca ra/ 'bu yi brag6 /sa yi khor yug 'khor ba'o/ 2 /lam dang /lam gyi ming bco brgyad/ rjes ldan rgyu sa dang / /'jug bya gcig rjes bgom ④bya dang / /bgrod bya 'gro sa rkang ldan dang / 2 /brta⑤/ ba dzwa/ rdul can dang / /pand+ra/ bā ṭa/ sa tha/ ba ha/ /a dhra/ mā ṭha/ khu lu ma'o/18/dam pa'i lam dang / mchod bya'i lam/ /lam po che dang / lam bzang dang / /dpal gyi lam dang / rgyal po'i lam/ 6 /lam bral/lam ngan/ 'jigs bcas lam/ /ka da dma dang / ka pa tha/ 5 /shri ga ṭa ka/dbyibs dang ni/ /lam 'dres dang ni/ bzhi dumado'o/ 9 /bar stong ring 120—1223

/depo / lam stong dang / /dgon pa dang ni/ bgrod dka'i lam/ /lam med pa dang a pa dzee/ /na lta/ khru ni 1bzhi brgya'o/ /beegs khrog lam dang /ā lasgyu sa/ /rim pas bgrod dka'/ kun rgyu ba/ /ba lang shing rta rgyang grags zung / /dpag tshad lam dang dha nu shaṃ/ /rgyal po'i lam dang kun 'gro ba / /de ni grong gi nye 'khor la/ /zhes pa'i sde sdogs so// //grong dang skyong byed grong khyer dang / /tshong rdal tshong srang gnas dang ljongs / /smad gnas/ mtshams gnas/ karba ṭi/ 10 /ā ram̐ ga dang /a tri ba/ /ram̐ ba/ pra ti/ rtswand+ra 4shaṃ/ 8 /grong gi rtsa ba'i grong las ni/ /kyis pa grong khyer nye ba'i grong / /de la rgyun 'bab/ grong chung dang / /urba sa su ram̐ zhes so/ 3 /'phrog byed zla grong bzang po'i grong / /dri za'i grong khyer zhes pa'o/ 3 /'dul gnas/ chos kyi phur bu'o/ 2 / mu dāḥṭī 6 dang /dmangs 'gul 7gnas/ /sa brkos/ spyod pa'i phur bu'o/ 2 /sertse ram̐ dang /dmar po 'chos/ /pa ṭo li kā/ sbas phur bu/ /'ga' zhig phyag dar/rdul la yang / /grong ni bzang po bdun brgya yi/ /dbus kyi gnas ni kaza ṭi/ /gal te de grong bzhi brgya'i dbus/ /de tshe dro ṇa mu khaṃ'o/ /kun nas 'dam pa'i tshong 'dus dang / /khyem dang / dbang po'i tshong 'dus dang / /grong gi 'gram zhes bya ba'o/ 4 /tshong lam/ zong 'tshong ra ba dang / /srang lam/tshong 'dus/ kun 'jug dang / /terta zong dang / a dzi ra/ /thob pa'i sgo dang / skyed dang ni/ /tshong lam/ dbyangs chen/ brje dang 'tshong / /ka tsam ga lam/ nirmu ṭa/ /mig mangs yang dag tshogs pa'o/ 3 /byis khyem/120—1224

khyem gyi sa dang gzhi/ 3 /'jug dang / 'jug bya/ skye bo'i gnas/ /rab bsngags gnas dang sa gzhi ma/ /rab tu dga' dang / dga' byed do/ /gri 1ha / kṛ haṃ/ bee sha dang / /beesmra dang ni gnas pa yin/ /go haṃ kun dga'i gnas dang ni/ /gnas khang / phibs 'og 'dun gnas dang / /mtshan mo'i nang gnas sgrib g.yogs 2dang / /khyim dang bya ba'i gnas kyang ngo //nges gnas/ gnas dang / kun tu gnas/ /skyabs 'og dang ni/ khang khyim dang / /khang chung / spyil po/ 'dun 4sa dang / /lo khā/ ka kṣu 'jug gnas so/ 27 /ra ba bzhi pa/ kun 'jug go/ 2 /kun gnas khyem dang / bshes gnyen can/ 2 /khang bzangs ra bas yongs bskor dang / /zla ba'i ra 5ba/ spyi bo'i khyem/ /khang brtsegs dang ni/ ba ḍa bhe6/ 6 /da bye 7ṭā dang / nges byas khyem/ /thub rnams lo ma'i spyil po dang / /mchod spyil po zhes bya ba'o/ /bzo bo rwadang ni kun 'jug gnas/ 2 /rta yi ra ba/rta yi khang / 2 /'dab chags ra ba/ bya ldan no/ 2 /chu khang btung ba'i ra ba'o / /rgya mtsho'i khyim dang rlung yong can/ /chu yi 'khrul 'khor gnas yin no / /ba si ta pa yi las dang / /a ba sa byā/ sbra yi khyem/ /til mar ra ba 'khrul 'khor khyim/ /dud khang a land+ra kā'o/ /btson ra dang ni 'ching ba'i khyem / /gsod ḍapa'i myu gu bya ba'i spyor/ /dka' tshegs gnas dang byed pa can / 6 /tshang ma'i khyem dang gasgo'o/ /grwa pa'i khang pa la sogs la/ /gabye dang ni/ ma ṭha'o/ /so so'i gnas ni de'i ra ba/ /thub pa rnams kyi gnas dang rten/ /grags pa'i phung po lha yi gnas/ mchod rten dang ni/ /mchod sbyin gnas/ 2 /snying po'i khang pa/ kun spyod do/ /'dun rkakhang dang ni skye 120—1225

bo'i gnas/ /sa gzhi dkor mdzes 'dun 7snakhang mchog /snying po'i khang pa/gnas khang 2dang / /longs skyod 1gnas su de brjod do/ /mtshan dang mtshan kyi bar dang ni/ /mdzod rab dang ni 'dun 4khang ngo / 2 /bang mdzod dang ni mdzod yin no/ /a riṣṭas ni bu btsas khyem/ /rtswa spyil dang ni/ lus tshad can/ /rna ba'i rgyud dang mañtsa kaḥ/ /rtswa yi khang bzangs ma ka ṭa/ /mun khang / 1 mañtsa/ ku tram̐ sha /bsil khang la sogs nor ldan gnas/ /khang bzangs lha dang sa bdag khyem/ /gtsang gnas dang ni rgyal po'i khang / /'du khang rgyal po'i pho brang dang / /bde legs can dang kun nas bzang / /mdog mdzes dang ni 'phel ba can/ /dga' ba 'khyel pa la sogs dang / /gzhan yang sgo sgrigs sogs kyis phye/ /khyad par bkod pa 'od rnams spel/ /dbang phyug ldan pa'i pho brang gi/ /khyad par gzhan yang sbyin sogs 'gyur/ /btsun mo'i khang pa sa spyod ma'i/ /nang dang pho brang srungs ma can/ /dag pa'i mtha' can kun nas 'gogs/ 4 /yang tog dang ni/ khang bzang ste/ /ya phubs dang rgo dgra khang ngo / /dbang po'i sgra dang / saṃ ga ka /manda ni nī ba lang ra/ /glang po mchog gi ra ba la/ /ku tram̐ ga dang / uste ṭa/ /si ṭha rā zhes bya ba'o/ /sadri/ ka tyā ṭa niḥku ṭī/ /grong rnams bar gyi lam po che/ /rātstsha zhes sad tshong khang dang / /zong gi saganas kyang de nyid do/ /lcogs chung tsa ya ba pri'o/ 2 /lcags ri skyibs 6dang / bgrod dka' dang / /mda' yi ra ba 'di'i rtsa chings ra ba/ 'obs 7rings/ mtha' mu khyud/ /gtam gyi lam zhes bya ba'o sgo/ 6 /khor yug /bskor ༄/ ba grong sogs mtha'/ /'od ma spa sogs las byas dkres/ /skyobs dang / mtha' bskor/ brtsigs 120—1226

pa brtsegs/ /e ḍū shaṃ zhes bya ba'o/ /de nang rus pa so btsugs pa/ /rtsig pa bhetrī/ ku bye'o/ /lus can khyem dang kun 'dzin no/ /sgo drung / sgo 'dun / sgo rtsa ni/ /phyi rol sgo yi khyams 1yin no/ /srang lam dang ni khyem gye 'gram/ 5 /g.yogs dang / khebs dang / bkab tsā la/ 4 /ku ṭī la dang / dī gra dang / /bkab dang / rab mtha' phreng ba can/ /tā ko/gral bcu/ rab rings dang / /sprin ldan/ a pa hā li kā/ 7 /sgo glegs/ka ba/ ka bā ṭa/ /a ra ra dang niblu ṭa/ /rwa ra kaṣṭa ka zhes so/ /sgo yi dbyug gu yongs 'joms dang / /sa ro dang / swarga/ shā zhes so/ 4 /sgo dang /srung byed/ sgo mo'o/ 3 /stegs 2bu dang ni kha khyer dang / /tsa tuḥki kā/lus ldan gnas/ 4 /rta babs dang ni/ phyi yi sgo/ /grong khyer sgo dang sgo mo che/ /mda' yab yongs brtsegs/ glang po'i sen/ /logs can/ /phyogs sgo/nyin mo'i sgo/ /am tī 4zhes bya ba'o/ 4 /rab tu bkab dang / mi snang byed / 2 /yan lag bzhi ldan brtan pa dang / /shing 'og rdo yi 5ya zem dang //re bzhi de yi steng du gnas/ /gong ma'i yan lag de yi 'gram/ /sgo yi steng gi shing gang yin/ /gdung sgur shing khyim thog shing rgyu/ /phug ron skyong dang bya skyibs can/ /krā ma shī rā spre'u'i mgo/ /zhwa yi rtse mo can zhes so/ 3 /sa bcings pa dang zhal zhal lo/ /yol bas bkab dang gos kyis 6bcil ma ta ti dang / 1 ba ta shaṃ/ /sa gzhi kha dog can zhes so/ /rlung gseng skar khung / khra ma can/ /nye ba'i mgrin ldan grong mtha' dang / /nye ba'i shaṃ lya zhes bya ba'o/ /grong dang grong bar 'dug gnas so/ /rtswa phreng / rtswa yi su li kā/ /'dzeg skas dang ni them/ skas dang / 2 /skas ka dang ni steng du 'dzeg 2/phyag 120—1227

dar / spyod pa byi dor dang / /gtsang bar byed pa zhes bya'o/gabyi dor byas dang /sbyangs pa dang / /phyag dang / phyi rol/ bya ba pa'o/ 4 /sgo dang nges par 'byung ba'o/ /nges par 'jug dang / des 'gugs so/ 2 /mtshams dang /so mtshams/ khyems dang / tshod/ /chu tshod dang ni/ a ba bye/ 6 /'brog khyem dang ni/ rtswa yi khyim/ 2 /'tsho byed gnas dang / rngon pa'i khyim/ /grong gi sde rdzogs so// //ri bo'i ming so gcig /mi g.yo/ ri bo/ rdo brtsegs dang / /tshigs can gyen 'phyur 'dzin byed dang / /sa 'dzin/ ma tī dha ra dang / /'gro med/mi 'gro/ ka ṭa tī/ /yangs ldan/ rtse can/ sha ṣa ra/ /rgyun ldan/khams 'dzin/ mi 'phrog pa/ /ri ljongs dang ldan/ sa gzhi 'dzin/ /rlan 'dzin/ sprin gyi so can dang / /sa skyob/ chu skyob/ sa'i phur bu/ /mgrin pa can dang / brtan pa dang / /cha shas che brtsegs/ kuṣṭi rā/ /sprin 'dzin/ 'byung gnas kaster/ 31 /ki lā pa dang rolaganas/ nor sbyin gnas / /nor sbyin ri bo/ tshogs kyi ri/ /dngul gye lcog can/ dngul rab gnas/ 6 /de nas ri bdag /gangs ri dang / /kha ba rab gnas/me nā'i bdag /dka' bzlog /bla ma zhes bya'o/ 2 /dbyig gi lte ba/me nā ka /lte ba bzang dang gangs ri'i bu/3/mtha' ri/ sa 'dzin phyi ma dang / /nub pa'i ri dang / lha'i ri bo/ 4 /shar ra 1nyin mo'i rtse mo dang / /mdun 1ri shar gyi g.yo med gnas/ /mkha' 'gro'i gdan zhes bya ba'o/ /'bigs byed dang ni/ me ka la/ /chu bo/ narma dā 'bab pa'o/ 3 /dal 'bab ri 120—1228

dang / dbang bo'i phur/ 3 /ri bo khrung khrung kauñtsa dang / /phreng ba can zhes bya ba'o/ 3 /bde ldan/ mid pa/ rab 'bab ri/ 2 /ri bo rtse gsum/ngos gsum pa/ /'jig rten snang dang / 'khor yug ri/ 2 /ma la ya dang tsandan ri/ /ri bo ā ṣā dha zhes so/ 2 /de nas ni ṣa dha dang ni/ /darda ra dang yongs 'du can/ /spos ngad ldan dang gzhan yang ni/ /sna tshogs brtsegs pa la sogs ri/ /gangs ri dang ni kha ba brtsegs/ /rna can/ rwa can / lha'i ri bo/ /sna tshogs can dang ni ṣa dha/ /bdun po 'di dag drang srong ri / /1rdo ba sbed — byed/ gor ma dang / /tsog po/ ju po/ stun dang rdo/ /gzhan 'joms/ pā ra/ ṭi ṭa dang / /sra ba/ sa 'joms shing 'joms so/ 12 /khab len/ rab 'byed/ 'o byed dang / /'khor bar byed la sogs pa'o/ /rwa dang / rtse mo1/ bya skyibs dang / /so dang brtsegs pa zhes bya'o/ 5 /rdo ba'i bu dang / ri'i rus sbal/ /ghargha nā la khyem gyi rdo/ 4 /btsag dang / rdo dmar/ dmar po'i khams/ /ri skyes nags kyi rgya skyegs dang / /me tog sa rul ri yi gsang / /nga mkhregs pa/ kha ṭī/warna 4dang / /re khā 5dang ni rdo dkar dang / /rdo ba'i khams dang sa dkar dang / /shi lā dhwa tu pra wa'o/ 8 /khams ni spyong ros mu zi dang / /ba bla dang ni cong 6zi btsag 5 /gzhan yang thun mong khyad par ba/ /ri las skyes pa rnams yin no/ /ri bo dang ni ri yi smad/ /ri yi 'gram dang / a dzi ram̐/ 4/ri ljongs/ bang rim steng snying po/ 4 /mtha' 'khob ri dang / ri'i rkang pa / 2 /g.yang sa/ ltung gnas/ ri gzar ngos/ /ri ngos khron pa/ ri steng chu/ /yang dag 'bab dang / ltung byed pa'o/ /chu ldan/ rab 'dzag/720—/229

chu 'bab dang / /chu rgyun lhung lhung sgra sgogs pa'o/ /lhas bskos khung dang /bu ga dang / /tshang tshing phug dang / ko ṭa ram̐/ 4 /ri sul dang ni/ ngam grog go/ /sa brkos pa dang 'byung khungs sa/ /ri btsan ni 'og sa gzhi dang //ri steng dang ni sa gzhi mtho/ /lto ba brtol dang brag brtol ba/ /shwa dang ri yi bud ces bya/ /nags tshal dang ni sman ljongs dang / /'gram shing sogs kyis ①lto ba bkag /zhes pa ri dzeeyi sde rdzogs so// //'brog dang dgon pa stong pa dang / /tshal dang tshang tshing nags tshal dang //jo ṭa/ dā pa da pa dang / /shing ldan/ phugs can/ ni sta li/ /ta lo pākṣarka/ 'brog dgon pa/ /mi med/ gzhi can/ dud 'gro can/ /skrag gnas zhes pa rnams yin no/ 17 /dgon pa chen po nags stug ①po/ /nges 'gro khyim gyi kun dga' ra/ /bcos ma'i tshal dang nye ba'i tshal/ /nags kyi kun dga' ra ba'o/ 2 /dpal gyi kun ra/ bsod nams 'bras/ 2 /'dod pa'i dgon sa/ btung mchog tshal/ 4 /smad 'tshong ma dang slob dpon gyi/ /khyim gyi kun dga' ra ba ni/ /pa ṭa'i shing ldan/ tsu ta'i rjoshing / /skyes bu rtse sa skyed mos tshal/ /thun mong rgyal po'i nags kyi tshal/ /rab dga'i tshal dang rab myos can/ /btsun mo rnams kyi skyed mos tshal/ /nags ldan dang ni nags tshogs can/ /de nyid rol pa'i skyed mos tshal/ /dus kyi nags dang rgya mtsho'i tshal/ /'gram gnas de yi 'gram dang di/ /chu klung 'gram gnas dgon pa ni/ /phra mo'i kun ra rab dang can/ /lha khang gnas kyi skyed mos tshal /rol mo can dang mang tshor can/ /gral dang phreng ba bkod pa dang / /ā li 120—1230

bsgrigs dang / dngar ba dang / /mtshar dang / yā le/ 'khrigs chags so / 7 /phreng bkod/ gral rim/ mngon 'thug byas/ /shing gi ming nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ sa skyes shing dang / nags kyi bdag /steng skyes pa dang / rtse mo can/ /yal ga can dang / 'khor lo can/ /sdong po/kun 'gro 'gro med dang / /na ga 'gro med ku dzaskye med a gatstsha mi 'gro/ /mi g.yo ka pa/brtan pa dang / /skyed —1byed/ sa ldan/ rkang 'thung dang / /rlan skyes/'dam ldan/ mgo ling can/ /phung po can dang / 'dab ma yangs / /rnam rgyas 'dab can yal ga 'dzin/ /yal gas lhag dang / lus rnams rgyas/ /kā ra yī zhes bya ba'o/ 28 /me tog 'dod 'jo la sa shing sa nag dang rki/ u dusru ra dang /bla kṣa la sogs/ 'bras med nags tshal bdag /de nyid ni mudngha 5zhes bya/ /me tog khardzu ra re 'brag bo dang / a mra dang / a la khre la sogs pa/ 'bras ldan tshal dag skyes/ /rkang 'thung mchod rten du brtan no/ /shing gi grib ma bstan pa'i grag /yal ga rtsa thung kṣu pa'o/ /lha yi bdud rtsi las byung shing / /kā ri ba 6dang bhañdza ru/2/'bras bu 'dzin pa mo gsham min/ /'bras ldan 'bras can 'bras bu can/ /rab shar nyer byed yang dag rgyas/ /sbubs grol ba dang rgyas pa dang / /rgya grol/nges byed/ go cha grol/ /rgyas/ 'dzum/ bya dang / gsal ba dang / /mi 'dzum pa dang shin tu rgyas/ /rnam dbye rnam gsal/ shin tu phye/ /rnam phye / gnyid bral 7shin tu mdzes/ /skyes dang / byung dang / rnam rgyas pa'o / 13 /mo gsham/ 'bras med/ sgra can no/ 3 /mo gsham min pa la sogs gsum/ /brtan pa nges pa/ shaṃ ku'o/ 3 /myu gu/ mngon 'khrungs/gsar du skyes/ 2 /sman dag gis ni rigs tsam la/ /a dza ta dang skyed med/720—1231

kun la sman/ /sman ni 'bras bu smin mtha' dang / /'khri shing / gu ga /lcang ma dang / /lcug ma dang ni tshang tshing ngo / /u pa sañtsa rtse bar bsdud pa/ sdong po dang / /mgo ling gnas dang gel pa can/ /rtsa ba yal ga'i bar gyi shing / /sdong rkang dang ni phung po'o/ 2 /yal ga rgyan dang 'khri shing ngo / /phung po'i yal ga mtho ba'o/ 2 /rtsa ba dang ni ral pa'o/ 2 /yal ga'i ral pa/ kun nas skyes/ /rtsa nas rtse mor 'khri shing son/ /shing la sogs pa btsugs pa dang / /bstod pa bsgrang dang / blang ba'o/ /mgo dang / rtse mo/ co to'o/ /rtsa ba/ smad dang / rkang ba'i ming / /gong hūṃbu dang ni/ snye ma'o/ /de nyid mañdzi ballī snyem/bong kṣebu dang / gurje1/ /'di rnams mtshungs/ /sbal mig thon dang dzā lo kā/ /ko mā ri ku/ dzā la kā/ 4 /gzhon nu gsar bu tshigs kais zab/ 3 /kha bye ba dang / gyes pa dang / /gutstsha/ kṣe pa/ gu lutstsha/ /ā listhā zhes bya ba'o/ 6 /bu tshab pa dang / mu ku la/ /me tog rab skyes skyes pa dang / /su ma na sa yidadaga'/ yid 'ong dang / /ku su ma me togazhes bya ba'o/ 6 /me tog rdul dang / yid 'ong rdul/ /me tog rtsi dang /me tog ro/ /lo ma rnyings pa/ sa ba ka/ /'dab ma lo ma/ sgrib byed dang //da li 'dab ma/ parno thing lo 4tstsha lo 'dabada'o/ /sdong po'i san 5ma brjañtsa/ /mgrin pa can dang / urki la/ /ka da ra dang / shu ni 6dang / /'dab ma'i rtse dang /dkar po'i rtse/ /sdong po can zhes bya ba'o/ /mgo ling / yal tshogs ke sha lo / /rtsar skyes sdong po lhag pa dang / /shing gi bcud dang yangs pa dang / /shing gi brtul zhugs shes pa'o/ /lcug ma dang ni 'khri shing dang / /sdong po'i 'khri shing yā ba ka /'dab ma'i lang tsho shing gi brtul/ /'dag khu/720—1232

rdul dang tsarba ṭa/ /byu ru shing dang / lcug ma gsar/ /ma smin 'bras bu shi la che/ /skam po rā na zhes pa'o/ /shing shun/ tso tsam/ shal rka dang / /skogs pa'am shun pa shing lngags dang ni bal ka lam/ 5 /snying po dang ni rkang mar mtshungs| 2 /rgyal chen dang ni mgo ling ngo / /khong stong dang ni nang can no//phra mo'i shing dang ki li—/ /me shing / shing bu/ bud shing dang / /yam shing /hom shing / 'tshod ①byed shing / /sbyin sreg shing zhes bya ba'o/ /shing 'khri shing sogs skyes pa yi/ /lo tog dang ni 'bras bu'o/ /mdud pa/ tshigs pa/pa ru ṣi/ 3 /thang chu 'ching ba/ binta'o②/ 2 /sman shing ⑦'bras bu 'byung ba kun| /a ru ra la sogs pa'o/ /a shwa tha skyes bi nu skyes/ /n+ya gro dha skyes aṅga de'i/ /'bras dang / pri rjoha tī skyes 'bras/ /dzaswā/ /dzasbru las skyes pa| /dzasba skyes dang / dzamyu ⑤skyes/ /bi dā ri ldan rtsa ba ma rang gi rtags can 'bru dang 'bras/ /me tog mkhri kā dang ni/ /dzā ti na ba mā li kā/ /ke ta tī dang gzhan yang ni/ /me tog skya snar rjol sogs so/ /byang chub shing gi ming / byang chub shing dang 'dab bskyod dang / /pibee la byang chub shingadang glang po'i bras/ /pā da ri ga a shwadma ⑦khyad par gnas sam tra gnas/ /kasi za'i ming / kapā spe'u gnas te na 'dab dzeem snum/ /ke sha bā la blakṣa rab 'gyur dang / /byang chub dang ni mchod rten shing / 12 /pi ⑨'bras gnod sbyin kha sbyor ro/ 1 /blakṣa ni baṭwā ⑩ṭī/ 3 /a za'i ming / a ma ⑫tsur/ bcud 'dzin dang / /mā ganda dang rkang drug tshos| /sbrang rtsi'i pho nya dpyid kyi shing / /bud med dga' dang / ge sar 'thab| /pi ka'i gnyen dang / rtsa lag 'dzin/ /120—1233

sam byed par ba'i ming /'di ni sa hā ka ra lhanacig byed dang / /shin tu bcud bzang zhes pa'o/ /a mra'i 'bras dang / 'bras bu mngar/ 2 /ki ka shi dang / ka ba tī| 2 /sa na se dang / tsher can 'bras/ /tsaspyo kā lu/ gtsug phud ldan/ /mu ra dza 'bras zhes pa'o/ 5 /de yi sbubs la sa na sa'i/ /tā le kā zhes bya ba'o/ /ba ku la dang / shrī ①dhu dang / /dri ldan ge sar can zhes pa'o/ 4 /mya ngan med kyi ming / mya ngan med dang / paspru la/ /chu la gar rtse/ rkang mdzes dang / /dga' ba sbyin zhes bya ba'o/ 5 /skya nar gyi ming / skya nar can shing don yod dang / /chu ldan gnas pa pā ṭa la/ /me tog rtsa nag lus ngan mig /kā tsi thangagikro/ sbra shā/ 'bras bu skyes/ /'dod pa'i pho nya mdzod tha ma/ /zangs kyi me tog can ma'o/ 12 /ṭwā ga ge sar gyi ming / tsam pa skyes dang ge sar can/ /nā ga ge sar rkang drug dga'| /nā ga putpa zhes kyang bya/ /'di ni gser gyi me tog can/ /putpa ro na/ gser 'dra dang / klu yi ming can zhes pa'o/ 9 /spung pa'i ming / ha ri dra ba 'di'i phye ma/ /de bzhin ka di ku sumbha le brgan2/tsam pa ka'i ming / tsam pa ka dang / bsod nams bsung / /me tog rgyal dang tsam pa skyes/ /mchog thob gser gyi me tog can/ 6 /'di yi 'bras bu ka li kā/ /dri yi 'bras bu zhes par 'gyur/ /se 'bru'i ming / se 'bru shing dang / me tog go/ /dī sbra dang se 'bru/ ka ra rka/ /'bras bu bya ba/ sartse bee/ /ṣpe co'i lcug ma tshigs chen skyes/ /rab skyes dang ni gong bu can/ 10 /'o ma can dang rgyal po'i zas/ /'bras bu'i bdag po zhes bya ba'o/ /klu shing skyes bu mtho ba dang / /ge sar can dang /120—1234

lha'i lcug ma/ /seng ge sgod dang / klu'i me tog /kiñdzi ra dang / ge sar dmar/ /bum can lha yi 'dab ma can/ 11 /ke ta ka dang / sogs le sgrib①| /tshad ldan 'dab ma me tog rtse/ /rtsa ba mang dang / dzambu 'dzin/ /sa srung skyes dang / klu yi tshon/ /shun pa dri zhim 'bab chu gnas/ /kidhī ra dang / chu bo skyes/ /sa yi dzasru ka rnams so/ /chu la rol dang / gzhol ba dang / /mdog mjes ma du laṅka ②la/ /myur ji chen po ming / skyur rtsi chen po so rtsed dang / /skyur mo/ skuramo/ dzaspur/myur mo/ dzambha la/ /legs 'dzin/ rab gnas me tog dang / /snying rje dang ni so dga' byed/ /rnam par mjes zhes bya ba'o/ 10 /rgyal po'i 'o ma/ spre'u yi sprang / /las kyi tshon dang / las kyi cha/ 2 /rab mchod dang ni ma la rka/ /btung ba nas kyi btung ba dang / /ma la ki zhes bya ba'o/ /da ram̐/ rakṇi ba da rā/ /mal rka zhes pa la yang de'o/ 4 /chus gang ba dang / sa bon gang / /de nyid skyur ba'i ge sar can/ 3 /mā ru lum gī/ rul 'bras ma/ /lha ldan ma dang dri bzang can/ 4 /la ku tsa dang ni ku la/ /shing skyur dang ni shing bran dang / /phra ba'i sa na sa zhes so/ 5 /me ldan ma dang / /tirnyi dri/ /tsiñtsa/tirnyi ri yi shing / /tsu krā/ sprin gyi rwa can dang / /shing skyur yal ga skyur ba dang / /sa skyes skyur dang / shā kābee/ /tirnyi lī dang / dmar pos gang /tirnyi ṭī ka /star bu shing / 3 /de nas bya rgod sen mo dang / /ko ni/ rgya shug karkaza/ /bee ci la 'dog 'bras zhim dang / /'bras ldum can zhes bya ba'o/ /ko la/ shin tu dpa' skyes dang / /rgya shug sgoṇḍa/ sa stobs dang / /sa la nges gnas zhes pa'o/ 4 /'bras bu nag min/ bi gu 'bras/ /sde bzang 120—1235

dang ni lag 'joms so 4 /bam pa'i ming / bil ba dpal gyi 'bras bu dang / /drang srong gi dbye bas shāṇḍi phya dang / mā phru ra/ /ha rī rta tī/ ka pi ta tsha/ /she phru ṣa dang rab mchod mig /mā kand+ra dang / ma la rmā/ 10 /'di mi sdong bu/ /gnya' shing gi ming / lo ga lī/ /nā li ke ra/ tsug ldan dang / /bu ga byed dang / chu ldan mgo/ /'bras ldan mgo rgyan/ bu haṃ ka① /bā na'i chu dang /'bras rtag dang / /me tog rtags dang 'bras bu'i phung / /sbyang ba'i piṣka/me tog sgom/ /ha ṭā'i 'bras can/ sa 'tsho'i 'dab/ /tā la'i rgyal dang bcud skye'o/ 18 /gu bā ka dang / mkha' 'gro skedang / /ghorte sdug /kra mgo lag 'joms/ /snying po tsher ma can/sko /snying po can dang / snyo ta'o/9/so rtsi dang ni dpal mo'i bdag /shaṃ gā'i rtsibs ldan zhes pa'o/ 2 /gyen shugs 'bras can smin pa 'dzin/ /'jam pa'i 'bras bu ldan pa'o/ /dga' byed sru ga 'dod pa can/ /thub pa'i su ga lha shing dang sne/ 4 /rtsas ④rgyas/pa ya stu la dang / /ta la mi bdag su/ lta ga /'bra go mdud pa mthug pa dang / /sbrang gi 'o ma mkhrigs 'byung dang / /bung ba rtsub dang bcud skye dang / /myang bya dang ni shing thog mngar/ 8 /'bra go'i shing gi pung ⑤po la/ /sa skyong dang ni dzamyu ④skyes/ / thra yadku ⑦dang 'bras ldan ma/ /sngo bsangs can dang /kā ri bhasde/ /bud med ming can sna tshogs sde/ /dri yi 'bras can/ kund+ra dang / /so la phyag 'tshal 'bras bu can/ /'khri shing mchog ldan dkar mo dang / /dga' byed 'byung po'i me tog can/ 11 /pha rol can dang / mjos ldan dang / /mu tig 'bras dang / 'bras bu can/ /klu yi mdog ma/ so rtsi dang / /so 120—1236

rtsi'i lcug ma zhes pa'o/ 3 /rgun 'brum gyi ming / rgan 'bru shing dang ro mngar dang / /ro zhim/ 'jam ldan pa'i nu ma/ 5 /do shal byed dang / rab dgod ma/ /khyu ldan/ dbus 'gyur / 'chang ma dang / /tshogs can ma dang ma gnas so/ /ge sar/gser gyi me tog ma/ /phreng ldan ma dang / yid bzang skyes/ /mtshan ma'i me tog mā kandi/ /mā lā tī dang ka li kā/ /yid bzang ①skyes dang / nī bi du/ /puṇḍa ka dang 'phrog byed ldan/ /sa nyi mutta'i ming / shin tu grol ma a ti mukta/ dpyid bzang dang / dpyid kyi pho nya/ bya sarnyi/ /sbrang rtsi skyes ma 'khri shing ngo / 8 /kun tu gyes dang nags las byung / /'dab bdun phreng ba'i gsar pa dang / /sos ②ka can zhes bya ba'o/ /rtsa stong dang ni rgya 'jigs dang / /malli ka ④dang sa yi rkang / /de nas mu ku ta ra'i/ me tog/ /bi tsa tī la/ mu ku ram̐/ 2 /byer ba mkhregs dang / grong gsum phreng / 2 /ā āo tā dang / nags 'phreng can/2/mtshan mo'i me tog narguṇḍi/ /she pha li kā/ legs 'bab dang / /dmar po'i tshogs can bya ru can/ /sngon po can dang / ro zhim dkar/ 8 /'di dkar 'byung po'i skra can no/ / band+ra dzi ba duka'i ming / bsgru ⑤ka dang / rtsa lag 'dzin/ rtsa lag dang ni rtsa lag 'tsho/ /dmar po can zhes bya ba'o/ /rlung dga' ma dang / snying rje'i phreng rjo/ /sprang rtsi phreng dang / ka ru ṇa/ 4 /de nas nus ldan chen po dang / /ki ki rā ta āman/na/de dmar ku ru rub ka ste/ /ser na ku ruṇḍa ka'o/ /ārjan sngon po mu men te/ /bi sha ri kā /kuṇḍa sngo/ /kunda dang ni bo ra ṭa/ /120—1237

mchu zla mdzes dang / 'dab ma'i mdzod/ /da khā ṭa ka zhes bya'o/ /dpa' bo'i lag pa ka ra bī ①ra'i ming / ka ra bī ra so sor dgod/ /brgyad skyes/gtum po/ rta gsod pa/ 5 /paṇḍi ta ka /ta ga ra/ 2 /paṇḍi ta ga ra dang ni//paṇḍi ta ga ra zhes dang / /ka pa 'phel ba can zhes so/ 3 /ma ru ba rka /pā rā ṭi| /lo ra bha yi 'dabs la gnas/ /me tog sa bon zhes pa dang / /tshor ldan me tog /dri med 'dab/ 7 /ha ṭā'i tsher can 'dul byed can/ /'dul byed rnga yab me tog go/ /chu shing / pags ldan/ rtsom byed dang / /glang po'i lcug ma grol ba dang / /pā ḍa bu ṣā/ rgyud rnams 'dzin/ /'od med 'bras can—/ 'jam 'bras ldan/ /nad kyi 'bras ldan/ 'chi 'bras can/ /rtsa yi snying po mdzod lus can/ /shāsma lī dang rlung la 'dun/ /shing 'dzin zhes pa yang 'dod do/ 16 /ma li dang ni me tog dkris/ /grol ba can zhes bya ba'o/ /de ba dā ru'i ming / de ba dā ru/ yongs bzang dang / /lha dbang rkang 'thung / shing sar dang / /ki li ma'i shing bzang po'i shing / /dā ru/ser shing / tshi can shing / /mda' 'dzin dang ni/ bdug spos shing / /sa skyes mdangs can/ shing rings dang / /'od zer 'dab can sdongasnyegi tog//sbrang gnas can dang / me tog mngar/ /legs pa'i shing dang / nags rab skyes/ /lam pa'i longs spyod sgrang rtsi can/ /me tog bu ra chu skyes so/ /rkang mang pa ṭa/ n+ya gro dha/3 /a phra mthar byed/ spru ta na/ /spre'u'i tsu ta/spre'u dga'/ /ka pi ta na zhes pa'o/ 5 /yongs 'du'i ming / de nas yongs 'du sa brtol ni/ /rnga yab can dang /sa 'joms dang / /'dab ma bzung ldan chu skyes dang / /tsasba ka dang /120—1238

phun tshogs 'phel/ /gser gyi gdong can gser shing dang / /karbu 'joms pa nyid dang ni/ /smin pa'i dgrar yang lta bar bya/ 10 /she lu khang kan 'joms pa dang / /bsil ba gyen 'joms/ 'khor mang can/ /tshogs can nim pa'am ka dī'i ①ming ni/ ka dadza'i shing / gshol ldan dga'/ /dpa' ba'i 'dren byed bhā sa rgyun can/ tshogs can dang / /yung mdog gsal dang /me tog gi/ /rdul dang ldan pa'i tshogs can shing / /ge sar can dang /'bras ming ldan/ /rab mchog ldan dang / rdul stobs can/ /yongs su rgyud ldan nim pa'i shing / /mand+rar chadang yongs 'du dang / /sa lā dang ni tsam pa kasne/ 14 /rgya skyegs shing gi ming / pā lā ljang ser sha dang / ki shu ka ṣpe/detsasbra rjoka /padma dang ni/rgya skyegs shing / /rlung 'joms 'dab can/ 'jigs sgra can/ /gser shing me tog dmar po can/ /tshangs pa'i shing dang 'dab gsum pa'o/ 11 /shing gru'i ming / mig smin bzang dang / shi gru dang / /dri snom⑤/ mig 'dra| grol ba can/ /rab 'joms bud med/ sems 'phrog dang / /ri mo rnam par 'joms pa dang / /chom rkun dang ni rtsa ba can/ 10 /ma rgyu shing gru'i ming / de dmar mngar ba'i shi gru dang / /su ru gā'o 'di'i sa bon / /na le rtsabani shaṃ dkar shi gru skyed/ 1 /lung thang shing gi ming / lung thang / a ṛ ṭa lung thang phe na'idabu ma can 3 /lo ma bdun pa'i ming / lo ma bdun pa shun pa yangs/ /ston ka can dang /mi mnyam 'dag /lha yi bzang shing dri ldan dang / /skra can/ gdon 'joms| grangs can 'dab/ 7 /sā rjola'i shing dang / bra tsi shing / /120—1239

abyerka/ rta yi rna ba can/ /'khri shing thogs med shing dang ni/ /lo tog bde mchog zhes kyang bya/ 6 /sā la'i thang chu/ spos dkar dang / /me yi lcug ma zhes bya'o/ 3 /chu klung pra shing dpa' bo'i shing / /dbang shing ka ku/ bha srid sgrub / 5 /sā la ser po/ rtsa lag can/ /me tog dga' byed/ 'tsho byed dang / /kun za dga' byed/ sā la dang / /mdor byed ka ṣā/ ya gu'o/8/shing stag pa'i shing ①/ gro ga gdugs khebs pags pa can/ /re ga'i 'dab dang / shun pa mnyen②/ /yi ge'i gzhi can zhes bya'o/ 6 /ka pi ta shing dang dadhing shing / /so rtse la gnod skyur mo'o/ /de la zho 'bras me tog 'bru/ /so rtse nyams byed zhes pa'o/ /u dusthā ④ra dzantu'i 'bras/ /mchod sbyin yan lag gser 'o ma/ /shun pa me tog 'bras bu bsil/ /de 'bras 'bru dang tsher ma can—/ /rgyal po'i zas dang / pi yā la/ /rgyud kyi shing dang gzhu yi shing / /ṣa ṭa dga' ba 'dzin zhes bya/ 6 /shi rī ṣa dang me tog 'jam/ /chu 'thung /dug 'joms/ bhiṇḍa la/ /ṣpe tso 'tshe dang / phyir bzlog ma'o/ 7 /a gu ru'i shing gi ming / shirsha pā dang / 'dab bzung can/ /ser skya thal ba'i snying po can/ /bi tstsha la/ a gu ru 'dibyub/6 /shalla tī dang glang po'i zas/ /tshim byed/ cung bzang / sa skyes bcud/ /thang chu can dang / legs 'bab dang / /dri bzang ma haṃ/ ga skyes dga'/ 10 /'o ma'i ming can/iṅga rī/ /cha ba shing dang / dpal gyi gnas/ /su ṭi dzi ba zhes pa'o/ 2 /ka ta ka dang / chu dwangs byed/ 2 /'jigs med/ nad med/ na tshod gnas| /tshi can/ bdud rtsi/ a ru ra/ /gser ldan/ bcud len 'bras bu can/ /zhi ba/ sems byed/ dge legs can/ /dpal yon 120—1240

can dang / brgya byin spos/ /nad 'dor①/ bde byed don yod dang / /dag byed/ lha rdzas/ lus gnas byed/ /de bzhin nad rab 'joms pa'o10/skyu ru ra dang / dpal ldan dang / /zhi byed rgyal 'bras/ 'chi med dang / /na tshod bcud gnas ma ma dang / /bcud lnga ldan pa zhes bya'o/ /rab tu ra dang / ru li dang / /'byung po'i gnas dang / rtsod pa'i shing / /mig dang / tshim byed/ karṣa'i 'bras/ /mig gi rtsa ba/ dpag bsam shing /7/nisbra| kun bzang / shing kun 'dres/ /dri can 'jug byed/ 'jam po 'joms| /karka'i lcug ma/ arka dang / /sa skyes zhes pa rnams su 'gyur/7/shasma li dang / grol ba dang / /rnying pa/ skye ngan/ pitstsha li/ /dmar mo/ tshe brtan/ me tog dmar/ /tsa tu nī dang / badzdza ④la/ 10 /gasgyu re ①dang / 'dab bzang dang / /dpal gyi lo ma sbrang rtsi'i 'dab/ /kāsma rī dang kun bzang dang / /spro byed/ kāsma ri skyes so/ 8 /kā shadma li/shāsma li/ /snar byed phung po zhes pa'o/ 3/bee rka ka /dgang gzar shing / /pi rka ka ta/ mchod sbyin shing / /rgya shug phra mo tshigs mang dang / /stag gi rkang pa tsher ma zhim/ /sa 'tsho rgya shug tsher ma can/ /pre ⑦te ka ra zhes bya'o/11/a ko tha dang / zangs tsher can/ /mtshan can/ oslo li ka'o/ 4 /'di yi me tog mo ra ṭa/ /mngar 'bras/ se le ⑤shra sī'o/ 2 /kaso dā ra/a tsā ḍa/ /'di dag ri la skye ba'o/ /shin tu ka dang / spurdzi ka /nag po'i phung po/ rkang mar nag 4 /bya rog /zla ba/ rigs ngan dang / /bya rog 'thung gcod can dang ni/ /bya rog tind+ra ka yi shing / 4 /dong ka dang ni rgyal po'i shing / /ske tog phreng can gser ldan dang / /'khor lo 'dra dang 120—1241

nad 'joms dang / /legs smin/ sor bzhi pa dang gser/ /se pha le ka /gser me tog /'bras bu ring po can zhes so/ 12 /ri yi phreng ba bcad skye dang / /bi'u can/ shing skya/ /brgya byin shing / /su mtshan dbang dang nas bzang dang / /nas kyi 'bras bu can zhes so/ klu shing chu shing dkar ba dang / /tikka'i lo ma gzhon nu can/ /athra rī 'joms zhes bya'o/ /a ti mukta / ka yi shing / /ti ni pa dang 'jig byed dang / /mu ①khyud shing dang /shing rta'i shing / /sna tshogs byed dang / snod shing ngo / 7 /ka rī ra dang kra ka ra / /mdud pa can zhes bya ba'o②/ 3 /'jam po len dang / sā tsu ka /tra sa ri 6 dha/ bi dul/ /chu skyes chu yi be ta sa/ 4 /pe ta sa dang /bsel nag ④can/ /badzi la dang / chu 'dod pa dang / /shing rta'i shing dang sprin me tog /mkhas pa can dang yan lag mchog 7 /ni tsu la dang snye ma dmar| /'gro chu can dang / 'bab chu can/ /chu skyes shing zhes bya ba'o/5/gu gul grong dang / kau shi ka /bum can phru kha la ka dang / /mdung can sa lam dra rjoba'o/ 7 /mdzod ldan/ dri can/ spre'u shing / /ro hi ro hi ta ka dang / /mchin dgra se 'bru'i me tog go/ 4 /gā la ba dang shā ba ra/ /lo dhra/ ti rī ṭa/ ti nyu/ /byi dor byed pa zhes bya'o/ 6 /tsi ra bi lā mtshan mo'i phreng / /lag skyes/ ka rañdza ka'o/ 4 /so sor byang skyes/ pra tīrma/ /lā ṭa byed skyes/ pa tī ka /rtsod byed pa dang mar gyi gang / /de dbye marka ṭi dang ni/ /aṅgā rang dang / babee rī/ /tshigs drug pa zhes bya ba'o/ /seng sdeng ⑤dang ni glu len ma/ /so rgyug byed dang shing sru pa/ /byis pa'i lus dang / rul byed dang / /'dab ma gzhon nu can zhes so/ 7 /seng ldeng ngan 120—1242
