pa tshil dgra dang / /ka da ra dang seng ldeng lku dkar/ /zla ba'i shun pa zhes pa'o—/ /e raṇḍa dang snying po can/ /dri za'i lag dang stag gi mjug2 /u u ru dṛ/ ka gnas gsum ma/ pa dang 'bras bu can/ /tsazhu /dang ni sor lnga pa/ /snying po 'phel ldan rlung gi ma/ /rlung gi dgra dang ri mo can/ /glang po'i rnam pa stag gi 'dab/ /gnas can ma dang / gzhon nu'o/ 12 /'di yi rang kyang snyesmin pa ni/ /se ṣa dang ni/ nā ru rka/ /cung zad zhes dang sha mbi ra/ /sha mbi shaṃ ku'i 5'bras zhi ba/ / pas data tu 6mig nas so/5/saṃ ga ra 'bras sa mbi ka7 /rgyal dang rgyal byed rtogs pa'i dgra/ /chu bo skyes dang / 18 /rnam rgyal byed/ /gshor shing 'grol 'dzin gar byed dang / /me tog mgul rings ka ṭī 8ba/ /bcad cing gar byed sbal pa'i 'dab/ /bal 'dab ryadku sa skyes dang / /ṭuṇḍa ka dang / ṣpe tso sna/ /skar ma dang ni/ shwa na ka 13 /de nas shing gi atpa la/ /dong ka ba ni/ yongs snun dang / 1 /a ba dha dang / shun pa mngar/ /bya rog u dudza/ ri kā/ /philpu ma ra pūrdza dang / /gha na'i 'bras dang / dpyid kyi shing / /mtshan mo'i me tog dga' byed gnas/ /rab 9tu ba ka bsdus pa dang / /lag pa'i tshong 'du ma/ swā sha na/ /mgrin pa'i zug rngu myos byed dang / /chos can/ pitstsha la dang shun/ /'khyog po'i sde zhes bya ba'o/ /shun pa/ nub shing / ṣpe tso sna/ /thub pa'i sdong 7po zhes bya'o/ /sind+ra bā ra/ /sind+ra ka /sa ra sa/ send+ra pā ri ka /nirgu ṇḍi ni kā ka/5 6 /sgur 'khyog rdo rje'i tsher ma can/ /bal rta po'i shing dang / rma byed dang / /mi'i 4gdong / mobhalbā ta kāng karma mul dzepan dang mya ngan byedadze/ /srin po 'joms dang me'i rkang 'thung / 10 /shing chen dang ni 120—1243

dzha ṭal/ /dri can skya nar/ khros pa'i shing / 5 /sha za'i shing dang / 'bras bu ser①/ /yal gas khyab dang / grib mas 'gebs/ 4 /dpal gyi lo ma ku mud ②can/ /bum can/ kai ṭarlu snedang / ni/ /tsha ba len zhes bya ba'o/5/zhu mkhan paṭi kā khya dang / /pa ṭi la dang / dmar po len/ /rgya skyegs dwangs byed ces bya'o/ 5 /'deng byed/ gso byed/ rim pa can/ /tshangs sha /tshangs pa'i mchod sbyin shing / /nyer sbyor shing dang / tshangs pa'i shing / /ra tu dang ni tu la ya/ 6 /kanda ra la bong bu'i sgong / /chu 'thung ngos bzang /blakṣa'o—/ /chu klung skyes dang / sa'i dzamyu/ /nag po'i phung po ta mā la/ /piñdza kā dang mchu can na④/ 4 /nag mo skyes dang / pikhyu'i 'dab/ /hartu dang ni/ 'dab ma 'jam/ 5 /dpal gyi lo ma mi bsrub dang / /rked ldan/dal byed/ rgyal ma'o/ 5 /dpal ldan dang ni thig le can/ /gru ra ka zhes bya ba mtshungs/ 3 /zung du skye dang / hind+ra ma/ /de yi 'bras bu gi ri ṭi/ /skyed mos tshal dang nags kyi rab tu byed pa'o// //mchu can dang ni rgya mtsho'i mtha'/ /ras bal can dang rgya shug go/ 6 /nags de bha ⑤ra dhwa dzā'/ /ras bal srad bu'i me tog can/ 2 /e 0'bar ma ni mu rnyi kṣa/ /bhā ta tī dang skye byed ma/ /zungs kyi me tog me tog can/ /myos byed gnas ma zhes par 'gyur/ 6 /smyo byed ke ⑦ta ba/ dhurta/ /dhu ku ra dang / gser ming can/ /skya nar chen po dhu tu ra/ /me tog snying can/ kā ha la/ /mā tu la dang / stsos byed do/ 11 /a sma pha la la ni mā ru la su tra ka dang / ho ḍa pu྾ dang / dza bā dmar po dang / dmar po'i gong bu dang /stan mchog go/ 5 /dza ba'i shing la ni ma ho ṭa dang / rdo rje'i me tog dang /120—1244

til me tog go/ /sau ma ri ya ga ni/ rnyiṇḍi yin te/ de dmar na bu ba ka dang / /se ban ku ruspyo ka ste1/ /rnyiṇḍi de dang lhan cig spyod pa gnyis so/ /driṇḍi sngon po ni gnyis te/ nags kyi 'bangs dang / tshogs can utpala'o/ /'di na rtig la'o/ /de nas klu'i lce dang / ba ri se hā'o/ 2 /arka'i 'dab ma la/ rma 'o ma can dang / nor can dang / 'gags pa can dang / sna tshogs dang / pistso ra dang / nyi mas mtshan pa dang / mand+ra ra dang / sna tshogs kyi gzugs can dang / rnam par 'thor byed/ 'di la de sgo'i 'bras bu zhes pa'o/ 11 /'di dkar na a larka dang / rab tu gdung ba can no/2/kathiṣṭha nar ni/ brnas te/ ku thi ra ka dang / ku thilla ka dag go/ /'di dkar na ardza ka dang / dri'i su can dang / bu thi ra ka'o/ /sa mbi ra ṇa dang / ma rub ka dang / brasbra putpa dang / ha ni dzdza ka dang / dzaX ra'o/2/de nas sthā bee ra ni lha'i sgra dang / chu'i ming can to/ /dā la dang /dri'i chu dang / babhiṣṭi dag go/ /gañdzi ni dbang po dang / ā sa ni ma'o/ /4ka ni zhi ba'i lcug ma yin te/ bu ka dang / phyugs bdag dang / nor dang /e gabhā la zhes pa'o/ /rpā ṣṭha ni tsi tra ka dang / me'i ming can te/ 'joms byed dang / sgrun byed dang / chu nad 'joms byed do/ 5 /shing za ba dang /sri srid 'gro ba dang / 'tsho byed dang / bya rog skyes dang / shing skye yang de'o / 5/de nas 'od ldan ma dang / nyil sar 5can dang / phug ron can dang / iṅga rī dang / ro kha ba dang / 'dor byed dang / dka' thub sbyar dang / shing shun dang / phug ron rkang dang / ka ṭa ddhā dang / 'khri shing dang / pi n+ya na 6dang / sarka ṭī'o/ 3 /gu ḍū tsi dang / rgas rnged 720—1245

dang / ba dzā dang / rgyud can dang / hi tshotā ka dang / mri tā dang / pu bras dang / bcad skye dang / yangs pa dang / sbrang rtsi'i 'dab ma dang /'tsho byed dang / zla ba'i lcug ma rnams so/ 12 /sha nitha 'joms na phun rta bā'o/2/saptalā dang / kṛṣṭa lā dang / sle tres/ gser can dang / kā kāñtsi kā dang / guñdza dang / brag mchog dang / dzā tsa ru lā dang / sa bon dmar po can dang / durme ṣā dang / du byed ma dang / 'dab ma dmar po dang / gtsug gi nor bu yang de'o/ 3 /kispru ka la ni/ ma hā kā la dang /u tu kā la'o / 2 /de nas sapta lā dang / dri'i rdzas dang / dri med ma dang /lā ta lā dang / dbu ba mang po dang / tsarma ka ṭha zhes pa yang ngo / /nag po dang / u ba ku lya dang / lus 'phags skyes dang / pispa lī dang / g.yo ba dang / zegs ma dang / u ṣa ṇa dang / mā gha dhīdang / ko lā dang /sna ring sa dang / rtog med ma zhes pa rnams so/ 11 /mdud pa can dang /pispa lbo dang / rtsa ba tshigs zug pa dang / bi kā shī 4ra rnams so/ /spre'u'i lcug ma dang / ko la'i lcug ma dang / dge legs ma dang / glang mo'i pi spa li dang / ba si ro nā rnams so / /de nas tsa ki ka dang / dbyi mo dang /gzi brjed ma zhes pa yang ngo / /mdog med skyes dang / zla ba'i lcug ma dang /lcug ma bzang po dang / zla ba'i rgyal mo dang / lug nag ma dang / 'bras nag ma dang / bā gā dzi 5dang / rul pa'i 'bras bu yang ngo / 8 /shu dag dang / dri mchog dang / mdung ma drug pa dang / tshigs brgya pa dang /sa yi spu dang / ngag phan dang / dri rtsub zhes par 'gyur ro/ 7 /de nyid dkar po la gser ldan ma zhes so/ /yung ba la ni ni shā dang / mdog mdzes 720—1246

ma dang / mdog mchog dang / ka ṭi dang / ka me ri 1dang / rul ldan ma dang / gser ldan ma dang / gser 'joms ma dang / ser mo dang /khu ser ma dang / ganda sā lā dang / shī sī dang / ta pā la kā dang / la bā dang / pra gha rā ddhā rnams so/ 17 /de nas 'o ma dang / rnam par 'jo ba dang / mtshungs 4so/ /e la'i shun pa dang / dri bzang dang / pra tsi kā dang / pags pa las byung ba dang / sa mo dang / zla ba gzhon nu ma dang /nidku ṭi ba hu lā dang / tsa bā dang / spom mo rnams so/ 9 /sug smel dang /ru tā dang / ka rang gī dang / phur ma gsum pa dang / gcod byed dang /phug ron mdog dang / ma la ya skyes dang / u pa kuñtsi kā dang / shing ldan dang / 'dab ma dang / shing ser dang / ka ṭi ka ṭi dang / ka ṭi ka ṭi rī dang / sī ta dru dang / dus su skyes pa dang / ljang ser mdog dang /parya n+ya dang / parya byā dang / spru ta kāsgo dang / bī ta na ra kai rnams so/21/le brgan dang / bi ka kha dang / dzidhī dang / yang dag lus ma dang /lus nag ma dang / sbal pa'i 'dab ma dang / bhāṇḍa rī dang / bhaṇḍi ya dang /chu'i lcug ma dang / dri bzang rtsa ba dang / rlung 'joms ma dang / bkra ba'i 'dab ma can ma rnams so/ 12 /gabyu paṇi dang / mdud pa'i lo ma dang /ka ba skyes dang / /mdud pa can dang / dri bzang dang / shing dkar dang /ṣpe tso dang / rma bya dang / me tog sbom po/ kuklu ri rnams so/ 10 /sbrang can dang / shing mngar dang / llī ta kai dang / ma dhu yaṣṭi kā dang /yabye ma dhu kā rnams so/ /de nas nang can dang / ru rta dang / mṛtpa lo dang /lus ngan skyes dang / 'od 'bar dang / bya ba dang / yongs su bsgo ba 120—1247

dang / smin pa can dang / dbyug pas mtshan pa rnams so/ /'di'i rtsa ba padma'i rtsa ba dang / dpa' bo rgyas byed dang / katrī ra dang / padma'i 'dab ma dang / ṇi rnams so/ 5 /mon gyi tikta 1dang / sa'i nim pa dang / mon skyes ma dang / 'gro byed tikta ka dang / yun rings tikta ka dang / gser can rnams mtshungs so/ 7 /sa'i tshor gzem ma dang / sa'i 'gyur byed can dang / tsher ma gsum sbyar ba dang / kṣu ra dang / sa lam ka ṣa dang /bur shing dri dang / so dang / cher ma mngar ba dang / thang gi rwa can dang /ke rwa ye rwa can dang / kha dog gsum pa rnams so/ 11 /bur shing dri dang /kāṇḍi kṣu dang / khu byug mig dang / kṣu ra dang / kṣu ra'o/ 6 /u 6 pra sto dang / mi 'jigs 'dab can ma dang / rtsa ba brgya ma dang / brgya mchog ma dang / sred med dang / bu mangs ma dang / 'jigs med ma dang /dbang mo dang / ba rī ba rā dang / ā te ru rnams so/ 10 /u 6 pro kṣa ni/spre'u mo dang / paṃ ka selba kā dang / bdag sbas ma dang / skyes ma dang /tyaṇḍa dang / kantu rā dang / rab char 'bebs ma dang / nags kyi mi 'dra dang / spre'u sngo can rnams so/ /rwa can ni u ṣa bha dang / aṣṭa bste pa nyi ta/de'i u ṣa bhā 6 ni thra ṣa'o/ 3 /ba lang bsrung ba'i 'bras dang / klu'i stobs dang / mjug ma dang / 'dab ma can dang / gaṅge ru pā tsa dang / shin tu stobs ma dang / u ṣa dang / thung dug bee tru kā rnams so/ 7 /ba la'i dbye ba la lu nyi bā khā dang / ba lā dang / ba tidmā dang / spyod pa'i me tog ma dang / bā tya la gen ri'o/ /go dhwa pa dī ni legs 'bab ma dang / 'dab gsum ma dang / ngang pa'i rkang ma yang ngo / 4 /a sbo tā ri'i rna ba yin te/120—1248

khyab 'jug gnod pa dang / gzhan kyis 1mi thub pa dang / ba lang zas dang /gi ri ka ṣkadang / thang gi me tog pa dang / ba shi yang de'o/ /de nas ba ka ni sman pa'i ma dang / seng ge ma dang / bā sa kā dang / bri ṣā dang /gnas can ma dang / a ṭa ru ṣa dang / seng ge can ma dang / rta so can rnams so/ 8 /ku nas 'o ma dang / ā bī dang / gaṇḍa dang / rdo rje du byu ka dang / sgu tī dang / gu hā ma rnams so/ /bee ḍi ga dang / don yod dang / 'bras dang / 'bras khra bo dang / kṛ ma/ rmatsū dang / stu la dang / khewaṃ dang / rakta dṛrlu dang / kai ri khā rnams so/ 98 /dga' ba ni/drag po'i dri dang / tshangs pa'i ngag dang / ya mā rgo kā dang / hṝ rya dang /gsal byed ma dang / dga' ba'i dngos po ma rnams so/ 7 /gzhon nu ma dang /ta ra tsi dang / nt+ra ha'o/ /skra'i rgyal po dang / klu'i bdud dang / ba rā tu / j-iṅga so da ra rnams so/ 4 /bung ba dang / bung 4ba'i rdul dang /bung ba'i rgyal po dang / mārka tī dang / dzā ga rā'o/ 5 /bā ya mbi dang / kā ka mā ṭī dang / bya rog zas dang / bcud len no/ 4 /sa ha bra be ddhā dang /tsa krobee dang / ba tab dang / sa ta be dhī'o/ 4 /tseṅga rī dang / tsu kre kā dang / dgu sha thā dang / braṣṭa dang / mū mo ni kā dang / kṣu rāsmra dang /'dab ma phra ma dang / 'dzin byed ma dang / ambi ro kyi kā rnams so/ 9 /shing a bā mārga la shi khā ri ka dhwa dang / mārga ba dang / rma bya can dang / pra hra kya rte dang / shī sha brte dang / ki ṇi tī dang / kha ra mañdza rā rnams so/ /agho zwa dang / tsher can 'bras bu dang / llītasgo dang / sha ta su྾ ka rnams so / 4 /ruṇḍi ki rī dang / rakta pha lā dang / gzugs can ma dang / ma dhu pa ṇi 120—1249

dang / bi baṃ ka dang / chu srin ma yang ngo / 6 /de nas bi tulla ka dang /dzñā ṭā ma khā dang / dzñā ṭa tā li dang / zhi ma dang / tā ma lnga tī bha ṭī dang /sde tshan bu mo dang / phra mo'i 'bras bu dang / argyaṇḍa pa ①bhū myu ma la hi yang ngo 9/badzra pa gyasbri dang / saṃ hā ra dang / ha ste shunḍi ②dang / ba lā li kā dang / da dru da la dang / bā tu ṭha dang / a rim kuṇḍi ka rnams so/ 7 /lhar bcas ma dang / lhan cig ma dang / sna tshogs lha mo dang / utpal yu ba ma rnams so/ 4 /phag nag ma dang / nyi ma bsgyur dang / hu lu hu lu yang de'o/5/poṇḍa ri rka dang / poṇḍa tya'o/ 2 /sho thi rjani byu na rā ṣa'o/ /chu klung shing dang / 'khyog po dang / arnyo la ka dang / katstsha dang / lus ngan can dang /tunda'o—/ 6 /dung can ma ni chom rkun me tog ma dang / sgra can ma'o/ /so ka can dang / kri bhi ra ṭa dang / la mdzes dang / nags kyi tikta rnams so/gabakṣu ṇa dang / bad kan gyi snying 'dab mar byed pa dang / glo nad 'joms byed do/ /tshangs ma ni nya mig ma dang / na tshod gnas dang / zla ba'i 'khri shing zhes bshad pa la sogs pa 'dab ma dang / lcug ma'o/ /pa ṭu'i 'dab ma dang / gser ldan ma dang / gser byed ma dang / gangs can ma rnams sorka/ 4 /dhwa mārga ba dang / sgra can dang / ā hā ko ṣā ta tī dang / ko ṣa ta tī dang / mdzod 'bras rnams so/ 5 /dra ba chen po dang / sa ra ①can no—/ /zug rngu yang ma dang / shlau khā dang / mtha' yas ma dang / 'bras ldan ma dang / brgya byen me tog ma yang ngo / 5 /be bhā kha rā dang / ga rī dang / lha mtshungs dang / char sprin zhes pa yang ngo / 4 /lug gi rwa dang /me dru'i rwa dang / rwa can ma dang / rwa'i rwa can ma'o/ 4 /dṛ dhwa dā ra ka la 120—1250

ni dzaṅga dang / ā be gri dang / tstsha ga lārnyi kā dang / ri 6 ga: yang ngo /6/spang spos dang / mi sī dang / 'byung po'i ral pa dang / ral pa can dang /dri'i rdzas dang / dka' thub can ma dang / ral pa 'dzin ma dang / rgyun sbyin ma dang / ral pa'i sru can ma rnams so/ 9 /dri'i 'dab ma dang /stobs bzang ma dang / 'gro byed ma dang / rab 'gro ma dang / ka ṭambha ra dang / rgyal po'i stobs dang / dri 'dzin ma dang / 'byor pa'i dri ldan ma rnams so/ /ra ①sprurpā dang / lha mo dang / ro ma dar ma dang / mo ra ṭā dang / rno byed ma dang / sru bhā ma dhu le kā dang / dha nu dang / she tī tha/kaṇi dang se'i lu/ parṇa yang ngo / /rgya spos dang / lha mo dang / lha dang /phreng ba dang / ser sna dang / yang sha'i 'khri shing dang / bya ba'i tshad dang /rgya mtsho'i mtha' dang / pa dha lang kā dang / shā kā ②zhes pa yang ngo 10 /de nas rwa can dang / bong nga nag po dang / bong nga dkar po dang / shin tu dug dang / 'od dmar dang / sman chen dang / nye ba'i dug dang /dug sbun du gnon pa dang / babee rī ①rnams so/ /rma bya dang / byed ldan snang dang rta bong mig dang / mgo dang / rma bya'i gtsug phud kyang ngo / 5 /de nas mu gya lī dang / tā li'i rtsa ba can no/ 2 /rnam par 'joms pa dang /'o ma dkar po dang / bur shing dri dang / rnga mo dang / grags ldan ma'o/5/gzhan 'gyur la rnam 'joms dang / dkar chen dri ldan ma dang / 'o ma can ma dang / rtsa ba mngar ba dang / bye la can no/ 6 /brjod ldan dang /rang gnas dang / rig pa'i rna ba dang / 'jog med ma dang / dpal mo dang / bcud ma dang / gnas gcig 'dzin dang / sā ya ba lī dang /120—1251

rab bsngags dang / nags kyi tikta rnams so/ 10 /tsha ba dang / tsha ba 'dzin ma dang / mya ngan med dmar po dang / nya'i 'byor pa dang / lus ngag mig dang / 'khor lo'i lus dang / bya'i zas rnams so/ /sngon mo dang /nag mo dang / rdul ma dang / mchog dang / nya mo dang / spang gi 'dab ma dang / dpal 'bras dang / tuttha dang / tū nī dang / 'degs ma dang /sngon mo ldan ma rnams so/ 11 /dgra ①stas gcod ma dang / dgra ④sta can ma'o / 2 /'bras ①can ma dang / legs mthong ma'o/ /'dri byed lo ma dang /lo ma so so ba dang / tsi ṭa pa bhā dang / rkang ldan ma dang / lcug ma can ma dang / rnga mo'i 'byor pa dang ngo / /seng ge'i mjug rjom dang / cha shas grub ma dang / nags thug ma rnams so/3 /phyogs des ma dang / reg ldan ma dang / stag ldan ma dang / gri ⑤hā bhā dang / kaṇḍa kā ri dang / rab tu skul byed ma dang / rig ldan ma dang / phra mo dang / reg dka' ma dang /yul 'khor ma rnams so/ 10 /'od ma phra mo dang / ku kuñdza rjodang / lag 'joms rnams so/ 3 /blo 'joms ma dang / nyung ngu 'joms dang / baṅka bā ḍi rnams so/ /thams cad rjes su 'byor dang / ma 'joms ma dang /phung ba gsum ma dang / gsum skor ma dang / dur byed dang / tshangs gsum ma dang / 'dor byed ma rnams so/ 7 /sngo bsangs ma dang skyong byed ma ni sde bzang ma ste/ kā khā ma su dang / 'das ⑦bral ma dang / zla ba phyed pa dang / lug nag ma rnams so/ 7 /nā ku le dang / bcud bzang dang /gand+ra dang / gand+ra nā ku lī dang / na ku lā dang / 'dod ma dang / lag 'gro mig ma dang / gdugs can ma dang / legs 'bab ma zhes pa yang de'o/7/120—1252

rnam ①'joms ma ①dang / dri snemyur ldan ma dang / 'dab ④ma mtho ba dang / brtan ma dang / nges ma rnams so/ 5 /ri dwags dri dang / 'khyog po dang / lha min ma dang / ta la'i 'dab ma dang dri ldan ma rnams so/ 5 /rab thob ma dang / glang po dkar po dang / da dru 'joms 'khor lo mthong dang / padmā ṭā dang / u ra ṇa zhes bya ba la ⑤yang ngo / 6 /'khor 'o ma mtshan pa ni sman chen te/ dug 'joms dang / maghri'o/ /gharṇa bā ṇi sha ṇi dang / me tog can no/ /rung sa rjodang 'byor pa ni a rgya zhes bya ba'i sman gyis ⑦grub pa ste/ dpal mo dang / bkra shis ma dang / rtogs byed ma dang /dga' ma dang / mā ṇad dang / thub pa spros dang / 'phel ba ste 'di dag ni ⑧mtshon pa 'di rnams ni/ barba ram̐ dang / barba rī ki dang / barba rī kṣi dang / barba ri puṣṭhatā zhes pa la 'ang ⑨ngo / /barba rā ka ba ṭī dang / mthon po ma dang / ba ra barba ṭī dang / yal ga'i me tog ma dang / 'phro ⑩ldan ma rnams so/ /e la'i lo ma ni/ legs 'bab ma dang / raspra dang / pho ⑪bcud ldan ma gang 6)de'o/ 4 /dri dza/ gnyis skyes ni/ re na kā dang /karnyi dang / ha re ṇi dang / thal ba'i dri dang / ser skya mo rnams so/6/muṅga'i lo ma ni/ bya rog muṅga dang / lhan cig pa zhes kyang ngo / 3 /rtag 'jug ma ni/ 'dar byed skyes ma dang / zla ba'i lo ma dang / bzod chen ma rnams so/ 4 /shing tsha dang / 'dab ma dang / pūtna ṭi dang / mtho ba dang / shun pa dang / tso tsa dang / lus mchog can rnams so/ 7 /ga pur dang / tā bee tra ka dang / 'od srungs dang / rig byed gtso mo rnams so/gasna tshogs sde'i dga' ma dang / kṛṣṭi dang / phag mo dang / rgya shug ⑫dang /120—1253

phag gdong zhes pa yang de'o/ 5 /skyob byed ma ni/ ri ngos skyes dang / phra mo skyes dang / rā tsi ①ke dang / skyob ma dang / nags tshal bzang mo rnams so//kṛ twa shīrṣa dang / mngar ba can dang / shiṅga hra so ⑦swāṅga dzi ba aṣṭa brga ya ti ta su dzi ba kā su kāḥ 'dab skum ma dang / ngo tsha ldan ma dang / nor can dang / ba su twaji ka'o/ 2 /bkra ba dang / nyer bkra dang / n+ya go dhwa dang / pra brnyi dang / shasba rī dang / thra ṣā dang / pra tya kṣe tī dang /su ta she hā dang / raṇḍa dang / byi ba'i lo ma rnams so/ /hañdza kā dang /bram ze dang / padmā bhāṅgā dang / bram ze'i mchod sdong dang / sol ba'i mdo ma dang / skob skyes dang / bakṣa shā dang / bi shā ka dang / barba ta badzha ha rnams so/ 9 /reg dka'/ dha nā yā sha dang / du byed ma dang / yīl ya nī sa dang / katshwa rā/ mtha' yas ma dang / rgya mtsho yi/ tha ma rnyed dka' ka ṇa sa'o/ 10 /sa 'tsho'i snebu mo mtha' yas rtsa/ /me tog phra mo kṣi ṇi rirka/ /ba lang srung ④ma sngo bsangs ma/ /sngo bsangs 'khri shing / sā rikṣa/ /mtha' yas utpa la sā ri kṣa/ 9 /mi yi gtsug phud la'ang ga li/ /gshol ldan ma dang smra byed ma/ /rab gdung ma dang go byed ma/ /rang dbang ma dang mi gdong ma/2 /de nas bya rog byin pa la/ /bya rog lus dang bya rog sna/ 2 /dri yi rdzas kyi i la dā/ /ka me la ya dri bzang dang / /gser bye ma dang / bye ma can—/ 5 /de nas sa lo tī la ni/ /mu kun ṭu dang gu 0du dang / /ku tu ru zhes bya ba'o/ 3 /sbrang rtsi dang ni 'tsho byed ma/ /'tsho byed/ 'tsho ma/ 'tsho ldan ma/ 5 /na tshod gnas dang / sde brgyad dang / /kā ko lī dang / ā lī dang / /'bras bu zhi ma dang / lang tsho gnas/ /de nas ma kyu la ka dang / /120—1254

bum nges glang po/ son can gyi/ /so so'i phreng ba dag dang ni/ /u duṭwā ①ra'i 'dab kyang ngo / /nad med mdang shin tu spyod/ /padma spyod dang padma mchog /lam skyes spyod ma rnams yin no/ 5 /kāmbi rū dang / karka sha /zla ba lus dmar gsal ma yang / 5 /gzhan gyis mi thub dha ta ka /shī te ma dang /sha ni 'dab/ 4 /dārbi ka dang / ba lang lce/ /darngi 'dab ma can dang ni/ /gser gyi 'o ma can yang de'o/ /me tog brgya pa kā ra bī/ /a kaklu྾/gdugs dkar dang / /shin tu gdungs dang mi si dang / /ma dhu rā zhes pa rnams so/ 78 /ra ba skyes dang si ba dang / mngar ldan mi sī g.yo ba dang / /deste ya zhes pa rnams so/ 6 /kun tu reg dang / dza tu byed/ /skyed ma bye ba zhes bya dang / /mchod sbyin ma dang / dzi byu kṛ ta/ /'khor los sgyur ma rnams yin no/ 7 /sha ṭī sha the ②kastso ra/ /mdud pa drug pa tri'i sha ྾/ /sa khā sa dang spos kyi rtsa/ 7 /sbubs ldan byu ru'i 'khri shing dang / phug ron rkang dang gar mkhan ma/ /don bzang rdzas kyi sdong bu'o/ 5 /skye ba'i skra dang / dha ma n+ya/ /tanta haṣṭa bi khā dang / /spos rdzas sī rtswa zhes bya'o/ 4 /nya phyis dung dang /rmig pa dang / /ko la'i 'dab dang sen mo yi/ 5 /na khri/ alba ṭa ki dang / /bya rog sa dang / sbyong byed ma/ /sa can yul 'khor skyes pa'o/ 5 /'khyog po gang byed grong bcu pa/ /stobs skyes pa ra sa la ko/ /rkyal 'gro/ sngon 'gro①/rkyal mchen ④pa/ /ke ba ṭi zhes bshad 'di rnams/ /gla sgang ming du blta bar bya| 8 /gcan gzan mtshon cha/ stag sen dang / /lag skyes 'khor lo byed pa skyes/ 4 /dus rjes 'brang dang gzhi 'dzin bsel/ /rdo yi me tog /rgan po dang / /brag las byung dang brag las ⑤skyes/ 7 /tshogs bde dang ni srin mo 120—1255

dang / /gtum mo nor 'phrog bde bam dang / /bu ngan tshogs dang 'bangs mo dang / 8 /gaṇḍi'i me tog ḍo ka ṭa/ 2 /gaṇḍi ra dang / mnyam gnas 'dzin| /nye ba spyod dang / sha marsā/ /'di la chu yi rma bya can/ 5 /dpal gyi lag ldan byu rū ṇḍi/ /'bras bu/ be blu/ ki ṭa lo/ /ku ri ①binda sprin ming can/ / masta ②dang ni/ musta ke/ /guṇḍa/ rdul can/ se ru'o/ /gtsug phud 'dzin dang 'bras gang dang / /skyong byed 'khor lo 'dzin guṇḍa/ /kra ma ka dang mkha' yi grong / /i tri ka dang / shi lī:/ /i du lī re dang / kanda lo/ /lus bral bcud ldan/ sa dang ni/ /sgeg pa dang ni ba ka'o—/ 7 /yal ga nag po dus skyes dang / /shā tha dzi hwa ra sā ta rka/ 4 /gzhi can dga' byed yal ga dpa'/ /tsandi rā lo/ sprin dri med/ /ṭakka'i yul can/tsā shu'i 'dab/ /dngos po can zhes bya ba rnams/ 8 /rtsa ldan pa dang / lte ba'i 'dab/ /zhing skyes dang ni dben par spyod/ 4 /sā ta ki ni spyos byed rkang //'khri shing ①mchu dang / steng phur dang / /mjug ma can zhes bya ba'o/ /shā li dang ni/ sand+ra ra/ /lcags gsod pa dang / yul 'khor che/ /ba rā ṭi'i bris/ mā ri ṣa/ /pa ṭo la dang / sa bdag 'bras/ /tikta/ karka shi yi 'dab/ /ya ④ṭu dang ni ka la rka/ 6 /'di yi 'khri shing / kā li kā/ /rtsa ba dga' byed/ dī brinta/ /sen mo dang ni ruñdza la/ 2 /ka ṭasgyu ⑤rā 'dab ring dang / /chu bo zhags ldan ka lasdi/ 4 /hi la mo ṭī tshangs ma'i chu/ /nya lus ma dang 'di rnams mtshungs/ 3 /bi tund+ra rka/ 'dab ma'i zhing / /legs gnas dang ni tsu tsu'o/ /'dab bu can dang shog shing dang / /pi spa lī dang / /bya yi zas/ 4 /seng sdeng rjodang ni yid byed ma/ /mnyam lus 'dud dang /120—1256

dbu ba can/ /sdong nag /shu ka pathra dang / /ma 'dod pa dang / mthun pa can / 7 /tā ri ṭī dang pā ra tī/ /bha rā dang ni tso ti kā/ /rtsa ba pā ṭī ra dang ni/ /glang po'i so dang / rgyal po 'jig /rtsa ba che dang / rtsa ba phyi/galag pa/ 'ug ldan/ pe tsa'o/ 3 /sgog pa kun dong su kanda/ 2 /me mo/spre'u du pru mo/ /de nyid ljang gu sman chen no/ /sgog skya/ ke'u/ a riṣṭa/ /rā thra hra ta seṣṭa/ /rā son/ tsha ba'i rtsa ba/ rtsa ba chatshi/ /kla klo'i spros 2te 'di rnams dgu/ /de nas ma jo lu ka la/ /lha yi lo ma tsher ma med/ /'bras bu'i me tog /pa raṇḍa lu/ /shaṃ gā ra gnas 'dzin yu ta'o/ /bde legs mo ta/ dpal gye mgo /su ra kitstsha bar ma can/ /kabye'i rgyal dang /gdugs kyi bu/ /thang gi padma nga rgyal can/ 6 /kasbyi/ kand+ra/ yal ga'i khyon//bi taṇḍa dang / nga rgyal chung / 4 /'ded byed/ skem byed/ 'brum pa 'joms//ka ra beella/ kā thi khru/ /steng dkar ba dang / pa rā ru/ /rang ro/ba ku la'i sa bon/ /de ni rā dza ba ro li'o/ 7 /'di rnams sa dza kuṣṭhaṇḍa/ /lo rgyus ma dang / mtshan ldan ma/ /rab tu tshugs dka'/ bhaṇḍa tī/ /'khyog po 'phel ldan chen po dang / /bil ba'i yal ga /bārta kā/ /bā ḍi 4shaṃ ṇa/sa khā dang / /ro bī/ baṭwā rnams yin no/12/kuṣṭhaṇḍa dang / nag mo dang / /rgyal po'i sbal mo zhes so/ 3 /byo ma can dang / sbal mo dang / /bā ru/gshin ldan lo ma shā/ 3 /de nas dgas dang sbal pa dang / /'gas byed/ bī ru / nya phyis rnams/ /shāṇi briṇḍa5/ bde gnas dang / /mā lutrī na/te mi ṣā/ 4 /de nas ba lang mig dang ni/ /go dusthā dang / glang po tsi bha ṭi zhes dang / shaṃ ka chen mo zhes pa rnams/ 5 /yangs pa chu lha'i dbang mo dang / /120—1257

dbang mchog/ ba las gzhan pa dang / /nags kyi me tog ces pa'o 5 /bur shing / tsha ba'i tu mbir 'gyur/ /tusbya khā/ shu dubye kā/ /lā bu ke/grong kudmāṇḍa/ /piṇḍa tirnyi li kā rnams so/ 6 /'od ldan ma dang / skya nar dang / /dra ba can dang rnga zlum byed/ /'bigs byed dra ba mang po dang / /dra ba ring dang ring mo dang / /rakta pa ṭo li ka dang / /de la ko sha ta tī dang / /rnam par rgyas dang sdong bu rings/ 12 /rtsa ba'i 'dab ma rab skyes dang / /'bras mchog mda' 'phags/ pags pa bye/ /ralca rka dang / ba kā ①dang / /da sha dhwa shā ki zhes brjod/ /'od ma pags pa'i snying po dang / /karmā dang /shun pa'i snying / /ki lā ṭi na tshigs brgya pa/ /tshigs bzang rtsa'i tog /rtsa'i rgyal mtshan/ /'od ma nas kyi 'bras bu dang / /sa bon gyis 'chi 'gyur med dang / /brjid ldan rnga rlum ba tī na/ 26 /ka rī ra dang 'od ma dang / /karka ra 'o gang yang ni/ /rlung gi sgra sgogs bi shā dang / /ki tsa kā ste snede dag 'chi| /'od ma 'di yi skye ba ni/ /rgyud dang 'bras bu nas 'bras ldan/ /muñdza sa ra bra dang ni/ /dza ṇa ka dang guṇḍa stesne/ /de ltar 'di rnams mtshungs pa yin/ /ku sha ku ṭha darba ④dang / /dag byed dang ni mchod sbyin rgyan/ /badhi dang ni khrus kyi rtsa/ 18 /dāṭwā dang ni tshigs brgya pa/ /brtson 'grus stong ldan rdul med dang / /ngan sgong skyes dang ljang ser can/ /skye zhing gnas dang sa yi 'dab/ /mtha' yas dang ni dkyil 'khor can/ /glang sbu brtson 'grus brgya pa dang / sdong bu 'dzin dang / bya yi mig 14 /mdzod byed pa dang / bcud 'dzin dang / /bur shing ral gri lo ma can/ /gu ḍa da ru mngar ba'i rtsa/ /shiṇḍa'i tshigs dang 'o ma 'dzin/ /'o ma mngar dang / ro 120—1258

mngar dang / /me tog 'chi dang bcud chen po/ 14 /'di yi rtsa ba mo ra ṭa/ /tshigs la ta ra ṭa zhes bya/ /dbye ba dgon pa'i bur shing sogs/ /ku na lī dang a na lā/ /mkha' ni po ṭa ka la dang / /ku4 la ka dha ma na/ 4 /yal 'dab la ni skabs chen po/ /gsal ba po ṭa gal dang / /nags dgod pa dang / byeglu khā/ /bya rog bur shing spyad bya gzhon/ /igru gand+ra zhes bya'o/ /sa la rtsa lag skye ba'o/ /i ḍa ka ṭa rtsa ba'i sde/ /mdzod kyi yan lag tsub pa'i dbang / /dpa' byed dang ni ches dpa' ba/ /dpa' bo'i me tog sgo ba'i dgra| 4 /'di yi rtsa ba shir ma dang / /pad rtsa'o de nas chu la nyal/ /'jigs med bsten byed na la dang / /nags tshal bsregs dang 'dod dang lam//lā madzdza ka zhes pa dang / /yang ba'i gnas dang 'khrug ces bya/ 11 /ka rā ma su ri zhes bya'i/ /rtsa ni shin tu dri bzang can/ /bo ra shin tu dri bzang can/ /lha skyes ka ro ti ka'o/ 5 /gdugs dang shin tu gdugs dang skyong / /gdugs kyi rnam pa rtswa'i bye brag /se gho zhes bya ba'o/ /phreng ba'i rtswa dang sa yi rtswa/2 /sha 6 dang ni rtswa gzhon nu/ 2 /rgyal ba nyer rgyas phyugs 'dzin no/ 3/thun mong ma yin rtswa skye ba/ /kun tu skye dang rtswa dmar ro/ /rtswa rnams yang dag bsdus pa ni//rtswa yi stan dang rtswa'i phung po/ /ku sha la sogs pa yi rtswa/ /'dab ma ljang gu can la sogs/ /'bra ko dang ni ke ta ki/ /tā li bee ①ta la sogs lnga/ /hidha la dang bcas pa ni/ /thams cad rtswa dang shing gi ming / /sman gyi rab tu byed pa'o / /zhes pa mu tig phreng ba las nags dang sman gyi sde'o// //seng ge 'phrog byed ri dwags dbang / /ral can gdong lnga/ nga ro can//120—1259

mche ba ldan dang / mig grol dang / /yongs su dbang dang / nags kyi rgyal/ /gtsug phud lnga pa 'jigs byed dang / /rnam par gnon dang / tshogs kyi rgyal/ /glang po 'tshe dang / glang po 'joms/ /ri gnas/ 'phrog byed/ mig dkar ser/ /nam mkha' gnon dang / cha sha 'jigs/ /ri dwags za byed/mdzod ldan dang / /ma rutpa la zhes bya rnams/ 24 /'di yi sgra skad/ bu kwa ra//kṣe ḍi ta zhes bya bar 'gyur/ /gang yang sha ra bha dang ni/ /steng rkang can dang sha rdu la/ /rkang pa brgyad pa glang po'i dgra/ 5 /de nas phyugs 'tshe sha zan dang / /gcan gzan 'tsho byed zhes bya yang / 4 /stag dang dri snom lku'atshe byed dang / /gung dang gcan gzan ri dwags za/ /nags kyi khyi dang yu bā ku/ /zla ba can dang / lus bkra'o/ /ri dwags dgra zhes bya ba'o/ 11 /dred dang ri dwags za byed do/ /phag dang gtsang byed ko la dang / /sa 'joms sa 'byed mche ba can/ /rko byed/ 'thor byed/ g.yang byed dang / /dag byed / sa rlog /mche ba'i mtshon/ /'byed byed dang ni/ su rengs dang / /mgo bo gharmā khab spu can/ /nags kyi hi ra/ ngur sgra can/ /sa rko ba dang / rna chen dang / /mchu rings dang ni 'khor lo'i gdong / /dga' rings / mang skyes/ rab skye mang / 25 /dom la latstsha bha khru dang / /bhāsmra kā ④la lu bhasmra ga /bha lu kā dang / atstsha dang / /phug du nyal/ spu rings dang / /a ba ba du/ ngan pa'o/ 9 /de nas bse la/ khaṅga dang / /rwa can dang ni/ bye ṇi dang / spro ba'i tshogs dang / gatshigs pa can/ 6 /de la ka ni mchog yin no/ /ma he la ni lu khā ya/ /gshin rje'i bzhon thupa rol ba can/ /rdul can dang ni rta yi dgra/ /dā ba si kā sa ra dang / /mee bi bha 720—1260

dang / pukṣa dang / /mig dmar dang ni hi la gnas/ /'jigs pa bcu pa rdul ldan ma'o/ /ga ba la dang / ma te skyes/ /shi ke ①ka tā/ ma he'i bu/ /stag sogs nags na rgyu ba yi/ /dud 'gro rnams ni gcan gzan brjod/ /spre'u dang ni/ mi dang 'dra/ /tī sha dang ni/ gi tha dang / /shing gi ri dwags 'phrog byed dang / /spre'u rgyug byed mchong byed dang / /yal ga'i ri dwags nags na gnas/ /gnyer ma gdong dang 'gro byed dang / /'phar byed 'khri shing ri dwags dang / /sa yi mjug ma rka khi dang/ /kā su 'dzin dang /dmar po dang / /shin tu dam pa zhes bya'o/ 20 /mi dang 'dra dang bya ba byed/ /ba lang mjug ②ces 'ga' zhig 'dod/ /spre'u las byung spre'u rnams kyi/ /rtsed mo la sogs rnams su 'gyur/ /ce spyang dang ni sa la rgyu/ /ri dwags khram pa ba lang 'tshe/ /ngan g.yo ma dang / zhi ba ma/ /'gro byed/ sgra sgrogs/slu byed dang / /sa myos/ khyi 'dra/ 'jigs dang 'dra/ /gnas dang /ce spyang / thra ka ngan/ /phra ma can dang sa mdzes dang / /mtshan mo'i ri dwags tsheg sgra can/ /snu yi sgra can mtshan mo pa/ /ca co can dang / zhi ba 'dzin| /'dzin byed ba lang rengs pa dang / /smin pa dang ni 'khor byed ①pa'o/ /gyen gdong dang ni lce 'bar dang / /ki khi khi dang 'gro byed dang / /rnga mo lo sā zhi ba gnas/ 8 /khri nyal/ rul pa'i rwa rjocan no/ /khri gnas 'gro byed/ khrus mkhan dang / /nags kyi khye dang / nags na gnas/ 5 /ba men/ ba lang rjes su byed/ 9 /lug can/ byis ya/ thob byed dang / /'jam dang / rwa can/ stobs sgrib pa dang / /ba lang dang ni rims nad med| /ri bong dang ni/ spu 'jomasasnyedang / /nags kyi bye ba/ sgeg pa'o//120—1261

zhum shishu zer bu byi la khrus mkhan dang / /byi ba gsod dang / byi ba za/ /mtshan mo spyod dang / byi zas can/ /kun tu la dang/ grong gi spre'u/ /'dor byed dang ni/ lus skum dang / /gong bu'i mig dang / dkyil 'khor can / /rnam sgol mig dang 'bar ba'i mig /me nā do ra/ kanda khā/ /gzugs mo byi dur/ sbra byed dang / /shā bee ṭa dang / sha lya'o/ 2 /de yi sa ni lya 'dod/ /sha lā kā dang / sha la yī—1/ /sha la lo/ sha lo'o/ 4 /dpal be'us mtshan dang / ta ṇi shā/ /'phar ba nags khye 2ri dwags gsod/ 4 /rna ba / bā ta/ pra dmā'o/ 2 /gla rtsi'i ri dwags gla ba'o/ 2 /ri dwags pags pa'i skye 4gnas te/ /sa lus dang ni/ sa 'dre ba/ /ri dwags/rlung bsreg /mig mdzes dang / ṛste/ a ri/ shyan dang / /rnam 'tshe/'jigs ldan/ sgra la 'jigs/ /mya ngam snying dang ko lo gu/ 13 /e saṣpe ya dang / shi lya dang / /tsarmā rghaṃ dang / e ma su/ /ka ta li dang / gser mdog can/ /tsi na g.yag rgod/ dga' byed dang / /ba pa sa rū ru ri dwags / /'di rnams pags pa'i skye gnas so/ /gzhung nag ru ru bye 6ku dang / /saṃ ku sdom pa skyed byed dang / /ba lang rna ba/ ri dwags dang / /e ṇarsha dang ro hi ta/ /tsa ma ra dang / ri dwags dang / /rta dang /mdzes dang / dga' byed sogs/ /gzhan yang ri dwags dbang sogs dang / /ba men la sogs rnams dang ni/ /phyugs kyi rigs rnams shes par bya/ /da byid dang ni go dhwa ra/ /te'u lo pa dang dag skyes so/ 3 /byi ba/ u che ma/kund+ra / /thra ṣa/ 'bigs byed/ rkun po dang / /rko byed dang ni/ bug pa byed/ /bṛ ṣas mtshan dang / dṛ ṣa'i mig /ba 7bhu/ sen rings/720—1262

kun chags so/ 13 /'di yi dga' ma/ rkun byed ma/ /zhan ma dang ni rtags can ma/ / marig mtshan ma skodang bye dzosnagazhan ma/ 6 /'dza/ khyem gyi sre mong dang / /bṛṣa/ dri yi byi ba dang / /sgo sgonda rī nd+raziyang / /rtsangs pa dang ni/ mig sman rtsa/ 7 /kṛ ka lā sa sog — le can/ /nyin sa pa dang ral gri can/ /tse dā ra dang / rtswa'i da byid/ /rtsangs naphran dang ni khyem gyi rtsangs/ /mthu bo dang ni khyim ldan dang / /mdung can ltas shes tsa ṭi gi/ /gshol ldan dang ni/ bkra ba dang / /rgyal ba bzhon pa chen po'o/ 4 /byed pa/ ka rā/ṭi kā dang / /rna chu/ ka sha ta pa ṭi/ /'bu dang / grogs sbur/ mbi lo gu/ /rkang brgyad pa dang / 'bu phran no/ /lte ba bal can spre'u 'dra dang //thur ma can dang / dra ba can/ /sdom dang / thags mkhan zhes bya'o/ /'dis bcings/ rgya dang 'dra ba'o/ /rta shig pa dang sdig pa'o/ /'bu phran dang ni sbur bu dang / /'bu nar dang ni mjug ma can/ /ba mi/za byed/ ka ba ṭi/ /nye lus nye bar phyogs pa dang / /skra 'dra/ nye ba'i lce can no/ /grog ma dang ni/ srin phran dang / /gshin rje'i bu dang / ghu rgyu ra / /dar gyi srin 'bu/ /skud pa'i bu/ /rtsa 'bu/ shing zan yi ge pa/ /steng gi sha dang ma ku sha /mdud can skye ba phra mo'o/ /phyugs la sogs pa'i rab tu byed pa'o// //mkha' 'gro yan lag drug pa dang / /mkha' la 'gro dang / mkha' la 'phur / /pa ta 'ga' dang / 'dab gshog can/ /'dab skyob dang ni/'dab mas skyob/ /bya dang / sgo ldan/ sha kunda/ /sha kunta ya bi ka re/ /baṅgi jer dang / nam mkha'i rta/ /mkhar nyal/ tshong 1las byung ba dang / /120—1263

'dab ldan gshog ldan/ nam mkhar 'gro/ /dge mtshan can dang / lus mgyogs dang / /'gro byed 'dab ma'i shing rta yab/ /mkha' la ①spyod byed me yi mgrin/ /spu can dang ni gnam la spyod/ /na tshod gnas dang / mkhar 'gro dang / /tsadzi dang ni dṛllī tsā②/ /dzā ṣpe ka dang gnyis skyes dang / /lce gnyis pa dang / khri tī shā/ /steng 'gro dang ni shing la gnas/ 38 /'dab ma'i theg pa na tshod gnas/ /thra pa khā kṣa ta ru sha /dpyid kyi pho nya ngag snyan dang / /yu jorbha ①la pi ka dang / /ku snu'i mgrin ldan phrog byed gtam/ /mgrin snyan kha nas ku hu 'don/ /nags su dga' dang / /gzhan gyi gsol/ /khya byug dang ni gzhan gyis rgyas/ /'dod pa'i pho nya ma dhu kaṇḍa/ /'dod pa'i tā la/ ku snu snyan/ /mig mjes dang ni bya rog gsos/ /dbyangs mkhas④/su tra rnga na dang / /dbyangs snyan 'bras bus nam mkha' 'gro/ /nags la rag lus gzhan la sems/ /khya byug skad dang lnga pa dang / /sbrang rtsi'i sgrar yang de brjod do/ 27 /rma bya/ sa 'gro/ mdangs ⑤ldan dang / /bkra ba bkra ba'i 'og pag can/ /gtsug phud can dang rtse mo can/ /ko ki'i sgra can rab g.yo dang / /ki sha ra dga' mgrin sngon can/ /si tā saṅgā zhes bya dang / /'brug sgra'i rjes su sgeg pa dang / /rna rgyan can dang sen mo'i gar/ /gtsug phud can rgya mtsho skyes dang / /'dab brgya pa dang / sprin gyis 0sgeg /me nā da dang mgul pa sngo/ /mjug sgo can dang / legs bris sgo/ /sel sil sgrogs dang lag 'gro za/ /shed la brtse dang brtan par gragasadzee/ /gar mkhan ri mo dmar ser can/ /byi dor byas pa'i mgrin ldan pa'o/ 30 /rma bya'i thig le u ruṇḍa/ 8 /mjug ma mdongs ldan de bzhin du/ /gtsug phud 120—1264

dang ni rab g.yo'o/ 4 /zla kham dang ni mdongs lon 2no/ 2 /thod dang gtsug phud nyid kyang ngo / 2 /ko tī'i tshig ldan gtsug phud can/ /bya rog la ni gtor za dang / /sgra ldan dang ni/ mo ku li/ /kha 2ta bo na ga 'chi med/ /gtor mas rgyas dang / brgya byin skyes/ /lhan 1cig skyes dang bdag nyid sgogs / /dga' bas/ /rgyud dang thos sgogs dang / /'khrig pa sbed dang /luṇḍa ka /dri pa sa dang / kā na dang / gzhan gso —byed dang / drod gsher 5spyod/ /bden pa'i ngag dang / rab dga' dang / /lte ba skyes dang gha kā sgogs6/ /dbang skye sru ṭī/ dīka tra/ /rṇa pa ra 'chi/ dpa' bo can//kā rku nga dang / kā ku shes/ /rilbā ta li gtam can dang / /lan cig dga' dang tsher ma'i tshang / /rdo rje mchu can mdog gcig pa/ /sgogs ldan zhes pa rnams su 'gyur/36/bya rog chen po kā ko la/ /ragha bya rog mo ku li/ /bya rog mnan dang / bya rog nag /'chi ba slu 7ba zhes bya'o/ 7 /de nas 'ug pa nyin mo 'jigs/ 7 /bya rog dgra dang / be tsa ka /mtshan mo spyod dang dri bānda / /brgya byin bshad dang / rna 'khyog dang / /'phrog byed mig dang /bya rog 'jigs/ /sen mo shī sbo gha gha bo9/ /mtshan mo za ba rnams yin no / 13 /dmar ser lin se tsi ka /'ug pa/ tsa ṭi kā yin no/ 3 /kṛghā⑩ /gtum mo/ ri skegs dang / /myos byed thur ma/ rjod byed ma/ /mig bkra ma dang rkang bkra ma/ /mtshon byed brtod pa'i snyem pa'o / 9 /rnam par 'gro byed ku ṇa yī/ /sa 'thor dang ni go rā ṭa/ 4 /bya gag /sa gnas/bā li ka /kṛ mi dang rgo ku ku sgogs/ 5 /ṣpe tso/ 'dab ma za ba dang / /'thor byed yid gzhungs/ tsa bye mi/ /blo gsal shin tu gnas pa dang / /120—1265

'khyog po'i mthu can zhes bya'o/ /sauṣṭha tī dang / mi gnas dang / /ngag skyes/dbang po/ 3sgra dang / /spyod byed sbrang rtsi sbrang rtsi 'dod/ /sprang rtsi brtul zhugs| sbrang rtsi byed/ /sbrang rtsi myang dang sbrang rtsi skyong / /sbrang bu me tog zas can dang / /bung ba nyam ①chung sgrang ma dang / /me tog 'jug dang /me tog rtse/ /ra yi gnyis pa bcud brtul zhugs/ /ge sar 'dzin dang bcud 'dzin dang / /rdul 'chang / skems dang / bcud sbyin dang / /rdul nyal me tog 'thor ba dang / /sbrang rtsi'i dri myang ge sar spyod/ /des ni cha shas mthun sgra dang / /ri skyes dang na ②spos ngad ldan/ /ro myong mchog dag skad cig 'dres/ /snying por son pa zhes bya rnams/ 33 /sī ba ba ta/ sgra snyan dang / /skad cig 'dod ldan 'gyur dga' dang / /rab tu dang dang /kuklu ṭa/ rnyillī sgogs dang / khyem phug ron/ /bā rā ba ta/ ka pa ⑦ta/ /ka pa ka ni phug ron no/ 2 /ḍosbyi'i ④pa rā ba ta ni/ /kha cig khyim gyi phug ron no| /khañdza rī ṭa/ ka ṇḍa ṭīn/ /khañdza le kha/ khañdza na/ /bzang ming gra dang / ni ṣi sta/ /rta lo gyu ni/ bu can dang / /bya rog skugs ⑤dang /mgrin nag dang / /ni dhi ra ta/ sha ra ta/ /karka ra'i mig /ston ka spyod—/ /tshang sbas/ ra ṭa tsa ra dang / /tsa ṭa ka'i/ rgyal char mtshon byed dang / /chang lta dga' ba'i sil snyan dang / /khañdza ri ṭa lan cig dga'/ /lan cig tumbi zhes bya rnams/ 22 /hā yi bu mo/ yungs kar ma/ /bzang mo//khañdza li kā dang / /ma can/ sā raṅga/ bandi/ /thub pa'i bu dang / si ta dang / /khug rta dang ni/ chu nyung dang / /sprin 'degs/ sprin rlong /ma spri shaṃ ku/ /char la dga' dang / dga' sgra sgrogs/ 10 /khug rta gzhon nu tsā sī 120—1266

ha / /zangs kyi gtsug phud kṛ ka sgrog /bya gag rkang pa'i mtshon cha can/ /snga bar sgra sgrogs mtshan mo rig /mig zlum ka lā bi ka dang / /sā la 'gro mkhas tsa ṭa ka /zung gi dbyangs sgogs mtshan mo skad/ /bde legs can dang yongs su mig /dga' byed/ gso byed 'phel byed dang / /pags pa'i gtsug phud mya ngan med/ /nor bu'i mgrin can 'od kyi ste/ 21 /mchil pa ka la piṅka yin/ /rgyab bkra/ khyu mchog bgrod pa dang / /mgrin sngon bkra ba'i rgyal po dang / /khyem du tshong byed/ khyem du nyal/ /rigs can dang ni/ nyer chags rnams/ 10 /de yi chung ma mchil pa mo/ /bu ni tsā ṭa kai ra'o/ /bu mo tsā ṭa kai ba hi/ /ri dwags dbang dang / mchil pa sogs//gsod mkhas/ 'dzin byed 'joms byed pa'o/ / tsi rṇa dkyil 'khor can spyod byed/ /mkha' spyod dang ni ring du smra/ /'pho ba mgrin tshang mkha' la 'khor//rlung gcod pa dang ring 'dor ro/ /de nas bya rgod/ dākṣu tya/ /ring du mthong ba zhes bya'o/ 3 /khra dang ri bong za ba dang / /ba ṭī bā dzi mkha' la 'gro/ /g.yo ba zhes bya rnams yin no/ /tisti ri da sregapa/dang / gshog bkra dang / /sha chu ka biñdza la'o/ 4 /byang chub bha ra/ dā dza'/ 2 /khrung khrung / kruñtsa 'khor la gnas / 3 /biṣṭa liṅgā mdog can no/ /lā ba ka dang / 'gro nyung ngo / /kuklu bha ni ku lā la/ /ku ku ṭa dang / bu ga'i dbyangs/ /sdu mtshan/dud pa du ba skyes/ /a ṭa'i rgyal po/ gshog ldan dang / /hiṅga ka zhes bya ba rnams / 6 /karka re ṭu/ ke ra ṭa/ /ka ṭa ṭu dang / karka rā/ 4 /shing rta mo dang / shing 'joms dang / /mgrin ring dang ni 'dab brgya pa/ /kṛ ka ṇa dang / kra ka ra'o/ 6 /tsā sha /tī ki di bi dang / /gser gyi gtsug phud 120—1267

ma yi rtags/ /de bzhin mkha' 'gro'i rgyal po'o/ 4 /shang shang te'u dug 'chi dang / /'tsho ba 'tsho byed/ tānd+ra la/ 4 /'od la dga' dang / mchu g.yo dang / /tsa ko ra dang / dug mtshon byed/ 4 /rā ti/ rā ṭi 'dam bu'i dgra//mgrin ldan/ gzhon nu/ dā rgyu ta/ /mgrin dkar dang ni/ a kyu ha/ /kā ko maṅga/ kā thā dhu rā/ /gi 3gā tsasmi/ de baṭi2/ /sna tshogs can chu'i bya gag 4 /matpa ra ka /dzhasthā rde/ /ma ṇi tsa ka /chu'i maṅga/ 4 /ṭiṭi shwe dang / ka ṭu'i sgra/ /steng 'gro dang ni/ nyal byed do/ 4 /rgyang grags thos dang / sgra sgrogs dang / /ku ta rā dang / nya 'joms so/ 4 /ngur pa 'khor lo/ /'khor lo can/ /shing rta'i lus kyi ming can dang / /gnyis gnyis spyor dang mkha' la gnas/ /'od ldan mtshan mo 'bral byed do/ 8 /lcags rgyab dang ni/ karja dang / /rkang ring ko la'i mjug ma can/ 4 /ga le gaṇḍa / brka ḍa/ /chu skyar ka la haṃ ba yin/ /chu can rkyal byed maṅga dang / /ki kā dang ni nya 'bigs byed/ 4 /sprin gyi bya dang gtsug phud can/ /mchod stong can chu'i kuklu bhā/ /go bhaṇḍa ra/ 'dam 'thor 4ro/ /rgyal po'i cod pan/hā'i bu mo/ 8 /bya dkar/ ba ka /ke ka dang / /ra ko ta dang / ni she ta//shaṃ ka tu tra/ gtor ma za/ /zla ba'i gtsug phud mkha' 'gro dang / /khyim gyi gtor za/ rkang ring dang / /bi na dang ni thob byed do/ 12 /ba ke ru ka pa khā ka /dug gi mgrin pa can rnams so/ 3 /bzhad dang rdzing bu'i mtshan ma dang / /sgra 'byin ka tsibye ra'o/ 4 /ngang pa mkha' lding dkar po dang / /'chi med 'dzin dang / ma dros gnas/ /dra ba'i rkang ldan mtsho snyeyi bya/ /'khor lo'i yan lag grong 'joms so/ /ngang pa'i rgyal po mchu dag dang / /120—1268

rkang pa dmar po/ lus dkar po/ /dri ma can gyi phreng 'dzin dang / /yul 'khor 1snaskyong ngang dang skya'o/ /pakṣi rā dhri sa ngang pa/ /ka la hi sa zhes kha cig /ngang pa'i chung ma ba ra ṭa/ /bzhad mo dang ni dpal mo'o/ /bi kha'i khu byug de yi yang / /khu byug gi ni baphru bha/ /rtsod pa byed dang tsu thra ti/ /khyim bzang muṇḍa ka ser po'o/ /bcad nyams dang ni gang ba dang / /gzhan spro 2dang ni/ til sgrum can/ ga rorsā dhī/ 'bras bu'ori/ /dbyangs ldan nam mkhar sgeg pa dang / /bkra ba'i skad 'byin zhes pa'o/ /de nas zho can zho tshogs dang / /zho yi gnas zhes bya ba'o/ /pha baṃ/ pags byi'u4/ bhaṅgā rī / /pags pa'i 'dab can/ dza tu dzñā5/ /khyim 'gro dang ni bya rog dgra'o/ /bā gu li dang / ba gu dang / /ta ru hu ni kā ra ṭa bye/ /dha na tstsha kā zla ba 'jug /btson 6lus bya rog mgo zlum spyod/ /'dab chags bye brag hā rī ta/ /kā raṇḍa pa brta kā/ /tu ni kā dang / spo ṭi kā/ /mtshungs so gzhan yang phye ma leb/ /cha ga pa dang me khyer dang / /mun 'joms nam mkha'i mu khyud 'od//mkha' snang dang ni nam mkha'i 'od/ /mun sel/ lam 'od/ 'od sa bon/ /sa ḍā rbu dang zhes bya rnams/ 8 /lci sbur sngon po ma kṣi kā/ sbrang ma dang ni sbrang rtsi skyes/ /grog 7ma putrī ka yin no/ /sbrang rtsi ches nyung sa ra sdu/ /sbrang gi sbrang bu sbrang bu'i dbye/ /bee shaṃ 8dam sha bhambha ḍā/ /nags kyi sbrang bu bhe ra ḍi/ 4 /za byed sbrang bu de rigs gzhan/ /ba rā ṭī dang / gasgo li/ /ga ro lli dang tshangs ma dang / /bar ṭā dang / dug rwa can/ /j-iṅga ḍo la/ pa ḍa la/ /rtswa za byed pa rnams yin no/ /j-iṅga ḍi dang sgyi ru kā/ /ṭī rī rnyi lli kā dag mtshungs / /sbrang gshog can dang dbyangs sgrog dang / /dbyangs byed/ sgra 120—1269

byed / bzi bzir yang / /lham bu chu gshegs sdong po'i 'bu/ /de dbye srar ba ka dang / /lan cig 'bu dang gzhan byed dang / /dus can bhakṣa rā ṭi kṣa / /nag mig dang ni srin bu dang / /uthra ka dang / nyi me tog /bya spu gshog pa sgro dang ni/ /'gebs byed lo ma lus skyes so/ /dpung pa/ gshog rtsa/pakṣa ti/ /gshog sgo'i phreng ba a riñtsha līlku/ /'phur dang 'gro la'o/ /rab tu 'phur dang shin tu 'phur/ /yang dag 'phur/ rab 2'di rnams ni/ /mkha' 'gro rnams kyi bya ba'o/ /sbubs dang / mdzod dang / shubs sgo nga /4 /mchu dang gcod byed/ nyer 'dzin can/ 3 /rigs dang / lus/ yan lag /gsar skyes/ /byis pa/ bu phrug dang / phrug gu/ /bum bu/bye'u / 7 pho mo 'dus dang / 22 dang / /zung dang / dor dang / kha 'tsham dang / /gnyis ldan gnyis pa mtshe ma dang / /phrugs dang / bubs zhes bya ba'o/ 8 /tshogs dang / don mthun/ spyi 'dus pa/ /tshogs pa/phung po/ tshogs 'du ba/ /bsags pa dang ni spungs pa'o/ /yang dag tshogs dang bsags dang tshogs/ /'dus pa sde dang / dra ba skyes/ /bṛnda/dkyil 'khor/ ku dudza/ /ni ka ra dang / sto ma dang / /bi sa ra dang / pā sta dang / /saṃsmra dang / saṃ na ya/ /khaṇḍa/ sa mu da ya dang / /kṣa two dang ni ba ṭa yo/ /saṃ ha ti dang / ni ba ha/ /ni tsa ya dang / tsakra dang / /tsakra bā lo/ ka lā pa/ /bi ḍa ka dang / pra ka ra/ /sa ri ka ra/ yu baṃ yang /zhags pa skra las gzhan tshogs pa/ /grong gi sgra sogs sngon ma can/ /tshogs pa'i dbye ba sde tshan mtshungs/ /rigs mthun dang ni/ chos mthun pa/ /de yi rigs dang mtshungs pa dang / /'dus dang don mthun rigs skye'o/ /dud 'gro'i 120—/270

khyu dang phyugs kyi tshogs/ /gzhan rnams la ni 'dus par 'gyur/ /'ga' zhig don mthun tshogs pa'i tshogs/ /phung po/ mchod rten/ srungs dang /tshogs / /brtsegs nyepa'o phug ron tshogs dang ni/ /ṣpe tso'i tshogs dang rma bya'i tshogs/ /sreg pa'i tshogs sogs de yi tshogs/ /khyem gnas bya dang ri dwags dang / /de dag lhag ma 'ga' zhig gzung / /bya la sogs pa'i rab tu byed pa'o/ /seng ge la sogs pa'i sde rdzogs so// //sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi dang yid skyes ma nu'i bu/ /shes ldan/yid ldan/ shed bu'o/ 6 /skyes pa/ lnga skyes skyes bu dang / /skyong byed dang ni pho rnams so/ 5 /mo dang / mi mo mtshams ldan ma/ /btsun mo/ yo ṣā/yo ṣi ta/ /'ching byed/ zur blta/ g.yon ma dang / /dga' ba'i sa gzhi mchod ldan ma/ /stobs med/ pā yā/ drag mo dang / /stobs ldan/dga' ma/ g.yon byed ma/ /gnas byed ma dang / skyed ma dang / /bu mo/snying po can ma dang / /legs dga' ma dang / gnod skyong ngo / 12 /dbye ma dga' ma/ dga' byed ma/ /'dod ma/ g.yon ma/ phul byung ma/ /'dren pa mo dang / spyan ma dang / /lus ldan ma dang la la na/ /'jigs ma/sgom ma/ smad rgyas ma/ /rab myos/ mdzes ma/ sdug gu ma/ /bcu gnyis ma ste 'di rnams so/ /khro byed ma dang / 'jigs byed ma/ /gtum mo dang ni/ kro dha nā/ /zhes pa 'di rnams mtshungs pa'o/ 4 /mchog dang /rab skyes/ gsal ma dang / /mchog gi lcug ma myos gsal ma/ 5 /rnam mkhas ma dang / tshigs ldan ma/ 2/gzhon nu ma dang ta lu ni/ /chags 120—1271

pa'i na tshod ldan ma dang / /na chung / nor ldan/ phyogs byed ma/ /'thab mo can ma rnams yin no/ 7 /dar ma/ grong 'dzin/ myos ma dang / /gsal ma/ dbang bsgur/ byas btsun mo/ /longs spyod can ma mi bdag ma//lus ldan ma dang bdag ldan ma/ /lag pa 'dzin dang / gnyis pa mo/ /chos bcas ma dang / chung ma dang / /khyim na spyod ma ka la tram̐/ /'ching byed/shin tu dam byed ma/ /'dzin pa mo dang skyed byed ma/ /khur ldan ma dang /lhan cig spyod/ 22 /gnyen byas/ khyem gsar/ bag gsar dang / /dang po'i rdul dang khro 'dam masna/ /rang gis 'dam dang kha dum dang / /sa rā bambi/su ta dang / /po tā yu ka spyod byed ma'o/ /rigs kyi ma dang / rigs skyong ma/ /bdag po gcig ldan/ bden ldan ma/ /legs spyod bdag po'i brtul zhugs ma / /legs ma rnams so de nas ni/ /ma 'ongs rdul ldan dkar gcer mo/3/gzhon nu ma dang / bu mo'i tshogs/ /nag dga' ma dang mchog sbyin ma/ /na ba pa ti kā rnams so/ /pho nya bcas ma mthong bzlog dang / /rdul bcas ma dang / char ldan ma/ /rdul mthong ma dang / bu mo dang / /snying po can dang / bar ma can/ /gsar bkod/ gsar pa mchog can dang / /rdul gsar gser 'debs dang me tog gsar/ /me tog mthong bar bar ma'o/ 20 /cung zad lang tsho ldan pa la/ /gnas pa pha khyem nges gnas ma/ /khyem pa mo dang / grong 'dzin dang / /bu bza' can ma skyed ma dang / /dga' ma/bag gsar/ mna' ma dang / /snyan pa'i pi wang sgra sgrogs dang / /nges sgrogs / de bdag sa gaṅga / /rā bi snga da dang pa ra ti/ 7 /g.yo ma/'phyon ma/ rang dbang ma/ /'ching ma/ bden ma/ phyag dar ma/ /120—1272

mtshon byed/ rigs tshogs dum bu yi/ /ngang tshul myos pa'i phreng ldan ma/ /dubyadhī dang / mtshon ma dang / /'ching ba sbyin dang cha shas byed/ 11 /'dod ma/ sgo dza na/ dha na di ṣisgo ba sa/ ba tī kā/ 'dod ldan ma/thra ṣa srudhī/ tu kā mi thu ṣpesgo ra tyasba tī/ kādhwa rti mbi tu yā yā te saṃ ge tai sā bhe sā ri kā/ 1 bā dhī na bhaju kā suta/ tyaghā bye/ yabee shaḥsri ya yā su kalpi ti telpa snyi sunda rī/ pa sa ba rja ni ma tra pa ka padzdza bi yas mā ga mo tri bi 1pā laddhā sa ma ya bye/ du tī kā bye6 yadma taḥ ba rī 3shaṃ yī ta saṃ/ ke to reḥ na me la ti thra yaḥ 4 yā ba byerma pri ya ko pā ta tsā ṭu ka rañtsa nirga tā tīsu ta 3nu sha yeḥpañtsa ṅka la hanta ri tā hi pā/ 5 uta kiṇḍa tā tu pā ya snga bā pa/ be thra ni shā ga taḥthra yo nā ga ma ṣpe hentu bibye4/ yarnyi pa mā ku lo/ 6 ku ta byeta kā ra ṇa ta ya suḥpri yo da shāhaṃ 5re ga ta kṛ 6twa ba dhī ṭi rna pārtu rngo ྾ ta pre ya rpā beeta/ 7 ku tabyedza ga ti kādhe kun tu gdung ma dum bu ma/ /mdzes ma dga' ma rtsom byed ma/ /rnam par sbyangs byas mig ma'o/ /de ni dga' ma'i gzhi dang ni/ /dga' ba'i phur bu zhes pa yang / /bi thraṣā dang skal ngan ma/ /bu bdun btsas bu/bska rā/ /bud med gcer mo gos me ma/ /mthong ldan ma dang byis pa thob/ /lang tsho zhags ma theg bral ma/ /dpa' mo min dang rgyu mthun ma/ /so sor bdag ma rjes bcas ma/ /byed pa'i gzhi dang rnam ston ma/ /yid ldan dra ma can ma'o/ /rang dbang ma dang gzhan khyim gnas/ /legs dbang ma dang bzo byed ma/ /bud med ces pa'i mtshan nyid ma/ /pe ṭa sha dang dre sha dang / /'tsho byed ldan ma thos ma dang / /mi yi phreng ldan ma rnams so/ /ma ruṇḍa dang dpral ba'o/ /ngur smrig 7gos dang ldan pa yi/ /rgan mo kā tyā nī ya mbi/ / 120—1273

rgan mo skra dkar dge ma'o/ /rgas dang 'khogs dang rgan mo'o/ /blon po rgan min btsun mo'o/ /phrin skyel pho brang spyod ma'o/ /shes rab ma dang mkhas ma dang / /shes ldan ma dang blo ldan ma/ /dmangs mo dmangs rigs chung ma yi/ /dmangs dang de yi rigs kyang ngo / /dmangs rigs chen mo ā ddhā rī/ /rigs dang skyes pa spyor dag mtshungs/ /slob dpon chung ma slob dpon ma/ /skyes spyor thra shra sogs ldan pa/ /'phags ma rgyal rigs ma dang ni/ /rgyal rigs chung ma mkhan po ma/ /mkhan po'i chung mar 'gyur ba'o/ /rje mo rje rigs chung 'phags ma/ /rgyal rigs bu mo rgyal rigs ma/ /mkhan po'i chung ma mkhan mo ste/ /khrog dang kha ton byed par 'gyur/ /slob dpon ma nyid 'ba' zhig go/ /dpa' bo'i bdag ldan dpa' chung ma/ /dpa' bo'i ma dang dpa' skyong ma/ /skye dgu'i bdag mo skye dgu ma/ /rab tu skye dang rab skye ma/ /zla mo grogs mo na mnyam ma/ /pho nya mo dang kun spyod mtshungs/ /mo ma mig mthong lta shes dang / /de nas rdul dang ldan pa dang / /bud med chos ldan dus ldan ma/ /dri ma ldan dang me tog ldan/ /skyed nad dang ni khrag ldan ma/ /rdul dang / me tog zla mtshan no/ 3 /phrug gu chags dang mig blo mangs/ /rlog med ma dang zla mtshan sangs/ /mngal chags ma dang sbrum ma dang / /bu che ma dang lus mi bde/ /tshogs can ma yi tshogs rnams dang / /sbrum ma gzhon nu ma rnams tshogs/ /lan bu can ma re dma' 7dang / /tshong kha bud med tshogs can ma/ /zug rngu byed ma ṛtstsha lā/ /gzugs kyi tshor ma mdzes ma dang / /'dod pas btsan ma ngan rol ma/ /rtags can re mos smra ma dang / /phra mo pyos pa'i sbubs can ma'o/ 13 /gal te de byed skye bo yi/ /120—1274

tshogs can re dma'i 1gtso mor 'gyur/ /lus bsgyur ma dang lcug rīldan ma/ /bkab pa'i tshogs can ma zhes kyang / /mdza' mkhan ma dang sbyor byed ma/ /kha lo ma dang dga' byed ma/ /lta ba mo dang sbrang rtsi ldan/ /skul byed tshogs can bran mo yang / /ra ba bsrungs dang / ra ba byed/ /sa skyong zhal ba/sped byed pa/ /yid gnas khang spyod 'brangs mo byed/ /tshogs byed 'tsho skyes po ṭā'o/ 5 /phrin skyel dang ni grong du spyod/ /nye grong 'bangs gtso/ tsha bcas ma/ /nges sbyor so rtsi byed ma dang / /pha rgya ka dang / tta kā'o/ /zung can ma dang / zung bud med/ /rab 'phrog theg pa sbyor byed ma/ /kir ti dang / bla ma dang / /gzhon nu rlung yab 'dzin ma'o/ /bu mo shing dang snying po'i shing / /ku ruṇḍi dang / sdong po bstan/ /chu skyes sngo dang /'dod ma dang / /'di nyid thal ma byed ma'o/ /shudhī lcags kyi ka ba dang / /gzugs can 'phrog byed gser rang bzhin/ /lnga lan ma ma dang / bu mo dang //po dang gos la sogs sprul ma/ /gnyis grags/ beer byung de bye 6/ /de yi bdag bo dhi di 6/ /gnyis skyes bcas dang bu bza' 4ma/ /de la de mchog de dhi ṣā/ /gang las slar byung de dag go/ /'bangs mo 'bangs las 'bangs med pa/ /gang gi sba bya bee dha'i bu/ /bee dha ba skyes ma med skyes/ /phyi mo meed dang / bee ma tra/ /bskal bzang bu dang bskal bzang skyes/ /gzhan gyi bud med skyes nal phrug /gar mkhan bu dang gar ma'i bu/ /pha yi sring mo las skyes dang / ṣpe ṣpe las skyes rnams yin no/ /ma yi nu mo las skyes dang / /sgra gnyis bu mo 'dod pa'o/ /rigs 'chol dang ni byi phrug go/ /slong mos 'tsho zhing skyes pa la/ /da ni ka lo ṭi ṣpe ya/ /rigs sgyur 1dang ni bdag skyes 120—1275

so / /bu mo'i bu dang ka pa'i na/ /pi shu dza zhes bya ba'o/ /ma gnyis bu dang ma yang bu/ /ma mchog bu rnams mtshungs pa'o/ /rya mṛ 1ta dang dzā ra dza/ /kuṇḍi mṛ ta/ go tsa dang / /go na ka dang bdag byes dang / /lus skyes bu dang gnyis pa'o/ /kun 'dzin byed rang skyes dang / /bu smad bu dang / lto byung / rgyu/ /skye byed dang ni dag 2byed do/ /mo la bu mo smra ba ste/ /bdun 'dir bdag skyes ma la sogs/ /bu mo blo ldan btsun mo dang / /mnyam byed lus kyi kun spyod ma/ /rang skyes/ zhing skyes brang las skyes/ /brang byung gnas skyes dbang gnyis pas/ /skye dgu/ bu rgyud/ rgyud skyes/ /bu / /u ta na sha ya/ ḍimbha/ /'o ma'i mgrin bcas nu ma 'thung / /'khyud 'thung / khye'u/ bu byis pa/ /phrug gu/ gzhon nu/ gso bya dang / /smin rgyu/ 'o 'thung / shā ba ka 14 /nyal 'tsho/ bu mo/ 'o 'thung ma/ /lus la 'thung ma rnams yin no/ 4 /yab dang / skyed byed/pha dang ni/ /a pha skyed go/ gso ba po/ /skyed par byed pa po rnams so/ 7 /skyed ma/ ma dang / a ma dang / /'dzin ma/ rab skyed/ mchod sbyin 'don / /skyed byed/ skyed ma/ zhing ma dang / /mngal 'dzin ma dang bcas ma'o/ 11 /ma gzhan ma ma 'dzin ma dang / /nye ba'i ma ma zhes pa'o/ /sring mo/ swā sā/ bha gi dī/ /pra dza gipa ti/ srun zla'i chung / /bdag po'i sring mo snying mo'o/ /chung ma'i spun zla skud po dang / /yā ta ra ni tshig ma'o//bdag mo'i pha ma gyos sgyug snyego/ /de dag la ni gyos po'o / /bu mo'i bdag dang mag /pa dang / bā ra tī ra shya la ka /byā li kā dang ke ni ku pe/ /kā de bri dang de ba byer/ /chags rtsibs pra rgyu/ dand+ra dza/ /tra ya zhes pa 120—1276

rnams yin no/ /pha yi spun zla/ khu bo dang / /ma yi srun zla zhang po dang / /bdag can dang ni ma'i skra nye/ /de yi chung ma ṣpe ṣpe mo/ /sring mo'i bu dang /sring mo skyes/ /tsha bo dang ni/ srun las skyes/ /bu yi bu 1dang / bu mo'i bu / /bu dang bu mo'i bu ru 'dod/ /de dag tsha bo nayang tsha'o ma yi pha dang / pha yi ma/ /de dag phyi mo yang phyi sogs/ /skyed byed dang ni skyed byed ma / /gyos sgyug dag ni/ shwa shur/ /bu dang bu mo/ bu to'o/ /bu yi bu la sogs pa 4yang / /spun zla sring mo ming 5sring dag /khro shug bza' 6 mi bza' bo dag /pha yi pha ni mes po dang / /de yi pha ni yang mes po7/ /ma yi ma ni phyi mo sogs / /phan tshun gso dang / rigs brgyud ḍadang / /skye gnas mtshungs dang ming sring dang / /lhag pa'i skyes dang tshangs pa mtshungs//rang las legs skyes bdag nyid shes/ /nye du rtsa lag 'brel pa dang / /rus bcas / 'gro ba/ bgo 1skal spyod/ /dri bcas myur ba/ snag dang bcas//gnyen dang / de dngos tshogs pa dang / /gnyen 'byel/ 'dzin byed/dga' ba'i bdag /gtso bo/ sbyin byed/ 'tsho dbang phyug /snying dbang / dga' ba/ lci ba dang / /rtsed 'jo'i rten dang / dga' ston bde—/ /srog mgon snyeng la phan pa dang / /nga rgyal dang ni/ mngon 'dod shing / /mchog dang / mchog byed bza' ston pa/ /a dī ta tso dang / ā dī ka /dzi zher/ nye bdag /sdig pa'i bdag /nges 'dzin gtso bo sngon skyes dang / /dpal dang / thu wībo/ sngon las skyes/ /de nas rjes skyes ka nī yang / /mthe'u chung dang / ya rpā ya/ /phyis skyes dang ni rjes su skyes/ /mngal gzugs dang ni na tshod gnas/ /gzhon nu/ thor bu/ lang tsho can/ /720—1277

lo yi theg pa bcu pa dang / /lang tsho nyams dang rgas 'khogs rgan/ /lang tsho yol dang / gnas brtan rgan/ /brgya pa tshe song rgas 1chen po/ /thu bo/rgan rim/ rgan po'i tshogs/ /smin dang na tshod yol ba dang / /skra la sogs pa dkar ba'o/ /byis pa bu tsha/ phrug gu dang / /dar ma/ lang tsho/ldan pa mtshungs/ /gnas brtan sangs rgyas/ ches rgan 'phel/ /gsum pa'i rang bzhin za ma dang / /ma ning dang ni pho ma ning / /nyams pa dang ni/nyug rum mo/ /mtshan gnyis pa dang / bo ṭā dang / /gsum pa'i rang bzhin de gzhon nu/ /rgyan gyur byis pa'i zla ba dang / /mngal ldan dang ni/shya re ṇa/ /mngal gyi brgyad pa lha'i zla ba/ /'gro byed dang ni 'o ma smin/ /gnas dang skyes pa'i tshal dang ni/ /skyes pa'i gnas zhes bya ba yang /mtshams mtha' 'dren byed snying po'i gnas/ /snying po can dang ldan pa'o/ /rtsa ba'i zla ba gzhan skyed do/ /mngal dang rum ste 'di dag mtshungs/ /mngal dang / bu rogs phru ma dang / ulle dang ni ka la lo/ /'chi med/ lte ba dang ni/ rgyun/ tsa lu byis pa smra ba'o/ /skyes bu ngan dang / skyes bu smad/ /de la bram ze'i khye'u yang / /skra bcas/ skra ldan/ skra can dang / /sa yod / skra ldan sa la'o/ 5 /zhi ba/ piṣṭa/ khal tī/ khadhri ṭa dang /khadzee'o / /dbang po/ lutta ldan pa la/ /ant+ra nalupta ka zhes 'di/ /u la la ni/ lo ma sa/ /thraṣṭa ra le thulus can la/ /sha med/ nyam zhechung rid pa dang / /stobs med ces pa'o bzod ldan dang / /stobs ldan/ stobs bcas / sha rgyas dang / /phul byung stobs can zhes pa'o/ /gsus po che dang / lto 'phyang dang / /lto ldir/ sked 6sbom/ gsus rdzing can/ /sna 120—1278

nyeg pa dang / sna leb ①dang / /nyeg po dang ni/ sna gong med/ /sna snyung dang ni sna rings so/ /sna bcad pa dang / sna byegs pa/ /mig pa'i sna can/rmig sna'o/ /sna mtho dang ni/ sna sgur ro/ /yan lag ma tshang / yan lag nyams| /sgur po dang ni/ lag pa 'jas/ /gyol po dang ni/ 'khyog 'gros can/ /bya 'gros byed dang / sgu po ②dang / /skra med dang ni/mgo rlum mo/ /sgur 'khyog /nad can/ dbye ①dgu can/ /yas 'jog can dang steng pus mo/ /sgyid 'khris dang ni pus mo 'byar/ /gom ④rlabs can ⑤dang rab 'gro bus/ /dkar dang skra can lus can no/ /nad gcong rjomed dang nad bu med/ /gso dpyad sman gyi bya ba dang / /rtsi dang / sman dang / gso byed dang / /nad sel dang ni/ 'tsho byed do/ /na dang /khams mi bde ba dang / /nyams ⑦mi bde dang / tsha ba dang / /na tsha dang ni mnar ba'o/ /cha med/ nad dang / kun tu zug /kun khyab dang ni/nye bar gdung / /dza kṣa zad byed/ skom dzeend dang / /dbugs mi bde dang byud pa dang / /byud nad/ skyigs bu lud pa dang / /glo dang /skrangs 'bur/ rnag 'bur dang / /skrangs pa zhes pa rnams yin no/ /sha bkra| nag po/ sha mtshan can/ /smre ⑨ba dang ni/ nag thig go/ /za 'phrug /za byed/ pra ta ti/ /rā ka/ glang shu/ khye rngo ⑩dang / /pags pa'i me tog/ /pags rdul ⑪dang / /g.yan pa dang ni/ rkang shu dang //rkang pa⑩/ rkang pa'i grog mkhar dang / /rko byed/ rkang pa'i gaṇḍi ta/ /za tsheg /bem tsheg g.ya' ba dang / /rngo shu/ g.ya' 'phrug /phol mig dang / /'brum phran/ rnam phye/ so sor 'phye/ /rma dang / rmas dang 120—1279

ma tu dang / /pags pa tsha ba ki ṇa'o/ /phra mo'i rma dang / rtsa yi rma/ /rtag tu 'dzag pa'i rma dang ni/ /dbang po 'dzag dang / skra 'joms dang / /ko pi tha dang / rtag tu'o/ /rgyab gzhungs dang ni garga dang / /bshang ba'i phugs bu can rnams so/ /a shra/ ming ngan can dang ni/ /mtshungs pa'i skye ①gnas/ gzhang rtsa'i ming / /chu 'gags pa dang / chu bsdams dang / /zas rlon dongalgekhar mi 'ong ni/ /tshang 'khru dang ni/ tshang nad dang //rjes su dri ldan lto ba'i nad/ /lus kyi rma la 'brog ①mkhar can/ /ma ru ri kā sdig pa'i nad/ /raktab ḍi ④'di la ni/ /rkang 'bras dang ni phol mig go/ /padma can dang / tsher ma can/ /g.ya' ba/ skya sbab/ dkyil 'khor can/ /rgyu ma nor can/ rlung 'bras dang / /'khrogs pa/ pa la lā sha ya/ /mkhris pa pa la/ rims/ mā yu/ /mi skyong ba dang / mi 'thor can/ /ka pha/ sedha/ gug pa dang / /bad kan stobs dang / snum pa yi/ /skye gnas can dang / mchil ma'o/ /skyugs pa/ zas ldog /skyug ⑤nad dang / /skyug rjobyed/ 'dor byed/ rtsa nas 'byin/ /mngon par bsrub dang / lta ba dang / /skyed dang 'dzin dang / phyi mo dang / /yu ba gaṇḍa/pa raṇḍa/ /ku raṇḍa dang 'phel ba dang / /garbaṇḍa dang lte ba dang / /gu ḍa ka dang / mchu lte mtho/ /shu ba'i nad dang / dkyil 'khor can/ /mdze nad sha bkra/ skya bo'o⑦/ /nad dbye/ dri chu bsdams pa dang / /rde'u ⑧nad dang ni/ bee dra bhi⑨/ /zug dang / gsus rdzing / dmu chu ⑩dang / /chu sri/ mtshan par rdol ba'o/ /nad 'joms/ nad sel/ sman pa dang / /'tsho byed dang ni/ gso dpyad 4spemakhan/ /skyon shes/ tshe yi rig byed 120—1280

pa'o / 7 /nad sos pa dang nad kyis btang / /nad las de ma thag mgo zug/gtam dang / nad med ka phya'o/ /rnam 'gyur med par de brjod do/ /nad kyis btab dang mi gsal dang / /rang snang mi sdug /mthu drug dang / /bro 'tshal ba dang / gdung bas gzir/ /nad can nad pa/ yun ring na/ /rngo ①can dang ni glang shu dang / /rlung nad can dang / rlung can dang / /me dbal dang ni spru shu mtshungs/ /'khru skyugs dang ni/ rgyu gzer ro/ /sha bkra dang ni/ me dbal dang / /'brum nad/ yu to/ gzhang 'brum mo/ /mig tshag /tshag po/ mig nad can/ /pi1 klinde mig tshag po/ /'on pa rna ba mi gsang dang / /lug ltar lkugs dang ngag thos min/ /der ni lug 'dra'i lkugs pa dang / /bems po ltar lkugs ngag mi brtanacha/ /tshig nyams ngag gis ①dbul ba dang / /tshig mi gsal ba dang / sems bems po/ /mig gcig zhar ba mig bzang dang / /long ba/ mthong bral/ chu ser dang //bad kan/ bad nad/ ka shī lo/ /lte chen/ lte 'bur/ lte ba mtho/ /rmongs dang / brgyal ④dang / dran nyams so/ /myos ldan smyo dang / smyon pa'o| /rtsa dang 'bab ldan zhes pa'o/ /shig 'dzin dang ni/ shig ldan dang //gong bu 'dzin dang / byin pa sbom/ /gsus can dang ni/ chu lto can/ /bum pa 'dzin dang / bum pa can/ /sman pa'i mtshams zhes bya ba rnams/ /khu ba sa bon stobs brtson 'grus/ /thig le gzi brjid dbang por 'gro/ 7 /sha dang pa lam pa la lam/ /bi shi tam dang / ta ra sam/ /ā mi ṣam dang /u ṣas mo⑤/ /dza gra lam dang / kra bya dang / /dza tu tham dang / tsā ra ṭi| 11/sha kam dang ni/ baphru ra/ /shin tu bskams pa zhes bya'o/ /dug gis 120—1281

btab pa'i mtshon cha yis1/ /bsad pa'i phyugs sha kṛñtsa nam/ /khrag dang /dmar po rakta dang / /rna skyes sho ṇi rnga rte'ador byed/ /mi ltung rang skyes/sha'i 'gyur ba/ /lus skyes sha yi khu ba bcud/ 12 /snying sha /sha mchog /snying po/ snying / /tshil dang / zhag dang / snum bag go/ /mdangs dang /rkang mar / khu ba bye4/ /mgrin pa'i phyi rtsa/ ltag chu ba/ /'bab ldan rtsa dang / nā ḍi'o/ /thod pa/ bde mchog /bde skyong ngo / /pags pa dang ni khrag 'dzin dag /klad pa dang ni/ klad rgyas so/ /sgo tram̐/ ka liṇḍa ka'o/ /mtsher pa/ yā kṛta/ kā le yam/ /mchin pa dang ni/ llīhaṃ/ /ti la kai dang / klo ma dang / /garbha ṭa dang / tarṣa byu/ /kāṇḍa rā dang chu rgyus che/ /rgyus pa/ chu ba/ chu rgyus so/ /rgyu ma dang ni/ gang ba can//mchil ma/ kha chu 'dzag pa'o/ /dri ma/ 'dab ma/ ki ṭi'o/ 3 /rna ba'i dri ma rna spabs so/ /snabs dang sna yi dri ma'o/ /pi spi kā dang / so skyes dri/ /lce yi dri ma/ hu lu shaṃ/ /gci ba/ rab 'dzag /usgo rī/ /ma lo sa kṛ ta/ bska ro/ 6 /bshang ba5/ 'bab ldan/ khyab ldan dang / /dri ma/phyi sa/ brtsa ska/ /bi 66/ bi ṣa/ brtsa'o/ 9 /rus pa'i khams ni nā ruṇḍa / /ku bye dang ni tī ka shaṃ/ /lus rus/ keng rus/ rus pa'i gzebs3//yal ga'i rus pa na la kai /rgyab rus ka she ru ka'o/ /mgo bo'i rus pa ko hūṃ ro ṭi / /rtsib 9ma'i rus pa pārsha kā/ /lus dang khog pa pe ram̐ dang / /band+ra/de ha/ sha rī ram̐/ /piṇḍa/ kā ya/ bi gra ha/ /mūrti/ ta nu/ tabyu dang / /phung po/ zhing dang / pañdza ra/ /saṃ ha na rgo/ gang dag dang / /ba su/ shaste/ pa ram̐ dang / /dbang po'i skye mched aṅge dang / /mūrti zhes 120—1282

pa rnams su 'gyur/ 23 /yan lag /pra ti ka dang ni/ /a wa ya ba ko ma lo/ /aṅga maṅge/ phyogs gcig dang / /a ya gha na zhes pa rnams/ 7 /rkang pa/ rgyu byed/ parda/ pad/ /e ghi dang ni kra ma ṇa/ 6 /rkang rtse dang ni pra ba rda/ 2 /rkang mdud/ bhu ṭi ka /gusbra/ /rting pa/ phyi dang /goḍa ri/ /rkang pa'i rtsa ba zhes pa'o/ 7 /byen pa dang ni/ phra pre ta/ /baṭī/ba da— bān dang / /pus mo'i nye ba'i tshigs can no/ brla dang / pasbri'o de'i mtshams ni/ /paṃ kṣa ṇa dang pā su ram̐/ bshang lam/ 'og sgo/ thur lam / rkub/ /ta rgyu/ hra dang / 'og lam dang / /bshang sgo/ dṛ ①ti| pabhā'o/ 7 /lte 'og /mdoms ②dang / sked sdepa dang / /sho ṇi ka kurma ti'o'i/ /rked pa dang / 3 /rked pa ska rags yul dang ni/ /ska rags 'bras can/ ka ri haṃ/ /gser can gnas dang 'ching ba dang / /ka ṭī/thra tha/ mbi ṭa'o/ /bud med rnams kyi 'phongs kyi ni/ /phyi ma'i cha ni ni tasbra//mdun cha dza gha na zhes dang / /rgyab kyi gzhung rten dri ke'o/ /de'i sgo/bha ga skyes gnas dang / /masta ka'o/ /rkub tsos ④dang / /ni tasbra sgo/ /kun tu reg /lte 'og kyu bi tuṇḍi dang / /tundi rga ⑤ru/ skye ba'i gnasaske/ /gnyis dga' khyim dang bha ga dang / /myos byed dang ni mandi ra/ /byed pa'i yan lag chu ma dang / /gsang ba 'khor ba'i lam mi bzad/ /'og sgo nyer gnas mo'i rang bzhin/ /mtshams dumin/ rten dang / brjod bya'i phyogs| /de bzhin dran pa'i khron pa dang / /skye 'dzin dga' ba'i bu ga dang //me tog lam dang srid pa byed/ /bu gnas grong dang rmongs pa dang / /rmongs byed dang ni/ myos byed do/ 22/rtags dang / me dha/ me ha na/ /nyer 120—1283

gnas / she ba sgrub med dang / /nyal byed/ bde byed/ gtun shing dang / /myos byed/ lcags kyu/ haṅga lo/ /dran pa'i ka ba/ stsos 'khri shing / /mtshan dang / chags 'khri/ rgyal mtshan no/ 34 /sgo ba/sgo nga / mdzod dang sbubs/ /'bras bu'i mdzod dang / lte ba dang / /gsus pa/ dzaṭha 1 ra dang ni/ /dku dang / tunda zhes bya'o/ /brang skyes/nu ma/ 'o ma 'dzin/ /ku tsam/ logs skyes/ lang tsho'i mtshan/ /nu sor / nu tog /sngon nyid dang / /rgyab dang lus kyi phyi ma'o/ 4 /'byar dang / kun tu 'byar ba dang / /dbus ma dang ni/ bar ma'o/ /brang dang / nam tshoms/ byang khog stod/ /ko ḍi /ko ḍā lag pa'i bar/ /snying ga /'tsho ba'i gnas dang gnad/ /phrag pa/ lag pa/ mgo bo'i cha / /de yi mtshams ni dza tru ṭwā/ /lag pa'i rtsa ba gnyis mchan gung / /de dag 'og ni rtsib ma'o/ /spyod byed/ 'bab byed/ 'jug byed/ lag /gru mo / bar tshigs/ ka pha ṇi/ /gru mo'i steng ni bar lhu dang / /gru mo'i 'og ni lag ngar dang / /ki khā ṭī 4zhes bya ba'o/ /lag pa'i rtsa ba nor bu 'ching / /lag pa'i mjug 5ni karlu ṣe/ /lag pa tha snyad byed pa dang / /yal ga /lnga pa/ sug 6pa dang / /glang sna 'dra dang / dpung pa'i 'dab7/6/'khrig ma lag pa'i mthe chung bar/ /ka ra sgo dang lag gzhag go/ /sor mo bye lag pa'i yal ga ste/ /mje bong sor mo'i thu bo'o/ /rab tu ston byed mdzub 3 mo'o / /gung mo dang ni/ mo ste ba can/ /mthe'u chung dang / tha chung ngo //lhag ma ming gred du bshad do/ /sen mo/ slar skye/ sder mo dang / /myos byed / lcags kyu/ lag pa'i dpa'/ /lag 'khrungs/ lag skyes/ lag 120—1284

pa'i tshigs/ /kha ru/ i la/ lag pa'i mda'/ /spyod byed tsher ma ka ra ṭa/ 12 /ston byed mtho dang / ba lang sna/ /mdzub mo la sogs rnam pa'o/ /mthe bong / mthe chung / mtho la ni/ /sor mo bcu gnyis zhes bya'o/ /thal mo/ thal lcag /pra tai ①la/ /lag mthil sor mo brkyang ④pa'o/ /saṃ ha ta la gnyis tshogs so/ /pra ta la ni g.yas dang g.yon/ /lag pa cung zad skum khyor ba/ /de dag sbyar ba snyim pa'o/ /lag ngar rgyangs pa khru zhes bya/ /khu tshur bcangs pa bcag khru'o/ /a ra la ni mthe chung rgyangs/ /de yi khra bo ⑦khu tshur bcangs/ / 'dom ni dpung ⑦pa lag par bcas/ /de dag 'phred la gyes pa'o/ /steng du lag pa brkyangs pa ni/ /mi yi tshad dang skyes bus so/ /byā yā ga ⑤dang bi yā ma/ /lag pa gzhu dang lus kyi 'dom/ /ol mdud pa dang mgrin pa'o/ /skye dang / mgo ste/ mgo 'dzin dang / /mgo rten dung mgrin ri mo gsum/ /kā ka lo dang mgrin nor bu/ /bum pa 'dra zhes bya ba'o/ /ltag pa dang ni ltag chu ba/ /kha dang gdong dang / smra byed dang / /mchu dang / zhal dang / ngag 'don sgo/ /snom ⑦byed/ dri 'bab| sna bug /sna/ /ghoshā dang ni nā si ka /nā se kyi dang / shilbi ni| /na sgyu/ ni kre/ garnya nā si kā/ 11 /ya mchu/ ma mchu/ so sgrib dang / /so yi gos dang / so 'ching dang / /bcud myang / ngag 'dab| so 'dzin no/ 8 /de yi 'og tu ko sko dzeedang / / tsa tsū ⑧ka ma dang /'dod byed dang / /so dang / gcod byed/ rkan/ thag 'gram/ /sen mo/rmig pa/ rnon po dang / /mche ga 'dong stibyed/ gnyis skyes so/11 /gargo/mkhur tshos/ ka po la/ /de yi pha rol za 'gram pa/ /ste dang / bdud rtsi 120—1285

'dzag pa dang / /ro shes/ ro myang / lce ro ldan/ /bcud kyi ma dang /ro ma dang / /ta la na na/ ko ku'o/ /mchu yi mtha' ma/ ba yi gru/ /kha dang bdud rtsi'i rten/ /sbrang rtsi/ /rkan dang / kā ku de dag go/ /kustso smin ma'i dbus yin te/ /mig gi steng ni smin ma'o/ /lta byed/ 'dren byed/mig dang / spyan/ /tsagru dang ni/ dbang po dang / /tre ga dang / lta stangs1 / lha'i sgon ma/ /lta ba gsal ba/ asba shaṃ/ 12 /mchi ma/ mig chu / rlangs pa/ g.yos/ /gsher dang / 'dzag dang / dus las byung / /rdzi ma'i mig gi nor bu'i khyem/ /a pāṅga ni mig gi mtha'/ /mig gi 'bras bu/mthong ba mig /mig gi mtha' yi lta ba la/ /mig ngan/ zur mig phyed bltas so/ /rna ba/ sgra 'dzin/ sgra yi gnas/ /thos byed/ nyan byed/thos pa dang / /sgo tram̐ sgo ta zhes pa'o/ /dpral ba rgyan can byā la dang / /mig 'dzin yan lag mchog dang ke/ /mgo dang / spyi bo/ klad pa can/ /muṇḍa / shiste / mi zad bde/ /skra dang / 'khyil ba/ slar skye dang / /ka tsa/ mgo nyal/ mgo skyes dang / /'dor byed dang ni spyi bo skyes/ /ta shā / skra can/ skra tshogs can/ /skra tshugs/ma skra 4ba re/ /skra yi snying po can dang ni/ /ral can/ skra dkris me tog bcings/ /yang dag sdom pa'i skra dang ni/ /ku ra la dang / lhas ma can/ /skra 'khyogs le kharba dang / 'khums//thor tshugs skra zhags/ ka ṭi ra/ /brtul zhugs ral pa dzha ṭa'o/ /skra yi bar gnas dang bye/ /rgyan dang / skra lo 'khyel pa 'dra/ /de rnams dpral ba'i bung ba dang / /bya rog gshog pa/ gtsug phud can/ /lan bu/ skra ldan/skra'i lhas ma/ /ral pa skra yi tshogs legs pa/ /skra zhags 5phyogs dang lag pa 120—1286

shar / /skra las pha rol tshogs pa'i don/ /lus skyes sru dang ba spu dang / /de rgas sma 1ra kha spu'o/ /skyong byed mgo zlum bcas sma ra/ /ba spu/ gu tstsha ra ba bkra ma can/ /mi la sogs pa'i rab tu byed pa'o// //gsal byed/ mthong byed/ snang byed dang / /brgyan 2pa dang ni rnam par brgyan/ /rgyan gyes brgyan byas rgyan byed dang / /yongs byas rab tu bsgrubs dang brgyan/ /mdzes bcos rgyan bcings na 1ba thu ma/ /so so'i bzo dang mdzes par byas/ /rgyan gyi bya ba brgyan gyur dang / /lhab lhub rnam rgyan dang ni rgyan/ /yongs su bcos dang dkyil 'khor rgyan/ 6 /cod pan dang ni dbu rgyan dang / /rtse phran dang ni ki ri ṭa/ 4 /gtsug phud nor bu mgo'i rin chen/ /gtsug gi rin chen gtsug nor bu/ /do shal dbus gnas ta ra la/ /'dren pa dang ni mtshungs par 'gyur/ /skra zhags dang ni skra yi rgyan / /phud kyu dang ni dpral ba'i rgyan/ /dung dang tsandan gcod byed pa/ /mthong bar byed dang dpral ba can/ /rna ba dregs byed tā ḍaṅga/ /rna rgyan dang ni rna ba dkris/ /tā la pa ṭa ta la'i 'dab/ /ze 'bru can dang / rna ba'i rgyan/ 4 /rna zhags rna ba'i srad bu'o/ /bung ba'i mgrin dang ska rags dang / /ske rgyan/ mgrin ldan/ rma bya can/ /mgrin rgyan dang ni mgul pa'i rgyan / /mgrin rgyan 'chang dang swanta dang / /la lan ti kā rab 'phyang dang / /mu tig phreng dang si bo ḍa/ /mu tig srad bu mtshams do shal/ /phreng gcig dang ni dkris gcig pa/ /de nyid rgyu skar phreng bar 'gyur/ /mu tig nyi shu rtsa bdun pa/ /gutstsha sum cu rtsa gnyis dkres/ /nyi shu bzhi dkris gutstsha phyed/ /gang zhig drug cu rtsa bzhi dkris/ /de ni do shal phyed pa'o/ /nyi shu dang ni 120—1287

drug cu dag /mā ṇa ba ka ba'i nu ma/ /bzhi dkris byas pa lha bdun pa/ /gang zhig brgyad 1dkris byas gyur pa/ /de ni rnam rgyal bdun pa'o/ /do shal brgyad brgyad dkris pa'o/ 4 /lnga brgya yi 'od zer tshogs/ /dkres byas nya phyis dung dkris dang / /lag 'gro gnyis 'thung ri rgyud skyes/ /de dag las byung mu tig rigs/ /nya phyis las ni yang dag byung / /gdu bu dang ni lag gdub dang / /ka ṭa shaṃ dang lag skor 3ro/ /lag rgyan sor gdub sor mo can/ /rlabs ldan yi ge dang bcas pa/ /sor gdub rgya ldan zhes bya'o/ /asgojo ni zhes pa'ang de'o/ /dpung rgyan dang ni bar lhu'i rgyan/ /gser gyi lag gdub ke ka ṇa/ /lag skud sor 'brang ka rantu/ /bud med rked rgyan 'og pag dang //ro ldan ro ma/ gser can dang / /tshogs can bdun pa/ ka ghra'o/ /skyes pa'i rked rgyan dang ni sgrog /rkang gdub tu lo ko ṭī —dang / /mañdza ra dang zhabs gdub po/ /ngang pa can dang rkang skor dang / /g.yer ka 5dang ni dril 6chung can/ /rigs ma'i nor bu rkang zhags dang / /rkang pa'i sor gdub zhes pa rnams/ /pags pa 'bu yi srin bu dang / /spu rnams gos kyi skye gnas yin/ /ras gos ras bal 'bras bu la/ /snam bu 8ri dwags spu las skyes/ /gos dar srin bu'i sbubs las byung / /zar ras zar ma la sogs las/ /sar pa'i gos dang so ma dang / /gos sar kun dga'i ras dang gos/ /uṅgā ma byā ya zhes pa/ /bkrus pa'i gos zung gang yin pa/ /'dab ma bal dang ras gos bkrus / /rin thang che dang nor chen po/ /nad bsal du kyu la yi ras/ /gyon gos dang ni spyod gos so/ /gos dang g.yogs ma na bza' 7dang / /gcer skyob/ bgo ba/ aṅga sha /tsa 11ram̐/ so tai/ pags pa dang / /720—/288

thra ta rnam par bsags pa dang / /sta te dang ni ras rnams so/ 13 /gos zad/gos rnying / gos rul lo/ /dar gos/ gos bzang / gos phung po/ /gos chen/ ṣpe tso la/ /smad gos/ /ngar khebs dang ni/ bla gos so/ /bar gos/ smad gos/ pa ri sgo/ /sham thabs dang ni mthang ①gos so/ /stod gos/ thra ha ti kā dang / /bai ga sdekhya dang stod g.yogs dang / /sarnya na dang bla gos so/ 6 /mdoms ①dkris dang ni smad dkris so/ /bud med mchog gi smad gos ni/ /tsaṇḍa ta ka'i gos yin no/ /gos dang mgo dkris nā raṅgi④//kun tu dkris pa zhes bya'o/ /rkang pa'i rtse mor khyab pa'i gos/ /gang de sra bde ma zhes brjod/ /steng du bgo ba sillī dang / /utstsha li kā gnyis yin no/ /phra mo'i gos ni du kyu la/ /nakta rka dang karba ṭa/ /ba mo'i gos dang be'u ris so//kha ⑤ba rlung po skyob pa'i gos/ /'dir ni gos dang e ku sha /añtsa la zhes bya ba'ang 'dod/ /srid du ring ba ā ro ha/ /zheng che ba dang bi shā la/ /smad gos dang ni dung ba rjocan/ /nī bī dang ni ba rti bzhin/ /bud med rnams kyi phal che ba/ /khru bcu pa dang gnyis yin no/ /dngos po dang ni bi shi kā/ /bsags pa dang ni shā phru ra/ /lwa ba snam bu dmar po'o/ /mtshan khung spyod dang logs su spyod/ /gos spyod pa dang gnyis yin no/ /bla re dang ni stod g.yogs dang / /gur dang sbra zhes bya ba yang / /yol ba dang ni sgrib g.yogs dang / /mi snang byed dang gos g.yogs so/ /de nyid gos g.yogs yol ba'i gos| /gur dang sbra dang khyim gnas dang / /gon gnas gos khyem gos rang bzhin / /'phrang 'dzin rtsed mo can dang ni/ /'khrang khyim dang ni yon tan gnas| 9 /yongs bcos lus kyi bcas legs dang / /'dag chal khrus rtsi 120—1289

dag byed do/ /urpā da na tro ma nyid/ /bye ma bgos dang ldan pa'o/ /lus la rjes su byug pa dang / /pa rti dang ni kha dog can/ /rnam par byug dang rnam par gcod/ /bska ①bas byug dang yang dag thob/ /lus chags bgos dang phung bar byed/ /dbang bskur mngon par 'khru ba dang / /dbus dang rgyal byed kun tu rgyal/ /'khrud pa dang ni 'khru ba'o/ 7 /tusbra snang dang bye'u 'dzul—/ 7/sbyong byed/ gnas/ zegs/ rjes su 'gog 2 /sor 'dab 'phrin yig 'dab ma dang / /'dab lcug dang ni snye cha'o/ /ta ma la 'dab thig le dang / /ri mo'i bye brag bris pa'o/ /gla rtsi dang ni/ dri'i gos can/ /ri dwags lte ba ri dwags myos/ /myos pa'i mtshan ma dri yi thod/ 7 /gur kum/dpa' bo/ 1 sri ṇi/ /manda④/ ha ri/ tsandan dang / /kha che mchog dang /kha che skyes/ /tsandan dmar dang yang dag 'khums/ /snang byed/ nyi ma/dmar ming can/ /dzā gu ḍi dang / spru ta rna/ /sī ta kā dang / be ri dang //ser sna zur dang / dri zhim dang / /lus dmar/ a bi/ me'i rtse mo/ /me tog don can/ sarba ṭi/ 4 /sprin gyi snying po ras bal dang / /kha ba'i phye ④ma 'od dkar dang / /rdul gyi snying po zla ba'i thal/ /kha ba'i ming can rtogs byed dang / /shing gi snying po ro'i ge sar/ /ma la ④ya skyes dri'i snying po/ /dpal gyi dum bu tsandan dang / /bzang dpal mā ṇa yo ru dang / /bya me ke ⑤ga/skyed pa dang / /gos can/ mdog can/ tsandan dkar/ dri zhim btags dang / snying po ser/ /kha ba yā rmya zhes pa dang / /dri zhim dkar po zhes pa yang / 17 /til 'dab can dang / sa mchog dang / /'phrog byed tsandan zhes pa dbang / /rna ba nag mo dus rjes 'brang / /skye can dang ni/ khyab 120—1290

'jug skye1/ 4 /a ga ru dang rgyal mnyes byed/ /dmar po sprin skyes dzoṅga kai/ /ba ṇi ka dang / dri yi shing / /bya rog gdong dang tsandan ser/ /dus skyes/don ldan/ dzosgra ṇi/ /nags kyi tsandan mi bdag dga'/ /shing nag /mdog sbyin / mdzes sbyin byed/ 16 /a gu ru nag a gu ru/ /bkra shis phreng dang /dri dang ni/ /tsandan dmar dang 'dab ma'i lus/ /rañdza na dang sa'i tsandan/ /snum ldan dang ni bsam mi khyab/ 10 /si santu ram̐/ rna ba 'dzin/ /ko la ka dang snum 'bras dang / /sbubs skyes dza ti pha sngul mtshungs/ /zho dang 'o ma mar gyi mtshan / /dpal gyi gos dang thang chu'o/ /sbyar spos dang ni pā ya ba/ /rakta shīrṣa ka zhes so/ /gnod sbyin spos dang spos dkar dang / /sra rtsi byed dang kun ldan dang / /gzugs mang nor bu spro ba dang / /pri ṇa ka dang / mi'i lcug ma / /ā ra la dang sdong po can/ /grags ldan gdong bkris 5g.yo ba'i gdong /12 /tu ruṣka dang se 6hla dang / /snum can dang ni g.yo ming can/4 /gong bu can dang dag byed dang / /gnod sbyin spos dang sbyar spos so/ /rgya skyegs/rgya tshos/ dza tu dang / /tshos dang shing gnas yā ba dang / /nisgo tpa.āoṃ/ /tshos kyi ma/ /kha dog mchog ldan zhes pa rnams/ 9 /ga pur gla rtsi a ga ru/ /kasko la rnams mchod sbyin byug /gnas nas gnas gzhan song ba yi/ /bdun pa sha za'i spos yin no/ /dri dang phreng ba la sogs kyi/ /legs byas gang de sta gon no/ /thod du legs bsdams dga' dang bcas/ /de ni mgo bo'i me tog phreng / /rna ba gang bar blta byas te/ /de bzhin mchog de rna ba'i rgyan/ /dri zhim ma ru ba ka yi/ /phreng ba bsgrigs pa ta ma ni/ /me tog phreng ba spyi bo'i ste) / /skra yi dbus su snying po can/ /steng du 'phyang dang rtse mo 'phyang / /mdun 120—1291

'phyang la khā pa ko bosna/ /rab 'phyang drang por mgul du 'phyang / /me tog ga shal se ral kha/ /gang zhig 'phreng bcings brang la'o/ /nges pa'i phreng dang dri med mtshungs/ /li shi lha yi me tog dang / /lha rdzas dang ni dpal ming can/ /so sor 'bad dang 'chad rtsom pa/ /'dul byed ka tsa nārja ka /sngar/ dngos/mchod dang rtsol byas dang / /rtsol med dang ni yongs su rdzogs/ /mal dang nyal sa gnyid sa dang / /nyal byed dang ni nyal ba'o/ /gral dang skyil krung skyil mo krung / /lhan cig khri la 'dug pa'o/ /gdan khri chung ngu 'dug khri dang / /sngas dang / nyer brten3/ nye bar bsnyesagu/ /spang leb can zhes bya ba'o/ /a si gaṇḍa zhes pa dang / /ko la gand+ra bā ṭu kā/ /gabee tsā tu ri zhes pa'o/ /dri yi phye ma/ ma la āoṃ/ /byu ga /sā dza la/ dang ni/ /pha ru ke zhes bya ba'o/ /za ma tog dang / ga'u dang / /chol 4zangs dang ni mchil ma'i snod/ /bu 5ga'i khri dang sa na ka /prarjo/ ka ṭa ko lā kā/ /dus min byu ga'i phye mar 'gyur/ /dus min kun tu 'dres pa'o/ /so 6rtsi sha ke ma sra baṃ/ /i bhe kā dang guṇḍa ka /ka ṭa shriṅga la gar 'gyur/ /ri skyes dang ni kadhwa kā/ /sgul byed dang ni gu ḍa'o / 4 /mar me rab 'bar snum za dang / /bcu 'gugs bud shing bcu pa dang / /mtshan mo'i snang byed khyem nor bu/ /dud pa skyed dang snum la dga'/ /'bar ba'i ral pa can rnams so/9 /bung ba/ lta byed/ mig sman no/3 /de nas kau myu dī'i shing dang / /sgon shing dang ni gtsug phud shing / /mkhas pa'i khri yi bar la ni/ /khri dang / gdan dang / stan rnams so/ /skra shad dang ni so mangs dang / /skra chas/ skra yi byi dor ro/4 /btags dang gos la bgos pa dang / /dri mar byas dang rul song ba/ /rani byug khaṃ/ dul dang zhi/ /rlung 120—1292

g.yab spudang ni/ bsel g.yab 2po/ /me long kun mthong mū ku ra/ /mu ku ra dang karka ram̐/ /zhes pa snyan dngags 4mkhan po mkhas pa 5dpal 'dzin sde yis 6 rnam par bkod pa sna tshogs gsal ba zhes bya ba ming gzhan mu tig phreng ba las mi'i sde rdzogs so// //rgyud dang rigs dang rgyud 7dang ni/ /byung ba/ sngon skyes/ rjes 'gro dang / /rigs dang rus dang cho 'brang dang / /de yi rgyud ces bya ba yang / 9 /rgyud skyes/ rigs skyes/ rigs las byung / /rnam bltas dang ni rigs las 'khrungs/ /rgyal po'i rigs las byung ba la/ /rgyal po'i sa bon can rgyal brgyud / /rigs chen rigs bzang 'phags rigs dang / /rigs mchog skyes bu dam pa rnams/ /rigs bzhi bram ze la sogs te/ /gnyis skyes gnyis skyes shin tu byung / /tshangs pa'i bu dang bram ze dang / /pā ḍa pa dang / kha las skyes/ /gru skyes/ skye ba gnyis pa dang / /a la ya dang / mgren sku can / /rigs kyi thu bo rgyal mtshan can/ /yu dzā na bya brjod pa dang / /rgod ma skyes dang bzhi mdo ba/ /dbang bcas slar brjod skye ba'o/ /bram ze dang ni tshangs las byung / /bram ze'i chung ma dag la ni/ /bram ze mo dang rje btsun ma / /dag pa'i mtha' las byung ba dang / /bram ze dang ni tshangs pa'i bu/ /'di yi las drug mchod sbyin byed/ /klog dang sbyin la sogs dang ldan/ /bram ze dang ni gnyis skyes rigs/ /rgyal rigs rje'u 9rigs dmangs rigs dang / /de skye ta rī ya dang ni/ /da ta yā ta ma zhes 'gyur/ /tshangs par spyod dang khrims ldan dang / /nags na gnas dang dge slong dang / /rnam pa bzhi ru 120—1293
