gnas pa yin/ /rigs ldan tshangs spyod mkhas pa mtshungs/ /mkhas par byed dang kyu ba mig /de nas khyem ldan thu bo pa/ /gnas can khyem bdag 'dzin pa dang / /khyem yid can dang khyim rig go①/ 6 /nags gnas/ khyim med| bī kha ②na/ /dge slong dang ni kun tu rgyu/ /las sbyin bā ra sā ri dang / /maska ṭī dang legs gnyer gnas/ /yongs su 'dod dang dka' thub dang / /dka' thub can dang brtul zhugs can/ /kun tu rgyu dang yongs bsrung ba/ /dka' thub nyon mongs bzod dang 'dul/ /thub pa dang ni ngag bsdams pa'o/ /ring du mthong dang ring po mthong / /mdzangs dang rtogs ldan mkhas pa dang / /brtan pa/ sems shes/ shes rab can/ /skyon shes—/ kun shes/ snyan ngag mkhan/ /rigs ldan/ blo ldan/ blo bzang dang / /dpa' bo/ grags thob/ rnam par gsal/ /blo mchog go ba can dang / mkhas/ /grangs ldan dang ni rnam par dwangs/ /gsal ba'i sgo dang dus yig can/ /yi ge slob byed ces bya'o/ 15 /klog tu 'jug pa mkhan por 'gyur/ /dbang sogs byed pa bla ma'o/ /grwa pa nye gnas slob ma'o/ /bya ba byed dang gsar bu'o/ /gnang bcas rigs dang sgo glegs ①can/ /bslab pa ④rtogs dang / dang po pa/ /bsam pa can dang snyan ngag byed/ /tshig gi mtha' pa bstan bcos rig /bgegs mtha' ba ⑤ya pra khyu ha/ /bya nā ya dang shī la ni/ /yon tan goms dang nges sbyor dang / /rnam bshad rnam par 'grel pa mtshungs/ /gsang sngags 'chad byed slob dpon te/ /yul lugs 'dzin pa brtul zhugs ducan/ /mchod sbyin byed po mchod sbyin byed/ /zla ba'i btung ba dī kā ta/ /mchod sbyin mang ldan mchod sbyin byas/ /yā dzā 120—1294

mchod sbyin mtho ris 'dod/ /phur bu'i mchod sbyin sbra pa ti/ /zla ba'i chang 'thung so ma paḥsna/ /rig byed kun la mchod sbyin byas/ /mtho ris kun gyi yon gnas so/ /a nu tsa na rab brjod kyi/ /rig byed yan lag bcas pa bslabs / /bla ma'i bka' yi rjes gnang thob/ /sa mā dṛtta zhes pa'on/ /su tā 4mngon par khrus thob bo/ /gcig pur tshangs pa'i brtul zhugs spyod/ /cig 5shos tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod/ /sa tīddhā ni bla ma 6gcig /pra baṃ anda bā da ni/ /mi ldan sbyin sreg mkhan du 'gyur/ /bsags ldan me ni idha cir7 / /brgyud pa'i man ngag e ti bye/ /bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa yis/ /man ngag yang dag rab sbyin pa/ /nye bar shes dad dang por shes/ /shes nas rtsom pa nye ba'i rim/ /mchod sbyin gyis sreg a dhwa ḍa/ /mchod sbyin dang ni rgyud bdun pa/ /ma kha tra tu saṃ sta ra/ /gral dang / rgyun dang / thos pa'i las/ /bde ba'i chu dang / bla re'o/ 13 /rgyal po'i mchod sbyin bcos pa dang / /mi yi bdag po'i a dha ra/ /'don dang sbyin sreg mgron 'ongs mchod / /mtshun gsol ba dang gtor ma ste/ /'di rnams mchod sbyin chen po lnga/ /tshangs pa'i mchod sbyin klog 'don pa/ /lha yi mchod sbyin sbyin sreg yin / /mi yi mchod sbyin mgron blo'ongs mchod/ /pha mes mchod sbyin mtshun tshim byed/ /'byung po'i mchod sbyin gtor mar brjod/ /'khor dang yongs bskor tshogs pa 'du/ /sa mi ti dang se pa dang / /sa mi ti dang saṃ mi bye/ /kun tu gnas dang sa rda dang / /na na dang ni 'dus pa'o/ 12 /khyem dang dang po'i rgyud dang ni/ /dang po/ sbyin sreg /'dus pa dang / /'phral 'dus pa dang / tā ra dang / /sa bhā sa da/ rab tu bsten/ /'dus dang 120—1295

cho ga blta ba'o/ /sdeb sbyor shes dang thos ldan mtshungs/ /sho 1ti/ sho tri ya tā'o / /rigs 2tsam dang ni nyer 'tsho gang / /de ni bram zer 'gyur bar bshad / /a dhwa srud dang / bhra hri gidang / /sbyin sreg byed po mchod sbyin dang / /snyan tshig rig byed rim pa las/ /aspru dhri 5sogs las phyi rol/ /dus mchod rig byed spyod byed pa/ /mchod sbyin zla ba'i bgrod pa dang / /dbang po'i brtul zhugs mtshungs pa'o/ /de ni sam stu pa'i mchod sbyin/ /bstod pa'i sa gzhi skye bos dbeen/ /rig byed sa gzhi yongs su sbyangs/ /thang mnyam pa dang bzhi mdo'o/ /sbyin sreg thab la ta ra ni/ /ma hā rī ro me ma khā/ /sbyin sreg du ba nges tshigs so/ /sbyin sreg thal ba beṣṭa tai/ /phyugs btags srog shing tsa ṣā la/ /bum pa shin tu bskor ba'i khyem/ /srog shing rtse mo ta rma'o/ /rtsub shing rtsub stan a ra ṇi/ /lho yi me dang / khyem gyi me/ /ha ba ni ste me gsum mo/ /me 'di gsum la te tā'o/ /dri ṇa ta ni legs sbyangs me/ /sa mṛ kṣ-i ni yongs su spyod/ /nyer spyod me ni rab tu spyor/ /gang zhig khyem bdag dā dī ma/ /lho phyogs me ni pra ṇi ya/ /de ni ā la sur 'gyur ro/ /de nas sdeb sbyor gā ya ṭī/ /udzee ka la sogs kyang ngo / /des brjod yam shing sreg rdzas dang / /de ni me yi gter du brjod/ /a mi kṣu sā pri to ṣṭi/ /'o ma zho dang sbyar ba'o/ /sreg rdzas smin pa tsa tu te/ /zas mchog dang ni 'o thug go/ /ha 7bya lha zas 'o ma can/ /ka bya mtshun gsol zas yin no/ /de dag 'o ma ldan pa la/ /sru ṣa byin dang sru ṣa can/ /rlung yab dang ni bsel yab ni/ /ri dwags pags pa las byas pa'o/ /dgang gzar blugs gsar 9la sogs dbye/ /blugs gzar bra dhra ba nyer 'dzin/ /sru kashrī byu sbyin sreg byed/ /gzar bu 120—/296

mar la 'dri byed pa'o/ /u pa kṛ ta dud 'gro ni/ /mchod sbyin ched du gsod par btags/ /phan tshun zhing dang gsang gtor byas/ /gsod pa'i tshad kyi byugs yin no/ /brjod bya'i rtags ①can pra rmā ta/ /bsnyen rdzogs 'thor 'thung byas nas gsod/ /sreg rdzas sbyin sreg sbyin byas pa/ /zas ldan pa ṣa ṭa byas pa'o/ /de gnyis gcig ste mchod sbyin lha/ /sbyin sreg rdzas bānda smra/ /de nas thub pa smra ba bcad/ /dikṣa'i mtha' can mchod sbyin gtso/ /de dag gsod las byed ya rnyi yi/ /mchod sbyin las 'dod byurta'o/ /khā ta la sogs las rnams so/ /'dod pa'i pūrta la sogs las/ /a mṛ ta dang ①pi gha sa/ /mchod sbyin lhag ma'i bza' ba ste/ /mchod sbyin lhag ma'i rdzas dag ni/ /snod can sbyin dang rnam par gtong / /gtor ma 'bul ba sbyin pa dang / /nye bar 'gyed dang khrurnam par gtong / /rnam byen brims dang rnam par bkram/ /so sor byin dang mngon du bstan/ /'bul ba yon dang me tog go/ /gshin don ster ba sbyin pa ste/ /lo dza de nyi ka zhes bya/ /pha gshin sbyin bā ṣpe ba sa/ /shing ④zan de las bstan bcos sbyin/ /'phags pa can dang bsod snyoms sogs| /pha mes bya ba brgyad pa dang / /nyin mo'i cha dang ku ta pa/ /dus ston zla dus mchod pa'o/ /lha yi sgo dang lha'i ltar mo/ /gyad kyi ltad mo ma hūṃ ri//ko sha la can yun ring dang / /'don pa po dang chos smra ba/ /mngon par 'ongs dang mgron ⑤'ongs dang / /rab 'joms 'joms dang bi shi kā/ /tshes zad 'dzin byed mthun pa dang / /ba ku la dag mtshungs pa'o/ /mnyam pa rkang pa 'dzin pa dang / /mngon par smra dang nye bar 'dzin/ /gsong por rjosmra ba rnam pa gnyis/ /nye bar kun 'dzin cho ga bzhin/ /mngon par smra bya 120—1297

mchod par byed/ /dag pa rnam par bcas mchod mtshungs/ /gtor ma'o gus par nyan pa dang / /rnam par gnas dang nye bar gnas/ /yongs su spyod dang nye bar spyod/ /spyod pa dang ni spyod lam gnas/ /tshol ba yongs su tshol ba dang / /rjes su tshol dang kun tu tshol/ /gsol ba dang ni zhu ba'o/ /slong dang mngon par slong ba dang / /don du gnyer ba zhes bya'o/ /mchod pa'i ri ni mchod yon te/ /zhabs kyi ched du chu zhabs bsil/ /'gron po glo bur gsar 'ongs dang / /legs ①skyes zhes pa rnams yin no/ /'gro dang 'khyam dang slar yang 'gro/ /'chag sdepa dang ni 'gro ba'o/ /nye reg dang ni zhal bsil lo/ /gaṇḍa ṣa dang kha gang byed/ /mthar gyis pa ①dang go rims dngalge//yongs su rim pa rjes su rim/ /shin tu gnas dang yongs su 'gro/ /nye bar dgod dang nges pa dang / /brtul zhugs bsnyen gnas bsod nams can/ /shin tu gso dang nye bar gnas/ /bsnyen gnas kun nas sgol byed dang / /'da' bar byed dang brtul zhugs mdzes/ /zla ba bsnyen gnas byed pa dang / /gcig mtha' gsum mthar za ba dang / /zas drug pa dang dus can dang / /mchod sbyin gnas dang mchod sbyin brtan/ /dben pa tha dad bdag nyid dang / /glu len pa dang rig ⑤byed 'don/ /tshangs pa'i rig byed 'don pa dang / /mtshan mo grub pa brjod par 'gyur/ /tshangs pa dang ni bi ra li/ /klog cing kha chu 'thor ba ni/ /tshangs pa'i thig le zhes par 'gyur/ /skyed dang rig rjobyed klog ⑦pa ni/ /tshangs pa'i ba rtsa sa las byung / /yon tan sparma sa ti ka'o⑧//der ni mtho ba'i yan lag kyang / /bsam gtan rnal 'byor stan ⑨dang ni/ /tshangs stan rtogs pa'i cho ga rim/ /gtso bo dang ni rtogs ⑩pa'o/ /rjes kyi 120—1298

rtog pa rjes gcod pa/ /'du byed sngon du 'dzin pa ni/ /nye bar byed dang thos pa'o/ /tshangs spyod dbang po mtha' dag sdom/ /dbang po thul dang grong du zhi/ /zhi dang sdom brtson ①sdom ldan dang / /brtul zhugs che ldan yo bhiṅga/ /gtsang gnas khrus kyi sdebartul zhugs can/ /gang zhig brtul zhugs dbang gis ni| /thang nyal gcer nyal sthaṇḍi la/ /de nas chags bral ta ma pa/ /nyon mongs dang bral gnyis las 'das/ /rtags dang spyod pa chos phreng ldan/ /gsal ba'i brtul zhugs ①bkram pa'o/ /gang zhig rmongs pas srun zla yi/ /thu bor bag ma byed de'i gcung / /pa ri be rtar de shes bya/ /pa ri be ste de'i phu bo/ /bī ba ha ni rnam ④nyams med/ /brtul zhugs ⑤skyes dang 'du byed 'dor/ /ro langs brtul zhugs rjocan thams cad/ /mngon par dang byed gdur bar byed/ /dngos med dang ni du ni hā/ /gtong ba myur 'gro tshangs spyod can/ /pā ṣāṇḍa dang rigs ngan dang / /kun gyi rtags can gsum po mtshungs/ /spyod byed dang ni sgol byed dang / /tshul khrims spyod pa gtsang ba 'ongs/ /gtsang ma/ dag pa/ dri ma med/ /bsod nams dang ni yid gzhungs so/ /sā khā sha yi dbyug 'dzin dang / /chu stod kyi ⑦ni brtul zhugs ⑧can/ /chu shing dang ni 'od ma 'dzin/ /g.yang gzhi dang ni ri dwags lpags—/ /bud med brtul zhugs ⑨bstan/ thra ྾/ /spyi blugs/ chu snod bum chung ngo / /mchod rten kha dang me tog can/ /ka ra ka zhes bya ba'o//bsod snyoms pa dang slong mo pa/ /'tsho ba pa dang bslang bya ba/ /slong mo can dang sbyin byar 'gyur/ /'di yi bsam gtan ldan dang byed/ /kha ton dang ni bzlas brjod dang / /khrus byas khrus chu sa ba ni/ /rig byed dang ni bzlas 120—1299

kun gyis/ /sdeg pa 'joms par byed pa'o/ /mthong ba bco lnga gnam stong la/ /phyogs mtha' so so'i sbyin sreg snabyed/ /rtag tu lus sgrub ltos 2snapa yi las gang de ni rtsol ba'o/ /rtag tu las ni yang dag sdud/ /gya tshom gcig gi tsu ka ta/ /nges pa gang zhig rtag tu las/ /glo bur ba la bsnyen bkur bsgrub/ /de nas lhag ma dag byed 'gyur/ /mchod sbyin sa rī bā ba ta/ /u ba bī ta mchod sbyin gyi/ /srad bu dang ni gnyis skyes ldan/ /tshangs pa'i skud pa dag byed de/ /lag pa'i g.yas phyogs rab tu dkri/ /shādhī nā rpā ta g.yon dkris//ni bā ta ni mgul bar 'phyangs/ /pañtsa ba ṭi brang dang sked/ /mchod phyir thogs dang yang dag ldan/ /mchan khung phur ma ko pā ni/ /katstsha ngos su ldan pa'o / /dpral bar thal ba'i re khā 4gang / /sol ris gsum dang tirya ka /be khāe ta yi thig le ni/ /bhā la dang ni ba dan gsum/ /sor mo'i rtse mor tīrja lha/ /mthe chung rtsa bar tshangs lha'i chu/ /gung mo mjeb mdzub mtshun gye chu//mazeb chen rtsa bar tshangs chu sbyin/ /tshangs pa beer byung tshangs nyid dang / /tshangs pa yang dag ldan pa dang / /lha sogs skye ba de bzhin no/ /dka' tshegs dka' thub la sogs pa/ /mal med 'gro ba bhā bhya na/ /shes bya lta ba bye das grol/ /byu di to tre rim ji bzhin/ / sadhya sa ba tyān 5dang / /sa ṣpe pher mornyed la sogs dang / /'gro byed mkhas byung tshul 'chos dang / /tshul 'chos pa yi bya ba'o/ /sde gsum chos dang 'dong pa nor/ /sde tshan bzhi pa thar ba'o/ /de stobs bzhi ldan tshangs pa yi/ /grong ba'i lam gyi mchog yin no//bden smra shis brjod bstod pa rnams/ /'dun par drang srong chen po rnams/ /bram ze'i drang srong gnas 'jog sogs/ /thos sogs byas pa thos drang sogs/ /120—1300

a tri 'dab sogs rgyal drang srong / /skabs kyi drang srong rnams kyang ste/ /ji mi la sogs rig byed pa/ /rgyas pa dang ni 'od srungs pa/ /dga' ba dang ni gling skyes bu/ /thra ta ko ṭi bden ldan bu/ /pha rol 'gro dang gnas byed dang / /bde )ldan ma yi bu dang ni/ /bde 2ldan skyes ldan 1rgyas pa dang / /pha rol gzhan dgra bhā ra ta/ /j-i ta kā ki rgya shug gu/ 17 /grog mkhar skyes dang grog mkhar can/ /chu bdag dang ni ku sha'i rigs/ /ballī ka dang grog mkhar bu/ /snyan ngag thu bo grog mkhar 4sras/ /ku sha'i rgyud dang gnas ngan dang / /sna tshogs bshes gnyen glang bdag skyes/ /gnas 'jog rgyu ni tī mgon dang / /a bye mā na brla ldan dang / /sha ta nā ku/ go ta ma/ /gzegs zan 'od srungs mtshungs pa'o/ /thang la 'bar dang lha yi 'bangs/ /kā shi'i rgyal dang bdud rtsi skyes/ /skyong byed dang ni rnal 'byor can/ /glang mo skyes dang ring mo'i bu/ /khyab 'jug sbas dang 'khyog mo can/ /shā na tī dang rlabs ldan sor//nā sa yan 5brgyad klu dang / /phyogs ldan 'chang ba mi ni brjod/ /nye bar 'dam dang 'bras bu 'byor/ /byed ldan mtha' 'dzin slong ba dang / /ra ba kā ya na'i ra ba/ /kind+ra kṣi'i bu pā ṇi ṇa6/ /pā ṇi ni'i bu sbrul 'dzin dang / /skyes bu byed dang gdong byed dang / /yon tan byin dang pa ta li/ /dga' byed ldan dang dga' byed dang / /byā ḍi yid gzhungs ldan pa dang / /bikṣa bā se skyes pa dang / / nabs so7/ /mchog sred/ kā tyā dang / /kā tyā ya na gtsang skyes dang / /rnam spros bhā ra dhwa dza dang / /'dab bzang skyes dang ba ghra byed / /nag po'i rī'abangs dang bee jo dang / /drag po dang ni 'khyog po byed//bhā ra bi dang sa rtalla/ /srid pa'i 'byor dang gtsang mar brjod/ /sa yi snying 120—1301

po khog pa dang / /'jug pa 'khyog dang 'di dag mtshungs/ /mchod sbyin balka la rnal 'byor/ /tshangs pa dga' ba'i lugs gnyis so/ /de ni legs bsdus zhes byar 'gyur/ /gang zhig snga bar dran byed pa'o/ /bag ma dang ni nye zung dang / /gnyis smra smra byed lag bsdams so/ /nye bar rtsol dang nye bar 'dren/ /byis pa las byed 'dzin pa'o/ /de nas dril bu'i yan lag dang / /na gu la dang bkra shis sgra/ /bkra shis phreng 1ldan rulla lu/ /ku lu re tu lo la dang / /yo ta ke dang yu ta shaṃ/ /yon tan rkang bkra shis brgyad/ /tu ra ta rti ki dga' byed / /sgo yi rgyan dang ka bar 'gyur/ /tsandan dang ni phreng ba can/ /rta babs rtsa dang phreng ba dang / /rtse mo sbyar ba 'di dag mtshungs/ /gu pa ka dang me tog can/ / gu he nges skyed mdangs ldan mchog /spyod byed mthil dang rab tu 'phrog /bu ga rtse byed 'dab ma dang / /karka re ṭo zla ba phyed/ /lha yi sor mo sgo yi rgyan/ /a buṣṭa por/ pi ga sha /grong khyer dang ni ṭa ku ra / / ka ṭa ka dang yi ge gsum/ /ni saṃ chu shing bcud 'dzin dang / /ra tadhi ke bde dang khrus/ /kun sbyor nye bar 'dzin pa dang / /lus dang btung ba shlau ṭha dang / /kro ḍi bye ba 'khyud pa yang / /yongs rtsom pa ri kun 'joms dang / /kro ḍa kro ḍa ci 4'ga' zhig /kun tu rab sbyor a ba ti/ /log spyod mngon pa'i nga rgyal dang / /grong chos 'o byed dga' dang 'dzem/ /bde chen rol dga' mi tshangs spyod/ /ku dro nā ti bzang ba dang / /bha bhā ti dang dga' dang rmongs/ /skye ba 'ching ba dga' ba bsgrubs5/ /kṣa pi saṃ ste sa dzee dang / / mi ba ti 6dang dga' ba'i sgra/ /gang du di sbas ya ti rgo/ /de dum no 7ra tai du 'dod/ /dbeen dang skye bo med dang bkan/ /gsang ba/120—1302

tshogs med/ dgon gsang chen/ /'di drug gsang ba zhes pa'o/ /u dzā shu dang 'khyud pa dang / /ni sto ka dang nye bar phyi/ /shes pa dang ni rab gsal ba//gsang ba de las byung ba'o/ /mchog gi tshig la seng ge dang / /stag dang /shar bha/ khyu 1mchog go/ /dpa' bo glang po rta cang shes/ /mkhas dang padma dkar sogs smra/ /skyes bu gtso rjes rjod byed dang / /zhes pa paṇḍi 2ta snyan ngag mkhan po dpal ldan dpal 'dzin sde yis rnam par bkod pa sna tshogs gsal ba zhes bya ba mu tig phreng 4ba las bram ze'i sde rdzogs so// //spyi bor dbang bskur rgyal po'i bu/ /lag skyes rgyal rigs rnam par rgyal / /thra dza lirnyi mi bdag /kṣa ṭa ni gnam gyi rgyal/ /sa dbang 5/ sa skyong / sa yi bdag /sa 'dzin mi bdag sa 'tsho dang / /sa gzhi skyong dang lha yi rgyal/ /kṣa dha ra dang sa spyod dang / /rgyal phran dang ni dum bu can/ /spyi bor dbang bskur mi'i bdag bo/ /skye ba gcig dang cha shas bdag /rje btsun mi bdag skye dgu yi/ /bdag dang 'jigs 6pa sel byed pa'o/ /yul bdag mi dbang zas kyi bdag /sa dbang bdag po 7zhes pa yang / /gang gis rgyal 'dod mchod sbyin byas/ /dkyil 'khor dbang phyug brtan pa'o/ /gang gis bka' dang bstan pa dang / /rgyal po rnams ni mtshungs pa'o/ /gang dag rgyal po zhes brjod pa/ /rgyal po ma lus kun gyis ni/ /phyag byas lhag pa'i dbang phyug go/ /'khor los sgyur ba sa kun dbang / /mi bdag gzhan gyi rgyal phran no/ /rgyal po phal dang rgyal rigs tshogs/ /rgyal po ldan pa sa 'dzin tshogs/ /dang po'i rgyal po pri du dang / /bai n+ya ka dang bum pa can/ /120—1303

gzhan las rgyal dang lang tsho can/ /māsna ta la sogs pa dang / / ga sum̐ gi hūṃka zhes pa dang / /ya mad asni dga' byed dang / /ngan spong skyes dang rdul bzang skyes/ /dga' ba can dang ra dhu'i —bu/ /shing rta bcu pa de yi bu/ /skyed pa po dang ra ma ṇa/ /tshul bzang ma nidzha sha dang / /tshe da ma las dga' byed zla/ /dga' byed bzang dang gu bi dang / /shing rta bcu pa las skyes pa/ /mtshon byed dang ni lag ma ṇa/ /bshes gnyen bzang dang sprin sgra rgyal / /mdzod ldan pa dang mdzod 'dzin skyes/ /kai ka yi 4dang / ka tī/ /lus 'phags can dang skyed pa po/ /me thi lī yi sar byung dang / /ra ma'i bu dang ku sha sar/ /ha phru man dang 'od ldan dang / /ti rā ni ni mya ngan med/ /kun tu 'dren dang spyod mchog dang / /dga' byed pho nya srid sgrub skyes/ /ti ḍi kun tu dga' byed dang / /skyob byed skyes dang seng ge dga'/ /sang 5skyes gzhon nu byis pa dang / /mgrin bzang dang ni nyi ma dga'/ /e la gang dang rtogs byed dang / /dbang chen dang ni yal 'dab po/ /de nas sha kunda yi bu//thams cad 'dul dang bha ra ta/ /sha kunda skyes doṣṭhanta/ /yang yang 'gro dang yong ba can/ /srid sgrub lus skyes gcod byed dang / /bsgon 'grus ldan dang 'byung po'i steng / /'dam bu dang ni/ ṣpe ṣa dha/ /bsod nams grags ldan rab dang ldan/ /thos ldan zhi ba 'jigs chen dang / /pra bye ya dang dga' ba'o / /bu mo yo dza na ganda/ /gī 6ge yī dang bde ldan ma/ /rnam bkra brtson 'grus lus bkra skyes/ /nag mo a ṣe da rī dang / /ganda ba ti rgyas pa'i ma/ /shaṃ gā skyes dang ga gā ma/ /bu ni lha yi brtul zhugs dang / /zhi ba gsar dang gaṅgā'i bu/ /gaṅgā skyes dang 'jigs pa dang / /mdzod gnas kla 720—/304

klo 'chi bdag dang / /grong gi nor zhes bya ba'o/ /yul 'khor srung —1gi ma las skyes/ /shes rab mig dang ma can bu/ /skya ba'o mbi ḍi so so yi/ /kānta kundi 'di dag mtshungs/ /a mru li ka las skyes pa/ /bismra ba dang a mra'i bu/ /'thab dka'i dgra ngan rgyal po ste/ /gārja ra skyes 'thab pa med/ /chos rgyal skyes ni mā rnyi ste/ /chos kyi bu ni dka' thub bu/ / ki ka rnams ni rjes su skyes / /ma skyes dgra ni g.yul ngor brtan/ /bṛ ko da ri 'jigs sde'o/ /dpa' bo'i rdul dang ka ṭa'i rma/ /tshogs skyes klu yi stobs zhes bya/ /rlung gi bu ni ḍirma bhi tā/ /ba ka ki dī kadhī ra/ /dza rī sbrang rtsi 'joms pa'o/ ardzu na la bu re kra/ /stobs bzang dbang dang 'dam pa 4che/ /yānda cod pan gāṇḍi5//snying po med dang brgya byin dga'/ /'jigs rung rnam 6rgyal rgyal byed dang / /ma bya pā tsā dha na gang / /gzhon pa dkar po bīrta sgo7/ /gsang ba'i rab dbye ka bi skyes/ /dga' ba'i dbyangs 'gyur gāṇḍa 9bee/ /gaṇḍi bi dang dha nu'o//tre ba dī dang ri skyes ma/ /nag mo lnga len ma skye'o/ /skyed ma bsod nams grags ldan ma/ /mchog sbyin 'dren ma rig byed skyes/ /rtag tu lang tsho ldan ma'o / /kra ya stobs bzang ma gnyis ma/ /srid sgrub ma dang lus ldan ma/ /rigs med dang ni lhar bcas kyi/ /ma las skyes pa skye dgu skyes/ /sa'i rna ba la aṅga'i rgyal/ /rā dhar skyes dang 'joms byed bu/ /nyi ma dga' ba rnams yin no/ /bum pa can la mthar byed dang / /dus kyi phyi ma mun dbang phyug /nag mo skyes dang sde bzang dang / /bkra ba'i sa dang gcod byed do/ /bre bo che la rgyun gyi bdag /bhā ra dhwa dza'i slob dpon dang / /chu yi bdag dang bla ma'o / /bye bo che'i bu chu yi bu/ /skye bo mgul dang drang srong rgyal/ /yongs 120—1305

su 'phangs pa'i bu yang ngo / /dza ra ku ru 'gro byed mchog /ba the ta su tshes bcas ma/ /dza ta ko ru ma na mā/ /lha mo zhes dang e ta dag /gnas pa can mi dang lus bdag dang / /rnam snang bu dang stobs ldan dang / /mngal can binda 1ba li'i bu/ /mtshon cha can dang bṛ to pa/ /'dul dbyangs dang bu mchod rten dang / /byis pa skyong dang tsi rī ra/ /shing rta che'i bu mkhar ba dang //dza ra sa dzre bde mchog skyes/ /rna ba can dang rtsa ba'i lha / /2rtsa ba bzang dang myu gu'i cha'o/ /bka' dbang gros pa blon po dang / /gros kyi snod dang gzhung lugs 'dzin/ /blo dang bzod pa can zhes pa/ /gzhan ni las dang lhan cig spyod/ /slob dpon chen po gtso bo dang / /slob dpon chen po mdun na 'don/ /bde legs can dang lta thog pa/ /gnyer pa dang ni spyan gzigs pa/ /mig gi chos can spyan pa dang / /rtog dang rtog par byed nga/ po//tha snyad rnams la blta ba'o/ /sgo srung 4ba dang sgo skyong ba/ /sgor gnas sgo ldan dbyug pa can/ /sgor gnas pa la blta ba'o/ /pra tī hārya nyer gnas blta//de 5ni bee tra byed pa dang / /pe tra 'dzin dang to ḍa ka /log 6sgrub skyes dang 'jug byed pa/ /snyems tshogs can dang dpya yi gnas/ /mkhar can dang ni rdzong skyong ba/ /dus bu skyong dang dum bu can/ /srung ma'i tshogs pa sku srungs pa / /be tra'i sde dang bsrung ba'o/ /gnas brtan dang ni grong dpon dang / /gzhis bdag gnyer ba hu ri pa/ /pho brang nang pa nang mi dang / /nang na gnas pa'i skye bo'o/ /gser mdzod pa dang / gser gnyer pa/ /dngul mdzod pa dang 'dul 7gnyer ba/ /grong gnas pa dang gnas byed pa/ /spyan pa de nas sa bi ba/ /slob dpon gnong can 'gram dang ni/ /grol ba'i las 720—1306

dang gros byed pa/ /dung gi spyan pa dung pa dang / /spyan pa dang por byed pa mtshungs| /dar gu li ka so rtsi byin/ /rab 'jug byed dang 'jug pa po/ /'jug byed bu dang rgyug byed pa/ /dzam ghā ka re dzam rnyi ka /btsun mo'i sku srung ①kañtsa ki/ /gnas byed dang ni nyug rum pa/ /ma ning nyams pa za ma mtshungs—/ /yang dag thob byed lus nyad ③pa/ /zhabs thog pa dang 'tsho ba pa/ /grogs byed la dang sbyid ④byed pa/ /yul mthar gnas pa'i rgyal po dgra/ /de yi pha rol bshes yin no/ /u pā shi na bar gnas yul/ /rtsa 'dzin dang ni rgyal gnas so/ /dgra bo mi dga' yongs bgrod dang / /dgrar 'dzin pa dang bshes mi byed/ /sdang byed/ zhe 'gras/ 'khon byed dang / /mi mdza' ④ba dang pha rol rgol/ /mngon bgrod dgra byed rnam sdang dang / /mi phan byed dang phyir rgol dang / /yongs gnas 'gran zla mngon gzhom bya/ /dzi gha kun tu 'gran sdang byed/ /rnam sdang bzod byed mi dga' byed/ /bzhin mnyam mtshungs pa 'gran zla dang / /gogs dang gros gnyen/ /snag gnyen dang / /sdug dang / rtsed rol/ lhan cig spyod/ /sī shurba nī zhes pa yang / /dbang bcas legs spyod/ legs sdud dang / /'grogs dang 'dun pa'i skye bo dang / /bdun brgyud ⑤gnyen dang mdza' rjogrogs bshes/ /ljang gu'i mtshon 'dar ⑦brjod pa dang / /skad cig tsam gyis mtshon gyur pa/ /sngon po'i chos bzhin ⑧brtan pa dang / /dga' dang dor byas rjes su 'jug /mkha' la rtsen dang rol rtsed dang / /der ni nye bar gyur pa'o/ /lta nyul dang ni rtog mi ⑨ba/ /rtog dpyod byed dang nyul mi dang / /ldum bu pa dang so ⑫rtog mi/ /bya gtong dang ni nang yan no/ /lo shes rtsis mkhan lha zhes dang / /120—1307

lha yig pa dang shes ldan dang / /dus shes yud tsam thang cig shes/ /gnas shes 'grangs byed lha 'dri ba/ /gus par 'dri dang sems brjod 'gyur/ /pra su sha ka ṭi zhes pa'o/ /der ni nges 'gro sbyin pa ①dang / /lha la 'dri dang nye bar thos/ /rgyud dang grub mtha' shes pa dang / /sbyin bdag khyim bdag mtshungs pa'o/ /bris mkhan dang ni yig mkhan dang / /yi ge pa dang 'dri byed pa/ /ki ra ka dang shārnyi ka /yi ge can dang snag tsha'i zong / /kā ②kṣi ka dang po li ka /de nas me khā burma khā/ /dga' byed dang ni yi ge 'chags//snag tsha'i nor bu snag tsha'i nor/ /yi ge khron can bārta la/ /snag tsha chu ngang ma lā dang / /mda' la mig sman snag tsha'o/ /myu gu yi ge'i 'dab can dang / /kā tsa na dang yi ge 'ching / /yi ge'i pho nya khya tshur byed①/ /phrin yig brjod dang rjod byed pa/ /yi ge'i gnas dang dri gtsang khang / /rgyas 'debs rkyen byed 'dri byed dang / /bri bya/ kun tu bri bya dang / /yi ge'i rim pa gnyis rnams so/ /la ④khāe la ka 'phrin yig khyen/ /lhag par 'phrin ⑤yig spyod byed 'dod| /yig mkhan las byed rkyen bcug pa'o/ /skyes kha dang ni pho nya ba/ /du byi rjode dngos las yin no/ /lam la ⑦tshong pa 'gron po dang / /lam 'grul 'gron lam gnas spos pa/ /'gro byed lam po de nas ni/ /sdud byed lam pa dang ni rgyud/ /mnyam pa sa mu na sā tha/ /dzaṅka 'dug gnas 'di dag mtshungs//dzā ga ma la sogs pa'i rab tu byed pa'o/ /bdag po blon po thugs ches dang / /mdzod dang yul 'khor rdzong dang dpung / /rgyal po'i yan lag gnyis yin no/ /khab dang pho brang zhes pa dang / /dums dang 'thab dang chas pa dang / /gnas dang nor gtong gzhan brten ⑧rnams/ /drug rnams yon tan zhes bya'o//120—1308

nus pa dang ni mthu stobs dang / /dga' bar byas dang sngags bzlas dang / /zad dang gnas dang 'phel ba dang / /sde tshan gsum po rig pa'o/ /rnam par gnon dang skyes bu'i mthu/ /gzi brjid dang ni mdangs dang stobs/ /dpung ①dang mthu brjid can dang ni/ /bang mdzod nor gyis gang ba dang / /dbye dang sdud dang dums dang ni/ /dpya 'tshal thabs ni rnam pa bzhi/ /khral dang sdud dang dpya dang ni/ /phra ma dang ni skyo ma mtshungs/ /de nas dbye dang nye bar 'gyed/ /u pa dha ni chos sogs kyi/ /gang zhig nye bar blta ba'o/ /drug ni lta ①bar byed pa ste/ /gang zhig gsum sogs spyod yul lo/ /mtshungs pa blo thub yid ches so/ /nyams na dman pa ji ltar 'grims/ /ma nyams rigs pa rtog pa dang / /gzugs ston pa dang mtshungs par gnas/ /rigs pa thabs dang thob pa dang / /'os pa 'thad pa lugs bzhin dang / /rigs pas thob dang gnas su brjod/ /mngags pa gang zhig lam btsas pa/ /gang de so sor bstan pa'o/ /nges bstan kun tu bstan pa dang / /mngags bstan gdams pa bstan pa dang / /bstan pa dka' dang rjes su gnang / /khrims lugs dang ni 'dzin pa'o/ /kun tu gnas dang yul chos dang / /yang dag rab 'dzin kun tu 'ching / /nges gzung ①/ sdoms dang / 'ching ba mtshungs| /nyes pa/ nongs pa/ skyon can dang / /tuṇḍi kā dang rigs bab 'gro/ /gnyis sogs chad pa nyis 'gyur len/ /thob bya dpya ④dang sdud dka' dang / /khral bar thob pa shosnyegam mo/ /'di yi 'byor pa kun nakyidang //nye bar sbyin dang nye bar spyod/ /zang zing lalca u kau dang / /rab tu ston dang kun tu ston/ /mdzod 'dzin 'bul ba nye bar sbyin/ /skyes dang zhu rten 120—1309

zhes bya dang / /rnam gzhag dang ni mdun ①'jog dang / /sbyin par brtsams dang dad rdzas dang / /de yi dus la sbyin pa'o/ /phyi dus la ni ā ma ti/ /'di la mthong ba'i 'bras bu dang / /phyi mar mthong ba'i 'bras bu dang / /mthong med me dang chu la sogs/ /mthong ba rang bzhin dgra bo dang / /sa skyong shin tu 'jigs pa dang / /rang phyogs mthu yis ②'jigs pa'o/ /rgyal po'i pho brang ka ṭa rka/ /kun tu gnas dang phung po skyob/ /nges 'jug dang ni khyogs can dang / /byi dor can dang ā ju byed/ /rab tu rtsom dang bka' lung ngo / /rnga yab dang ni g.yob byed do/ /rnga yab rnga ma spu can dang / /sa ram̐ tsā ba tsū la rka/ /kra ye rlung g.yab lus gcig pa/ /bo ma gutstsha rka dang ni/ /shaṃ ga ṛ zhes bya ba'o/ /mi bdag stan ni bzang po'i stan/ /de ni gser gyi rang bzhin 'gyur/ /seng ge'i khri 'o gdugs tshad skyob/ /pu po ṭa skyes tsha ba sgrib| /ubyu ṭi dang 'khor lo'i lus/ /sa bdag la gnas rgyal po yi/ /rtags mtshan gser gyi dbyug pa dang / /nye bar mtshon ces bya ba'o①/ /bum pa bzang po gang ba'i bum/ /gser gyi ril ba j-iṅga ④ra/ /so rtsi'i snod ni ka re ka /sthā gi kā lu kā zhes so/ /phye ma khā ba phye ma ni/ /'gyur byed mtshon gyis bsgribs pa'o/ /khyogs ⑤dang 'degs dang do li kā/ /zikhāe/ briṭwā la ni dang / /brikhro la zhes bya ba dang / /briṅka rijo la riṅgarjo/ /breṅka ṇa raṅka ṇi'o//rgyal srid kyi yan lag gi rab tu byed pa'o// //glang rta shing rta rkang thang rnams/ /dmag gi yan lag rnam pa bzhi/ /mi mthun lce dang glang mo skyes/ /glang po rwa can nā ga dang / /rdzing can/ lag ldan| ri dwags che/ /rpā lu mang 'thung gnyis 'thung dang / /cher myos i 120—1310

bha| kā ri ṭā/ /kā ṭī ral can/ 'dus pa dang / /rgya mtsho can dang bum pa can/ /haste/ ma tai/ ga skyes dang / /skyob byed mche ba gnyis pa dang / /sdong po 'dzin dang sdong po dga'/ /padma can dang 'khri shing can/ /pre tsi la dang / pe tsa tī/ /so ldan mche ba'i stobs can dang / /glang mo'i bdag dang dza la ka /paṇḍi pā dang / bā jo ta/ /dīrgha sā ru ta zhes dang / /arnyaḥswo de ①te rā dang / /nirdu ra dang mtshon byed rten/ /nyi ma thob dang 'khor lo'i rkang / /stobs mchog ṣa hā ya na dang / /myos pa'i bri ku/ bur shing rtse/ /gnyis 'joms daṇḍa pā la dhi/ /lus chen dī hā/ 'gram byin sdedang / /sgogs byed gnyis 'thung bu rnams so/ 53 /lag ldan ma dang glang mo dang / /rna ba 'dzin ma bhā ba sā/ /gnas ma i bhya ka tsā dang / /gzhon ma/tshogs can/ sgeg ma'o/ /khyu bdag chu sneyi mgon po dang / /ka la bha dang glang po'i bdag /bikko bye tra rjos chen dang / /so dbang u da gra da na/ /zab mo'i rigs dang glang po bcas/ /gang 'gyur lcags kyus gdul dka' ba/ /g.yo ba can dang bya la ka /shin tu gdug dang ma haṃ skyes/ /gcer bu rab bye mibhinda/ /sgogs byed myos pa'i so ldan dang / /glang po'i chang dang myos pa'i chang / /glang po smyon pa glang po rgod/ /rgyal po'i phyi yi glang po'i rgyal/ /mchog tu rnam par rgyal byed pa/ /gang 'gyur phal chen myos ral ⑤can/ /pū ri ṣā sogs nges par dregs/ /glang mo spos kyi glang mo de/ /gang zhig khro byed khros pa'o/ /skad cig gis ni dbang du 'gyur/ /gal te mtshon pas bhā sto/ /'od zer can dang mchod sbyin gyi/ /glang po mchog rgyal rtags pa mtshungs/ /bi haṃ glang po phal pa'o/ /glang tshogs glang po 'dus pa'o/ /dud 'gro byin 120—1311

dang gdab pa dang / /glang po'i yongs 'dren bi dha'o/ /bum pa'i 'og ni bā ha bye/ /pra ti ma ni de yi 'og /bum pa can dang glang ①'bur gnyis/ /de yi bar ni bidha'o/ /ā rakta ni bum pa'i mtshams/ /gaṇḍa sham kha 'gram pa'i mtshams/ /mche ba'i sha ni pra beṣṭa/ /ka rī ra ka so'i rtsa ba/ /sna yi gong ni stu la'o/ /lag sor lag pa'i ze 'bru la/ /dpral ba a ba gā ha'o/ /rgyab kyi sha ni ta khya lām/ /phrag pa'i phyogs ni ā pa ni/ /yī kṣi kā ni mig 'bras so/ /mig gi zur phyogs nirlu dzwa/ /sanda na ni mig rus 'og /ā yasthā ra byin pa'i rtse/ /thra ha rkang pa'i tshigs la'o/ /pakṣa bhā ga rtsib ma'i cha/ /danta bhā ga mche ba'i rtse/ /rje ngar phyi dang rtse mo'i ni④/ /a pa re dang yo gi ta/ /rje ngar bdun dang rtse mo'i cha/ /gā trar 'gyur ro so rtsa ③ka /mjug ma'i rtsa ba dang ni mtha'o/ /gang ④po'i kha cha padma'i rka/ /rna ba'i rtsa ba tsū li kā/ /ru lasgo khā rna ba'i nag /myos pa'i sbyor ba bya stu ra/ /de nas sbyin pa myos pa'o//glang po'i rgyan la/ shri ma mkha/ /glang po'i mgo dang lag ldan mgo/ /hakko gardzo 'bod pa'o/ /lcags kyu la ni sh-i ṇi'o/ /rna ba 'bigs pa karṇa rā/ /'ching ma sa thag /la lī'o/ /'dogs pa'i ka ba a la dzwa/ /shaṃ ga rakhyo ḍa zhes pa'ang / /lcags sgrog ⑤bā tsi nyiñdzi ra/ /lcags thag antu ka zhes pa'o/ /de nas thraṣā ka 7 dang / /ba ra tra ni glang po'i thag /mā ga grwa ni glang po'i chingasarjo| /nā rī glang po'i chings so/ /a pa ba ta 'ching bas 'dzin/ /glang po mchog ni gu ḍa rgo/ /rtogs ldan skye bo dam pa dang / dze ga ninda dza gardza ni/ /mkhris pa'i rims dang bā ka la/ /skyon bral brtsegs pa bā ka la/ /la ba khra'o/ /glang po'i g.yog⑦ /kha dog stan dang / ku tha'o/ /rta dang chu 'thung 120—1312

myur 'gro dang / /'gro mgyogs/ mgyogs 'gro bdun pa dang / sind+ra skyes dang 'gro byed dang / /sgrub byed gshog ldan ha ya dang / /'phrog byed dpal gyi bu dang ni/ /si dzwa rnam gdon ①rlung las skyes/ /rlung gi shing rta yang yang za| /rnga yab can dang hi ྾ dang / /spru ti de ka sha ka dang / /'gro byed phung po rmig pa can/ /kisbyi sā li ho dra dang / /ral can tshangs pa rang skyes dang / /mchod sbyin phyugs dang ku byu ra/ /rgyalalge'adzin ri dwags ral pa dang / /dzā nu ba dhu rtsa ①gdong dang / /rnga yab mjug ma can rnams so/ 25 /cang shes dang ni rigs ldan dang / /rlung dang kun shes zhes kyang ngo / /rta mchog send+ra bā ra dang / /rang rigs dang ni legs brtson ldan/ /lhag par rgyugs dang bang ldan dang / /rnam par dul dang legs 'gro dang / /thra ṣā na la shugs 'gro dang / /lhag spyod a shwa ta ra dang / /kha ra dang ni skyob byed pa/ /turmi/samā| rta dkar dang / /dpal gyi shing can gang gi ming / /shing gi rjes su mtshon byed pa/ /rta ni bzang po lnga re rnams/ /yan lag lnga rnams legs par rgyas/ /mdzee kā mig dkar min rnams/ /nag dang dbang po'i gzhu lta bu//gshog ldan rta gtsang mchod sbyin la/ /gang zhig mchod ④sbyin thob pa'i mchog /rlung gi rta dang sa yi phyogs/ /rlung tshogs/ 'phrog byed/ to ra bee/ /mdung can dang ni rnam par dul/ /dbye ba 'dar byed gling skyes dang / /mi ldan yul du skyes pa dang / /bā nā yu ⑤skyes/ pāta sig skyes/ /bā ra ṭa zhes pha rol la pa⑦/ /rgyab ldan dang ni gnas pa'o/ /shing rta 'dren byed ra tha gye/ /bde bar byed dang bde bar spyod/ /rte'u dang ni thu ru nyid/ /mo rta rgod ma bā rmā dang / /a shā/ ha yī/ rab skyed ma/6/rta yi khyu dang rta yi tshogs/ /rgod 120—1313

ma'i khyu dang rgod ma'i tshogs/ /dpal gyi shing can snying gar 'khyel①/ /mdzes byed mgrin par gnas pa'o/ /ze rngog ru gnas gang 'khyil ba/ /de ni lha yi nor bur brjod/ /kargyan ②rta yi sked pa'o/ /he ṣā tī ṣā de yi skad/ /'tsher 'gro/ phyogs bzhir 'gro ba dang / /yongs skor mchong 'gro ring du 'gro| /lnga po 'di rnams rta yi 'gros/ /rta yi gdong dang mtshul pa'o/ /ze rngog dang ni ze ba'i phyogs/ /rmig pa sha paṃ/ beṅgā'o/ /rta mjug dzeedang ni rnga ma dang / /rta rnga khā gu la zhes dang / /bā la hasta rta ④snying ngo / /band+ra li kā tshogs su 'gyur/ /'dre bar byed dang bande mtshungs/ /nye bar 'dre dang 'dre log dang / /pha rol 'dre dang sa la 'dre/ /steng du gnas dang skyes bu can/ /rnam par gnon dang rgyug dang bang / /rta yi srab dang ka ba ma bye⑤/ /ka pi ke dang na nā'o/ /ha ya sgo ṭa'i phrag pa/ /mgrin par dril bu g.yer kha'o/ /rab bskul 'dzin dpyad/ srab parṇa/ / sa tū rjo'ajug byed dang ni lcag /yongs su 'gro byed/ 'dod byed dang / /raṅga'o 'di yi rtse mo'i cha/ /pra ṣa re dang banda ha/ /pags pas dkris dang ka ṣa mtshungs/ /rta yis ⑦nyin gcig bgrod pa'i lam/ /gang de ā shrī rna zhes bya/ /mgrin par 'phyang la le nā sha /zhags pa ṣpe nā li tī⑧/ /theg pa 'khor los 'gro ba dang / /g.yul gyi shing rta yan lag brgyad/ /rgyal byed sna tshogs shing rta dang / /pha rol legs bgrod smra ldan no/ /'di ni me tog shing rta dang / /rtsed sogs rgyu can 'khor lo'i theg /theg pa shing rta rnam 'dren dang / /lam bgrod yongs su skyed pa'o/ /rna ba'i shing rta rab 'bab dang / /rta can mtshungs pa gsum yin no/ /gnyis so stan g.yogs stag can dang / /stag gi pags g.yogs shing rta'o/ /120—1314

la ba dkar pos g.yogs pa dang / /'bab ldan la ba dkar pos 1g.yogs/ /shing rta lwa ba can dang ni/ /gos can lwa ba sogs kyis g.yogs/ /gnyis 'thung la sogs shing rta rnams/ /shing rta'i tshogs dang lam bgrod do/ /rnga mo ldan pa'i shing rta ni/ /lhag par rnga mo yang pa ldan/ /gadhri dī bee sa ra'o /a na shing rtar gyur pa ni/ /gaṭī lwa ba'i phyi rol can/ /khyogs 2dang de bzhin thag pa dang / /lulba shing bī shing rta'o/ /dhu ni shing rta'i gdong yin te//a ba skar shing rta'i lus/ /shing rta'i yan lag 'khor lo'i rtsibs/ min dang de nas biṣṭi ka /'khor lo'i lte ba mtha'i mu khyud/ /pra bye'o de'i mig zer bu ni/ /a ni —ra ṇi zhes pa'o/ /'thab ra dang ni shing rta sgrib/ /yu ga:ra 5gnya' shing 'dzin/ /a nu karko 'og gi gnas/ /gnya' shing 'ching zhing yu ga dang / /bzhon pa lam 'degs theg pa dang / /phyogs dang 'khrul 'khor mgyogs byed do/ /phan tshun 'bab dang rgyu byed dang / /'degs byed zhes bya ba rnams so/ /bzhon pa ba dang glang po ba/ /glang chen steng na gnas pa'o / /me miṇḍa dang blon po che/ /rta yi steng na gnas pa'o/ /'di rnams de ltar spyod byed pa/ /zhes pa skyong bar byed pa'o/ /kha lo pa dang mgo 'dren dang / /sna thag sna khrid kha lo sgyur7/ /g.yas sdong 8lho phyogs gnas pa'i ming //shing rta'i gnyen zhes bya ba'o/ /rta la gnas dang shing rta pa/ /'thab byed dpa' bo rtul 6phod pa/ /bya ra ba dang mel tshe pa/ /dmag dpon dang ni dmag mgo ba/ /bde chen dang ni chen po 'dis — / /sde bsrung ba dang sde can no / /dmag la mnyam par rig pa gang / /dmag dpung dang ni dmag tshogs so/ /gang zhig stong gi stobs ldan pa/ /de ni stong thub zhes bya'o/ /120—13/5

dpa' bo/ spyod byed/ shor ba dang / /kubye/ slag can/ sasta rja/ /gon khrab dang ni mda' skyob dang / /go bya dang ni tso la ka /lus skyob khrab dang ya lad dang / /brang khebs ka ba ta la nam/ /pags skyob kaṅga ṭa ka hūṃdang / /dza ga ra dang ka ba tsa'o/ /sprul lto 'dra dang brang skyob dang / /kabhu la dang sgrib skyob dang / /sor mo skyob dang sor skyob byed/ /byin pa skyob dang marlu khaṃ/ /mgo skyob/ mgo khebs/ tshem zha 2rmog /lcags kyi rang bzhin dra ba can/ /dra ba phal cher lus bsrung ngo / /go cha gon dang go chas can/ /go cha ba dang chas zhugs dang / /go cha dang ni parmi ta/ /go bgos/ sa dza rnyi na rja dang / /khru zwa dang bee ka ka ṭa/ /'di ni chas pa ma sogs skabs/ /thams cad mngon par 'gro ba dang / /tshogs kun pa dang go kun bgos/ /go cha can sogs go 'dzin dang / /khrab can ba dhurnyi dbus der/ /bdag can mtshon cha'i snying po mtshon/ /rkang thang rkang dmag rkang 'gros pa/ /rkang 'gros can dang rkang shar ba/ /pa dā bee ka /rkang rgyu ba/ /rkang 'gro rkang can / dpung bu chung / /rkang thang tshogs dang yan lag byed/ /lus kyis je'athab par byed pa'o/ /mtshon chas 'tsho 5dang mtshon cha ba/ /mtshon cha blo can mtshon cha mtshungs/ /lag yang dang ni myur du 'bigs/ /myur bar 'phogs 6dang bslab pa'o/ /lag sbyangs skyes bu sgyu rtsal 7can/ /dgos pa bcas dang myur bar bgrod/ /'ben las mda' ni gzhan mi 'gro/ /gzhu can / gzhu ldan/ gzhu thogs dang / /dong ldan dang ni mda' snod can/ /gsal shing mtshon dang gsal shing ba/ /mdung can dang ni mdung mtshon can/ /ral gri pa dang gri mtshon can/ /mdung pa dang ni mdung can pa/ /dgra/ sta 120—1316

bdag bcas gang yin pa/ /de na 1dgra sta'i mtshon cha can/ /pags ldan lag na phub yin no/ /ba dan 'byar 2dang rnam rgyal can/ /de gcod dka' spyod gzhu thogs dang / /mda' pa dang ni mda' 'dzin pa/ /grogs byed rjes su spyod pa dang / /rjes su rgyug dang phyir 'brang ba/ /sngon 'gro mdun 'gro dang por 'gro/ /gdong 'gro ba dang sngon la 'gro/ /sna 'dor —ba dang mig sngar 'gro/ /mand+ra ra dang dal gyes 5'gro/ /bang chen pa dang mngon par mgyogs / /myur 'gro/ mgyogs pa shugs can dang / /rab mkhyegs rgyug par byed dang mgyogs/ /'dod 'gro rjes su 'dod pa dang / /kun tu myur dang shin tu myur/ /rgyal dang rgyal nus dze ḍū ste/ /dze la 6rgyal bar sems pa'o) /abhya mi ta/ grogs ngan dang / /skya log zhes pa de brjod do/ /gang zhig sgra 'dun 'gro byed pa/ /rgyal ba gsal byed rgyal brjod pa'o/ /stobs chen dang ni gyad mi dang / /gang zhig shin tu rtul — phod pa/ /brang sprod a ra se la'o/ /shi rta ra rta shing rta'i bdag /rgyal byed rgyal ba rnam rgyal byed/ /dze tā rgyal can rgyal bar byed/ /dpa' bo rab stobs rnam 1gnon can/ /dpa' spyod/shor ba/ stag shar dang / /g.yul na brjid dang legs pa dang / /rkang thang gzhan la thob byed pa'o/ /rgyal mtshan can dang bzhon pa can/ /dmag dpon ru chadar sde dang ni/ /dmag dang dpung ni chas pa'o/ /stobs kyi sde dang 'khor lo dang / /tshogs pa dang ni ba dan can/ /de nas nā sī ri lngadang ni / /'dren pa dang ni sngon 'gro mtshungs/ /dpung 1 tshogs rnams kyi bkod pa ni/ /de dbye dbyug sogs 'khrug shoms so/ /zang 1/dkar zlum pa'i dbyug par 'gyur/ /longs spyod rjes su spyod par brjod/ /dkyil 'khor 120—1317

kun sbyin zlum po ni/ /so sor spyod pa 'dus pa'o1/ /slar 'brang bkod pa phyi ma'o / /dmag gi rgyab ni yongs 'dzin pa/ /glang po shing rta re re dang / /rta pa gsum dang rkang thang lnga/ /pa dā ti kā zhes pa'o/ /so sor yan lag sum 'gyur gyis/ /se byā 2mu khaṃ'o rim pas gzhan/ /sum 'gyur gusmi ga kau dang / /ba ha mbi dang 4/ thra tā dzā/ /tsa bye/ waṃ bhā ki bee 5dang / /de bcu akko hi shlaur 'dod/ /phun tshogs 'byor ldan dpal dang shis/ /phongs pa ma 'byor phun tshogs/ bral/ /dal gyis sa srung 7 chen por 'gyur/ /dal gnas/mtshon cha/ balpa ri/ /gzhu dnge tsā ba/ dha nu dang / /mdakṣiṃ 'phen dang ni rgordzu ka /mda' mo/ mda' dang / mda' rgon dang 218/4 /a ba skṛ ṇa tā ti ṇa/ /tā dha nu dang / gu bhā tā/ /gzhu mchog dang ni/ a sha'o//gāṇḍi ba dang gaṇḍi ba/ /chang zung dang ni rna ba dang / /rgyab nag mda' yi zas can no/ /gzhu yi mchog ma mu ṭa byā/ /ta lam lag 'brag lag stan no/ /go bā dang ni la rka sta ka /chang zung dang ni gzhu yi rgyud/ /gzhu rgyud srad bu rgyud yon tan/ /ga bye dang ni tā ra baṃ/ /mda' 'phen mtshon cha/ la hūṃ 1 dang / /mda' bsnun dbug bya 'phen pa dang / /mtshan ma dang ni so so'i lus/ /drang lta rab 'gro mda'i spyod yul/ /g.yon brkyang g.yas brkyang la sogs pa'i/ /gnas 'di rnams la lnga zhes so/ /mda' dang lam ldan shā ya ka /bā ṇa/tsher can i 6 dang / /mi 'khrog dang ni mkha' la 'gro/ /sgro ldan skra ba skyes 'dra dang / /sha ra nag phran ro pa dang / /tshogs can dang ni/ pre skaṣa rka/ /rtse mo can dang myur 'gro dang / /gshog ldan 'bab byed bha la dang / /kṣe la 720—/318

shaṃ ka mtshon cha'i 'dab/ /ka ṭa ka ka rnam par 'don/ /'been bsnun snadapa' 'joms rab 'joms dang / /bā dze 2na dang / bi karka / 26 /de nas phyogs can 'gro byed dang / /gsum khas sta dang gcod byed dang / /'gro ldan 'dab ldan bkod pa can/ /bhalli/ bhalla la sogs mda'/ /lcags mda' sgra chen lcags sbubs can/ /mtshon cha'i gtso bo zhes pa'o/ /rtse mo'i cha la tshol byed dang / /mtshon cha tshad ldan mu ṇa ya/ /dug can li sta mda' phyogs dang / /li sta ko zhes pa rnams so/ /ni ra ta ni mda' 'phangs pa/ /'gro ldan 'dor byed shā ya ka /mda' dang grol ba rnam par gcod/ /'bar byed dang ni shugs drag go/ /zla ba phyed pa po can dang / /bra sogs sgo dang dhwa rā'o—/ /tū ṇa tū ṇi ra dag mtshungs/ /nges chags dang ni mda' 'dzin no/ /nye bar chags dang tshogs can dang / /mda' yi gnas dang bi pā tha/ ral gri dang ni dkyil 'khor can/ /rtse mo can dang kṛ bā ṇa/ /a si gcod byed shā ya ka /lag skyong zla ba 'dzum byed dang / /sgrol byed skyob byed gcod byed dang / /shang lang dang ni brdeg cha dang / /bzang bdag skyes dang pha rol skyes / /mtshon cha'i gzhi dang 'dzin byed 'dzin/ /dug can dang ni rnam 'joms dang / dpal gyi snying po las rnon dang / /rjes su gtse 4dang /shis byed dang /21/phub dang phal ka zhes so/ /pags ldan drang po'i ral gri dang //ka ṭī ta la/ arga āoṃ/ /'khor lo'i cha can g.yul du 'dzin/ /se ru ral gri'i yu ba ste/ /de yi 'ching thag mo kha la/ /sthātyā 5kā ra/ ka la ha/ /si dha na ka ral gri'i shubs/ /tho ba 'joms byed gha na'o/ /dbyug pa lcags bcings pa ri gha/ /skyed gri ka ra bā li'o6/ /bhindi bā la mda' thung mtshungs/ /120—1319

dgra sta sta ri gcod byed dang / /sta mo zhes pa'o dgra sta'i 'og /gcod byed/gzod dang gri gri gug /chu gri gri thung sgo ri kā/ /mdzod kyi ral gri ral gri'i bu/ /mda' bo che ni to ma ra/ /mdung dang mtshon ring thag mdung dang / / ka rā rta ba dang sha la rnams/ /mdung thung dang ni kā shrī 2mtshungs/ /'phang mdung /sor mdung / pir shang ga /mdung dang mtshams can zhes pa'o/ /rtse gsum pa dang mtshams gsum pa/ /phur bu/ brtan pa/ shaṃ ku dang / /zhi ba me tog cha rnams mtshungs/ /sna mdor ko ṭaya zhes so/ /zur dang mtshon cha rnam pa bzhi/ /lag grol 'khrul 'khor grol ba dang / /mughā/ pu ka /mukta kai/ /lag grol shatta la sogs te/ /grol ba chu gri la sogs pa/ /mughra mukta gsal shing sogs/ /'khrul 'khor grol ba mda' la sogs/ /mda' spyong mda' ni ring ba la/ /phyi rol nges dang basbyi 4sham/ /dbyug pa/gsal shing be con dang / /'khor lo la sogs mtshon rigs dang / /mda' dang mtshon cha goms pa ni/ /u bā pa ni yekhu ra lī/ /rgyal pos dmag la mda' gsol byed/ /dgra la dpung ni sngon 'gro dang / /gang zhig dmag 'gro de dbang bskur/ /phyir 6rgol byed dang phyir sngon 'gro/ /'thab skyod shin tu 'gog pa'o/ /kun tu 'thab dang 'khrug pa dang / /dmag 'joms pa dang nges par 'jug /dmag 'gro bskyod 7dang thegs 8pa dang / /zhugs dang 'gro ba ga la'o/ /'jug dang de ru gnas pa dang / /yul lta pra ti ra thar 'dod / /brkyang ba dang ni ru brkyang shedang / /pha rol dmag nang 'jug pa'i don/ /bai tā li kā go phyed pa/ /bde ba sgrub par byed pa'o/ /'khor lo can dang dril bu can/ /mnyam dka' dang ni sbrang can mtshungs/ /gcer bu 120—1320

bstod pa'i brtul zhugs dang / /phyag 'tshal go ra 1ga stong 'don/ /tho rangs mdo ni rab 'don dang / /dbyangs dang bkra shis brjod byed pa/ /longs spyod stobs ldan phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rnam par rgyal dang rgyal byed rgyal/ /phye ma dang ni kko da'o/ /nye bar 'khrug dang 'gyed pa'o/ /'dzings pa dang ni phyogs med do/ /sngon gyi 'dzin pa mchod pa dang / /longs spyod tshogs dang yongs rdzogs nyid/ /ba dan rnam par rgyal byed dang / /rgyal mtshan tog dang nam —mkha'i snye ma/ /ka dha lbo dang kaddhā lbo/ /bsags ldan mtshon byed bha dza yi//a ba tsū la asgo la/ /'phel byin kha dang kurba ka /dur khrod 'khrug pa'i sa gzhi dang / /shin tu 'jigs pa rab tu ster/ /nga sngang snga zhes pa dang / /bdag ni snga'o zhes bya ba/ /mtshar can skyes bu dregs pa can/ /de ni nga rgyal can dang bdag /nga nga zhes smra phan tshun thu'agran/ /gang zhig 'gran par byed pa'o/ /shugs can thal 'gro rtul 1phod dang / /stobs ldan dpa' dang nyam nga med/ /'joms byed mthu dang brtson 'grus dang / /nus pa srog dang pha rol gnon/14 /rnam gnon dang ni shin tu dpa'/ /gnod pa'i gnas su 'joms byed pa/ /dpa' bo mchog ni gang zhig gi/ /chang 'thung 6g.yul gye snga phyi ru/ /'khrug pa 'gyed pa rgyal byed pa/ /saṃ kṣa/ mṛ dhi/ sa lī ka /du byed dang ni rka 7da āoṃ/ /rab tu rnam par 'joms pa dang / /g.yul du 'thab dang rtsod pa dang / /saṃ yu ga dang kan rab 'joms/ /g.yul gyi 'du byed rtsod pa che/ /rnam 'dzin g.yul las skyes pa gang / /mi bde g.yul 'gyed a dzi ni/ /sa mi yu dha zhes bya'o/ /g.yul du 'thab mos phan tshun dag /mnyam du shi ba a rna ka /dge bral saṃ spo 87ṭa zhes 'dod/ /sādza ra yi ki 120—1321

dang ni/ /mngon par nyid dang yang dag 'joms/ /'khrug long rnams ni spyi yin no/ /du byed mi bzad 'thab mo'o/ /mtshon med g.yul sha 1tu mu la/ /dpung pas 'thab pa ni yurta/ /glang bo'i bum pa'i sgra dang ni/ /ngu sgra 'thab dang dgra kun 'phel/ /glang sgra seng ge'i 'ur sgra dang / /'khrug rnga 3pa ṭa/ha yi sgra/ /mtshungs so ta raṣṭa dang ni/ /mngon gsal rjas dang a raṣṭa/ /snyems pa'i garga ra rnams so / /dpa' bo'i brtson pa dpa' bo'i rgyud/ /dregs 4rtsom ma ṭa ka ṭi'o/ /g.yo sgyu ngan thabs na ṭha'o5/ /de nas 'khrul dang nor ba dang / /'chi byed 'chir 'jug shi ba dang / /nges zin slar yang bskor ba'o/ /brgyal 6dang myos dang 'bog pa dang / /mnar ba dang ni mtshir — ba'o/ /rmas pa lus nyams ltung ba'o/ /'gras dang rtsen dang slar byed dang / /'khon ḍazhugs pa dang sha 'khon —zhugs/ /'jigs dang sgo lo snying stor dang / /paṇḍa ga ṭa zhes bya'o/ /bros dang byer dang nye bar bros/ /shin tu bros dang rnam par bros/ /phyir song ba dang phyir log dang / /kun tu bros dang khyus pa'o/ /ce spyang can dang mche ba dang / /'du byed dang ni rnam par 'phyo/ /dus mtshan 'jigs byed shing rta mo/ /g.yul du bcom dang gzhan rgyal dang / /'pham pa dang ni pha rol rgyal/ /yib pa dang ni bskyab pa'o / /ma lus gsod dang nges par snyebasnun/ /gsod pa dang ni brdeg pa dang / /brdung gtag dang ni rab tu 'joms/ /rnam par gnon dang 'jug byed dang / /'tshe byed yongs dor gnas med byed/ /gos med stan med gnas med dang / /tsa ka dang ni kanor 'joms dang / /nges 'tshe nges gnod nges par sel/ /gnas spo gzhan nas nges 'gugs dang / /sel byed 720—1322

dang ni brnab 1sems dang / /ni shunta na/ nges par gtser/ /rab 'joms mnar dang mnar ba dang / /kun thob rnams 'gro shin tu bsrub/ /'joms dang 'tshed dang / gnod pa dang / /gnod byed/ 'gro byed/'tshe ba dang / /rkyen dang rnam 'dor rab 'jal 'jug /rnam bsnun srub byed yongs 'jal 'jug /chud za byed dang rnam zhi byed/ /'joms dang nges sel rnam 'tshe byed/ /de bskyed ces pa rnams su 'gyur/ 57 /gnyid log mtshan mo sad pa shi/ /sa dang me dang chu dag go/ /mnyam pa dang ni 'bras bu bcas / /lnga pa nyid du dus kyi chos/ /lta ba'i mtha' dang 'jig 4pa dang / /shin tu 'gro dang nges par thim/ /ring du/ chas dang 5/ kun tu gnas/ /lnga nyid mtha' dang zhig pa dang / /'chi dang / shi dang / nub pa dang / /nges par lhung dang sa thob pa'o/ 17 /ro dang / rab thob lnga pa nyid/ /tshe 'das nyer thob rab tu bkod/ /gzhan song / rab thim/ kun tu gnas/ /rab song dang ni gzhan du song / /bcu pa zhes pa rnams su 'gyur/ 11 /ro dang / phung po/ gnas son dang / /ro sha /sa 'phel/ gnas skabs lnga / 6 /mthar 'gyur dang ni/ bā ru tha/ /ro khri can dang / bā ṭi dang / /ro yi shing rta shing gi gyad/6/ka bandha dang / byed ldan ni/ /mgo bo dang bral khog pa'o/ /dur khrod dang ni pha mes nags/ /drag po rol ba zhi ba'i gnas/ /'jig 6gnas bsreg gnas yi dwags 7gnas/ /ro thab sgong pug tsa ti dang / /shing gi gnas zhes bya ba'o/ /ri mos bkra dang mchod rten dang / /rtag par ro khar byur bu'o/ /legs byas bkur 8ste dam pa byed/ /mchog tu byed pa rnams 9yin no/ /rab zung / nyer bzung / gzung 1 bya dang / /120—1323

phyag byed pa dang ma ti'o/ /btson rar shābacings pa'i khang pa dang / /khri mon dang ni chad pa'i khyem/ /shing gnas/ shing ༄ khyem/ chad can bcings / /skyes bu'i srog ni pā ṇa'o/ /de bzhin 'tsho dang gson pa dang //tshe ni ji srid 'tsho ba'i dus/ /skyes bu 'tsho byed 'tsho ba'i sman/ /dmag gi yan lag gi 1rab tu byed pa'o// //zhes pa snyan ngag mkhan po paṇḍi ta dpal ldan dpal 'dzin sde yis rnam par bkod pa sna tshogs gsal ba zhes bya ba ming gzhan mu tig phreng ba las rgyal rigs kyi sde sdogs so// //brla byung / brla skyes/ rdo dang / /rje rigs sa 'dzin rje'u 'o—/ 6 /kun 'tsho ba 5dang / 'tshe ba dang / /son 5byed so nam 'tsho tshis so/ /'tsho bar byed dang 'jug byed do/ /skye bo 'jig rten skye dgu rnams/ /zhing pa phyugs skyong / tshong byed dang / /'tsho ba'i chos zhes bya ba'o/ /zhabs thog 'jug byed/ lta ba dang / /bden par brjod dang zhing las dang / /bden dang shi po ñtsa dang ni/ /rmo rko dang ni phru rlog 3go/ /ma bslangs pa dang /a mṛ ta/ /bslangs pa dang ni mṛ 8 ta'o/ /pā mi bye ni skyed kyis 'tsho/ /bu lon dang ni parya dang / /bskyi ba dang ni g.yar ba dang / /brje sheb dang ni bsgyur brlog go/ /so sor sbyin dang rnam par brje1 / /nges pa yongs su 'jug pa dang / /brje khye dang yongs 'jug cha gzhan dang / /nor kyi rab tu sbyor ba dang / /le lo can dang skyed kyis 'tsho/ /ma khā kṣi kā ha zhes dang / /ra ṇi jo ba bden mi bden/ /bi shan ni/ bu lon gtong / /skyed pa dang ni 120—1324

nor spel ba/ /'dzin pa can dang spyor ba pa/ /utta ma ni rab spyor ba/ /spel ba spo dang spel bas 'tsho/ /log min byed dang log 'tsho ba/ /legs pa dang ni nyis 'gyur ba/ /zhing pa shes pa so nam pa/ /phru 1rlog pa dang rmos pa dang / /bram ze zhes pa 'di dag mtshungs/ /rab rje ba dang nus ldan dang / /shor ba pa dang 'khor lo skyong / /zhing dang 'bru shas pa le yo/ /'bru dang sā 2lu 'byung ma'o/ /nas/ dang nas zhing dug thu ba/ /nas sogs 'byung ba'i sa gzhi'o / /til zhing dang ni til skye ba/ /au mbi ni dang sran ma skye/ /sran ma can dang bye gī ta/ /bcang bya gzhan lam rag pa'o/ /thog gnyis mon gyi khri tshe dang / /sran sogs skye dang bzod pa'o/ /sa bon btsugs dang bskrun pa dang / /btab dang rmos 4dang skyed pa'o/ /gsum log dang ni lan gsum pa//gsum rlog gsum rmos 5de la yang / /nyis 6'gyur byas dang de bzhin du/ /thams cad sasthā kṛta 7mo/ /bye dang bre bo che sogs tshad/ /bye can bre bo che can sogs/ /bā rī tshad can khā rī ka /ma rta marte 9dang pa'o/ /zhing dang sa gzhi 'bru skye dang / /'brum sa chu ma mu tshigs can/ /rmo ba zhing sa 1 sa gzhi tshogs/ /bong ba dang ni sa sgong dang / /ko ṭi ra dang ko ṭi dang / /she loṣṭa sogs dbye ba'o/ /lcag pa dbyig pa to tri dang / /pra dza na dang gzir byed do/ /zor ba dang ni rnga byed do/ /tog tse dang ni rko byed do/ /gshol dang thong pa rmod byed dang / /ri rī shaṃ dang laṅga la/ /pha lo phung po can ha lo/ /sa 'joms dang ni ku dā la/ /ma ni rnam par 'joms pa'o /gshol chen dzitpa ha byā dang / /sā mya'o gnya' shing gnya' phur dang / /gshol mda' gshol gye dbyig pa'o/ /dor dang rmo glang bsto ti/ /pags dang sgul 120—/325

byed dam rtapa las/ /srab dang 'dzin spyad ces pa yang / /brtod phur dang ni 'dogs pa'i shing / /gang du phyugs rnams 'ching ba'o/ /kha lā dha no kha la mtshungs / /rnga ba dang ni gcod pa'o/ /pa rī tra pa sa bon yin/ /'bras dkar 'bru dang pa ṭa la/ /'bru dbye anda mbi na dang / /tshogs can bod kyi sran ma dang / /ha ri rku dang khaṇḍi kā/ /bṛ lam̐ ku dang khre rgod do/ /bkra shis dang ni sran chung dang / /mon sran 'bru ser gre'u'o/ /gro dang yid bzang kla klo'i zas/ /rab sgrim zhes pa 'di dag go/ /bri ka dkar po ya tsa dag /to kṣu kha dog ljang ser ro/ /parba ṭa ni sran ma'i rgyal/ /sran dkar nas kyi 'khri shing ngo / /sran ma yongs mnyam mukhāe dang / /tsa na ka dang 'phrog byed spu po/ /muṅga dang ni 'phrog byed do/ /mu ta nag po nags skye dang / /dpyid skyes nags kyi muṅga dang / /muṅga brkyang ba dag mtshungs te/ /til skyes dang ni dgos pa'i til/ /til gyi phung po dzā ṭī la/ /ko ḍa pa dang ko tra pa/ /gyin 'joms de nas yungs nag la/ /tshogs can sa ri pa ba dang / /tsha ba'i snum can tan tu bha/ /yungs kar don grub zas gtsang dang / /'byung po 'jigs byed ces pa'o/ /ske tshe/ kṣu dha mngon skyed dang / /ā shwa rī dang nag mo dang / /kṣa ba dang ni yungs kar rgyal/ /ku lattha dang nges snum dang / /zangs kyi gtsug phud kulla ṣa/ /ya ba ka rnams mtshungs pa'o/ /mā tu lā ni bhaṅgā'o/ /zar ma u mukṣu mbi'o/ /tsaṇḍi kā ni/ tsaṅga ṭī/ /shaṃ gesgo zhes bya ba ni/ /sha ṭa sharka rā zhes so/ /rtsa dang so ba des sgrib dang / /sngo bsangs kā byu thun 'gro mtshungs/ /lo thog sngurtse mo kai sha ru5/ /lo tog snye ma ka ṣpe shaṃ/ /so ba 'bru dang skogs can dang / /stadza gutstsha rtswa sogs 'bru/ /za byed tsha ba'i 720—1326

'joms pa ni/ /lo tog rnams kyi gcod byed do/ /mgul ba ngar pa sdong bu dang / /pā la lā 1dang 'bras bu med/ /sbun stong dang ni phub ma dang / /skogs pa dang ni sbun pa'o/ /rtse mo dang ni gra ma dang / /rno ba sha mi sisthā'o/ /so ba'i tshogs pa dhwa n+ya yin/ /btsang ba dang ni mang byas dang / /sran ma la sogs gong bu'i 'bru/ /snye ma'i 'bru ni nas la sogs/ /ka lā la sogs sā la 4rnams/ /drug cu 5pa la sogs pa'o/ /ga pe/ bgrod dka'/ /be dhu kā / /rgya che'i rtsa dang dgu luzhu/ /zegs ma phra mo tāṇḍa la/ /lcags rtse dang ni gtun shing dang / /gtun dang u byu ṣa 6la'o/ /kaṇḍa ra dang bā ḍi ra/ /tshogs se dang ni khrol ma'o/ /blo ma dang ni 'khrab byed do/ /khres dang thum bu sgye pa tshe/ /rtswa khres ka linda ka dang / /sbyangs dang nges sbyangs 'bru'i bdag /ku shul ka /uṣṭi kā/ /lus ldan snod dang piṅgā rgo/ /kā tsa'i snod dang snod spyad dang / /lhung bzed dang ni a ma tram̐/ /bye skyong / ru khā/sgra lī dang / /me thab dang ni si tha ra/ /bum pa bum chu pa'i ba dang / /ka la sha dang bum pa'i rgyal/ /mgrin bug can dang kumbha dang / /sa li gha zhes bya ba yang / /ra shā lā dza te / 'tshe bya ba/ /kham phor dang ni rdza phor ro/ /chu khang kha chod sa ldan dang / /sa tsan bā ra sa sum̐ dha/ /sa da āoṃ dang chu 'dzin 'phel / /bum can ma dzha ri dang mtshungs/ /rdza ma dang ni/ btso rdza'o/ /chu yi snod dang chu rdza'o/ /nanta sha nā ka ṭa ha/ /chu sgod mtshungs pa kā ra dang //lo bhadhi kā su ta'o/ /snum zan ma dang dul ma dang / /'khar ba dang ni btung ba'i sgod/ /lcags can rtsub pa solla dang / /ko 5tu ko sbubs snum gye snod / /de nyid chung ma kutta ya/ /shing dang lcags las byas pa yi/ /gzar 720—1327

bu kau pi kā ma le/ /su da ḍa dang zan ma dang / /g.yos ma dang ni lag bde ba/ /mchod byed pa dang gnas byed pa/ /thab kha ba zhes bya ba'o/ /phyag tshang ba dang zas gnyer ba/ /zas byed pa zhes bya ba rnams/ /tshang mang dang ni ro ldan dang / /mchod pa'i gnas dang g.yos khang ngo / /thab dang sgyed 1bu me thab dang / /tsu li dang ni g.yos pa'o/ /baṇi ha piddhā tīṅga tso ta bi sha bā/ga ti bhe ṭa lyabee su skri 2 ta pya shiṅge/ ya ta saṃ skṛ ta su ta swetā/ yongs thob phun tshogs gya nom dang / /yongs su sbyangs dang legs par sbyar/ /snum brngos snum btsos mdangs dang ldan/ /ltar ltar dang ni mal mul lo/ /legs sbyangs pa dang dag byas mtshungs/ /mtshungs pa 'gyur bā se tam/ /mdung dang dag pa'i bar gsum mo/ /ma smin pa dang bsru bu zas/ /rma med pa dang ma nyams pa/ /'bras yos bcag pa so ba brngos/ /de bzhin u 6 zhes dang / /yos dang su ṭa dhwa n+ya dang / /tsa ma ka dang byis pa can/ /yos dang nas brngos nga/ dag mdag /yos bkra mdzes pa'i rma can dang / /bcang bya dang ni gong ma can/ /po la ba ṭa ka dang ni/ /ṣiṣṭa gang ba can zhes so/ /shing sgril gnas dang tsam sa/ /yongs bcod dang ni bcad bya mtshungs/ /thug pa'o gro phye bag phyer brjod/ /zas dang rjes su myos pa dang / /bza' ba dang ni rab dang byed/ /'khrugs dang tshos dang tshig 4nga/ mtshungs/ /zas dang lto zhes bya ba dang/ /ro kun dang po khu ba'o/ /'bras khu tsa ma khu ba dang / /thug pa khu ba zan las byung / /snyigs ma bye ma bza' ba dang / /ro can shā ba dhwa li kā/ /me rdza lcags sgod me gzhong dang / /rngod gzhi sla nga jer po'o/ /thod pa dang ni ras bal mtshungs/ /gzar bu dang ni lag skyogs so/ /lo ma 120—1328

sngo yi lo ma dang / /ngar pa sdong bu chu ba'o/ /sbod dang kha dog sgyur byed do/ /ka ḍadza dang ka lasba/ /be la pa ra yo byad do/ /zi ra dza ra a dzā dzi/ /yul dbus skyes sogs shī ka ra/ /zegs ma snang byed ka ra bī/ /zi ra nag po rgya chen ma/ /gro bzang can dang yangs ma dang / /dus nye ba dang kuñdzi kā/ /sge'u ①gsher dang rwa can no/ /de nyid sman chen sga dang ni/ /nā ga ram̐ dang ku la sman/ /chen po'i sman dang thams cad pa/ /sna tshogs 'gro dang pe lu dza/ /pho ba ris nag mu ṣa rde/ /ko la rka dang chos kyi sman/ /sogs pa dhwa bye dpal yon can/ /'u su/ bi tunda lo dang / /kastusbra tī dpal yon tri/ /nor can dha ya bhā ṣa ka/ /dbang po shing kun me ldan dang / /thra pi ②bdug pa tsi bo che—/ /stong 'bigs dang ni dza tu rka/ /zug 'joms sartse la dga' dang / /sa mo nye ldan mchog ma dang / /bya rog sgra dang yangs pa'o/ /kāñdzi rka dang grub pa'i chu/ /bdud kyi sdong bu sbun pa'i chu/ /srung byed zla ba shin tu dpa'/ /a rnyi mā ḍa ku1 ṣa/ /nya phyis phyi mchu dpal yon chu/ /kuñdza na dang / khams 'jig byed/ /'dzin ma mngar ba tsū kyi dang / /rdul 'joms thab dang sho la rka| /ra ①chen zhes bya rnams su 'gyur/ 17 /shing skyur bse yab tindi ḍi/ /rgya mtsho'i lañtsha dang ni tshwa/ /dpyid dus chags pa de dang de/ /'gyur byed/rnon po/ chu yi ro/ /ka ra ba shya ba le'o/ /sentu skyes dang bsal ba dang / /sintu las byung lañtsa mchog /mā ni mand+ra 'gyur byed rkyen/ /rdo ba'i lami send+ra rdza| /sibyu ba lam 'gyur byed rdo/ /la ba ṇa dang u paṃ dang / 18 / ba tsa ④skrukṣe tu/ tsa rka/ /thig le can dang mdangs ducan no/ /smin pa bi tram̐ byas pa tsam/ /ro ma ka dang sbyar char 'dod/ /ka ra dbu ba hwags dang ni/ /120—1329

sharka ra dang ka ra dkar/ /sdong bu 'dzin dang bu ram dang / /ro mngar bisba ṭa dang ni/ /ka ra bzang po ki khā ṭi/ /'o ma'i rnam 'gyur kurtsi rka/ /ka ra dkar po/ dkar chen dang / /sbrang rtsi sbyar ba rā ①sa lā/ /tshod ma dang ni thug pa dang / /tsha ba rnams ni mtshungs pa'o/ /'byor ba z-iṣṭi/ bharya ṭi/ /cha shas dang ni yan lag 'di/ /lī tsi ta dang mbi nā mbi/ /gho darda rā rma thra saṃ/ /'di rnams tshod ④ma'i khyad par ro/ /'o ma a mra bzho ba dang / /tā li ye dang pā ka lo/ /pā tsa lam rnams mtshungs pa'o/ /rtse byas/ bsreg sha shu lam bya'o/ /btsos pa'i sha ni bai tha ram̐/ /sidha zho yis bsres pa'o/ /'o ma mar sar dag kho narka/ /khā ba ni rka/ sāmbi two/ /zhag lon til gyi bza' ba la/ /au da kri ṣa/lo ta st+ri ta/ /'bras thug dang ni ya ba gu/ /thug pa skyo ①tsha ta ra la/ /ngom/'grongs| tshim dang / chog pa'o/ /bkres rjodang / longs spyod/ sha za can/ /za 'dod/ za/ ltogs/ zas la gdungs/ /bza' ba kha zas ldan pa dang / /zas dang / bza' rgyu/ nyin mo ba/ /bha kṣa ṇa dang ni ka ṣa/ /nges za/ mngon za/ dza kṣa ṇi/ /bhukṇi/ nges gnon/ mthar 'gyur dang / /zas bzang ba dang 'jigs med dang / /lus 'degs nges par gso byed do/ /za ba dang ni khams dag mtshungs/ /btung ⑤ba dang bcas si pā ti/ /bza' ba dang bcas pa pa'i 'o/ /rnal 'byor ldan pa rnams kyis ni/ /bden 'byung ston mo tshogs 'khor ro/ /de gzhan sred pa brtan po yis/ /za 'dod btung ba 'dod pa'o/ /zos lhag rjodang ni lhag rol dang / /sder zhabs zos te bor pa'o/ /'dod pa rab 'dong gdung ba dang / /zhen pa dang ni sred pa'o/ /spri ⑦ni 'o ma gsar pa'o/ /'o ma/ kshi ra/ dusnya 120—1330

dang / /pa yas kun tu 'jo dang 'bab/ /'jo dang / nye bar 'dren pa'o/ /sa bya dzubye/ sha shakhye1/ /brla skyes dang ni nu skyes kyang / /'o ma las byung zho la sogs / /rab tu chags dang dpal mkhregs zho/ /zho kha chu ni zho las byung / /dbye / zho mkhregs las gzhan pa'o/ /sa ra/ zho yi mchog yin te/ /zho yi gsher ba karghaṃ ka /de ni he ya ma bī rna/ /gang zhig khar tshang ba bzhos mar / /zhun mar zhun ma bsreg rdzas mar/ /mar sar dang ni sar las byung / /hai yo ga bī dzee mtsho skyes/ /bsrubs 2skyes ga lo mū ṭi'o/ /chu skya chab skya dar ba'o / /ma thi ram̐ ni chung rkang gcig /chu phyed pa ni ni rdza lam/ /dbyug bsnun dar ba zhes sbyangs so/ /ba lang rnams kyi lpags —ngan sogs/ /pa las byung ste brjod bya zhing / /go ha rgo dang tshe ga rgo/ /ba lang lci ba ba byung ngo //tstsha ga ṭa suta phyi ba dang / /ba lang mdung dang / ba byung ka/ /phyugs ldan go mi zhes bya 5ste/ /glang rdzi ba lang dbang phyug go/ /'brog pa phyugs skyong ba lang bgrang / /ba 'jo zho mkhan lcags thogs so/ /paṇḍi 6ra ni ma he skyong / /brka ra ni/ phyugs gzhon nu/ /ba lang rnams kyi tshogs pa la/ /phyugs tshogs / /kurba7/ nor phyugs nor/ /a nadhe 8na/ sau ra ste/ /ba lang /khyu mchog /mchog dang glang / /nog can bzang po stobs ldan dang /gog shal can dang skye mchog glang / /yi ge dang bcas phung po dkar/ /'bab byed/ lus ldan/ zho srung byed/ /glang mchog /rwa ldan shā ku ra/ /'gro byed/ dri ldan/ log spyod can/12/glang chen dang ni nog chen dang / /nog chen rgas dang glang rgan no/ /nog skye ba dang / nog skyes dang / /phrug gu dang ni/ drug mthong sogs/ /'jigs dang rwa can snying can dang / /na 120— 1331

su dang ni naste ta mtshungs/ / tu pa ri ①ni/ rās dman pa/ /nog can tshogs pa/ au kṣa ke/ /be'u sa kṛṅka ra dang / /zho 'thung dang ni da byu ka /ā ṭa ka rna/ kṣa lbo byed/ /gnya' 'dul dang ni glang por ②mtshungs/ /ma ning sha bcad sbyor ba'o/ /ma ning bdag po i 1 ra/ /ba khyu ba tshogs/ ba lang lus/ /be'u'i tshogs ni bātpa rka/ /bzhon ma dang ni drus ma'o/ /rgyab len 'gro dang phyir 'gro dang / /gnya' shing la sogs po ṭā ra/ /gnya' shing glang 'dul shing rta 'dren/ /rgal dang khal pa khur 'dren pa/ /gnyis po gcig gis ①khur theg pa/ /chig theg gcig pus 'dren pa'o/ /kun gyis ༷khur theg dul ma dang / /khur kun 'dren par nus pa'o/ /rmod byed gcod byed—/ 'khru byed pa/ /gshol ldan/ rmos ldan khal glang dang / /dpung pa'i phyogs ni ba ha'o/ /sāsna ske yi sgog shal lo/ /ba lang mgo phyogs ṣpe tso ka/ /phyag 'tshal ba ni re tsa na/ /ba lang lo la re bha rna/ /lag mgrin/ lā dzā/go li gā⑤/ /ba lang ma he la sogs pa/ /gson pa'i nor dang rkang pa'i no/ /ba lang za dang gsol ba'i gnas/ /ba lang za gnas gang zhig la/ /zhi ba'i skye mched udzraṣṭa/ /mtshams dang khyu mchog dkyil 'khor/ /sgrub byed ma dang dri bzang skyes/ /gro ru zwa dang ma ma dang / /rwa ldan ma dang mchod byed skyes/ /ba mo bā ni laspri dang / /chu skyes dang ni tu hi ṇi/ /ubhā mā ya ba lang rnams/ /ba lang kha lo ni pi tī/ /kha dog la sogs dbye ba las/ /ser skya khra bo dkar po sogs/ /lo gnyis ma dang lo gcig pa/ /lo gcig ma dang lo gcig pa/ /ba sar/ she dus be'u 'khor/ /be'u zin pa/ zhes pa'o/ /a pa to ka be'u shor/ /khyu mchog sbyor dang mtshams ldan ma/ /'phral du mngal chags 120—1332

be'u'i ma/ /be'u'i ①ma/ /bzhon ②ma drus ma dang / /mang ①du 'joms ma/yongs 'joms ma/ /legs brtul ma dang 'jo bde ma/ /nu rgyas ma dang bzhon ④can ma/ /be'u yun ring ma lo khur ma/ /be'u mangs ma dang mig gtum ma/ /'jo ma/ 'o 'phel/ 'o ma 'ching / /'o 'ching gnas ma 'o gnas ma/ /gro ṇa spyi ra bye chen bzhon⑤/ /bī ra ba lī ba lang zhagabu /lo re zhing ni skye ba dang / /lo btung skye dang slar skye ma/ /skyed dus ldan ma pra sa ṣpe//bhanda rna pyata rab skye ma/ /bzhon ⑦nyid dang ni ā bī na/ /pra su ba stu pi ya su/ /ni pā rna dang de haṃ rtswa/ /srub ma'i rdza ma mtshungs pa'o/ /srub ma srub shing na mand+ra⑧| /srub ma dang ni zho skye'o/ /ta kra ṭa dang zho bsgral dang / /srub ma bdun pa zhes pa'o/ /srub ma'i ka ba ku tha ro/ /zhi ba'i phur pa ni ṣkambha/ /srub thag sanda na dang ni/ /sa shur byu dā ma rī/ /de la ba ni gang gyur pa/ /'ching ba rkang pa gcig pa'o/ /sa li kā dang lhas ma can/ /zho sogs gcod byed gang yin pa'o/ /rnga mo rim can rang bzhin dang / /lus can la ni tsher ma'i lcag /mchu 'phyang sgo li bya santa/ /ku la nā sa rlung gnyis 'thung / /dhu za shi ⑨ka lcags sgog ⑩dang / /dga' byed ring po laṅga na/ /'khor lo'i mgrin dang mang po sgril/ /ra sa lā dhwa rlung la dga'/ /dhu ri dha ra rol pa bkramaske/ /rde'u dang ni rnga phrug go/ /rde'u 'dogs thag shing kha la/ /shing la rkang pa 'dogs pa'o/ /ra dang lto 'phyang tstsha ga dang / /bo tsang bya lhan cig rangs pa dang / /lha rnams dga' dang me nā dang / /brka ra dang zhi ba dga'//'dab ma'i zas can rna ba 'phyang / /yid srub ⑪yang ba zhes pa dang / /bsto bukka āphya bu⑫/15 /ra rnams dang ni ra khyu dang / /ra yi tsu luspra dang ni/ /tstsha 120—1333

ga lī dang tstsha gi dang / /mañdza ga la mun can no/ /lug dang spu ldan g.yang dkar dang / /bal ldan/ a bi/ e ḍa ka /lto 'phyang dang ni u ra ju/ /gnas bcas yu mang 'joms byed ma/ /maṇḍi/ bhaṇa/ u gi lu/ /me ṣi dra ba can dang ni/ /bzhon ①lug a bhā mā ④rī dang / /sha te snebi dang sau rte bi/ /be du kha dang 'dra ba'o/ /rnga mo brang 'gro tshogs dang khyu/ /rnga khyu gsus 'phyang rnga mo'i khyu/ /bong bu dang ni 'khor lo can/ /sna chen/ skad chen/ rā su bha—/ /kha ra grong du 'dren pa dang / /dran pa dran bya phur bu'i rna/ /lam 'gro byed dang / rnga ma can/ /chu ba ring dang byin pa gtsang / /sbyong byed phyugs dang rtswa ā ru/ /tri ṇa bee nyi bha zhes dang / /tsha ṭa'i khyu mchog lam ba dang / /bzod pa'i mu khyud sa la nyal/ /kṣa ra zhes pa rnams yin no/ 24 /lus 'phags skyes dang ded dpon dang / /tshong dpon tshong pa nges 'gro dang / /zong dang tshong gi ka yi ka /zong ba dang ni nyo tshong ngo / /pi gro ti na tshong mkhan te/ /nyo ba gra ④yi ka dag mtshungs/ /btsong bya ba ni bye yin no/ /a ñtsa⑤kra ya rin gzhal bya/ /zong rjodang tshong dngos rtsa nor dang / /rnyed pa lhag pa'i 'bras bu can/ /bcol dang gtams dang bkod pa'o/ /beer blangs pa dang gtang ba dang / /zong tshong bkram pa bkra bee ste/ /kre yi tshong gi ⑦phyi ma'o//btsong bya tshong zong tshong zog dang / /bsgyur bar bya ba la sogs so/ /sa ma yā ni bden byed dang / /bden byas kā ka ṇi pa ṇa/ /ta ri'i cha dang bi kra ya/ /bi sa na rnams mtshungs pa'o/ /phreng bcu swa tstsha zhes bya ste/ /grangs dang bgrang bya bcu la sogs/ /grangs dang bgrang ⑧bya bgrang byed kyi/ /nyi shu la sogs rtag tu gcig /grangs ⑨don gnyis dang mang po nyid/ /de rnams la 120—1334

yang dgu bcu'o/ /bcu gnyis grangs kyi rkang pa ste/ /gcig bcu brgya yi rim pa las/ /stong dang khri 'bum sa ya dang / /bye ba dung phyur nirbu dang / /padma la sogs thams cad ni/ /phyi ma phyi ma bcu 'gyur ro/ /'jal bar byed dang ched du byed/ /mnyam byed ces pa tshad kyi don/ /'jal byed srang dang sor dang bye/ /ma ru lnga rnams mā sha ka /de rnams bcu drug zho yin te/ /zho bzhi la ni srang gang ngo / /gser 'jal zho cha gser mig ste/ /ku ru bi sta de yi srang / /'degs byed dang ni stoms byed do/ /srang brgya khur yin nyi shu srang / /yā tsi tri ni khur bcu'o/ /shing rta khur ta ā tsirta/ / karṣa pa ṇi dong tshe yin/ /zangs kyi dong tshe pa ṇa'o/ /bzhi cha bzhi pa dag dang ni/ /bcu drug nyi shu kuñtsa ka /u ḍa ba dang bye la sogs/ /yongs su 'jal byed so so ko /rkang pa zhes pa bzhi cha yin/ /cha dang cha shas dgod pa'o/ /longs spyod/ zang zing / rdzas rang dbang / /nor dang / ba su/ a nā 4dang / /dbyig dang rin chen yo byad rnams/ /'byor pa/ mdud pa/snying por 5re/ /ṛ 6kṣ-i/ ṛtstsha snye sgrub byed rnams/ 18 /mdzod dang rin chen gser gzugs dang / /sgom dang sgod ces bya ba yang / /de dag las gzhan spa bya dang / /dngul dang de gnyis ma hā ti/ /mkha' lding gshog pa margad dang / /rdo yi snying po nor bu ljang / /padma rā ga dmar po dang / /ku ru binda/bye nāsma/ /ri bzang can dang rin chen dmar/ /ya ba rbo la/ dpal me tog/nor bu chen po byu ru dang / /'khri shing nor bu tsa kṛ kan/ /lus dmar 'dab dang gser can 'dab/ /byu ru dang ni rtsi dmar ro/ /mu tig nya phyis sa bon dang / /grol ba can dang mu tig 'bras/ /nya phyis skye bar sbubs skyes dang / /120—1335

ba ra sa yi u ba lo/ 7 /mu men rgyal po 'khyel ba dang / /rgyal po'i cod pan rnam gsal skyes/ 4 /shel la arka ga lwarka/ /me shel 'od gsal nyi ma dang / /rdo ba 'od gsal ri skyes dang / /sreg byed rdo ba shā li 'phye①/ /sbyangs pa'i rdo ba dri ldan dang / /tsa ma'i snying po dngas pa dang / /dag pa'i rdo ②dkar zla ba'i bri/ /rdo ba dkar po zhes pa rnams/ 17 /nyi bzhon la ni be ③ḍūdro/ /sprin chen dang ni gzhon nu skyes/ 7 /rdo rje la ni zho ldan gnas/ /tī ra ka dang nor bu'i dbye/ /chu shel ma ni pa sā ma/ /ma ṇi tsa ka dbus na 'dzag /mig la phan dang rin chen che/ /bsel ba'i char ba ldan zhes pa'ang 7 /dbang po sngon po nor bu sngo/ /nor bu'i snying po rjes 'brang ba/ /sarga se 'bru'i sa bon mdog /nor bu las skyes thod du 'dod/ /rdo skyes mu tig la sogs kyang / /nor bu mdzes bzang rol pa dang / /rin po che dang 'gyur byed dang / /'ching bu 'di dag mtshungs pa'o/ /putpa ra ga sa yi tshil baṃ sha rā ga la sogs gzhan/ /gser la swarṇa/ ka na ka /he ma zangs rjomachog kāñtsa ⑤rna/ /dugru dang ni tsam sa skyes/ /gi gā skyes dang bsreg bya dang / /ā le dang ni karbu re/ /sa le sbram dang skyes gzugs dang / /bum brgya skyes dang ri las skyes/ /bharmā/ 'od byed 'dzam bu'i gser/ /rkang brgyad pa dang hi ra ṇi/ /cha shas sbyangs dang mtsho'i sa bon/ /gzi brjid skyes dang rin chen che//skyes dang tsa ku ra skyes dang / /'tsho ba sgol dang sa'i zla ba/ /lcags mchog mdog ldan su rā bhi/ 27 /rwa can rgyan gser/ rwa can gser/ /mi zad gser la ka khye rna/ /dngul la tshon can/ arga ḍidu/ /khardzu ra dkar mdog ngan dang / /'khyog po'i sa bon tā ra'o/ 7 /zangs ma ⑦shudzee nyi ma yi/ /120—1336

ljon dmar u dusru ①ra dang / /dmar po kla klo'i kha gnyis brgyad/ /bi raṣṭha dang thub mkhris 'dzin/ /lcags dmar dang ni yong skyob kyang / /ra gan/ri'i kā ri med/ /mkhris 'dzin ā ra ku ṭa dang / /ri ti dang ni zhu bya'o/ /rga ba 'khyog dang lus 'jam dang / /su re bha dang / pitstsha ṭa/ /tra su zhes bya ba rnams so/ /zha nye/ sī pa/ ka sbyor 'dod/ /tra pu dang ni des 'dod can/ /thratstsha ta dang sī pa'i bdag /ba oṃ/ 'jam pa'i gzugs can no/ /gser gyi dgra dang / stobs mang po/ /ma dhu tsā dang stobs po che//lcags dang mtshon cha can rnon po/ /gong bu/ nag po/ lcags gong dang //ri yi snying po rdo yi snying / /sa ra sa pa zhes pa yang / /lcags kyi rnam 'gyur phra mo 'di/ /thams cad kyang ni lcags su 'gyur/ /lcags snyigs so thog lcags dreg dang / /lcags kyi dri ma tsha mo'i zhag /'khar ba ke su kai sa sbri/ /zangs skyes bsil ba'i chu skyes so/ /zha nye skyes dang zangs skyes dang / /sa rā 1 rka tsa ra rde/ /rgyug byed dngul chu 'dang byed dang / /khu ba'i dbang po zhes grags dang / /'phrog byed sa bon khams chen po/ /drag ②pa'i khams dang su ta ka /mtshal skyes dang ni hing gu la/ /dā ra da dang dmar po dang / /mchog sbyin ngang pa'i rkang pa'o/ /sind+ra ①ra dang bye ma dmar/ /phye ma dmar dang rdul dmar dang / /dri 'dzin skyes dang zha nye skyes/ /ba bla la ni karbu ram̐/ /ba lang so dang gar ming can/ /piñdza ra dang rpā ta rna/ /tā la mā lam/ gar gyi rgyan/ /ser po/ spru tsā/ byi la'i mig /ro ma pra ta rna zhes so/ 11 /ldong ros dang ni gar ngan ma/ /yid 'bod ma dang klu lce ma'o/ /bal mo sa yi gor ma dang / /go la dri rno ④mu zi'i dri/ /dri bzangs dang ni mig la phan/ /120—1337

rigs can ku labee kā'o/ /dus kyi me tog me tog ①ze/ /po6 rka dang ku shu'i khamasarka/ /kā shi shaṃ dang maspru rna/ /dus kyi padmo las skyes dang / /phug ron skyes dang dpal bzang skyes/ /chu srol mig sman sau nī rā/ /mig sman ga tis ya mu rna/ /mig sman nag po chu klung skyes/ /rgyun gyi mig sman mig gi rgyan/ /spang ma'i mig sman rtse can mgrin/ /sngon po dang ni rma bya can/ /btsos pa las byung spang ma'o/ /spang ma brtul ba dbee ka /mig sman sngon po bya khyung rdo②//khu ba'i mig sman khu ba'i snying / /kā shi ṣa khams kā shī khams①/ /le brgan ka ma lus dang mchog /yang dag tshon dang me'i rtse mo/ /grong gi gur gum zhes pa rnams/ /brag zhum rjodon phan rin skyes dang / /rdo skyes shi lā dza tu dang / /rdo ba'i nad ces bya ba'o/ /dbyar rtsi gong bu dri sbyin dang / /ri bong gos srog can dang / /ra sa garnya ⑤gasdo ra/ /gnag tsha 'phel zhes rjobya ba rnams/ 9 /tshal ṭaṅka kṣa rā ṣṭi/ /gar 'o de nas ri tsa ka /ya bag ⑦kṣa ra 'gyur byed sman⑧| /ya ba sri ka nas rtse skyes/ /rgya tsha 'gyur byed/ kā po ta/ /bde 'phel sau brtsa la dang / /ru tsa rka dang ri skyes dang / /sgra blu kā mā ⑨la rnams so / /sbrang dang mngar ldan mā kṣ-i ka /sa ra gha byung sā ra hūṃ/ /pra tshil dang ni sbrang rtsi'i snyigs/ /shing rtsa spyig rkang sa yi spu/ /nā patta saṃ 'byung po'i skraske/ /tsandan dmar po tsha ba gsum/ /drod ⑩gsum skyon dang smin pa dang / /'bras gsum pha lo kṛ ke dang / /tri pha khā dang dri pha lā/ /ri bong bal dang ri bong spu/ /lug skyes lwa ba lug bal dang / /lug can lto 'phyang can zhes pa'ang / /zhes pa snyan ngag mkhan paṇḍi ta dpal ldan dpal 'dzin sdes rnam par bkod pa sna tshogs gsal ba zhes bya ba ming gzhan mu tig phreng ba las rje 120—1338

rigs kyi sde rdzogs so// //dmangs rigs rkang skyes 'bangs dang ni/ /rigs kyi tha ma byen pa skyes| /chos snum de nas gtum po dang / /'dres pa'i ri mo mkhan sogs so//dmangs dang rjes skyes ri mo mkhan/ /sman pa rje'u rigs ①gnyis skyes las/ /dmangs dang rgyal rigs drag po'o/ /bya bas 'tshe ba rgyal rje 'dres/ /mā ti byu ni rje rgyal 'dres/ /kṣand+ra rje'u dmangs rigs 'dres/ /bram ze dang ni rgyal rigs bu/ /de ni lus 'phags rje'u ①rigs rnams/ /shing rta mkhan ni ma hi 6/ /ri mo mkhan las byung ba'o/ /gtum po'i skye bar gyur pa ni/ /bram ze mo dang chos bsgrub las/ /yi ge pa dang bka' 'grel ①byed/ /rtsegs pa rigs dang glegs bam rigs/ /byed mkhan dang ni rjobazo mo mkhan/ /ri mo'i las byed sgyu rtsal rigs/ /rang bzhin gyis ni shas nyan ⑤can/ /blo gros can dang bzo bo'i rjorigs/ /rigs ldan dang ni rigs kyi gtso/ /grong brtsegs pa dang chen po'o/ /phreng rgyud mkhan dang me tog gcod/ /me tog gis 'tsho me tog can/ /de la me tog ya bā ྾/ /me tog gcod ma nags mdzes ma/ /pubee mā ji phreng ldan ma/ /me tog rab tu sog byed ma'o/ /rdza mkhan dang ni bum pa mkhan/ /'khor los 'tsho dang sa las byed/ /dbyug gu bsgyur ba zhes pa'o/ /zhal ba mkhan po la ⑦pa ka /pra dhas 'tsho dang tstsha dhwa dang / /su dha su ⑧sta phyugs sogs las/ /tanta ba ya thags mkhan no/ /gos bzo ba dang tshem bu mkhan/ /dung mkhan dang ni dung 'bud yopa/ /zangs mkhan dang ni zangs mgar ⑩ba/ /gser mkhan dang ni gser byed pa/ /120—1339

gser bzo ba dang gser mgar ①dang / /goñdzi kā dang dmar ba can/ /muṣṭi kas 'tsho zla bas 'jug /nor bu byed dang bai ka ṭi/ /ko raṅgas 'tsho bkra ba byed/ /ri mo can dang ri mo byed/ /kha dog spyod pa to li ka /phra mo go chas 'tsho bungs chags/ /mtshon tsha mkhan dang ral gri mkhan/ /lcags bzo ba dang lcags mgaralgeb/ /ba ru ṭi ①byed bā ru ṇi/ ka lha bā la btung ba 'tsho//chang tshong ma dang chang ma'o/ /sprang chang tshong ma go lī dang / /mtshams can chu yi g.yon pa can/ /grong dpon dang ni mtho ris grags/ /nā bi ta dang mthar gnas pa/ /'dreg dumakhan/ skra mkhan zla ba can/ /sen mo gcod dang ba4'i bu/ /tho ba can dang kau ri ka /snod spyad 'dren dang snod spyad pa//zla 'dzin grong dbang gcod pa'o/ 17 /shing mkhan shing bzo shing 'jog pa/ /shing rta byed dang shing 'jog mkhan/ /phya mkhan dang ni shing khyem mkhan/ /khyem gnas dang ni bza' mi'o/ /tshos ma dang ni btso blag mkhan/ /tsha ba dang ni yas phur can/ /gzhu bu ⑤ma la ha rjorī dang / /srang ba sbyangs dzeedang tshos byed pa/ /lham nag byed dang lham mkhan dang / /ko ⑧pags mkhan dang ku ra ṭa/ /zho shas 'tsho dang las byed pa/ /gla pa dang ni gla yis ⑨'tsho/ /gla za bang chen 'phrin pa dang / /khur pa dang ni khur 'dren pa/ /shornyi ka dang mig 'phrul ba/ /na bha shra ma dbang po'i rta/ /sgyu ma pa dang sgyu ma mkhan/ /ngan g.yo ba dang slu byed pa/ /sgyu ma byed dang dga' byed pa/ /byed pa sbyor dang kham smra ba/ /lha yis 'tsho dang lha bzo ba/ /'byung ba las skyes tshangs pa mkha' / /tshangs pa las byung lha bram ze/ /rnga pa dang ni rnga brdung ba/ /lag pa'i sgra dang thal mo rdeg /gling bu pa dang gling bu 'bud/ /pi ⑩wang pa 120—1340

dang pi wang mkhan/ /'tsho ba'i tha chad bya shor ba/ /de nyid lam du 'dren pa'o / /ra rdzi dang ni ra skyong pa/ /rngon pa/ snyi 1 pa/ bshan pa/lings / /sha 'tshong ba dang sha gcod pa/ /gang zhig skam pa'i sha 'tshong ba/ /de ni sha bskams can yin no/ /shan pa ri dwags gsod pas 'tsho/ /rngon pa dang ni lings pa'o/ /ā ṣe 2ḍi ka ri dwags 'dzin/ /ri dwags rgya dang 'dra ba can/ /'deng byed/ gsod byed/ rkistong byed dang / rya ste/ ri dwags dra ba'o/ / a tso da rna ā khe ṭa/ /ri dwags sdig pa gnyis kyang ngo / /udma na dang 'dab can brtsegs/ /bī ta sastu nye bar byed/ /bya dang ri dwags 'ching ba'o/ /daspyi shā ka bsnun pa nyid/ /de ni ri dwags g.yas rmas can / /ā khe ṭa dang 'ching ba dang / /zhags pa dang ni shu ram̐ bha/ /rgyud can / shulba/ thag pa dang / /mri 4 6 ba ṭī gu ṇi'o/ /phal pa/dman pa/ ngan rigs dang / /dzal ma cig shos so so skyes/ /ngan pa dmangs rigs ris med dang / /khol dang byed pas gnas pa'o/ /bran dang 'bangs dang g.yog po dang / /gla mi dang ni tsi tra 5ka / mngag gzhug bsgo 6bya sbed pa dang / /sngags pa zhags thogs yongs gcod pa/ /gzhan sos dang ni tsaphru dang / /gzhan skyes pa dang gzhan gyi skyong / /luṣṭha mtshams 'khyogs mand+ra ra/ /nges bzo dang ni bems po'o/ /tha shal lto 'gengs shī ta ka /'dar ba lan glan 7le lo can/ /sgren 8po khram pa mkhas pa dang / /gsal po drung po spyang po'o/ /gtum po gdol pa mtho ris so/ /sdeg can gsong por 9'gro byed dang / /nges 'jigs byed dang ma tai ga /ngan thabs can dang nyal med pa/ /mthar gnas dang ni mi 'dod pa/ /dbye ba mon pa ri 120—1341

khrod pa/ /shin shun pa ni kla klo skyes/ / chom po rkun 1ma rkun po dang / /srang ba sha dim ta mdog can/ /jag pa gzhan rku na.ar pa dang / /rku jag chom rkun 'jab bu ba/ /yangs — 'phyag so sor rku byed do/ /bum pa can 'gebs skyes bu 'gebs/ /mtshams kyi byed po 'og tu rgyu/ /su ruṅga sbrul me tog can/ /sa yi chu bag 4zhes pa dang / /'og gi su ruṅga sgo ra/ /rnam sgogs dang ni ḍiṇḍa ka /rab chags chom rkun byudzazla/ /phyag 'tshal sgra dang mā ba la/ /phyag byed pa dang de bshad dang / /pa rāṅga ṭa dung gi sgra/ /snyan ngag chom rkun zla ba'i rdul / /ka pra/ bcang bya/ rko byed do/ /sa ruṅga mtshams de dbye ba/ /dpal bee'u ba lang kha sogs5 ma/ /na byeste sru tre no 6ṣṭi/ /rkun nor rkun 7rdzas chom rkun can/ /rku bya zhes bya chom rkun la/ /bcings pa zhes ni kha cig go/ /khye dang sā ra me ya dang / /ser skya dang ni ri dwags za/ /shu na ka dang smra byed dang / /moshā dang / int+ra ma na dang / /'dod can dkyil 'khor ring po dang / /rab dga' brnya8/ da ra dang / /kau me su ka nā li ha/ /rdo rje'i mjug ma nyal ldan dang / /dga' gsum ra ta pra la dang / /bcud 'thung dga' dang bco ba dang / /dga' mtha' shā la dṛ ka dang / /grong gi ri dwags ku ku 9ra/ /phra ma can dang gso bya dang / /rus pa za dang khrel can dang / /rol pa lce sgril zhi ba'i sgra/ /bshes byed/ dgra byed/ ri dwags dgra/ /skye ba'i cha can 'dod dbang dang / /dga' ba'i phur bu zhes rnams so/ 37 /a la ka dang sbyar bcas dang / /a khe ṭi ka sna tshogs drag /ri dwags 'tshed dang g.yo dang khye/ /kha che ka /shā seng ge'i rigs/ /ro ldan/ tumbu ri/ shu ni/ /shu n+ya/ shu bhya/ shu nā ra/ /bshang ba za dang grong gi phag /thod pa chu ser can ma dang / /120—1342

sdigs byed ma dang sred can ma/ /bud 1med rnams kyi 'jug pa la/ /srad bu gcod byed ni྾ ta/ /rtog pa khri'u pañtsi ka /shing bal dang ni nā ki kā/ /tū la pi tsu shing bal 'jam/ /'jam po las skyes tū la kai/ /ras bal dang ni brta re/ /shing bal 'khal 2ba piñdza na / /nges 'thag nā ri bī ra me/ /shing bal shing ldan karka rī/ /zla ba can dang ku shā ṇa/ /ku la sa ka ja 4phro la/ /srad bu thags rgyud hadmā na/ /snal ma srad bu thags kyi rgyu/ /thags bzang dang ni rtag ma'o/ /sa rī dang ni thags mkhan dang / /thags 'thag bhu ti blu ti / /zhes so/ /ta rī mdog gnyis shing yin no/ /sgam dang / sgom dang /snod dang mdzod/ /'jog sa dang ni bang ba'o/ /bzo bo las dang sgyu rtsal lo5/ /kanda bā sa khur 'dzin dang / /khur shing de 'phyang thag pa dang / /kā tsa'os de nas bi ba dha/ /bi ba dha dang khur yongs 'dren/ /lham dang chag dang bcag 6lham dang / /mthil lham dang ni srog phan dang / /mdzod ldan rkang pa'i shing rta dang / /rkang mchog skye dang rkang khri dang / /rkang rten zla ba gcig pa dang / /zhabs stegs dang ni rkang stegs so/ /'breng thag /'bring zhags ko thag go/ /gser gcod rdo 7ni ka ṣa ste/ /nā rā ṭī dang zho cha'o/ /mchan gri dang ni gri gug mtshungs/ /sog le gcod byed 'dab ma 'dzin/ /gsor dang 'bigs byed ces bya'o/ /snyung dang ko ba 'beegs byed do/ /shing za gzong 8dang shing 'bigs dang / /ṭi ka rdo ba'i gzong yin no/ /chan gri pa ṭa pa ra shu/ /grags ldan dang ni za byed do/ /'od can lugs kong mū la'o/ /sbud pa dang ni ko ba'i sbud/ /khra bo 'dri byed pir dang ni/ /bris smyug dang ni tu li kā/ /kā bā ri dang dza la hā/ /skye 'gro'i cod pan kharba rā/ /bha med da ṭī 11mgo bo'i 720—1343
