zhwa| /chu skyob mgo ras mgo bo 'ching / /pa lā sha yi 'dab ma dang / /'dab ma pi tsā tsi ka'o/ /gtum po rnams kyi pi wang ni/ /tsaṇḍa la dang babee tī/ /sku gzugs gzugs brnyan pra ti ma①/ /lder bzo dang ni slar grib ma/ /slar byas 'dra dang so sor mtshungs/ /slar gzugs dang ni sku 'dra dang / /'dra bar bzhengs dang 'dra 'bag dang / /pra phab bzhin dang legs par bzhengs/ /nye bar 'jal dang dpe rnams so/ /brjod bya'i rtags can mnyam dang mtshungs//de 'dra de mnyam de dang mtshungs/ /de yi gzhi 'dzin rab tu 'dra/ /mtshungs pa dang ni slar gzugs bzhin/ /de nas kun gsal nges par gsal/ /so sor gsal dang rab gsal bzhin/ /nges snang nges snang grib ma dang / /mnyam dang mchog gi gnas su brjod/ /las gla/ sgrub gla/ rngan pa dang / /bya dga'/gla dang / dge dang ni/ /khur ④gla gla dang rin dang ni/ /yon dang snyed ①pa zhes bya'o/ /chang dang myos 'gyur myos byed dang / /bshol ldan mnyes dang bcud rab dang / /sgos ngad ldang dang so sor thos/ /myos par byed dang yongs su thos/ /ka pi shi dang kun 'dzin ma/ /chu ma bshol ma tshogs ldan ma/ /ka shyi| ka khye chu bdag skyes/ /dpa' mo dri mchog gnod sbyin bcud/ /ā li kā dang sharya ni/ /shuṇḍa/ nying khu④/ ko sum̐ dang / /karnyo yi dang lha min mo//ka tsa mā li kā dang ni/ /'gro byed chags ldan myos gnas dang / /a biṣṭi zhes bya ba yang / 32 /shun pa'i chang ni shing shun chu/ /bur chang bu ram las byung ba/ /ba nu karṇa māṭī rka/ /sbrang chang sbrang rtsi las skyes pa/ /sdong bu ldan pa sdong bu'i bcudarka/ /chang 'degs dang ni tā la tī/ /me tog sbrang chang ma dha ga /mngar ldan dang ni sbrang gi chang / /me re ya dang me tog chang / /bur chang ma dha ka 120—1344

dang ni/ /sbyar chang dang ni mtshungs pa'o/ /sma rā sa bo/ skobade byed/ /ma dhu bā rā sbrang gi chang / /nye bar za dang kun tu za/ /chang spags dang ni chang zas so/ /chang khang chang mal btung ba'i gnas/ /chang ra dang ni chang 'thung gnas / /chang skyogs 1dang ni chang snod dang / /kha phor dang ni tshim byed do//pā rī dang ni ga lu ka /phab 2dang chang rtsi zhes bya'o/ /nying khu bdud rtsi'i snying po dang / /sarnya na dang chang bsnyal pa'o/ /cho lo rgyan po sho dang ni/ /rgyan 'gyed kṛṣṭa ko ha la/ /sho rgyan rtse dang gnya' bo dang / /rtse dang ma khā ṇa dang ni/ /khab len mgo 'thu cha 'dzin no/ /sho rtsed cho lo ldan pa dang / /rgyan 'gyed du to da ram̐ dang / /pa ṇa zhags ldan cho lo'i mig /rgyud rtse pa ṇa cho lo'i skugs / /'byeng byed lcags sgrog 5pañtsa mbi/ /yongs 'dren brkyang pa khye dang bye/ /kun nas skyed pa zhes bya'o/ /rkang brgyad re mig 'bras bu can/ /de yang gnas can dgu nyid do/ /tsazhu ri dang tirnyi ḍi/ /srog chags skugs sho rgyal zhes bya/ /don can ba ṭa stsoddhānda/ /dza du pu ṭā kā yin no/ /twanma bī kā cho lo'i dbye/ /lnga gcig ka ni ka rnams mtshungs/ /cho lo ston pa byi ba'i rna/ /kurbi kanta sna can no/ /rtags kyi phreng bar ci brjod pa/ /de nas chos gzhan la yang 'jug /gang dang gang du bstan gyur pa'i/ /sgra yi spyor ba rnam rtogs bya/ /zhes pa dmangs rigs kyi sde rdzogs so// //legs byas pa ni bsod nams ldan/ /dpal yon ldan dang chos can dang / /skal ldan dang ni bzang byas so/6 /snying du sdug dang snying la 'bab/ /yid 'ong dang ni snying po ldan/ 4 /'dod pa dang ni 'dod dang ldan/ 2 /blo che 120—1345

ba dang bsam yangs dang / /mi zhan pa dang mthon ①po dang / /bdag nyid che ba bsam pa che/6 /skyabs gnas rgya chen yon gyi ④gnas/ 4 /rtsom ①pa che dang spro ba che/ /brtson chen mtshon thabs bslab ④pa dang / /brtse ldan dang ni snying rje che⑤/ /snying brtse ④ldan dang nges pa dang / /phun tshogs can dang mtshan ldan dang / /shlau la dang dpal ldan dang / /dpal dang mjos pa yang dag ldan/ /las la byang dang kha byang dang / /bslab dzeepa dang ni dge dang mkhas / /mngon shes rnam shes nges par byang / /legs shas ⑧rnam par shes pa can/ /shes ldan dang ni go ba can/ /de nas nus ldan stobs ldan mtshungs//lha dang rje btsun mdo ldan dang / /'od ldan legs ldan mchod bya dang / /zhabs dang mthar 'gro yon gnas dang / /mchod 'os sbyin 'os yon dbulashebya//rab sbyin gtong phod sbyin rlabs can/ /mang du 'god dang snyan smra dang / /sbyin dang tshul ldan dpal stug ⑩dang / /shin tu sbyin byed sbyin pa po/ /sbyin byed grol ba snu ka la/ /sbyin po/ spyong po zhes bya dang / /yongs su rtogs dang rgyu mtshan can/ /mchog sbyin dang ni rab tu ster/ /yun ring ⑪'tsho dang tshe ldan no/ /bshes gnyen can dang bstan bcos rig /shes rab can dang legs sbyangs shes/ /yid gzhungs pa dang blo gtsang mtshungs/ /yid dga' mgu dang yid rab bde/ /sems ni rangs par byed pa'o/ /mig ngan dang ni yid ngan dang / /yid nang chud dang yid mi bde/ /blo chud zos dang sems stsos pa/ /soṅkasgyu ⑫dang u ṅkabyu/ /the tshom dang ni som nyi dang / /yid gnyis dang ni ma nges pa/ /yon tan nor ldan mtshan ⑫nyid dang / /phan par byed pa mtshan nyid can/ /shes ldan rgya cher grags pa can/ /rigs ldan rnam 120—1346

shes rnam par thos/ /rab tu brtan dang khrigs gnas dang / /kun tu dul dang yang dag 'dul/ /lhur byed gzhol dang rab tu 'bab/ /rab tu gnas dang rab zhan 'dod/ /gzhol dang kun tu chags pa mtshungs/ /nī ra pa dang paṇḍi ra/ /nor ldan nor dbang phyug pa dang / /rdzas ldan nor ldan yo byad can / /dbang ldan dbang phyug rje bo dang / /gtso bo mgo 'dren bdag po dang / /lhag sbyor/ 'dren pa/ mgo dpon dang / /jo bo mnga' bdag dpon po dang / /lhag par 'phel dang chen por skye/ /grong khyer rtsed byed tstsha gi lu'o/ /ṣi ṅge bid ṣṭa ṣa rgya dzha bya lī katstsha ka /nā ga ḍi/ bhu dza ga jiṅga laṅga byu taral byu pa de ba kaḥ tsasgo bai byā pa tri rtswa thabha bi litstsha la ro pi ṭaḥ / 3 ge rtse dang gnas 'joms dang / /'dod pa'i rtsed mo rnam ①sun 'byin| /sgo lo pe lu ha labye ba be la sa bi bhā wa le se/ la te ba grosti ra ti re tstsha kā latstsha ki khā bu rbha/ /yan lag mchog dang gzugs ldan dang / /lus mjes pa dang sdu gu'o/ / srung ma nyug rum dzeenyams pa dang / /'og med dang ni khyem khol po①/ /ngas byed bya ba byed pa dang / /gzhungs byed 'grus par byed pa'o//smra mi shes dang lkugs pa'o/ /yid la gcags dang pha bcas dang / /pha yi chos ldan pa dang 'dra/ /pha lta bu dang gnas bya'o/ /dga' bas brgyan bya bu mo dang / /gang zhig sbyin byed lan cig 'go/ /de la pha rol son pa dang / /'dod don brtson dang brtson 'grus can/ /byams dang / mnyes gshin mtshungs pa'o/ /mdza' ldan mdza' dang gces par 'dzin/ /dge ldan/bde ldan bde 'byung dang / /dge gsum pa dang yan lag ldan/ /nga ldan nga rgyal ldan pa dang / /nga rgyal byed ces bya ba'o/ /rang rgyud/ rang dbang /120—1347

rang bdag can/ /rang dga' gzhan gyis ma bzung ba/ /sred bcas de ni ci 'dod can/ /khri la 'phye dang rdul can no/ /gzhan rgyud gzhan dbang pha rol dbang / /rang dbang med dang bdag dbang med①/ /rang dbang med par 'dzin pa ④can/ /rang dbang med dang gzhan dbang can/ /gzhan gyis zin par de brjod do/ /gang zhig bud med skyes pa yi/ /mtshan ma rig byed rgya mtsho pa/ /rma gzir ba dang gnad la reg /gnad du phog dang gnad 'byed pa'o/ /'brel pa can dang yon tan ldan/ /ldan dang bya ldan las la brtson| /las bzod las nus las su rung / /las la nus pa ldan pa'o/ /las kyi ngang tshul las la bzang / /las la dpa' dang mgo thon snebyed/ /gla zan dang ni las byed dang / /las mkhan de yi bya ba'o/ /phyag ma dang ni mang pos byed/ /yun ring thogs dang ring du byed/ /skye bo'i bya ba grong ldan dang / /grong bya grong dang ldan pa'o/ /'dres par spyod dang ci 'grub byed/ /ngan dang dman pa byed mkhos chung / /nyam ④chung stobs chung sgrub pa las/ /'dres ma'i lam du 'phags pa'o/ /gti mug rbongs dang ji bzhin skyes/ /shes pa gzhan dang ma la brten/ /mdog med dang ni mtshan nyid med/ /lta ba dman dang 'jigs bcas so/ /'gro med kun tu bsgribs pas 'tsho/ /skyabs tshol mngon zhugs skyabs don gnyer/ /rjes skye ba dang mtshan nyid med/ /ltogs pa dang ni bkres pa dang / /bru ba tsha dang zas 'dod pa/ / bkres gyur bkres ⑤dang lo ma za/ /ku ṭī ba ga gzhan za dang / /gzhan gyi bsod snyoms za ba dang / /gzhan skyes gzhan la reg pa'o/ /kun zas kun gyis 'tsho ba'o/ /'dod pa can dang rde can dang / /a mi gyu dang 'dod srung ducan/ /brkam ⑦120—1348

dang shin tu rmongs pa'o/ /snyom 1las sgying snyom sgying skyur dang / /'jas po dang ni tha shal lo/ /bdag 'gengs dang ni rang grod 'gengs/ /bdag gi gsus pa 'gengs pa'o/ /krums dang sha yi zas dang ni/ /lto chen grod che dong ga —bde/ /btung 5'dod pa las tshim 6pa dang / /skom 7pa tshim dang bri ṭa'o/ /shin tu 'dod lo lu bha/ /lubhā/ma lo ma/dze lam dang ni/ /pa ṭa khā la sā zhes so/ /ba spu'i myu gu/ ba spu langs/ /kun tu zhugs dang yi dwags byed / /breng khe le tai mdzes pa dang / /rab tu 'gro dang rol pa mtshungs/ /lo ma med dang shing khrus dang / /gnas sbyar dang ni mi bzad mtshungs/ /pyos pa dang ni ra ro ba/ /rang nyid bye dang 'khrab pa'o/ /myos dang chang gis g.yengs pa dang / /g.yo ldan chang 'thung myos pas g.yengs/ /lam ring don ni yang dag mthong / /ring du ldang dang ring po mthong / /da ltar byung ba'i blo gros dang / /dus su nye bar zhugs pa'i blo/ /gang zhig 'byung 'gyur bskal pa gzhan/ /mnyam dang mthong pa po dag mtshungs/ /phra mo mthong dang ku sha bsten/ /blo skye ba dang mchog bde ba/ /'dod dang lnga skyes snod la sogs / /a bhe ra dang bha dza no/ /snod dang bcas dang thun zos dang / /dus su skyes dang nye bar gnas/1/'dod ldan la ni ka mi tā/ /ka mu kā ma ra zhes dang / /kā la la dang a nu ka /i dī ka dang / a bhe ka /kā ma mi tā zhes pa'o/ /mi brtan pa dang srabs pa dang / /rang gnas mi gnas gzhan sdang min/ /gang de gnas su brjod par bya/ / kru dṛ —tā tir gnyen las skyes/ /log 1can mtshams kyi 'tsho ba'o/ /'jug byed rjes dang sha sogs dang / /chu ral sma bya mngon sgrub pa'o/ /sgrub can dang ni dul ba 'dzin//120—1349

tshig brtan pa dang ā shwa ba/ /dbang dang rang dgar byed pa dang / /zhi ba dul ba mnyen pa mtshungs/ /spyi brtol 1spobs can mdze med dang / /log par spobs dang bye 6 dang / /j-isngu tshug med/ gnongs med dang / /phyag 'tshal gsong por smra ba'o/ /gsod dang 'joms byed rnam par 'tshe mi la 'tshe dang rtsub las byed/ /lcags rtse can dang rnon po'i las/ /myur bar byed dang 'debs pa dang / /nus pas gzir dang gdung bar byed/ /'ded byed nyams byed 'joms byed dang / /rab sgrub rnam 'gebs gaṇḍa dang / /rigs dang sngags bcas gaṇḍa ka /tsi ki ta dang dgongs pa dang / /bag tsha/'jigs dang / 'jigs med dang / /'jigs rung dang ni skrag pa'o/ /'jigs phyir rab zhugs rab 'bad ldan/ / bha rghaṃ ṭi ni bdag po'i chung / /'thab pa'i don du rab sbyin byed/ /a nutpa la thams cad kyi/ /utyā la mchog dpa' ba'o/ /sho tha nga rgyal med pa mtshungs/ /nga rgyal bcas pa saṃ ma ṇi / /nye bar gyur dang nye bar gdugs/ /lus ldan/ murti mṛrghaṃ dang / /ka tho ram̐ dang / mkhregs dang / brtan/ /niṣṭha 4pa ram̐ dang ka thu ṭi/ /kyu ram̐ dang ni/ dza tha ram̐/ /karka sha zhes bya ba rnams/ 11 /mtshams med dang ni rlung med dang / /nirba re dang karka ram̐/ /rpā ta ra dang rpā na ṭī/ /yā 5no sbom po byed ces kyang / /ser sna dman dang zhan pa dang / /mi tai pa tsi ka pa tsā na/ /srang dang khu tshur srin bu dang / /kṣu pa ka da rgya ngan pa/ /dbul po sgrub med dman pa dang / /nisthā cung zad ngan 'gro nyid/ /gnas ngan nges 'thor bā tha tsā//tsa ke tshol ba'i don can dang / /ba bee ba ka slong ba po/ /ba su ki ta kha gzhan no / /kun tu chos can chos ldan dang / /shing ku ra bi mtha' ldan no/60 /sa 120—1350

spyo tpa nga rgyal shes/ /sga nt+ra snum dang mnyen pa'o/ /shin tu gzhon dang so mā dzā//ga ma lo dang rtsa ba sbyin/ /'jam dang reg bde ko ma lo/ /se la baṃ zhes bya ba'o / 4 /mdzes dang / gsal dang / bzang ba dang / /su bam dang bā dha dang / /sho bha rgo dang / kādhe dang / /yid 'phrog tu tsa yid 'ong dang / /ma dru dang ni mañdza lo/ / lo ḍi 1haṃ dang bzang po can/ /na yurjal/ ga tai dang / /barṇa dang ni/ bzlu ram̐/ 18 /g.yon dang padma ldan pa dang / /yid du 'thad dang yid dga' dang / /nyams dga' spyod pa/ dga' ba ldan/ /byed ldan zhi ba se sha lam/ /mngon pa a bhe ma ta dang / /snying 'bab thob dang rtse dang dga'/ /skal bzang dang ni ma lu ram̐/ /mig tu 'thad dang mthong na dga'/ /lta bas chog mi shes dang tshim/ /mtha' med grags ldan legs mthong ba/ /gzhan dang thun mong min pa dang / /bra ti sri shaṃ ma 'dres pa / /rdon po dang ni rgyal po 'joms/ /ma stan dang lhod pa dang / /tshags lhod 'dod rgyal rab tu lhod/ /lhod pa mgor gnas 'dren pa min/ /ma dha sba dang / bribhe dang / /bcom dang / rgyab dang sham bde ba/gtam dang thos can rab bsten 2bya/ /rab tu sbyin byed ces pa'o/ /brnab nasems yid 'dod ces bya dang / /khyim chags pa dang khyem zhan 4pa/ /ngang can nang gnas dang chags pa/ /ltung 'dod dang ni babs 'dod do/ /ngo tsha tshul can khrel ldan no/ /'jug pa dang ni 'phel 'dod dang / /'phur 5'dod dang ni steng 'gro 'dod/ /tshul bzang logs dang rmang med pa/ /gyen dang / steng dul/ steng gnas dang / /rab tu zhi dang spobs pa can/ /rgyan 'dod dang ni rgyan cha 'dod/ /'gyur 'dod dang ni yid 'dod dang / /120—1351

'khor 'dod/ 'jug 'dod mtshungs pa'o/ /kha 'gog nya snab/ chu 'dod pa / /ni ri ga la/ a ba dha/ /shes ldan rnam spyod thig le dang / /rnam par rgyas dang / rnam par gsal/ /bkram pa brdal ba rab tu brkyangs2 / /rnam par brkyang ba zhes bya'o/ /mnags nus/ mi 'dzer bzod pa dang / /bzod dang bsran nus gus pa'o/ /khang pa/ chu klung / khyem/ de pa'o/ /bsnyus/ pa'i dpa' bo 4de nas khro/ /khro ba/ 'tshig 5pa/ sna thung ba/ /gtum pa shin tu khro ba'o/ 6 /gnyid med dang ni gnyid chag go /gnyid yur ba dang / rab tu 'thibs / /gnyid 'dod pa dang / gnyid log 'dod / /gnyid log pa dang nyal ba mtshungs/ 8 /'phyang dang / mdzes dang / phra dang zang / /de nas nyams dang zin pa'o/ /lhar 'gro/ lha la phyogs pa dang / /sna tshogs 'gro ba kun tu 'gro/ /gang zhig 'phred 'gro da 7dung 'gro/ /lhan cig 'gro dang dus gabyug 'gro/ /phyin ci log dang gzhan du phyogs / /phyir phyogs pa dang pha rol phyogs/ /rgyab kyis phyogs dang / pra tī pa/ /mthun pa/ sa mañdza ba'o/ /nye ba dang ni nye bar zhugs/ /'grol dang kha bub 'og tu phyogs/ /rjes su 'gro dang rjes su son/ /bzod 'dod nye bar bsten pa dang / /rjes su 'gro byed de rjes tshig /ma ning dang ni mi zad pa'o/ /sgo bcas nges bcas rab brjod dang / /smra bar byed dang /spobs pa can/ /ngag dbang dang ni ngag bdag mtshungs/ /bzlas pa smra ba brjod pa'o/ /gsung ldan smra byed/ smra mkhas dang / /gsal ldan dang ni sgrin po dang / /smra ba'i byed 9po zhes bya'o/ /kha bcings/ kha ngan/ tshig ngan no/ /gtam dang / lo rgyus lab bzang dang / /smra bzang / smra mang /720—1352

gtam mang 7po/ /bla na med pa gang smra ba/ /bsnyems pas brjod dang /brjod pa chung / /ngan smra/ ngan spyod mtshungs pa'o/ /'bru mi gsal dang /gtam mi gsal/ /skad dang / sgra zhes bya ba dang / /bstod smad/bsngags 2smra brjod pa mtshungs/ /nus dang 'gal ba smra byed mtshungs/ /gzengs bstod pa dang mtho bar byas/ / smra ba'i tshul dang kha rog go/ /gcer bu gos med phyogs kyi gos/ /gnod dang / gzir dang / gzhan gyes 'tshir/ /gzhal dang mig zhal nges 'joms so/ /'khrul dang phal cher rnam skrag dang / /bag tsha ba dang / 'phyar 4ba mtshungs/ /byar med pa dang rnam g.yo mtshungs/ /bya sta 'khrog po kun tu 'khrugs/ /'dod dang / utpa 5ñdza la dang / /skrag pa sbyin dang dgos pa'o/ /sdig spyod dang ni kun spyod ngan//dbang bral 'ching 6ltas sun 'byin blo/ /don med pa dang don stong 7'thob /nyam nga ba dang shin tu 'jigs/ /kṣi ta lcag tsub lcag gi rgyu/ /g.yo ba dang ni mi brtan pa'o/ /mi shes blun po mngon par ston/ /sun 'byin pa dang /byi bshor ro/ /kha rgyal ba dang shags rgyal ba/ /lag yangs pa ni/ ster 'dod mtshungs/ /'jigs pa med dang kun shes dang / /'gro dang / ti ka bā ga ra/ /tshig rdeg dang ni/ slar smra ba/ /'ching byed phur bu 'gog byed do / /'ching ba bcing dang go cha can/ / lcag gzhus 8skyob byed gsad bya gsod / /skyon 'dzin pha rol nye bar rtog /skyon la gcig tu rtog pa'o/ /dug sel keb dang dug gis gsod/ /gtun shing / gtun gyis brdungs pa dang / /zhe sdang dang ni 'khrug pa dang / /gsad 1 bya mgo bcad 'di dag mtshungs / /uṭwā bi la g.yo ba dang / /shin tu g.yo dang rnam g.yeng ngo / /120—1353

uṭwā la dang / ta rā la/ /log dang ma dul tshul ngan can/ /rna bar zlos dang smra mchu can/ /phra ma dbyes dang gtsugs 1zhes bya/ /skye bo ngan dang / /lce gnyis dang / /slu byed dang ni swo da ka /rnam 'tshe 'joms byed 'tsho ba sdig /mnar byed dang ni ma sgrungs pa/ /stha ga /ma rungs ki ta ba/ /g.yo dang / nges byed ma 2yin skyes/ /dbyug 'khrug can dang ku ha ka 1 /sgo glegs can dang / dra ba can/ /sri ti ka dang / kham pa dang / zur mig sgyu ma ldan pa dang / sgyu ma mkhan dang sgyu ma can/ /sgrub med ngan pa nyer 'jig dang / /yid can kha na ma tho dang / /rigs ngan kun tu dman pa dang //a ba dzee ku yā pa ram̐/ /kai re pa dang / sā llī dang / /khe ṭa gasgo pra tiṇḍa/ /arba / pā ba 5ni kāṇḍi/ /tsa lo sgru shaṃ he tu pre/ 21 /sdig pa sdig 'dod/sdig can no/ /ston pa/ bstan pa/ ston byed do/ /mtho ris lha rnams rdzus skyes te/ /mi dang phyugs sogs mngal na skyes/ /sha sbrang srin sogs drod gsher sgres/ /bya dang sbrul sogs sgong skyes rnams/ /shing dang sngo sogs sa gzhi skyes/ /sas bskrun/ sa skye/ sa las 'khrungs/ /kha ba bska ba/dri zhim dang / /'gro ba rab spyong lam kha'o/ /gtsang ba dri ma med pa dang / /ye dag rang bzhin dri med don/ /tshogs pa sbyar dang byi dor byas/ /bkrus dang dri ma med par byas/ /nges sbyangs/ khrus dang / dag pa dang / /dag byas rab tu bkrus pa dang / /rnyog — pa med dang dri ma bral/ /rnam sbyangs 'bar dang dri ma med/ /dri mas gos dang / dri ma can/ /nag nog dri mas sun phyung ba/ /nyams pa dang ni/ kaṣṭha waṃ/ /snying po med dang /phalgu'o / /stong pa dang ni gsog dang gsob/ /ya ma brla 9dang / ta li ni//720—1354

gtso bo dang ni dang po'i sgo/ /gdong dang / mchog dang / dpon dang ni/ /che shos/ rtse mo/ mchog gyur dang / /gong ma'i gong dang / mchog rab mchog /rab rtse chen po phul byung dang / /ches che ba dang / phul byung dang //mchog gi mchog dang rtse mor 'gro/ /legs pa legs gnas mchog ldan dang / /mchog gnas dang ni/ rab mchog rab/ /phul byung gya 1nom/ /shin tu mchog /bla na med dang shin tu mdzes/ /gong ma ma yin dman pa gnyis/ /'og ma dang ni ma rabs so/ /che dang / rgya che ba tram̐ dang / /yangs dang yangs ldan yangs pa dang / /ma ha ta/ rnam yangs/ /dbyes che dang / /mu ra blu du2/ gu ru'o/ /phra mo bag tsam chung du ma/ /chung bar gnas dang a lī ya4/ /chung dang / nyung dang / cung zad pa/ /phra ma/'jam pa/ rtsa phran tshogs/ /srab dang / char nye bag tsam dang / /zegs 5ma dang ni 'thor ma'o/ /sa tu phran tshigs thun tshigs so/ /dpag med/tshan che/ mang po dang / /rab mang dpung che phal che dang / /mang rab dang ni bhu ti'o/ /gang ba/ brtan pa/ khengs 6pa dang / /rgyas pa dang ni gtams pa'o/ /nges par sgrub dang nges par 'jug /btsas pa dang ni smin pa'o / /byas pa dang ni bcos pa mtshungs/ /sbyin pa/ byin 7dang / byen pa'o / /bde byed dang ni 'dod pa med/ /ma ṭi ka ra bde byed do/ /rgyud dang / dge ba/ sbyin byed dang / /dge ba sbyin sogs de byed pa'o/ /gong du 'pho dang zhi ba pa/ /sangs rgyas pa dang rnam 'jig mtshungs/ /lnga 'dzin pa dang / phyugs bdag skyes/ /kaun sta dang 'dren 'dod pa/ /zas byed pa dang dbye ba dang she/ /'dzem med gos rnged phyogs gos can/ /gcer 120—1355

bu / ba lang / lus gcer tshogs/ /bsod snyoms za dang / dri ma 'dzin//'tsho ba pa dang thos byed pa/ /'khogs dang / btsun pa/ srid 'dul byed| 15 /che phan bgrod pa nges 'gro ba/ /rab grags pa dang pha mes 'dong/ /dkar po ldan dang / 'phags pa 'dres/ /mchod bya dang ni 'gron 'ongs mtshungasaske/ /de 'tsho bsam 'dod re ba dang / /sbyin byed dang ni nges 'dzoms so/ /nyin mo dga' dang 'dod pa dang / /'joms byed brtse/dakta ①bta/ /rab tu thal sbyor drang po dang / /ni randa la gnod las rgyal/ /'dor 'dod/ snang 'dod/ rab gnas dang / /mchog gnas/ sgros gnas| phyi rol gnas/ /myur dang / phra dang / shin tu 'dod/ /rgya tshe sbom ma/ rab byed don/ /legs dang / ring dang / rgyas pa dang / /shin tu phyi dang / shin tu thung / /'phel dang che dang yangs pa dang / /mang dang / barming dang / thung ba dang / /tshogs ldan shin tu phul byung ngo / /thams cad sna tshogs ma lus dang / /zad par lhag med lus pa med/ /ni khi ma dang / mtha' dag dang / /sa ma gra dang / sa masta/ /rdzogs dang ma tshang med pa dang / /kun dang dum bu min zhes bya/1gabargya las pha rol stong la sogs / /brgya sogs pha rol grangs gyur pa/ /gang de grangs te brtsis te gzhal④rka/ /bgrang ba dang ni brtsi ①ba'o/ /bsdus dang / bsgyur dang /bsnun pa dang / /kun tu bsnun pa zhes par 'gyur/ /rnam par bcad pas khyad par byas/ /stug po bar med/ mtshams med dang / /tho re ba dang /co le ba/ /nye logs/ nye 'khor drung na mo/ /glo dang mtho 'khor 'dra ba mo//nye ba'i mgrin dang / lugs bcas pa/ /phyogs mthun pa dang mtshungs par 120—1356

spyod—/ /sa dī i dang nye ba dang / /ma zad pa ni a bya yo/ /logs dang /mtha' dang nye ba'o/ 18 /phyogs 'dra ba dang / phyogs mtshungs 'dod/ /yang dag chags pa 'byar ba dang / /shin tu 'thams pa zhes kyang ngo / /'gyangs 1dang mchog tu ring ba dang / /a rang bya ba haṃ tai mtshungs/ /shin tu ring 'gyangs ches ring dang / /ring po dang ni/ rgya che ba/ /zlum po ril po—/ zur med/ sgong / /mtho dang mthon po ring po dang / /dma' ba thung ngu / mi mtho 2ba/ /mchu thung ba'o/ /de nas mtho/ /ring dang rtse mo bsgreng ba dang / /tuṅge dang ni ustso pa'o/ /bakṣu ram̐ dang / gug dang /dud / /rtse min dma' dang / thung ba'o/ /'khyog po yon po/ kyog pa dang / /mi drang 'khyus dang / sgur po dang / /yo can kyag kyog 'khyog can dang / /gya gyu/ dgye dgu/ bha sgu ra/ /yan lag ma tshang 4 rtsi tai dang / /ka khā la dang sa sto mtshungs/ /drang po dang ni 'khyog 5rnged dang / /pra gu ṇa dang / sha ra la/ 4 /rtag pa rtag tu nges pa dang / rtag tu gtan du chags med dang / /gzugs gcig nyid kyi dus khyab dang / /ther zug par ni brjod par bya/ 7 /don med don bral mo gsham 6dang / /'bras med/ cha med / swā hā'o7/ /ka re bee tai spras pa dang / /khros pa bhu ru kuṇḍi tai/ /gnas dang / ches brtan/ gnas bya dang / /brtan dang cig shos g.yo ba'o / /spyod dang / g.yo ba/ spyod byed dang / /g.yo ba/ sdeg pa/'gul ba dang / / bskyod pa 'khyams 9pa yam yom dang / ldag sdeg /shig shig pag rtse pig dang / /'gul 11dang bskyod pa nyid dang ni/ /yongs su 'gul dang yongs su 'khyol/ /'gro dang / rkyal dang / rab g.yo 'degs/ /120—1357

rnying ①pa dang ni rab rgan dang / /sngon dus ma dang / yun ring ma/ /sngon skyes dang po rgas pa'o/ /bzang po sar pa/ mngon par sar so ma/beer byung / rab gzhon dang / /thog ma yag ma gsar byung ngo / /rab 'phel dar ma me rnyi ta/ /rab gsal snang ba gsal ba dang / /rab sgang /rab gsal/ sgru ṭa'o/ /rtse gcig dang ni bgrod gcig dang / /lus gcig pa dang gzhan min 'jug /bgrod gcig 'gro dang gcig 'gro ba/ /mchog gcig dang ni der 'gro'o/ / rting pa dang ni phyi mo'o②/ /gcig gcig pa yang re re ba/ /thog ma/ sngon ma/ snga ma dang / /dang po mgo ①ma la sogs so/ /tha ma tha shal/ rjes ma/ mtha'/ /phyi ma dang ni mjug ma'o/ /tha dad don dang / gcig gzhan dang / /ches gzhan pa dang cig shos so/ /bee tsa gi ka chags bral 'os/ /ma lus dor ba zhes bya gnyis/ /dbang po can dang bar lta ba/ /mngon sum la ni phyi zhes kyang / /dbang po las 'das nang dang phyi/ /bar na gnas pa don med can/ /bi swatstsha ④stu sbri re shu/ /sko bā na mā su na nī ra saṃ/ /sutstshaṇḍa ti rnam 'phyang min/ /a lo ga ṭi/ rab 'phyang min| /shing rta dang ni saṃ bā dha/ /'dres pa dang ni 'chol ba'o/ /sa bye lus kyi g.yon la 'gyur/ /a pa sa bye g.yas la 'o/ /pra sa ⑤bye ni go bzlog 'gyur| /a pabyu yang g.yas la 'o/ /mi mthun pra ti lo ma dang / /pra ti ku lo| a pabyu rjolo/ /phan dang mnyes gshin ⑦gces pa'o/ /mthong bya ba sho j-i ta'o/ /lcags sgog a narla na'o/ /tshig mang gcig gis dbye ba dang / /skra bregs pa dang / bzhar ⑧ba'o/ /mnyes pa bsub pa 'phur ⑨ba dang / /rnam bab 'gro dang 'gyur ba'o/ /bar du song dang brjed ⑩pa dang / /rab tu 120—1358

song dang bar dag mtshungs/ /'phul ba 'ded pa bskul ba dang / /bskyed pa/'phul ba/ 'phen par 'dod/ /ni gā ḍa dang shā ta dang / /brdar bas rno byas rnon por byas①/ /rgya btab pa dang / ab btab pa/ /bsgo ba dang ni brjod pa dang / /slong ba dang ni/ zhu ba'o/ /rab tu bkab dang sasbyi tai/ /khebs dang bkab pa zhes pa yang / /nges pa dang ni ni ya ta/ /gang ba dang ni rdzogs pa'o/ /rdzogs la khad dang / zin la khad/ /bsregs dang /tshig dang / tshig ma'o/ /bzhogs dang / bzhur dang / chung ngur byas//nyon mongs dang ni sems sdug go/ /phug dang / rtol dang / bug pa byas/ /rnam dpyad/ brtag dpyad/ rnam par phye/ /stug po/ 'thug ②po/ dru ta'oske/ /grub pa/ zin pa/ rdzogs pa'o/ /gses pa/ phye ba/ dbye ba'o| /'khor ba 'jug pa 'khyel ba'o/ /yang dag 'byor dang nye bar 'byor//'ching ba/ 'khyigs pa/ bsdoms ①dang / 'dogs/ /brtod ④pa dang ni dkris ⑤pa'o/ /dog ༷pa/ snal ma/ ran ma snas/ /thags kyi rgyu rnams byed ⑦pa'o/ /nye bar gnas dang nye bar btud/ /nye bar dong dang nye bar son/ /nges mchod sogs dang 'phar dang por/ /ster dang shin tu mchod pa dang / /grol dang yongs su 'jam pa mtshungs/ /'thob dang / rnyed pa gnyis dag go/ /'dogs pa 'khyod ba 'gul ba dang / /g.yo ldeg ⑧pa dang /'dar ba'o/ /gsher can rlan can/ rlon pa dang / /'das po skal min thag can blon/ /kun mchod dang ni klinda'o/ /rab tu 'gro dang rab tu 'phel//chag pa dang ni zhig pa'o/ /sbas dang / yib dang / nye bar bsags/ /smin dang / myug dang / len pa dang / /te bar byug pa zhes bya'o/ /babs 120—1359

pa dang ni zhu ba'o/ /chu dong dang ni khron pa'i chu/ /bsgo ba dang ni/ slob pa'o| /mchod dang / rjed ①dang / gsol rim 'gro/ /pā ṭa dang ni ma nā yang / /bkur ste 'gro dang / mar 'o ma/ /chu yis smin pa zhes pa'o/ /sna dang / snom dang / bsnam pa dang / /sna mang / snom ②nyan/ sgo chos pa/ /khrel dang ngo tsha 'dzem bag dang / 'thob bya/ 'dud bya/ bsdu ba sogs/ /g.yogs pa dang ni byebs pa'o/ /'gro ba/ 'bab pa 'gyur dang 'jug /zhar byung ba ni zur gyis brjod/ /yongs su gyur dang brjod pa'oske/ /rnam sgrub mang byed sna tshogs dang / /gzugs ni so sor sgrub pa mtshungs / /bsdoms ①nas brjod dang bsdu yig go/ /sa munda rta nges par smad| /myang 'das thub pa'i me la sogs/ /myang 'das rlung mi 'jug pa'o/ /bshang ba/ phyi ba bcag byas pa/ /rgyas pa dang ni gang ba'o/ /kha slang ba dang rang gir byas/ /kun thos so sor bzod pa dang / /yang dag thos dang rig pa dang / /nye bar thos dang chad byas dang / /mnyam par bzhag dang nye bar son/ /phyag 'tshal 'dud dang / mchod pa dang / /bkur ste rim gro/ri mor byas/ /nye bar spyod dang / nye bar gnas/ /zhabs thog zhabs 'bring bkur ba'o/ /snyan brjod bsngags ④pa brjod pa dang / /bstod pa/brjod pa/ sgrogs pa dang / /ngag snyan/ tshig snyan/ bsgrags pa dang / /legs brjod/ grags brjod/ yon tan brjod/ /yang dag gdung dang /sems sdug dang / /sdug bsngal dang ni tsha ba dang / /gdung dang kun tu gdung ba'o/ /mi mdzes bzod dang dul ba dang / /dul 'gyur/ zhi dang /zhi bar 'gyur/ /bcad pa/ gtubs pa/ zegs pa dang / /bkas pa/120—1360

dral ①ba/ gas pa dang / /'thub pa dang ni/ gcod pa'o/ /yid dga'/sems dga'/ tshim dang dngas/ /rab tu dga' dang mnyes pa'o/ /bcom dang zhig dang nyams pa dang / /brlag pa chud zos zhig pa nyams/ /thob pa rnyed pa/ 'phrad pa dang / /dngos rnyed/ 'thob pa rnyed pa'o/ /lam rtog pa dang lam nyul dang / /tshol dang rjes tshol rta rjes 'brang / /rjes su dgongs dang kun tu brjod/ /'chab dang sbed pa mtshungs pa'o/ /brnyas pa/ sngan canakhru/khog chud dang / /tshod yod/ ha sa ha ste lta/ /btang ba bor ba spangs pa dang //'phangs pa bskyur peb bor ba'o/ /dben pa dang ni bral ba dang / /bcom dang bzhag pa med pa'o/ /skyabs dang skyob rjopa bsrung ba dang / /sbed pa sgrib pa sbas pa'o/ /smra ba brjod pa zlos ⑤pa gtam/ /grags pa lo rgyus bka' mchid do//go dang rtogs dang khong du chud/ /rig rjodang shes dang kun chub pa/ /zos pa 'chos pa myangs pa dang / / bldad pa ⑦mid pa gsol dang zas/ /myangs byas tshim byas zos pa ⑧dang / /gsol ba tshim bya za dang zas/ /gon dang a ri gtam dang bkab/ /bsgribs dang skor dang 'dod dang bzhag /slar bcings bsdams dang chings ma dang / /kun tu bsdams ⑨pa zhes pa yang / /bkag pa dkris pa bcings pa bskor/ /yongs bskor nges bskor yongs su bcug /rab tu kun phye ba dang phye/ /bzhag dang rnam bkod btags pa dang / /nges bkod phyugs dang nges par son/ /nges bkor btson ⑩dang de nas bral/ /rku dang bye ba dag mtshungs so/ /sgra sgrogs sgra byed nges par nyo/ /skad cig bcom dang phyi mar byas/ /bkram dang rab tu gtor ba dang / /lhur ba dang ni rab 'gro'o| /'khrugs dang 'tshol dang yang dag 'khrugs/ /nges par bsags 120—1361

dang kun tu bsags/ /kun 'jug ①gang dang rdzogs pa dang / /khyab dang bkab par yang brjod do/ /rtsad nas bton dang drung phyung dang / /gnad ⑦nas phyung ba zhes pa yang / /bkag pa dang ni bsal ba dang / /bor dang spangs dang yongs su spang / /spang dzeebyas yongs su bsnun pa yang / / chag grum ④dang ni zhig pa'o/ /bkag sogs rjes su mi 'dod pa/ /rnam par sel dang kun tu yangs/ /rgod dang nges par snyems pa'o/ /bslus pa dang ni rnam par thob/ /de bzhin des bkug ces pa yang / /gser ldan legs rgyal dang ba che/ /gzir ba dang ni btsir ba'o/ /ji lta ji ⑤ltar sbyin gyur dang / /gang gi de la ma gus las/ /'bad dang rab 'bad nges par bkab/ /nges par gtam 'dod brtan pa dang / /su rī tha dang lugs dag mtshungs/ /spyod pa ngan dang bsam pa 'khyog /'gro byed gso byed 'gro dang rgyug /phyag dar ba dang sun 'byin pa/ /so sor brtan dang ṇa rda ka /phrag dog can dang tshul 'chos dumatshungs| /rtsal nyid gang du 'gro yon tan/ /phra ma dang ni byed pa'o/ /de 'gyur rtse mor son pa pa/ /ba dan dang ni mda' zhes pa'ang / /zhes pa dpal ldan dpal 'dzin sdes rnam par bkod pa sna tshogs mig ces bya ba'i mngon brjod las khyad par can gyi sde rdzogs so// //rang bzhin rkyen la sogs don gyi/ /'dren pa'i rtags rnams drang bar bya /las dang bya ba byed pa yi/ /cho ga sgrub par byed pa yi/ /cho ga'i las ni rtag tu 'phro/ /phan tshun gzhom par byed pa rnams/ /mtha' dag tshig la mchog tu 'grorka/ /las dang sgrub byed bya ba la/ /song dang kun tu 'gro bar byed/ /120—1362

rtag tu dbang bya spyin pa dang / /dbang du byed pa zhes pa yang / /nu ma longs spyod nu ①ma 'dzin/ /gzhan gyi tshe dang rang gi 'byor/ /yongs su thob dang yongs su skyob/ /chog pa dang ni lag pa 'gebs/ /g.yo ba dang ni 'dar bar byed/ /ngom ⑧pa dang ni tshim pa'o/ /'tshem pa dang ni tshem bu'o/ /'dra ba gcod pa gtubs pa'o①/ /rol ba dang ni kun tu brtse/ /bsten dang kun tu bsten pa'o/ /de nas skyob dang mnyam gnyis rdzas/ /sa mañdza saṃ gzhan min bcas/ /gcig 'gro ba dang phyogs gcig pa/ /grags ldan grogs su gyur pa dang / /sbyin par byed dang lha nyid dang / /yid kyi rgyal srid grub bcas dang / /nye bar 'gro dang rtse ba dang / /mi zad sbyin dang sbyin pa dang / /'phel du 'jug byed dang sbyin pa/ /yid byed pa dang lha sogs de/ /gang ba'i bzhin dang gang ba'i snod/ /ba lang / ba dang nye bar byug /dbye ba brjod dang brjod brten dang / /snyan brjod mkhas dang mkhas ldan dang / /byams ldan dang ni mdza' bshes ldan/ /yongs su yan lag kun tu gnas/ /rtogs pa dang ni byang chub po/ /kun nas shes dang kun tu 'gro/ /bab chol dang ni 'gro byed de/ /nor dang dpal yon bā ṭa baṃ/ / yangs pa ④can dang byed pa can/ /gzhan dngos byed ⑤dang rgyal ba'o/ /zhi dang dul dang nges pa dang / /bzod dang nus dang thub pa'o/ /nor dang 'khrul rjodang 'khor ba'o/ /spyod pa dang ni spyod tshul lo/ /rigs pa dang ni lugs dang tshul/ /sbyin pa sbyin byed 'debs dang stong / /'byor dang reg pa 'bod pa sgon/ /grags dang rab grags bab dang rtsang / /'phel ba dang ni rgyas pa'o/ /'tshed pa phreng ba smin pa'o/ /gnon pa dang ni brtson pa'o/ /tshig pa bsregs pa bzung 120—1363

ba ①blangs/ /'bugs dang 'bigs dang zad dang rdzogs/ /bsrung ba dang ni skyob ②pa dang / /rgyu dang mi gsal ba yi sgra/ /brten pa dang ni rten byed 'dod—/ /rab 'jal tshad ma 'jal byed do/ /yang dag 'phel dang sgrub pa mtshungasaske/ /'phel byed gcod rtogs bse ba'o/ /brgyal ba dang ni mngon par khyab/ /slong ba bsod snyoms don 'dod slong / /khro ba dang ni mngon par khro/ /tshor ba myong ba nyams su myong / /dri ba dang ni rmed pa dang / /khams bde ba dang 'dri ba'o/ /rab tu 'gro dang rab tu skye/ /'gyur byed rab tu srung byed 'dor/ /ri dang ri bo rgas dang 'khogs/ rgyas pa dang ni 'phro ba'o/ /brjod dang dbyangs sogs rgyags dang khengs/ /byed sgrub gyen bskyod steng du bskyod①/ /shin tu phul phyin sbyar dang 'khyud/ /yul dag dang ni bsam pa'o/ /mtshe ma zung dang phrug ma dang / /bubs dang ro zhes bya ba'o//nyams pa dang ni rmas pa'o/ /bsdu ba dang ni btus pa dang / /rjes su 'gying dang rjes su sgrub/ /bsdu ba dang ni mngon par len/ /mngon par bsdu dang mngon par 'dzin/ /gnas dang yongs su rgyu ba'o/ /so sor bsdu dang nye bar len| /sdod dang gnas par byed ④pa'o/ /yongs su 'gro dang yongs su 'brang / /rjes su byed dang yongs su byed/ /'chags pa bste gnas ngal bso dang / /dri byug pa dang mtshon byed do/ /rtsang ba lhung pa rtsang byed lhung / /'gro byed dang ni 'gro ba'o/ /nges tshig ⑤dang ni rab tu nges/ /nye 'khor nye logs dag dang ni/ /khu tshur bcings dang yang dag gzung / /mngon par bskyed dudang rjes su 'dzin/ /mi 'dzin de dang 'gal ba'o/ /mngon par sbyor dang mngon par 'dzin/ /rnam par nye dang yongs su nyid/ /nges par 120—1364

'jug dang nye bar spyod/ /bgegs dang bar gcod grub pa'i bgegs/ /'byung po nyer 'dug 'khod cing 'dug /rab tu 'beebs dang 'jug pa dang / /'byung dang 'jug dang 'gyur ba'o/ /'brel ba skyigs pa gcod pa'o/ /nad pa reg bya rlung nad can/ /spyod byed rlum po byed pa dang / /phyir byed pa dang 'jig dang bred/ /yengs 'gyur rnam par 'gyur ba dang / /gnyis mtshungs ma med log par byed/ /rnam ①'che'i las dang mngon spyod dang / /de nas song zin zad pa'o/ /lhan cig mi gnas spangs te 'gal/ /mi mthun pa dang 'gal ba'o/ /mdor bsdus pa dang bsdus pa'o/ /nyes pa dang ni mthong ba med| /rnam par khyed dang /da pa dang / /tshogs pa bsdoms pa mtshungs pa'o—/ /gnas skabs dang ni skabs yin no/ /lan cig dang ni skad cig kyang / /sha sbyor mngon par 'khrig pa'o/ /thags yun bkri rdzong snal ②ma bkri//rnga ba 'dreg ①pa 'bal ba'o/ /nges par 'phyar ba 'khrab pa'o/ /yang dag bstod dang kun tu spyod/ /blo nus dang ni chu srol lo/ /'khrug phyir 'jug dang rab sbyor ngon/ /rtsom pa dang ni mgo 'ju ba/ /shom dang mgo zug a re bā| /sbyin pa dang ni gsal bar byed/ /bar chad dang ni bgegs byed do/ /myur rtsol mgyogs su byed pa'o/ /nye bar dmigs dang nyams su myong / /sku byug dang ni byug pa'o/ /rjes chags dang ni sbyor ba'o/ /rnam par dmigs dang shin tu 'dor/ /lus kyi rgyas pa sprustu rā/ /sgra yi rgyas pa bista ra/ /kun zhum zag pa nyon mongs so/ /tshogs pa 'dus pa 'phung ba'o/ /lta ba tshol ba rtogs pa dang / /nyung dang tshol ba zhes bya'o/ /rnam grangs dang ni ming gzhan dang / /ming gi rim pa rnams mtshungs so/ /phyir rgol dang ni bzlog rjo120—1365

pa dang / /bkag pa dang ni bsal ba'o/ /sdog pa dang ni phyir lag dang / /nyal sar log dang phyin ci log /'gongs pa dang ni mchongs pa dang / /'phro ba go rims 'das pa'o/ /rnam par grags dang rab tu grags/ /legs 'bab dang ni nyed pa'o/ /nges klog nges brjod 'don pa dang / /nges par 'dren dang nges tshig go /dbyebs dang de yi gnas tshul dang / /yang dag 'gro ba zhes bya'o/ /skyug ①bro ba dang zhe mer dang / / btsog skyug ②lta log don dag go/ /ring po'i dus dang nyin zhag ring / /u da dza ni phyugs 'ded pa—/ /shing stegs shing 'jog gang dag tu/ /shing stan shing gi u— na/ /gang gi sdong po 'bigs shing za/ /sdong po 'joms dang sdong 'joms so/ /de la kun mnyam gang zhig gis/ /de skyes pa ni mtho ba'o/ /glo lu lud pa 'bod pa dang / /glo 'khogs pa dang lud pa 'khogs/ /rims dang tshad pa'o rgyug dang 'khyu/ /bī ra ti dang ā ra ti/ /ngal bso dang ni nye bar dga'/ /phur bu dang ni phung po dang / /bso ba steng du 'phen pa'i don/ /rī kā ra ni sgregs ④pa ste/ /gyen log lung pa sgrigs pa'o/ /so sor sgrigs ④pa las byung ba| /glo dang zas dag rim pa las/ /rab byung brtul zhugs sbyin pa dang / /dka' thub nges pa gnas pa'o/ /yongs su spyod dang gso ba dang / /'dud dang phyag 'tshal pa dag mtshungs/ /mtha' ni sā ti pi rā mi/ /sā ni zhes pa dag kyang ngo / /ga li sta dang sa pa lo/ /nyul dang rgyal mtshan ldan pa dag /skad cig skad cig ldan dus dang / /'dod dang za bar byed pa'o/ /dus su chad ⑤dang yang dag rdzogs/ /dum bu mu khyud mi zad pa/ /gsol dang yongs su bshad pa dang / /ri ldan rta dang mnyam byed dang / /pra ti pā ni tshigs so 120—1366

so| /dga' ba'i sgra dang ca cor 'gyur/ /byed pa med dang 'phrog skyed sogs| /byed sogs bya ba bco ba la/ /'gran zla med dang gtam dang ni/ /'du 'dzi dang ni 'dor dang gtong / /rigs mthar de yi tshogs pa dang / /u ba ga na ka la sogs/ /bems po sems med rigs ①med dang / /de bzhin sems med la sogs pa/ /byes pa dang ni bu tsha'/ /lhan cig 'gro dang dus gcig 'gro/ /bram ze mi tshogs ②mi rnams kyis/ /bshol tshogs ha la rna du 'gyur/ /g.yul sa g.yul thang g.yul kha'o/ /rtsib logs dang ni rgyab rnams ni/ /pārghaṃsde/ thrasgo/ /zhes pa nyid/ /grong tshogs skye tshogs du ba'i tshogasarka/ /zhags pa tshogs pa so so'o/ /stong phrag tshogs dang ste me tshogs/ /go tshogs rig rjobyed la sogs kyang / /sde tshan ⑤bye ba rdzogs pa las/ /'dod bzhin bshad pa rab tu brjod/ /rgyud bcings pa yi khyad par can/ /gtam dang yongs su brjod pa dang / /dum bu'i gtam dang tshogs pa dang / /gtso bo gzhan yang rtogs par bya/ /bcad dang sde tshan le'u dang / /yongs gcod ldan pa'i mtshams mi zad/ /tshig dang rab brjod snang byed pa/ /bud med skabs dang pho'i be'u/ /aṅgi'i gzhung ni gsal ba yi/ /gnas 'dir yang ni yang dag bsdus/ /tshigs bcad so so so so'i gnas/ /phan tshun brjod pa'i nang las so/ /sargas bcings pa snyan ngag che/ /gzugs can chen po zlos gar du'o/ /drang srong kun dharmā'i bstan bcos/ /dran pa'i lung dang bstan bcos dang / /grangs dang tog dang gzhal ba dang / /gnyis gzhung gnyis gsum bcu yig can/ /rjes su dpag dang lung can dang / /gtan tshigs khyab dang rtags sgrub byed/ /de nas rgyu dang nyer len dang / /rkyen dang lhan 120—1367

cig byed pa'o/ /klog dang de la goms pa dang / /bsdus pa dang ni spyod pa'o//rgyu mthun de dang 'dra ba dang / /kun da smin drug can dus ston/ /dgongs pa dang ni kun spyod do/ /'khor lo dang ni dkyil 'khor ro/ /shuṇḍa ṣpe dang g.yo ba'o/ /khyo re bzang por byed pa yang / /'dab bcas dang ni de byed gang / /mchog dang gang zhig gzir ba'o/ /rā mā ya ṇa dga' byed kyis/ /sgra sgrogs zad par byed ①pa'o/ /dngos po tshig don chos dang ni/ /sems can phyin dang spyod pa'o/ /'das pa'i rnam pa 'phen pa dang / /nges par bsgrub bya yi ge mang / /de nyid dang ni de'i skad cig /tshig dang gtso bo zhes pa yang / /khye'u dang ni ma bsdus dang / /sgrib par byed dang rten med pa/ /byed pa gang dang so sor byed/ /so sor de nyid tshar phyin pa/ /rab tu nges tshig rjes kyi tshul/ /sārsā dzwa dang mnyam gsum mo/ /gang yang 'od ldan lam dang ni/ /gtso bo nyid dang 'od zhugs 'gyur/ /de nas chu dang zheng dang gnas| /mtho dang gzugs can zhes pa'o/ /yongs su spyod dang yongs su 'joms—/ /yongs su 'dun dang yongs su 'dzin/ /yongs su 'chos dang yongs su byed/ /yongs su smod dang yongs su 'gebs/ /cha shas skye ba dug mtshon cha/ /gsad ②pa bya dang ri dwags dag /'os dang snang ba 'jig pa dang / /'thug dang snyigs snemar gyur pa brjod/ /khā ṭi 'dab ma mgo bo rnamasaske/ /gnas dang yul 'khor nges par gnas/ /cha shas nye tshig dri dang zas / /'ching dang tshol bar byed pa dang / /sangs rgyas rdzas dang mchod rten dkor/ /sems can rdzas dang rtsa lag dang / /drug gi grangs kyis phyugs rnams kyi④/ /tshig la ba lang drug par 'dod/ /rnam gnyis rtsod dang 120—1368

gzugs dang ni/ /byed pa 'gro ba dga' ba dang / /dge ba nyes lhung snying la bris / /rtog dang sems dang tshul du byas/ /'khor lo 'jug dang yur ga dang / /nges 'joms dang ni mi 'gro ba/ /grong tshogs grong dang phyag dar dang / /phub can nor dang dga' ba can/ /tshong pa dang ①ni tshong bya dang / /nye bar bsten dang nye bar 'dor/ /ruṇḍa lus 'ching snod dang gnas/ /sa gnas 'tsho ba btung bya dang / /snying dang pags pa phur ma 'dod/ /a la brgya dang 'dud pa'i gnas/ /'dir ni de bzhin sgrub pa min/ /bslu dang mngon par spang po dang / /phreng ba gral dang 'jug pa gral/ /kun tu 'dzin dang chu yi snod/ /mchod rten dang ni rnam 'dren sgo/ /mngon sum dang ni don gsal mthong / /dpa' bo gnon dang rnam par gnon/ /de nas rab tu bstod dang brtsam②/ /de la phyogs pa zhes pa yang / /rang 'dun skyes dang 'dud byed dang / /rab g.yo skyes dang rjes 'brel bzhin/ /ṅga kho chu yi ba raṇḍa / /pa ku ra dang yang dag gnas/ /kun skyob tshong zong 'dud snepa dang //gser bum mtshams dang sna can dang / /gang ba sgrub pa mchog 'dud dupa/ /'jig par byed dang aṣṭa ka /glang po rnga dang khrus chen dang / /tshangs pa chen po thos dang zan/ /ā ba lya ka utpaṣṭha/ /blon po bar ma mjal ba gnyis//sbal pa dang ni ba lang gshed⑤/ /zas dang byed pa tarku ṭa/ /nyin mo ma tsu rka ma ning / /mā mā dzre ti rta rnams kyi'o / /duzhes pa snyan ngag mkhan po paṇḍi ta dpal ldan dpal 'dzin sde yis rnam par bkod pa sna tshogs gsal ba zhes bya ba ming gzhan mu tig phreng ba las 'dres pa'i sde rdzogs so// //120—1369

〉〉sgrags/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sregs/ ⑤〈po ra 〉〉cad—/1367 kya7〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉/ga kye〈〈snar 〉/tshog 1〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉/yo/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉/rigs/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉120—1384

༄ / /skad dod gcig gis don du mar 'jug pa'i mngon brjod nor bu'i phreng ba bzhugs so// 1༄go/ /sa/ngas/ rgyas/ 'a/ phyag 'tshal/ lo/ /dbyangs/ dang ka sogs rim nga/ la/sa/ /gtan phab ka la sogs pa'i mtha'/ /yi ge gnyis/ pa la yang yod/ /nges nga/ ka so/gas/ rim/ nga/ las// /kaḥni tshangs/ pa/ rlung nyi ma/ /me dang /gshin rje bdag nyid dang / /gsa'/ ba dang ni 'gro ba la'o/ /kai ni/ mgo dang / chu dang bde/ /ku'i sgra/ sa dang ngan nga/ la/ /a ka /sdug bsngal/sdig nga/ 'a// /arka/ ri mo/ ma/tshan mo/ dang / /mtshan ma/ dang ni mtshan nyid dang / /gar la sogs dang le'u dang / /phang pa dang ni/ gzugs can la/ /anta ka ni/ ri mo 'khrug /sngags dang / gnas dang / rgyan dag la'o/ /arka/ nyi ma/ arka'i 'dab/ /brgya byen shel dang zangs dag la/ /e ka /gtso bo/ grogs/ po dang / /gang zhig cig shos min pa la / /shaṃ ka /'dab chags bye brag dang / /mthar byed/ sgo glegs 720/de1386

gnyis skyes la/ /karka rin chen karke ta/ /me dang / rta dkar/ me long bum / /kabee sdig pa/ bshang 1ba dang / /kiṣṭa skyon dang / ngan g.yo dang / /de bzhin til mar tshigs ma dang / /sdig sems dang ni/ ba tu ra'o / /kā ka /bya rog /gdan dang / sbrul/ /mgo bo/ byad gdong / ngan pa dang / /nga rgyal gling dang / shing gi bar/ /kā kā/ bya rog byin pa dang / — /bya rog /gral dang / bya rog shing / /kā ka /mā bya/dri ma 'joms/ /brag can la yang blta bar bya/ /kā kai/ bya rog tshogs nga/ dang / /g.yo ba 'ching bar byed pa la'ang / /kusum̐/ mtho dang khru dang ni/ /bang mdzod dang ni/ smad nga/ 'a// /ko ka /'khor lo ce spyang dang / /gtso bo dang ni/ 'bra go'i shing / /sbal pa khyab 'jug rnams la'o/ /tstsha ka /khyem la zhen pa dang / /sna tshogs ri dwags/ 'dab chags dang / /grong khyer dang ni/ 'khyog ngo/ la/ /ṭi ka /rdo ba 'joms pa dang / /rdo yi rtsig pa mngon brjod dang / /nga rgyal/ bye brag /spre'u'i gnas/ /byin pa'i bar dang / ral gri'i shubs/ /khro dang rko bar byed pa la/ /tarka/som nyi rnam rtog dang / /sbrul dang las dang shā tri yi/ /rab tu dbye ba dag 'a/'o / /to shaṃ/ bu rgyud/ bu dang ni/ /ri mo dang ni rgyab 'jog gsum/ /tri kā/ khron pa'i mu khyud dang / /gnyis pa can dang bya rog mdzod/ /nā ka /mtho ris/ bar snang la/ /nā ku/ grog mkhar ri bong dang / /thub pa'i bye brag rnams la'o/ /niṣka gser dang / dong tse 4zho/ /brgyad lhag brgya yi gser dang ni/ /brang gi rgyan srang gser srang la'o/ /n+yadku / ri dwags / drang srong dbye/ /paṅka / 'dam dang / sdig pa la/ /pā ka/120—/387

smin dang byis pa la/ /bā ka /rgas dang yongs su smin/ /mthar thug pa dang ngal ba la/ /ba ga mthar byed zhi ba dang / /srin po'i bye brag /lus ngan la/ /baṅga chu sogs 'khrog pa dang / /baryā na dang / skal ba dang / /bcom pa la/ ni brjod bya ldan/ /paṅka / shing shun/ shing skogs 1rdu/ /dhū ka/bu ga dus la'o/ /bhe ka /sbal pa/ sprin dag pa/ /muṣka/ sgo nga'i mdzod dang / tshogs/ /thar pa can dang / yal ga can/ /rū ka /ngag mi ldan dang / dman/ /raṅka / rta dang gyang dag la/ /rā kā/ mthong ba'i rdu'/ dang ni/ /bu mo dang ni 'bab chu'i bar/ /zla ba gang zhing rdzogs pa dang / /g.ya' ba'i nad la'ang blta bar bya/ re ka /dog pa/ pa ri ka /tha ma dang ni brjod bya can/ /ro kai bu ga /byin nas 'phrog /ri bo ka dang mdzes nga/'o/ /laṅgā / srin po'i grong / yal ga /ku laṣṭa dang / shā ki dī / /ā lo ka ni snang bar brjod/ /lo ka nga/ dang / skye bo la/ /shaṃ kā/skrag dang / rnam rtog la/ /shaṃ ku/ gangs 4kyi khyad par dang / /zhi ba/phur bu/ rkang pa dang / /mtshon cha'i khyad par dag la yang / /shalke dag/shing shun phye/ /shā ka nus pa shing dang glang 5/ /mi yi bdag po'i khyad par la//shā shaṃ/ ljang gu lo ma dang / /me tog 'bras bu la sogs so/ /shu ka 'thor byed rgyas nga/'i bu/ /sgra sgogs dang ni bsngags pa la/ /shu kang / gradzre parṇa dang / /shi rī ṣa dang / shing dmar la/ /shulke/ byed pa la sogs dang / /gang zhig ma yi chad pa 6la'o/ /shri ka /shuṅga brtse ba la/ /sho rka/ ṣpe sgo'i tshogs dang ni/ /bud 7med byed pa'i khyad par la'ang / /shlau ka tshigs bcad grags pa la/ /sre ka /rlung dang utpal mnga'/ /sto ka /chung ngu char sdod 720—1388

bye'u / /a nu kā 1ni nyung dang / mkhas/ /dmag dang nyon mongs ra ṇa rka//rigs dang ngang tshul a ṇa ka④/ /lcags sgog skye ba/ abyu ka /adhi ki ni nyi dang thab/ /arnyi kā ni 'khyags dang sman/ /aṇḍi zhukā ni rtsar yang bshad/ /sring mo che bar yongs su grags/ /a dī ka ni 'jigs pa med/ /'chil byed/'dod ldan snyan ngag mkhan/ /rnams la brjod bya ldan pa'o/ /ambi ka ni chu ldan dang / /skye bor skye ba rnams la yang / /yungs kar dang ni kye ④ta ba/ /grub pa la yang asmṛ rnguka /ambi kā ni tsu kri ka / sgyurapodang / de bzhin tibye ḍi kā dang / /sgyur ba'i tshogs la'ang blta bar bya/ / a bha 'uka ni nya dang byis/ /rmongs pa byu ṇa rtsig pa la'ang / /a la ka ni lus ngan grong / /lan bu/ phye ma a la ka /a la na thuni nyi ma dkar/ /rnal 'byor/ sbyo byed/ khyi la'o/ /a li ldu ka ni brdzun tshig dang / /mi mdza' ba dang nyin mo la'ang / /a sho ka ni 'jam po len/ /nga rgyal dang ni shing sdong la/ /a sho kai ni mchog sbyin la/ /a sho kā ni tsha ba dang / /ro hi bhā dang sho kabyaka /ā dha ka ni nga rgyal dbye/ /gdams pa dang ni āorje ka /ā taṅga ni nad dang gdung / /saṅgā dang ni rdza rnga'i sgra/ /ā na ka ni rnga chung dang / /rnga dang / rnga zlum/ sprin gyi sgra/ /ā lo ka ni blta ba dang / /gsal dang gsong 1por smra ba dang / /āsna shaṃ ni nyin mo dang / /nges 'gro 'dor ba rtag pa'i las/ /ikṣu ku ni/ bur shing dang / /bran/ bza' 6/ nyi ma'i rigs mi bdag /u darka ni/ tshol byed dang / /nag mo'i 'bras dang pyos byed chang / /u phru ka ni ⑫'ug pa dang //ldum dang / sgra ngan 'thab pa la/ /uṣṭa ka ni nges gdung dang / /tsha ba tsam dang myur byed dang / /mkhas pa rnams la'o uṣṭi kā/ /'jim pa/ glang mo/120—1389

myos byed brag /urmi kā ni dpa' rlabs dang / /sor gdub dang ni sbrang bu'i sgra / /gos zhig pa dang / steng du 'khrug /saṃ shu kai ni gos phra dang / /gos tsam dang ni stod g.yogs la/ /katso ka ni go cha dang / /'da' sgrib nges grol brlab pa dang / /dga' byin lus kyi gos la'o/ /sman gyi khyad par kadzi tī / /ka ṭā rta kai ni ri ngos dang / /ri zhol/ rgyal po'i pho brang dang / /gdu bu rgya mtsho'i lan tshwa dang / /rgyan dang glang po'i so la'o/ /ka ṇa 2 ka ni tsha ba dmar/ /tsha ba'i me dang byo 'a la'o/ /ka bye ka ni ngang tshul ngan/ /rudhe rṣa dang sbrul la'o/ /kā li kā ni bshad pa dang / /shin tu 'gro dang / dngos me bsrub/ /kaṇḍa ka ni shing yan lag /lus 4kyi gnas dang skyon dag la/ /ba spu dang ni phran tshegs dag /gsod byed la yang blta bar bya/ /ka na ka ni gser sbyo byed/ /nā 5ga ge sar tsaspa 6ka /ki shu ka dang / gser rtsibs dang / /ko li'i ya la'ang 'ga' zhig 'dod/ /ka ra ka ni thod pa dang / /spyi blugs dang ni mkha' 'gro dang / /le brgan/ se 'bru/ lag pa la/ /sprin kyi rdo ba ka ra kā/ /ka ram̐ ka ni lo thog dang / /bden pa nā ri ke la'i rus//mgo bo rnams so karte kā/ /rna rgyan gling bu rwasogs bskul lcag /lag ldan lag rtse skal ba dang / /lag pa'i gung mo'i sor mo dang / /'dam bu'i sa bon mdzod dang ni/ /ku ṭa ni la'ang 'ga' zhig zer/ /ka waṃ ka ni rtags mtshan dang / /nag bo/ skyon dang skur 'debs la/ /kā thra ka ni bya gag dang / /mgo ser dang ni ko ka la/ /kā mu ka 9 ni 'od ldan bshad/ /a sho ka shing shin tu grol/ /kā ra ka /byed por shes bya/ /las kyi dang po byed por 'dod/ /kā ri kā ni tshigs bcad dang / /'grel pa rgyas pa byas pa la/ /ka ri kā ni 720—1390

gar glang mo① / /nā si ta sogs bzo bo la/ /ka /byermu kai ni 'od ma gzhu ③/ /las kri nus pa brjod byar ldan/ /kā li kā ni gtan ④mo dang / /rnal 'byor ma yi bye brag dang / /nub par gyur dang rin thang dang / /'khye shing khyad par ba to byel/ /ba spu'i phreng ba du ba can/ /snag tsha la'o kā tī ni/ /sdig pa 'dab can sprin stobs ma/ /stobs dang du ba'i rab dbye dang / /sprin sar rnams la brjod byar ldan/ /ki pā ka ni nag chen 'bras/ /rmongs pa dang ni tī tsa ka /sgra ldan 'od ma lha min rlung / /'od ma skam po shing bye brag /tī ṭa ka ni 'bu yi rigs/ /gya tshom hūṃcan la brjod byar ldan/ /ku la ka ni rigs gtso bo/ /grog mkhar bya rog shin tu ka /ku la ke ni tshigs bcad sbyar//sdebs pa dang ni le'u can/ /ku li ka ni klu'i bye brag /rigs gtso shing gi khyad par ro/ /ku shi ka ni thub pa'i dbye/ /thang chu shing dang shing gi mig /til mar lhag ma rnams la'o/ /ku sha ka ni gzhan gdung byed/ /spre'u dang ni 'od chen la/ /rtse mo'i khyad par ku tsi kā/ /'o ma'i rnam 'gyur/ /tū li kyu/kuñtsi ka ni/ kuzla la/ /kyu pa ka ni yon tan shing / /til mar snod dang chu'i btung ba/ /ku kurja ra shi ba la/ /ka bi kā chu'i rdo pa'o/ /grog mkhar mchod rten ku la ka /ku la shaṃ ni 'gram la'o/ /zhing las thong gshol kṛ ṣa ka /kiñtsa ka ni cung zad dang / /pha rol byis pa'i khrag la'o/ /ko ra shaṃ ni kha 'bus mkhas/ /padma'i rtsa ba/ kasko la'o/ / ma taṅga dzwani ze 'bru dang // /bur shing srin bu'i khyad par la/ /kau shu shaṃ ni ltad mo dang / /dga' ston/mngon 'dod/ rtsed 'jo dga'/ /phan tshun phrad dang bkra shis samāyā ra dang / /gtam bshad rgya chen bag ma len/ /yul gyi longs spyod dus la yang / /kau shi 120—1391

ka ni gu gul dang / /'ug pa ṣpe'u le sbrul khas sdig /dbang po sna tshogs bshes gnyen dang / /drang srong mdzod shes rnams la'o/ /gtum mo dang ni chu klung gi/ /bye brag la ni kau shi tī/ /kra mu ka sengaphrom nga/ ni 'bras smanagang la/ /gu bā ka di tshangs pa'i shing / /piṣṭa kā sazhum/khan dang lo dhra dang / /ras bal la'o kharbhe ka /ma hi 'o ma dbu ba can/ /sho ni ka zhes pa la'ang / /kha na ka ni de nyid shes/ /mtshams dang chom rkun/ rnam 'joms la/ /mu ṣi ka ni byi ba dang / /chung dang dman dang tha ma la/ /kho la ka ni smin pa dang / /grog mkhar dang ni shing gla gor/ /mdzod dang mgo bo'i gos la'o/ /ga na 1ka ni skar mkhan dang / /grangs mkhan tshong pa'i bud med la'o/ /ga ṇi ka ni tshogs/ can ma/ /rtog can mo dang glang chen mo/ /gaṇḍa ka ni bse ru dang / /grangs dang rig pa'i rab dbye dang / /rnam par dpyod pa'i khyad par la'o/ /'bab chu'i khyad par gaṇḍa tī/ /gāṇḍi 2ka ni dri bzang po/ /le ka 1ka ni tha snyad byed/ /guṇḍa ka ni dri ma btul4/ /cha shas brjod dang snum gye snod/ /gu hra ka ni sbed pa dang / /gsang ba pa yi snod sbyin dang / /tshe ka dres par brnags pa la/ /gi 5ri ki ni khams bye brag /khams spyi tsam dang gser la'o//go ram̐ ka ni/ bya yi rigs/ /na gu ka dang sā ṭha ka /go la ka ni nor bu can//rlung gi tshul dang phru ba la/ /gradzre ka ni/ ka rī ra/ / smyugama'i myu gu/ lha shes/gu gul/ rim pa dang / /gradzre barṇa/ mdza' bo'i bu/ /pi pi li yi rtsa ba la'o/ /gra ha ka ni snang ba dang / /mkha' 'go/ gza' yi cig shos la/ /tsa ṭa ka ni/ka la dzi ka /de yi bu mo chung ma la/ /tsa tuṅgā ni/ ma sha ka /'phrog byed mchod sdong / khyem bye brag /tsa lu ka ni/ rab 'thor dang / /snod kyi 720—/392

khyad par dag la'o/ /tsa ṣa ka ni chang gi snod/ /chang dang chang gi rab dbye la/ /tsā ra ka ni skyong byed dang / /btson rar bcings pa dag la'o/ /tsi tra kai ni thig le la/ /tsi tra ka ni me yi ming / /e raṇḍa chuthingadang byis/ pa dang / /gcan gzan 1gye ni khyad par stagal/ /tsi ra ka ni lhag par byed/ /yi ge la yang brjod bya ldan/ /tsi ri kā ni bung ba la/ /tsudza ka ni khab len dang / /khram nga// rig pas nyer 'tsho dang / /'dod ldan la'o tsu lu ka /rab 'thor snod kyi khyad par la/ /tsu lu tī na byis pa gsod/ /sgod dbye/ cha shas/khyad par la/ /tsū ḍa ka ni/ gtsug phud dang / /bcud len/ spre'u mdun/shing ka spru ta/ /tsū yi kā ni zlos gar lus/ /rna ba'i rtsa ba glang po la'o/ /dza tu ka ni pags pa'i 'dab/ /'khrul 'khor/ mtshal dang / mig dag la/ /dza na ka ni pha skyed byed/ /rgyal po'i drang srong rgyu'i khyad par/ /dzambu ka ni ce spyang dang / /dman pa nub phyogs bdag po la/ /dzā la kai ni byed pa po/ /ngan g.yo'i rab tu dbye ba dang / /dra ba can dang 'bras bu la/ /dzā la/ kā ni dra ba dang / /rigs su 'gro dang rol mtsho la/ /dzā li ka ni nya pa dang / /khram pa'o grong rtsegs dzha li kai/ /dzā li kā ni/ gos/ bye brag /dra ba can dang 'bras/ bu dang / /ri yi snying po chu gnas/ dang / /shor ba rnams/ kyi rdo ba dang / /lus 'thug pa dang srin mo la'o/ /dzā ha ka ni/ gho bye dang / /byi la khri dang / ka ruṇḍi/ /dzre ba ka ni/ shing bye brag /srog ldan dang ni sbrul khas sdeg /ser po'i ra ba zad nustesasabyed pa/ /rgan po'i 'tsho ba bsnyen bkur ba/ /dzre bi kā ni rgyal 'dra'i lo/ /dzhai li ke 4ni bung ba dang / /byug pa dang ni dri ma dang / /dzhai ru kā dang sbyin dang mdzes/ /ṭuklu ka ni/ dri 720—1393

gtsang khang / /bla gab med pa'i gtsug lag khang / /ṭuṇḍa ka ni dmar ba dang / /cung zad khro ba la yang brjod/ /ḍiṇḍi ka ni na gru ka /chom rkun rmyedaga' ba lhur byed la'o/ /ḍimbi kā ni chu'i gzugs brnyan/ /nga rgyal can dang 'dod ldan no/ /taṇḍa ka ni shing phung dang / /brjod pa mang po bsdus pa dang / /khyem gyi shing dang dbu ba dang / /rkang 'theng dang ni sgyu ma can/ /takṣa ka ni thu klu'i bye brag /'phel ba can dang shing bye brag /tā ra ka ni lha min dang / /gru'i—/ rlung yor 'dzin dang mthong bas sgrol/ /skar ma/ ka bhā/ ni kā'o/ /tā ra kai ni sgol ba po/ /ti la ka ni shing dang nad/ /sme ba rta yi bye brag go/ /tī la shaṃ/ kharutsha/ sau brtsa la/ /ngal ba dang ni kha chu la'o/ /nyi la kā ni khra bo la/ /tu na kā ni sde ris dang / /zho can dang ni 'dab chags la/ /tu ruṣka ni/ spos se hla/ /garalog kla klo'i bye brag dpal gyi gnas/ /tū li kā zhes bya ba ni/ /rnam bkod bkra ba'i ri mo can/ /tū la talpa malastan dag la'o / /tri shaṃ ku phyemaleb ni sha la bha/ /mi bdag dbye ba glang gis so/ /darsha ka ni mchod pa dang / /pha mes slabs zidang pra bee ṇa/ / pi wang bgreng / dā ra ka ni 'byed pa dang / /bu rgyud/ bag ma'i las la'o/ /dī pa ka ni/ngag gi rgyan/ /sgon me 'bar bar byed pa'o/ /dī bya rka ni gtsug phud dang / /a dza mo da sman ra dga' ba ya bā dī/ legs ldan ma/ /dru ṣi kā mig dri ma dang / /tū li kā'o dra ba ka /rdo yi bye brag rnam par tshig /dbyangs ldan la'o dha ni ka /legs pa dang ni dpal yon can/ /dha ni kā ni rgyug 'gropa la'o/ /dhwa ba ka ni / rdul can dang / /rgyal po 'gro ba'i las rnal 'byor/ dha nu ka ni ba bzhon 5ma/ /glang mo phru gu btsas pa la/ /dhe nu kai ni/ bud med kyis/ /120— 1394

byed pa dang ni gzhon ma'i tshogs/ /nasna ka ni gcer bu pa/ /gos med mdud pa med pa'o/ /nisna kā ni gcer mo zhon/ /nanda ka ni 'phrog byed dang //khabyā dga' byed rigs skyong ba/ /na ra ka ni dmyal ba dang / /lha ma yin gyi khyad par la/ /brta ka ni gar dang rtse/ /spyod dang pho ṭa ga la ka/ gru'i 'gram pa/ la/sgeg mo glang mo narta tī/ /nā ya ka ni 'dren pa gtso/ /mchod 'os dang ni dbus ma la/ /'dam skyes mi shes nā li ka /mda' dang zug rngu nā lbo ka /mtsho skyes/ pad sdong / nā li shaṃ/ /bi pā ka ni 'chos pa dang / /rdul dang las kyi 'bras bu rnamasminal/ /nirmo ka ni nam mkha' dang / /go cha thar pa sbrul shun brjes/ /bā ra ka /rta/ blon po che/ /glang po dang ni dung la'o/ /nī ka dang ni dī li kā/ /tshonartsi/ rams dang phra mo'i nad dang ni/ /she pha li ka'i don can no/ /pa tā kā ni rnam rgyal dang / /skal bzang mtshan ma'i rgyal mtshan la/ /padma shaṃ ni/ padma'i shing / /glang mo rig can 'dam skyes la/ /pa rī ka ni brtul zhugs dang / /ral gri skyil krung talba bstanagyi khye/ /glang mo parya ti kā la'o/ /pakṣa ka ni ngos logs phyogs/ /phyogs kyi sgo dang logs bcas dang / /ka ṭa ka yi khyad par dang / /pā ṭa ka zhes bya rnams dang / /mig sogs blta dang rtsa ba'i rdzas/ /nye bar bsags dang ku la dang / ma hā kidku rol mo dang / /grong gi dbye ba la yang blta/ /bārta ka ni g.yang sa dang / /lhung ba skyong chu'i glang po la'o/ /pā laṅka yal ga'i bye brag /sha khru tī ta 'dab chags la'o/ /pā ba ka mi rtag tu spyod/ /bse nyashing gi 'bras bu/ bhalla ta ga bye dong — /ka /tsi tra ka dang me bsrub dang / /dag par byed pa rnams la'o/ /pi sgyu ka ni kaṅga la/ /mtshal dang se hla/ til snyigs ma/ /si nā ka ni 'phrog 120—1395

byed dbyug /mdung dang legs par char 'bab la/ /siṣṭaka ni tsa ma sa/ /nas kyi so ba mig gi nas/ /pu tra ka ni/ sha ra bha/ /bu shing / khram pa ri'i khyad par/ /pu tri kā ni bu 'dzin ma/ /yā ba ka dang tū ka'o/ /pu la ka ni 'bu'i bye brag /nor bu'i skyon dang rdo'i bye brag /glang po'i zan changs ba sru langs/ /ga lwarka dang bab la'o/ /pu khā ka ni sban she stong dang / /bsdus dang zas kyi snyigs ma'o/ /dutpa ke ni lus ngan po'i/ /gzhal med khang dang rin chen zegs/ /mig nad sha tsha ra gan dang / /mig sman khu ba rnams dang ni / /rnga zlum/ ra sa ka ṭī dang / /lcags dang 'khar ba rnams la'o/ /thra thu ka ni/ byis/ sna nyag /pū dā ku ni srog chags pra/ /dṛ dā ku ni/sdog spu dang / /stag dang khra bo dag la yang / /be tsa ka ni/ 'ug pa dang / /glang po'i mjug ma'i rtsa dang rtse/ /pe ṭa ka ni po ti yi/ /sgam dang tshogs pa can la'o/ /pra tī ka ni mi mthun dang / /phyogs re ba dag go zlog dang / /cha shas la'o pra bee ka /'khrus dang shi pa dag la'o/ /pā ṇa ka ni sems can rigs / /po la ka dang 'tsho byed shing / /pri ya ka ni ka dadza/ /a li tsi tra lus ngan dang / /dṛ yam̐ ku dang ljang ser dang / /gur rku dang ni dga' byed la'o / /pha la ka ni bkod pa bkra/ /dar dpyangs lus kyi rab dbye dag /pa rā ka ni brjod bya ldan/ /spyang dang rjes rtse saṅka ra/ /ba su ka ni/ zhi ba'i gyad/ /arka'i 'dab dang spu can dang / /nyi ma dang ni sbal pa can/ /dā tru ha dang khron pa la/ /bā ra ka ni rta'i bye brag /rta yi 'gros dang dgag pa la/ /bāzlu shaṃ ni rgan po'i tshogs/ /rgan po nyid dang rgan po'i las/ /bā la ka ni mi shes byis/ /skra dang / rta dang / glang po dang / /sgra can 120—1396

rnams la blta bar bya/ /bā la ka ni/ ngo tsha dang / /bā ri harya sor gdub la/ /bā li kā ni bye ma byis/ /bo la kā ni rgyan la'o/ /bā lu kā ni bye ma la/ /bā lu ka ni e la'i bye1/ /thra— ka byeni sdig srin dang / /shing dang khyem dang de bzhin sman/ bhasma ka ni thal nad dang / /byi dang ga dang cha yi gter/ /tā dzee ka ni dmar po dang / /sngo yi bye brag rus sbal dang / /'phrog byed mtshan nyid chen po rdzogs/ /skyes bu lag pa'i 'dab ma'o/ /bhū ti shaṃ ni/ bhū nidru //'bar byed ga pur gcod byed dang / /sa can/ bkod pa sa yi ni/ /khyad par yongs su bzung ba'o/ /ju ma ka ni ce spyang dang / /khram pa nyi 'khyems rdo'i bye brag /mazle ka ni sbal sprul dang / /'ching ba'i rab dbye dmar po la/ /lo ma la yang mazla ka /mazle tī ni sbrang rtsi can/ /shing mngar zhes kyang bod pa dang / /phyag dang phyogs kyi khyad par dang / /shing mngar lo ma la yang ngo / /milla ka dang malli kā/ /ngang pa'i rgyal po'i khyad 4par la/ /milla kā ni rtsa stod dang / /nya dang sa yi smod dag la/ /ma pa ka ni srog chags phra/ /rab dbye 'gro ba'i khyad par la/ /mā tro kā ni ma mo dang / /tshangs ma sogs dang lha la yang / /'dzin ma dang ni byed pa la'ang / /mā ma ka ni zhang por brjod/ /mā sa kai ni mnyam nyid ldan/ /phreng ba dang ni mgul rgyan dang / /do shal me tog phreng ba dang / /mkha' lding chu klung khyad par la/ /me tsa ka ni sngo bsangs dang / /rma bya'i mdongs dang mun pa la/ /mee tsa shaṃ ni/ brjod bya bzhin/ /kha dog nag po la 'gyur ro/ /mo tsa ka ni chu shing 'bras/ /de las skyes dang se gru la/ /nirmo tsa ka chags bral can/ /mo da ga ni bca' ba yi/ /bye brag dga' byed gzhan bzhin no/ /ya ma shaṃ ni/ yang dag sdom/ /sgra yi rgyan 720—1397

dang mtshe ma skyes/ /dzā ga ka ni 'gro ba'i tshul/ /rgyal po'i glang po mchod pa can / /yādzhai ka ni mchod sbyin dang / /ku sha mchod sbyin nyer spyor la/ /su ta shaṃ ni byes pa dang / /susma/ rkang rtse/ je tshom dang / /gos dbye/ bu mo'i gos g.yo dang / /ldan pa la ni brjod bya ldan/ /mu thi ka ni 'dod pa dang / /khyu dang / nad med me tog 'ga'/ /rakta ka ni nad gred dang / /gnyen byed/ gos dmar rdzas 1chags la/ /ra dza ka ni/ rgyug pa dang / /ṣpe tso pho dang btso lag mkhan/ /ra sbo kā ni bcud ldan dang / /gser dang ske rags dag 'a/'o/ /rā dzi kā ni springs yig dang / /nya pa/ ske tshe/ yungs kar 'a/'o/ /rā tri ka ni rje rigs kyi/ /khyem dang lo ni 'gro ba'o/ /rā tro kai rgo ma/tshan mo/ la'o/ /ru tsa rka ni mgul rgyan dang / /byi dong ga dang bkra shis/ rdzas/ / /bshang ba/ phreng ba de'i rked dang / /rus rgyan gi wang lha shing dang / /skyur rtsi bī dzadru/ ra dang / /gser la sogs pa'i dong tse la'o/ /ruṇḍi kā ni 'thab nga/ dang / /sgo dang basbus pa pho nya mo/ /re ṇa kā ni glang mo dang / /ya mang a/ghi'i dga' ma la/ /lambu ka ni/ yul/ rgyan gos/ /lā sa ka ni ro'/ pa dang / /sgeg pa'i byed po ma rdzogs pa/ /phru na ka ni/ phyugs tha dang / /lo tsa 4ka ni mig 'bras/ dang / /sha yi gong bu bsdus pa dang / /btsun mo dang ni byis/ nga/'i rgyan/ /dud pa sngon po 'dres pa dang / /mobye/ smin ma/pags pa lhod/ /chu shing dang ni rna ba gang / /nges pa'i blo gros rnams la'o/ /nga/ñtsa ka ni grol ba dang / /khram pa dang ni khyem pa dang / /rta sreb 5dang ce spyang la/ /bandha ka ni brje ba la/ /bandha ki ni g.yo bcas ma/ /bantu kai ni rtsa lag 'tsho/ /bantu ka ni gdong ser la/ /brta ka ‘ni zlum po dang / /bya yi bye 720—/398

brag rta'i rmig pa/ /barṇa ka dang barṇa shaṃ/ /phyag dang spyod dang snyan ngag mkhan//byug pa dang ni 1ri mo mkhan/ /yi ga dang ni tsan dan la/'o/ /nga/rja kā dī sra ba dang / /be'u dang ni smyu gu la'o/ /ballī ka ni grog ma/khar dang / /thub nga/ nad kyi bye brag la/ /bīsgo kai ni skyob pa la/ /barṣa dus 'a/ gzhan bzhin 'gyur/ /bā sgo ka ni me ldan dang / /yul gyi khyad par dang ni rta/ /bā dngha ni me lda na dang //dpa' bo dang ni tshal dag la// /bee tarka ni the tshom dang / /rtog dang dpyod la/ 'ga' zhig 'dod/ /bi sā ka ni yongs 'gyur dang / /rdul dang ro myang ngan 'gro la'o/ /bee be ka ni rnam dpyod dang / /chu yi sno da dang dbeen nga/ 'a /thra ṣāṅka ni bde byed dang / /lcags dang bhalbā ta ka dang / /gzhi chen 'a/'o/ /bi dza kai/ / shaṃ gru'i byu ma dang rgyu dang ni/ /'phra'/ du phyung ba'i myu gu 'a / /bya lī shaṃ ni mi dzi'i 'a/sa/ /mtshan gzhi bral dang gzir ba dang / /grong khyer nga/'o shaṃ kha ka /ma/go bo'i nad la'o/ /༄zhi kha kai/ /gdu bu dung la/'o/ /༄khya dru kā/ /lha ma yin gyi khyad nga/ra dang / /dbyangs ldan glang po'i bum/ mtha' la// /sabaṃ bu ka ni chu'i nya phyis// /sha khā/ kā ni mda' nyid dang / / zug rngu dang ni gdugs/ kyi gur/ /tarku shing bal ri skegs/ myos/ /thob nga min nga/ dag la/ yang / /shābee tī byā khye dang bya/ /shā ya ka ni ral gre mda'/ /shā karka rgyal cho la ra ni/shā 4rka ra'i/ /gong bu 'o ma'i dbu ba la/ /shi shu ka ni byes nga/ dang / /byis pa gso/da dang byis nga/'i tshig /shi ta ka bee legs/ gnas dang / /grang ba'i dus dang ma 'ongs/ mthong / /shi 5 ka ka ni/ dbyar ka yi/ /'bru dang /dngul chu dag 'a/'o/ /sasthā ki ni phreng bar byas/ /tarku dhriṣṭa dag la'o/ /saṃ brka ni sbyangs stobs/ dang / /'du 'dzi dang ni reg pa la/ /ba ra ka ni ma 720—/399

tshang dang / /lam dang / gral dang mtsho dang ni/ /sbo dhu'i btung / snod sī dhu la'o/ /sa gye ka ni pa ta sogs/ /snying po ral gri nor bu la'o/ /sru tsa ka ni ngan nga/ dang / /bya rog khab dang khye dang rtogs/ /sru ta kai ni skye ba la/ /sru ta kai ni/ dngu'/ chu 'a// /sre dā ku ni nags tshal dang / /nyi ma'i gzugs brnyan rdo rje rlung / /'khrud byed/ chu sbyin/ pe tsa ka /se nga/ ka ni/ basma tī/ /rab mtha' shing 'khyeg rjes su 'tsho/ /sthā ka ni spyod pa dang / /pha ra sogs dang chu bur la 'o/ /su byā kā ni/ rams la 'gyur/ /grog mkhar/ shing dag su mbi kā/ /swa/ ste ka ni bkra shis rdzas/ /dga' dang khyem gyi bye brag dang / /phye ma'i rab tu dbye ba dang / /dga' ba'i se' snyan dag 'a/'o/ /hā ra ka ni g.yo can dang / /chom/ rkun tshigs/ bcad rnam/ shes/ dbye/ /du ṭu ka ni/ sel snyan dbye/ /myos pa'i ca co dā tru ha'o/ /te ru ka ni sangs rgyas dbye/ /de bzhin nag po chen po'i tshogs/ / /kṣu ra ka ni/ dra ba can/ /bya dang nya sogs rgya dang dol/ /kṣu ra ka ni khu byug mig /ba la nga rmig nga/ sbum can shing / /aṅga ra ka sol ba dang / /saza' mi sa dam ra/ sa/ skyes kaṇḍa ka 'a 'o/ /i gā ri ka /bur shing mda'/ /ki shu ka'i rko ra ka'o/ /ā ma/ 'a/ ka /sbal/ pa dang / /sbrang can/ chu skyes/ ge sar la'o/ /a li ba ka /gral/ dang ni/ /pi ka dga' ba'i khyad nga/ra ma /a/sma nta kai/ uspyo na/ /mā lu ka dang 'gems nga/ la/ /ā pabee ka /mun pa dang / /rmongs dang mdud nga// 'phyang dang dga'/ /'jug pa'o/ /ā kha ni ka ni/ /byi ba/ chom rkun/ phag dag 'a// /ā kṣe pa ka /rlung nad dang / /nad dang rmod nga/ la 'gyur ro/ /uṅka li ka /rtseng mi dang / /mgren pa bteg dang rgyun mang chu/ /e ḍa mū ka g.yo dang ni/ /ngag dang thos 720—/ /00

pa spangs pa la/ /ka thibee 1 ka /nab so dang / /kā ra bella ra'/ gre 'dab/ /ka ni ka ni mje 2chung gi/ /so/ra mo dang ni/ mig 'bras 'a// /ka parta ka /ral pa bcings/ /dzo ṭiṅga dang / lte ba 'a// /karko ta ke/ dpa'/ 'bras dang / /glu yi rab tu dbye ba la/ /ka la piṅka grong gi bye'u/ /ku liṅga ka dag la'o / /kā ka rū ka /'ug pa rta/ /rgyal byed mkhas nga// ma/kha' gos/ can//'jigs dang dbul ba rnams la'o/ /kā ya ṭi ka gzhan gnad shes// /gdugs dang / dus dang / yul 'a/'o/ /ku ra ba ka 'dod nga/ dang / /seṇḍi 4kā dang / nad bye brag /kṛ ka bā ku khyem bya dang / /sgeg byed dang ni rma bya'o/ /ko ṣā ta ka sgra dang ni/ /snang lda na/ sprin dam/ra sgra sgrogs so// /kau klu ṭi ngan g.yo can/ /ring du bskul dang dal/ med nga/'o/ /kau le ya ka dbang po dang / /'dod chen tī lī na dag 'a/'o/ /khā rā li ka grong bi gtso/ /gnyer dang lcags/ mda' nyer 'jog 'a// /gu ṇa ni kā goms/ nga/ dang / /yan lag stong nga/ 1ga byang dang / /gar 'a/'o shā kaṇḍa ka ni/ /ba 'a/nga rmi/ga nga/ 'a/ 'dod de/ /ba lang yan la/ga dri ma dang / /legs/ byung ska/ma/ gnas/ phur ma/ la'ang / /ga ku li ka ke ka ra/ /'dam gnas/ ba lang phyogs/ can 'a// /sgo me da ka nor bu ser/ /kā ko la/ dang 'dab chags/ la/'ang / /ghargha ri kā/dril chung dang / /rol mo/'i bye brag dag la/ dran/ /de bzhin 'bras/ kyi so/ ba 'dzin / /chu klung gi ni bye brag dang / /rol mo/'i dbyug gu dag la'o/ /tsaṇḍa li kā sman bye brag /go 6rī kā ni mi'am ci/ /dzaṭa ru ka /klu shing dang //chu'i a byu ka ral pa can/ /de bzhin yal ga 'phrog byed dang / /tu lā dha ṭa rnams la'o/ /dzadzdza ri ka rī mo ma/nga / /hrul ngo/ra gyur pa dag la'o/ /dzī babye 720—/ /0/

kā / 'tsho bar bshad/ /yal ga /phyag 'tshal gu ḍū tsi/ /dzi ba tri 1 ka ri bong can/ /tshe ldan lha rdzas sman zhing las/ /tartu rī ka mchog tu gyur/ /tartu rī kai sgod la/'o/ /tikta shā ka /chu lha dang / /seng sdeng lam dang /ma/dzes/ nga/ la/ /tri nga/rṇa kai ni/ tsha ba gsum/ /'bras bu gsum dang gze ma la / /dbye shri — ka lag 'gro dang / /gnod sbyin la 'gyur de nas ni/ /ā ṭa ka /rang byes/ dang / /nā ga ge sar til dbu ba/ /kunda shi rī ṣa dris lan/ /rlung dang 'obs dang sgol ba che/ /btsag dang glang mo'i rna ba dang / /me dang gzegs/ ma'i tshogs/ dang ni/ /bre dang bya ba'i phung ngo/ la/ /dā se ra ka 'bangs/ mo/'i bu/ /glang ngo/'i phru gu nya pa'o/ /ni yā ma ka gru 'dren dang / /bla ma/ blo gros/ rlung g.yo/ra 'dzin/ 'khru'/ 'khor byed nga/ rnams/ 'a/'o/ /nirgand+ra ka zad byad 4 nga// /cha med/ gos/ med spyod med dang / /rlung dang rang dbang bshang ba'i zad/ /nga/ñdzu 6li kā/ gos// bu mo/ /glu yi bye brag dag la 'o/ /nga/ṇḍi ta ka sgo/sa/ dang dregs// /dbu ba rdos/ dang nu ma'i dngos/ /bispa/ li ka ma/ ning dang / /sī ba na dang srin bal/ can/ /puṇḍa rī ka /me/phyogs / glang / /stag dang bud shing bye brag nga / /puṇḍa ri kai gdugs dkar dang / /chu skyes dkar dang sma na la'o/ /puṣka la/ ka ri dwags/ dri / /phur bu dang rgo zad byed 'a// / dru rṇa nga/ ka sgod gang ba/ /pa ṭa ha yi sgod dag 'a// /ngo/ tī na shaṃ po ta tī/ /rnam g.yo/ po tā dha na la'o/ /pra tīrṇa kai mdud pa'i dbye/ /bkra shis rnga yab rta la'o/ /pra tsa lī ཿka mda' 'phen dang / /rma/ bya gnod sbyin la/ga 'gro 'a// /pharka rī ka tsa pe ṭa/ / parka ri kai 'jam po la / /ba ge ru ka 'khyeg po'i dbye/ /rlung rnged pa dang lcug ma la/ /ka 720/de/ /02

parda ka mig 'bras dag /brang ⑫po sa bon mdzod lte ba/ /ba raṇḍa ka glang po yi/ /tshor reg lang tsho'i tsher ma dang / /de bzhin kun nas zlum po la/ /brta rū ka chu klung dbye/ /dza le 47pa ṭa bya rog tshang / /sgo nga'i gnas la yang 'dod do/ /barpā rī ka nag po che/ /skra yi bkod pa yal ga la/ /ba khā hā ka chu 'dren dang / /klu dang lha min khyad par rig /pā ṇi — dza ga tshong pa'i rtags/ /ri dwags mtshan ma 'dod ldan ma/ /ḍorba dang ni/ rjes chags tshig /brind+ra 4ra ka lha dang gtso/ /yid du 'ong dang tshogs par dran75/ /bri ha hi kā stag ldan dang / /gos kyi khyad par dag la'o/ /bhaṭwā thur ka lha dang ni/ /sa skyong dka' thub nor can la/ /bha yā na ka stag hūṃdang ni/ /seng ge dang ni 'jigs rung la/ /bhāryā ṭi ka chung ma dang / nges rgyal 'phrog byed khyad par la/ /bhra ma ra ka sprin sbrang chang / /aspyo na dang phye ma dang / mdung 'dzin zhes pa rnams la'o/ /maṇḍi da ka sems chags dang / /kun tu byug pa dag la'o/ /maṇḍa la shaṃ gzugs dang ni/ /mdze yi bye brag dregs pa la/ /bee de ha ka tshong pa dang / /srad bu rje rigs bu la'o/ /bee nā shi ka skad cig pa/ /gzhan dbang dang ni lte ba'i bal/ /sha tā ni ka thub pa'i dbye/ /rgan po sdong po spyang ki khye/ /ce spyang dang ni spre'u la/ /shi lā ṭa ka snum dang drag /shriṅga ṭa ka sgo'i lcog dang / /lam gyi bzhi 3 mdo dag la'o/ /saṃ ghā ṭi kā snam sbyar dang / /sna dang chu snod kuṣṭa bee/ /santa ni ka 'o zho'i mtsho/ /spre'u'i dra ba dag la'o/ /saṃ rda shi ka shaṃ pa dang / /lcags kyi 'khrul 'khor rab dbye la/ /a pra tī ka 9dbang ldan dang / /phyogs kyi glang po lha yi gzugs/ /shri 7ga li ka ce spyang mo/ /skrag pa dang ni 'bros pa la/ /shi ka ti shaṃ ma yi snod/ /bkra shis srad bu dag la ni/ /720—1403

de bkod dang ni je tshom la'o/ /ma yu ra ka spangs ma tshonartsidang ma dang / /a pā mārga'i shing la'o/ /ma ru ba ka myos byed dang / /me tog dbye ba dbu ba sngos① //bā ṇa ba ka do shal dbye/ /byis pa skyes ngan mkhas pa la/ /mṛṣṭi ru ka smra byed ma / /mṛṭwā shin dang 'gron po'i dgra/ /ra tadhi kai bde ba'i 'khrus/ /bkra shis brgyad pa dang nyin mo/ /rā dha raṅka rgan la nyan/ /shis byed sprin gyi rdo ba'o/ /la tā li ka a mra'i lcug /rdo rje'i khu tshur la yang dran/ /lā lā ṭi ka bya la bzod/ /'khyud pa'i khyad par dag dang ni/ /gtso bo'i dpral ba blta ba dang / /mthong ba med pa yang brjod do/ /le spyi ra ka phrin yig khyer/ /ke yabya yi phrin yig la/ /le khāe la ka gzhan lag nas/ /rang gi lag gi phrin yig la/ /bi tunda shaṃ dpal yon can/ /dzha ṭa ma la la yang ngo / /bi dru ṣa ka mkhas pa dang / /gzhan smos pa dang cho ga byed/ /bi nā ya ka rgyal ba mgon/ /bya khyung khyab 'jug bgegs bla ma/ /bi mā na ki nga rgyal gyes/ /stong pa dang ni mngon par sems/ /lha yi theg dang sa bdun khyem/ /bi she ṣa ka thig le dang / /khyad par du ni byed pa la/ /bee ta li ka rtogs byed pa'i/ /ri mo dang ni grags pa dang / /ḍi tā la dang bu dang ni/ /phye ma gnyis pa phreng gnyis pa/ /rnam par skyod byed rnams la'o/ /mee ka nyi ka dri gtsang khang / /rgya mtsho dang ni khrus la'o/ /rang gi chung ma so bhārgyu gzhan ba dal byetasta gnas sbyi/ /gang yozhig na sgrub par bīdhayituḥm nus pa shakṣamade/ /de la der tatrasabakod rsās tsam mātre ṇa gyes ni/ /bkres par kyubha 6rtabyas pa'i kṛtabaza' ba sgodzanab la'o/ /so ma balka shun pa dang / /seng sdeng dkar po dag la'o/ /sau garnyi ka gdung dang / /padma rā ga gcod byed dang / /dri can dri ldan dag la'o/ /120/de1404

a ṣpe ḍa mū ka zhes pa/ /ki ta ba dang / ngag thos spangs/ /ātstsha ri ta ka zhes pa/ /dgong dang sen mo 'joms bye brag /u pa kā ri kā zhes pa/ /rgyal po'i chibs kyi ra ba dang / /piṣṭa'i dgon pa bur shing byed/ /ka ṭa ko 1 bar byed pa dang / /'ching bu'i bum pa dag dang ni/ /gtor mas rgyas dang ce spyang la'o/ /kakṣu pekṣu 2 ka zhes pa/ /brtan dang dag pa'i mtha' dang ni/ /skyed tshal skyong bar byed pa dang / /'khrud dang tsaṅgā 'tsho sgo skyong / /kṛ mi kaṇḍa shaṃ zhes/ pa/ /ri mo/ spyo ba/ byi tang nag / sma na/ /sho dza ga ri ko zhes nga// /bkra shis brjod dang thab byed nga/'o/ /tsi li mbi li kā zhes pa/ /mgrin pa can gyi bye brag dang / /ma/kha' snang dang ni khrog rnams la'o/ /dza la kuza 4ka zhes pa/ /lcog dang chu khang pra shī'o/ /dza la tā yi ka zhes pa/ /illī sha dang kā kā tsi/ /nya dag la ni/ 'dod nga/ yin/ /na ba ka raṅka zhes pa/ /be ta'i 'bras bu dang ni sprin/ /na ba pha li kā zhes/ nga///dung dang chu yi khri shing dang / /gru dang gsar du skyes/ nga/ dang / /dang ngo/ra gas/ra skyed 5bud med rdu'// /nā ga pā/ ri rka zhes/ nga// /rgyal/ ngo/'i glang mo/ra glang po skyes// /bya khyung dang ni grangs/ gnas dang / /ske rags/ ri mo/ can 'a/'o//bya ba hā ri kā zhes pa/ /sbyang bar bya ba dang ni mtshal/ /'jig rten gyi ni tha snyad do/ /bye hi rā dzi ka zhes nga// /krā ma dī dang rgya yi 'bras// /sha ta sa/rngi kā/drurpā6 / /shī ta tsadza ka yi sgra/ /gshin rje tshim byed sgon me 'a// /su/ ga santa kai dpyid la'o/ /rgyags pa'i ngag ston la yang 'gyur/ /he ma pu྾ ka dang ni/te ma putpa ka zhes pa/ /me tog tsam pa ka'i phung po'o/ /gā ma madku rwari kā lcog /grang gi 'thab mo la yang blta'o/ /ma nga na ṇa lā kā ni/ /sprul dang 'dod pa 720/de1 /05

skyes la'o/ /mā tu la su tra ka ni/ /zhang po skyes dang khram pa'i 'bras/ /la tā marka ṭa ka ni/ /bu mo me tog spre'u 'o/ /barṇa bi lo ḍa ka ni/ /tshigs bcad greb ma 'phrog bcom 1rkun/ /sezla ra ti la ka ni/ /klu dang sidhū ra'i thig le/ / sna tā tsi kitpa ka ni/ /zla ba bzhi pa'i bsnyen gnas la/ /rtswa ta tsi ki tpa kai ni/ /dka' thub bud med me tog la'o/ /zhes pa snyan ngag mkhan po paṇḍi ta dpal/ ldan dpa'/ 'dzin sde yis rnam par bkod pa sna tshogs gsal ba zhes pa/ming gzhan mu tig phreng ba las/ ka dbyangs bcas ka mtha'i sde'o// //kha ni nam mkha' lha yul sde/ /bla dang yang dag rig dang grong / /stong nga/ thig le dbang po zhing / /ku rja ha la'i 'bras bu la'o/ /na ga sen mo gaṇḍa la / /na khāe/ na khā na dri yi rdzas/ /oṃ kha snyan tshig yid 'ong / /snyan tshig oṃ yig drug pa la 'o/ /phrekhāe parya ṭa la dang / /gar dang 'gros dang rta yi 'gros/4 / /sekhāe 'gro ba'i khyad par dang / /gar dang mṛ 5 ka shi kya la/ /mu khaṃ kha dang nges 'byung sgo/ /thabs dang rtsom pa dag la'o/ /le kha spring 6yig lha min la/ /le khā ri mo gral yi ge/ /shaṃ kha dung dang dpral rus la/ /na khāe gter gyi bye brag la/ /sā/ khā lcug ma rig byed che/ /mtha' can lag pa phyogs kyi bar/ /shi khā yal ga gtsug phud rtse/ /phud bu 'bar ba mjug 7ma la/ /ryā/ kha mdza' bo grogs po la/ /su khaṃ dmed dang mtho ris la/ /su khā grong dang rab sems so/ /go mu kha ni kha chung dang / /rol mo'i snod dang nyer byug dang //tri shī dri shā khā bhe ka thabee ko/ /bi shī kha ni mda' bo che/ /mda' dang rko byed shing rta dang / sdong bu la'o/ /bi shi 17/ sa ga sgrub byed/ /bsrub pa 720—/ 06

la'o / /bra mu kha ni dang po/ gtso/ /'od chags 'bar ba/ nad lag pa'o / /bi shā khā ni skems byed rtog /asni mu kha lha dang ni/ /gnyis skyes dang ni rlung gi ming / /aghi mu khye zhes pa dang / /'ga' zhig abyā mu kha ste/ /ballī rmyeta ka'i shing la'o/ /abyā shi khā mjug ma can/ aghi shi khaṃ gur kum brjod / /ind+ra le khā zla ba'i cha/ /la tā su kha zla ba'i bcud/ /asne 2na kha rus sbal dang / /glang po 'gar ni ba lang sogs/ /baddhā ye khā bskrad pa la/ /baspyo 1shi kha byis pa la/ /ma hā saṃ kha mi rus dang / /gter dang dung gi rab dbye la/ /byu ghra na kha kanda ste/ /dri yi rdzas kyi bye brag go/ /parba dza 4mu khaṃ zhes pa/ /nam mkha' dang ni lam la'o/ /sarba te mu khā zhes pa/ /zhing shes cho ga drag po la'o/ /sna tshogs gsal ba las kha mtha'i sde'o// //gaḥni dri za tshogs bdag nyid/ /gi/ glu/ gā ni/ glu mkhan la/ /go ni glang dang mtho ris dang / mkha' 'od rdo rje dzra pa spyapho'ori ba lang sa phyogs mig dang ngag /mda' dang chu rnams la ni pho6/ /a ga 'gro med shing ri bogye/ /nyi ma lag 'gro dag la'o/ /aṅga chang gi rab dbye la/ /a shaṃ lus dang gtso bo dang / /thabs dang 'gran zla nye ba dang / /yan lag ldan pa rnams la'o/ /aṅga kun tu bod pa dang / /grangs mid zlos trīdon rab dga' la—/ /iṅga sur dang shes pa dang / /'gro dang rmad byung dag la'o/ /kha ga bya dang mda' dang ni/ /nyi ma lha dang gza' la'o/ /khaṅga ral gri tsher ma dang / /rwa can rgyal ba'i khyad par la/ /gāṅgā gdong drug 'jigs byed la/ /shaṃ kā 9 'byung ba brjod byar ldan/ /tsaṅga mdzes dang mkhas pa dang / /chags dang 120—1407

rnam par sgeg pa la/ /ṭaṅga mtshon cha'i khyad par dang / /byin pa dang ni rko byed la/ /tyā ga sbyin dang yongs gtong la/ /tuṅga mtho ba brjod byar ldan/ /tsu shaṃ klu shing ri bo la/ /rtu gi 1sgra dang mtshan mo'o/ /durga bgrod dka' durga ni / /gtum mo dang ni rams la'o/ /na ga ri shing 'gro med dang / /nyi ma lag 'gro dag la'o/ /na ga klu dang klu rngu shing dang / /nā ga ge sar so dang ni/ /glang po dang ni char sprin 'khrug /'khrug las lus kyi rlung bye brag /gtso bo nyid dang mchog gnas dang / /zha nye mtshon dang bud meed kyi/ /'chi bar byed pa'i khyad par la'o/ /seṅga dmar ser seṅga ni/ / mā sbo'o seṅga 1skra can la//siṅgā ra ma tha dang lusakyirtsa/ /lha mo u mā dang ni gi wang la/ /pū ga ni ku rulba dang / /rkang 'thung kra mu ka la'o/ /phalgu dri ma 'bras bu med/ /bha shaṃ ye shes skye gnas 'dod/ /grags pa bdag nyid tshe dang grol/ /dbang phyug brtson 'grus tshigs bral chos/ /dpal dang 'bad pa nyi ma la'o/ /bhaṅga chu rlabs nang bye brag /dbye ba rgyal ba go rims bzlog /bhri ga sha na'i lo tog la / /bhā ga cha dang rnam par dbye/ /phyogs gcig dang ni bgo skal ④la'o/ /j-i gu pa sangs pi nā kin/ /g.yang sa ya mang aghi la/ /j-i nga ga /bud ga /ṣaṅga chagasathogs dang / /du ba 'tshub ma rgyala'o z-iṅgi ni/ /skra yi rgyal dang bu ram shun/ /sgo ga bde dang / sbrul gyi ni/ /gdengs ka dang ni lus dag la//'dus la blta dang bud meed kyi/ /bza' 'ub skyong byed nor la'o/ /mārga lo yi thog ma dang / /sel snyan dang ni rjes tshol la/ /mṛ ga ri dwags phyugs glang po/ /rgyu skar gyi ni dbye ba la/ /mṛ gī tshol dang ri dwags 'gros/ /'dren pa'i khyad par dag la'o/ /yu ga /san mo/ sī rāṅga / /yu gi rdzogs ldan la sogs 120—1408

dus / /gru bzhi 'phel dang ming dang sman/ /yo ga go cha gyon pa dang / /sbyar 1ba bsam gtan las dang ni/ /khyon la sogs dang srad bu rdzas/ /kun 'joms mchog dang sngar med rnyed/ /sman dang thabs dang rigs rnams la/ /ro ga sman rul ba dang nang / /lo ga mdzes dang bibee la'o/ /bo shaṃ mtshan ma rjes su dpag / 'khrug dang /2 'thor dang / grangs dang ni/ /de ba'in ngan nga / ku pra kṛ ti rnams la'o/ /baṅga yul gyi khyad par dang / /bhaṇḍa ta tī ras bal la/ /baṅge mtshon la'ang blta bar bya/ /byaṅga sbal pa lus dman la/ /byaṅge gzhan bzhin ma ning ngo / /shāsgo mda' yi stan la'o/ /shāspyo khyab 'jug mda' stan la/ /shriṅge rwa dang rtse mo dang / /gtso bo mtho dang zhi ba la/ /shriṅga rtse mo'i chu 'bab ma/ /mtshan ma sa yi mag pa la/ /shriṅgā 4rwa dang khyu mchog dang / /nya dang gser gyi khyad par la/ /swarga/ rang bzhin nges grol dang / /nges pa sbyo dang blta ba dang / /rmongs dang le'u rnams la'o/ /n+ya gro dha dang blakṣa dag /ser po la ni siṅgā'o5/ /a ni ga ni/ yid srubs 6dang / /lus med nam mkha' yid la 'dod/ /a rgo ge ni lus dman dang / /lus kyi 'byung ba bzlog pa la/ /a sāṅge ni lus khral dang / /mig gi mtha' dang thig le la/ /a yo ga ni brtson gral brtsegs/ /phral dang khregs dang skyed mos tshal/ /ā sgo ga ni kun 'gro 'bad/ /gdugs dang rab sems gang ba dang / /kun spyor dri dang phreng ba sbyin/ /rtsol ba sgrib 7pa rnams la'o/ /ā shu ga ni mda' dang rlung / /utparga ni 'dor dang gtong / /thun mong ba dang phyir sbyin pa'o/ /urba ga ni skyo ba dang / /shin tu mang po can la'o/ /urba shaṃ ni shin tu 'gro/ /kra mu tī yi 'bras bu la'o/ /ka liṅga ni sen mo rul/ /720—1 409
