du ba 'tshubs dang tshong 1bye brag /yul gyi dbye ba mkhas pa dang / /bsregs dang ko ṭa ka'i 'bras bu/ /ka li gā ni btsun mo'o/ /kā bo gā ni grul bum pa/ /glang po dang ni sbrul dag go/ /ka lo tī ni sbal pa'i rgyab/ /tsa shrī ga ni 'dab chags teṭa// /tsa kre gī ni/ ku ṭu'i nya/ /dzi hma ga ni/ sbrul 'grol mang ayo /tā ḍa ka ni chu klung dang / /'dab ma'i phung bo'o tā ḍa gu/ /thu lu tā ta/skyed bu mo/ /tu ra gī ni rta bon po/ /tu ra gā nguni/ rta dang sems/ /ṭī brga ni/ chos 'dod don/ /tshogs dang / che ba gsum dang ni/ /snying stobs / rdul mun gsum 'dus dang / /'phel dang gnas dang zad pa rnams / /lhan cig brjod la yongs su grags/ /mu stegs/ ral gri dhwa rāṅga / /na raṅga ni pho'i rtags dang / /pa raṇḍa ga phur bu zlum/ /nā raṅga ni zha nye'i mtshon/ /bshang ba/ skye bo/ zung du skyes/ /bi mbi li'i khu ba la'o/ /ni ṣi ga ni/ /mda' dong grogs/ /ni saṃ ga ni/ tshul khrims le'u/ /ni laṅga ni/ 'bu srin dang / /dzha bha ra bhā snying po can/ /pa tai ga ni phye ma leb//nyi ma bya dang / 'bras bye brag /sa baṅga ni ro bcud la/ /ba tāṅga ni tsan dan dmar/ /gro ga dang ni shug pa la/ /banda ga /sbrul/ padma shing / /pa rā ga ni me tog rdul/ /khrus chal sogs dang rdul la'o/ /nye bar chags dang / tsandan dang / /ri bo'i khyad par dag la'ang bshad/ /sund+ra ga ni skyes bu gtso/ /shing gi khyad par utpal dkar/ /dzā sreti pha la dag dang ni/ /skya bo'i sprul la'ang blta bar bya/ /pra ya ga ni 'jug ngogs dbye/ /arga 'bab dang khyab stobs la/ /pa yo ga ni las rab sbyor/ /nges bstan la'o thra yo gu/ /shaṃ sum̐ rā dzi kā dang ni/ /'bras ldan dang ni bimbi lbo/ /sla ba ga ni/120—1410

spre'u dang / /sbal pa/ me lce/ kha lo pa/ /bhu dzee ga ni/ sbrul/ ṣibee/ /khyi 'tshed glang po mā tai ga /mṛ tai/ ga ni rnga dang dbyangs/ /lus dmar 'tsho ①byed sman la'o/ /ralto ga ni bkra shis dang / /brtan pa/ brtse ldan rnam gnon la/ /rā thā ga ni/ gnyis med dang / /'khor lo dang ni 'khor lo'i 'dab/ /shing rta'i yan lag rnams la'o/ /pa raṅga ni mgo skyes gnas/ /bu ram shun pa glang po la'o/ /bā ti ga ni bcu smin pa/ /sgyur ba po dang gser 'gyur mkhan/ /bi ḍi ga ni srin 'joms dang / /nā ga ra'o pi ha ga /mkha' 'gro dang ni rtse mor 'gro/ /bi sarga ni dman pa dang / /gtong dang dri ma 'dor ba dang / /rnam par 'dor dang grol ba dang / /'od dang sel ba'i khyad par la/ /saṃ sgo ga ni dga' ba dang / /longs spyod dang ni rgyal ba'i bstan—/ /sarba shaṃ ni chu la'o/ /khyab bdag bde byed sarba gaḥ/ /sā ram̐ ga ni ri dwags dang / /glang po bye'u mkha' 'gro'i dbye/ /bung ba dang ni khra bo la/ /bya khyung / tshangs pa/ he māṅga / /a nu ṣaṅga ma brtsams dang / /snying rje la yang 'ga' zhig 'dod/ /a ba brga thar pa dang / /'bras bcas bya ba byas pa la/ /a bhi ṣe ga 'du 'dzi dang / /mna' dang / spyo ba mdzod dang ni/ /g.yo ba pa dang spyang ki dang / /skye bo gzugs kyi rab dbye la'o/ /a pa rā ga mtho ris snang / /gza' dang rnge tog ldan pa dang / /du phru la yang / gza' rna can/ /yongs su smra ba rnams la'o/ /u pa sarga nad kyi dbye/ /nye bar 'gro ba dag la'o/ /ka ṭa sgo ga lo thog rnams/ /sen gcod/ bṛ ya tya ya'o//ind+ra rghaṃ ga zla ba skyes/ /rang dbang can dang mi bdag sna/ /dīrgha rdudhwa ka glang chen dang / /phrin yig khyer ba dag la brjod/ /malla nā ga glang chen dkar/ /120—1411

batpa'i bu dang thub pa la'o/ /rā dza shri ga gser gyi ni/ /dbyug pa dang ni maṅga ra / / chubya rog /sa nā/ yo shaṃ/ kun spyor dang / /'du ba dang ni dgos pa la / /saṃ pra/ yo ga rab dga' dang / /las dang rjes su 'gro ba la/ /ka thā pra saṅga zhes pa/ /rlung gi tshogs dang dug gi nad/ /'chos pa'i sman pa dag la brjod/ /nā ḍi ta ram̐ gā zhes pa/ /kā ko la dang / hiṇḍa ka /ra ta hiṇḍa ka la'o/ /ga mtha'i sde'o// //gha ni dril bu'i dbang po la/ /ghā ni dri'/ chung 'joms byed la/ /ghu ni bud med sgra la'o/ /a s+ho sdig nga/ snyug bsngal phongs/ /saṃ tso rkang pa shing gi rtsa/ /argha mchod byed rin thang la/ /ubha lag pa kha sbyar dang / /lus kyi rlung dang smin pa la/ /e gha phan tshun rgyug 1nga/ dang / /myur dang gar gyi man ngag dang / /tshogs dang lam dang rab 'bab la/ /ma llī sma na gye bye brag la/ /ma ghā rgyu skar bcu pa la/ /me gha sprin dang nu/sta la/ /mo gha 'bras med dman pa la/ /mo ghā rkang 'thung skya nar la// /'a/ ghu yid 'ong snying ngo/ med/ /a gu ru dang mṛṅgā dang / /a gu ru nag cig car la/ /shā ghā rab bsngags bsten bkur la/ /mngon nga/ra 'dod pa dag la'o/ /a na ghā ni sdig nga/sa stong / /dri ma med dang yid dga' la/ /a mo gha ni 'bras bur bcas// /a mo ghā ni kun bshad dang / /phan pa dang ni bye dang ga /ulbā gha ni nad rnged dang / /mkhas dang gtsang dang dga' ba ldan/ /kā tsi pagha ni gser dang ni/ /byi ga dkyil 'khor shin tu dngas/ /ni dru gha ni tsha ba'i dus/ /gdung tshad dang ni rngul gye chu/ /sa ri gha ni tho ba dang / /rnal 'byor dbye ba yan lag 'dzin/ /'joms dang 120—/7 12

'ching bu'i bum pa dang / /bum pa ra ba ba lang grong / /pra ti gha ni khong khro khro/ /ma hāsgo ni rin thang che/ /rin thang med dang khā ba ka /sarbo gha ni bla ma dang / /shugs don/ go cha kun don bdag /gha mtha'i sde'o// //nga ni 'jigs par byed dang yul/ /nga mtha'i sde'o// // tsa ni chom 1rkun zla ba dag /a tsa snyemachod dang / gzugs brnyan dag /utstsha che dang mtho ba la/ /ka tsa skra dang bla ma dang / khu ba bu dang rma chings skam/ /ka tsa glang po mo la'o/ /kā tsa nor bu dra ba dang / /mig nad dang ni sa'i khyad par/ /kāsbyi ske rags chun po dang / /losam/se/ guñdza dang ni tshangs bye brag /kurtsa smin ma'i dbus dang ni/ /bsgrub bya smar mi bsngags pa'o / /khrungakhrung / kruñtsa bya yi bye brag dang / /ri dang gling gi rab dbye la/ /tsañtsa sprul pa 'dam bu sogs/ /tsaspyo rtswa yi snami la'o/ /tsazi sor lā 4tro ṭī dang / /ba lang rtsa dang ki lboñtsa/ /tsartswa gnas dang / /rtog pa dang / /spyod dang sems pa snyedag dang ni/ /pags pa dang ni shing shun dang / /pags pa tsam dang bu ram shun/ /dī tsa sā ma ra dang gzhol/ /mi'u thung 'bab phyogs dma' ba dang / /mtha' dag 'jam po shing bal dang / /ru rta lha min bye brag dang / /zhing las 'jigs dang gzhan bye brag /pā tse dus dang phyogs dang yul/ /mo tsa mig sman bzang po la/ /mo tsa shālla li chu shing / /ru tsi mdzes dang 'od dang 'dong / /mngon par chags dang bzang ba la ba tsa ṣpe tso bā tsa 5ni/ /dri dang sā ri ka la brjod/ /bā tsa dbyangs can tshig dang ni//shin tu chung ba'i dba' rlabs dang / /go skabs dang ni bde ba la/ /sa ṭī 120—1413

dbang mo brgya byin ma/ /shu tsi'i nyer 'dzin dag pa dang / /sngags pa chu dang rma bya dang / /sgeg pa dang ni so ga'i dus/ /dkar ba dang ni ma nyams pa'o/ /sru tsi lag sogs tshul dang ni/ /snum 1pa dang ni rtse mo la'o/ /sru ṭī mtshams ldan rnams dang ni/ /brjod dang byed pa'i khyad par la/ /a bī tsa ni dmyal ba dang / /chu yi rba klong bi ha ra4/ / bralab dang / u dī tsi ni chu dang phyogs/ /yul dang dus la brjod bya ldan/ /ka ni tsi ni rgyas pa dang / /'khri shing guñdza shing rta la'o/ /ka ba tsa ni phub ma 'da'olku/ /rnga dang khong bu sgong la'o/ /kra ka tsa ni sog 4le dang / /mdud pa can dang sa skyes so/ /na mu tsi ni mos ldubyed dang / lha min klu chu glang po la'o/ /nā rā tsa ni lcags mda' ma/ /nā rā ṭī ni 'dogs bye brag/ /pra tī tsi ni phyogs dus yul/ /pra pañtsa ni rgya che dang / /kun bsags dang ni spros pa'o/ /ma ri tsi ni 'bar ba dang / /thub pa dang ni kṛ pa ṇa/ / rta dang ral gri dang bkren pa dang gsum la 'jug go/ /mā rā tsi ni mchod sbyin can/ /glang po che dang kasko la/ /srin po'i khyad par rnams la'o/ /mā ri ṭī ni lha mo'i dbye/ /bi ka tsa ni rab rgyas la/ /bee pañtsi ni ngo tsha can/ /rol rtsed pi wang phod can gza'/ /saṃ ko tsa 'uni 'ching ba dang / /nya yi bye brag dag la'o/ /saṃ ko tsam ni gur kum dang / /yang dag grogs po bzang bo la'o / /kā kā byu1/ srad/ sa bon/ /chu yi 'bu dang / di li ra/ /dza la sru tsi chu'i srin bu/ /rwa ④can dang ni byis pa gsod/ shaṃ ka tro ṭi dzhaka'o//ma li mū tsa/ chom rkun mi/ /ta ra nā rī tsa yi sgra/ /khyi dang dga' ba'i yal 'dab dang / /bud med mchog dang yongs brtsams las/ /kun tu byung ba'i bya ba la'o/ /tsa mtha'i sde'o// //120—1414

tsha ni gcod dang bya rog la/ /tsā ni gcod dang 'dod pa dang / /mtshan ma dang ni dang ba la/ /atstsha mi zad pa dang ni/ /dom dang shel dang mngon du phyogs/ /atstsha shin tu dang ba la/ /katstsha brag la sogs mtshams la /gru yi yan lag na ka la/ /ma min bdag dang yongs gnas dang / /g.yo ba'i khyad par rnams la'o/ /katstsha ṭī ri kā dang ni/ /phag mo la yang blta bar bya/ /gutstsha phon po do shal dbye/ /sdong po dang ni bsags pa la/ /bitstsha mjug ma bi tstsha ni/ /shasma li yis bkris pa dang / /rdul dang pū gatstsha ṭa'i sbubs/ /mā bā'i mdun khang phreng ba dang / /skye bo bral ba la putstsha/ /bitstsha phyi ma phyogs dag go/ /sletstsha skad mi gsal ba dang / /rigs kyi bye brag sdig la dga'/ /ma hā katstsha chu klung mgon / /chu yi bdag po la yang ngo / /tsha mtha'i sde'o// //dza ni myur 'gro dzā zhes pa/ /'byung po skye ba rgyal byed rgyal/ /rje ni rā ga dbyangs dang bstod/ /sha za dang ni mgyogs pa la'o/ /a dza nag po dran pa dang / /rdo rje sgra gcan ra ghu'i bu/ /asnga gzhu yi khyad par dang / /zla ba chu skyes ni tsu shingal/ /dung la'o a dzi sa mnyam/ g.yul/ /urdza spro dang /byed pa po/ /udzā brtson 'grus dang ni stobs/ /kañdza skra dang tshangs pa 1la /kañdzi bdud rtsi padma la/ /ku dzi/ dmyal ba/ sol ba la/ /kuñdza spre'u sdong po dang / /glang po dang ni so la yang / /kuñdza2/ sgur 'khyeg /shing bye brag /brdzu 'bra go'i shing dang ni/ /g.ya' ba dang ni srin bu'o/ /gañdza lha khang / gur kha ri gye/ /mdzod la'o/ /gadzā/ bsrub pa la/ /gardza pra hasta 120—1415

'a/'o / /guñdza/ kā ka mon sma na nu ma tsi ri dang / /pa ṭa ha dang sgra yi cha/ /dī dza/ bram ze/ sgong skyes so/ /dī dzā ngan spong / bu rdul bzang / /dhwa dza / rtags mtshan khri rkang dang / /ba dan mtshan rtags/ shoṇḍi ka /ni dza bdag po/ rtags nga/ dang / /rluñdza na byis pa thos nga/ra brjod/ /rludzdza mtshon gyi las la 'gyur/ /kubyā/ 'og tu phyogs pa la/ /piñdza gnod pa/piñdzi g.yo// /beersā shing bal/ yung ba la/ /pañdza 'khrugs la brjod bya ldan/ /pra dzā rgyud dang 'jig rten la// /pra dzā 1 'gro ba tshogs pa dang / /tsā ba ka dang la/ma la/'o/ /bhu dza dang ni ju dza dag /dpung na pa dang ni lag pa dang / /ma dang pha dang gnyis ka la'o/ /mardzu btso blag pa dang ni/ /khrus dang dag pa rnams la'o/ /radzu lhas/ ma yon tan thasas pa dang / /gral dang phreng ba rtsig nga 'a/'o/ /ru tsa nad dang uṅga la/ /lañdza/ da ra dang ma/tha' ngos la/ /lā dzā 'dzin dang 'bras/ so/ ba/ /lā dza gsher ba'i 'bras la'o/ /lā dzi/ pu shel/ rtse la brjod/ /bā dza phyogs la yang 'gyur te/ /sgra dang thub pa'i bye brag 'a/'ang / /rpā dzee mchod sbyin don dang la/ /mar la'o bī dzi rgyud dang ni/ /nye bar len dang khu ba la// /byā dza kun tu 'dzin don dang / /de nyid g.yo/ dang mi sto/na nga/'o/ /brdzu tshong pa dang ni 1ga /sadzdza go bgos/ kun tu 'byung / /sa/ñdza bde 'byung tshong / nga/ dang / /swa dza rdul/ dang rang skyes dang / /khrag dang de bzhin bu la/'o/ /aṅga dzee ni sgra dang dga'/ /bu dang bde bas dregs pa dang / /yan lag 'dzin dang glang po che/ /aṅga dza ni khyag la'o/ /aṇḍa dza ni bya dang nya/ /rtsangs pa sbrul dang gla rtsi dang / /sgong skyes rnams la'o/ /ambu dze / /mtsho skyes dang ni ni tsu la/ / chu'ilcang ma// kombi dza ni yul glang po/ /shaṃ 720/de/ / /6

ga'i dbye ba rnams la bstan/ /ka ra dza ni lag skyes dang / /stag sen dang ni sen mo la'o/ /rmā po dza ni/ zla ba'i shun/ /dung dang klu shing rta rnams la'o1/ /shaṃ bo dzre ni sran ma'i 'dab/ /shing kun lo ma la yang 'dod/ /kā ru dza ni bzo bo dang / /ri mo dang ni rang skyes snum/ /grog mkhar btsag dang dbu ba dang / /glang phrug nā ga ge sar la'o/ /ku ṭa dza ni shing bye brag /bra bo che dang bum pa skyes/ /gi ri dza ni ri yi bu/ /zhang po/ kho ru dā dṛ dā/ /gi ri dzee ni lhang tsher dang / /lcags dang brag zhun dri bzang la dza la dzee ni 'dam skyes dang / /chu skyes padma ru rta dung / /pa rañdza ni til 'khrul 'khor/ /ral gri dbu ba bor ba'i 'dab/ /pā ṇi dzu ni tshong pa dang / /'tsho byed byed pa'i khyad par la/ /ba la dzā ni tshong tshong zong / /kha dog ldan pa'i bud med 'a///ba la dzee ni sa dang zhing / /lo tog yul dang ba lang lhas// /bhū mi dzā sprul la a na tī/ /dmyal ba ngan skyes bhū mi dza/ /murga'i lo ma ba na dzā/ /kha na dza ni glang po stag /'dam skyes nags byung ba na dzee/ /ba hu dza ni rgya'/ rigs/ bshad//zig le khu ba swa yo dzā/ /sa ha dza ni grogs gred nga// /gzhan gye rtags can sa ha dzā/ /sā ma dza na snyan tshig byung / /brjod bya'i rtags can glang po la'o/ /hi ma dzā dang hi ma dza/ /ri yi sras 4ma legs brjod ma/ /de bzhin mai nā ka la'o / /a hi bhu dza rnam 'dul bu khyung / /'brug sgra'i rjes su sgeg pa rma bya la'o / /kāsmi ra da bong nga dkar/ /ru rta gur kum 5nga/dma la/ /gra ha rā dza zla nyi ma/ /dza gha n+ya dza zhes pa ni/ /nu bo dang ni dmangs rigs/ la/ /dī dza ra dzā mtshan mo'i mgon/ /'dul byed bdag skyes khyad par la/ /dharma rā dza gshin rje dang / /bde bar gshegs dang g.yu/la ngor brtan/ /bha ra dhwa dza bla 720—1 /17

ma'i bu/ /stag gi tshogs dang thub pa la/ /bhā ra dā dza bre bo 1 dang / /shing bal ras bal gyi ni khyad par la'o/ /j-i ga rā dza sbrang rtsi'i btung / /spre'u dang ni bya'i skyeb bye brag /yakṣa rā dza mig gsum grogs/ /rā dza rā dza nor sbyin dang / /sa kun dbang dang ri dwags mtshan/ /kṣi rābhi dzee ri bong can/ /khye rābhi dzā dang/la mo la/ /kṣu rābye dzee nya phyis dang / /rgya mtsho'i lan tshwa dag la'o/ / ṛ ṣabha ra dhwa dza'i sgra/ /bde byed mchod pa'i khyad par la/ /de nas mu ni bhe ṣa dzi/ /drang srong ri byi/ a ru ra/ /'gom nga/ la ste dza mtha'i sde'o// //dzha ni spyod pa rlung dag la/ /zhig pa la yang 'ga' zhig 'dod/ /j-i dzha sgra yi bye brag la/ /dzhai ni chu 'khyags char pa la'o/ /dzha mtha'i sde'o// //nya ni dbye kha'i sgra dang ni/ /glu len pa la 'ga' yis bshad/ /dzñā 4ni mkhas/ dang blo la'o/ /bi 5 dha'i sgra ni rmongs sems po/ /pādzñā 6blo la pradzñā 7ma/khas / /saṃ dzñā ming dang glu len dang / /sems pa drang srong bud med dang / /lo/nga ba'i 'a/ga pa mgo dang ni/ /mig rnams kyi ni mtshon byed la'o/ /kṛ ta dzñā ni byas nga/ shes/ /snying ngo/ gzhal bya brjod bya ldan/ /bud med rnams kyi lta ba 'a/ / /de ba dzñā ni tshogs can nga// /bde gshegs bde 'byung sarba dzha / /bdag dang grong khyer kṣe tra dzñā/ /nya mtha'i sde'o// //ṭā ni sa la'o/ ṭa ni sgra/ /ṭi ni bye blugs la 'gyur ro/ /arghaṃ khyem gyi khyad nga/ra dang / /zar ma/ skam po/ zas dag la'o/ /iṣṭa mi dang /mchod sbyin dang / /'du byed rnal 'byor mchod sbyin las/ /mchod dang 720/de/ / 18

mchog tu dga' dang bsngags/ /iṣṭi mchod sbyin mchod dang 'dod/ /bsdus dang tshig bcas srad bu dag /ka ṭa sked pa sha ka dang / /shin tu'i don dang lte ba dang / /glang po'i 'gram pa dam tshig dang / /bya yi rnam pa rmad du byung //ka ṭī/ ka ṭi/ ā ka bye/ /kakhye kā ni sun 'byin dang / /thra 1yo gu dang /ske tshe dang / mya ngan med dang dmar po dang / /tsha ba rnams la lta bar bya/ /ka ṭu bcud dang ser sna dga'/ /dri bzangs rnon po dag la'o/ /kaṣṭi thibs po dka' 'tshegs la/ /ku ṭa/ bum pa/ rdo gzhong dang / /ko ṭa dang ni/khyi la'o/ /ko ṭī/ 'o ma 'bangs mo chang / /ri mo dang ni gutstsha ka /ku ṭa/phung po dang ni shar/ /rtsibs dang tshul 'chos sgyu ma gar/ /spun pa/ rtse gsum / sī dzā ga /'khrul 'khor beegs gong g.yo gred la/ /kṛṣṭi/rtogs dang mi dang 'gugs/ /ko ṭi grangs kyi bye brag dang / /mchog dang shin tu phul byung rab/ /rtse mo gzhu yi mchog ma la/ /kruṣṭi ngu dang sgra sgrog 2la//kha ṭi bad kan thal lcag la/ /mun pa dang ni khron pa la/ /khā ṭi/ sa ba ra tha dang / /kṛ 4ṇa e ka /gra ha la'o/ /ke 5ṭa smod dang nor la dga'/ /ka pha bad lan grong gi dbye ba la/ /kreṣṭa 6sman gyi khyad nga/ra dang / /a dzā ka pra sa bandha la'o/ /gha ṭa bum pa glang po'i 'gram / /ting 'dzin gyi ni bye brag dang / /ba lang gnas dang byed pa la/ /gha ṭā'ang bum pa glang ngo/'i 'gram/ /j-iṣṭi phag dang kun tu sgrogs/ /khyab 'jug gnon dang sgrogs byed la'o/ /gyoṇḍa rgya shug /pū ga'o/ /tsa ṭu/ tsā ṭu/ pi tsiṇḍa/ / /gdan gyi bye brag /brtul zhugs la/ /dza ṭā/ gcer bur skra rtsa ba/ /spang spos la'o dza ṭī ni/ /lus dang dgon pa ni rkuñdza/ /rma yi bye dor/ nags tshal la/ /tru ṭi/720/de/ 19

—'god dang cha shas dang / /sug smel dang ni kun tu gdung / /dus kyi tshad 'a/'o tro ṭi ni/ /katpa la tang sel dang / chu dang nya/ /twaṣṭa 'phel dang / /tshig mda' dang / /bzo bo dang ni rnon po dang / /diṣṭi khu tshur yongs su 'ja'/ / /diṣṭa/ dus dang nyer bstan dag /driṣṭi skal pa/ triṣṭi 2ni/ /mig dang lta ba blo rnams la/ /dha ṭa dag pa 'jal ba la/ /dha ṭī dum bu dang ni gos/ /na ṭī/ 'a/ga nga/'i rnam rol la/ /na ṭa/ sho la/ shi khru ṣa/ /pha ṭa/ gos/ bzang yo byad skyong / /pa ṭu smra mkhas nad med dang / /rdo dang mkhas dang gsa'/ ba dang / /pa ṭo la 'us khur ma dang / gdug 4dang sprogs/ / /nga/ ṭu/ phye ma rdo ba dang / /spang leb/ bzhi mdo/ rma sogs 'ching / /rgya'/ ngo/'i lugs dang stan gyi dbye/ /pa tā rna rgyan rgyan cha dang /rgya byegs dang nga/ra byed nga/ 'a// /babye gos kyi bye brag dang / /ngag gi 'dren dang bum can shing / /puṣṭi 'phel dang gso bar byed/ /nga/ṭa gdengs ka tshul 'chos/ dang / /'gram 'a/ 'o nga'/ gso/ byas pa la/ /pāṇḍi de nas pa ṭa ni/ /n+ya gro dha dang ba rī ṭa/ /brti kā cosadang / ma ṭīr 'dod/ /bha ṭa/ pā ma/ ra yi dbye/ /dang/'a bo la'o bha ṭi ni/ /rab tu 'gro ba nyid la'o/ /byeṣṭa zhes/ nga/ spyo ba dang / /stong pa'i ba ṭi kā 5 la'o/ /muṣṭi 'bras bu khu tshur bcings/ / /mbiṣṭa mi gsal/ smra ba la/ /nad brjod nga/ la smiṣṭi'o/ /yaṣṭi ma/da' dang mtshon cha'i dbye/ /do shal mchog dang do shal che/ /'khri shing rgyal ma/tshan dbyug pa dang / /bhānī'o riṣṭi ni/ /'byor pa dang ni ral gri la/ / riṣṭi bde dang mi dge med/ /la ṭa ral gri rab myos skyon/ /lā ṭa yul dang gos phyogs/ la/ /bā ṭa lam dang tshul la'o/ /bā ṭī khyem dang nidku ṭa/ /bi ṭa 720—/ /20

ṣibee lan tshwa dang / /grangs dang byi ba mda' dang sbrul/ /biṣṭi las byed bzang po dang / /pe ta na dang mngag pa la/ /khruṣṭi nyin mo tho rangs dang / /'bras bu yongs su smyung ba 1la/ /bluṣṭi 'byor pa rigs pa dang / /nges pa la sogs 'bras bu la/ /sha ṭā ral pa seng ge la/ /briṣṭa 2sbrul dang sbyar ba dang //rnam par nges byas bskyed pa la/ /dṛbye sbrul pa le'u la/ /sgu ṭa gsal dang rgyas dang khyab/ /sgu ṭi gsal dang sbal pa mo/ /rkang sgogs la'o triṣṭa ni/ /sgu long dga' skyes rab bsnun la'o/ /a ba ṭa ni bu ga can/ /khron pa lhag ma dong la'o/ /ba ṭu dong dang khron pa la/ /bum pa ya ma ku ṭa dang / /lcags sgog dang ni 'ching ba la/ /a riṣṭa ni sbu ba can/ /gzhol 'phyang bya rog kai ka'o / /a ri 4ṣṭi ni bcas pa'i khyem/ /ta kra dge dang mi dge'i mtshan/ /utpa ṭa ni shas che dang / /dar ba bdo ba 5dregs pa'o/ /ka ra ṭa ni 'tsho ba smad / /shing zan nyi ma bcu gcig pa/ /bya rog sel snyan khyad par dang / /bram ze ngan dang le brgan rtsi/ /gdul dka' glang po'i 'gram pa dag /karka ṭa ni bud med kyi/ /byed pa khyem gye bye brag dang / /sbal pa dang ni bya la'o/ /karka ṭī ni skra can ma/ /shābee li yi 'bras bu la'o/ /karta ṭa ni 'dam dang ni/ /'dam rtsibs ka ra hā ṭar grags/ /kārba ṭa ni ras bal dang / /rgya skyegs la'o shī ka ṭa/ /'jal 'tshed nor med rta la'o/ /kurngu ṭa ni ma ga dha/ /zangs kyi gtsug phud can dang ni/ /gding ba srad bu 'khru 6dang ni/ /ku ku bha dang rdo can la'o/ /kuklu ṭī ni rna rgyan dbus/ /se gol dga' ba dman pa'i dbye/ /zangs kyi gtsug phud can ma dang / /bud med log par spyod pa la / /shā la bhañdzi ku ruṇḍi/ /sgoñdzi kā yi dbye kuṇḍa/ /kṛ sī ṭa ni dga' ba dang / /720—1421

chu dang sgra tshogs 'byung gnas dang / /'phrog byed rnams so tsakrā ṭa/ /dman dang khram pa dug sel ma/ /tsarba ṭa ni khyab pa dang / /rgya che ba dang thal lcag dang / /sarba ṭa la'o tsarba ṭī/ /phye ma'i bye brag la 'gyur ro/ /tsi bee ṭa ni sna leb dang / /sna nyeg dang ni ri sri 1 ta/ /tsi riṇḍi legs gnas ma/ /lang tso gnyis pa'i bud med dang / /spyod pa me tog ngan pa la'o/ /dza ku ṭī ni dza ku ṭa'i / /ri dang khyem la'o dza kyu ṭi/ /rgya mtsho yi ni lan tsha la/ /tri ku ṭa ni dus bzangs la/ /tri pu ṭa ni zhen pa dang / /sa tī na ga la yang 'gyur/ /tri ngu/ ṭā ni gre tog gi/ /dbye ba sug smel dur byid la/ /tram̐ ga ni dra ba'i dbye//bye tāñtsa lī ma yang 'dod/ /tro hā ṭa ni rngon pa dang / /tshigs bcad rab dbye la 'dod do/ /bā ra ṭi/ rta/ tsa ta ka /ro langs brtul zhugs can la'o//nirta ṭa ni brtse med dang / /gzhan snod khrag dang 'bras bu med/ /nirku ṭa ni skyed tshal khyem/ nya pa dang ni sgo glegs la/ /parba ṭa ni phye ma yi/ /rnam 'gyur dang ni sman bye brag /pa riṣṭa ni bsnyen bkur dang / /rab tu gsal dang 'tshol ba la/ /brka ṭī ni sla kṣa dang / /sā ka li yi shing dag la/ /ras bal zhing las pā tra ṭa/ /pitstsha ṭa/ mig /ki ṭā'i rdul/ /pitstsha ṭi ni zha nye sogs/ /ba ra ṭā ni dad pa gso/ /pa ra ṭā ni gasgo lbo/ /parba ṭi ni rje rigs 'bru/ /bārba ṭa ni chu srin la/ /bā ruṇḍa ni byis pa la/ /bhā kyu ṭa ni nya dang brag /bhārlu ṭa ni rngas 'tsho ba/ /chags dang rang gi bud med phrad/ /bhā bā ṭa ni 'dod ldan dang / /legs dang cha lugs lus dang gar/ /marka 4 ṭa ni spre'u sdom/ /bud med kyi ni byed pa la/ /marka ṭi ni spre'u mo/ /sdom mo ṣpe tso dra ba dang / /lag pa lag 5skyes khyad par la/ /mārka ṭa ni sa bon dang / /120—1 122

karka ṭa yi rgyal ba ①tsi na/ /sgyu ru ra dang ba lang dang / /dhu ka'i 'bras la'ang blta bar bya/ /mo tsa ṭa ni tsan dan dang / /nag pos 'tsho dang chu shing gi/ /rus dang nye bar byed pa la/ /mo ra ti ni rtsa ba dang / /e ko ṭi ni me tog la/ /mo ra ṭa ni zhag bdun dang / /'o ma mchog dang mūrbi kā/ /basthā ṭa ni glu mkhan dang / /'dod can ri mo tog tses 'tsho/ /bi ka ṭa ni rnam gcigs dang / /yangs dang mdzes dang mchog la'o/ /bee ka ṭa ni rnam mdzes dang / /nya dang lang tsho gsar pa la/ /be ra ṭa ni 'dres dang dman/ /rgya shug gi ni 'bras bu la/ /shi mā ṭa ni lha yi gzhi/ /seng ge skra dkar mon yul lo/ /saṃ sreṣṭa ni bārnyi sogs/ /legs par dag dang 'grogs pa'o/ /harma ṭa ni/ āo ma dang / /khang bzang / baṃ ge/ rus sbal la'o/ /ustsoṅga ṭa nya'i dbye dang / /skyes bu khro bar byed la'o/ /ga grur hā ṭa chu skyes rtsa/ /sha lya/ dru dang me tog dbye/ /kā ma kyu ṭa tshogs can ma/ /rnam par 'khyams dang tshogs can dga'/ /kadru pu ṇa ngo tsha med/ /smyo dang long bar byed pa la/ /ka ṭi/ na ṭi/ nya pa dang / /gla sgang dang ni dmar po la'o/ /kuṇḍa shī ṭa long ba dang / /ngag dang mngon shes g.yo ba dang / /dzā ra dza yi bram ze ma/ /bu dang 'bangs mo 'dod can la/ /baṅka rī ṭa spang leb dang / /ral gri'i so dang brtul zhugs spyod/ /gā zwa muṣṭi ser sna dang / /ral gri dang ni chu gri sogs / /tsakra bā ṭa/ kra ya dang / /chu thuzheng mtha' dang / gtsug phud shing / /tsa tuḥṣaṣṭi grangs mang cha/ /nā ra ki ṭa rdo ba'i bu/ /legs byin sha bi / haj-i la'o/ /ba ra buṣṭa gzhan 'dzin dang / /gzhan gyis gsos dang tshong zong la/ /pra ti/ kṛṣṭi gsang ba dang / /zhing rmed las ni gnyis pa 120—1423

la'o / /pra ti shiṣṭi zhes pa ni/ /so sor bshad dang bsngags pa la/ /paṭwā rā ṭa zur mig dang / /nyi ma gzhon nu 'od 'bar dang / /mi'u thung chu 'dzin phang pa dang / kānta datta sen mo nyams/ /shi ba'i biṣṭa ngan pa dang / /pags pa ngan dang dbang phyug che/ /pāñtsa lo ha rnams la 'o/ /khru ti ka ṭa/sems mang sbrul/ /sau hatstsha ṭa zhes pa ni/ /klu shing dang ni ge sar la'o/ /da sha no stsoṣṭa zhes pa/ /kha spyor dang ni dbugs 'byin rten/ /pā tā tsaspa ṭa zhes pa/ /lcags/ dang 'khar 1ba rnga zlum dang / /'thab dang rked pa rin chen zegs/ /rlung dang / rnga chen/ rgya shug la'o/ /ṭa mtha'i sde'o// //ṭha ni zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / /stong pa bde byed mtho ba'i sgra/ /ka ṭha thub pa nges brjod dbye/ /lhag par de klog de rig lha/ /kaṇḍa mgrin pa rtsib logs dang / /zug rngu 'joms dang sgra dag la/ /kāddhā phyogs dang rab 'gyur gnas/ /dus kyi 'jal byed mtshams dang ni/ /thang shing la'o kābye ni/ bud shing kuṇḍa rmongs las med/ /kurja nad dang nad mtshon byed/ /goṣṭha 4nang dang lto ba khyem/ /ku shul dang rang gi ba'o/ /gobyā 'dun sa gtam gyi sa/ /gosgo ba lang lhas la 'dod/ /byeṣṭha zla ba'i bye brag dang / /gtso bo dang ni rgan pa la/ /dzreṣṭha zhes pa skar ma dang / /gtun shing sor mo'i khyad par la/ /dunghru nyam chung tha ma la'o/ /nibye nges thob rdzogs pa dang / /nyams dang mtha' dang phul byung dang / /slong ba dang ni nyon mongs la'o/ /yā lbo ma'i gnas/ pā ṭha klog /thrabye lus kyi rgyab phyi ma/ /phraṣṭha sngon 'gro gtso bo la/ /pāṣṭha gtum mo dang ni sman/ /baṇḍa ma byas kun thob dang / /720—/ 12

gdung gi so dang mi'u thung / /sha ṭha ngan pa khram pa dang / /par du gnas pa dag la'o/ /shā ṭha le lo rmongs pa la/ /sheṣṭha mchog dang ku be ra/ /ṣadhī drug rnams rdzogs pa dang / /'phrog byed kyi ni btsun mo la/ /ha ṭha stobs kyi byed pa dang / /pā ri pa li dag la'o/ /a praṣṭha ni dus byes pa/ /a baṣṭha ni rje rigs kyi/ /bu dang gnyis skyes yul phyogs la/ /adzabye ni shaṃ gā skyes/ /ma'i gnas dang ni tshogs/ la'o/ /ka niṣṭha ni chung ngu dang / /no go na chung nyam chung dang / /mthe'u chung dang ni sor mo la'o/ /ka ma ṭha ni rus sbal la/ /ka ma shā ni snod bye brag /dza ra ṭha ni sra pa dang / / skya bo 1dang ni gseg mar brjod / /narma ṭha ni tsū tsu ka /grong khyer la'o bra koṣṭha/ /rgyas par byed dang ras bal gzhi/ /mi yi bdag po'i khra ma'o/ /pra tiṣṭha ni zhe sar 'dod/ /mchod sbyin sgrub dang gnas gzhi dang / yi ge tshigs bcad dag la'o/ /ba riṣṭha ni rab mchog mdzes/ /tije ri la'o ba ribye/ /na le shaṃ dang zangs la'o/ /ma kuṣṭha ni bsrub nga/ dang / /'bru dang phar 'gro dag la'o/ /la ghiṣṭha gos shin tu chung / /bee kuṣṭha ni/ skra can dang / /brgya byin la'o/ /shrī kaṣṭha/ /ri sras bdag dang / sgra ngan dang / /dug sel la yang 'gyur ba'o/ /sā bye ṣṭha 'phags shin tu brtan / /4ka la kaṇḍa pi ka dang / /phug ron ngang pa/ /sgra snyan dang / /kai ka ri dwags khyad par la/ /kā la/ thraṣṭha/ rna ba gzhu5/ /danta sha tha skyur rtsi dang / /ka pittha dang / mtshon gyi las/ /nā rāṅga dang tsu kri kā'o/ /mbi la kaṣṭha dā kyu ha'o/ /gyol po dang ni rab g.yo dang / /ki ni ka la dzi ka 6dang / /ser po'i snying po can dag la'o/ /kā la kaṇḍa bzhin du 'jug /pū ti kāsgo thang shing dang / /lha shing dang ni/ sa skyes la'o/ /sru 720—1425

tra kaṣṭha phug ron dang / /gnyis skyes khañdza ri ṭa la/ /hā ri kaṇḍa/ khu byug dang / /mgren pa do shal bcas la'o/ /ṭha 1mtha'i sde'o// //ḍa ni ri yi mgon po dang / /skrag pa'i sgra la'ang blta bar bya/ /aṇḍa bya dang / nya sogs mdzod/ /'dom gyi sgo nga / brtson 'grus la/ /yī ḍā rtogs pa bu mo dag /i lā bzhin du sa ba lang / /kāṇḍa sde tshan/ mda' dang don/ /sdong bu/ skabs dang chu/ dbyug pa/ /mtshams dang / kusthā/sdong ngo/ dang / /'phrog dang / smad dang bdag ldan ma/ /bu dang dzā rā ta rnam/sa/ so// /kuṇḍi spyi blugs la/ /kuṇḍi/ lha yi dra ba'i gzhi/ /pha ma yang rgo 'dod pa'o/ /1 ḍā/ rtsed mo smod brnyas dang / /ku re la/ 'o kro ḍa ni/ /dal/ ba dang ni phag pa'o/ /kro ḍi phag dang bakṣas la/ /khaṇḍa phyed ma bur shing ji / /rnam 'gyur nor bu sun 'byin la/ /ga ḍa/ nya dang par la 'gro/ /gu zu/ sgur rgyab/ bu re la/ /gaṇḍa/ bre dang spyor ba'i dbye/ /bse ru dang ni khur tshos dang / /mchog dang rab dpa' mtshan ma dang / /rta dang rgyan dang chu bor la'o/ /gu ḍa glang po'i go cha dang / /phru ba bur shing rnam 'gyur la'o/ /gu ḍa/ sgu tī/ ri lu dang / /ma dhwa na la yang 'dod pa'o/ /goṇḍa pā ma ra'i dbye ba/ /rgan po'i lte ba la brjod do/ /tsaṇḍa drag po lha min dbye / /gshin rje'i 'bangs dang shin tu khro/ /tsaṇḍa 2nor 'phrog ma dang ni/ /dung gi me tog can dag la/ /byuṇḍi ri yi bu mo dang / /'tshe byed btsun mo khro byed ma/ /tsū ḍā gdu bu'i dbye ba dang / /gtsug phud dang ni ba ḍa bhū/ /tso ḍa yul dang / gos bye brag /dza ḍa/ rmongs/ lkugs grang bas gzir/ /720—/ 426

kuṇḍa sman la'o bhā ḍa ni/ /khu tshur sogs dang yang dag 'jal/ /rtsa la sogs dang rdeg pa la/ /tā ḍi thal mo dang ni shing / /daṇḍa gtum mo'i cha shas kyis/ /yongs bskor rmyedamag dang dpung bye brag /nga rgyal dbye ba gshin rje 'dul/ /mngon pa'i nga rgyal srub dang rta/ /zur gyi dbyug pa mtshams dang ni/ /gza' gdon mi bdag gdugs dang ni/ /la gu ḍa la 'dod pa'o/ /nā ḍi/ sbubs rtsa rma rnams kyi/ /gaṇḍa/ tudzee dag dang ni/ /skad cig drug gi dus dang ni/ /spyod pa dang ni/ ku ha na'o/ /ni ḍi gnas dang rigs su 'gro/ /nye ba dang ni snga ba bcas/ /baṇḍa blo dkar baṇḍa dang / /baṇḍa kadhī'i bdag dang dkar/ /biṇḍi 2lus kyi cha dag dang / /gnas dang se hla ka'o/ /piṇḍa nas las skyes pa'o/ /gong bur byas pa dag la'o/ /piṇḍi rgyun dang stobs po la/ /khyem gyi cha dang 'tsho ba dang / /piṇḍi ā khā bu dang ni/ /'bra go dang ni spos bye brag /pi ḍā 'joms dang brtse ba dang / /thang shing dang ni mgo'i me tog /tsaṇḍa rigs rnams tshogs pa la/ /tsaṇḍa lag sogs bor ba la/ /bhaṇḍi snod dang /rtsa ba chod pa yi/ /nor dang / rgyan dang rta yi rgyan/ /chu klung snod la'ang 'ga' zhig 'dod/ /kuṇḍa rjugrul bum sbal mo la'o/ /maṇḍa snying po mjug ma dang / /raṇḍa dang ni rgyan dag la/ /maṇḍa ma ma'o ṇḍi ni/ /phal pa'i dbye ba la yang ngo / /muṇḍa/ sgra gcan mgo bo dang / /lha ma yin gyi bye brag la/ /raṇḍa bya ba'i lo ma dang / /sman dang bi dha ba la'o/ /byā ḍa phyug la 'tshe dang sbrul / /shuṇḍa myos dang gya tshom la/ /puṇḍa chang dang rje rigs dang / /sdong bu glang po'i lag pa la/ /shuṇḍa chu yi glang mo la/ /shoṇḍa myos pa mngon par brjod / /shoṇḍi zegs ma tsa bi ka /ṣa ḍa btung ba'i khyad par dang / /padma 120—1427

sogs kyi tshal la'o/ /ṣaṇḍa/ bang rim 1bdag / po sogs2/ /kṣe ḍa sgra dang ka ra la/ /rna bar byung dang rtsub pa dang / /'khyog po'i kṣe ḍā glang mo dang / /dpa' bo rnams kyi seng ge'i sgra/ /rgyab kyi zug rngu la yang ngo /rākṣe ḍi/ arka dmar po'i 'bras/ /dbyangs dang me tog du ra sang / / ka ra ṇa rdoni sbrang rtsi can/ /pā si ka raṇḍa ba dang / /'dab chags da lā ṭa ka'o/ /kuṣṭhaṇḍa ni tshogs kyi dbye/ /srin bu karmā ru dang mngal/ /kuṣṭhaṇḍi ni gtum mo sman / /ko daṇḍa ni smin ma gzhu/ /yul gyi bye brag la yang ngo / /gā ru ḍi ni bstan bcos dang / /dug dang ma ra ka ta la/ /ta raṇḍa ni/ snum can dang / /mchil 4pa/ srad bu bcings pa dang / /dngos po dang ni grub la'o/ /tibye ḍa ni lha min dbye/ /tibye ḍi ni gshin rje'i bran/ /shing dbye mu tsañtsa yi shing / /dra ba'i ḍa ni dbye ba'i sgo/ /tshang gi khyad par mkha' dag la/ /nirguṇḍa ni tra ṇi kā / /sngon po'i rtags dang chung ba dang / / 'dzin dang /5 kar hā ṭa ka la'o / /pi tsiṇḍa ni sra ba dang / /phyugs kyi yan lag la yang ngo / /pu tyaṇḍa sbrul ri dwags dri/ /gaddhā tī ṭa ka la'o/ /pra kaṇḍa ni bkra shis dang / /rtsa ba yal ga'i mtshams shing dang / /yal ga'i tshogs pa la yang ngo / /pra tsaṇḍa ni rab gdung dang / /ngan 'bab/ lugs dang dpa' bo'i lag /ba raṇḍa ni chod 6pa dang / /yu ba gaṇḍa ka dang ni/ /bar gye kha khyer dag la'o/ /bārtaṇḍa ni mche can bya/ /pā ruṇḍi ni sgo'i piṇḍa7/ /bā ruṇḍa thabs mig dri ma/ /gaṇḍi sta yi rgyal po la/ /khrus kyi snod dang tha ba la/ /bhe ruṇḍa ni 'dab chags mo/ /lha mo dbye dang 'jigs ma la/ /mārtaṇḍa ni gtum mo'i 'od/ /phag la 'o ma raṇḍa ni sbrul/ /lam dang / ba byung dkyil 'khor la/ /pi tsaṇḍa ni 720—1428

ri skegs dang / /ral gri gzhon ma gnas la 'jug /bee taṇḍa ni rlung dbye dang / /ka ra bī rī rdo yi ming / /kastso sā ka sādzñā la'o/ /shi khaṇḍa ni/rma bya gtsug /sa piṇḍa ni bgo skal dang / /gong bu dang bcas nu ma la/ /sa raṇḍa ni sa ra ṭa/ /khram pa rgyan gyi khyad par la/ /a po gaṇḍa byis pa can/ /lus ma tshad dang shin tu 'jigs/ /tsa kra bā ḍa ri'i dbye ba/ /tsakra bā ḍi zlum po'o/ /dza ga ruṇḍa chu sgyur ba/ /chu rdul dang ni sbrul dag la/ /de ba tā rā lha yi nyi/ /mtho ris sgang byed dbyangs ldan ma/ /bā tāḥkhu ḍa rlung dmar dang / /batyā lcags sgog mjug ma can/ /gnas tsam la yang blta bar bya/ /ḍa mtha'i sde'o// //bhā ni rda dang yon tan med/ /mi zad pa yi sgra la'o/ /sbo zwa dben dang gsang ba sgribarmye/ /kāphe 'che bye ba 'dod pa la/ /dṛ 'uzwa sgom po stobs ldan la//dṛ bye/ bā bhā/ bra ba/ shwe/ /mā rnyi 'dab sogs bcom pa dang / /nor dang / zhan dang gsal ba la/ /mū bhā le lo/ /rmongs pa la/ /rā bhā tshangs pa bzang dang mdzes/ /ba rnyi des dang dam bca' la/ /do 4bhā rgyas dang skyes pa la/ /khyubhā rgya che rnam bkod tshogs/ /ṣaṇḍa/ sgrib/ char skyes bu bcings / /so bhā bzod dang nus pa la/ /sho zwa yang ni bzod pa la/ /azlu zwa ni dbang phyug la'o/ /azlu ṭwā ni btsun mo dang / /kṛ ta bā bzlu la'o/ /ā ṣā bhā ni brtul zhugs kyi/ /dbyug pa zla ba/ /dri ma slong / /u byu snya ni/phung po sgom/ /u bo bhā ni bkod pa tshogs/ /pra gī bhā ni brtan dang dga'5 / /pra mbi rnye ṇi'u/ dri chu 'thug /pra rū snya ni rtsa ba bcings/ /mkhregs pa dang 720—1429

ni gur la'o/ /bā rū bhā ni rgyags dang me/ /gos dang g.yo ba sgo glegs la/ /bee ghra bhā ni/ /smad dang sbed/ /bee rū bhā ni sol ba skyed/ /sa spru ḍā ni sarba dang / /bhusna/ nye bar 'gro ba dang / /phung po byas pa'o/ /saṃ rū shwe/ /dar ma dang ni myu gu la'o/ /a dhya ru snya/ zhon pa dang / /lhag pa la ste rtags gsum pa/ /shwe mtha'i sde rdzogs so// //ṇa ni gtan la phab dang shes/ /rku ni phra dang bram ze'i dbye/ /a ṇi mchog tu mkhas pa dang / /phur bu mtshams dang zur la'o/ /uṇḍa chad pa gdung ba dang / /bsregs pa dang ni mkhas pa'o/ /urṇa mdzod spu lug sne sogs bal/ /ka ṇa/ pra zegs so ba'i cha/ /ka rja dzi ra bispa li/ /chu srin dang ni ma kṣi kā/ /karṇa/ rna ba thra thā'i bu/ /mdog bzang dang ni lta ba la/ /kā ṇa/ mo kṛ/ khā ba dang / /lta ba'o ki ṇa/ rma mtshan rtags/ /phra mo rma dang yon tan la'o/ /tīṇḍi khebs dang yongs khyab dang / /'tshe ba mngon par brjod pa'o/ /ku ṇi khyi dang gzir ba la/ /kṛṣṭa nakhyab 'jug srid sgrub/spre'u / /rgyas pa la'o/ kṛṣṭi ni/ /na le shaṃ dang / lcags la'o/ /kṛṣṭha/dzre pa dī dī dang / /ba mo/ tū rā/ pispa li/ /ko ṇa mchi ma dbyug pa dang //rol mo'i dbye ba karka skyes/ /pi waṃ la sogs sbyor thabs dang / /phyogs gcig dang ni khyim rnams so/ /ga ṇa tshogs dang 'joms byed grangs/ /dmag gi rab tu dbye ba la/ /gu ṇa gzugs sogs/ snying stobs sogs/ /rig pa sogs dang ljang gu sogs/ /'dod dang gtso bo min pa dang / /mtshams sogs/ thag pa/ modhī dang / /spyang ki'i lto ba rnams la'o/ /720—/‘ 30

gesngu gar dang glu len la/ /1 ṇa/ snying rje smad pa la/ /ghā rde/ sna dang /spyo ta la'o/ /tsūrte phye mar gyur pa la/ /tsūrṇa sgo da 'gyur byed dbye/ /tsurṇa dri yi sbyor ba la/ /dzerṇa shing dang cha shas gter/ / zlab/ dziṣṭa/ sa dang /dbang po mi/ /rgyal byed la'o dzre rte ni/ /smin dang rgan dang mchog tu rgas/ /ri ṇi/ byu ga gdug pa'i lha/ /thos pa dang ni mkhregs pa la/ /tīkyā 'gyur byed lhag par rno/ /rdo ba'i bdag nyid la sogs la/ /tī.āoṃ lcags dang dug dang ni/ /rgya mtsho'i lan tshwa 'thab pa dang / /nas kyi rtse dang swo 1ka ka'o/ /tū ṇi sngon mo/ tū ṇa chags/ /triṣṭa sred dang 'dod pa la/ /tā rde skyob dang bsrub pa dang / /skyong ⑤dang skyob par byed pa la/ /rīrte/ bcom dang 'jigs pa la/ /deju 'joms byed gdul dka' la/ /dru ṇa sdig pa bung ba la//dru bhā rus sbal mo dang ni/ /chu yi sbal mo la yang ngo / /dru khaṃ ral gri zil yang ngo / /dro ṇa bya rog /kṛ rpā'i bdag /lung pa bzhi mdo 'brog la'o/ /dro bhā shing dang 'bab 'bab dang / /ba lang za dang sa dang ni/ /shing / khyim/ri dang mtshams dang ni/ /tshong ⑤gi dbye ba la yang ngo / /dharṇa gser dang mchod sbyin dang / /pa ṇa/ zong dang / /glad dang sbadasnye/ /brgyad cu dang ni ba rā ṭa/ /kārṣa pa ṇa dang ni nor/ /tshong dang shing rta cho lo ⑦dang / /tha snyad la yang dran ⑧par bya/ /khu tshur bcings pa la yang ngo / /parṇa/ljang gu/ ki shu ka /parte 'dab ma/ lo ma la/ /sāspyo zhes pa phyi yi cha/ /dmag rgyab sa 'og /smyo ba la/ /pārṇa chog dang gang ba la/ /pā rja gnas dang shā ṇa ni/ /rlung mchog rlung dang g.yo ba la/ /pā rde/ snyan ngag 'tsho ba dang / /bo la dang ni/ gang ba la/ /pha ni/ bu ram̐ byed long pa'i rting pa pal/ /120—1431

pā ṇi7 / bkod pa dang ni ngag /pā ṇi sprin dang / rin thang la/ /bhū ṇa/bud med mnga' dang byes/ /ma ṇi rin chen rtags kyi rtse/ /rwa duda'agro dang mgrin pa nu ma dang / /a liñdza ra/ mu tig sogs/ /mo ṇa pa ṭa kutpa ka /nags dang / chu srin kusbyi ra/ /ma kṣi ka /sbrul za ma tog /ra ṇa zur/sgra / 'thab pa la'o/ /ra ṇa/ rdul dang / nag po dang / /parba ṭa la parba ṇi/ /bstod pa gzugs/ grags yon tan dang / /chags dang bram ze la sogs dang / /dkar po sogs dang mdzes pa dang / /la ba khra bo brtul zhugs dbyangs/ /shing dang / cha byad/ mdog mig go/ /bā ṇa sa yi bu dang / rta/ /rta yi lus dang 'ba' zhig pa/ /mdangs tredang dzhaiṇḍa can la'o//biju sred med bu nyi ma/ /bī ṇa nor lha'i dbye ba dang / /pi wang dang ni glog dag la/ /thraṣṭa yā da ba dang lug /sā ṣaṇḍi dang gtum pa la/ /be ṇi chu klung ri mo dang / /skra bcings pa yi khyad par dang / /lha la sogs pa la yang ngo / /be rku 'od ma mi bdag dbye/ /shā ṇa phyed 'degs zhing las dang / /'tshe ba dang ni sog le dang / /grang ba skyob pa'i khyad par la/ /shā bhā/snyigs dang chung ngu dang / /rnam par snyigs pa rnams la'o/ /sho ṇa dga' ba chu klung dmar/ /ngang pa bya khra rma bya dang / /rta dmar la'o shā rja ni/ /kāXcho ma'i / thug pa la na brjod bya ldan/ /shā ṇi/ 'tshed pa gre ṇi ni/ /phreng ba dang ni khrus la'o/ /sthā rku bzo yi tshogs dang ni/ /'phrog byed brtan pa nges pa'o / /sbra rja rilcags kyi gzugs brnyan dang / /ka ba dag la'o kṣa ṇa ni/ /dga' ston dus dbye/ skabs dang tshigs/ /a dī kyā nges pa dang / /shin tu'i don la'o a ru ṇa/ /skya rengs dang ni nyi ma dang / /ru rta/ sman/ mi 720—1 132

gsal dmar ba dang / /thun mtshams dmar ba chu 'dra dang / /dmar dang ser skya 'dres pa la'o/ /a ru ṇa ni dur byid sman dang / /bong nga / sngo bsangs le brgan la/ /a ra ṇi ni me bsrub dang / /srub par byed pa'i dbyug pa la/ /ind+ra ṇi ni bde sogs ma/ /sind+ra wā snar byed pa la/ /byā ra rde ni ma mo stong / /yī kṣa rte ni mthong dang blta/ /u ṣa shā ni zegs ma la/ /u ṣa rde ni/ /na le sham/ /e ṣa ddhā ni rma dang lam/ /rjes su 'brang dang srang gi dbye/ /e ṣa ṇi ni nalcags mda' dang / /rjes su 'tshol dang sngar rjes can/ /shaṃ ka rṇa ni lag pa'i rgyan/ /lag pa'i srad bu mgo thod la/ /katri ni ni/rtsa'i bye brag /chu yi lo ma la yang ngo / /ka ra ṇa ni rje'u rigs dang / /dmangs rigs dang ni rjes skyes la/ /ka ra ṇi ni sgrub po mchog /lus dang lus gnas las dang ni/ /bya ba dang ni dbang po zhing / /byis pa'i smra ba dbyangs kyi lus/ /do shal kun tu 'jug pa dang / /bya ba'i khyad par la yang 'dod / /ka ru ṇa dang / ka ru zla/ /brtse ba ro nyams shing la'o/ /ka ru ṇa ni dbang dang ni/ /lta ba glang mo 4dag la'o/ /ka lya lkuṇa ni dge ba dang / /gser dang bkra shis mi zad lagye/ /kā ka bhā ni bzhi cha dang / /srang dang tshad kyi dbyug pa la/ /kā ka ṇi ni guñdza dang / /pa ṭa tsam dang / masgo'i bye brag /kā ra rte ni bsnun dang bsad/ /gzir dang gnod pa'i byed pa la/ /kā ra zla ni 'bad pa la/ /karma rde ni 'tshe ba'i las/ /gzhan lus rab 'jug shes pa dang / /sngags dang rgyud kyi rab spyor la/ /kuṭwā ṇa ni glang mi byed/ /kṛ pa ṇa ni smod dang 'bu/ /kṛ pā ṇa ni/ ral gri la/ /mtshan dang byed po kṛ pā ṇi/ /koṅga ṇa ni yul bye brag /koṅka ṇi ni mtshon bye brag /ko 7karṇa ni dre'u dang / /120—1433

sprul dang ri dwags dbye ba dang / /tshogs kyi khyad par mthe bo dang / /ming med tshad sman mūbee kā/ /gra ha ṇa ni mi bdag thob/ /rang gir byas dang byed pa la/ /bza' 37 dang / nyer tshags/ phyag 'tshal dang / /rkyen dang gus pa dag la yang / /gā ma ju ni/ nā se ta/ /gtso bo bdag po longs spyod can/ /tshogs can/ grong dpon/ rim khya rnams la'o/ /tsa ra khaṃ ni/ a brku/ /'gros dang rin dang rkang pa rigs/ /tsā dur rṇa ni 'khor ba dang / /mtha' dang / rgyu ba za ba dang / /zi ra/ go snyod mtshal dang ni/ /sau brtsa la 'dod do/ /tā 4ra ṇi ni sgol byed nyi/ /gzhon nu ma dang gru mkhan la/ /ta ru ṇa ni na chung dang / /gsar pa 'khyog po'i me tog dang / /ce spyang chen po dag la'o/ /dakṣi ṇa ni/ thang shing dang / /g.yon min gzhan 'dun rjes su 'jug /a pā tsi las byung la 'dod/ /dakṣi ṇa ni mchod sbyin/ sbyin/ /rab gnas a pā tsā la'o/ /durbhaṇḍi ni bye ma can/ /gzung dang mdog ngan la yang brjod/ /dorpā ṇi ni mṛṣṭi'i jusnye'adab/ /drurpā'i khu ba la yang ngo / /dru gha ṇa ni tho ba dang / /pa ra/ sru dha 'tshe ba la/ /dra bi khaṃ ni pha rol gnon/ /gser dang 'byor pa la yang ngo / /dha ra rde ni 'dzin pa dang / /nga rgyal dbye ba dag la'o/ /dha ra bhā ni sa la'o/ /dha ru ṇi ni chu dang ni/ /mtho ris dang ni mchog la gnas/ /dharmā ṇa ni sbrul bye brag /rkang 'thung khyad par dag la yang / /dharṣa bhā ni rigs tshogs ma/ /dharṣa khaṃ ni mdzod dang dga'/ /dmā ra bhā ni sangs rgyas gsung 6/ /sngags kyi bye brag zlos gar la/ /dhi ṣa ṇa ni lha'i slob dpon/ /bye ṣa shā ni blo dang gnyid/ /nirmā khaṃ ni sprul pa dang / /snying po dang ni bkod pa dang / /sa mañdza pa zhes pa la/ /nirya ṇi ni des 'byung thar/ /120—1434

mdzod dang a/ pāṅka dang bcings/ /nirpā ṇi ni ①myang 'das thar/ /nub dang glang po skyes bu dam/ /niḥgre ṇi ni them skas dang / /'bra go'i rkang 'thung dag la'o/ /ba troṇi ni sbyangs pa'i dar/ /batrorṇa ni/ shā na'i shing / /bakṣi ṭwā ni kun 'gro dang / /da ltar ba dang nyin mtshan ldan/ /phyogs mtha' dang ni nya gang ba/ /yal ga can kyi dbye ba la/ /pu rā zlabye/ karṣa pa ṇa'o/ /pu rā rṇa ni mtshan nyid lnga/ /dus rings lon pa'i rdzas la brjod/ /pū ra ṇa ni sdogs byed dang / /ba skong phye ma'i khyad par la/ /pū ra ddhā/ shabee li/ /gos dang rtsom dang srad bu'i dbye/ /phra kyegha ṇa ni zangs bum dang / /a linda dang lcags tho la/ /bra ma ṇa ni/ bden smra dang / /rgyu mtshan gtan tshigs bstan bcos dang / /lcags thudang gcig skyob ra ba 'jal/ /rgyu mtshan 'di snyed ces pa la'o/ /pra ba ṇa ni rab tu sbyangs/ /'bod dang rim gzhol/ sa/skad cig /bzhi mdo la'o/ /pra bee nithu/ /'dres dang rul ba dag la'o/ /thrakṣa ṇi ni khrus dang 'ching / /ba ra ṇa ni ra ba la'o/ /ba ru ṇa shini tshul la'o/ /ba ru ṇi ni shing dbye dang / /lo ma kha ba chu bdag dang / /nyi ma dang ni chu la'o//bā ra ṇa ni glang por bshad/ /bā ra rṇa ni dgag pa la/ /bā ru dhī ni nub phyogs dang / /mai re ya dang durpā tri/ /pāhma ddhā ni rten byed ma/ /gnyis skyes chung ma gnyis skyes ma/ /thraṅgā rnams so/ /zwahma ṇa/ /de bzhin drwahma ṇi zhes pa / /sngags rigs dang ni gnyis skyes tshogs/ /bha ra ṇi ni dmar po dmape/ /bha ra rde ni rigs dang blazu/ /mi bzad mche ba/ ddhā ṣa ṇa/ /shalla ṣi'i bcud dī ṣa ṇi/ /bhra ma ṇi ni tsher ma dang / /dbang phyug rol pa g.yo ba la'o/ /madku ṇa ni rma ra dang / /kun tu dor ba'i mi dang ni/ /so med glang po che dang 120—1435

—ni / /mthon po dang ni be ta la'o/ /ma mṛ ṇa ni karka sha /snum pa dang ni 'jam pa la/ /ma mṛ ṇa ni kṣu mā la'o/ /mārga ṇi 1ni slong ba dang / /mda' dang sems can ṣasnyo la'o/ /yant+ra ṇi ni nges dang 'ching / /srung la'o/ pa ṭo 'a/'i rtsa ba/ /ra pa khaṃ do/ ra ma ṇa/ /dga' ba dang ni rtsub pa la/ /ra pa ṇi ni sgra sgrogs/ sgra/ /ro ṣa ṇa ni khro byed dang / /gzhan skyon sbyin dang gser brdar ba'o/ /ro nyi ṇi pa skar ma dang / /rna ba'i nad kyi dbye ba dang / /dmar ngo/ so/ ma/ babee dang / /ka ṭu ro hi ṇi la'o/ /la ba rte ni gnyis 'thung dbye / /la/ ba ṇa ni ro bcud bsrung / /rgya mtsho'i dbye ba mdzes dang gsal/ /'a/kṣa khaṃ ni ming mtshan ma/ /la kṣa khaṃ rgo dga' byed dpun/ /lakṣa ma rṇa ni/ zla ba dbang / /laghra khaṃ ni ming mtshan byed/ /laghra ṇa ni mtsho skyes ma/ /'od ldan ma/ dang dang/la ldan ma'o/ /bi ba ṇi ni/ tshong khang zong / /ā pa ṇa ni tshong zong la/ /bi ṣā ṇi 2ni phyugs kyi rwa/ /mche ba/ sna dang / so dag la/'o / /bi ṣṭha ṇi ni lug rā can/ /sha ra rte ni/ srung dang 'ching / /sa ra khaṃ ni khyem gyi g.yabs// /saṃ gha rde ni sna'i dri ma/ /shi ghā khaṃ ni lcags kyi rtsa/ /'ching bu'i sgod la'ang blta 4bar bya/ /shra ma ṇa ni sdom brtson dbye/ /smad pa'i 'tsho ba legs mthong dang / /snag tsha/ chang ma/ dge slong ma'o/ /shra ba ṇa ni rgyu skar la/ /shra ma khaṃ ni/ rna ba thos/ /shā ba ṇa ni mā si dang / /saṣṭa dang / da dhyā lī'o/ /shrī badngha ni bum pa can dang / /gasgru ri dang /nga/dma dang / /me srub byed pa rnams la'o/ /saṃ/ kāṇḍi ni 'dres ma dang / /ma dag pa'o pa ra ṇi/ /phreng ba dang ni lam la'o/ /sā ra ṇa ni 'bod sgogs kyi//blon po dang ni chang nad la'o/ /sā ra ṭī ni 'bab chu chung / /rab tu 'bab 720—/ 36

pa dag la'o/ /su baṇḍi ni gtsug phud gser/ /bya khyung dang ni phreng ba la/ /su barṇa ni padma can/ /bya khyung gi ni ma la'o/ /su barṇa ni gser ldan ma/ /a gu ru nag sog po'i dbye/ /su brte ni/ mdog gser zho/ /su ṣe ṇa ni seng ge dang / /mgrin bzang rig pa lag nyed la/ /ha ra khaṃ ni gru yi rdzas/ /lus kyi do shal lag pa snying / /ha ri ṇa ni ri dwags skye/ /hi ra ṇi ni ljang gu dang / /ri dwags bud med kun spyod dbye/ /harṣa ṇa ni gzer gyes lkugazugs//rab dga' lto ba'i nad bye brag /lha la dad pa las byung ba/ /he ru rku ni bud med rigs/ /bud med rdul dang sha tī la/ /hi ra ṇa dang / ti ra ju/ /lte ba gser dang khya ba'o/ /kṣe pa ṭī ni gru'i dbyug pa/ /dra ba'i khyad par dag la yang / /aṅgā ṛ 3/bhā/ ha sast+ri/ /nyi ma dang ni bor ba la/ /ā tarba ṇa khaṃ tshim pa dang / /kun tu byug pa la yang ngo / /ā thargya ṇa srid bsrungs shes/ /bram ze dang ni mdun na 'don/ /ā ro ha rde them skas dang / /yang dag 'dzeg dang rab tu 'dzegs/ /uspyo pa ni rlung yab dang / /so ba nyed dang dngos po la/ /skyugs dang drungs nas 'byin dang sel/ /steng du 'dren dang /'byin la 'dod/ /kā me gu ṇa chags pa dang / /longs spyod dang ni yul la yang / /kāste pa zla snying po dang / /rko bar byed pa la yang ngo / /hrīrṇa parṇa 'bra go shing / /bi tsu marda'i shing la'o/ /tsū ḍa ma ṇi mgo'i rin chen/ /bya rog mchu dang 'bras bu la4/ /dzu hu pā ṇa me 'bras/ gu/ /tarja thurī ṇa 'bu dang ni/ /gshin rje'i yul la/ brka ba6/ /te la paṇi ri skyes dang / /sehma dang ni dpal gye gnas/ /dākṣu ya ni bgrod dka' ma/ /snar ma dang ni sgrol ma la/ /de ba ma ṇi zhes pa ni/ /zhi ba nor bu gostu bha/ /rgyal bo'i 120—1437

mgrin par 'khyil pa la/ /nārle 1ya ṇa mi nyams dang / /'jigs byed dkar mo sred med ma/ /ni ga ra ṇa zas dang mid/ /ni rū pa ṇi rnam spyad dang / /snang ba dang ni lta ba la/ /niste ra rṇa nges sgol dang / /thabs dang nges par 'gro ba la/ /niḥs ra ṇi sgo dang grol/ /nges 'byung thabs dang 'chi ba la/ /ba rī ra ṇa rus sbal dang / /dbyug pa pa ṭa/ bla ṭa ka /sarba rla 4ṇa/rdo leb dang / /mad dang la ba dag dang ni/ /lo ma phye ma'i khu ba dang / /dkar po dri zhim tshogs rnams la/ /pa ra pa 5ṇi bshad pa dang / /chos kyi sbyin nga/ bee'u la/ /pa rā ya khaṃ lhur len dang / /mngon 'dod dang ni rten la'o/ /pā rā ma ṇi pha rol bgrod/ /yang dag kun chags la bar 6ba dang / /bī lu/barṇa mūrgya dang / /gzugs dang sman gyi dbye ba la/ /puṣka ri ni mtsho skyes dang / /lag lda na dang ni chu'i gzhi la/ /pra ti pa ṇa 'du byed dang / /nye bar 'dzin dang 'dod pa la/ /pra bā ra khaṃ 'gog pa dang / /'dod bya sbyin dang sgrib pa la//pā ra bā ṇa ya lad dang / /go cha thams cad la yang ngo / /mbi nā mbi ṇa rkang 'jeng dang / /sbrul gyi shun pa dag la'o/ /rakṣa ra rku'i mri dang / / pā la 7 sha yi me tog rdul/ /rā ga tsūṇḍa dran pa dang / /khrag dang bya ma so rgyug pa'o/ /re re hā ṇa/ phyugs bdag mkha'/ /lalba karṇa ra dang ni/ /ajo tha dang sa skyes la'o/ /pi dā ra ṇi 'thab pa dang / /'byang ba dang ni spyo ba la/ /bee tebee bhā zhes bya ba/ /yi dwags chu klung srin po'i ma/ /shi ra pā ṇi mda' yi ltong rka / /sā ye kyang dmangs 'tsho ba'o/ /si la 1rduri ṇi spyod pa yi/ /dbye ba dang ni ta kri'i 1 dbye/ /rin po che dang malli kā/ /ba spu'i phreng ba la yang brjod / /sa mbi ra ṇa rlung dang ṣpe/ /pri 7ba me tog bam la'o/ /saṃ ba ra rde 720—/ 38

'khor ba dang / /slar yang 'gro dang ba lang grong / /lam po che dang 'thab mo rtsom / /bsru ba dang ni 'chol ba'o/ /haste karṇa sa lā ba/ /e raṇḍa dang tshogs kyi dbye/ /a ba gra ha rde 1zhes pa/ / lo sar 'go dang ma 2rtsom pa/ /a ba hā ra bee zhes so / /'byung bo 'angebs dang añtsa la mchod/ /a pa tā ra rja zhes pa/ /kun bshad cha dang mchod pa'i tshogs/ /pa ri bhā ṣa rde zhes pa/ /smod dang nyer dmigs nyid dang smra/ /bra birla ra ṇa zhes pa/ /'dzin sa dang 'khrugs pa dag la'o/ /mozle ka barṇa pa shing / /ka shyan 4ka dang a rā li/ /ka bā ta ra dag la'o/ /mazla ka piṇi 5zhes pa/ /le brgan tshangs ma pa yang lce'o / /matta nā ra ṇa zhes pa/ /myos shing gdul dka'i glang po dang / /khang bzang dang ni tshad gang 6gi/ /ba raṇḍa ཿ dang phyi rten dang / /pa ru ra yi shing la'o/ / ra ma harla ṇi/ bu leng / /pā ta rā ya ti ni smyo/ /rtsegs pa dang ni 'tshol ba dang / /bzhad kyi gom nga/ lag pa'i 'dog /cung zad byed pa med pa la'o/ /de ha da lakṣa rṇa ni/ /na tshod mtshams dang mngal la'o/ /yo ba ya ladza rde ni/ /'o ma 'dzin dang mdzes par 'dod/ /sna tshogs gsal ba las ṇa mtha'i sde'o// //tā ni skyong byed skyong ba po/ /ta ni tshems kun 1 phag gi mjug /i ka rnam dag khyab pa la/ /anta 'jig dang yid 'phrog dang / /rang bzhin la'o a na rab mtha' dang ni nya 2ba la/ /arti gzir ba gzhu dang rtse/ /asta nub kyi ri bo la/ /asta 'phangs dang song ba la/ /āsta/ 'dun sa bzung ba la/ /ā bye sdom dang 'thob pa la/ /a tai mkhas dang / rtogs pa la/ /yī nyi char 120—1439

ches la sogs drug /ḍi sba dang ni 1sra bā sa/ /uste 2smra dang yi ge gcig /'dun pa'o spru ti zhes bya ba/ /srung bar byed dang / sbra 1ti'o/ / ri ta nu nya'o 4rdo dang chu/ /ri 5ti bden dang 'gro ba dang / /'bar ba dang ni mngon par mchod/ /ra ti 'gro dang smad pa dang / /'gran pa dang ni bkra shis la/ / ni byā dus 6skyes snang ba dang / /dpyid la sogs dang brtan pa la/ /kanta 'gro ba zal po dang / /yid du 'ong dang dga' ba dang / /rdo ba la'o kāddhā dzee/ /thra yang ku 7dang / dgon pa la/ /kārnyi mdzes dang mngon 'dod la/ /tīrti grags nga/ bstar ba dang / /khang bzang dang ni rgya chen la/ /kuntu drwa sa ba lang 'jo / /rang bzhin srog chags chung ngu la/ /kust+ri skyab seng btsun mo la/ /kṛ tram̐/ gu gul shing dang ni/ / shābee ki dang bden pa zung / /'bras bu med dang rnam grangs 'thob/ /byas dang kun tu phan pa la/ /kṛ ti 'ching dang byed pa la/ /kṛ ti dzi la dang ni gnas/ /kṛ ti/ ru 9sbal gro ga dang / /byas pa can la rab tu brjod/ /ke tu gza' yi bye brag dang / /gyen du 'gro dang 'od mtshon byed/ /rgyal mtshan dang ni sgra 7la'o/ /kra tu/ mchod sbyin thub bhe lu/ /ga ti 'du shes dka' thub la/ /ga ti bcu dang 'gro ba dang / /ye shes lam dang khas blangs rta1dang / /rtsa yi rma yi 'gro ba dang / /skye bo'i khyad par lto ba la/ /garta dong gsum bye brag dang / /ku kund+ra ra/ sa'i g.yang sa//gā ru tri la 'khor dang 'phyang / /khro byed khya byug pho la'o/ /gi ti/ sdeb spyor bye brag glu/ /gī tai/ glu dang sgra la'o/ /gupta bsrung dang sbed pa la/ /dmangs rigs zla ba snga ma can/ /gurnyi yi ge'i khyem dong dang 1 / /ba lang skyong bsrung / gshin rje'o/ /gra ste zos dang byas pa la/ /lupta mdog dang 720/de1 440

rkang pa 'byung / /ghā ta/ bsnun dang tsher ma la/ /rja tai gsal dang /snang ba chu/ /tsi ti tshogs dang / bsags pa la/ /tsi ti 'dus dang /tshogs pa dang / /skabs 1dang sgyed pu la yang ngo / /dza tai/ skye ba tshogs dang skye/ /dza ti spyi dang phreng ba can/ /sdeb spyor dbye ba rigs dang skye/ /dzā ti pha la la yang ngo / /'gro byed g.yo ba sgyed pu la'ang / /dzñā ti rigs bzang ba 2la'o/ /ta ta rlung la'o/ /ta tai ni/ /pi wang la sogs rol mo la/ /prabee rnam par rgyas pa la/ /tā ta rjes brtse/ skyed pa po/ /kikta ro dang dri bzangs la/ /tighra ka ṭu ro hi bhā/ /nyilto parba ta la 'dod/ /tre tā dus dang mi gsum la/ /datrī bī shā bi ta dang / /a bi ta'o danta ni/ /so dang glang po dag la'o/ /daṭī sman gyi bye brag dang / /dānta dka' thub 4nyon mongs bzod / /dul bar gyur pa la yang ngo / /di ti/ sbyin dang dum bu la/ /dīpta 'bar dang bsregs pa dang / /nges par gsal ba la yang 'gyur/ /tro ti pags pa sbyar dang / nya/ /gribee ma sgribs nus pa la/ /rlu ti 'bar dang /mdzes pa dag /dru tai/ myur dang rnam par 'gro/ /rnam par zhum dang myur 'gro la/ /dhwa ru tshangs pa yongs su skyong / /bya ba'i don dang khu ba dang / /bad kan sogs dang khrag sogs bcud5/ /'byung ba sogs dang sa sogs dang //ldong ros sogs dang ko lā hwa6/ /khyad par btsag dang mig rnams la'o/ /dhu ti / rnam par gsal dang dor/ /bye ta bsgul dang bcos pa la/ /dhū sgo/lan tshwa'i dum bu dang / /ngan pa dang ni g.yo can la/ /dhri ti 'dzin dang mchog shes dang / /brtan dang rnal 'byor bye brag la7/ /na ta/ ti ga ra yi shing / /'khyog po 9dang ni 'dam bu la/ /nā ⑩ti/ tshul dang thob pa la/ /120/de1441

dṛ tu/ /'bu dang gar mkhan la/ /batta 'tshed dang gus pa la/ /piṅgā phreng dang bcu pa dang / /yi ge bcu pa'i bṛtta la/ /pa ti khyab bdag rtsa ba dang / /'gro ba la'o batrī ni/ /rkang thang dpa' bo dmag bye brag /ba ti ltung dang skyob pa la/ /bī ti/ ser dang yā tsānta/ /skyong ba dang ni yung ba la/ /rpā tā/btung ba dang ni/ rta/ /rpā tī/ btud pa'o/ pi 1ste ni/ /rnam shes dang ni glegs 2bam bris/ /pū tai gtsang byed sha ṭi ta/ /bkangs dang bkab dang shar bu byas// /pūrti grang ba 'obs sogs las/ /po ta byes pa dang ni gu//pā ti/ gang ba phyogs gcig la/ /pābhe cher 'byung thob pa la/ /pābye thob dang mnyam skyes dang / /spru ti rnal 'byor dbye ba dang / /dran pa/ bu dang /dga' dang / rangs/ /spru ti dga' dang rtsed 'jo la/ /pra ta/ ro dang 'byung ngo/'i dbye/ /po ti gos dang phreng bar rgyus/ /plu ta phyi mo gsum la'o/ /plu tai/ myur ba'i 'gros dang ni/ /chu la rkyal gyes 'gro ba'o/ /bhasti rnam par dbye dang gus/ /bharta/ rje bo 'dzin pa po/ /bhitrī rtsig pa dbye ba dang //go skabs cha dang phyogs re ba/ /bhe tai 'jigs dang 'jigs bcas la/ /dī ti/sā dhwa/ ba kṛsba/ /bhū ta lha yi skye gnas kyi/ /dbye ba dang ni lha ldan la/ /thob dang spyod nga/ la yang ngo / /bhā 5tai rigs dang bden nga/ dang / /nye bar mjal/ dang sa sogs la/ /sha za la'ang brjod par bya/ /byu ti glang po sgeg pa dang / /'byor pa thal ba skye ba la/ /bhri ti 'dzin thob rin dag la/ /bhradhi 'khrul dang log pa'i blo/ /mi gnas dpa' bo ma ta ni/ /mchod dang rjes su 'gro ba la/ /mi ti/ blo dang dran dang 'dod/ /manta shed bu mchog gnas la/ /mā tā kha lang tshang ma sogs/ /snyan ngag mkhan dang bcas pa dang / /dkar 720—1(1712

mo dang ni sa la'o/ /gzhan yang g.yang 1bdag mā pā ka /rab tu rngam can rnams la'o/ /mi ti/ tshang dang kun nas spyod/ /kuste thar dang grol ba la/ /mukta thar bar gyur dang dor/ /mukta 2mu tig nyid la'o/ /mūrte/ mkhregs pa ldan pa la/ /mūtstsha rmongs brgyal sra ba la/ /murti lus dang sra ba la/ /spyoṭwā 3'chi dang blo gros la/ /mṛ tai/ slod dang shi ba la/ /ya ti klog gcod sdom brtson dang / /nges 'byed la'o yaddhā ni/ /srad bu dang ni 'dug pa la/ /yusti sbyor ba rigs tshul la/ /yang dag ldan la yu ta ste/ /yu tai tho bzhi pa la yang / /ratta khrag dang rjes su chags/ /dmar po dang ni tshong la ste/ /nub phyogs skyu ru ra dang ni/ /gur gum dang ni zangs la yang / /ra tī 5gser dang nags tshal chags/ /yid bsrub dang ni btsun mo la/ /ra tai rab dga' gsang ba la/ /ra tū 'bab chu dang ni lam/ /raste stong pa nags tshang/ la/ /rī ti tshig dang lam la'o/ /rī ti rta dang rab spyod dang / /lcags kyi rtsa dang jer zug min/ /sa tā sbrang rtsi skyes lcug ma/ /yal ga dṛ kā thra yadku / /la tā 'od ldan ma dang ni/ /gla rtsi dang ni durba'o7/ /luste rnam par phyug pa dang / /dug chang dang ni 'khyegs sog la/ /phru tā srog chags sdom dang ni/ /grog ma chu klung khyad par ro/ /lo tai chom rkun rlangs pa dang / /smra byed smra mkhas mkhas pa la'o/ /bsta gnas dang lteng ka dang / /lus dang sgon me bcu pa dang / /mar me sman dang sprul pa dang / mig dang mig sman yi ge la/ /brti lus dang rjes su byug /brteḍa/ nad med snying po med/ /bāṭwā spyod mtha' zhing las sogs/ /zhing las ma dang / spyod pa la/ /ma ta/ spyod tshul ni rug dang / /urba ti'o bi: ni/ /'byor pa la ni yang dag 'dod/ /rnam 720—1443

par gcad dang shes pa dang / /'thob pa la yang brjod par bya/ /shes dang rnyed dang 'byung ba la'ang / /bī tai snying po med pa dang / /glang po rta dang dor ba dang / /lus la gnas dang las la'o/ /bi ti gtod dang 'gro dang 'bar / /mchong dang rgyug dang za ba la/ /dṛtta 1rnam par 'grel pa dang / /mtsho bya brgya byin ma la so/gas/ /bṛtta/ zlum po 'das pa dang / /shi dang brtan dang spyod nga/ la/ /dṛs+ho dbul ngo/ sdeb spyor 'jug /dṛ ti 'dzin dang dam bca' dkres/ /thra tai sgrib dang rab 'dzag 'ching / /nu ma'i ste dang bum nga/ 'dzin/ /byalti gsal dang shes rab can/ /byaste khyab dang kun tu 'khrugs/ / /byāste bshad dang yang dag dman/ /byāste khyab byed rnyed pa la/ /shakta sgo/ma dang / brten pa la/ /shatta mthu la sogs dang stobs/ /shaste bde dang bkra shis 'a// /sha ta phra dang rno ba la/ /shā tī / skyid nga/ shānta nyams/ / /dānta shintu grol/ ba nga// /shādhi zhi dang dge ba la/ /shāsta ston pa sangs/ rgyas/ la/ /shi ti nag /dkar gro ga la/ /shi tai/ phra dang rgo ba la/ /shi ta chu grang 'khor mang la/ /shī tai/ tsaṇḍa 4kha ba skyes// /'khyags dang grang dang le lo 'a// /shutta dung dang ni kha dang / /nya phyis/ dang ni dung chung la/ /nu/tta nu/ tig ma/dzod ring 5la/ /rta gnas thod nga/ ka ko la/ /nya phyis/ skyur rtsub ru'/ ba la/ /khru tai bstan bcos 'dzin pa la/ /shu ti/ rna ba rig byed dang / /gtam dang rna ba'i las la'o/ /shwe tai/ gzugs dang dkar po la/ /shwe ta/ gling dang ri'i bye brag /shwe tā/ lte ba dung can ma/ /ljon shing skye'o legs dang yod/ /bkra shis dang ni mchod pa la/ /sa tī legs ma gtum po la/ /sabhu bden pa sā snyi sbyin/ /pi tai/ dkar po rdzogs pa la/ /720/de1 17/ /

shes dang bcings pa la yang ngo / /se tā bu ram ka ra'o/ /shī tā nam mkha'i gaṅgā dang / /skyed byed ma dang mdzes pa'i lam/ /su ta/ sa bdag skyes dang bu/ /subye yid brtan 'joms pa dang / /nyal dang reg pa shes/ nga/ la// /sru ta kha lo bsgyur ba dang / /phyag 'tshal shingaphrab skye ba'i khu ba 'jog nga 'a// /rgyal rigs bram ze mo dang bu/ /rab tu btsas dang ded nga/ 'a// /sru ti 'alngo dang lam la'o/ /se tu chu dang bung ba la// /sbe ta yang gnas/ pa dang / /nges/ dang dam bca' dang bcas dang / /'gro ba med dang bcings/ nga/ 'a// /sbri ti/ khrims lugs gnas/ pa dang / /kun tu gnas dang mtshams/ rnams/ la'o / /smṛ ti chos/ kyi bstan bcos/ dang / /dran nga/ blo dang 'dod nga/ 'a// /snyutī / rgyu 1 dang / sī ba na/ /sru tā / u/ ta rab tu gus// /nā/bye rgo/rang nang / sem/sa/ 'thibs ngo// /hasta// rgyu ska/ra/ glang ngo/ dang / /glang mo lag nga/ byed pa la/ /re mig byed dang skra mchog bsags/ /nyi ti 'gro dang 'dzin dang phan/ /he ti/ 'bar ba nyi ma dang / /gzi brjid dang ni mtshon cha'o/ /kṣa rte kha lo/ bsgyur ba dang / /gnyis/ gnas/ dang ni gnyis/ 'dzin dang / /bhu 'dzin kṣa skyes/ nges/ spyor dang / dam/ngas rigs dang ni rgyang rigs bu/ /kṣi ti sa dang gnas/ tsam dang / /gnas dang zad nga/ 'a/ yang ngo / /a gaste ni ri byi dang / /baṅga'i sde 'jom/sa/ ā hu ti/ /me dang tshangs/ 4nga/ me'i sbyin sreg /a sgro ta/ brtan/ tha gu'i lto/ /khyab 'jug rgyal/ ka a dzi ta/ /a di ti ni lha yi ma/ /brdzun dang zhing las a dzre 5 ta/ /khyab 'jug klulhag ma a nanta/ /a nadhe ni nam mkha' dang / /mtha' yas/ dang ni mtshams med la / /a nāddhā ni sa gzhi dang / /drurpā mdzes ma ri'i bu mo/ /ryā/ ri bā dang /720/de/ / /5

glu ḍū tsi/ /rgya mtsho'i mtha' dang yangs pa la'o/ /a mṛ tai ni/ /bdud rtsi chu/ /thar ba dang ni snying 'bab dngos/ /ma slongs pa dang mchod sbyin lhag /mang dang shin tu mdzes pa la/ /a mṛ ta ni tshig bzang dang / /jo nabye la 'dod pa yin/ /a mṛ tā ni/ gu ḍū ṭī/ /skyu ru 1ra dang / phan pa dang / /ā ga tī rnams la 'dod do/ /a ma ti ni/ zla ba dang / /dus dang dgra bcom rgyal mchod 'os/ /ardi ta ni rlung nad dang / /lhung ba dang ni bcom pa la/ /arba tī ni/ /'bangs mo dang / /mi'u thung ma rta mchod ngan/ /ā 2byakta ni/'phrog byed dang / /rdo rje rmongs dang mi gsal brjod/ /ma hā ta ni dang po'i bdag /a swanta ni 'chi dang ngan/ /sgyed pu shing dang bar med la/ /a kṣa tai ni rmi/ med 'bras/ /rang bzhin gsum pa rma yis dman/ /ā kṛ ti ni lus dang gzugs// /de bzhin thun mong ba la yang / /a khyu tai 4ni kun bshad dang / /ting gi mtha'i tshig la bshad/ /āghā tai ni dri snom 'tshed/ /a tsi tai ni bsags bkab bzung / /ā tsi ta ni shing rta dang / /kun tu rje dang spun mi ldan/ /ā dṛ ta mchod gus pa thob/ /ā dhwa na ni rlung nad dang / /rtad / sgra grag pa dag la'o/ /ā na rta ni gar gyi gnas/ /yul gyi dbye ba sgra skye'o/ /ā batrī ni thob dang skyon/ /ā ba ti 5ni lhung bar 'dod/ /mtho ba yang ngo / /ā blu ta/ /khrus tsam dang ni khrus byed la'o/ /ā batrī ni gsher ba dang / /khrims lugs dkar po stobs gnas la'o/ /a ya ti ni yang dag sdom / /ring po mthu dang dus phyi ma/ /a ya sta āoṃ rno dang 'bangs6/ khro dang nyon mongs gyur kyang bsnun/ /a bārta ni sems dang 'jug /chu yi klong 'khor la yang ngo / /ā sgo ta ni/ arka'i 'dab/ /ljon shing yongs 'du sa 120—1446

———brtol 1la'o/ /ā sgo tā ni nags me tog /ri yi rna ba la yang ngo / /ā ba sti ni kun 'gro thob/ /ā ha tai ni bzod pa'i don/ /sngon med gos dang gos sar dang / /nā na ka dang bsnun dang bsgyur/ /iṅga tai ni bkris dang 'gros/ /u tsi tai ni mnyam shes la/ /a bhya sta ni mnyam shes la/ /a sgyu sta ni rjes su ldan / /son dang rnam par mkhas pa la/ /ustsor ༄ tai ni ra ba 'phel/ /kun tu skye dang sgreng ba la/ /uttaste ni sha skam dang / /kun tu gdungs dang yongs su rgyal / /u bye tai ni skye ba dang / /rab tu 'char dang 'phel ldan la//u di tai ni 'char dang thob/ /kun tu 'phags dang rab brjod la/ /u ṅgā ta ni tho ba dang / /a tyā dhwa ni 4nyer bgrod dang / /'gro ba 'khrul dang phye ma/ leb/ /bum can rnams so u darnyi5/ /gtam dang skyes bu dam pa la/ /u danta ni yang dag gnon/ /ma myos pa yi glang po la/ /u da ta ni dbyangs bye brag /snyan ngag dag gi rgyan la'o/ /u danta ni sbyin byed dang / /chen po 'dod pa'i snying la 'bab/ /uj-i tai ni li ta dang / /zos dang / phyung dang gyen du bteg /bdud rtsi la'o unda ni/ /'char dang rgan dang 'phags pa dang / /skar mig bu yi chung ma la'o/ /udmatta ni smyo ldan la/ /dan pa mu tsu kunda la'o/ /u ṣi tai ni gnas ngang bsregs/ rta dang bzhag nga/ sreg byed la/ /e dha tu ni skyes bu dang / /sdig pa/ gtong ba/ nad dag la/ /ka po ta ni phug ron la / /ka ba kā khya mkha' 'gro la/ /ka li tai ni rig dang shes/ /kā po tai ni phug ron khyu/ /bshad pa mig sman sta dzā'/ /ṣpe ra ta ni lus chung dang / /kla klo sa yi nidza dang / /rdung byed lha yi yi 6 ge'o/ /ki ra ti ni gnas ngan dang / /gla mi dang ni las byed la'o/ /kṛ tānta ni bshes 7gnyen dang / /120/de/ /‘/7

grub mtha' gnam brkos dge ba'i las/ /krandi tai ni ngu dang 'bod/ /ga bha ti ni 'od nyi ma/ /bsreg za dang ni 'gro byed la'o/ /gardzi ti ni sprin gyi sgra/ /gardzi ta ni glang chen myos/ /bya khyung gser dang yal ga'o/ /go dbye/ bab la dang / /ga shi ta dang go cha bgos// /go pa ti ni sa bdag dang / /ma ning nyi ma mkha' rtse mo/ /gā ti tai ni/ spel/ ba dang / /mnan dang 'tshe ba rnam/sa la'o / /tsolbā ta rgo mi g.yo/ dang / /gaṅgā'i tsi la ring du 'tsho/ /dza gabye ni rlung sa/ 'gro/ /dza ga tā ni 'gro ba sa/ /sdeb spyor dbye ba chu la'o/ /dza yarnya rgo brgya byin skyes// /bde 'byung la'o dza yaṭī/ /shing gi dbye ba rgyal/ mtshan dang / /sgo ri dbang po bu mo la// /dza mā tā ni bu mo'i bdag /nyi ma 'khyims/ dang da yi ta/ /dzre mū ta ni brgya byin sprin/ /lha yi chu dang dbyangs lda/na dang / /'dzin nga/ dang rgo 'tsho ba la'o/ /dzi warnyi ni zas dang mtsho/ /'tsho bar byed nga/'i sma na la'o/ /dzi wadhi ni 'tsho byed ma/ /shing dang / zhi ma/phyag 'tshal/ dang / /bdud rtsi rnams la'o/ dzisgo tai/ /byed ngo/ bud med naspyod nga/ gas/'a / /dzwa li tai ni 'bar dang bsregs/ /tā ni ta ni dngas dang sgos/ / /ro'/ mo/'i sgod dang yo/na tan la/ /dṛ ṇa ta ni gzhu dang rtsa/ /do dkra grangs kyi khyad par dang / /tshong 4gi dbye ba'o tram̐ garta/ /dril chung dang ni 'dong can no/ /twa ra tai ni rab mgyogs myur/ /ngan 'gro dang ni/dmya' ba/ dor/ /dbul ngo/ yang ngo / /durdza tai/ /ngan par skyes dang 'phongs pa la/ /dṛṣṭanta ni bstan bcos dang / /dper brjod bla'o rda shi tai/ /sgo cha bgos dang / sos zin nga/'o/ /tra babye ni 'bang chu'i dbye/ /sman la'o de nas/ dri dzā ti/ /gnyis skyes bya dang khro ldan dang / /tshig bdag brtan (20/de/ /—/8

pa blo gros can/ /ni j-i tai ni rab tu thob/ /dman dang rang bzhin bral ba la/ /ni kṛ ti ni spyod dang dor/ /ngan g.yo dang ni g.yo can la/ /ni mitta ni mtshan nyid rgyu/ /rgyu mtshan dang ni / tshig la'o/ /a ganta ni lha yi yul/ /ni ya tai ni yul dang sgrub/ /ni rasta ni mngags pa mnga'/ /kun tu dor dang myur dang skye//gsal ba dang ni so sor bcom// /nidngha ti ni nyer mi 'gro/ /phyogs spyong rna ba nag po la/ /ni rbi ti ni legs gnas dang / /bde dang myang 'das nub gyur dus / /nirmutta mi grogs/ spa/ngas dang / /shun pa rjes dang nga/dza ga /ni bā ta ni rlung phral dang / /gnas/ dang go cha brtan po la/ /ni shanta rgo zhi ba la// /ni sharnyi ni yod dang gnas/ /pañtsa tā ni shi tsam dang / /lnga nga/'i dngos/ dang lnga pa nyid/ /paṇḍi ta ni dkar dang brtan/ /'gro dang 'gro byed 'dab chags/ la/ /baddhā ti ni lam dang gral/ /be re ta ro 'byung po'i dbye/ /barba ta ni char bzang ri/ /pā/ryāpta ni glang po dang / /tshim dang ci 'dod nus/ dang 'thob/ /'jig dang / dbyug nga/ dka' tshegs skyon/ /baryabye ni rab 'dod dang / /thob dang / yo/ngas/ su bsrung ba la/ /baryasta ni/ khrung / 'bangs/ bsnun/ /pa li ta ni sgra dkar dang / /'dam dang / tshad gdung ri 'a/sa skyes/ /nga/ kā ti ni tshes gcig dang / /phyogs rtsa dang ni dang ngo/'i tshes/ /pā/rnga/ tī ni/ dro ba dī/ /rdzong ma/ 'tsho ma shalla tī/ /piṇḍi te ni bsgyur dang basbus/ /dmag 'gro dang pa 'dab chags so/ /pi shi tā ni ba la la/ /rpā ḍi tai ni bud med kyi/ /byed pa 'khrul 'khor rol mo dkrol/ /pu ḍi tai ni glang po dang / /sbyar sogs plu tā/ pā ṭi ta'o/ /pri —ṣa ta ni bsre ngo/ dang / /thig le tsam dang ri dwags rta/ /dmar dang thig le dkar po can/ /pra kṛ ti ni snying 120/de/ 419

stobs dang / /rdul dang mun pa ci tsam dang / /rang bzhin blo dang grong dang ni / /rtags dang skye gnas bdag la'o/ /thra 1 ti ta ni rab tu bstod/ /rab byas rang bzhin gnas pa la'o/ /pra tsi ta ni shing rta dang / /shin tu brje dang spur mi ldan/ /pra bhā ta ni 'dris dang me/ /rab tu 'bebs dang 'dus byas dang / //nye bar phun tshogs/ nges spel byas/ /pra tī ta ni gus bcas bshad / /dga' dang mthong / dang mkhas pa dang / /lug dang shes pa la yang ngo / /pra ta ti ni brtul zhugs byung / /ta ti'o de nas pra pā ta/ /chu sgra g.yang sa a ba ṭa/ /pra bye 2 ta ni the ri ba dang / /pā bye' de nas pra mbi ta/ /rab tu song dang shi ba la/ /pra bṛtrī ni/ 'grel pa dang / /spyad mtha' rab 'bag rab 'jug ma/ /pra sru ti ni rab skyes dang / /skye dang 'dab na bu mo 'a// /pra sru ti ni me tog dang / /lcug ma dang ni skye ba la/ /pra sru tā ni skye dgu dang / /tha ma dang ni rab skye la/ /pra mṛ ha ni/ steng thal spyor/ /de rab 'gro dang / /'jug rnam des/ /pra ha ti ni/ kyuṇḍa mtho/ /prabee two 5ni slong ba dang / /dgra bo 'gog dang rnam par bcom/ /sngokṣi ti ni rnam par bcom / /badhi ti ni bkangs pa dang / /bkab dang / spel dang /'bras rgan po/ /thra tī 6tī/ ma hā tī/ /kaṇḍa kā rī bum pa can/ /shu dag /lo rgyus phra mo dang / /sdeb spyor dbye ba gong rgyan 7la/ /bha ra ta ni dga' ston skyes / /gar dang gar gyi bstan bcos la/ /do ṣṭhadhe ni rngon pa dang / /tha ga nga/ la rgyas pas bshad/ /bā ra tī ni/ dag dang mda'/ /'dab chags/bye brag /spyod pa'i dbye/ /drang srong rgyas pa'i gzhung las ni/ /'dzam gling dhwa ra ta tu bshad/ /bhā bee tai ni/ gnas dang thob/ /bsam dang skyed pa 720—1450

rnams la'o/ /bhā santa ni snang ba dang / /mkha' 'gro dang ni mdzes pa dang / /'od dang / gsal dang / nyi ma dang / /sa 'dzin/ thra 1ba gala'o/ /mthi tai ni/ bsrubs dang / dkrugs/ /chu med dang ni/ ba sri ta'o/ /ma ru ta zhes bya ba ni/ /lha dang / rlung dang / rgyal srid che/ /ma na tī ni mi sbyin gyi/ /pi wang dang ni sa gzhi la'o/ /mā la tī ni/ dzā ti dang / /na chung yobyā/ ni kṣu dang / /chu klung gi ni dbye ba la/ /mu ṣi tai ni me'i rtse mo/ /kā ka mā ṭī dum bu snying / /mūdhri tai ni rmongs par 'gyur/ /de bsgreng pa dang brten pa la/ /ra dza tai ni dngul do shal/ /btsun pa dang ni rgyas pa la/ /ra ma ti ni mtho ris 'dren/ /ra se ti ni/ sprin dang sgra/ /gser la sogs pas spras pa la'o/ /re ba tī ni ma mo dang / /skar ma'i bye brag 'bras ldan ma'o//ri ba ta ni ri'i bye brag /gser gyi phreng dang mdung can la'o/ /ro hi tai ni thang shing dang / /yul 4du brtan dang khrag la'o/ /ro hi tā mbi dang po dang / /nya dang ri dwags dbye ba la/ /ro hi ṇi dang ro hi ta dang / /nyi ma khri shing dbye ba la/ /la li ti ni mdzes dang 'dod/ /do shal gye ni 5khyad par la/ /lo hi tai ni tsandan dmar/ /sa mchog dang ni/ gur kum dang / /khrag dang kha dog dmar po la/ /lo hi ta ni/ sa'i 'dab ma/ /chu klung bye brag la yang ngo / /pa ni tā ni skyed ma dang / /shin tu chags dang btsun mo la/ /ba ni tai ni/slong dang bsten/ /ba sa ti ni mtshan mo khyim/ /kun tu gnas dang mchod ngal gsoce/ /ba ha tu ni 7khyu mchog lam/ /ba sa ti/ glang pi tsi ba/ /bi ba tai ni gnyis skyes dang / /byas dang mgo bo'i cha dag la/ /ba santa ni khu byug dang / /sran ma/ maṅga / glang phrug dang / /thob pa dang ni yal phran la'o//120—1451

bā sadzñā ni/ spang ldan/ khyu/ /ljon shing skya nar dag la yang / /ba se tā ni/glang po dang / /bud med la'o bā si tai/ /nam mkhar 'gro ba'i sgra dang ni/ /shes dang gos kyis dkris pa dang / /dri zhim byas pa dag la'o/ /bi kṛ ti ni 'jigs rung dang / /nad can dang ni 'dus ma byas/ /spyo ba dang ni nad la'o / /bi kri 1ti/ bral/ 'od med 'gro/ /bi tsitta ni lus chags dang / /rnam nga/ra chad dang sgeg pa la/ /bi dzā tā ni rab bcos la/ /rnam par 'gyur dang skyed pa la/ /bi ta tai ni khyab pa dang / /rgya che ba la mngon par brjod/ /birlu ta ni glog ge 'od/ /thun mtshams dang ni 'od med la/ /bi di tai ni/shes dang don/ /bi dhwa tā ni/ tshangs pa dran/ /pi na ta ni rab 'dud dang / /nyams pa dang ni lhod pa la/ /bi na tā ni khyung gi ma/ /pha yi khyad par dag la yang / /be dī tai ni 'dul pa thob/ /legs 'bab rta dang dbang po thul/ /nye bar drangs dang khrid pa dang / /nges par zung dang ngag skyes so/ /rgyal po yu/nga/ can bi ṣpe tā/ /'ongs dang / slong ba di patrī/ /nad dang phran tshegs/bi thra tā/ bi thra tī ni gsal ba'o/ /bi batrī ni kun spyod dang / /rab tu 'jug dang gar dag la/ /bi bishrī ni bye bo bral/ /rul dang 'du 'dzi med dang dben/ /bi khru tai ni shes pa dang / /mkhas dang kun nas dga' ba la/ /bi thrastu ni/ bsgrub pa la/ /bi shwasta ni nges 'dzin la/ /rnam par sbyangs pa la yang ngo / /bee hasta ni dkar skya dang / /rnam par skrag dang lag med la/ /dṛttanta ni srid pa 'dod/ /lo rgyus dang ni khyad par la/ /rab tu byed dang skabs dang ni/ /mtha' gcig la yang 'ga' zhig 'dod/ /beedzee tai ni g.yo ba dang / /'khor lo skyal dang 'gros la'o/ /beṣṭi tai ni bud med kyi/ /byed pa 720—/ 152

sgeg pa spyod pa la'o/ /byā ghā ta ni bar dang ni/ /rnal 'byor dbye ba rab tu 'phrog /byā ya ti ni che dang ring / /bya pa dang ni nyal pa la/ /sha kunta ni mkha' 'gro dang / /'dab chags dbye ba 'od/ bde phyogs/ /shu dhwanta ni mtha' grong dang / /re'u mig dang gsang bar brjod/ /shri ba timbi pad dkar mig /dpal kyi bdag dang sa yi bdag /dpal ldan snum can shing dang ni/ /dbang phyug dang ni yid 'phrog la/ /saṃ ghā ta ni 'dus pa dang / /rab 'joms / mi yi dgon pa la/ /saṃ gha ta ni 'grogs dang bshesalku/ /panda ti ni 'dud dang / sgra/ /banda ti ni rgyud dang bu/ /rigs dang rgya che gral dang ni/ /gcig nas gcig tu brgyud kṣe pa la'ang / /sa maste ni gus dang dga' / /rjes gnang mngon 'dod saṃ mi ti/ /sa mi ti ni yang dag gnon/ /mnyam dang 'dun pa 'grogs pa dang / /yang dag rig dang drang po dang / /dam bca' kun spyod shes pa la/ /sambisti ni rtsod pa med/ /so sor go byed skye bo la/ /salbarta ni bskal pa'i mtha'/ /lo dang rtsod pa'i shing la'o/ /se ka tā ni seg ma can/ /yul dang nad kyi khyad par dang / /bye ma dang rgo bu ram la / /su kṛ tai ni dge ba dang / /bsod nams dang ni legs byas la/ /su mbi ti ni bzang po'i tshul/ /lugs bzang des pa phyi mo la/ /su pra tā ni bde ba dang / /ba lang tshogs dang brtul zhugs bzang / /su ra ste 1ni nags tshal dang / /lha nyid dang ni rab dga' la'o/ /su hi ta ni tshim pa dang / /smras dang legs par phan pa la/ /su dri tai ni bkra shis dang / /bden dang mnyam par brjod pa la/ /saṃ skṛ ta ni mtshan nyid dang / /ldan dang brtson dang 'dus byas la/ /rgyan dang bkra shis la yang ngo / /saṃ ha ste ni 'grogs 120—1453

dang brtan/ /rṣa li dang ni zos pa dang / /'khrul pa dang ni g.yo ba la/ /ste mi tai ni g.yo ba bral/ /ri bo lta bur gyur pa la/ /stha sa nyi ni bzo bo'i dbye/ /go cha can dang srad bu dang / /'tsho ba 'dod dang mchod sbyin la/ /sthā pi ti ni bkod dang des/ /sra brnyi ni chu klung dang / /'dam bu byin dang sman gyi dbye / /ha ri tā ni zlum po dang / /ljang gu dang ni mdog ldan dang / /rta dang mdog dang phyogs la'o/ /rtsa yi rab tu dbye ba la'ang / /harmi tai ni spel dang bsregs/ /ha padhi ni sol ba dang / /so ba dang ni rnge tog dang / /yal ga can kyi dbye ba la/ /hā rī ta ni rgyan 'gyed dang / /bya dang thub pa'i dbye ba la/ /hri sheṣi tai ni rnam par 'dzum/ /thogs dang dga' ba spu long 'dud / /kṣu ri ta ni 'dzag pa dang / /'gyur dang a bi shapta rngul/ /i ga ri tai tshig pa dang / /pa khā sha yi yal 'dab la/ /a ti mukta dpyid dang shing //ti ni pa dang cha med la/ /a tyā hi tai 'jigs chen dang / /srog la bltos med bya ba la/ /a tikṣi bha gzhan 'gyur dang / /smon pa'o a na ha ti ni/ /sngon med gos dang gos sar la'o/ /a nu ma ti zla ba nya/ /gang ba dang ni rjes gnang la'o/ /antarga ta dbus dang nang / /thob dang mi dran pa la'o/ /a pa tsi ti mchod pa dang / /nges byed zad dang nyams pa la/ /a pā thra ta bkab pa dang / /rang rgyud a rnyi dzā ta ni/ /bzhad pa rigs pa ku lī na/ /thob pa'i gzugs dag la yang ngo / /a bhi yugha zhe sdang sdom/ /mngon par brtson dang lhur byed pa'o/ /a bhe mbi ta rigs pa dang / /'dus byas dang ni bzod pa'o/ /a bye shaste 'jig rten gyis/ /smod dang slong dang mngon par spyong / /arba pa ti sa bdag dang / /dbang phyug mi 'am ci dang dbyangs/ /120—1454

a ba gi tai yongs su brjod/ /yang yang lta dang rnam par smod/ /a wa dhasta yongs su bkrus/ /smad dang kun nas phye mar byas/ /e ba dā tai dkar dang ser / /rnam par dag dang rab mchog la/ /shes dang bkag pa la yang ngo / /a wa si tai 'gro dang mtha'/ /tshe dang ldan dang rnal 'byor dbye/ /ring du 'tsho ba dag la'o/ /udzhaisdi ta spyod pa rgyas/ /u nga spru ta spyod pa rgyal/ /smon lam dang ni sgo skyong la/ /asgra hi ta nyer bkod dang / /bcings/ dang bzung ba dag la'o/ /u pā kṛ ta mchod sbyin la/ /gsad 1bya'i phyugs dang nye bar phan / /u pa tsi ta mnyam gzhag dang / /bsags dang yang dag 'byor pa la/ /u pā hi ta me dang skyed/ /kun nas btags nga/ rnams la'o/ /u pa rakṣa myun pas khyab/ /zla ba nyi ma 'phongs bye brag /sgra gcan la yang blta bar bya/ /u pa batrī bsten pa dang / /so sor go bar byed pa la/ /'grogs pa'o udzee li tai ni/ /kun tu bkram dang srab mor byas/ /drang srong gis 2brjod nga rgyal 'domasan / /rtse mo dra ba g.yo ba'i dbye/ /e rā ba ta glang chen dkar/ /gdeng can mtho ba nā re ga /i rā ba tai ring po dang / /thang shing dbang dang mda' stan la/ /i rā ba tī glog 'od ldan/ /sprin gyi dbye ba nyi ma dang / /sā la'i 'dab dang 'od ldan pa—/ /ka la dhi ta ca co sgogs/ /gser dang dngul dag la yang ngo / /ku murba tī ku mud ldan/ /ku mud mar 5dang ku mud can / /ku ha ri tai 6sgra dang ni/ /ku sha'i 'dab ma la yang 'dod/ /rin chen gser dang tshogs can dang / /phye ma nag dang skya nar dang / /mā sa'i lo ma la yang ngo / /ganta ba tī chang dang sa/ /grong dang chu dang sbyar ba'i dri/ /ga rutthan ta bya khyung bya/ /gri ha pa ti khyem gnas dang / /ra tyā dhwa na pa tri ṇa/ /120—/455

tsakrā hu tī dpung pa ring / /'khor dang sreg blugs gang ba la/ /tsant+ra kanta nor bu ṭwābu'i dbye/ /zla ba chu shel kai ra ba/ /tsarma nā tī chu klung gi/ /dbye ba dang ni chu shing la/ /tsā tu dra tā zhes bya ba/ /chu dang ri yi khyad par dang / /'bab chu kā ra tī zhes dang / /zla ba nye bar gnas la brjod/ /tsi tra gubee dbyug 'dzin dang / /de'i yi ge pa la'o/ /de bā tīrti gtum po dang / /nā pi ta dang bya rog sgra/ /di bā bi 37ta 'ug pa dang / /ku muta 'byung gnas chu srin no/ /dī ṣpepa panta mtsho dang chu/ /dī pa ba tī ri dang sa/ /dhū ma ge krutu nyi chen dang / /skye dang gza' yi dbye ba la/ /nā ga danta glang po'i so/ /khyim du nges par son pa'i shing / /nā ga darnyi bum pa dang / /dpal gye lag ldan ma la'ang blta/ /na dī kanta chu gter dang / /rgya mtsho'i 'khor dang 'gro chu la/ /ni dā kaddhā dzambu yi/ /khri shing bya rog skang pa'i byin pa dang / /legs par rnam par grags pa'o/ /naddhā brta khyem bye brag / ta ba snyer yi shing la'o/ /ni rā gri thutī kha ton med/ /so sor spong dang spel ba la/ /nistu ṣi haṃ phra mor byas/ /btang dang pags pa stong pa la/ /niḥ ka si ta nges phyin dang / /ngan par byas dang steng du phan/ /pañtsa gu bee rus sbal dang / /tsārpā ka yi mthong ba la/ /pa ri ga tai shes dang bskor/ /g.yang sa thob dang rnyed pa la / /pa ri ghā ta yongs 'joms g.yul/ /pa ri brta 'bru dang brje/ /rus sbal rgyal dang 'bros pa la/ /palla be tai ta ta dang / /de rab 'jug dang rgya skyegs dmar/ /pā rā ba ta phug ron dang / /ri skyes spre'u tind+ra ka /sā rā ba ti sa skyong dang / /dbyangs dang mdzes dang 'bras bu la/ /pā ri dzā ta yongs bzang dang / /mand+ra ra dang lha yi shing / /pā shu pa ta phyugs bdag lha'i/ /120/de1456

bu dang pa ka'i me tog can/ /pu ra skṛ tai mdun du byas/ /mngon par mchod pa dga' la'o/ /mtshon cha khrus byas dgras bzung dang / /bdag gir byas pa la yang ngo / /puju danta rigs 'dzin gye/ /bye brag glang po phyogs kyi glang / /pra dzā pa ti sa bdag dang / /tshangs pa dang ni skye 1dgu'i bdag /pra ṇi hi tai bshad dang bkod/ /thob dang mnyam par gzhag 2pa la/ /pra ti ha ta dgra dang ni/ /so sor 'khrul dang bkag pa la/ /pra ti batrī lam dang sems/ /gos byed gnas byed rab 'jug thob/ /spyod yul dang ni rab tu rtogs/ /yang dag rig dang cha la'o/ /pra ti kṛ ti bcos pa dang / /gzugs brnyan dang ni mchod pa la/ /pra ti kṣi pā so sor thogs/ /mngags pa dang ni sel ba la / /pra dhū pi ta nyon mongs dang / /nyi ma bgrod pa'i phyogs la'o/ /pra bra dzi ta dka' thub mtha'/ /spang spos sman dang mgo zlum mo/ /bha ga bānta go rī dang / /bud med rgyal ba mchod 'os dang / /zlos gar dang ni gar la'o/ /sgo ga banta longs spyod can/ /sgo ga wa tī klu yi grong / /klu dang chu klung la yang 'dod / /rang ga ma tā rgya skyegs dang / /brtsegs ma la yang blta bar bya/ /lasmre pa te mi bdag dang / /khyab 'jug li shi pū ga'i 'bras/ /ba na sā ti shing tsam dang / /me tog 'bras med shing la'o/ /bi jista tai/ kha 'byed 4dang / /spyod pa mngon par 'phags pa la/ /bi ni pā ta lha sogs kyi/ /phongs dang 'og tu ltung ba la/ /bi ba swā ta bā ba su/ /tse 5na dbang phyug dag la'o/ /ba bakṣi ti smra 'dod bzang / /bi spyodza yanta rgyal mtshan dang / /brgya byin khang bzang mda' skyes la/ /bai dzā yadhi ba dan dang / /rgyal byed dang ni me bsrub la'o/ /bya ti ba ta rnal 'byor dbye/ /cher 'byung ba dang 720—/457

phyir 'jal dang / /sha ti dhri ti brgyabyin smin pa 'joms/ /padma'i gdan can la yang 'dod/ /shu ba dādhī/ glang po/ rlung / /glang mo dang ni so bzang ma'o/ /saṃ khya banta mkhas grangs ldan/ /sa dā ga ti dri bzhon dang / /rtag pa'i dbang phyug mya ngan 'das/ /sa mu dānta mtha' yas dang / /ras bal dang ni spyo ka'o/ /sa mu bye tā 1kun nas g.yengs/ /ma dul ba dang rgod pa'o / /sa mā ghā ta gsod dang 'khrug /ting 'dzin gnas dang mnyam par gzhag2 /bkod dang dam bca' legs grub dang / /bdag nyid ldan pa rnams la'o/ /sa mā hi tai kun tu 'dzin/ /bkod dang mnyam par bzhag pa la//sa/ ra swa/nta mtsho can dang / /rgya mtsho dang ni/ chu klung la/ /swa ra swa tī chu klung dbye/ /chu klung lha mo sa dang ngag /lha yi ri bo rnams la'o/ /su dhwa sru ti mdzes pa dang / /lus ngan gzhan pa dag la'o/ /srurya bhakta nyi ma lha/ /bsgo dzi ba dag la'o/ /se nā ba ti sde dpon dang / /dmag dpon dang ni skems byed la/ /he ma ba tī me nyi ma/ /sla la dang ni kha ba'i dgra/ /ser po dang ni a ru ra/ /gser gyi 'o ma shu dag dkar/ /a byā bi tai dang ni skyes/ /'gro dang rdzu 'phrul spyod pa la/ /a pa rā ni dzi tai zhes/ /dpal mgren dang ni rtul mo'i bu/ /mchod sbyin dbye ba rnams la'o/ /a pa dzā 4dzi ta zhes pa/ /rgyal byed ma dang ri'i bu mo/ /khyab 'jug gnon pa rnams dang ni/ /dkar mo dang ni pham pa'o/ /a ba lo ke tai 5zhes pa/ /lta ba bshad pa 'jig rten mgon / /spyan ras gzigs pa rnams la'o/ /u pa dhu ba ti zhes pa/ /nye bar 'chi dang yongs su gdung / /ga shā bye pa ti zhes pa/ /dbang phyug dang ni log 'dren la/ /pi pa ti ṣarnya zhes pa/ /lhung 'dod dang ni mkha' 'gro la/ /120—1458

thra thi bī pa ti zhes pa/ /sa bdag /khyu mchog sman la'o/ /mūspyo bhe ṣikta zhes pa / /sa spyong rgyal rigs sngags pa la/ /yā ta rpā pa ti zhes pa/ /chu bdag dang ni nyi ma la/ /pa sanda dru ta zhes pa/ /mā kanda dang bee ka dang / /lnga pa'i chags pa dag la'o/ /pa sanda dru tī yi sgra/ /skya nar ldan dang mu tig can/ /gzhan phyed 'debs dang mgul ris can/ /titrī ri dang mtsho'i mar sar/ /bdud rtsi bdud rtsi'i gter la'o/ /sna tshogs gsal ba las ta mtha'i sde'o// //tha ni rdo ba brtsegs pa la/ /thu ni 'jigs spyob bkra shis la/ /arja/dgos pa 'byor pa dang / /rgyu dang byis pa mang po'i dngos/ /sgra yi brjod bya'i yul dang ni/ /'jug pa dang ni rnam pa las1/ /ā sthā dmigs pa/bltos pa med/ /'bad dang gnas la blta bar bya/ /kāsthā sa dang rtsig pa dang / /mgo bo'i khyad par dag la'o/ /ku tha/ mdog dang la ba dang / /rma bya'o ko tha mig nad dbye/ /ras dang / srub par byed pa la/ /kā tha phongs dang nges smin rdzas/ /sdug bsngal la'o gā thā ni/ /tshigs bcad dang ni ngag dbye la/ /grand+ra bsgrigs dang yi ge ni/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis nges byas la/ /gradzre tshigs dang mdud pa dang / /nad kyi dbye ba dag la'o/ /tī rja 'khyog 2po 'ching ba'i dbye/ /bstan bcos dang ni 'jug pa dang / /bsod nams zhing dang snod chen dang / /thabs dang mkhan po lta ba dang / /drang srong bsten dang chu mchod sbyin/ /pus mo ba ni tā dus mchod/ /tuttha/ spangs ma sug smel la/ /tuje mig sman tuttha me/ /duḥsbra ngan 'gro rmongs pa la/ /sarja ka ku bha srid sgrub / /rpā tha/ nyi ma/ bā dzee chu/ /thra thu mi bdag 720—1459
