zir nag /rdzing bu dang ni chen po brjod/ /prastha ri ngos tshad dang ni/ /nyung ngur byas pa'i dngos po la/ /pro tharta dang zhodakrogs lkupa'idar ba dang / /lam dang rked pa snying po la/ /bī bye khyem gyi snying po dang / /phreng ba/ zlos gar gzugs can lam/ /mand+ra/ srub byed/ dbyug gu dang / /bcu gnyis/bdag dang / tsam pa la/ /mig nad kyang ngo / /pri khudzee ni/ /dud 'gro bsags dang / tshogs pa la/ /pra dngha —bhā/ mnyam dka' me tog dbye/ /ku ruṇḍa ka'o/ /ra tha ni/ /shing rta lus dang / be ta sa/ /sgra'o/ /sāṭwā tshong pa la/ /'dus dang tshogs tsam la yang blta/ /sekshi rams dang sbrang rtsi snyigasapya//zas las byung ba la yang ngo / /saṃ sthā 'jig dang rnam gnas dang / /gsal dang de mthong ba dag la/ /spru ti gnas dang grangs zhi du yod dang / /rjes gnang dang ni spyod pa dang / /ni dza rāṣṭa dag la'o(khye/ /a ti thi ni gshe ba ⑦dang / /khro ba dang ni ku sha'i bu/ /a bya tha ni nad kyis dman/ /phan dang nad med/ yu nu ka /a shottha khyani gang ba dang / /garda shingabhāṇḍa bispa li/ /u da tha ni dbang chen dang / /'dod chen zangs kyi gtsug phud can/ /khyim bya / udma tha ni 'dab brtsegs 1snadang / /'gro byed dang ni 'joms byed do/ /u pastha ni phang pa dang / /skye gnas dang ni bshang lam mo/ /mi rnams rigs kyi bye brag dang / /mchog gi bdag la ka yasru/ /na tshod gnas dang phan pa dang / /lus kyi dbyibs la gā 0yasthā/ /ba lang lce dang ba lang lhas/ /phyi ba sman la go grasbi/ /da ma tha ni dul ba dang / /dbyug pa gos med phyogs dang ni//nor med dang ni skra nyal pa'o/ /ni shī tha ni mtshan phyed dang / /mtshan mo tsam mo / pra ma tha/ /bde byed tshogs dang phan pa dang / /de bzhin rab 120—1460

'joms la yang ngo / /ba yasthā ni shasma byā 1/ /phan da kā ko li skyu ru ra'o/ /pa yasbra ni gzhon nu dang / /tshangs ma tru ṭi ku 2ḍū ṭī/ /madma tha ni 'dod sems dang / /'dod pa'i lha dang ka pittha/ / shing/ ba ma thu ni sgyug pa dang / /glang po che dang dbang byed la'o/ /ba rū tha ni shing rta sbas/ /ba rū thang ni pags pa'i khyem/ /bi da tha ni/ rnal 'byor dang / /ka ḍi na'o/ /sha ma tha//zhi ba dang ni blon po la/ /shu dag sha ṭi ṣasgabye / /sen mo'i khyad par ṣaṭwānd+ra/ /sa marja ni nus pa dang / /shor ba dnga'aba'ibacings pa'i don phan pa/ /seddhārja zhes bya ba ni/ /don kun grub dang yungs kar dkar/ /kṣa pa thu ni kha bye dang / /sprid pa dang ni phun tshogs la/ /a ni kaṣṭha 4ngan pa 'thab/ /mtshan rtags pa ṭa/ 'joms pa dang / /rgyal po bsrung dang lam po che/ /'dus dang mkhas pa rnams la'o/ /i ti ru thā/ grong gtam dang / /prabhaṣṭa yi chos la'o/ /pā ti ka thā zhes bya ba/ /sa bdag tshig dang ma dad pa/ /u da ra thi nyi ma mtsho/ /tsa tubee tha bzhi mdo'i lam/ /yang dag 'gro dang gnyis skyes la/ /tsi tri ra tha rigs 'dzin dang / /dri za'i bye brag dag la'o/ /da sha mbi sbya nyi ma dang / /gnas brtan dang ni chags zad la/ /ba na prastha sbrang rtsi'i gnas/ /bsnyi gnas gsum pa/ ki shu ka'o/ /a pra ti ra tha zhes pa//dpa' ba dang ni ltad mo dang / /snyan tshig 5dang ni bkra shis la/ /tha yig mtha'i sde tshan no// //da ni ngag dang 'bod pa la/ /dā ni ma ma gcod dang / sbyin/ /and+ra rgyan gye bye brag dang / /'ching bar byed pa'i dngos po la/ /inda 6lo dang 720—1461

sprin dang ni/ /glegs bam dang ni ri'i bye brag /kanda shing gi rtsa ba dang / /sprin dang nu ma/ srur ṇa/ /kusdo mā/ sgya/ 'khor lo g.yo/ /ni bi dang ni lha yi dgra/ /ga da khyab 'jug spun zla nang / /gā da mtshon cha'i khyad par la//i dā 'dab ma gshog pa dang / /mdud pa'i lo ma ta mā la/ /inda/ bsam pa 'jug pa la/ /bī dā/ bu mo yid 'dod la/ /na dī 'bab chu/ na da mtsho / /dmar po sogs dang sgra la'o/ /nandi zhi ba mchod pa dang / /dga' dang rgyan po 'gyed pa la/ /nand+ra nor bu phun tshogs la/ /nandi snod dang bkur 'debs dang / /ba rda tshig dang gnas la'o/ /bya da spyod dang smod pa la / /bā da/ des mtshon sgra dang ni/ /skyob dang mtshan ma dngos po dang / /rkang pa rgyu byed rtsa ba dang / /bzhi cha dang ni 'od zer dang / /ri yi mtha' dang ri bo la/ /bi dā shes dang 'dod pa dang / /'byor pa po 'joms dkar po la/ /de bi rnam par 'gro ba gsum/ /sor gdub rgya dang blo dang ni/ /legs byas sa yi mthil la'o/ /brnyi/ grong dpon dge ba la/ /bhe ta/rnam gnyis/ khyad par la/ /bi dā/ 'thag dang / nye bar smra/ /ma dī/zhing las/ dngos po la/ /ma dā/ pyos 'gyur/ glang rtsi dang / /sbyin dang tho ba mchog la'o/ /manda rang dbang ngan pa dang / /dal bar dga' dang rmongs gzhan sbyor/ /gza' spen pa dang skal med dang / /glang po'i rigs kyi khyad par la'o/ /mri ①du/ rno med 'jam ②po la/ /ra da/ so dang myu bugu la/ /sha da/ 'dzim pa/ sha 6'o/ /sru da/ gsal byed yon tan la/ /swā du/ zhim dang / yid 'ong la/ /sbe da/ rdul dang tshong ④pa la/ /hri ⑤di snying la'o sgo da ni/ /phye ma dang ni zhib mo la/ /e ga da ni/120—1462

skya dang bu/ /i ga rda ni dpung rgyan la'o/ /saṃ ga dā ni lho phyogs kyi/ /glang po che la glang mo la/ /arngu da ni grangs bye brag /sha 'dzer rte7dang ni ri bo la/ /a snyand+ra ⑤ni zla phyed dang / /lag sor sen mos mtshan ma la/ /ā krānda ni mi bzad sgras/ /du dang grogs dang dpun zla la/ /a mo da ni dri bzung dga'/ /ā spa rda ni bya pa/ gnas/ /ka ku da ni glang gi lus/ /nog dang rgyal po'i mtshon byed la/ /ka patna ni dpa' bo dang / /bde 'byung ral pa'i tshogs dang ni/ /rwa dang gtso bo karkanda/ /yi ge bcas dang yal ga dang / /chu yi dra ba phug tu 'gro/ /gyen du 'degs pa rnams la'o/ /karṇand+ra ni rna/ zhags la / /kā ma dā ni gzhon ma la/ /'dod pa 'jo bar byed pa la/ /ku mu da ni phyogs kyi glang / /klu dang lha min khyad par dang / /mtho ri sa la'o ku 1mu rda/ /kai ra ba la blta bar bya/ /ku mu rda ni 'dam skyes dkar/ /ku mu dā ni bum can dang / /gasgyu ri yi shing dag la/ /ku mu de ni/ sa dga' dang / /mda' dang ral gri dag la'o/ /kyu si da ni le lo bcas/ /ku sī rda ni 'phel 'tsho byed/ /kau mu da ni smin drug can/ /kau mu dī ni/ zla ba can/ /kra byā da ni ro zan dang / /sha za dang ni srin po la'o/ /go binda ni dbang gzhan skyes//ba lang mig dang dbyangs bdag la/ /gotpa rda ni ba lang gingu/ /rmig rjes g.yang sa ba lang 'gros/ /spyod yul la'o gotpa da/ /brtan ⑤pa dang ni sa la'o//sprin dang musta dza la dang / /srang dang sman pa dzī ba dang / /ngur ba rkyal byed/u ra dang / /sprin dang ma sta/ to ya dang / /to ya de ni mar la 'dod/ /da ra da ni 'jigs g.yang sa/ /gnya'o shes dang bu dag la/ /da ⑥ra da ni dngul chu dang / /rgya mtsho/ mtshal ⑦dang dug bye brag /tri sha dang ni/120—1463

zhib btags dang / /dro ba dar dpyangs grong dpon la/ /sbyin byed dpal sbyin / dha na dang / /narma da ni rtsed mo ldan/ /rtsed 'jo byed ma/ narma dā/ /nam gru ma la yang de bzhin/ /na la di ni chu srin sbyin/ /spang spos can dang pu shel tse/ /nosthā da ni yongs su rgol/ /yongs su mthar phyin smra ba la/ /ni ṣā da ni dbyangs kyi dbye/ /khyi sha 'tshed pa la yang ngo / /pra rja da ni/ nad dbye dang / /shin tu mtho ba'i sgra la'o/ /pa ma da ni 'dod mo myos/ /bra ma da ni snyems dang dga'/ /pra pa da ni rab dang pa/ /snyan ngag rgyan gyi khyad par dang / /shin tu dad dang rjes su 'dzin/ /sgra sgogs lha min/ prarmā dang / /pā sā da ni lha mi dang / /lha yi bskyod pa dag la'o/ /ma ra da ni bu mo zhi/ /ba ra da ni rab dang la'o/ /bha sa da ni/ dus dang spyod/ /sha dang 'od gsal ba la'o/ /maryā dā ni gnas dang mtshams/ /khrims lugs dang ni spyod pa la'o/ /ma kanda ni ro bcud 'dzin/ /mā karnyi dang / sgyu ru'i 'bras / /me nā da ni/ ri byi la/ /'brug sgra'i rjes su sgeg pa la/ /ba tandi ni brka ra/ /shing lcags dang ni stegs bu la'o/ /bi sha da ni skye bo kha dog dang / /gsal ba dang ni sa ra ta/ /'dam bu dang ni lo dag la/ /shā ra dī chu'i bispa lbo/ /'dab ma bdun pa'o sha ra dang / /sā li —1dang ni murga ser / /barba lo dang sgrub dang mngags/ /sadza da/ yon tan bstod pa dang / /'byor pa do shal rab dbye la/ /sambi da/ dam bca' ba dang brda/ /ye shes kun spyod ming dang ni/ /chu dang bya ba'i rnam pa dang / /'thab dang yang dag 'chad pa la/ /saṃ bhe da ni/ rnam phye dang / /rgya mtsho yang dag 'grogs pa la//su nand+ra ni sred/ bud med/ /kṣa ṇa da ni tshogs can dang / /dga' ston 720/de1 /64

sbyin pa'o kṣa ṇa dam/ /chu la'o kṣa 3ṇa dā mtshan mo/ /a pa pā da smod pa dang / /bka' dang / yid brtan dag la'o/ /a bhi gyanda mngon par 'phel /'dzag pa dang ni mig la yang / /a bhi ma dha/ sgra bsrub shing / /abye pa dā shā ri'i 'bras/ /sha ra bha dang / spre'u dang / /zla ba'i phreng ba la yang ngo / /e ka pa dam dus dang lam/ /rkang gcig la'o de nas ni/ /ka ṭu kanda sdig pa dang / /shi gru'i khu ba dag la'o/ /ku ru binda musta dang / /kulbā ṣa dang /'bru'i dbye ba/ /ku ru bsdo tho ba dang / /padma rā ga mtshal dag la/ /ko ka na da padma dmar/ /dmar po'i ke ra ba la'o/ /tsakra tsunda 'od phung dang / /rwa byas nya yi bye brag la/ /tsa tutpa dā rta glang sogs/ /bud med byed pa'i khyad par la/ /dza na pa da/ yul dang ljongs/ /ta mo nu ta mun sel dang / /zla ba nyi ma me rnams la/ /pa rī bā da smod pa dang / /pi wang brdung ba'i dngos po la/ /rpā ṭha mad a byeṣṭi4/ /gar dang 'dren pa dga' ba la/ /pu ṭa bhe dang chu klung khang / /grong khyer dang ni gzhal med khang / /lam dang dang po'i tshes dang ni/ /yang dag rig pa la yang dran/ /thra yalba da mkha' spyod dang / /snyan par smra ba nyid la'o/ /ma hā nā da sgra chen po/ /dbyar dus sbrul chen glang po la/ /mu tsu kunda/ thub pa dang / /lha min shing gi khyad par la / /me gha nā da/ nyi ma dang / /laṅka mgrin bcu'i bu la'o/ /bee shā ra da mkhas pa dang / /spobs ldan 'jigs pa med pa la/ /beesngu pa da/ rgya mtsho dang / /nam mkha' dang ni chu skyes la/ /biju pa dī sgo rīglegs dang / /rtsal gyi dbye ba dag la yang / /shata hā da/ klog ldan sprin/ /ste mo brgya pa dag la'o / /sru ka ba rda/ spros pa dang / /rtse mo'i phung po rtsa la'o/ /sa maryā rda 120—1465

nye ba dang / /khrims lugs ldan pa dag la'o/ /sa ha sra pā da zhes pa/ /nyi ma dang ni za ma tog /chos dang gsang dang nye bar 'gog /dul dang ngos khyim mchog sbyin la/ /da yig mtha'i sde tshan no// //dha ni nor dang nor dbang la/ /dhwa ni 'dzin byed chos nyid la/ /arghaṃ rab rib mthong bas dman/ /long ba mngon par brjod pa'o/ /arnyi chu gter mtsho mchog la/ /asgo cha mnyam/ phyed/ dum bu/ /a bye/sems dang gzir ba dang / /mi 'dod 'ching dang / /phongs dang gnas/ /beebye kun tu gdung dang 'bar/ /ṛ rghaṃ/ 'byor dang 'byel pa dang / /ghaddhā dri can yang dag 'byel/ /cha shas 'dod dga' snyems pa la/ /gā dha gnas sogs 'dod pa la/ /go dhwa mthil dang ni hā ka /dagha gnas dang nyi ma shing / /darghaṃ bsregs pa la yang ngo / /da dhi dpal stug zho dang ni/ /dpal gnas dang ni gnas la'o/ /disgo dus dang / bi shi ṣa/ /nibee'i don can la yang ngo / /dusgo 'o ma rab tu dang / /dogha bee'u ba lang skyong / /shin tu nyer 'tsho 2snyan ngag mkhan/ /darghaṃ phyung dang bcings pa la/ /ā bye 'ching dang tshul dang gnyen/ /paju spun zla rtsa lag la/ /gnyen can dang ni shing la yang / /bā dhwa/ sdug bsngal dgag pa la/ /budha bde gshegs bstan 1dang zhi/ /blo dang ldan pa rnams la'o/ /budhe mkhas zhi/ rtogs pa dang / /smin pa dang ni de bzhin gshegs/ /burnyi 'phel dang 'byor dang sman/ /dga' ba'i cha shas khyad par la/ /dṛdha skyes dang snyan ngag mkhan/ /rgas 'khogs la'o thrarghaṃ ni/ /ri las skyes pa la yang ngo / /bo bye ting 'dzin dbye ba 120—1466

dang / /byang chub rtogs pa/ sa la skyes/ /ma dhu me tog bcud dang ni/ /sbrang skyes chang chu 'o ma la/ /mngar dang sbrang rtsi can dri zhim/ /ri mo lha min khyad par la/ /'tsho ba yal ga la yang ngo / /mi snye/ le lo/ bshes gnyen dang / /bsam pa mngon phyogs/ mdzes dang gnas/ /me dha mchod sbyin blo gros gtsang / /me rnyi ngan pa mi bzad pa/ /rā dmā/ lcug ma'i dbye ba dang / /ri mo'i dbye dang gzhu can dang / /sa ga /klog rmyedang khyab 'jug gnon/ /rgyal gyi 'bras bu rnams la'o/ /rā dhwa/ sa ga skyes la'o/ /lupta/ rngon pa 'dod can la/ /ba dhū/ bu mo chung ma dang / /btsun mo mna' ma sar pa dang / /ras dang ri skegs spos rnams la/ /bi byerngu / de 'dra 'phangs dang bcug /bi dhi byed po cho ga dang / /dus dang / nges pa rnams la'o/ /ba 1dha rnam pa rdzu 'phrul dang / /glang po'i zas dang thob dang sgrub/ /bi dhu ri bong mtshan ma dang / /khyab 'jug /ga pur srin po'i dbye/ /byā dhi/ nad dang khyab pa dang / /bsnun dang / rngon pa/ gdug pa can/ /shudhe 'ba' zhig gtsang ba la/ /shradha dad pa nyid dang 'dod/ /shārghaṃ nges par gnas pa la/ /shādha dad dang ldan pa la/ /sant+ra gnas dang dam bcas dang / /kun tu 'dzin pa la yang ngo / /sarnyi/ dbye ba mtshon legs dang / /bu ga yang dag spyod pa la/ /sā dhu/ legs mdzes skyes bu dam/ /sedha rtag pa rdzogs pa dang / /rab tu grags dang lha dag la/ /grub dang mngon par rab 'dzin dang / /sgrub dang byer ba la yang ngo / /sentu chu gter chu klung yul/ /rgyags pa dang ni 'bab chu la/ /su jo/ bdud rtsi/ sgo dhwa ni/ /drurpā/ sgu hi/ge gar gnas/ /sri khyodhu blo dang bu ram la/ /skandha/ lus dang skabs dang ni//120—1467

dpung pa'i rtsa ba/ tshogs dang 'dus/ /sa bdag mi dang glang bo che/ /rta rnams yang dag basbus pa la/ /sdibha/ mnyes 2gshin/ phun tshogs dang / /tshig snyeṇa la mngon par brjod/ /smaddhā yang dag dga' dang mtshungs/ /'gran dang rim pa kun nas mtho/ /i gā dha ni mthil reg min/ /a ba dhi ni kun tu 'dzin/ /mtshams dus khung bu gnas la'o/ /a na rnyi ni bcings pa dang / /kun tu bcings dang rdza rnga sogs/ /ā bandha ni dga' ma'i 3rgyan/ /brtan par bcings pa la yang brjod/ /ā bidha ni rab bsnun dang / /'khrog po/dgag pa/ lus 'greng dang / /zol byed pa dang 'khor lo la/ /u pa bye ni nye bar 'dzin/ /khyad par rgyan 'gyed chos sems dang / /bu bza'i bya ba la yang ngo / /ka bandha ni da ra dang / /sga 4gcan srin bo'i dbye ba la/ /ka 5—bandha ni/ chu dang 'gro/ /spyi bo dang ni lus la'o/ /drubee 6 dha ni/ /sdug bsngal dman/ /na 7ro dha ni 'gog dang bsam/ /ni kha dha ni ri dang yul/ /de yi rgyal po mkhregs she pa la/ /n+ya gro dha ni/ bha ṭa'i shing / /sa mi 'dom gang mnyam pa la/ /n+ya gro bye ni/ dug lo ma/ /rmongs byed ma dang bha skrudhri'o/ /ba ra bye ni mchod sbyin spyod/ /nyi ma'i nye bar bskor ba la/ /yal ga /mchod sbyin/ shing la yang / /pra siddhā ni grags dang rgyan/ /mā ga dhwa 1— ni yul dbus nas/ /byung dang rgyal rigs rje rigs skyes/ /phyag 'tshal 'tsho ba dag la'o/ /mā ga dhwa ni zegs ma khyu/ /bi ba dha ni yongs su za/ /lam la 'khor dang bī ba bye/ /bee bu dha ni mkhas dang lha/ /rnam par sbyangs dang nges bdag nyid/ /bi 1nashradha ni zhi ba dang / /thams cad sgrol dang dpa' ba la/ /sandadhe ni go cha bgos/ /yal ga /go ling / rnam skyes la/ /sambi dha 15ni 120—1468

kun tu 'dzin/ /pho mo'i dbang po'i spyod yul la/ /sa mā bye ni bsam gtan dang / /ngag med nges pa/ nus pa la/ /sasthā dha ni/ shaṃ ka ṭa/ /skye gnas dri bzangs shaṃ ga ra/ /saṃ ro dha ni mngon 'dod dri/ /sug smel skyes dang 'phangs dang 'gog /saṃ siddhi ni 'dod pa dang / /mtshams ldan ma dang rang bzhin grub/ /a ni ru ddhā dran pa'i bu/ /spyod dang lus med skyes la'o/ /a nu brnya gtso bo yi/ /rjes su 'brang dang rtag pa dang / /skyon bskyed pa dang rang bzhin sbyin/ /rab tu 'jug dang nges 'jug la'o/ /a nu beedhi tsoskyigs bu dang / /sred pa la yang blta bar bya/ /a bha (kyero dha dag pa'i mtha'/ /rgyal po'i khab 1dang anta dhi/ /a baṣṭa bye④/ mnan pa dang / /ring ba dang ni snye'aphyang ba la/ /6ā banta ni )dbugs dbyung dang / /spre'u'i gnas dang dra ba can/ /i kṣu gand+ra/ spu byegri dang / /glo dang khro ba gze ma la/ /u gra gandha shu dag dang / /dza ma ni dang / dzred 'byung sman/ /u pa ladngha 'thob pa dang / /blo gros shes rab mtshan nyid ma/ /kā la kaddhā ḍata mā la/ /byurja ka dang 'tsho byed shing / /dīkyā gandha shu dag dang / /ske tshe ma ta shlau gru'o/ /tre rde go dhwa tsi tra ka /rgya skyegs dang ni rtsangs pa'o/ /ba ri bya dha 'dod chung 7dang //utta la'i shing la'o/ /brahma/ bantu lhag par 'dor/ /nges par ston dang gnyis skyes mchog /ma ho ra ṣa dug bca' sga/ / shriṅga pa ra33/ ro bcud do/ /sa mundadhe kun tu 'byung / /mkhas par zlom dang tshim pa la/ /yo dza na gandha/glang rtsi/ /rgyas pas spros dang bsil ba la'ang / /dha mtha'i sde'o// //bee ni 'dren pa dang ni gru/ /na ni rgyal dang / mchod pa la/ /no ni/120/de1469

gru dang skyes pa la/ /nu ni/ bstod pa stong byed la/ /a.oṃ zas brjod pa la'o / /i na sa bdag nyi ma bdag /gros hūṃyul dang byed skyod la/ /spru rgo sgra dang skyed mos tshal/ /dman pa la'o kṛṣṭa ni/ /thams cad lto ba chu la'o/ /ghra ṇi/ 'khar ba'i pheg rdob dang / /sel snyan bar ma'i gar la'o/ /gha na/sprin dang / musta dang / /rgya chen lcags kyi tho ba la/ /sra dang / mkhregs dang / gsher bcas la'o/ /tsirja rgyal mtshan tsam dang ni/ /mtshan ma dang ni ba dan la/ /ṭī na yul dang gos dang 'bru/ /ri dwags khyad par rgyud kyi dbye / /tstsharja bkab dang gsang ba la/ /tstsharghaṃ dbye ba/ stso1 gi/ /shi g.yo thal mo sā ma ra/ /dza na 'jig rten 'jig rten che3/ /'jig rten gzhan yang blta bar bya/ /dza dī bu mo mtshams ldan ma/ /dza ni 'byung ba'o dzi na ni/ /dgra bcom sangs rgyas shin tu rgan/ /rgyal po'i lta bu phra ba dang / /byi la dang ni / chung ngu tsam/ /dra —/ gtong ba glang po/ myos/ /gcod dang dag dang / bsrung ba la/ /dā nu sbyin byed rnam gnon la/ /dī nā byi ba btsun mo la/ /dī na ngan 'gro kā ta ra/ /rlu :/ 'byor pa pha rol gnon/ /dha nu gzhu dang dra ba dang / /khyim gyi dbye ba la yang ngo / /dha rgo nor dang 'byor pa la/ /jo nā z-iṣṭa ya ba dang / /so ba myu gu chu gter la/ /dhe na 'jo ba chu bo la/ /nasna/ gcer bu gos bral dang / /zad byed pa dang mchod 'os so/ /yu bye.āoṃ dman pa smod pa la/ /pā bee/ btung ba srung ba la/ /ba āoṃ nags tshal chu dang ni/ /dga' ston dang ni rab gnas la/ /bisdo cegos dang rin dang ni/ /be ta na dang rdzas dag la/ / ba dhathu/ si tā/ dbang ldan dang / /dhwa nu/ nyi ma 'od 'bar la/ /dhīmbi bcom dang / grogs 120—1470

dang / gsal/ /mā ni tshod ma/ bre sogs dang / /'jal dang / sems dang / 'dzin pa dang / /mchod pa'o/ /mbi na zhes bya ba/ /nya dang khyim gyi dbye ba la/ /myu ni/ ngag bcad sangs rgyas dang / /ri bye dang ni ki shu ka /iṅga dī dang / mṛsgo 1dang / /tu pa ri dang sa dag la/ /ya āoṃ phyi dang 'gro ba la/ /yo ni 'byung gnas bud med dbang / /rarja nor bu gtso bo'o/ /ratna sman dang / gtum po'o/ /raṣṭha sbrul mig e la'i 'dab/ /lahūṃ khyem rnams 'chang ba ste/ /yang dag chags dang dam pa rgyal/ /bā shaṃ/ 'bras bu skam 2po dang / /skam po'i rgun po myu ni/ /su ruṅga dang / chu rlabs dang / /dri zhim/ ka ṭa 'gro ba la/ /bi.oṃ shes dang gnas dang thob/ /shī na gnyid log rmongs pa dang / /bye na dkar dang / bya ba'i bye brag /rwa dang mkhas dang / lam la'o/ /ba na lcug ma/ bā tya la/ /sru nu nyi ma/ phu nu'o/ /sru āoṃ btsas dang rab tu skyes/ /sru na/ mutstsha dkar po la/ /sru tyā/ bu mo 'ching gnas dang / /ga la shuṇḍi la yang 'dod/ /sgyu na le lo dud pa dang / /snum dang pra ti/ khru rya la/ /sthā ni/ gnas de 'dra ba dang / /nges par 'jug dang go skabs dang / /rigs pa'i don dang byed don dang / /sru na/nyi ma 'od zer la/ /swa sna/ gnyid log /blo bral mthong / /ha gu 'gram pa yan lag dang / /'chi dang mtshon cha be con dang / /tshong dus dang ni sgeg mo la/ /tī rna/ smad dang dman pa la/ /aṅga lda ni yan lag mchog /theg pa dang ni lus ma dang / /nā paṃ kā yo khyad par la/ /añdza na ni phyogs byed dbang / /añdza rna ni mig sman bcud/ /sudhī dud pa so so rpār/ /shing gi dbye ba la yang ngo / /añdza na ni thu bo'i dbye/ /rlung dang sa byā'o/ /añdza 720—1471

nā / /byug pa dang ni btsun mo la/ / kyesthā na ni dus dang lam/ /kun nas nyon mongs phung po dus/ /a pā na ni/ bshang lam rlung / /a sā āoṃ ni bshang lam 'dod/ /a: na ni chen po grogs/ /a ya na ni/ lam nyi ma/ /lho dang byang du bgrod pa la/ /na raṣṭi ka ṭa'i 'bras/ /taṅga la dang re mig bcas / /ardzu na ni sa bdag dang / /ka ku bha dang / brtson 'grus byed/ /gtsug phud phyed dang / dkar po la/ /ardzu byā ni ba lang gnas/ /bang chung dang ni lag chu la/ /ardzu ni ni/ rtsa mig nad/ /don dang / slong dang gnod sbyin dang / /bstan 2dang / rnam par brtsod pa dang / /chu khams smod dang rta dang glang / /rna ba dang ni dbang chen la// /asgo llī/ tā la'i 'dab/ /'brum bu 'joms dang dpa' byed do/ /a ba rna ni srung byed dang / /sdig pa/ bung ba/ a lā dga'/ /a sha ni ni rdo rje dang / /glog dang gnam lcags la 'dod do/ /a billī ni 'bab chu dang / /mngags pa dag mtha'/ rgan btsun ma/ /bdag dang tshangs pa yid dang lus/ /rang bzhin/ brtan pa/ blo rnams la/ /ā dā rna ni bdag dang mad/ /rab bsnun rgyal po'i rgyan la'o/ /ā banda ni phongs gyur pa'o/ /ā sa ni/ni glang po che'o/ /phrag pa gdan dang gdan la gnas/ /a sa byā ni tshong zong ngo / /ā sa na ni mgyogs byed shing / /uṭwā rgo ni gan rkyal 4dang / /gnyid log pa dang zab pa'o/ /uttha dzee ni ldang ba dang / /rgyud dang / skyed tshal / dga' dang 'thob5/ /rab lus zho shas 'tsho ba dang / /gyad kyi shugs dang glegs bam la/ /u dā rgo ni mgrin pa'i rlung / /rgya shug 6'khyel dang rlung bye — brag /udī rna ni sgyed pu dang / /de bzhin gyen du 'gro ba'o/ /120—1472

u dā rna ni skyed tshal dang / /rtsed mo'i sa dang des spro la/ /ka ṣṭha nā ni/sgod dang ni/ /bu ram ka ra'i gong bu la/ /ka ṣṭha dzā ni thod le skor/ /ka thi āoṃ ni gya tshom mo/ /ka da rgo ni 'khrug sdig 'dod/ /kā ma na 'dod mya ngan med//'dod pa can dang gzugs bzang ngo / /kadza rna ni g.yo ba dang / /'gul ba khyab pa/ bya ba la/ /karta rgo ni gcod pa dang / /shing bal rgyud dang las btsun mo/ /kalpa ṣpe ni gtsod dang nus/ /glang po skyes mchog kalpa nā/ /kā ki byā ni/ tshong zong dang / /tshad kyi shing bu bzhi cha la/ /kañtsa na ni klu shing dang / /nā ga ge sar tsadza ka /u dusthā 1ra/ kāñdza nā/ /kāñtsa dzā ni yung ba la / /kāñtsa dzee ni/ ge sar/ gser/ /kā na rghaṃ ni/ nags dang khyem/ /gdong bzhi'i gdong la'o/ /kā byā na/ /rgyas pa dang ni rna ba can/ /ka n+ya kā yi bu dag la/ /'jigs dang phyag 'tshal kā mi dī/ /kā ma ni/ 'dod tsam ko ka dang / /phug ron la'o kund+ra rna/ /'ching bu'i snod dang / phru'i bye brag/ku ha nā ni ngan g.yo'i spyod/ /phrag dog dang ni tshul/ 'chos so/ /kri nati na mkhas dang rung ba la/ /ke ta rna ni mtshon ma khyem/ /ba dan las dang 'bod pa la/ /mdzes dang yul gcig kau bi ni/ /smod dang ngan las gsad dang 'thab / /ku lbo na dang bcung lag 'gro/ /phyugs dang 'dab chags rnams la yang / /kranda āoṃ ni 'bod pa dang / /mchi ma dang ni/ rnam grol la'o/ /khaṅgān bse dang / bse ru dang / /ral gri'i mtshon cha la yang ngo / /gand+ra 58 ni mtshon byed dang / /'tshe dang spro dang / rab gsal la/ /gardza ni ni khro dang sgra/ /sgra med pa yi sprin la'o/ /ga ha ṣpe ni nags tshal dang / /snyug bsngal / tshang tshing / rtsod ldan la/ /dug shing gis bsregs phyugs kyi sha'o/ /120—1473

guñdza āoṃ ni rtags can la/ /go mbin sa yi rmyedabang phyug dang / /'phrog byed dge bsnyen chen po la/ /go na7sta bee ni do shal 'khrugs/ /do shal dbye ba/ba'i nu ma/ /grwa bān/ rdo ba/ ri chu/ brtse/ /ghatta nā ni g.yo ba dang / /kun tu 'jug dang 'khor lo can/ /'phrog byed sprul dang ku lā la/ /ko ka grong gi dra ba la/ /sbal pa'i dbye ba tsan da na/ /ma la ya skyes tsan dan ni/ /tsa nda ni chu klung dbye/ /tsadzren ba bas pa/ /'bras bu'i shing / 'bras bu'i lag dang 'jam pa yi/ /pags dang z-iṅga / rī ṭa la/ /tsa la rna ni g.yo dang 'gul sna / /g.yo ba'i sa la la yang ngo / /tsa ma mbi/ gos/ gharto thudzā/ /tsā bī'i dbye ba la yang blta/ /tse ta na ni sems dang rigs/ /yang dag rigs pa rnams la'o/ /tstsha da rgo ni 'dab ma gdugs/ /khang pa g.yo dang /ka snyelpas/ /'bun la grangasayang ngo tstsha da na/ /snod dang 'phyang dang / skyug pa la/ /tstsha 6da rna ni/ 'byed dang / gcod/ /'gro ba skye bo/ shuṣṭha ṇa/ /dza gha ram̐ ni/ bud med dang / /ska rags dang ni sngon ma'i cha/ /ka ṭī da ka rnams la'o/ /dzā thu ya rgo ni rgyal ba rta/ /glang po sogs dang go cha la/ /dza ba na ni myur tsam chodang / /lhag par myur dang mgyogs 'gro la/ /yul gyi dbye dang / tu rulka/ /rab tu phye pob la yang ngo / /dza ba nī ni/ sman dbye dang / /dzī pa phrengaban nī/ bo de tse/ /dzī bi ⑫ rna ni/ myur tsam la'ang / /gnas pa dang ni chu la yang / /dzre ⑪ba nā mbi/ tshil la 'dod/ /dzi ba nī ni 'tsho byed shing / /dzñā nī na/ lha shes ye shes can/ /ye shes ldan pa rnams la'o—/ /ta pa na ni nyi ma dang / /kun tu gdung dang bha bla ta/ /dmyal ⑫ba'i dbye ba dag la'o/ /ta mo sna zla nyi me/ /blo dang dpal mgrin khyab 'jug 120—1474

dang / /ta skyeli ni ni byi la dang / /chung ngu dang ba/ zab pa la/ /ta lu na chung lang tsho can/ /ta lu mbi ni na chung ma/ /te ma nā 2ni tshod ma gsher/ /te ma bhā ni/ sgyed ⑦bu'i dbye/ /to da rna ni/ gzir dang bsnun/ /da ma na ni/ gtong dang 'deng / /sbyin byed me tog dpa' bo'o/ /dar sgo ni mthong me long / /rmi lam li dang bstan bcos dang / /chos dang nye bar dmigs pa la/ /da sha na ni/ rtse mo la/ /da sha ni ni go chas so/ /da ha na ni/ gdug spyod dang / / dro bo chobhalbā ta dang me/ /dṛ shā na ni gza' yi bdag /dṛ shā āoṃ ni skar mar brjod/ /de ba na ni zhags pa can/ /de ba rna ni smra 'dod dang / /rtse ba dang ni tha snyad la/ /da sha rgo ni/ so/ go cha//rlu bān nyin mo'i mgon dang ni/ /mngon par 'gro ba'o/ /a dhwambi/ /mya ngan thang dang gzhu dang mdung / /dhaninathu/ gzhu 'dzin/ ṣibee dang / /srid sgrub shing la'o dha ma na/ /me dang smin sbyor 'khrug pa la/ /dha ma dī ni g.yo ba dang / /yung ba dang ni mgo dag la/ /dhwa ba ni ni/ sbyor 'od zer/ /khyim lus/ mthu/ gnas/ skye dang rgyug /ngag dang / dri ba lo ma la/ /sbyangs g.yo/ tshos mkhan tha ga pa'o/ /dhwa 'dzin gnyis skyes shing rta dang / /ri skyes rta dang sbrul la'o/ /nanda rmā peni dga' dang bu/ /nanda rna ni/ 'dres tshal la/ /rtsed bskyod rtse dga' nanda dī/ /nandi ldu dga' ba'i dbang phyug go/ /ljon shing / n+ya gro dha bong sgong / /na li mbi ni/ mtsho skyes ma/ /mtsho las skyes dang mtsho mchog dang / /nam mkha'i gaṅgā rgyun can lakyi/ /na li rna ni chu chu skyes/ /dzā dā rna ni nad dang des/ /dang po'i rgyu dang gnas dag la/ /phrug gu/ phreng ba ni dha ⑪rgo/ / 'di bha sum̐ tsa⑪/ bum pa 'jig /ba dī na/120—1475

mda' dang / mkha' 'gro khra/ /ri/ shing / shing rta/ shing rta can/ /padme mbi na/ padma dang / /pad can mtsho dang / bud med dbye/ /sarban/dga' ston dus tshigs dang / /bi 6 bta dang rab 'dzin dang / /tshes gcig mthong dang tshigs skabs dang / /mtshan nyid kyi ni khyad par la/ /ba ba na dī 3/ ku lā la'i/ /'tshed gnas rlung dang rnam rtog med/ /baghran/mig gi sman dang ni/ /skra dang / cha phra/ srad bu sogs/ /pā tsa rgo ni chu dang / rka/ /'tshed pa'i gnas dang mkhas pa la/ /pā ྾ na ni 'joms pa dang / /bkra ba dang ni/ 'joms byed dang / /klog mkhan dang ni gu gul shing / /pā tsa na ni/ se hā ma5/ /pā tsa rgo ni/ 'tshed byed la/ /pā pa dzee ni mang du sems/ /pā ba mbi ni a ru ra/ /zhags pa can dang / zhags pa 'dzin/ /bi shu na ni/ ngan pa dang / /phra ma can dang nā ra dang / /bi shu rgo ni gur kum la/ /pi shu nā ni thrakrā la/ /rpā ta na/ ka pi tsū ta'o/ /bi ta rgo ni thang shing dang / /gur gum dang ni bab la'o/ /pū na nā ni srin mo'i dbye / /phan pa a bee ki mbi dang / /dmag gi dbye ba/ sde dang dmag /pradzñā dzwa ni mtshan ma shes/ /blo 'o de nas pra dha rna/ /'joms byed dang ni grangs la'o/ /pra dhwa āoṃ ni mchog bdag nyid/ /zhing shes blo dang ma chen dang //gcig nyid mchog dang rtag tu ba'o/ /pra sru rgo guni skyes pa la/ /pra sru ④āoṃ ni me tog 'bras/ /pra sand+ra ni ma di rā/ /rab tu dang ba dang bcas pa'o pre twa 5na/ bzhad dang rlung la'o/ /pre man mdangs dang rtsed 'jo la/ /phalgu nā 5ni dka' thub dang / /sgrub dang ardzu na yi shing / /phalku na ni chu klung skyes//phru 7lgu ni ni zla ba'i dbye/ /bhandha byeni ni gsod dang 'ching / /brja nā ni/120—1476

chu'i dpal yon/ /bzlu rna ni gcod dang 'phel/ /ba se āoṃ ni khebs dang gos//pa ①nā ni/ stsos/ mkhas/ gar ma/ /ba sa rna ni gos dang stan/ /'khor dang shes dang gdugs pa la/ /bā hi mbi ni dmag gi dbye/ /a dī ki bhā chu klung dang / /lce ba la'o buddhā na/ /rtogs pa dang ni mkhas pa la/ /bo dha mbi ni byang chub dang / /spi spi lī 'o bo dha rna/ /spos dang mar me dag la'o/ /byon ḍa2man lha yi lam dang ni/ /bā ri ṇi la brjod par bya/ /bra hman tshangs pa bram ze dang / /dus mchod zla nyi sbyor ba la/ /thos dashes/ nad dang dka' thub la'ang / /bhaṭi mbi ni btsun mo dang / /zlos gar mkhan dang btsun mo'i rgyal / /tshangs ma mi pham go cha bgos/ /bhaṇḍa āoṃ ni ngan byas la/ /bharman/gser dang / glu gar khur/ /bha ba rna ni/ khang pa/ lus/ /bhā dza rna ni/snod rung ba/ /bhā ga ④/dzā ni/ bsam gtan/ byug /bhu ba rna ni/'jig rten chu/ /nam mkha' dang ni 'gro ba la/ /sgo gin/ gdengs ka ldan pa dang / /sbrul dang / grong dpon rgyal po dang / /nā se tā'o/ sgo gi mbi/ /dbang bsgur ma dang rang rigs ma/ /rgyal po'i btsun mo rnams la'o/ /maṇḍa rna—/ rgyan/ rgyan byed pa'o/ /ma da rna ni/ dran pa dang / /ngan pa/dpyid / shing / pra tshil la/ /ma lan ni lcags gos la/ /ma la rgo ni 'joms pa la/ /ma li mbi ni me tog can/ /ma li rgo ni dga' dang nag /mādzdza sum̐ ni byi lar 'dod/ /madzdza na ni rgya skyegs shing / /mā li nī ni tshigs bcad dbye/ /sgo gā phreng ldan btsun mo dang / /dkar mo tsaspra'i grong khyer la/ /mi thu nā ḍathuni khyim la'o/ /mi thu rgo ni/ /khyo shug ra6dang / /chung dang grong dang 'byel chos la/ /mgo zlum yid skyob muṇḍa ni/ /me ha lda ni/ dri chu dang / /120—1477

shishā'o mo thu rna zhes pa/ /ni dhu ba na'o/ me hūṃthu rna/ /yang dag 'grogs pa'o ya ma rna/ /mchog dang 'ching dang zung la'o/ /yā ba rna ni 'jug dus 'dod / /ser bar byed pa la yang ngo / /yu dza 3sna na ni bram ze dang / /shā ra tha'o yu ban ni/ /gzhon nu/ gtso bo nges 'dor dang / /stobs dang yangs pa rnams la'o/ /yo dza āoṃ ni rgyang grags bzhi/ /rnal 'byor dang ni mchog bdag la/ /rā dzā dī ni yung ba dang / /rgya skyegs 'dam bu/ mtshan mo la'o/ /rañdza na ni/ chags skyes byed/ /tshos dang mngar dang tsandan la/ /rañdza nī ni rams / guṇḍa/ /le brgan dang ni gsal ba la/ /dza hwan/ gser dang /ro shes dang / /ro ma dang ni ro myong thul/ /swa da rmā thuni brdzun pa dang / /sbud pa'i rlung dang sbubs kyi rlung / /rā dzan/ zla ba/ mi bdag dang / /brgya byin/ rgyal rigs/ gnod sbyin gtso/ /dā gīn 'dod ldan/ chags ldan no/ /rā dha rna ni/ sgrub thob mgu/ /ro tsa bee ni/ dur byid/ sga/ /ro tsa ni ni so ldan dang / /mun can ma'o/ ro tsa na/ /shābee le yi shing phung dang / /rakta ka/ dmā ra/ zhes pa/ /ro tsa nā ni gi wang dang / /bkra shis dang ni mdzes pa la/ /ro da āoṃ ni du ba dang / /mchi ma 'dzag pa tsam la yang / /ro ha ni sna chen ro nyi ta/ /byang chub shing dang n+ya gro dhwa skyo/ /lam gha rgo ni gom pa dang / /phyin dang byas dang lhung dang rkyal/ /la la na ni bud med dang / /lce dang rtsa yi khyad par la/ /lakṣan thumatshan ma gtso bo la/ /khāñtsa rna ni ming mtshan ma/ /le kha ṣpe she— yi ger dgod/ /tshod dang / gro ba dag la ni/ /shu dag bram ze tshig ngan no/ /ba pa dzwa ni mgo zlum gnas/ /ba ma lda shyini/ sgyugs dbyibs/ slong / /brdza rna ni gtong dang 'tshe/ /120—1478

brdza rna ni nags rmye tshal dang / /'tsho ba dang ni shing bal rgyun/ /brtan ni/rtogs—/ /bsdus nyid/ /brta nā ni lam la'o/ /baṇin ri mo byed pa dang / /tshangs par spyod dang yi ge pa'o/ /baṭwān lus dang shin tu mdzes/ /tshad ma rnam pa dag la'o/ /bāgrin tshig bdag snam bu la/ /bā dzin rta dang /mkha' 'gro mda'/ /bā ma na ni/ khyab 'jug dbye/ /oṃ ko ṭha dang yā bye dang / /mi'u thung dang phyogs kyi glang / /rnam par rul dang mi g.yo dang / /snyegs dang rgas dang 'khogs la yang / /bisbyinda ni yang dag thob/ /rnam dbye dang ni 'khyog ⑤po la/ /bi dzñā āoṃ ni las dang shes/ /bi tā dzee ni gtong ba dal//gyen mig bla re mchod sbyin las/ /tshigs bcad dbye dang / skad cig dang / /skabs dang 'khrug pa dag la'o/ /bi banda ni lag 'gro dang / /pi paṅga ta zhig pa la/ /bi ma na ni nam mkha'i thog /sa bdun dang ni shing la yang bee lagha / ni lus dbus dang / /kun tu chags dang dus sbyor la/ /bi ṣa sna ni/shi rī ṣa/ /gu ḍū tsi da/ dur byid zul/ /thra dzi rna ni/ rnyog pa dang / /'khyog po dang ni skra la'o/ /thra ṣan/ rna ba lha'i dbang phyug /ba da 8 ni shes pa seng / /beeṣṭa nang ni/ rna ba dang / /shadku lbo dang gtsug tor dang / /cod pan dang ni/ bkrid pa la/ /byañdza dzwa ni tshod ma dang / /sma ra dang ni mtshan rtags dang / /yan lag can la sogs pa dang / /rang dbang du ni byas pa la/ /o dzñā rna ni 'gog spyod la/ /bya sa 8 ni mi dge sdig /btung ba dang ni ri dwags sogs/ /lha yi mi 'dod 'bras bu dang / /nus pa rgud pa 'bras med la/ /sha ku rgo ni bkra shis dang / /'dod pa dang ni rgyu mtshan la/ /sha ku na ni bya la'o/ /sha ku ni ni mkha' 'gro dang / /stobs bzang bu dang 120—1479

byed pa'i dbye/ /shaṃ khi dī ni dung gi tshogs/ /sprul lkudang bud med rab dbye dang / dkar dang tso ra'i me tog la/ /sha taspyo mtshon cha'i dbye/ /ka rañdza dang sdig pa la/ /sha ma sha ni gshin rje dang / /mdzes pa dang ni gsod byed la//shi ma rna yang de ltar 'dod/ /sha ma rna ni/ mal tsam dang / /gnyid dang rab dga' dag la yang / /sha khin shing dang rig byed dang / /tu ru dang skye bo la/ /sha sa rgo ni bstan bcos dka'/ /rgyal pos byin dang chen po dang / /bstan pa dang ni yi ge la/ /shi khin rgyal mtshan gza' dang me/ /rma bya dang ni bya gag mda'/ /glang dang ba ka /ljon shing dang / /gtsug phud ldan pa rnams la'o/ /shilpi na/ shing bzo ba la'o/ /shilpi ni ni sna can ma'o/ /shraṅgin / klu dang khyu mchog dang / /ri bo shing dang mdzes pa dang / /rnal 'byor dbye ba rnams la'o/ /shri gha na ni bde gshegs dang / /dge slong la'o shrī gha ni / /zho dang nirda dag la'o/ /byeṣṭha ghandi/ malli kā/ /g.yo ldan dang ni dbu ba skyes/ /shā sa na ni rlung dang dbugs/ /myos byed shing la'o sadzdza na/ /legs pa'o sadzdza nā ni rtog /sadzdza āoṃ ni gel pa byed/ /sa da āoṃ ni rta ra chu/ /lus dang khang pa btung ba khyim/ /saddhā na ni rgyud dang rigs/ /pha dang lha yi shing la'o/ /saṃ jo āoṃ ni mngon skye dang / /yang dag byed pa la yang ngo / /sarnyi ni ni lus dang mdzes/ /dus dang ba bzhon thudag la dran/ /sa ma ni ni mngon 'gro min/ /sa ma de ka dang mtshungs pa la/ /sadzanda ni phun tshogs dang / /ldan pa dang ni bsgrubs pa la/ /saṃ byā āoṃ ni bla gos khebs/ /saṃ 5ba rna ni mchod pa dang / /zla ba nges par 'joms la 'dod/ /sā dī 6na shing rta/ rta can/ /gding ba la yang de bzhin no/ /sā dha ṣpe ni mjug 3ma 120—1 480

dang / /zla skyes/ tshar zin shin tu grub/ /byed dang nye bar byed pa dang / /shi ba'i 'du byed gsod pa dang / /'gro byed kyi tshotshangs pa dang / /thabs dang sbyin du 'jug dang nags/ /sā dhwa 2na ni mchod sbyin dang / /las kyi mtha' dang mchod sbyin byed/ /rab sems khrims lugs mtshams dang zhing / /bum pa dang ni gnas la'o/ /sru tsa na ni/ tshul dṛṣka1/ /dri dang /bsnun pa la yang ngo / /se tsa rna ni/ khrus gzhong dang / /khrus dang 'gyur ba dag la yang / /se nā mbi ni dmag dpon dang / /'dam bu skyes la'o se tsa dzā4 //khrus byed pa dang / bstan 5pa la/ /saṃ sthā sum̐ ni dbyibs dang ni6/ /khyim dang shing dang / bzhi mdo la/ /sta na rgo ni 'brug sgra dang / /sgra tsam dang ni shaṃ chi 7na'o/ /sthā pa rgo ni 8nags tshal dang / /ting nge 'dzin dang gtad pa la/ /sparsha rna ni reg dang bu/ /sanda rna ni 'dzag dang chu/ /ti ni pa dang shing rta la/ /swa min khyab bdag sa ga'o/ /ta lin/ zhing rmod pa dang stobs/ /ha sa ni ni sol ba dang / /so ba'o/ /ha sa rgo dgod pa/ /haste ni ni gtso mo yi / /dbye ba glang po'i chung ma la/ /hā ya na ni lo tshigs dang / /'bru yi dbye ba'i don dag la/ /hiṇḍa rgo ni rab dga' rtse/ /hā di rgo ni rdo rje glog /a tharba ni tsusrid bsrung dang / /bram ze'i bye brag dag la'o/ /a byeṣṭha na mthu dang grong / /lhag par gnas dang 'khor lo la/ /a nu tsa na dul ba dang / /'grogs dang rig byed mkhas pa dang / /rtse mo gug dang pho nyid la'ang / a nā sa rna bstan pa dang / /gos gshar 1 ba dang nye ba'i stan/ /a bā tsi rna go zlog dang / /lho dang phyogs ngos skye nges la/ /a bhi dze na rigs su grags/ / 1kyi rgyal mtshan dag la'o/ /a bhe brja mngon par sgrub/ /mngon par sod dang 120—1481

zos dang rgud/ /lto dang rang gis byas pa la/ /a bhi mā na skyes bu'i snyems/ /shes dang / pra ṇa ya dang 'tshe/ /'gro byed nyi ma nyi ma'i zas pha mes rnams kyi lha la'o/ /a ba dā ni/ las de dag3 /de lta bu byung rtogs brjod dum/ /lus dbugs dang ni kun sbyor dang / /kun nas sbyor 2ba mngon par brjod/ /ā ka la ni som nyi dang / /yongs su bgrang dang rnam par 'ching / /ātstsha da rgo kha chod dang / /gos dang / sgrib par byed pa la/ /ā ta rgo ni so sor gnas/ /rgyug par byed dang bgrod par 'dod/ /ātpa yon ni rnam spro byed/ /yid las byung ba mngon par brjod/ /ā ba sha rgo/bzo khang dang / /'byung po'i gnas dang rab 'jug pa/ /ā yo dha no 'khrug dang gsod/ /'thab par byed pa la 'dod do/ /ā ra dha rna mchod pa dang / /'tshed dang 'thab pa dag la yang / /a skanda ni mi mngon dang / /kun nas skems dang sgra la'o/ /utpa ta rgo kun nas skye/ /'byung dang gyen du bgrod pa la / /utpa da ni kun nas bris/ /legs par 'jug dang / 'byung don can / /u da ya na zhes bya ba/ /patpa'i rgyal dang bum pa skyes/ /u da brta rna kun skyes dang / /rnam par 'jug dang rnam par bris/ /ubye ha ni/jeg 4pa dang/ /gyen du 'dren 5dang dī sī tya/ /u pa dhwa āoṃ/ gaṇḍa'i tog /khyad par dang ni pra ṇa ya/ /u bā sa rna/ 'da' goms dang / /nyan par 'dod dang 'tshe ba la/ /kazhu ki ni legs 'dul skyes/ /sbrul dang dmar ser 'gro byed la/ /ka rpā ta ni 5shi rī ṣa/ /ā mra dang ni khyad par gnas/ /garja bhaṇḍa'i shing rnams la'o/ /ka la dhwa ni/ ca co sgrogs/ /phug ron ṣpe tso rma bya'o / /ka la sen ni/ bya dang shing / /'brug sgra'i rjes su sgeg pa la/ /120— 1482

kā tyā ya na mchog sred dang / /dkar mo kā tya'i tūbu mo dang / /rgan po'i rnam pa ngur smrig ñtshagos/ /ku tsanda rna/ tsandan dmar/ /'dab ma ri lus dang shing dbye la/ /kuṇḍa lidma chu lha nyid/ /rma bya ri dwags sbrul rna rgyan/ /bum pa skyes ni ri byi dang / /srid sgrub dang ni phur bu la/ /ke sha ran ni/seng ge/ klu/ /nā ga ge sar rta rnams la/ /kroñtsa da āoṃ/ sgozhu lbo/ /byusgo ta ka padma'i rtsa/ /kha kā ma nī nges brtan dang / /spyod byed ma dang bud med gzhon / /khaṅga dhe nu bu mo'i gri/ /de bzhin sdong po can la'o/ /go 1da yiṅga smra byed dang / /'dod dang 'dod ldan rnams la'o/ /ga bā da rgo chu lha'i dbang / /lus ldan dbyangs kyi rten la'o/ /gha nā gha na/ char sprin dang / /brgya byin dang ni glang po myos/ /gho ṣa yibyu zhes bya ba/ /ṣpe tso dang ni rībram ze la—/ /tsi tra bhā nu bya dang me/ /tso la kin ni zha nye dang / /lo ba ba lang gi/dang ni kibyu'i tshigs/ /dza khā ṭa na 'jug pa dang / /kre ka /kai ka khrag gi rgyun—/ /dza la ṭa ni chu 'khor la/ /dza khā ṭa ni chu byeganas la/ /na la mbi na nya'i bye brag /idzi ka dang byis pa gsod/ /ta pa sri ni dka' thub can/ /dka' thub dang ni rjes su rtse/ /ta bo dha na dka' thub la/ /snag can tsha ba skye ba la/ /ta bo dha na mgo zlum ma/ /nang ma khyim dang dpa' ba la/ /durpā mambi 'dam kyi ni/ /nya phyis dang ni 'brum sran no/ /de ba se ni 'ulha yi dmag/gnas dang rtogs pa dag la'o/ /dī dzadma na/ so/ bya bram ze/ /glang po thob / klu shing klu/ /ni dhū ba rgo/ bskyod dang dga'/ /gsod dang mthar byed nags tshal la/ /nirpā sa ni gnas med dang / /'tshe dang 'go ba'i gnas la'o/ /nirghatpa ni klungan byed dang / /a lakta ka zhes pa la/ /120—1483

niryā ta rgo sbyin pa dang / /bkod dang gtong dang sgra dag la/ /ni ba ma ni/thos dang mthong / /na shā ma ni/ lta dang mthong / /pa ya swa ni ba bzhon dang / /mun can ma dang sprin la'o/ /ba ri dzran ni mchod sbyin can/ /mchod sbyin las dang yongs byed la/ /pu ju dza na srin po dang / /ljon shing sā lā sha dang rgo/ /srung dang skyes mchog bya rnams la/ /thra tha ljan rmongs dang dman / /pra dza na ni skye gnas dang / /skye ba dang ni rab 'gro la/ /pa ṇi dhwa rgo rab 'bad dang / /rab tu 'jug dang mnyam gzhag la/ /pra ti mā rgo gzugs brnyan dang / /ngag glang po'i mche ba'i bar la'o/ /pra ti panda dam bca' dang / /rnam par shes dang zhugs pa'o/ /pra ti yatna 'du byed dang / /so sor 'dzin dang 'dod pa'o/ /pra tya thin ni brjod bya'i rtags/ /gnyis gnyis so sor smra ba'o/ /pra yo dza rgo/ dgos pa rgyu/ /pra ba tsa ni bzang po dang / /rang bzhin brjod pa la yang ngo / /pra sgo tra rgo/ nyi ma dang / /rab tu kha bye bsnun pa la/ /pra sā dha mbi grub pa dang / /ka ka ti kā zhes pa la/ /pra sā dha ni/ 'bebs pa la/ /pra ha sa rna 'joms 7pa dang / /rab tu bzhad dang kun bskyod la/ /pha la kin ni 'bras bu can/ /illi shi zhes bya ba la / /bsgo mā na 'dam bu dang / /nyams pa med dang e raṇḍa/ /dri ba'i bye brag rnams la'o/ /bā ḍa 2gidngha sdang ba dang / /lam dang lo mas 'tsho ba dang //rta yi khyad par rnams la'o/ /bā rā sha rna 'gro 'joms dang / /mdung dang sgo skyong dag la'o/ /bhū tadma —na ni tshangs pa dang / /gang zag ma da yiṅga ni/ /chang dang / sī dhu'i btung ba la/ /ma dha dha rghaṃ/ bdud rtsi che/ /gos bzang dang ni se hla'o/ /ma hā mu ni ri byi dang / /dpal yon dang ni ri byi'i 720—1484

bu—/ /ma hā se na sa ga dang / /dmag dpon chen po dag la'o/ /mā tu lā byā bhāṅgā dang / /cha shas grabagrod dang zhang po la/ /mā lu dhwa na ka sbrul khra bo/ /padma chen po dag la'o/ /mā lu dhwa bhā 'khri shing dbye/ /yid gzhungs can dang yid gzhungs ldanatso/ /me dha po nī bram ze mo/ /ra sā ya na mkha' lding la/ /ra sā ya ni ru ra dang / /nad 'phrog dug dang phyi dong lceka /rā dza da ni bdag 'dzin shing / /'o ma can dang rka shu ka /la lā ma dang la khā man/ /rtags thumatshan nyams dga' rgyan dang ni/ /rwa dang gtso bo mjug ma dang / /mthu dang rgyal mtshan rta rnams la/ /lo ga linda/ puṇḍa'i shing / /'bi ta sha'i 5dang gshol mtshon no/ /ba nartse ni ce spyang dang / /dzambu ka dang stag dang ni/ /dred thudang byi la rnams la'o/ /bi ro tsa na nyi ma me/ /zla ba rab bde / dga' ba la/ /bi ṣa yin ni dbang po dang / /yul can yid las skyes dang sreg /yul las skyes dang mi yi bdag /'bar ba dang ni rang dbang can/ /bi ṣā ṇi ni rwa can 'jig /bi le pa nī ta rā lā/ /la sadha dang tsā ga nā/ /bi la sen ni gdengs 3can dang / /dug sbrul dag la blta — bar bya/ /bai 9 shwakle nā mi nyams la/ /bi shwakle nā/ 'bras ldan shing / /bee ba rdza na yongs su gtong / /sbyin dang / mngags dang gsod pa la/ /bismra sa ni dri za'i grong / /bu ga can dang dran pa la/ /bi ha na ni 'joms pa dang / /biñdza na dang shing bal bskyod/ /bi he ṭha ni tshe'atshe dang 'joms/ /dṛkṣu da dī shing skyes dang / /rnam par 'joms dang dri dag la/ /bṛkṣu 11da ram̐ sbrang yab dang / /dgra sta dang ni a shwattha/ /bai ro tsa na/ bde gshegs kyi/ /bye brag nyi ma stobs ldan bu/ /bya bā yin ni 'dod ldan dang / /rdzas kyi dbye ba rjod 120/de1485

par byed/ /shi khaṇḍi na ni mda'i bye brag /'jigs med sgra dzodang rma bya tshogs//shi khaṇḍi nā/ guñdza dang / /khyu dang yal ga dag la'o/ /shi kha rin ni ri rtse dang / /sdeb sbyor a bā mārga'i shing / /shriṅgā rin ni/ dkris bzang dang / /'dod pa can dang glang po che/ /bye ṣa gha nā/ mallī dang / /ka ta tī dang ti kta'i bcud/ /sa dā da na/ glang chen dkar/ ha la gnas dang spos kyi glang / /sa nā ta na 'phrog byed dang / /khyab 'jug pha mes 'gron po/ brtan/ /rtag pa'o/ sa ma 4pa.oṃ ni/ /gsad 5pa thob pa rul ba rdzogs/ /sa mā sa rna yang dag thob/ /yongs su gcod dang mnyam gzhag gzung / /sā ma dā rna mthun pa dang / /'dzin dang rtag pa'i las la'o/ /sa muttha āoṃ nad langs dang / /kun 'gog /sa mutstsha āoṃ ni/ /mngon khyab yang dag 'dod dang rmongs / /saspra ha rgo/ khur la sogs/ /'dren dang yan lag nyed pa la/ /sasba da dzā 6lta ba dang / /bslu dang dbang du byed pa la/ /sa ro dzi dī padma can/ /mtsho las skyes dang mtsho mchog la/ /sā ma yo ni ting nge 'dzin/ /glang po che dang mchog gnas la/ /sa mā bye ni nges brjod dang / /sbyin sreg byed pa'i shing grangs la/ /sā ra sa dzā 7gser la'o/ /ta nu tri rgo grang skyob la/ /su ka rman ni rnal 'byor dbye/ /zas bzang lha yi bzo bo la/ /su darsha ni/ lha grong dang / /khyab 'jug gi ni 'khor lo la/ /su darṣa hūṃ nā bka' dang ni/ /lhun po'i dzasthā sman gyi 9dbye/ /mig gi dga' bar byed pa la/ /sru dā mimbi/sprin dang ri/ /su dha na na ni/ brtan pa dang / /gzhu can sna tshogs las la'o / /su barban ni skabs gsum dang / /'od ma 'da' dang du ba tshigs/ /su yā mu na khyab 'jug dang / /nad dang batpa'i rgyal po dang / /blo bzang skyes 120/de1 /86

pa rnams la'o/ /sau rā ma ni glog dbye dang / /rnam gsal chu skyes khyad par la/ /saṃ ya ma mbi gshin rje'i grong / /brtul zhugs dang ni yang dag sdom/ /sta na yidku sprin dang ni/ /'brug sgra shi dang dbyug pa la/ /harṣa yidku 1pu dang gser//a gra dzadma na tshangs pa dang / /spun zla'i mthu bo bram ze dang / /gsod dang /sbyin dang gtong ba la/ /a nu pā san zhes pa/ /snum pa'i las dang bdug pa la / /anda ༄ sna bā shin/ gtum po dang / /slob ma nye gnas dag la'o/ /a pa brdza ni zhes pa/ /yongs su gtong dang mya ngan 'das/ /bi shā ṇa na zhes pa la / /a ba sardza āoṃ zhes pa/ /sbyin dang yongs su 'dor ba la/ /a bhi niṣṭa na yi ge/ /rnam par gtod pa dag la'o/ /u pa sparla rna/ reg pa dang / /khrus dang zhal bsil la yang ngo / /u pa sasparghaṃ ni byas/ /legs par 'dus byas pa la'o/ /kā ma tsa ri na tsa ṭa ka /'dod ldan dang ni rang 'dod la/ /kā ranta mi 'khar ༄ snab mkhan/ /gser 'gyur mkhan la 'ang blta bar bya/ /kidku barban 'od ma dang / /dar gyi srin bu dang ni me/ /kriṇḍa thu baṭwān bsreg za dang / /kun spyod ngan dang / sgra gcan la/ /kha ra bhā dza sna zhes pa/ /'jam dang 'khar rgya ba solla dang / /'jug pa la'o de nas ni/ /ganta mā dha na ra'i dbye/ /bung ba dang ni dri ldan ma/ /garnya mā da dī/ ni chang / /'khri shing ri dwags dbye ba la/ /tsa kra tsā rin byis pa dang / /nor can/ grong gi dra ba can/ /tsi ra dzī bin/ tshe ring dang / /khyab 'jug dang ni lhan cig skyes bu / /tikta parban gu ḍū tshig/ /shing mang ra hi la mo :'a/ /dhū ma ke ta na yi sgra/ /me dang du ba mjug rings la/ /padma lāñtsa na nyi ma/ /'jig rten dbang phyug nor sbyin tshangs/ /padma lāñtsa na sgol ma/ /dbyangs can ma dang 120—1487

padma ma/ /sī da tsandan rna zhes pa/ /nag mo can dang yung ba la/ /thraṣṭha shriṅgin / garbha dang / /'jigs bcu pa dang ce spyang lto/ /pra tsa khā kin/lam 'gro dang / /'brug sgra'i rjes su sgeg rmyepa la/ /pra ti pā da ni sbyin pa/ /khro dang go bar byed pa la/ /ba na mā lin sgra 'greng pa/ /ba na mā li ni phag mo/ /ba brte bee 'bras bu 2ldan/ /bud med rin chen mtshon byed ma/ /sred pa dang ni yung ba la/ /bar tsanda dzwa lha'i shing / /nag mo can la'ang blta bar bya/ /byo ma tsā rin mkha' 'gro dang / /lha dang rig pa 'dzin pa la/ /ma dru sru da na phag mo/ /spu 'chad par ni rnam shes bya/ /ma hā ra dza rna zhes pa/ /bum pa dang ni bum brgya pa/ /mri 5sgo prañtsan dpal 'bras/ /kā ko la dang / gzig gos can/ /bigyu 4kā rin 'jigs mthong dang / /rnam par 'joms par byed pa la/ /bi shwa karman lha bzo dang / /mārtaṇḍa dang thub pa'i dbye/ /thra ṣā sarban 'phrog byed dang / /lha min/ sgeg ldan gro ma'o/ /sha ku lā da mbi zhes pa / /sha can chu yi bispa li/ /ghizhu dzee dang / tshangs pa 5can/ /shā 6lo kṣa ya na yi sgra/ /rdo yi dbye ba dga' byed la/ /she 7pa ki rta na 'dod ldan/ /byeṅgi ri ti padmā'o8/ /shwe ta bā ha na srid sgrub/ /bdud rtsi spyor bar byed pa la//shweta bān /na bdud rtsi spyor/ /rgya mtsho'i dbu ba sprin gyi snying / /ṣaṣṭha hā ya na zhes pa/ /'bras kyi dbye ba sentu ra/ /saṃ pra yo gin cha yis rtse/ /'dod ldan dang ni 9rab sbyor la/ /ha ri tsandan ni ba mchog /lha yi shing dang 'od ldan ma/ /gur gum padma rā —ga la'o/ /ha ri bā ha na zhes pa/ /nyin mor byed dang sprin gyi bzhonanyu / /addhā ba shā yin khyi 'tshod/ /nā bi te dang thub pa'i dbye/ /kā lā nu mā din zhes pa/ /ka la bo ka ro ladza/ /ka bañdzi la 120—/7 88

rnams la'o/ /dzā yā nu dzī bi na zhes pa/ /rgyas dang ngan 'gro 'dul dang che / /saha sra bee bye na zhes pa/ /dga' byed 'joms dang ro sgyur shing / /na mtha'i sde rdzogs so / / sna7pa ni rlung ngo ku 2dag byed/ /pā ni btung ba skyong byed la/ /kalpa tshangs pa'i nyin zhag dang / /rigs pa/ 'jigs pa/ bstan bcos sgrub/ /kyu pa chu yi dngo dang ni/ /shi ba byi dor byed pa'i khung / /kṛ pā rtse ba zhes bshad do/ /kṛ pa rgyas pa de'i yang ni/ /bhā ra tā'i skyes bu la/ /khatpa stobs kyi byed pa dang / /khro ba la yang grags pa yin/ /go ba lcug ma ba lang gnas/ /grong la sogs pa'i bdag po yang 1/ /go bī sa skyong sa 'dzin dang / /srung ba pa dang snying po can/ /chu pa reg dang kṣu pa dang / /g.yul 'gyed pa dang rlung dmar la/ /tadzee chung ma mal dang ni/ /dgra khang la'o tā pa ni/ /kun tu gdung dang da ba thu/ /tā bī chu yi khyad par la/ /tra pā ngo tsha rig 4la'o/ /tra pu zha nye mtshon dag la/ /darngu thung rgyal dregs pa dang / /ri dwags myos pa la yang ngo / /dī pa rtul dang tshogs la 'gyur/ /pañtsa sngel sngon gzhu dag la/ /pu྾ ④me tog bud med rdul/ /rgyas dang kha bye ba la'o/ /rū paṃ rnam pa mdzes rang bzhin/ /tshigs su bcad dang nā na ka /gar mkhan sogs dad ri dwags mdung / /spyod pa phyugs dang sgra la'o/ /re ba snod dang 'khrug pa la/ /ro pa mda' dang 'dogs pa la/ /le pa byug dang bdud rtsi la/ /dze ma na'o/ /pa bā ni/ /bu ga dang ni tshem bu la/ /patpa 8/mig chu rlangs pa la/ /shatpa rtsa gzhon so sor zas/ /shā pa mna' dang spyo ba la/ /sru pa byed pa mchod ma'i 720—1489

dbye / /swā ba nyal dang mi shes nyid/ /reg pa mi shes don can no/ /kṣi pa thogs pa rnam par 'god/ /ku re 'phen dang 'dzin pa la/ /byug dang snyoms pa la yang ngo / /arṇa pa ṇi/ mee ri bha/ /chu rnams yang dag 'khrug pa la/ /ā kalpa ni khyem tsam dang / /rtog par byed pa la yang ngo / /ā bā ba ni 'dod dang smin/ /yongs 'dor a la/ bā la'o/ /a kṣe pa ni smod dang gtong / /'gugs dang snyan dngags tshosnargyan la'o/ /a che ② pa ni zla ba gos / /u la pa ni / rtsa'i dbye ba/ /a la paṃ ni gel par 'dod/ /katstsha ba ni ru sbal dang //gyad kyi 'ching ba'i khyad par la/ /katstsha bī ni/ ru sbal mo/ /phra mo'i nad kyi dbye ba dang / /shing shun dbye ba dag la'o/ /ka lā pa ni tshogs rma bya/ /gser dang tu bhā ra dang / zas/ /gos dang ka si sru ra dang / /kau ④nyi gnyis ka dag la'o/ /kā shya rpā ni sa dang nya/ /kṣa shyi pa ni/ thub pa'i dbye/ /ku ṭa ba ni nga rgyal dbye/ /nidku ṭa dang thub pa la/ /badhī miri kā la yang ngo / /ku ṇa pa ni ro rul dri/ /ku ta pa ni tsha mo dang / /nyi ma'i brgyad cha⑥ / tshad pa ra/ /la ba ku sha rol mo la'o/ /dzi hā pa ni khyi byi la/ /stag dang khra bo dag la'o/ /bā da pa shing / thra rkang / lham/ /bā khyetā ba ni gzi brjid/rdul / /rakta ba ni mtshan mo rgyu/ /rakta bā ni padma dang / /rnam rtog 'khrul dang phyogs rnams la/ /bi ṭa pa ni khri shing sdong / /ṣilda rgya chen lcug ma'o/ /a pa lā ba ngan smras dang / /yid gcugs du sel ba dag la'o/ /a bhi byu pa rtogs bya dang / /dga' dang rab thob gzugs la'o/ /a ba le ba skyon dang stoms—/ /byug pa yang dag 'gro ba la/ /u pa tā ba smra nyer gdung / /myur ba'i don can du 'dod do/ /u pa dza ma khyad par dang / /dbye dang rnam par 120—1490

'joms pa la/ /dza la ku bī sprung bu dang / /khron pa'i snying po dag la'o/ /nā ga /putpa/ klu shing dang / /nā ga ge sar tsaspa ka /pa ri kadza 'jigs pa dang / /yongs su 'gul dang rab bskyod la/ /pa rī bā pa chu gnas dang / /yongs su thob dang kun tu 'gebs/ /beeṇḍa putpa mya ngan med/ /dza ba'i me tog 'dam skyes la/ /ba hu byu pa dran pa dang / /rdo rje rang byung mda' tshogs/bskyod / /me gha pubee/ lhang tsher gong / /chu dang chu la skyes pa la/ /bi bra lā ba 'gal brjod dang / /don dang bral ba'i tshig ga la/ /ba husnadza pubee myos byed dang / /de bzhin ma ru ba ka la'o/ /bri lduka dhū pa shing ser dang / /bcos ma'i bdug ⑦pa dag la'o/ /z-i rnguṣā ka'i lha chen po/ /'bar byed nag po dag la'o/ /he ma putpa mya ngan med/ /dza ba'i me tog tsadza ka /tsa ma ra putpa ni gsal/ /tsū ta dang ni ke ka'o/ /pa mtha'i rngusde'o// //phu ni sngags dang phe ni sgra/ /grangs med spra ni rgan dang 'phel/ /spa ni/ghañdza'i rlung dang khyab/ /sgu ni sgung byed balgu'i dngos/ /gumyu dpung pa'i rgyan dang / tshig /lugs dang brjod pa dag la'o/ /re pha ra yig smod pa brjod//ba phe ba lang sogs rmig pa/ /ljon shing sogs kyi sgra la'o/ /shing ṭwā ral pa chu klung dang / /sha can dang ni ma ma la'o/ /pha mtha'i sde'o// //ba ni chu lha nyer mjal rdzas/ /kambi/ kha dzā kā dang ni/ /'od ma'i cha'o shaṃ bu ni/ /glang po gdu bu dung / dung phran/ /mgrin pa dang ni sbubs can la'o/ /bā ⑥rā gzugs thung / grangs bye brag /tsāṭī mdzes dang blo 120—1491

dag la/ /mbu 1ri dang chu klung dang / /gling dang shing 2gi dbye ba la/ /ḍimbi ca co 'jigs pa dang / /glo ba mchin pa/ rnam 'gro dang / /e raṇḍa la'o dbye ni/ /kha dzā kā dang 'bras bu la/ /dī shing ser/ yung ba dang / /lha shing / sa ldan/ sngon skyes la/ /pūṭwā sngon dang sngar rtse mo/ /tumbi tikta lasthā dpal/ /bilba gzugs can 'bras bu dang / /dkyil 'khor dang ni gzugs brnyan la/ /shasba 4dge dang yangs pa dang / /gtun shing rtse gnas lcags snying ldan/ /rdo rje rnams so stalba ni/ /rtswa dang gel pa shing rnams so/ /ka dadzee ni don grub dang / /ni ku rulba byā pa'o/ /sdong bu yal ga ka lasbyi/ /ka lambi ni sdong bu mda'/ /mbi sa la'o kā dalba/ /dang nga/'i tshogs dang mda' 'a/'o / /ga dzā hā glang po bibee 5lī/ /glang po 'gran dang glang po'i grong tsho/ /gaddhānd+ra ni/ ri dwags dbye/ /glu mkhan dang ni mkha' spyod dang / /srid pa bar ma'i sems can la/ khu byug — rta dang bcud len grub/ /lha yi glu mkhan rnams/ la'o/ /gu ḍūdza ni snying dang 'bras// /brinta dang ni ba lang zas/ /dī dzi hā ni sbrul phra mo/ /ka ṭi ra ka'o ni tadza/ /rtse mo phrag pa lus byed do/ /pra la ma ni/ 'phyang ba dang / /lha min tā la'i myu gu dang / /ya'/ ga la'o pā lcadza / /khyab 'jug dbye ba gsum rgyas dang / /'o ma 'dzin pa'o bhū dzambu/ /bi kai ka ta'i 'bras bu dang / /go ḍūlba la'o he ralba/ /ma he lto 'phyang dpa' dang snyems/ /dza ra dzamyu dzamyu 'byed/ /'bra go'i 'bras bu dag la'o/ /la la dzī —hā 'tshe ba dang / /rim nga/sa 'gro dang khyem la'o/ /sha ta barpā durpā dang / /ngan spang bu dang btsun mo la/ /go rakṣa 'bru dzamyu ni gro/ /de bzhin sa bsrungs 'bras la'o/ dhū lī ka dadza ni shing / /ti ni sha dang ka dasba/ /chu 720—/pa492

la'i shing la blta 1snabar bya/ /shri gā la dzamyu zhes pa/ /go chelba'o 'ga' zhig ni/ /rgya shug 3sna'abras bu zhes 'dod do/ /ba mtha'i snyesde tshan no// //bha ni 'dri chags pa dang ni/ /dkar dang rgyas pa'i don la yang / /bhā ni 'bar dang gnas tsam la/ /dzha ni skal 4ma dī ni 'jigs/ /bhū ni sa dang gnas tsam la/ /'byung bar byed pa rnams la'o/ /sgo lastertags ni bod pa mi zad pa'o/ /kumbha bum pa khyem gyi dbye/ /bi ṭa glang po'i mgo'i yan lag /bum rna can gyi bu la yang / /kusbyi 5skya nar chu'i 'dab ma/ /bi ṭha ra ka ta 'bras bu'o/ /kurghaṃ gu gul shing dur byid/ /garbha/ mngal dang byis pa dang //nag phyogs tsher can/ pa nas/ /dzambha/ so dang / sgyur rtsi dang / /lha min dbye dang za ba la/ /j-isgo/ kha gdangs kha bya glal/ /ḍasdi6/ bā li sha dang byis/ /dambha tog can shing shun la/ /dṛsnru sbrul dang bdag po la/ /nā bhe/ /rgyu skar 'khor lo sgyur/ /gtso bo 'khor lo'i mtha' dang ni/ /srog chags yan lag myos pa la/ /ni bha 'dra ba zol la'o/ /rambha 'od ma'i dbyug pa la/ /rambha 7chu shing chu skyes ma/ /bi ju sum rtsen dbang khyab bdag /shasgru dbang phyug tshangs pa dang / /mchod 'os dang ni skra can ma/ /shu bha grub pa shu rbha bde/ /sho bha mdzes dang grib ma la/ /sa bha/ mdun/ pa/ ba lang gnas/ /rgyan po 'gyed pa rta rag go/ /stambha bems po/ ka ba la/ /sa bhū khyab 'jug tshangs pa la/ /a shu bha ni 'chi ltas sdig /mi 'dod/ me bzang / sdig can no/ /ādmā 8bhū ni/ 'dod lha tshangs/ /a rambha ni/skyed tshal dang / /dregs dang myur dang gsod pa la/ /ṛ ṣa bha ni/ khyu 120—1193

mchog gtso bo1/ /sde tshan brgyad dang sman bye brag /dbyangs kyi khyad par phag pa'i 'jug /bu ga rna ba dag la'o/ /ṛṣa bhā mi yi rnam pa/ /bud med rnam mang btsun mo dang / /rtse mo/ byi la mchog gnas gtso/ /ka ku pa ni srid sgrub shing / /'dod chags dbye ba rab bsten dang / /phyogs mdzes bstan bcos la ba dang / /tsadza ka yi phreng ba la'o/ /ka ra bhi ni — 7'khrig ma dang / /mje'u chung cha dang rim pas 'gro /rkang pa brgyad pa sha ra bha / /ri dwags bye brag dag la'o/ /ku sumbha ni/ gser tshos/ chen/ /ril ba spyi blugs / garda bha/ /bong bu/ dri yi dbye ba dang / /ki barṇa dang kai ra ba/ /garda ddhā ni nad nyung dang / /skye ba'i khyad par dag la'o/ /dund+ra bhe ni rnga bo che /sbyin skyes dbang pos thig le la/ /durma bha ni rnyed dka' dang / /yid gcugs/khye rngo/ nad can la/ /ni kusmra ceni so ldan ma/ /bum rna can gyi bur yang dran / /palla bha ni rig ldan dang / /brtse ba can dang dbang po la/ /barṣa bhū ni slar skye dang / /kañtsi li dang sbal pa la/ /biṣkambha ni spyor ba'i dbye/ /rgya khyon so sor bcings pa dang / /gzugs can yan lag so sor 'bad/ /'ching ba'i dbye dang rnal 'byor can/ /biṣṭambha ni so sor 'ching / /rnam 'phel ba dang rnam par 'phel/ /bi srambha ni rol pa can/ /'thab mo dbugs 'byin 'dren dang gsod/ /thra 3ṣa bha ni/ khyu mchog dang / /dkar po khu ba/skyes mchog la'ang / /bee dharbha 9ni ngag 'khyog po/ /nyid dang mtshams pa'i khyad par 3la/ /sha ra bha ni/ seng ge'i dbye/ /rkang pa brgyad pa ka ra bha/ /sa nā bhi ni rang skye mtshungs/ /su ra dha ni tsadza ka /khra bo dpyid dang dri ldan la//gser dang dzā ti khyapha la dang / /yid 'ong dri bzangs dag la'o/ /sha ra 120—1497/

bhi ni shalla ki/ /ma mo'i dbye ba dag la'o/ /a nubyu bha mda' dang ni/ /sdeb sbyor rab dbye dag la dran/ /a baṣṭambha gser dang ni/ /rab rtsom dka' ba dag la yang / /shā ta kurghaṃ gser la ste/ /shā ta kumbha rta gsod pa'o / /bha mtha'i sde tshan lkuno// //ma ni zhi ba mā zla ba/ /sgra gcan dang ni ma mo dang / /dga' dang nga rgyal 'ching ba dang / /dgag pa la ste mi zad pa'o/ /me dang mo zhes pa'ang /don de'o/ /ā ma nad dang de dbye phyogs/ /iṣā 'dod dang / dpyid la'o/ /u mā go rī dang ni ser/ /mdzes dang grags dang dga' ba la/ /u ma grong dang byed pa la/ /urmi rlabs dang dba' klong snyedang / /'jug pa dang ni gsal ba la/ /gos khums pa dang rtsig pa dang / /mgrin pa bteg dang bcir ba la/ /kā ma dran pa grib ma la/ /ka oṃ 'dod bya dga' nges 'dod/ /ā ma rjes su 'dod pa la/ /kā mbi 'dod dang bud med btsun/ /kā mi 4 'dod can skyes bur 'gyur/ /sarba nā ma'i kai phyezhes pa/ /rnam par rtog dang dri ba dang / /'dor dang smod dang rnam pa la/ /ki mi gser dang bu mo dang / /phreng ba ā bhā hphukhā la'o/ / kri srin bu 3tī ṭa dang / /rgya skyegs dang ni srin bu'i dbang / /gnyis ma nub pa rim pa dang / /g.yo ba dang ni 'gul ba la/ /kharma zer na'i byerab dbye la/ /ga ma a nā lo tsi ta/ /lam dang rgyan 'gyed khyad par la/ /gusma sdong po tsa rū ni/ /bsrung dang dmag sde mchin nad dbyespu//gullī ā ma la kya dang / /yol ba dang ni gos kyi khyim/ /zwa ⑫ma dbyangs dang 'dug gnas dang / /tshogs dang sgra sogs snga ma can/ /gharma tshad gdung sos 120—1495

ka dang / /drod dang rngul gye chu la'o/ /dzābee sā ma ra dang 'khrus/ /yang dag lta bar byed pa mo1/ /dzi hma gya gyu ta ga ra/ / rgyaspos/ dal ba dang ni 'khor lo'o / /yung ba dang ni ljang gu la'ang / /tokla tospru / thos dri ma/ /da ma 'du byed/ dbyug pa dang / /dul dang zhal zhal la yang ngo / /dasma mi dang / chom rkun dang / /skye bo'i nga rgyal la yang dran/ /dru ma/ rkang 'thung yongs 'du dang / /mi 'am ci yi dbang phyug la/ /dharma 'tshe med bsod nams dang / /rigs pa mchod sbyin rang bzhin dang / /dpe dang /sdom dang kun spyod dang / /rigs byed mtha' dang gzhu rna ba 'byor/ /zhi ba'i btung ba sman bdag nyid/ /dri yi rtsa dang bsel ba dang / /'dul byed ming dang gzhan bstod la/ /na 4mi khron pa'i kha skor dang / /nyi ni sha shing 'khor lo'i mtha'/ /ṣpe ma dus dang mtshams dang dor/ /ra ba dang ni ṣpe ta ka'o / /padma padma'i tshogs dang ni/ /chu skyes bkod pa grangs bye brag /gter dang padma can klu'i dbye/ /padmā bhā shīr dang ni dpal/ /krātrī dbyangs can 'dam skyes gdong / /tshangs pa'i nus ma paspyo kā/ /zla ba'i lcug ma yal ga'i dbye/ /bhā ma khro ba sgra dang 'od/ /dī ma bde 'byung spyang ka 5lto/ /a mā be ta sa'i shing dang / /drag po dang ni 6'jigs rung la/ /dīṣṭha 'phrog byed shā ga byas/ /srin po dang ni 'jigs byed ma/ /bhū mi sa dang / gnas tsam la/ /rbha ma/ dmyal ba sa skyes la gza'/ /bhā ma 'khrul dang kund+ra dang / /zad dang chu yi nges 'gro la/ /ya ma gshin rje chos kyi rgyal/ /zung dang yang dag sdom dang khwa/ /mtshe ma skyes dang / lus dang sgrub/ /bltos pa med gang dag 8pa'i las/ /yā ma mtshon cha yang dag 'gog /yā mi srin 9mo bud 720/de/ /96

med rigs/ /yund+ra gzhu dang g.yul 'gyed 3pa/ /ra yā/ sbrang rtsi'i lha ma yin chung ma la/ /ra ma yid bsrubs mdzes pa dang / /sa skyes mya ngan med pa la / /rasmi 'od dang rta'i srab dang / /mig gi rma dag la'o/ /rā ma da ghra'i bu dang rgo/ /drang srong ya mang aghi dang / /shol 'dzin phyugs 2kyi dbye ba dang / /shin tu yid du 'ong rnams la'o/ /rā mā bud med dang shing kun/ /rā me gnas can ru rta'o/ /rusmi gser dang lcags la ste/ /ma swa tsal tsa ṇa ka re/ /ru mā mgrin bzang mdzes pa la/ /lasmi dpal dang phun tshogs la/ /padma thra 4yadku dang mdzes/ /ba mi nad can sgyugs pa la/ /nā ma g.yon dang 'phrog byed dang / /'dod dang sprin dang phra tī ba/ /bā oṃ gcod byed bā mā mdzes / /sha mi phye dang 'bras bu dang / /shimbha dang ni ngag mtshungs pa/ /shu྾ 5nyin mo'i bdag po la/ /shu྾ gzi brjod la 'dod do/ /shā ma ljang gu nag po dang / /rab spyor ba ṭa'i shing dang ni/ /sbal pa sprin dang byis pa rgan/ /byā mā kha dog ljang gu dang / /sngo bsangs tsā grwa li tsā gu li zer ba'i ma/chan bu snang dang ni / /rab tu 'gro min bud med dang / /zla ba'i 'khri 6shing sman dur byed/ /sī 7ri pa dang gudzā dang / /mtshan mo rams dang thra yadku'o/ /byā ma ma lan dza'i dbye ba dang / /na le shaṃ la'o/ shā ma ni/ /thub pa dus dang snga ma min/ /dal ba sel ba'o ma lā ni/ /'gugs dang 'dra dang / skye bo kun/ /sbo ma mtshams dang dus dang ni/ /zhing dang dbye ba gnas la'o/ /sra 1 ma mkha' dang 'o ma la/ /sra྾ 1chung ngu mngon par brjod/ /sri྾ phra dang nang dag la//srukṣu phra dang phyi mo la/ /so ma 'od dkar/ bu gar 'gro/ /pha mes dang ni lha dag la/ /sthā ma lha'i sman/ bri shing dang / /nor gyi dbye ba rlung spre'u/ /hi 120—1497

rma kha ba ba mo dang / / tsa na dzobasil dang 'khyags 2/pa la/ /ho mi dang ba dang ni mar/ /kṣa ma sa dang bzod pa la/ /kṣa ma bzod pa ldan pa la/ /kṣa ma zar ma phreng ba can/ /kṣe ma 'thob dang bsrung ba dang / /bkra shis dang ni chom rkun la/ /kṣe mā gtum po 'phrog byed la/ /kṣiṃ mi zar ma'i gos dang ni/ /du thi la yi ras la'o/ /a da ma ni smad dang dman/ /ā ga ma ni bstan bcos lung / /ā shra ma ni tshangs spyod sogs/ /thub pa'i gnas dang tshogs khang la/ /utta ma dang utta oṃ/ /mchog dang phul du byung ba'o/ /kā 4la ma ni sā li 'dzin/ /brko bya 'bras dang rgya skyegs bcud/ /ku su rma ni me tog 'bras / /dus su skyes dang mig nad la/ /kṛ tri oṃ ni lan tshwa dang / /sihla ka dang bcos pa dang / /go dhū na ni/ 'bru'i bye brag /na raṅga dang sman gyi dbye / /go mi 5mi ni/ drurpā dkar/ /'khor dang shu dag la yang ngo / /go ta ma ni thub pa'i dbye/ /shākya seng ge'o/ go ha mbi/ /bgrod dka' dang ni gsal ba la/ /ta ni rma ni ral mal dang / /bla re dang ni zhal zhal la/ /kra ḍi ma ni se 'bru dang / /ka ra ka dang e la'o/ /ni ga ma ni tshong dral dang / /pūbee dka ṭa ludhī/ /tshong pa'o ni ga ma 6na des/ /'ching ba dam bca' 'khrul 'khor skyob/ /nirga ma ni des 'gro blo/ /phun sum tshogs dang rigs ngan la/ /ṣpe ga ma ni lha'i mtha' dang / /tshong pa'i grong khyer nā se ta/ /pañtsa ma ni 'dod chags dbye/ /lnga rnams dang ni rdzogs byed la/ /mkhas pa dang ni khong 3chud la'ang / /pañtsa me rkeni skyabs seng bu/ /ba ra mi ni phul byung gtso/ /snang ba'o pa ra ma oṃ mdzad/ /rjes gnang dang ni grangs med can//pra kra ma ni skabs go rims/ /nye ba'i rim dang rim pa'o/ /pra tā ma ni rjes 120—1498

su byed/ /so 'ching ma sgodang so ldan ma/ /pra tha ma ni dang po gtso/ /bra harma ni khang brtsegs dang / /bum pa dang ni ri yi stod/ /ma dhya ma ni yul dbus dang / /mchog dang gung dang dbus su skyes/ /ma bye mā ni gnam stong dang / /rdul mthong bud med dag dang ni/ /rna ba can dang yang gsum gyi/ /sdeb spyor lag sor dathus ma la/ /bi kra ma ni rnam gnon mdzes/ /bzo dang nus pa phun tshogs la/ /be 4dru ma ni rin chen shing / /bi ru dang ni lcug ma sar/ /bi sbra ma ni rnam sgeg dang / /'khrul dang sgeg pa'i bya ba la/ /bi lo ma ni go bzlog dang / /lag 'gro khye dang zhags pa la/ /bi lo mbi na na tshod gnas/ /bzlog dang gsod 5par byed pa la/ /byā ya ma ni bgrod dka' ba'i/ /kun spyod rnam 'gog skyes bu'i rtsal/ /saṃ kra ma ni 'gro byed dang / /chu las yang dag sgrol ba yi/ /kun spyod 'khrul 'khor dag la'o/ /satta ma ni ches mchod 'os / /mchog dang legs pa la yang ngo / /saṃ bhra ma ni gus pa dang / /skyong dang legs pa la yang ngo / /su ṣa saṃ ni mdzes dang 'dus/ /su ṣa mā ni gsal ba dang / /mngon par gsal ba la 6yang ngo / /su ṣi ma ni sbrul bye brag /su ྾ ma ni rlung ser bu/ /mdzes dang 'khyags pa dag la'o/ /a nu pa ma mdzes pa dang / /stong pa dang ni srin po yi/ /phyogs kyi glang mo la 'dod do/ /a sgyu ga ma mthar byed dang / /shan 7pa 'gal byed khas blangs mtshon/ /u pa kra ma gso sbyong dang / /nyer 'dzin tsam —snadang rnam par gnon/ /u pa kra ma logs su 'gro/ /rang gir byas pa dag la'o/ /dza la ga ma chu'i gong 9dang //chu yi bzhi mdo rus sal la/ /daṇḍa yā na nyin mo dang / /bum pa skyes dang kyo nā sa/ /ba ra kra ma nus pa dang / /rnam gnon brtson pa dag la'o/ /sā 11 720—/499

baṅga ma sbal pa spre'u/ /na hā padma nga rgyal can/ /ma hā padma grangs dang gter/ /klu yi khyad par la yang 'dod/ /mātta bā ma 'khogs pa dang / /yongs su zos dang bor ba la/ /sarba bye ma phyogs glang dbye/ /sa kun pa la yang 'dod do/ /ma mtha'i sde'o// //ya ni rlung dang grags nga/ dang / /thob byed gtod dang 'gro byed la/ /yā/ ni sa/ dang ma mo/ dang / /me dang rnga yab mūdhī dang / /ru/dzdza dmā rnams la'o/ /dro/ ni lha gnas/ na/bas/ gsu/ma/ la/ma// /a/ nu mtshungs med dbye ba dang / /ga'-in du 'gyur dang tha ma/ 'a// /abye blo dang rig 4nga/ dang / /brag zhun la'o a/bye dzee rgo/ /rin thang don dang ma/chod dang 'os// /argya sbyor ba tsam/ 'a yang /a bye rje bo rje rigs nga / /ā byu gnas/ dang gtso bo 'a / /ā bye gdong dbus/ kha 'a sa/ byung / /i hra bā ma/ 'dod dang sbyin/ /mchod dang 'gregs/ dang gnas/ la 'o / /i bhya phyug ngo ra gyur nga/ la// /i sgyu glang ngo/ shalla tī/ /ka tyā bud med chung ngu dang / /ga'on nu ma/ dang khyim/ byi dbye/ /sma na gye bye brag dag 'a/'o/ /ka khye tho rangs/ nd+ra nga ba dang / /nyin mo/'o ka bye nad med mkhas// /ka spyo skyes/ ma/chog dbe ba 'chang / /ka bye chang dang ci ga 'os/ dang / /bar ma dang ni ñtsa gas/ rnam/sa/ la / /kakṣu chen ngo/ dang rgo gser/ /sked chings dang ni glang ngo/'i so/ /shaṃ sum̐ khang bzangs/ la/ so/gas kyi/ /re mig dang ni btung ba'i sgod / /gzi brjid skyes dang rdzas/ kyi dbye/ /rol mo'i bye brag la yang ngo / /kā ya lus/ dang rang bzhin 'dus/ /'bum dang lha la/sa byung ba'o/ /ka: rgyu dang dgos nga/ la/ /kā bya ba sangs gza' la'o/ /ka bya gtsang byed blo dag la/ /shā bye 720—/500

gzhung gi khyad par la/ /ku bye rtsig pa byug pa la/ /ku lya mā tya rigs byung dang / /rigs la shin tu phan pa dang / /sha dang nyi ma khrus gzhong dang / /tī ka sha'o ku spyo ni/ /chung ngu bcos ma chu klung dang / /chu bo 'tsho gsel sgra sgogs / /kṛ tyā/ bya ba lha dag dang / /nor la sogs pa bgo bya dang / /'phel ba'i bya ba dag la 'di/ /kṛ tyā ta bya sogs su brjod/ /kṛ yā las dang bya ba dang / /byed pa rab tu bzung dang thabs/ /rtsom pa dang ni bslab pa mchod / /gso dpyad dang ni nges byed la/ /ga bye rgyal bya ba lang gi/ /'o ma sogs dang mchod sbyin rdzas/ /ga bya 1ba lang rigs pa phan/ /gu hūṃ gsang ba nyer gnas dang / /sba bya khyo shug rus sbal la/ /gu tyā yal ga'i grong dang phug /bya dang ri dwags tshang dag dang / /bshang nalam rang dbang min dang phyogs / /ge ya glu mkhan glu dang dbyangs/ /go hye 4yon tan sbyin dang bu/ /grwa mya skyed ma bud meed dang / /gā bye dga' 'brel ashā la/ /tsas gdung ba tshogs dang ni/ /rtsa ba ra ba 'ching ba'o/ /tsa bya dben ba tsa byā ni/ /chen po dang ni dri yi mchog /tsi tyā ro yi kha dang ma/ /tsi bye gshin ngo/'i mchod rten la / /tsi hye gnas gzhi tsi tyā ni/ /gtsang khang phyur bu 'a/ yang ngo tsi tya sangs rgyas sgu gzugs/ dang / /shing la yang ni shin tu bsten/ /tsi tya 6dri ba rmad byung la/ /tsābye brjod bya bzhin tso la// /dpal gnas ma'o/ tsā bā ni//tsha gdung med dang bkur ste dang / /shin tu bskums dang mdzes pa dang / /gzugs brnyan me shel gral skyong ba/ /dzan ma dang mna' ma sar/ /bshes dang khol po dga' dang phan/ /skyed byed ma'o dza bye ni/ /kun spyor yongs smod tshong dus la/ /dzatyā ma dang grogs mo dga'/ /dzarlu srog chags me mchog 720—1501

gnas / /dza ya rgyal byed rnam rgyal la/ /dza ya chos kyi dbye ba nad/ /u ma'i grogs mo rgyal byed ma/ /phan pa dang ni ma bsrung 1la/ /dzā hye rigs can gtso bo la/ /tākhye 2bya khyung nyi ma yi / /kha lo ba dang shing rta rta/ /rta rna la sogs la 'dod do/ /ta khye mig sman 4khu ba la/ /ti6 me tog cha shas la/ /'dzin nga/ la'o tra yī ni/ /de gsum rigs byed gsum pa dang / /rdzogs pa la ni yang dag 'dod/ /draskru dgra 5dang chom rkun la/ /dā ya sokhruṇḍa bshad dang / /yo ta ka so/gas nor dang sbyin/ /cha sogs rin dang ba 6yi dngos/ /di bye/lam bcas// li shi dang / /me tog la lo di byā ni/ /sgyu ru ra'o/ di bye ni/ /kha dog la/ so/gas 'byor pa 'a / /dā byā gos khyem gos la ste/ /de tya lha min de tyā ni/ /chang dang gtum ngo/ sman nga/ yang / /dra bye bi ru la dang 'byor/ /shing bi rnam 'gyur skyed nga/ dang / /sman dang sa sogs 'jig rka dang 'dul/ /dha n+ya 'bras/ dang sgyu ru ra/ /dha n+ya bsod nams ldan nga/ la// /ṅgā rgo 'bru dang so/ ba 'a// /byebye/ rgyu skar khang nga/ la/ /na ya nus nga/ gnas/ dang ma / /lugs dang pho nya'i khyad par 'a// /nā bye sel snyan gsum nga/ sgeg /ni hye stag dang des/ nga/ la/ /nga/ byā a ru ra la 'dod/ /pa bye phan nga/ nyid la/'o/ /nga/ rya dmangs/ rigs/ nga/ bye ni/ /tshigs bcad pa tyā mi yi lam/ /pa rya kun tu rnam 'gyur dang / /pi tiṅgi'o yī pre ni/ /smod pa dang ni btung ba la/ /rpā yu nyi ma 'ug nga/ dus/ /pu bye legs byas chos dang ni/ /bsod nams ldan dang yid 'ong la/ /pū dzu dang phyag 'os la/ /pe yo btung bya 'o thug la/ /de yā/'tshed bya dang ba snying / /pā ya phal che mang dang mtshungs/ /mal dang 'chi bdag dag /la'o/ /pri ya/ dga' dang myur/ rgan sman/ /ba bye/720—/502

nags tshal las byung la/ /badhyā 1tshogs dang nags kyi chu/ /ba:2/ bud med mo gsham la/ /bandha/ rgyal dang 'bras med shing / /ba bye gtso bo stobs byed 'dzin/ /brlu/ mchog ldan mtsho lnga pa/ /biddhā gcod byed mdzes pa la/ /bindha/ snum dang sun —'byed la/ /bīṅgi/ mthu dang khu ba dang / /gzi brjid dang ni nus pa la/ /ba 4byā tshogs can ma la'o/ /be shrī rje rigs ke ta na/ /bha yang dag 5po so sor 'jigs/ /rab deng /sgur 'khrogs dga' ba dang / /las dang tshon gyi shing dag la/ /bha bya legs dang skal ldan byed/ /bha bye bden dang dge ba dang / /rung ba dang ni ngo bo can/ /bhā rgyu 7dge ba'i bdag nyid dang / /sgrub dang dge dang mi dge'i las/ /bhri tyā 'bangs dang gla mi la/ /maspya nya dang da'i dbye ba/ /shing gi rgyal po la yang ngo / /ma bye 'byar byed kun tu 'byar/ /rigs dang go skabs tha ma la/ /ma rgyu lha min mchod sbyin khro/ /ma ya bzo bo lha min dang / /glang po che dang rta la'o/ /ma yu ri dwags mi 'am ci/ /mā ya gos sar 9can lha mi / /ma ya ngan g.yo brtse ba dang / /rmā pa rī dang blo dag la/ /mā bye me tog phreng ba la/ /mū bye rin dang dngos po la/ / mri tru mtshed rtadang lha dag la//me bye me du ra la 'o/ /me dhyā zas dang shu dag la/ /bārya / gtsang pa me bye rten / /ba yu rta dang mchod sbyin rta/ yāmyu smin byed rgyas pa la/ /yā myu ri byi tsandan la/ /ya gya pi wang mchog dag la/ /gābye nus dang sdig pa can/ /yo gya sma sa me shel lo/ /yo gya 'byor dang sman dag la/ /ra bya 'khyog 1)dang bzhi mdo dang / /lo dang shing rta dag la'o/ /ra zu shing rta 'dren pa la/ /ra rmya 5yid dga' ra myu ni/ /mchog tu rnam par bsams pa'o/ /ra mya tsaspa 720—1503

ka yi shing / /rū bye gus dang gser dang dngul/ /rab bzhi'i tshul dang thob bya dang / /thob pa dang ni rigs pa la/ /la ya gar sogs mtshungs pa dang / /rnam par sgeg dang ma 'dres pa/ /la hūṃ grangs dang mda' zad pa/ /khang pa la'o / lā sde ni/ /sil snyan gsum pa bud med gar/ /bikṣu rta yi rol pa dang / /mthong bya rmad du byung ba la/ /brasmyu sde tshan rab gnas dang / /barya ṭa na la yang ngo / /shā 1ya/ mal stan/ sbrul lag pa/ /mal dang ldan pa nyid dang yang / /sgra yi gubee la yang ngo / /shalya shā bi ṭā/ myos byed shing / /sha mya phur bu mda' dang ni/ /'od ma'i kambi kā mda' chen/ /shā tyā sbubs can / shu bye ni/ /skye bo rnged pa la 'dod do/ /saurja dpa' ba nyid dang ni/ /spyod dang shor ba la yang ngo / /saṃ khye yang dag 'gro dang grangs/ /gcig nyid sogs dang 'dor ba la'o/ /ta ya 'jig rten las pha rol/ /sa tya bden pa bden pa zung / /lha rdzas la'o sa tyā skad/ /sa bye de ldan mtshams dang bsags / /chu klung dbye ba kun 'dzin dang / /dam bca' bsam pa khrims lugs la/ /sa bya nagayon phyogs nye ba la/ /sha bye mtshon cha 'bras yon tan/ /rdo ba bdun dang sausnye bya/ /ṣpe ru bye dang bzod pa la/ /sa dhya rnal 'byor dbye ba la/ /tshogs dang lha'o bsgrub bya la'ang / /sā ya mda' dang phyi dro la/ /srurya nyin mo'i de'i dga' ma/ /sman gyi dbye ba la suryā/ /se bye bsten 'os 'dam bu byings/ /bsten pa'o so myu mdzes 'khye shing / /sbe ya mdun na 'don la'o/ /sma ya rtsod 4pa'i tshig gtan 'bebs5/ /sgol ba snyems dang rmad du byung / /hārya pa ru ra yi shing / /'phrog bya la'o dzdza rya ni/ /dbang du byed dang rig 6byed sngags/ /rig pa dang ni sman la'o/ /dṛ rya dzwa'atsho ba brgya 720—/507

pa dang / /snying dga' ba dang snying po la/ /kṣa ya 'god dang bskal pa'i mtha' / /gnas dang skyes bu'i khyad par la/ /a rya ya ni sun 'byin dang / /bka' 1dang rim 'das 'jig pa'i dbyug /a bye 26 ni tshugs pa med/ /sbungs chen chu klung khyad par la/ /a na ya ni phongs pa dang / /skal ba lugs dang mi dge'i gnas/ /a pa tai ni bu mo gu / /a bha ya ni 'jigs pa med/ /a bha ni ya'o pan pa la/ /a bhi ya ni u shī ra/ /a bhe khyu ni/ snyan dang grags / /bzang ngo/ rnam grags ming rnams la/ /a ba bye ni bsad 'os dang / /don ma yin dang spyo ba la/ /a shī ya ni rta'i tshogs dang / /rta la phan pa'o a ha lya/ /lha dang dpal mo'i dbye ba dang / /go ta ma yi btsun mo'o/ /ma hārma ni ri dang brtan/ /ā ti thugs ni shen pa'i bu/ /shen pa la/'o ā tre yī/ /me tog can dang rgyun shes bu/ /'bab chu'i khyad par dag la'o/ /ā tre ya ni 4thub pa'i dbye/ /ā di tya ni nyi ma lha/ /asna 5ya ni man ngag thos// /ā sha ya ni bsam pa dang / /gzhi rten gzhan la brten 6pa'o/ /ā shra ya ni bang mdzod dang / /margas pa ngang ci 'chad ma'o/ /idhri yang ni sems la ste/ /idhri ya ni yul dbang byed/ /u da ya ni shar ri 'char/ /a bā ya ni mnyam 'byed sogs/ /thabs dang nye bar bgrod pa la/ /u/rṇa yu ni bal ldan 'u/ga /lwa ba skad cig 'jig pa la/ /e bye yo ni e bye'i lpags/ /dga' ba 'ching ba'i khyad par la/ /au tsi bye ni grol de nyid/ /bden nga dang ni rung ba la/ /kadza ya ni nirya ma/ /bcud kyi dbye ba byug pa dang / /'dod chags yan lag dri bzang dmar/ /kā le ya ni lha min dbye/ /kā me yo ni dus dum bu/ /ku khā ya ni sngon po bzhin/ /'dab chags sngon po dang ni gnas/ /kau kṛ tya ni 720—1505

rjes su gdung / /mi rig byed pa dag la'o/ /hūṃ ge yo ni musta ka /gser dang ka ste ru ṣa'o/ /shā ge ya ni sde tshan dang / /'jigs sde dang ni hūṃ ga'i bu/ /tsakṣu ṣe 1 ni ka ḍi ka /pad dkar shing dang mig sman bcud/ /ku sha bye ni skang/ bzang dang / /mig la phan pa'o tsambi ya/ /shya pa ka dang 'jig byed ma/da' / /rnge tog be sa/ra gser la/'o/ /dza gha bye ni tha ma/ smod/ /lhag ma'o dza ṭā yu bya'i dbye/ /gu gul shing ngo ta pa snga/ /tshangs spyod dka' thub ska/ra ma dbo / /de ba yu ni chos/ ldan dang / /de 2ba yā tro ka la'o/ /dī tī yā ni ches/ dbye dang / /sa/ le rdzogs/ par byed nga/ 'a/'o/ /nā de yi 4ni rgya' ma dang / /sba/ yi dzambu chu'i lcang ma/ /byā ka ya ni bdag nyid khyem// /dza bā ni raṅga gi guṣṭha/ /chos/ ma/jun nges/ 'bab ma/tshon cha dang / /'dus nga/ dang ni 'dres nga/ la/'o /ṣpe nga bye ni tshos byed nga// /rab tu sgrub nga/ra byed nga/ la// /ba ya su āoṃ'o thug dang / /ma/dog bzang 'o ma/ bzhon ma/ dang / /'o ma phan nga/'o barya dang / /gnas/ dang 'brug sgra sgra 'byen la/ /nga/ryā ya ni rnam/ grangs/ dang / /sprul nga/ rab 'byed ma/da' 'a/'o/ /ryā/ dī ya ni btung bya chu/ /bā ru ṣa ni phur bu la/ /bā ru bye ni rtsub nga/ dang / /brgya byin gyi ni tshal/ la/ 'ang yang / /pu larngu ni mi ci'i dbang / /'od yangs tsha 'o mgrin bcu la/ /bra tīrle ni lag skyes rul/ /cho ga nges/ nga/ra bkram nga/ la/ /pra na ya ni dga' ba dang / /bi shrambha dang slong ba 'a / /pra rja ya ni sred la 'dor/ /yang dag mi 'dod mngon par brjod/ /pra tya ya ni mna' gtan tshigs// /shes dang yid rton nges pa dang / / sīddhā di khyu ta tā dang / /bu ga gnas spyod rag las la'o/ /pra ma ya mchi bskal pa'i mtha'/ /brgyal bar gyur pa rnams la'o/ /pra nga/ bya ni lam mthun dang / /720—1506

rang bzhin ldan pa'o/ /pa la ya/ /gdu bu/ mgul nad/ kai ka ṇa/ /bā le ya ni bañdzi kā/ /bong bu ba se hi ta pa/ /brahma/ n+ya ni sa nu dang / /bṛ rtaṣa tshangs/ pa'i legs pa la/ /brahma/ bye ni bram ze dang / /bram/ ze rnams/ kyi tshogs pa 'a// /bhu dzi 6 ni grogs/ ngan dang / /lag pa'i srad bu'o bhu dzi spyo / /rag lus man dang rje rigs/ bran/ / bhū ṣṭha tsu 4ni 'od chen 'dod/ /bsel ba'i 'od zer rnam/sa/ la'o/ /ju tri bya ni/ spun zla'i/ thutsho/ /saṃ ga bye ni zho bkra shis// /yid 'ong la'o maṅga khye / /dpal 'bras dang ni a/ shwattha/ /ma sru rā dang skyob byed la/ /ram̐/ ga khye ni gsal ma dang / /me tog brgya nga/ khru yang gu/ /thur bltas me tog zhi ma/ dkar/ /dung gi gre tog shu dag rnam/sa/ /ma la ya ni yu/la ri'i dbye/ /kun dga' ra dang ri yi cha/ /dur byid 'a/ yang ma la/ yā / /spyo ga yu/ ni bram zer brjod/ /sgo ma/ mu ni nad dag la / /ra ha gya ni sba bya la/ /ra ha snga ni chu bo'i dbye/ /lo hi bye ni dmar ngo/ dang / /'bru dang chu bo'i khyad nga/ra la / /bakta bya ni smod dang dman/ /rag 'a/sa/ nga/'o ma/ dā hra / /ngag bzang ngo/ dang gcod byed dang / /rnam nga ra rgya' dang rgyal ba'i lam / /bi dza ya ni rgo rī dang / /de yi grogs/ mo chos/ dbye nga// /bi na ya ni drul dang 'u gas// /dra ba la 'o bi sha lya/ /mo yi gtsug phud glang po dang / /gu ḍū tsi dang dur byid dang / /zug rngu bral ba la yang ngo / /bisma ya ni rmad byung snyems/ /bi ṣa ya ni spyod la ma yul/ /dbang ngo/'i don la'ang nges par 'jug /'byel pa sogs kyi shes pa'ang dran/ /bya bā ya ni rab dga' dang / /mi snang ba la yang dag dran/ /bya bā yi ni gzi brjid la/ /shiṇḍa yi ni/ thub pa'i dbye/ /dpal 'bras dag byed khyad par la/ /shā lya yi ni me tog brgya/ /720—1507

sha'o 1skyes pa la yang ngo / /shrīrṣa bye ni rnam par rgyas/ /skra dang rtse mo can la'o / /shi le yo ni rgya mtsho'i tsha/ /ta la'i 'dab dang brag skyes la/ /shwa shurlu sgyug mo dang / / bum pa 4dang ni shā le ka /panda ya ni rgyab gnas dang / /stobs dang lugs dang 'du ba'o/ /sa ma ya ni grub mtha' dang / /mna' dang kun spyod yang dag rig /des bstan bya ba'i rnam pa dang / /dus dang brda rnams la yang ngo / /sa rarje ni chu sbyin dang / /rlung dang nus pa/ rung ba stobs/ /po kabye ni a nā ya pa/ /phag gi bya ba la yang ngo / /sau ra bye ni dri bzang dang / /mdzes dang yon tan gus pa la'o/ /saṃ st+ya ya ni kun tu 'jug /dbyibs dang rgya che mgrin pa la/ /nyir bye ni mi zad rdzas/ /mchog dang gser dang khu ba dang / /nga rgyal dbye ba la yang ngo / /hri de yo ni snying po snying / /kṣi pa bye ni dri zhim lus/ /kṣi tra ya ni gzhan lus dang / /gso spyad 'os dang zhing dang rtsa/ /gzhan gyi chung ma dga' ba dang / /bsgrub bya dang ni nad dag la/ /a nu sha ya rjes su gdung / /rjes su 'byel dang zhe sdang la/ /anta sha yā 'chi ba dang / /sa yi mal dang dur khrod ma/ /g.yas bral g.yas min mi mthun pa/ /a ba bya na snyems ni na/ /u pa kārya ltami bdag gnas/ /phan par byed pa'i dbye ba la/ /kā tra be ya zha nye dang / /sha tshe dang ni mtshon dag la/ /u ba kra ya gso spyad dang / /rtsom pa dang ni gsod pa la/ /zla ba'i na tshod bla re dang / /bdag nyid dang ni sman kyi dbye/ /dzā 6lā sha ya chu yi gzhi / /dza la sha yo 'dam 7bu sbyin/ /taṇḍa li ya byi dong naga'i/ /shing dang chung ngu mā ri la/ / /gdung ba rtsa dang stong pa dang / /ka ta ka'i 'bras phreng ba yangs/ /dha rgo dza ya rta dang lus/ /glang po rlung me ka ku bha/ /ni ra ma ya skyon med rtog /pa 720—/508

ri bā ma chu yi gnas/ /dzwa ta rja dang / yongs su bkab/ /pāñtsa dze n+ya hri 1byā ka sha/dung dang bāṭa ga la'o/ /bo ru ṣe ya skyes bu'i rtsal/ tshig dbye tshogs pa gsod pa dang / /skyes bus byas pa rnams la'o/ /bi ta bā yo 'jigs pa dang / /'jigs rung pra ti shra ma rduni/ /'dun sa dang ni gnas la'o/ /pha lo 1da ya 'bras bu rnams/ /'byung dang rnyed dang sum rtsen la/ /pi le sha ya byes pa sprul / /bhā ga dhe yo skal ba dang / /lag pa dang ni cha la'o/ / bhri taj-i4 ya byed pa dang / /sgra dang spyod yul 'dus pa la/ /ma ho da bo yekun 'byung dang / /byang grol du 6mo rgur mo la/ /ya hā la ma gtsug dzwalag khang / /mu 8stegs khang dang mchog bdag la/ /ma hā rū blu rin thang che/ /padma rā ga la sogs la/ /mādzā ri ya dmangs rigs dang / /byi la bya ba spyod pa la/ / ra te /—snargya ya rab 'phyang gsod/ /lhag pa dang ni ṣpe'u le1༷ / /sa mutstsha ya dzreng 1dang 'gog /sa mu dā meya tshogs pa dang / /kun tu sbyor dang nye ba'i rim/ /sa mū dā ya tshogs brid sgra/ /salba ra ya g.yul 'gyed 1rtedang / /rgud dang phyi ma'i dus dag la/ /sa laṅga ya sgra dang ming / /rol rtsed phyugs dang bya dag la⑩/ /snyu lotstsha ya mtha' dag ni/ /shing dum rdo ba za ma tog /glang po rnams kyi bar ma la/ /a ku to bha yo zhes pa/ /lha khang a tīnde shīka /kā lnga nu pā: ni shing //shi sha ba dang dus skyes dang / /ri las skyes pa rnams la'o/ /dugha tā lī yang zhes pa/ /ā ma'i 'o ma 'o 7ma'i sa/ /dbu ba can dang de nas ni/ /'o ma'i tsa ma sa dang ni/ /ta ta paṇḍa tī ṭa 'o/ /pra ba tsa dī ya lngazhes pa/ /brjod bya'i rab dang rjod byed rab/ /bṛṣa ka bā yī zhes pa/ /dpal mo go rim 1 'tsho byed ma/ /brgya las mchog tu gyur ma'o/ /pa 1snyetruṅga ma nī yi ni/ /nye 120—1509
