6 ma je 6 shā khā su tsa kurja rā rde/ /ye byu bhri tsā tsi tra mṛ 1 te ba sarnyi ra gnas dang glang chen gres gnas dang / /rgyal po'i dkor khang dag na gang gnas dang / /lam srang sum mdo byā su bī bhā 6 tsa tsa twa re khye/ /ya tsi ka thra kṣe ṣā ma hā ba the 6 ma hā dre shā ṣpe dang ni bzhi mdo dang / /gang dag la ma po che dang shing gcig drung / /dur khrod chen po nags tshal 6 ma hā ba ṣpe 6/ /se he bha ri kṣu ju ṣi tā su ye tsa ba saje sgo rā su ma hā chen ngo/ dang / /seng ge dred dang gcan gzan gnas rnams dang / /'brog chen 'jigs su rung bar gang ṭa rpā 6/ /dwa pe ṣā di bye 6 kṛ tā la ya bya me ro thra shā ṣpe ni ba saje yo tsa/ /gnas dang / /gang dag gling mchog dag na gnas pa dang / /lhun po dur khrod dag na gnas pa rnams//z-ibye pa sandaḥ pra dza garnya mā bye dhū paṃ ba bo dī pa bi rjañtsi bhasgyu/ /rab tu dgyes shing mgu bar gyur nas su/ /phreng ba me tog dri dang bdug pa dang / /bstod dang gtor ma kṛṇḍantu bhuñdzantu pi bantu tse da mi dañtsa karma sa pha lo dzu mar me gus 'bul na/ /'di dag gso' zhing legs par 5bzhes nas/ kyang / /bdag gi la sa/ kyi 'bras/ bu ṣabye / /ma hā ba liḥ 1mchis nga ra mdzod/ /gtor ma chen po'o/ /oṃ badzra yo gi mbi 6 dhīḥ/ tu nya khaḥ phe nya i/ ma ma ma naḥ sedhe 7 pra yatstsha rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bdag gi yid bzhin dngos grub stsol /ba bo kṛtna kṛsgo/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ shu krā ga ga na kṣa pā ba liḥ 2gtor ma zung gtor ma zung / nam mkha' dkar mo 'a 'thor ba'i gtor ma'o/ /oṃ pi shā tsi parṇa sha ba ri sarbo pa dra ba nā shi ni sarba ro ga pra sha ma ni sarba bha sha za ma ri khrod lo ma can nyer 'tshe thams cad sel ma/ nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed ma/ya bi nā shi ni i rda ba li kṛṇḍa kṛṇḍa/ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ sarba 'jigs pa thams cad sel ma/ gtor ma 'di zung zung / zo zo/ zo shig zo shig /gdug pa'i sems can 120—1618

duṣṭa mā rā na mā rā na/ brnya bandha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/thams cad sod sod/ chings chings/ snun snun/ sregs sregs/ tshos tshos/mā ra ya mā ra ya/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ parṇa sha ba ri ba liḥ 3gsad par gyis gsad par gyis/ ri khrod lo ma can gyi 1gtor ma'o/ /oṃ ma hā kā khā shā sa no pa kā ri ṇi/ pabye ma kā lo ya mi rda ratna nag po chen po/ bstan pa la/ phan 'dogs par/ phyi ma ma yin pa'i dus 'di dang 'dir/tra yā pa kā ṛ hūṃ/ ya di pra ti dzñā sma ra se ta dā/ i rda ba dkon mchog gsum la gnod par byed pa/ gal te byung na de'i tshe dam bca' grudran par byus/ gtor lo kṛṇḍa kṛṇḍa kha kha khā hi khā nyi/ sarba duṣṭa satwa na mā ra mā ra/ kṛṇḍa kṛṇḍa/ma 'di zung zung zo zo/ zo shig zo shig /gdug pa'i sems can thams cad sod sod/ zung zung / bharnya bhandhabye/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ dī ④ na me ke na mā ra ya chings chings/ snun snun/ sregs sregs/ tshos tshos/ nyi ma gcig gis gsad par 3 gyis mā ra ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ ma hā kā la ba liḥ 4 gsad par gyisahūṃ/ nag po chen po'i gtor ma'o/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ.uspyo 3ṣa sumbha rā dza/ ya mānta ka pra dzñārnya ka padmānta ka gtsug tor gnod mdzes rgyal po/ gshin rje mthar byed/ shes rab mthar byed/ padma mthar byed/bispyonta 3ka a tsa la ṭakki rā dza nī la daṇḍa ma hā ba la bhyaḥ/bgegs rngumathar byed/ mi g.yo ba/ 'dod pa'i rgyal po/ /dbyug sngon/ stobs po che ṅkurnams/sa pa ri wa re bhyaḥ i rda ba lo garghaṃ pu྾ dhū /skrepaṃ dī pañtsa /byekṣa tai da 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ gtor ma 'di dang dri dang me tog dang / bdug pa dang mar me ma nyams dā ma te/ te tsā gatya sa pa ri wa raḥshrī ghra mi rda ba bo kṛṇḍarnya khā dantu/ pi bintu pa sbyin gyis/ de rnams byon nas 'khor bcas myur bar gtor ma 'di zung gsol/ 'thung zhig /yang 120—1619

dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ sarnyi snga ma ma sarba satā nañtsa shā) puṣṭi rakṣu sa kyer ṇa gubye kurbantu dag par tshim ste bdag dang sems can thams cad la zhi ba dang rgyas pa dang bsrung ba dang bskyab hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa badzra dha ra ā dzñā pa ya ti swā hā/ da sha kro 3 dha ba liḥ 5pa dang sba bar mdzod/ rdo rje 'chang gi bka' bzhin du/ khro bo bcu'i gtor ma'o/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ.i hā pa sbi te bhyaḥ kṣe tra pā le bhyo n+ya bhyabya i rda garghaṃ pu྾ 'dir gnas pa'i/ zhing skyong rnams dang / gzhan rnams la/ 'di dri dang me tog dhū paṃ/ dī pa makṣa tai da dā ma he/ te tsa hūṃ ga tya sa pa ri wā rāḥshī ghra mi rda ba bobadug pa mar me ma nyams pa sbyin gyi de rnams kyang byon nas/ 'khor dang bcas pa rnams myur du gtor kṛṇḍantu jekhā dantu pi dantu dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥsarnyi phyesta ma ma sarba satā nañtsa hūṃshārnyi puṣṭi rakṣa ma 'di zung gsol 'thung / yang dag par tshim ste/ bdag dang sems can thams cad zhi ba dang rgyas sa 7 ra ṇa gudzhai kurbantu hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa/ badzra dha ra ā dzñā pa ya ti swā hā/pa dang bsrung ba dang bskyab pa dang sba bar mdzod/ rdo rje 'chang gi bka' bzhin gyes/kṣe tra pā li ba liḥ 6zhing skyong gi gtor ma'o/ /oṃ na maḥ su rū — / pā ya ta thā ga tā yā rta te samyakshi buddhā de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gzugs mdzes la ya / ta rya thā/ oṃ su ru su ru/ pra su ru pra su ru/phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di lta ste/ gzugs mdzes gzugs mdzes/ rab tu gzugs mdzes rab tu gzugs mdzes/ta ra ta ra/ bha ra bha ra/ sambha ra sambha ra/ sma ra sma ra/sgrol ba sgrol ba/ 'dzin pa 'dzin pa/ yang dag par 'dzin pa yang dag par 'dzin pa/ dran pa dran pa/santarṣa ya santarsha ya/ sarba pre tā bhā swā hā/ a pa sa radhwa pa ta kun tu tshim par byis kun tu tshim par kyisaspu/ yi dwags rnams thams cad song zhig /glags lta ba rnams 120—1620

ra prakṣi ①rto da dā mya haṃ sarba lo ka dmā tu ni bā si dzā pre tā nā mā hā ra mi nyi/la (bye sbyin gyirngu/ ngas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na gnas pa'i yi dwags rnams kyi bza' jeb/pre ta ba liḥ 7yi dwags kyi gtor ma'o/ /oṃ da sha disbya basbi te bhyaḥ i hā ba sbi te bhyaḥ su ra ga ru rnguḍa kinda ra ma ho phyogs bcur rnam par gnas pa rnams dang / 'dir gnas pa rnams dang lha dang nam mkha' ra ga bhū ta pre ta pi shā tsodmā dā pa smra ra ostu ra kā di bhyo ba li dā pa yā lding dang mi'am ci dang lto 'phye chen po dang 'byung po dang / yi dwags dang sha za dang spyo khyebyed dang brjed ma i rda pu྾ dhū paṃ dī paṃ garghaṃ ṣpe byu dhī lnga di saṃ yushrī byed dang gnon po la sogs pa rnams la gtor ma sbyin gye me tog bdug pa mar me dri zhal zas la sogs kṛ hi twa su kha sau ma na gya khā nyi no bha brnyu/ sthā nāñtsa ni ru 7༷ pa dra paṃ pa dang ldan pa shyi 'di bzung nas/ bde ba dang yid bde ba thob par gyur cig /gnas su nye bar 'tshe ba kurbantu / sarba buddhā skye 7byeṣṭha na ṣpe te/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ i da ma mṛ ta piṇḍa tso—:bhughā med par mdzod/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs kyi/ bdud rtsi'i gong bu 'di zos nas/ma ma sarba satā 1)nāñtsa shārnyi kurbantu swa ste swā hā/ sa mā 15dzi kā dzñā bdag dang sems can thams cad la zhi ba dang bde legs su mdzod cig /'dus pa rnams kyi 'byung po sarba bye ti ba liḥ 8thams cad kyi gtor ma'o/ /e byentu ba rdzu sa ha bhū ta paṃ ghi ri mañtsa kṛhāntu ba 1 lo bi shiṣṭi /shar phyogs rdo rje can byi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas/ /gtor ma phul ba 'di dag bzhes su gsol//asnirya mo ṣpe ṛ ti byu pa ti:/ a shā ba tirba yu dha nā ti she5pabya/ i shā na me dang gshin rje bden bral 'byung po'i bdag /chu bdag rlung bdag nor gyi bdag po dang / /dbang ldan lha 120—1621

bhū tā bye pa tibya/ /de bā usgo ñtsa tsand+ra rka pi ta ma ha:/ /de bāḥs ma stu bhū mi ye tsa ste 'byung po'i bdag po dang / /steng gi nyi zla tshangs pa chen po dang / /lha rnams kun dang gang dag sa steng klu//nā gā dha ra gu hra ga ṇiḥs me tāḥpra ti patta dwo ka ni bee dañtsa swa ka swa ka spe ①ri yi lha dang gsang ba'i tshogs bcas la/ /so so so sor phul ba 'di dag kun/ /rab tu dges shing mgu ba de shā pu bhū tāḥkṛtta 4/zluṣṭaḥ sa ba māḥs pe tyā pa bu tra mi tra swa dza ṣpeḥbar gyur pa yis/ /rang rang phyogs su legs par bzhugs nas kyang / /rang gi bu smad mdza' bshes gnyen sa me tāḥ /pu྾ ba lo dhū pa ni be da nañtsa bhuñdzantu dzi ghrantu pi bantu tse da mi rda 'dun bcas/ /gtor ma me tog bdug pa 'bul lags na/ /'di dag gsol zhing bzhes te bsnams tsa kand+ra sa pha lo yu ṣantu/ dilnga pyel ba boḥ 9nas kyang / /bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /phyogs skyong gi gtor ma'o/ /oṃ phe sthā hūṃ dzaḥ ba bo rakta gyeputpa kā ma rā dza sarba sidhe phye pra yatstsha gtor ma dmar po/ me tog 'dod pa'i rgyal po dngos grub thams cad ma ma pi tu dha tsinta kān bhasmi ku ru hūṃ/ sapta pā 3tā la ga ta sha hūṃ kyen pā da ta rab tu stsol// /bdag la 'gal bar sems pa rnams thal bar mdzod/ sa 'og rim pa bdun du dgra rnams lo ku ru/ / sarba dza no pa shāṅgi ku ru phaṭa swā hā/ kā ma rā dza ba boḥ 10rkang pa'i mthil du gyis/ /skye bo thams cad la nye bar zhi bar mdzod/ /'dod pa'i rgyal po'i gtor ma'o/ /o hriḥ e hra rta hi e ka dza ṭī shā3ma mo pa rgyu tā na shakṣiṃ ku ru puṣṭi ku ru tshur byon tshur byon ral gcig ma/ bdag 'khor dang bcas pa 'a/ zhi bar mdzod/ rgyas par mdzod/ma hā yakṣu bye pa ta ye i rda ba bo kṛṇḍa kṛṇḍa kṛṇḍa pa ya kṛṇḍa pa ya/ pa ra pi dhī 1rte.ā lhag par gnod sbyin gyi bdag po chen po la gtor ma 'di/ zung zung / zung shig zung shig /pha rol kaste ya ā kaste ya/ tru ṭa tru ṭa/ mu ()ṭa mu ṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/gyi rig pa khug khug /chod chod/ chol chom/120/de1622

u gra tā rā ba liḥ 11sgol ma drag mo'i gtor ma'o/ /oṃ āḥsthāsthā ku ru kulle sarba satwa ba shaṃ ka ri sarba bha ya bha yo ka ri rigs su byed ma/ /sems can thams cad dbang du byed ma/ /'jigs pa thams cad 'jigs i rda ba li hūṃ garghaṃ puhūṃ dhū paṃ dī pa.āoṃ lā tai dā ma he sarba de ba nā ga yakṣa par byed/ 'di gtor ma/ dri dang me tog dang bdug pa dang mar me ma nyams pa dbul gye/ lha dang ga rnyarpā su ra ga ru ḍa kinda ra ma ho ra gā da yo ya dzee ṣṭi bhū ñdza tha klu dang gnod sbyin dang dri za dang lha ma yin pa dang nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang lto 'phye chen po khā da tha si ba tha dzi ghra tha ma ma ma naḥnaḥ zhu sirnyi pra yatstsha tha oṃ āḥsthā hūṃ la sogs pa thams cad cad ci 'dod zo zhig /'chos shig /'thung zhig dri snoms/ bdag gi yid la phaṭa swā hā/ ku ru kullī gib liḥ 12dngos grub rab tu sprul cig /rigs su byed pa'i gtor ma'o/ /oṃ na mo bha ga ba te shrī tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa shā ya de bā su ra na tra sa nā ya sa bcom ldan 'das dpal gtum po 'jigs rung chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha dang lha ma yin dang ka la mā ra ba ma bi nā sa nā ya a ta sī ku su a wa pu ṣe/ asgo bhya kṛ mi rnams skrag par mdzad pa/ bdud dpung mtha' dag rnam par zhi ba/ zar ma'i me tog lta bu'i sku can/ta she kha rā ya i rda ba lo kṛ hā kṛ hā / ma ma sa rba bi spyo na tsa mi bskyod pa'i cod pan mdzad pa la/ gtor ma 'di zung zung bye/bdag la gegs rnams thams cad dang /turmā rā na ni bā ga ya bā ga ya/ tra sa ya tra sa ya/ blu ma bhra ma/ tshinda tshinda/bdud bzhi po rnams zlog byupar gyis zlog par gyis/skrag par gyis skrag par gyis/g.yo ba g.yo ba/chod chod/bhinda bhinda/ nā shā nā shā/ tā pa tā pa/ sho ṣa sha ṣa 5/ tstsha da tstsha da/ bhe da bhe da3 /phug phug /shig shig /sregs sregs/ skoms skoms/ chod chod/ phye phye/120—1623

duṣṭa satā na ma ma bi ruddhā tsitta kān bhasmi ku ru hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ tsaṇḍa ma hā gdug pa'i sems can bdag la 'gal bar sems pa rnams thal bar mdzod/ gtum po 'jigs ro ṣa ṇa ba liḥ 13rung chen po'i gtor ma'o/ /oṃ dzambha la dza land+ra ya ma hā dha nā ya ma hā yakṣa se nā pa ta ye/ i rda ba bo rmugs 'dzin chu'i dbang po la/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po la/ bdud rtsi lnga'i pañtsa mṛ tī 2 kṛṇḍa kṛṇḍa/ kha kha/ khā hi khā nyi/ sa ma ya ma nu sma ra/gtor ma 'di zung zung / zo zo/ zo shig zo shig /dam tshig rjes su dran par gyes/dzaḥdzaḥhūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ dzambha la ba liḥ 14rmugs 'dzin gye gtor ma'o/ /oṃ rakta mu ku ṭā ya rakta mu khā ya rakta sha rī rā ya rakta bhu dzā ya rakta cod pan dmar po la/ ral pa dmar po la/ gdong dmar po la/ lus dmar po la/ phyag dmar hā ra ba li mā lā ya rakta ra tha sa ma rū khye ya raghra na nā ya/ raghā bha ra ṇa bhū po la / do shal phreng ba dmar po ldan pa/ shing rta dmar po la yang dag par bzhugs pa/ byergyan cha dmar ṣi tā ya i rda ba bo kṛṇḍi kṛṇḍa/ ma ma sarba bispyon ha ra ha ra/ tsa turmā rā na ni pos brgyan pa la / bdag gi bgegs thams cad phrogs phrogs / bdud bzhi po rnams zlog par byis/bā ra ya bā ra ya/ tā sa ya tā sa ya/ dhra ma bhra ma/ tshinda tshinda/ binda binda/ nā sha ya nā sha ya/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ tsinda rngu dzib/ bhe da bhe da/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/pabyata prabye she na tsā ra ye ta/ ind+ra ya na laḥ juḥ ya mā ya na maḥsgyiḥ ba ru shā ya de nas cha shas so sor brjod par bya stebye/ dbang po la 'dud/ gshin rje la 'dud/ chu'i lha la na maḥbi/ ku be rā ya na maḥkṛ/ agha ye na maḥta/ āo shwa rā ya na maḥ.ā/ ṣpe ra 'dud—/ lus ngan la 'dud/ me lha la 'dud/ dbang phyug la 'dud/ bden bral 120—1624

ta ya na maḥn/ pā ya bee na maḥn/ tsand+ra ya na maḥhūṃ/ armā ya na maḥhūṃ/ bra hma ma lkul 'dud/ rlung lha la 'dud/ zla ba la 'dud/ nyi ma la 'dud/ tshangs pa ṇi na maḥphaṭa/ ba su dhwa ra yi na maḥphaṭa/ be ma tsi tri ṇi na maḥswā hā②/ sarba byu la 'dud/ nor rgyun ma la 'dud/ thags bzangs 1ris la 'dud/ 'byung po te bhyo na maḥswā hā④/ ha hā hi tī hu snu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ rakta ya mā ri ba liḥ 15rnams thams cad la 'dud/ gshin rje gshed dmar po'i gtor ma'o/ /oṃ tā ri ṇi sarba duḥ kha bha ya ha ri ṇi tsa turmā ra ṇi bā ri ṇi sgrol ma/ sdug bsngal dang 'jigs pa thams cad 'phrog ma/ bdud bzhi bzlog par mdzad ma sarba da bā su ra na ra gantarba ki na ra ma ho ra gārlu ba dra ba pra marda ni lha dang lha ma yin pa dang mi dang dri za dang mi'am ci dang lto 'phye 3chen po la sogs pa'i nyer 'tshe rab byu ta pre ta yakṣa sa ḍā ki n+ya di pa 'uya bi dhwabee ni ra kri me ra yant+ra mand+ra tu 'joms ma/'byung po yi dwags gnod sbyin srin po dang mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro ma 1la sogs pa'i tant+ra tra byeyo ga bi nā shi na ba 1— snag ba ti 'jigs pa rnam par 'joms ma/ gzhan byus hūṃ byas pa'i 'khrul 'khor dang sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba durgakhye / ri ṇi ā gatstsha ā gatstsha/ i rda ba lo kṛṇḍa rmyekṛhā/ ma ma sarba sha tū na ha na rnam par zhi ba/ bcom ldan 'das ma ngan 'gro las sgol ma tshur byon/ha na/ khā hi khā hi/ sarba bhandha na byā dhi gra hā na da ha da ha/ bhe da ya bhe da ya/'ching ba dang nad dang gdon thams cad/ 'chos 'chos/ khos khos/pho ṭa ya pho ṭa ya/ sgo skyoṭa ya sgo ṭa ya/ sarba sernyi rngumbi pra yatstsha shārnyi puṣṭi rashā me ku ru sarba ka li ka la ha bi gra ha bi/ wa da bisgo rpā da byatta ka dzā sbyinda sbyinda/ bhanda thubhanda/'thab pa dang 'thab mo 'gyed pa dang / rtsod pa dang / bgegs bskyed cing gsal bar byed pa rnams/bhañdza ya bhañdza ya/ khyo bha ya kko bha ya/ stambha ya stambha ya/ dhī sthā sthā/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/720—1625

oṃ badzra bā rā hi i rda ba li kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ sarba yakṣa rakṣa sa bhū ta rdo rje phag mo/pre ta pi shā tsā basthā ra ḍā ka ḍā ki tyā da ya i rda ba bo kṛhāntu/ sa ma ya rakṣantu ya dzee baṃ ya beeṣṭi ṣpebhuñdza tha khā da tha bi ba tha dzi ghra tha mā ri kra ma tha ma ma sarpā kā ra ra yā sakhru kha baṃ bṛdhe ye sa hā ya kā bha bantu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/badzra bā rā tī ba liḥ 19rdo rje phag mo'i gtor ma'o/ /na mo bha ga ba ti badzra tā ra sarba sernyi ka re sarba bha ha re i rda ba bo pa.āoṃ mṛ phyag 'tshal lo bcom ldan ma rdo rje sgrol ma dngos grub kun mdzad ma/ 'jigs pa rkun rte'aphrog ma/tai kṛhā kṛṇḍa/ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ sarba duṣṭa pra duṣṭa na ma ma kṛ te stambha ya stambha ya/bdud rtsi lnga'i gtor ma 'di zung zung / bdag la gdug pa dang rab tu sdug par byed pa rnams thams cad/mo hā ya mo hā ya/ banda byeya banda ya/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/sarba duṣṭa stambha ni badzra tā re swā hā/ badzra tā tā ra ba loḥ 20gdug pa can thams cad rengs par byed ma/ rdo rje sgol ma'i gtor ma'o/ /na maḥs manta buddhā rmā/ na maḥs manta dharmā rde/ na maḥs manta saṃ ghā dzā/kun nas sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ si tā ta pa tra/ oṃ bi ma la/ oṃ shaṃ ka ra/ oṃ pra hye gi ra badzra uste ṣa tsakra gdugs ④dkar po/ dri ma med pa/ bde byed/ phyir bzlog /rdo rje gtsug tor 'khor 'o sa sgyur ba/ba rti sa rba ya nt+ra rū la ka rma ba nta rna tā ḍa dzā tī la dzwa bā /'khrul 'khor dang sngags dang rtsa ba'i las thams cad dang bcings pa bsnun pa phur bus btab pa'am/ma ma kṛ te ye na ke na tsi tre she tai tatpa rpān stsonda sbyinda/ bhinda bhenda/ tsi ri bdag la byed pa po gang ci yang rung bas byed pa po 'di dang de thams cad/120—1627

tsi ri/ gi ṭwāri gi ri/ ma ra ma ra/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/uṣṭi ṣa tsakra brti ba liḥ 21gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba'i gtor ma'o/ /oṃ āḥsarba rgya dhwa dza ga dha sha diklo rnguka dhwa tu nanta ga ga na sa mu dra me dus gsum pa'i 'gro ba phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gye khams mtha' yas/ nam mkha' rgya mtsho gha byu ha pra sa ra pa ra mā rku ra dzo maṇḍal pa radza rāntarga ta tha mā sprin gyi bkod pa/ rab 'byams kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi dkyil 'khor gcig nas gcig tu brgyud ba bya ba spru tā dha rma dha tu sa ma ba sa ra ṇa ā kā sha dhwa ngo 'i nang du gnas shing / snyoms par 'jug pa gnas pa chos kyi dbyings dang / snyoms je par 'jug pa tu pa ma wa sā nāḥ sarba rgya dhwa dza gadrwa sha diklo snye ka dhwa twa nanta byu ha nam mkha'i khams dang mnyam par gnas pa thams cad dang sa gsum pa'i 'gro ba phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten sra sa ra ga ga na sa māḥ sa rba lo ka pā lāḥ sa rba gyi khams mtha' yas pa'i bkod pa/ rab 'byams hūṃnam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'jig rten skyong ba satāñtsa / tarya thā/ badzā yu dha/ badzra kā la nā ga badzra thams cad dang sems can thams cad la/ 'di lta ste/ rdo rje mtshon cha dang / rdo rje dus dang / rdo rje klu badzra bye ra ba badzra ma la badzra su ṣa la badzra ni la badzra kro dha dang / rdo rje 'jigs byed dang / rdo rje me dang / rdo rje gtun shing dang / rdo rje rlung dang / rdo rje khro bo dang /badzra sbo che na badzra mā yā badzra shoṇḍa badzra sra bha badzra kro dha thugs rdo rje dang / rdo rje sgyu ma dang / rdo rje glang sna dang / rdo rje 'od dang / rdo rje khro bo dang /be ma tsi tri dṛ 3thi wi de bi byetāḥs pa ri wā rā i rda ba bo pu྾ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/thags bzangs ris dang / sa'i lha mo rnams 'khor dang bcas pas/ gtor ma/ me tog bdug sgos mar me garghaṃ / ṣpe wi /— tyā di paṃ/ yus+ho⑫/ bakhru/ pra ⑫hā re/ pra tīstso ba bhū ⑫dri zhal zas la sogs pa dang / ldan pa'i gtor ma'i mchod pa 'di bzhes shing longs spyad de/ bdag 120—1628

rdzu ma ma sarba bisna bi nā ya kā na sarba duṭwā —) na ma nu 6 na ma nu 6 na gi bgegs dang log 'dren dang gdug pa dang rab tu gdug 2pa'i mi dang mi ma yin pa rnams thams cad dzambha ya ta stambha ya ta/ bhandha lceya ta/ bi dhwa bee ya ta/ ma ma hi ra rgya su warṇa dha na rmugs par gyis/ rengs par gyis/ chings/ rnam par choms/ bdag gi dbyig dang gser dang nor dhwa tyā yu yo ba mā ro gya sakhru khā ni ma hā su kha bee bṛdha ye yā ba dā bo bye dang 'bru dang tshe dang lang tsho dang nad med pa dang bde ba dam pa rnams dang bde ba chen po/ /rnam par maṇḍa sarya rnye dzhai ka ya ta ma ma sa hā ya bye/ shārnyi puṣṭi rakṣuñtsa ku nā oṃ āḥmañdzu badzra saṃ 'phel ba'i ched dang ji srid byang chub snying po'i mthar thug par/ bdag gi stong grogs mdzod cig na/hūṃ swā hā/ mañdzu badzra bā gī shwa ra ba liḥ 22byams 4pa'i rdo rje ngag gi dbang phyug gi gtor ma'o/ /oṃ e bye hi bha ga ba ti badzra yo gi ni sarpā shā pa ri byu ri ke bhā ga ba ti tshur byon tshur byon bcom ldan ma/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs ba ra de na maste na maste pu na ba ri na ra pi na ma ste ma ma de bee mā ta ra nu gra ha par mdzad ma/ bcom ldan 'das ma mchog sbyin ma khyod la 'dud beer yang khyod la 'dud yu/ma lha mo/ku ru i rda ba lo kṛtta kṛṇḍa/ oṃ badzra bee ro tsa byā ye swā hā/ a tsa la kalpo khro 5 sarja 'di dag 6rjes su gzung 7 du gsol/ rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad ma/ mi g.yo ba'i rtog 8pa la sa gsungs kha ḍa kṣa ra badzra yo gi mbi ba liḥ 23pa byed bcas yi ge drug gi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gtor ma'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa ma ya ma nu sma ra hūṃ hūṃ/ phe phe/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig rjes su dran par gyis/raghā ga ga na kṣe pa ba liḥ 24nam mkha' dmar po la 'thor ba'i gtor ma'o/ /120—1629

oṃ badzra ḍā ki ni i rda ba lo sthā dī/ ha kṣiṃ ① haṃ nyiḥphaṭa ma ma sarba satwa dunāñtsa rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ bdag dang sems can thams cad zhi bar mdzod cig/shārnyi 1ku ru swā hā/ aṣṭa dmā byatsa tu dngha shā mi ya me ya me ba dā ta byā/ sha ba ra pā 'di brgyad dang bcu bzhi/ kho na la sbyin par bya'o/ /sha ba ri'i 2zhal snga nas dī ya kra ma badzra lo gi mbi ba liḥ 25kyi rim pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gtor ma'o/ /oṃ badzra ḍā ki ni i rda ba bo kṛhā kṛṇḍa/ ha ha ha haḥkha kha kha kha/ ya ya ya ya/rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/a a a aḥm ma sezlo pra yatstsha hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ shrī ma da dwa ya pā dā 'uya badzra yo gi dpal gnyis med zhabs kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor nā ba liḥ 26ma'i gtor ma'o/ /oṃ a ra pa tsa nā ya ku ma ti da ha na dakṣu ya tsant+ra kānta ma ṇi pra bhā ya 'khor ba sreg par byed pa/ blo gros ngan pa sreg par mkhas pa/ nor bu chu shel gyi 'od can/ khaspyo pu dzwasta ka bya gā ha stu ya mañdzu bā ddhā ba ra/ pra dā ya mañdzu budhi sedhi da dā ya ra' gri dang glegs bam phyag na bsnams pa/ 'jam par gsung ba/ 'jam dpal sangs rgyas dngos i rda 4ba bo garghaṃ pu྾ dhū paṃ dī paṃ ma dhu/ sharka rā di sa hi tai/ kṛṇḍa kṛhā/ kha kha/grub 9mchog stsol ba/ sbrang rtsi dang ka ra la sogs dang bcas pa/khā hi khā hi/ ma ma shārnyi puṣṭi rakṣu pa ra ṇa gubye ku ru ku ru/ oṃ āḥdhīḥhūṃ swā hā/a ra pa tsa na ba liḥ 27a ra pa tsa na'i gtor ma'o/ /oṃ ma hā shri ye ṭī hūṃ dī oṃ i rda ba bo kṛhā kṛṇḍa tram̐ lo kya saṃ sā rā ya dpal chen mo/ 'jig rten gsum byu 'khor ba'i 120—1630

dā ri byā hūṃ ga dzee bi dā ra ya sarba duṣṭa pra duṣṭa khyen bhañdza bhañdza/ a gatstsha a gatstsha/dbul ba'i glang po rnam par 'joms ma/ gdug pa dang rab tu gdug kyepa rnams thams cad nyes/bha ga ba ti ma ma ni dhi de hi swā hā/ ma hā shri tā rā ba liḥ 28bcom ldan 'das ma bdag la gter sprul cig /dpal chen sgol ma'i gtor ma'o/ /oṃ ba byeg pa ti aṣṭa ma hā/ bha ya tā ri ṇi shakṣiṃ bcom ldan 'das ma 'jigs thupa chen po brgyad las sgrol la/ zhi ba dang rgyas pa dang dbang du puṣṭi ba bye kā ri ṇa pa ra yant+ra mant+ra bi ṣa tsūrṇa bi nā shi ni ma hā yo ge shwa ri mdzad ma/ rnal 'byor kyi dbang phyug chen mo/ /gzhan byi 'khrul 'khor dang sngags dang dug phye ma rnam ma ma sarba sa tā nāñtsa rakhye ku ru aṣṭa ma hā dā ru ṇa bha ye bhya stu ra ya tā ra par sel ma/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la srung ce bar mdzod cig /'jigs pa mi bzad 4pa ya / di bya byu pi ṇi sau me mu khi i rda ba lo kṛhā kṛhā/ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ swā hā/chen po brgyad las sgol cig sgrol cig5 /lha'i gzugs can zhi ba'i zhal ma/aṣṭa ma hā bha ya tā ra ba liḥ 29'jigs pa chen po brgyad las sgrol ba'i gtor ma'o/ /oṃ bha ga ba ti stsonda maste pra shaste/oṃ sarba budha ḍā ki nī ye badzra bee ro tsa mbi bcom ldan 'das ma dbu bcad ma/ rab bsngags ma/ sangs rgyas kun gyi mkha' 'gro ma/ rdo rje ye i rda ba lo kṛṇḍa kṛhā/ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ ma ma bi rudzha tsitta kā na bha smi rnam par snang mdzad ma/ bdag la 'gal bar sems pa rnams thal bar mdzod cig /sa 'og rim bdun ku ru sapta pā tā la ga ta sha trun byepā da ta lo ku ru sarba tra ma ma shanti ti puṣṭi rakṣu du gnas pa'i dgra rnams rkang 'og tu gyis/ thams cad du bdag la zhi ba dang rgyas pa dang bsrung ba ba ra ṇa gubho ku ru hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ tri kā ya badzra yo gi ni ba liḥ 30dang bskyab /3 pa dang sba bar mdzod/ sku gsum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gtor ma'o/ /120—1631

oṃ sarba dharma badzā bye kā ra badzra ma hā kā la shā sa na ta la ga ma no pa ka ra chos thams cad rdo rje lhag par byed pa rdo rje nag po chen po bstan pa'i gzhi la 'gro ba'i yid ha hūṃ sthā kṣiṃ i me ba lo kṛṇḍa kṛhā/ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ sarba duṣṭa sa tā da ma/3 ha nye bar byed pa/hā hi tī hu tū te hai ho ho 2haṃ haḥphaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badzra ma hā kā la ba liḥ 31rdo rje nag po chen po'i gtor ma'o/ /oṃ ma hā pra bye gi re sarba shu bha shādhi ka re a shī ti yo ga sha ta sa ha sra kā ra phyir bzlog ma chen mo dge ba dang zhi ba kun byid —ma sbyo ra ba brgya stong phrag brgyad cu jebyed ma/i rda ba bo garghaṃ/ pu྾/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ kṛṇḍi kṛṇḍa/ ye na ke na dzin ma yant+ra mant+ra gang 'a 'a dag bdag 'khrul 'khor dang tant+ra bi ṣa tsūrṇapra yo ga 5 di rka kṛ kurbantu 6 tai tatpabaṃ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/snga gas dang rgyud dang drug gi phye ma'i sbyo ra ba la sogs pa byas pa dang byed du bcug pa de thams cad/pa tsa pa tsa/ ma tha ma tha/ gardza gardza/ tardza tardza/ ta sri ba masta ke ni pa 7de nyid kyi mgo ltung bar ta tu swā hā/ ma hā pra bye gi ra ba liḥ 32gyis shig /phyir bzlog ma chen mo'i gtor ma'o/ /oṃ ma hā pra ti sā 8 ri ma hā sā hā sra pra marda ni ma hā mā yu ri ma thuhā/ shī ta ba so so 'brang 1 chen mo/ stong chen mo/ rab tu 'joms pa/ rma bya chen mo/ bsel ba'i — —1tshal chen ni / ma hā mant+ra nu sā ri ṇi budhi te bye ba ma hādmā no bi tyā de byo ma hā ba lī )ཿ/mo / /gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin ma/ /sangs rgyas bdag nyid chen po dang / /rig pa'i lha mo stobs chen ma/mā ma tī j-i ku ṭī tsi/ btā rā bī tā shaṃ ku shī badzra shri kha lā shwe tā ( —mā ma tī dang khro gnyer can/ /lha mo sgrol ma lcags kyu ma/ /de bzhin rdo rje lcags sgrog ma/ /de bzhin dkar 120—/632

the ba tsa/ ma hā kā lī tsa pū tyastsa badzra dru tyasta thā ba raḥ/ /su pā shī badzra pā shī tsa mo dkar chen ma/ /nag mo che dang pho nya mo/ /de bzhin rdo rje pho nya gzhan/ /zhags bzang rdo rje zhags pa ma//badzra pā ṇi rma hā ba khā/ badzra ma lā ma hā bityā ta bee bā mṛ ta kuṇḍa liḥ/ a pa rā phyag na rdo rje stobs chen ma/ /rdo rje phreng ba rig ma che/ /de bzhin bdud rtsi 'khyel pa dang / /gzhan gyis mi dzi tā ma hā de bī kā la karje ma hā ba la7/ ta thā dha n+ya ma hā bhā gā padma kuṇḍa li re ba tsa/thub lha mo che/ /sme ba nag po stobs chen ma/ /de bzhin dpal yon skal chen ma/ /padma 'khyil pa nyid dang yang //pubee daṇḍi ma ṇi tsū ḍā swa n+ya ke shī tsa dzi ga khā/ ma hā te dzā ta thā de bī dha me tog so ma bcud ster 2 ma/ /gser gyi skra ma dmar ser ma/ /de bzhin lha mo gzi brjid chen//rsā tsa birlu dmā li byā/ /rākṣa sri ka dza ṭī tse ba busgye kṣi ti ka nā yi kāḥ/ /kā pā dpal mo klog gi phreng ldan ma/ /srin mo ral pa gcig ma dang / /sangs rgyas/ sa yi 'dren pa mo/ /thod pa li bee ma hā bhā gā dha sde laṅge shwa rī ta thā/ a tyābya ba ha bo bibyāḥs twa nu gra can ma paskal chen ma/ /de bzhin dpal mo laṅka'i dbang / /gzhan yang rig pa mang po ni/ /sems can yongs ka thu ri kāḥ/ tarya thā/ kā li ka rā li kusgyuṇḍi shaṃ khi ni/ ka ma lākṣi/su 'dzin pa ma/ /'di lta ste/ nag mo mche 9—gtsigs ma grul bum mem dung can ma/ padma'i mig ma/hā rī ti/ ha ri ke shi/ shrī ma ti/ ha ri seṅga le/ lasbe/ pra lasbe/'phrog ma/ skra ljang gu ma/ dpal ldan ma/ 'phrog she ma dmar ser ma/ /'phyang ma/ rab tu 'phyang ma/kā la pā she/ ka la sho da ri/ ya ma du ti/ ya ma rākṣa/ si bhū ta gra sa ni/zhags pa nag po/ bum pa'i lto ma/ gshin rje'i pho nya ma/ gshin rje'i 1 srin mo/ 'byung po za byed ma/pra tī tstsha mi gadzee 11pu྾ dhū 12paṃ dī paṃ ba lo tsa dā snga rma raṭwā ku ru/gtor ma dri dang me tog bdug spo sa 1mar me dang ldan pa 'di 'bul gyis bzhes shig srung bar 13mdzod/ma ma sarba satwa skyonāñtsa sarba bha yo pa dra bee spyo dzā geb tu/bdag dang sems can thams cad 'jigs pa dang nye bar 'tshe ba 'di las lo brgya 'tsho bar shog cig /120—1633

parṣa sha tai pa shya tu sa ra dī sha tai/ se5 she ntu mant+ra pa dāḥsru hā/ston brgya mthong bar shog cig /gsang sngags kyi tshigs hūṃrnams grub par gyur cig /pañtsa rakṣu ba liḥ 33bsrung ba lnga'i gtor ma'o/ /oṃ na mo bha ga ba ti pradzñā pā ra mi te3 /mi te ma hā bī te/ ma hā shwe te/bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma/ dpag med ma/ ser chen ma/ dkar chen ma/ma hā mbi la ratna paṅga snye dza pusta ka ha ste/ i oṃ ④ba bo pa.āoṃ mṛ tai bhuñdza dzi ghra/rin po che'i 'dam skyes sngon po chen pos glegs bam bsnams 'um/oṃ pi tsu pi tsu/ pradzñā badzha gyeni/ dzwa la dzwa la/ me dhwa brja ni/ bye ri bye ri/'jam pa 'jam pa/ shes rab 'phel ma/ 'bar ma 'bar ma/ yid gzhungs bye'aphel ma/ bu bye barbha rngo ni swā hā/ oṃ shu ti smṛ ti bi dza ye/ dhīḥ rngudhwa ra bhā ye swā hā/blo 'phel ma/ oṃ dhīḥkhru ti smre ti ma hā bi dza ye swā hā zer/ thos pa dran pa rnam rgyal ma/ blo 'dzin ma/pradzñā pā ra mi tā ba liḥ 34shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gtor ma'o/ /oṃ ba su dhwa tso1ri ṇi dā ri dhya duḥ kha bha ya ha ri ṇi/ sarba yakṣi ṇi sa me nor rgyun ma dbul ba'i sdug bsngal dang 'jigs pa 'phrog ma/ gnod sbyin ma thams cad tā shī rgyu ā gatstshantu1rte/ i rda ba bo kṛṇḍa kṛṇḍa/ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ oṃ dha ra ṇi dha ra dang ldan pa myur du tshur byon/ṇi swā hā/ ba su dhwa skyer ba liḥ 35nor rgyun ma'i gtor ma'o/ /oṃ pra sanda tā re a mṛ ta mu khi a mṛ (sngeta lo tsa ṣpe/ma ma sarpārba sā dha ni/rab tu dang ba'i sgol ma bdud rtsi'i zhal ma bdud rtsi'i spyan ma/ bdag gi don thams cad sgrub pa/ 720—1634

sarba sahūṃ shaṃ ⑫ ka ri/ i saṃ ba lo kṛṇḍa kṛṇḍi/ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/sems can thams cad bde byed ma/hūṃ phaṭa sthā dhī swā hā/ pra sanda tā ra ba liḥ 36rab tu dang ba'i sgol ma'i gtor ma'o/ /oṃ na maḥsha ba ri ku mā rī bi ṣa dru ṣa bhā ye/ bi ṣa bhakṣa sthā ye tsā la ya/ saṃ ri khrod ma gzhon nu ma dug sun 'byen ma/ dug za byed ma skyod cig /zung du ghaṣṭa ya/ manta mā tai gdun/ a bi dhe te/ i rda ba li bhuñdza dzi ghra oṃ dzāḥdzaḥswā —hā/brdungs shig /glang po stsos pa/ dug 'joms ma/ārja gu lbo ba liḥ na7'phags ma sor mo can gyi gtor ma'o/ /oṃ na mo bha ga ba hye/ badzra ghānta:④/ a ṣpe ka sha 3ta sa ha sra dzwa li ta bcom ldan 'das ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje sa ce'adzin ma/ 'od dang gzi brjid brgya stong dīpta te dzā ma u dra tī sder khyo/ bha yā na kā ma/ a — bye nyi/ tra yā rde raṭwā ghā phrag du ma 'bar ma ( rab tu 'bar ma 'od zer drag mo/ 'jigs rung ma la/ tshur byon tshur byon/sa tya 3 ༷na de bā dī ke/ ye tsā bye sa ma ye na tikhyu te kretā na ba zu ṣi swā mi shī ghra1snye /dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang lha la sogs pa dang / gang gzhan dam tshig la gnas pa de rnams mi rda ba li skyekṛhā kṛṇḍa/ oṃ ma la ma la/ tu lu tu lu/ mu lu mu lu/ tsu lu snang bar byed pa'i rje mo myur du/tsu lu/ dha ma dha ma/ raṅga raṅga / raṅga pa ya raṅga pa ya/ pū ra ya pū ra ya/tshos tshos/ tshos shig tshos shig /gang bar gyis gang bar gyis/ā shaṃ me (stebha ga ba ti (sgom hā badzra gānt+ra ri/ sedhi tsaṇḍa badzra pā ṇi rā dzñā pa bdag bsam pa bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje sa 'dzin chen mo/ grub pa gtum lho9po phyag na rdo rje'i 120—1635

ya ti swā hā/ badzra gānt+ra ri ba liḥ 38bka' bzhin byus/ rdo rje sa 'dzin pa'i gtor ma'o/ /oṃ dhwa dzā gra ke yu re/ dza ya dza ya/ bee dza ya bee dza ya/ dza yā ba rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i 1 dpung rgyan/ rgyal ba rgyal ba/ rnam par rgyal ba rnam par rgyal bakhye/ rgyal ba hi ni/ ma ma sarba sha hūṃ 1 dzambha ya dzambha ya/ stambha ya stambha ya/ ma tha ma tha/thob ma/ bdag gi dgra thams cad rmugs par gyis rmugs par gyis gra sa gra sa/ hūṃ rakṣa rakṣa rmā bha ga shrīce/ i oṃ ba lo kṛṇḍi kṛṇḍa/ bhañdza bhañdza/gzhan gyi dmag rnams rnam par choms choms/pa ra mee bye bee dhwadmā 5ya bidhwadmā ya/ sha tū na sha tūn tsa la tsa la tsi li tsi li/ tu lu dgra rnams skyod skyo da/tu lu/ ga la ga la/ ki li ki lngab/ ku lu ku lu/ sarba ta thā ga tā ba lo ki te de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kun tu swā hā/ gu ṇa rā dza pā bhā se swā hā/ tsabye 6rka bee ma le swā hā/ sarba nakṣa tra tsa gzigs ma/ yon tan rgyal po rab snang ma/ zla ba nyi ma dri med ma/ rgyu skar thams cad mi ka ri bee swā hā/ rakṣa rakṣa/ sarba ta thā ga te 3 bhyaḥswā hā/ dhwa dzā gra gas la bar byed marte / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rnams la// rgyal mtshan rtse ke yu rā ba liḥ 39mo'i dpung rgyan gyi gtor ma'o/ /oṃ na mo bha ga ba ti uṣṭi ṣa bi dza ye/ ma ma 9 mṛ kyu nā sha ya nā sha ya/bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor rnam par rgya' ma/ bdag gi 'chi bdag nyams par bi nā shā ya bi nā shā ya/ bee dhwadmā ya bi dhwadmā ya/ i do ba lo kṛṇḍa kṛṇḍi/gyis nyams par gyis/ rnam par nyams par gyis rnam par nyams par gyis/ rnam par choms choms/120—1636

dīrgha hūṃyu mi ku ru swā ste swā hā/ uṣṭi ṣa bi dza yā ba liḥ 40bdag gi tshe bsrings shig bde legs gzhi tshugs/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal ma'i gtor ma'o/ /oṃ sebye ka bī rā ya bī re shā ya ka ru rja pe sha la j-i da yā ya ni lo twa la dpa' bo gcig tu sgrub pa la/ dpa' bo'i dbang po la/ snying rje dang des pa'i thugs can la/hastu ya i rda ba dzi kṛhā kṛhā tī tā byeb bhu dze shābye snyeku ru sarba sirnyi ku ru hūṃ hūṃ utrul sngon po phyag na bsnams pa la/ bzung ste longs spyad de/phaṭa swā hā/ siddhi ka bī ra ba liḥ 41dpa' bo gcig tu sgrub pa'i gtor ma'o/ /oṃ ya mānta kā ya ya ma dī ṣa shā ya dīḥ sgyiḥbi kṛ tā na nā ya nā gā bha ra ṇa gshin zirje mthar byed/ gshin rje 'jigs par byed pa/ rnam par 'gyur ba'i zhal can klu'i ya tre lo kya bi marda na daṇḍa hasthā ya sarba mā ra ba la bee nā sha nā ya i phyarda ba lo kṛṇḍa rgyan can/ 'jig rten gsum rnam par 'joms pa'i dbyug pa phyag na bsnams pa/ bdud dpung greṇḍa / ma ma bisna na ha ra ha ra tsa turmā rā na ni bā ra ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/rnam par 'joms pa/ya mānta ka ba liḥ 42gshin rje mthar byed kyi gtor ma'o/ /oṃ bibyānta ka la hā kro 6 dha ma hā ba la pa rā kra ma i saṃ ba lo kṛṇḍa kṛṇḍa/bgegs mthar byed khro bo chen po stobs po che pha rol gnon pa/kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ ma ma sarba beespyon tstsha da tstsha da/ bhe da bhe da/ dru tai/ da ha da ha/pa tsa pa tsa/ ma tha ma tha/ āḥbispyon ke ta hūṃ swā hā/ bispyonta ka ba liḥ 43bgegs mthar byed kyi gtor ma'o/ /oṃ bha ga ba ti gra ha mā tri ke sarba gra ha na kṣa tra bha ya nā shi ni sarba de ba nā ga bcom ldan 'das ma gza' rnams kyi yum/ gza' dang rgyu skar thams cad kyi 3'jigs pa thams 720—1637

yakṣa di bha ya byu yu pa sha ma ni rā dza tso ra'i di bha ya bi dhwadma ni bha ga cad sel ma/ lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin la sogs pa thams cad kyi 'jigs pa nye bar zhi byed ma/ rgyal po ba ti gra hā mā tre ke sa rba gra ha na kṣa tā di bhiḥ shi s+ho ā gatstsha dang chom rkun ṭwāl sogs pa'i 'jigs pa rnam par 'joms ma/ bcom ldan 'das ma gza' rnams kyi yum/ā gatstsha/ i rda ba bo kṛṇḍa kṛhā/ ma ma sarba bibyān ha ra ha ra/ shādhi puṣṭi gza' dang rgyu 2skar la sogs pa thams cad lhan cig tu myur du byon/rakṣuñtsa me ku ru hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ gra ha mā tre kā ba liḥ 44gza' yum gyi gtor ma'o/ /oṃ na mo lo ka nā thā ya de bā su ra na ra yakṣa rākṣa snye de bhi rbandi ta 'jig rten mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha dang lha ma yin dang mi dang / gnod sbyin dang srin pā da padma ya a she ṣa nā ra ka sa twodha ra ṇa tsadhī ④ tatpa pā ya ma hā kā ku po la so gas pa rnams kyi zhabs kyi padmo la phyag bya ba/ dmyal ba'i sems can ma lus 'don par dgongs pa ṇi kā ya i rda ba lo du ddhā di sa nyi haṃ kṛṇḍa kṛṇḍa/ rmā sarba satā bya lhur mdzad pa/ thugs rje chen po can la / 'o ma sogs dang bcas pa'i gtor ma 'di zung zung /na ra kā di duḥ khā dutta ra ya khā dutta ra ya/ udha ra/ udha ra/bdag dang sems can thams cad dmyal ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal las sgrol sgol/ phyung phyung /sa mudha ra sa muddhā ra/ budha sa hye na dharma sa hye 3 na saṃ gha sa hye na sa tya bākun nas thophyung phyung / sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang chos kyi bden pa dang / dge 'dun gyi bden pas/ de sa tya na klu.oṃ yīḥsthāḥ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ sarba lo ke shwa ra ba liḥ 45'jig rten dbang phyug thams cad kyi gtor ma'o/ /oṃ na maḥ shrī byekha sarja ṇa ya tre lo kya dadzdza rja ya/phyag 'tshal dpal mkha' la gshegs pa 'jig rten gsum kyi me long / e tā gra tsitta ⑨ya/120—1638

sa ka la ro ga dā ri dhya duḥ/ kha dru ta mu pa sha ma nā ya i rda ba lo nad dang dbul ba dang / saṃ kyeha duḥ/ duḥkha du ri to pa zer te 'og ma don bzang / bzod par dka' ba'i dugha di sa hi de kṛ tī two pa ju bye shādhi puṣṭi rakṣuñtsa me ku ru oṃ āḥdhīḥhūṃ phaṭa swā hā/sdug bsngal mtha' dag myur du zhi bar mdzad pa/ bzung khruste longs spyad nas/kha sadzee shā ba liḥ 46mkha' la gshegs pa'i gtor ma'o/ /oṃ na mo budha ya/ ma hā ka ru zla bhā ra bha ri ta j-i da yā ya/ pa rārma ba sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /snying rje chen po'i khur gyis gang ba'i thugs can/ gzhan gyi don tā ga ta tsiṭwā ya tram̐ dha tu kai ka mūrta ye sa tārba ma hā duḥka ra kā ri ṇi i rda mnyam pa nyid rtogs pa'i thugs can/ khams gsum pa'i sku gcig pu rang gi don don chen po mdzad pa ba bo di bya garnya barṇa ra swa 7pe tai bu byu bye rmā sarba sahūṃ byu nuṭwā thurā yī samyagre mdzad pa/ lha'i dri dang kha dog dang / mu pa bhu rdzu zer te don gcig /rgya dpe gcig na 'di gnyis pa ra bya snang /bo sgo pra ti jo ba ya oṃ āḥ su ga ta badzra tu ྾ hoḥhūṃ ro dang ldan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes te bdag dang sems can thams cad bla na med pa yang dag swā hā / shri bu dha bha ṣṭa ra ka par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la rab tu khod cig /bde gshegs rdo rje dgyes pa/ dpal sangs rgyas rje btsun ba liḥ 47gyi gtor ma'o phye/ /oṃ mṛ kyu pañtsa ni tā re kā lā kā la mṛ tyā ha re dā re khyedru duḥkha/'chi ba bslu ba'i sgrol ma/ dus dang dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba 'phrog ma dbul ba dang / sdug bsngal bha yo ka re aṣṭa ma hā bha ya ha re khaṅgāñdza na pā du ka bha dra gha ṭā di gyi 'jigs pa 'jig spupar byed ma/ 'jigs pa chen po brgyad 'phrog ma ral gri dang mig sman dang lham 120—1639

sidhi de/ bha ga ba ti tā re i rda ba bo palnga dang bum pa bzang po la sogs pa'i dngos grub stsol ma/ bcom ldan 'das 3snam sgrol ma/mṛ tai kṛṇḍa kṛṇḍa/ ma mamṛ hūṃ nā sha ya nā sha ya/ oṃ tā re tuṭwā snyere tu re swā hā/sdug bsngal myur du sgrol ba'i sgrol ma/mṛ tru pañtsa mbi tā rā ba liḥ rga'achi ba bslu ba'i sgol ma'i gtor ma'o/ /oṃ na mo ratna tra yā ya na mo ma ṇi bha dra ya ma hā yakṣa se nā pa ta ye3/dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag 'tshal nor bu bzang po la/ /gnod sbyin sde oṃ und+rarmi dzambha la dza lend+ra ya i rda ba bo kṛṇḍa kṛṇḍa/ kha kha/ khā nyi khā hi/dpon chen po la/ /'chol jepa rmugs 'dzin chu'i dbang po la/ma hā ba su ma me de hi da dā ya swā hā/ grosgo ṣṭha dzambha la ba liḥ gobadag la nor chen po sbyin du chug cig /'chol byepa rmugs 'dzin byi gtor ma'o/ /oṃ āḥsthā hūṃ shudzee ka dza ṭī khye / i rda ba bo kṛṇḍa grehā/ ghā ṭa ya sarba ral gcig ma dkar mo/ phyes 7 shig gdug pa can duṣṭan hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ sarba mā ra ba la bi nā sha nā shādzee da byā ta/ shukli ka thams cad/ rnam par gshegs pa'i phyir du sbyin par bya ste/ ral gcig ma dza ṭi 8 ba liḥ 50dkar mo'i gtor ma'o/ /oṃ na maḥka ya wāñtsitta bhyaḥ/ karko ṭa shaṃ kha pā la a nanta pā su ki takṣa ka /phyag 'tshal sgu gsung thugs rnams la/ stobs rgyu/ dung skyong mtha' yas dang / nor rgyas bu dang /ku li ka padma ma hā padme bhyo nā ga rā dze bhya i rda ba lo nā no pa ka ra ṇa duḥkhā/'jog po dang / rigs spre/ldan padma padma chen po ste klu'i rgyal po rnams nyer spyod dang bcas pa'i gtor ma 'di/120—1640

sa nyi tai kṛhā kṛṇḍa/ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ ma ma na sernyi pra yatstsha oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ nā ga ba liḥ 51klu'i gtor ma'o/ /oṃ na maḥshrī mi tre ya nā thā ya/ bhā bi bee tyā tsa ra ṇa saspanda samyahūṃ buddhā byams pa mgon po la tsho/ sgom pa'i rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs ya / sarba sa tā ze ṇa 4 dra bi ta tsiṭwā ya/rgyas—/ bā bu rnyi tyā nutta rā lnga samyakle/sne du : tyā nutta rā dzee samyakle zer/ sems can thams cad kyi don gyis i rda ba lo di bya sde gandha barṇa ra so pe rda snye u pa bhu bye rmā/ sarba satwo 6 brlan pa'i thugs la/ phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha rdzas kyi dri dang kha dog dang ro dang ldan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes te/bya saṃ 7 sā duḥkhārṇa bā ra hūṃ bo sgo pra ti ṣṭha pa yi 6 si oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa bdag dang sems can thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral te/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas swā hā/ mai tri ya ba liḥ 52kyi sa la 'khod par mdzod cig /byams pa'i gtor ma'o/ /oṃ ind+ra dza ma dza la dza dzakṣa byu ta tsu ba sgo bā u rakṣa tsand+ra sudzdza dbang po/ gshin rje/ chu lha/ gnod sbyin/ 'byung po/ me lha 〉/ rlung lha/ srin po/ zla ba/ nyi ma/mā da babee tā li aṣṭha sābee swā hā/ i rda ba bo byuñdza dzi gha phu sma dhū 11pa rmā sa dzi gha stsos 1shām/ mazil/ 'og na/ sbrul brgyad/ 'di snomasashā / me tog /bdug 1 pa sha /asma sabee sā dha khārnyi khu ṇi phe ḍa gā da hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā hūṃ/nya sha bdag gi thams cad bsgrubs bzod par gsol gnod pa so la11/ā rya nutpanda tā ta oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ shrī mehe ru ka ba liḥ 53da 'di dpe shas cher mi 'dug / dpal he ru ka'i gtor ma'o/ /oṃ sa ha dza sadza ra āḥ hūṃ ā gatstsha ā gatstsha/ shī rgyu 18i rda ba lo kṛṇḍi kṛhā/lhan skyes sdom popa/ gsol zhing 'thung ste 120—1641

sarba satārja i tyā di nā/ oṃ badzra muḥswa he tya ṣpe na bi sardza sems can don kun mdzad ces bya ba la sogs pa dang / oṃ badzra muḥswā hā zhes bya ba 'dis gshegs su ye ta/ sadhand+ra ba liḥ 56gsol bar bya ste/ dam pa'i chos kyi gtor ma'o/ /oṃ bra dmā tyā de ba tāḥsarbe inda rya/ ma ma rakṣa kāḥnā ga /gandha sna tshangs pa la sogs pa'i lha rnams dang dbang po la sogs pa bdag bsrung ba'i klu dang / dri za yakṣu : saṃ tri 2 stu ba li nā sa dā/ oṃ a kā rte ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā rde a jerya nutpanda dang gnod sbyin rnams rtag tu gtor mas tshim par mdzod/tā ta oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ sarba kādhī 5 ka pa liḥ 57la/sa thams cad pa'i gtor ma'o/ /oṃ āḥrā hu kā māghi tsand+ra srurya oṃ ga la bu dha dṛ haspa ti shu kra ke tu she 6sgra gcan7/ dus me/ zla ba/ nyi ma/ bkra shis gza' lhag /phur bu/ pa sa/ngas/ni : re bhyopho n+ya de bhyaḥ/ tsa de ba nā ga yakṣa gandhaṭwā su ra ga ru ḍa kinda ra ma ho mjug rings/ / spen pa/ gzhan yang / lha klu/ gnod sbyin/ dri za/ lha ma yin nam mkha' lding /ra gā di bhya i rda ba bo kṛtta kṛṇḍa/ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ sarba gra ha ba boḥ 58mi'am ci/ lto 'phye chen po la sogs pa rnams/ gza' thams cad kyi gtor ma'o/ /oṃ ma hā sā ha sra pra marda ni pi tyā rarnyi sarba sha hūṃ 11pi dā ra ṇi ma ma sarba stong chen mo rab tu 'joms ma/ rig 1 snga gas kyi rgyal mo/ dgra thams cad rnam par 'joms ma/sa tā na ñtsa shādzhai /— ku ru puṣṭi ku ru skyepa bye ku ru sarba da nā ga gandhadzā/ su ra ga ru ḍa kinda ra ma ho ra ga bhū ta pre ta pi shā tsā dī na da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa ma tha ma tha bi dhū dma 15ya ma hā sā ha sra pra marda mbi i rda ba lo kṛṇḍa kṛṇḍa rma sarba sa hūṃ byu rakṣa rakṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa rṣaswā hā/ ma hā sā ha sra pra mardi ni ba liḥ 59stong chen mo rab tu 'joms ma'i gtor ma'o/ /120—1643

༄/ /tsand+ra pa'i yi ge'i mdo'i 'grel pa gsar 'gyur bzhugs/rte༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ tsand+ra byā ka ra ṇa baṇḍi sru tra ṇi dṛtrīḥ/ bod skad du/ lung ston pa tsand+ra pa'i yi ge'i mdo'i 'grel pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shin tu rgyal dka' bdud kyi stobs bcom ste/ /rnyed dka'i go 'phang nyams pa med brnyes pa/ /gzhan don legs mdzad rgud pa mi mnga' ba'i/ /mi mchog kun mkhyen de la phyag 'tshal nas/ /sgra yi bstan bcos mngon par mi shes shing / /rang gi don ni tshol bar 'dod pa la/ /yi ge'i mdo yi rnam par 'grel 3pa ni/ /bdag gis mdor bsdus pa yis 3brjod par bya/ /bdud kyis nyer sgyur skye bo ngan/ /yid ngani phrag dog gis bcom phyir/ /yon tan skyon dag mi shes pas/ /skyon med pa yang rtag tu skyon//skye bo dam pa ring nas bcom na yang / /da ltar gzhan kyi skyon dag rgyas mi byed//skye dgu rnams la nam yang mi brnyas pa'i/ /yon tan phyogs su lhung ba der phyag 120/de1650

'tshal / /de la re zhig dang por sgra'i mtshan nyid nye bar brjod par bya ba ni/ /nam 'gyur rnyed zhig na/ nam mkha' rlung las rab tu byung zhing lus las ni/ /yang dag rim pas gyen bskyod kha nang sgra ring 'di/ /gnas rnams de ma thag par rab tu rnam rtsol ldan/ /yi ge nyid du kun du 'gro ba gang de'i sgra/ /zhes pa snang ste 'gyur mi bde mkha' rlung las 'byung dang lus las dang / brjod dang kha dang nye ba nā da ste/ gnas gzhan snarnams su dbye bar byed pa yis/ /yi ge nyid du 'byung gang sgra yin no/ /nam mkha' dang rlung dang zhes pa ni nam mkha' dang rlung dag las de dag 'byung ba'i rgyu gang yin pa de nam mkha' dang rlung las byung ba'o/ /yang na nam mkha' dang rlung las 'byung ba ni skye ba ste skye'o zhes pa'i don to/ /lus las zhes pa ni lus kyi phyogs gcig lte ba'i phyogs las so/ /brjod pa zhes pa ni yang dag par steng nas phyir 'byung ba'i bar du 'gro'o zhes pa'o / /kha dang nye ba ni 'ong ba ste thob po zhes pa'i don no/ /ci yis de ni nā da'i sgrar 'gyur zhe na mi gsal ba'i sgra zhes pa'o/ /gnas gzhan rnams ni brgyad de/ khog pa/ mgrin pa/ spyi bo/ lce rtsa/ so/ sna/ mchu/rkan kyernams te/ de skad du'ang / yi ge'i gnas ni brgyad yin te/ khog pa mgrin pa spyi bo dang / /de bzhin lce rtse 4so dang sna/ /mchu dag dang ni rkan rnams so/ /de rnams kyang gang la ma ltos pa'i yeganas gzhan du brjod pa'o/ /khog pa'i gnas ni mgrin pa la ma ltos pa'i gnas te gnas gzhan mgren pa'i gnas las mi brjod pas khog par blta'o/ /gnas gzhan rnams kyang gzhan kho nar blta bar bya'o/ /des na de nyid gnas gzhan rnams su dbye bar byed pas so sor bya ba yin no/ /gang yi ge a yig la sogs pa rnams kyi gzugs su 'byung ba de ni sgra zhes gsal bar rtogs par bya'o/ /sgra gang gi mtshan nyid nye 120—1651

bar brjod pa de ni spyi'i bdag nyid do/ /ci ste yi ge de rnams ci las skye bar 'gyur zhe 1na smras pa/ gnas dang byed pa dang rtsol ba rnams las yi ge rnams skye'o zhes pa ste/ gnas ni sngar bshad pa'i khog pa dang mgrin pa la sogs pa'o / /byed pa ni lce'i rtsa ba la sogs pa'o/ /rtsol ba ni 'phrad pa la sogs pa'o / /gnas/ dang byed pa dang rtsol ba ni/ gnas dang 4byed nga/ dang 5rtsol ba rnams so/ /de rnams las yi ge a yig la 6sogs pa rnams skye ba ste mngon par 'byung ba'o/ /de rnams kyi nang nas yi ge rnams ci/ gnas ni ci/rtsol ba ni ci/ rnam par gzhag rā pa byu zhe na/ smras pa/ de la zhes pa ni nges/ gzung la bdun pa ste/ re zhig gnas rnam par bshad pa'ang 'di'o zhes bsams pa'o/ /a ku ha rnam par bcad nga/ rnams kyi mgrin nga/'o/ /mgrin nga/ las byung ba ni mgren nga/'i gnas te mgren pa'i gnas nas brjod pa'o/ /de dag ci zhe na/ a ku ha rnam par bcad pa rnams so/ /a ni a yig go/ /ku ni ka / sde'o/ /ha ni ha yig go/ /rnam par bcad nga/'i yang a/ sbyar ba ni brjod pa'i rten no/ /de rnams mgren pa'i gnas las 'byung bar shes par bya'o/ /ita eta meeta rnams kyi mgrin pa dang rkan no/ /rkan las gyur pa ni rkan can no / /mgren nga/ dang rkan dang zhes/ pa ni mgrin rkan gyi gnas so/ /ci rnams kyi zhe na ita ni i yin no/ /eta ni e yin no/ /ita ni i yin no/ /ita eta ita de rnams so/ /ta pha rol tu byed pa ni brjod bde ba'i don du'o/ /uta khrota auta rnams kyi mgrin mchu'o/ /mgrin pa dang mchu ni mgrin mchu'i gnas so/ /uta ni ci zhe na u yig go/ /khrota ni i yig go/ /auta —ni au yig go/ /uta auta ste de rnams so/ /ta pha rol tu byed pa tsam kyang snga ma 120—1652

bzhin no/ /ri ṭu ra ṣa rnams kyi spyi bo'o/ /ṛ ni ṛ yin no/ /ṭu ni ṭa sde'o//ra ni re pha'o/ /ṣa ni ṣa yig gi don no/ /ṛ ṭu ra ṣa rnams kyi gnas ni spyi bo'o / /'dir sngon rnged pa bsam par bya ba ni 'di yin te zhes re 1pha 'di ra 2yig gi dang po'am 'on te dbus sam mthar gnas/ de la gal te re zhig dang por dam 'cha' na/ agir/ ṛ ta dṛ bye zhes pa 'di la ṛ yig de/gang ni dang por zhes/ pa 'di'i phyir/ asniḥ ste ṛta ces 5pa 'di la/ra'i ra la zhes pa 'dis dbye bar 6'gyur ro/ /de ltar yang yang spre na ra dbyi bas ring bor thal lo/ /de'i phyir dang bor mi spyor te/ 'on te/ mthar nges par gzung ba de ltar yod na/ ho tri ra thanta ri zhes pa 'dir/ ra'i ra la dbyi bar 'gyur ba'i phyir de yang ma yin no/ /de nas nges par bya ba ni de bzhin du/ dṛ rde zhes pa 'dir mtshon bya ra ṣa 'a/sa na'i ṇa'o zhes pa 'dir mtshon bya ra ṣa las na'i ṇa'o zhes pa'i sbyor ba 'dis ṇa nyid du mi 'gyur ro zhes so / /bar du mi thob pa kho na yod pa 'di ni ma nges nga/'i gnas kyi bya ba'i dbang las kyang rnam nga/ra shes so/ /des na ji ltar bya ba rnams bsgrub pa'i skyon rnams kyang spang bar bya'o/ /dper na bya rog lta ba bzhin du 'di khas blang bar bya ste/ bya rog lta bar byed nga/ de ni nang dgang gi logs lta bar byed pa de dang de nyid du 'di'i dbang po 'gro'o/ /de skad du'ang / dang por ambiḥṛ ti mthong / /de nas ho tri ra than bzhag /bar du dṛ rde gzhag par bya/ /de phyir bya rog lta bzhin brjod/ /ces so/ /so no '-i tu la sa rnams kyi'o/ /dza ni dza yin no/ /tu ni ta sde'o/ /la ni la yig go/ /sa ni sa yig go/ /'-i tu la sa rnams so/ /'di rnams kyi gnas ni so yin par rtogs par bya'o/ /120—/653

sna ni rjes su nga ro'i 'o/ /i zhes pa rjes su nga ro ste zla ba phyed pa can no/ /de'i gnas ni sna'o/ /nga nya ṇa na ma rnams ni rang gi gnas dang rjes su sna ldan no / /rang gi zhes pa ni mgrin pa rkan/ spyi so/ mchu dag go/ /gnas kyi mtshan nyid ni 1gang dag sna dang rjes su 'byel ba'i mtha' can nam2/ rang gi gnas dang rjes su sna ldan pa'o/ /nga yig gi rang gi gnas ni mgrin pa ste/ka sde yin pa'i phyir ro/ /nya yig gi rang gnas ni rkan te/ tsa sde yin pa'i phyir ro/ /ṇa yig gi rang gi gnas ni spyi bo ste ṭa sde yin pa'i phyir ro/ /na yig gi rang gi gnas ni so ste/ ta sde yin pa'i phyir ro/ /ma yig gi rang gi gnas ni mchu dag ste/ pa sde yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de skad du bshad par 'gyur ba ni/ da yig la sogs pa re re'ang / mgrin pa la sogs pa re re'i gnas/ nye bar mtshon pas na/ gnas zhes pa'o/ /i tsu ya sha rnams kyi rkan no//i ta ni i yig go/ /tsu ni tsa sde'o/ /ya ni ya yig go/ /sha ni sha yig go/ /de rnams i 4tsu ya sha rnams so/ /de rnams kyi gnas ni rkan no/ /mchu dag ni u dang pu dang mchu dang nye ba can rnams kyi'o/ /u ni u yig go/ /pu ni pa sde'o/ /mchu dang nye bar can ni pa yig dang pha yig gi steng du bzhag pa'i yi ge glang po che'i bum pa'i rnam pa can no/ /'di ni mchu dang nye ba can te mchu las 'byung bar blta bar bya'o/ /so dang mchu ni wa yig bo'o/ /so dang mchu ste wa yig gi gnas su rtogs par bya'o/ /de ltar yi ge'i rim pa ji lta bas gnas kyi spros pa mngon par brjod de/ byed pa nas brtsams nas smras pa/byed pa ni lce'i rtsa ba can gyi lce'i rtsa ba'o zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ /ka yig dang kha yig dag gi steng du bzhag pa'i rdo rje'i rnam pa'i yi ge'o/ /lce'i rtsa ba can de'i 120—1654

byed pa ni lce'i rtsa bas byed do/ /'dis ni 'di'i byed pa dang gnas kyang 'di nyid du rtogs 1par bya'o/ /lce dbus 1 rnams kyi ni rkan gyi snyeganas las byung ba sngar bshad pa rnams kyi 4 lce'i dbus byed par gzung ngo / /lce'i rtse mo dang nye ba ni/ /spyi bo las byung ba rnams kyi'o/ /spyi bo'i gnas nas byung ba rnams kyi ni/ lce'i rtse mo dang nye ba goms pa ste/ rtse mo dang nye ba ni byed par rtogs par bya'o/ /so las byung ba rnams kyi ni lce'i rtse mo'o/ /lce rtse'i mtha' thug pa ni so'i gnas las byung ba rnams kyi byed par blta bar bya'o/ /lhag ma rnams ni rang gi gnas kyi byed pa can no/ /gang lhag ma rnams kyi byed pa ni rang gi gnas kho na byed pa ste rang gi gnas byed pa yin pa 'dis ni byed pa bzhi mngon par sgrub pa gzhan ma bshad pa'i gnas las byung ba rnams rang gi gnas kho na las rtogs par bya'o/ /de ltar byed pa mngon par brjod nas rtsol ba nye bar bstan pa'i phyir smras pa/ rtsol ba rnam pa gnyis te zhes pa la sogs pa ste/ches rab tu 'bad pas na rtsol ba ste byed pa rnams kyi nang du gtogs pa'i yon tan gyi khyad par las nges par byung ba'i rang bzhin te/ nam du'ang 'di'i rang bzhin mtha' dag par nges par mi nus so/ /des na 'dir yang de bzhin kho nar rnam par bshad pa brtsam 7par bya zhes pa'o/ /de yang rnam pa gnyis te/ji ltar zhe na/ nang dang phyi rol gyi rab tu byed pa gnyis so/ /nang ni 'u nang du 'jug pa'i byed pa'i nang du son par ro 2/ /de las bzlog pa ni phyi rol lo//de la'i sgra ni 'dir nges gzung la 'jug go/ /nang ni ji srid ma nor ba khyebarjod do zhes pa de srid du'o/ /nang gi rtsol ba 'di la'ang btsums pa dang phye ba dang phrad pa dang cung zad phrad pa'i dbye bas phye ba rnam pa bzhir 'gyur ro/ /120—1655

btsums pa ni a yig gi'o/ /mgrin pa phye ba ma yin pas brjod pa ni btsums pa ste/ a yig gi yin par bzhag go/ /de las phye ba ni dbyangs rnams dang dro ba rnams kyi'o/ /phye 1ba zhes pa ni mgren pa ma bsdams pas brjod pa'i yi ge ā yig dang e yig dang o yig ste/ dbyangs yig rnams dang sde pa'i gnyis pa dang bzhi pa dang sha ṣa sa ha rnams te dro —ba rnams so/ /de rnams las phye ba nyid ni eta meeta dag gi'o/ /de rnams las kyang lhag par phye ba ni/e yig dang mee yig dag gi'o/ /de dag las ota auta dag gi'o/ /e yig dang i yig de rnams 'a/sa kyang ches cher phye ba ni/ o yig dang au yig dag go/ /de dag las kyang ā yig gi'o/ /e yig dang au yig de dag las kyang lhag par phye ba yin pa ā yig gi'o/ /phrad pa ni reg pa rnams kyi'o/ /phrad pa ni gnas gang du yi ge de rnams mthon por brjod pa rtsol ba chen pos btsir nas 'phrad pa de rnams te/ ka sde dang / tsa sde dang / ṭa sde dang / ta sde dang / pa sde rnams su bshad pa ni phrad pa 5mngon par brjod do/ /cung zad phrad nga/ ni mthar gnas 6 kyi'o/ /bshad ma thag pa las bzlog pa/ mthar gnas te/ya ra la wa rnams nang du cung zad phrad pa mngon par brjod do/ /phyi rol ni sde nga/ rnams kyi dang po dang gnyis pa rnams dang sha dang ṣa dang sa dang rnam par bcad pa dang lce rtsa can dang mchu dang nye ba'ang phyi rol du byung ba ni phyi'i rtsol ba'o / /ci rnams kyi zhe na/ sde pa lnga po rnams kyi dang po dang gnyis pa rnams te/ ka kha tsa tsha ṭa ṭha ta tha pa pha zhes bya ba de rnams dang / gang yang sha yig dang / ṣa yig dang sa yig dang rnam par bcad pa dang lce rtsa can dang mchu dang nye ba can rnams kyang ste/ khyad par ci zhe 1na/ mgrin pa phye bas sgra 720—/656

rjes su rtogs pa ni sgra med pa rnams yin la/ phye ba ni mgrin pa'i bu ga ma bsdams pas brjod pa gang dag mgrin pa phye bas sgra rjes su ste/ phyi nas grag pa gang yin pa de rnams ni sgra rjes su rtogs pa'o/ /sgra zhes bya ba'i yon tan gang la med pa de rnams sgra med rnams so/ /dang po dang gsum pa rnams dang /lnga pa rnams dang mthar gnas rnams srog chung ba'o/ /gang sde pa rnams kyi dang po dang gsum pa dang lnga pa rnams te/ ka ga nga tsa dza 1ṭa ḍa ṇa ta da na pa ba ma zhes bya ba rnams so/ /gang yang mthar gnas ya ra la wa 'di rnams thams cad srog chung ba rnams nyid do/ /ci'i phyir zhe na/ srog ces bya ba'i rlung 'di rnams la chung zhing phra bas so/ /cig shos rnams srog che ba'o/ /cig shos ni sngar ma brjod pa'i sde pa lnga'i gnyis pa rnams dang bzhi pa rnams te/ kha gha tsha pta ṭha dha pha bha zhes bya ba rnams so/ /sha ṣa sa ha 'di rnams kyang brjod ma thag pa las bzlog pa sa nges par gzung ngo / /gsum pa dang bzhi pa dang lnga nga/ rjes su nga ro dang bcas pa rnams dang mthar gnas dang ha yig rnams so/ /sde pa lnga'i gsum pa rnams dang bzhi pa rnams dang lnga nga/ rnams te/ ga gha nga dza dzha nya ḍa shwe ṇa da dha na ba bha ma zhes bya ba rnams rjes su nga ror bcas pas rjes su nga ro dang bcas pa'i ya yig dang re pha dang la yig dang wa yig dang ha yig rnams kyang ste/ mgrin pa btsums 4pas sgra rjes su rtogs pa 'di dag ni sgra dang ldan pa'o / /btsums pa ni phye ba ma yin pa la sogs pa sngar bzhin yin la/ sgra'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i phyir sgra ldan no/ /gnyis pa dang bzhi pa dang sha ṣa sa 5rnams dro ba'o/ /gang dag sde pa lnga'i gnyis pa dang bzhi pa ste/ gnyis pa dang bzhi pa rnams ni kha gha tsha dzha ṭha zwa tha dha pha bha rnams su mngon par brjod pa 120—1657

rnams dang sha ṣa sa ha rnams kyang ste/ 'di dag thams cad dro ba nyid kyi yon tan dang ldan pas dro ba rnams kyi ming can du 'gyur ro zhes pa 'di ni phyi'i rtsol ba'o / /de ltar bar ma chad du brjod pa de rnams ni phyi'i rtsol bar rig par bya'o / /'dir yang a yig ni thung ngu dang ring po dang shin tu ring po zhes pa rnam 1pa gsum du dbye'o/ /'dir zhes pa yi ge'i rab tu byed pa 'di la ste/a yig ni a'i yi ge'o/ /de yang thung ngu dang ring po dang shin tu ring po'i rab tu byed pas gsum mo/ /dbye ba ni/ eta 3dang ita tu 'gyur ro/ /barṇa smos pas gnas skabs thams cad du ldan pa nyid de/ a'i rigs 'dzin zhing /de ltar gzhan du'ang ngo / /te te la u dātta dang / a nu dātta dang swa ri tas guphye ba dang rjes su sna ldan dang bcas ༄pas rjes su sna ldan med pa'i dbye bas rnam pa bco brgyad du 'gyur ro/ /te te ba ste/ thung ngu la sogs pa re re la u dātta dang a phyanu dātta dang swa ri tas 6phye bas rnam pa gsum du dbye bar 'gyur ro//thung ngu la sogs pa re re po de nyid slar yang rjes su sna ldan dang bcas pa dang rjes su sna ldan med pa nyid kyis nyams su phye bas de ltar gsum po rnams so sor rnam pa drug tu 'gyur ro/ /rnam pa drug po ni bco brgyad du 'gyur ro/ /de ltar i'i yi ge dang u'i yi ge dang ṛ'i yi ge'ang ngo / /ji ltar a yig la thung ngu la sogs pa'i rab tu byed pa ④phye bas rnam pa bco brgyad du 'gyur ba de ltar e yig la sogs pa'i yi ge'ang snyedabye bar 'gyur ro/ /lo'i yi ge la ring po yod pa ma yin te/ de nas rnam pa bcu gnyis su 'gyur ro/ /lo 9yig thung ngu dang shin tu ring por phye bas bcu gnyis kho na yin te/ ring por dbye ba'i rab tu byed pa drug pa rsha med pa'i phyir ro/ /mtshams spyor gyi yi ge rnams la 120—1658

thung ngu yod pa ma yin te/ de na de rnams kyang rnam pa bcu gnyis rnams su 'gyur ro/ /e yig la sogs pa yi ge bzhi rnams ni mtshams sbyor yi ge rnams te/de la'ang skyathung ngu rkyedrug rnams med pas ring po dang shin tu ring po rgyas par bya snyebs re re la bcu gnyis kho na'o/ /yi ge gnyis rnams kyang ngo / /kyang gi sgra ni mtshams spyor yi ge rnams su mngon par 'byel lo/ /de rnams kyang yi ge re re ba nyid du 'gyur ro/ /ci a yig dag dang ṛ yig dang lo ④yig rnams kyi ches gzhan pa tshogs pa la e yig tu 'gyur ba de bzhin du e yig dag kyang i yig ste 'di dag kyang u yig dang spru yig rnams kyi ches gzhan pa tshogs pa la o yig tu 'gyur ba yod pa de bzhin du o yig kun tu brjod pa la'ang au yig go/ /'di dag i yig dang ste yig dang / spru yig dang / u yig rnams kyi cig 5 shos phrad pa la'ang e yig dang o yig dag 'byung ba yod pa ma yin nam zhe na/yod pa bden te/ de rnams e yig dang o yig smos pas gzung gyeba'i phyir 'di dag so sor brjod do/ /phyi mo gcig pa thung ngu'o/ /thung ngu'i yi ge ni phyi mo gcig can du bstan to/ /phyi mo gnyis pa ring po'o/ /ring po ni phyi mo gnyis pa can du brjod do/ /phyi mo gsum pa plu ta'o/ /phyi mo gnyis pa'i rigs pas plu ta mngon par brjod par 'gyur ro/ /mthon po rnams kyis u dātta'o / /gang dag nga ro mthon pos klumangon par brjod pa'i yi ge de ni u dātta'obye / /dma' ba rnams kyis a nu dātta'o/ /yi ge gang gi nga ro dma' bas brjod par bya ba de ni a nu dātta'o/ /de dag par ma swa ri sputa'o/ /u dātta dang / a nu dātta de dag las/ bar ma'am bsdus pa dang ro mnyam pa ni swa ri 6 tar 'gyur ba nyid de/ de'i tshe 'dis mngon par brjod pa las mtho 120—1659

ba dang dma' ba'i nga ro ma gtogs pa'i nga ros yi ge gang mngon par brjod par byed pa de ni swa ri 1tar brjod do/ /rang gi gnas dang rjes su sna ldan dang rjes su sna ldan ma yin pa'o/ /rang gi ni bdag nyid kyi gnas dang / sna dang ldan pa'i gnas ni yi ge gang / /rang gi gnas kyi rjes su sna dang ldan pa dang /rjes su sna ldan ma yin nga/ ni sna'i gnas dang bral ba'o/ /mthar gnas ni rab tu dbye ba gnyis pa'o/ /rab tu dbye ba gnyis kyis rtogs pa/ ya ra la wa rnams so/ /ci ltar zhe na/ rjes su sna ldan dang bcas pa dang / rjes su sna ldan ma yin pa rnams kyang ste sngar smos pa bzhin no/ /phrag dog ser snas rig 2pa yi/ /rjes su legs par 'brang ba dag /yang dag lta ba'i dngos po yi/ /mtshan nyid mi ldan dor bar bya/ /gang phyir gzhan gyi don tshol ba'i/ /bla ma'i mkhyen pa las thob pa/ /mkhas pa bdag nyid kyis byas pa'i/ /dge ba blang bya nyid yin no/ /gang 'dir yi ge'i mdo ni 'grel byas pa'i/ /dge ba cung zad bsags/ pa de dag gis/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen por 'phyan gyur pa'i / /skye bo'i sbug bsngal spyor ba zhi gyur cig /lung ston pa tsand+ra pa'i yi ge'i mdo'i 'grel pa rdzogs so// //'di ni 'dzam bu'i gling mtha' dag snyan grags kyi gdugs dkar ngo/ dri ma med pa gcig gis khebs pa dngos grub mchog brnyes pa'i slob dpon chen bo tsand+ra go mi'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa ste/ sngon bod du ma 'gyur snang bas/gangs can gyi skye bo kun gyi mig gcig pu thams cad mkhyen pa zha lu lo tsā ba chen ngo/ dhadzre pā la bha dra'i bka' drin las rnam dpyod kyi skal ba'i cha shas thob pa skyogs ston lo tsā'i ming tsam 'chad pa ngag dbang rin chen bkra shis dpal 720/de1660

bzang pos 'dzin byed ces bya ba me pho byi ba'i rgyal can gyi nya la dpal gra thang gi gzims khang du bla ma dam pa nyid kyis bsgyur cig ces bka' sal pa bzhin dpang lo chen po'i phyag dpe rgya dpe las bsgyur cing ma rtogs pa dang log par rtogs pa thams cad rje lo tsā ba chen po'i gsung la gtugs nas dag par byas pa'o / /slar yang kha ra zhes bya ba lcags mo yos kyi dbo'i zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa la nyang po'i yul gyi ljongs phrag zur du gdong gi dpal kadzre pa'i chos kyi sde chen po 'jam dbyangs dgyes pa'i gtsug lag khang gi 'dabs su rgya dpe la gtugs te bsgyur ba po nyid kyis cung zad zhus shing gtan la phab pa'i yi ge pa ni sgra rig smra ba ā nanda badzra zhes bya ba'o/ /'dis kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa dang lus can dpag tu med pa la phan par gyur cig/ //bsdur mchan/165༷ 1mtshan byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉lhar brkod/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thabrel / na 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉༅/1651 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 pa / 〈〈snar 〉sngagazhon/ 〈〈pe 〉dku/chu ska na/ 〈〈snar 〉ma skan/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtsa/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉zo/sa/1652 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉rkes / 〈〈pe 〉〉 ni/ na〈〈snar 〉〉 gnas byed nga/ rtsol ba ni/ 4 5〈〈pe〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉7dang / 6〈〈snar 〉lke 'o 'es/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazhag 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉masas/ 9〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzung / ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉snga sam/ 1〈〈snar 〉ra cas/ 1 〈〈sna ra 〉〉7nga / 1 〈〈pe〉thamachu/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mtshota/1653 bye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༅sa te/ 2〈〈pe 〉ṭha/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉'a/ 4〈〈snar 〉phrosnaḥ/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉ta zhes/〈〈snar 〉〉ti ces/ 6〈〈snar 〉tha'o/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉khong / 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dṛ/ 9〈〈snar 〉rang /1 〈〈snar 〉〉ṇa'i/ 11〈〈pe 〉tha / 1na〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉〉dṛ/ 〈〈pe 〉tsū hūṃ dgag 〈〈snar 〉〉rte hūṃ dgag1654 nye〈〈pe 〉7na/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tham/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7yin/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sras/120/de1661

༄ / /sgob spyor rin chen 'byung gnas stag tshang lo tsha bas bsgyur ba balnga/gas so//lku༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ tstshanda ratna a 2 ka ra nā ma/ bod skad du/sdeb mispyor rin chen 'byung gnas zhes bya ba/ 'phags pa ngag gi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nang gi mtshan mo bshes jebral gyi/ /nang gi thub pa nyi ma ni / /snang ba mchog gi bdag nyid can/ /rgyal ba nyi ma la phyag 'tshal5 / /mdor bsdus tshigs bcad gsal ba dang / mdo yis dper brjod bkyis pa dang / /ma 'dres rim ldan 'don slad dang / /tshogs mthar sdod rnams yon tan yin/ /tshigs bcad gyerkang bzhi de la yang thu/ /dṛtta dzā ti zhes rnam gnyis / /yi ge bgrang ba bṛtta ste/ /phyi mo bgrang ba dzā ti yin/ /gsal byed rnams ni sum cu bdun/ /'dir ni dbyangs yig nyi shu gnyis/ /'di rnams yi ge lnga bcu dgu/ /dbyangs kyi yi ge bgrang bar bya/ /yang ba la yin drang po dbyangs/ /thung ngu'o legs byas nus bshad la/ /phyi ba ga yin 'khyog 120—1663

po ni/ /rkang pa'i mtha' rnams phal cher te/ /dbyangs dang bral ba'i gsal byed las/ /snga ma'ang shi na nus nas ci/ /ring bo dang ni plu ta 'ang / /gar bsgyur bud med lha yi lus/ /dbang po me nus rtse mo thob/ /gsum gye thog ma phyi ba bha/ /dbus lci dza yin mtha' phyi sa/ /thams cad lci ba ma zhes bya//thog ma yang ba ya yin te/ /dbus yang ra dang mtha' snga ta/ /thams cad yang ba na te brgyad/ /thog ma bar mtha' kun phyi ba/ /bha dang dza dang sa dang ma / /thog ma bar mtha' kun yang ba/ /ya dang ra dang ta dang ni1/ /bsnyu ba'i tshigs bcad do/ /drug pa nas brtsams re re 'phel/ /rkang pas sdeb spyor rnams rtogs byed/ /dbyengs sgog ram̐b dga' rjes barmyegs nadang / /bṛ je tī dang 'phrerjo ldan dang / /de bzhin gardzum bsngags zhes bya'o/ /dhri 'asgo rdzus shaṃn ṅgigs snrud dang / /bapyun 4'asdin rnams la so sor ni/ /re re'ang phyi mar shin tu'o/ /byed sdon dag pa'o rjob dang skun/ /rnom dang rlogs dang sgon tu dang / /rnyig pa rnams las phyi mo 5yang / /de ltar drug brgyad rta rnams so/ /mnyam dang phyed 6mnyam mi mnyam zhes bya ba/ /bṛtta rnam pa gsum du rab bshad bya/ /de ni dbus phra sogs dang nye bkra sogs/ /kha sgo la sogs rnams dang go rims bzhin/ /'dod pa rnams kyi gnas pa sdod / /'gram pa'i rdul sel mig mdzes ma/ /rna ba'i utpal nyams byed dang / /yon tan zung byas gtsug na bzlas/ /zhabs sen zer la rab tu 'dud / /tshogs chen stug por gyur pa la/ /gang gi rgyal mtshan tog dag gi/ /grags pa 'phro ba 'di nyid ni/ /sa skyong nyid du rnam par bshad/ /rkang pa 720/de166 1

rnams kyi mtha' la'o/ /bha sogs uta la de ldan no/ /rkang pa so so rnams la ni / /lco ba ba yin yang ba ka /gal te ta ya dbus phra ba'o/ /gzhon nu rol pa dza sa ga 1 /lci 1yang bzhi pa de 'dra mtshungs/ 2 /la ga bzhi pa de gzhal dpag 3 /gal te/ bha ga gnyis rkang bkra/ 4 /gal te ma gzung klog prephreng / 5 /bha las ta dang la dang ni/ /ga rnams yod pa bram ze'i bye/ 1/gal te ra las na rdong ni/ /sa dag yod pa rgoshol gdong ngo / 2 /na gnyis dang ni ma yod pa/ /lag 'gro khye'u'i bu yin no/ 1 /ma dang sa dang dza dang ga /ldag pa'i snang bar shes par bya/2 /ma dang na dang ya rnams las/ /lci ba nges par 'khar 2rjor bshad/ 3 /ra dang dza dang ra rnams ni/ /ga rnams rjo bya'i 'gros yin no/ 4 /gang la bha dang ma dang sa/ /gang yod de ni gserjo ldan no/ 5 /ma dang bha dang sa dang gas/ /bskyed ma myos rmir shes par bya/ 1 /ta las dza gnyis ga dang ga /zhes pa 'di ni nyerjo 'khod 'gyur/ 2/gal te ta gnyis dza dang ni/ /lci gnyis dbang po'i rdo rjo'o/ 3 /dza dang ta dang dza dang ni/ /lci gnyis nye dbang rdo rje'o/ /de ma thag tu brjod zin mtshan nyid dag /sna tshogs rtog pas rkang pa rnams su 'gyur / /de gnyis mnyan 'os ngal bso'i spros ldan gang / /de rnams dran pa'i dadṛng pos nyer bskyed bshad/ 5 /bha gsum las ni ga gnyis pa/ /de ni 'dod kau 'jo ba'o/6/ma dang ba dang ra gnyis pa/ /rig byed 'jig rten shā li dī/ 7 /gal te 120—1665

ma dang ba dang sa/ /ra dang ba ni chu rlabs 1'phreng / 8 /ma dang ba dang na dag dang / /ba ni rdzung ba rol pa'o/9 /ra las pha rol na dang ni/ /ra la ga rnams shing1 rta dregs/ 10 /ra dang na dang bha dang ga /rnams dang lci bar 2 legs 'orjos so/11 /na dang na dang sa dang ga /ga zhes bya ba dhrim napor 'gyur / 12/na dang na dang ra dang la/ /ga zhes bya ba bzang pyun nyid/13 /ra dang dza dang ra dang ni/ /la dang lci ba dkar morjo brjod/ 14 /dza dang sa dang ta dang ni/ ga ga rnams ni nyer garnos 'gyur/ 1 /ra dang na dang bha dang sas/ /rgyu zhing 'khor ba zlo ba'i lam/ 2 /dza dang ta dang dza dang ra / /'di ni rigs 4gapyas nyid du 'dod/ 3 /gang la ta 5gnyis dza dang ra/ /nges nga/ra dadṛng po'i rgyud tu 'gyur/ 4 /na gnyis ga dang ba ra ba/ /nor dang rig byed 'dir spyorjo ba'o/ 5 /dza su dza su dus zung ba/ /chu 'thor 6'gro rjo nyid yin no/ 6 /sa yig chu gter byas pa ni/ /de nas 'gro dṛr byed pa'o / 7 /na dang bha dang bha dang ni/ /ra rnams ldal myur yin par smra/ 8 /ya yig bzhi pa rnams kyis ni/ /lag 'gro pyung ba nyid yin no/ 9 /ra yig bzhi pa de nyid ni/ /me tog phreng rdzun ces grags so/ 10 /sa dang dza dang sa dang sa / /rnams kyis yi ge snyung ngur grags/ 11 /ma dang ga ba ra dag pa/ /mda' rtas sna tshogs snya mo'o/ 12 /ma ba na ya ga ba ste/ /yan lag mtsho yi rdzu 'dzin 120/de/666

phreng 1/ 13 /na na ra ra 'dus pa ni/ /dal gyis na'abeeb pa nyid yin no / 14 /na dang dza dang dza dang ra/ /ya mu na ru snrub pa smra/ 15 /gal te 'dir ni na dang dza/ /bha ya 'phrerjo ba gsar pa'o/ 1 /mu dang na dang dza ra ba//gsum dang phyogs kyi ldib dga' can/ 2 /dza ba na dza ra zhes bya/ /bzhi dang gza' yis ldaga' mdzes yin/ 3 /ma ba bha ta ya rnams te/ /de nyid ngal bso dṛ bya myos/ 4 /sa dang dza dang sa dang sa/ /ga ni snyan pa'i rjong par bshad / 5 /gal te sa dang dza dang sa/ /dza dang ga rnams 'arjom pa'i ngag 2 /ma ga ba dang na gnyis ma/ /lnga dang dgu yis gnod medi yin/ 2 /na na ba dang dza dza ba/ /dbyangs rnams garkin gyis mi thub po/ 3 /na na ba dang na na ba / /de rnams rmitshon cha kha 'bus yin/ 4 /ta bha dza dza ga ga dag /dpyid kyi thirgi ler shes par bya/ 5 /sa la wa 4na gzhan ra dag /lnga dang garjo' yis 5nor 'dzin yin/ 1 /yang ba ma nu'i mthar phyi ba/ /'dir ni ri bong sngun gyi cha / 2 /'di nyid ro dang dgus ngal bsor/ /gyur pa gshaṃn ni 'phreng ba'o / 3 /de bzhin nor dang thub pa yis/ /ngal bso yon tan noldi bu'i tshogs / 4 /na na ga pa ra ra bas/ /brgyad dang 'jig rten gyis 'phreX ldan / 5 /na dza bha dza ra rnams ni/ /rnam par spel 'di rgya rmitsho can/ 1 /bha 120—1667

ra ka na na sa las/ /thub bug khyu mchog ṅging chen rtsen/ 2 /gal te na dza bha dza ra / /phyi de de tsho le baṅgin rtsi/ 1 /ya mu na sa bhā 1la ba/ /ro drag ngal gso gadṛg phud can/ 2 /dza sa la ba na ra ra/ /nor dang bzang snod dring ldan no / 3 /bha ra na ba na na ga /phyogs thub 'od ma'i 'ardob lhung ba/ 4 /na su ma ba dza dza ba/ /ro chu dbyangs la ri dwargis mo/ 5 /ma ba na su ra ra ba/ /tshong dus 'dzin de sdol gyis gnon/ 6 /gal te na dza bha dza dza/ /yang lci de tshe dṛm pa can/ 2 /na dza ba na bhu bha ba/ /thub ro chu gter rdzu byug go/ 1 /ma phyi ba na su ra gnyis/ /ba rnams dbang dus 'jig rten gyes/ /me tog pyayo ba'i khri shing yin/ 2 /'dir ni na dang na dang ra/ /bzhi sgrigs lcags kyi malda' ru bshad / 1 /ya mu na dang su ra dag /ba rnams drug dus mgyogs 'gro yis//sprin rnams sgog cerdzu bya bar 'gyur/ 2 /gal te ma dang sa dza su/ /ta ta ba rnams nyi ma dang / /rta rnams kyis ni rnyig rnam rtsen/ 1 /gal te ma ra ba na dang / /na ba ta su rnams la ni/ /bdun ta ros phyi shaṃ mdzes yin/ 2 /ra dza ra dza ra dza dang / /phyi dang yang ba 'di lta bu/ /zlum po zhes ni rdzu bar 'dod / 1 /ma ra ba dang na na ba/ /ra ra ba rnams bdun gsum gyi/ /sdod pa phreng sde'adzin zhes byar 'ardzur/ 1 /gang la bha ra na ba dza/ /sa dza sa phyogs nyi mar ni/ /ngal gso 'di ni pyob mo'i dbyangs/ 1 /na dza bha la ba dza dang / /120/de1668

sa dang dza su'ang 'phrog byed dang / /nyi mar tha sdad rta rol pa/ 2 /'gal te ma ma ga ba na/ /la ka na na na ba rnams/ /nor dbang phyogs kyis 1myormo ma rtsen / /bha lci ba ba na na ba/ /bha zung na yu rnams la mda'/ /dbyangs gnyis ngal gso snrus phrar kye'agyur/ 1 /bha ga ba dang bha ga ba/ /na zung la ka na na ba/ /mda' mda' nor dang thub par ni/ /sdod pa khrung snrung rkang yin no / 1 /ma zung ga ba na zung dang / /la ka su dang dza zung dang / /ba rnams nor lha myos sred dang / /thub pas chig 'gro rnam bsgyings so/ /ma na nu dang na nu gnyis/ /sa ga ba zhes bya rnams la/ /dgu dang ro ro byed par ni/ /ngal bso bzlog phyogs 'drib par 'gyur/ 1 /'di ru rgyun chags dang po ni/ /7na gnyis de nas ra bdun byi/ /gtum pa'i char 'beebs su 'gyur ro/ /rkang pa so sor ra 'phel rnams/ /'dir ni chu rgyun rgya oṃrtse sbrulam̐/ /rdzur sprin rol pa'i 'apyung gnas dang / /shirno tu klu —snabus ding byeng sogs so/ /'dir ni ra yis ji lta bar/ /ya yis rgyun chags rab bsags te/ /na zung dag las ya rnams kyis/ /gtum pa'i ༵ra 'bebs sogs ji bzhin/ /mnyam pa'i brirte 4 rnams so/ 1 /zung min sa gsum la ga dang / /gal te zung la bha gsum las/ /ga zung can ni phywa bkrar smra/ 2 /bha gsum can las ga dag ste/ /sbar ni na dza dza ya rnams/ /gal te ldan gyur j-ir ba'i dbus/ 3 /sa gsum can la lci ba 720/de1669

dang / /bha gsum can la ga dag ni/ /gal te ldan na pyugs ldan ma/ 4 /zung min ta dza ra lci ba/ /zung las ma sa dza phyi ba/ /gang la ldan de brjong po'i snod/ 5 /mi mnyam pa dza sa lci ba/ /mnyam la bha ra na phyi ba/ /gal te ḍa na torgo ldan ma/ 6 /zung min te zung dza lci ba/ /zung la dza ta dza ga phyi/ /gal te ldan na skun bsgrags 1so/ 7 /'dir yang dza ta dza ga ga /ta zung dza ga phyi de ni/ /bzlog napa'i skun bsgrags snga ma can/ 8 /sa gsum can las la dang ga /na bha bha ra rnams kyang ni/ /gal te de tshe ri kaugs 'phyong / 7 /gal te na na ra la ga /gal te na dza dza ra ni/ /de yi tshe na gshaṃn sgor 'dod / 10 /zung min na zung ra ya dang / /zung la na dza dza ra ga /me tog rgyas nga/'i rtse morjo brjod/ 12 /ra dza ra dza de bzhin du/ /dza ra dza ra ga rnams las / /ya ba'i 4sgra las ma tūs 5yin/ /bud med mtshungs brjod rnos ldan ma / 12 /mi mnyam bcu dang bcu nor yang / /cig shos bcu dang bcu bcu 7 yang / /tha ma gnyis ka lcir byas pa/ /rol rkang rnam spro rgitsug phud can/ 13 /mnyam dang mi mnyam rkang pa yis/ /yongs brjod nges gnas nges bral byas/ /'dab mar bkod pa'i nges 'di ni/ /rkang 'khyog 'gros ldan 'jeng —po dang / /mtshungs 'drar gyur pa 'jeng por baṃrjod(/ /phyed mnyam pa'i bṛtta rnams so/ 1 /rkang pa yig brgyad dang po las/ /sa dang na min mtsho las ni/ /ya ru gyur pa pya 120—1670

sgo'o / 2 /rkang pa zung dag dza yig gis/ /kha sgo kaun pa zhes par grags/ 3 /dza yis zung min brjod 'di ni/ /zlog pa dang po rdzun 1gyi de'o/ 4 /na yig spyor las kha sgo de/ /gya gyu can du shes par bya/ /zung la bdun pa yang gyur pa//de ni thub pas skrongs mar 'dod/ 5 /thams cad nas de de nyid de'i/ /mtsho las bha yis de'i skrongs ma/ 2 /ra yis sda bzhin de las gzhan/ 8 /na yig gis kyang de bzhirno 2yang / 7 /ta yig gis skung de lta nyid/ 10 /ma yig gis kyang de kaur lta/ 11 /de las gshaṃn pa'i bla bre yin/ /rkang pa kun la thog ma las / /sa dang na min rkang zung gi/ /mtsho las dza dang zung min la/ /phal cher ji ltar mdzes spyor lta/ /kha sgo'i bye brag rnams so/ 1 /rkang pa dang po yig brgyad yin/ /'di las phyi mar rim bzhin du/ /bzhi dang mngon 'phel de dang de/ /sna tshogs rnam bkod yang dag mdzes/ /rkang pa rkang par rol sgeg ldan/ /rkang bzhi 'phel du marnyis rnams smra/ 2 /'dir lda rkang bzhi 'phel de la/ /kun yang rkang mthar ga dang ga /rol sgeg 4bcas phan ngal gso'i 'gros/ /'jig rten dga' bskyed slo ldan pa'i/ /rpā ṭar gyur de kun ṅgis bcer5/ 3 /'dir ni yang dag lhung ba yi/ /rkang pa rnams lam 6dang po ni/ /nye las pha rol gnas byas kyang / /de nas dbus su gnas gyur la/ /cig 7shos gsum rnams g.yo med par/ /des rgonas me tog kha ma bye/ 4 /yang dag shin tu 'dir lhung ba'i/ /rkang pa dang por grags pa de/ /nye ba'i 720—1671

rkang pa zung 'das la/ /cig 1shos rkang pa gsum rnams ni/ /g.yo med nges gnas yud tsam rol/ 5 /'dir ni rkang pa dang po yis/ /cig 2shos g.yo med gsum 'das par/ /lhung 'gyur —rnam mang rol sgeg sdod/ /mngon dga' bskyed 'di bdud rtsi'i rnyin/ /rkang bzhi 'phel gyi bye brag rnams so/ 1 /snga ma sa dza sa dang la/ /na sa dza lci de ma thag /de nas bha na dza la ga /de nas sa dza sa dang dza/ /lci 'gyur 'di ni sterngo 'gro nyid/ 2 /gsum ni steng 'gro de 'drar 'gyur/ /gsum pa gzhan du shes bya ste/ /ra na bha dang phyi bsgrigs ④pa//de 'dra dri zhim zlon du brjod/ 3 /gsum par na zung sa dag 'gyur/ /rkang pa zhes bya gzhan gsum la/ /rab spros tshig bkod rol sgeg ldan/ /rol par snyan rngog mkhan rnams bzhed/ /steng 'gro'i bye phrag rnams so/ 1 /dang po ma sa dza bha phyi/ /de nas sa na dza ra ga /pha rol na gnyis dang ni sa/ /de nas na gsum dza ya 'di/ /nye bar gnas pa'i rjol 'gror brjod/ 2 /rkang pa gsum par na zung dang / /sa dang na zung sa yin la/ /gzhan kun dal 'gro dang 'dra bar/ /rkang par gnas pa'i mtshan nyid kyisnye/ /bsgrub pa so sor 60nges de ni/ /snyan dngags mkhan gyis 'phel ldan brjod/ /gang tshe gsum par ta dza ra/ /'di yi dang po ngal gso te/ /gzhan gsum dal 'gro dag dang tshogs/ /mtshungs gyur dag pa snang ldan gyis/ /khyad par rjob mchog ldan du brjod/ /mi mnyam pa'i dṛtta rnams so/ /6dṛtta'i rnam par 4brtag pa bshad zin te/ /phyi nas dzā ti mngon brjod 720—1672

bya / /yang ba phyi mo gcig yin te/ /lci gnyis gsal byed dag gis min/ /bha dza sa dang lci ba zung / /yang ba bzhi tshogs de lnga po/ /phyi mo bzhi pa'o tsa yin la/ /yang ba bzhi po kha yang yin/ /phyi mo gcig gnyis ka dang nga / /'dab ma 'dab mar tshogs brgyad sa/ /mi mnyam rnams la dza spangs shing / /phyi mo sti/phyed la drug pa ka /gnyis ka'i brgyad pa nga yin la/ /lhag ma tsa rnams 'ashāgs mar 'gyur/ 31 /phyed spang snyedrug pa dza'am kha/ /kha la sngon du yang ba'i sdod/ /pha rol kha la drug pa'i mthar/ /'dab ma phyi mar bzhi pa 'ang /zung min rkang pa tsa gsum kyis/ /rdzogs pa de tshe zlophrod par 'gyur/ 2 /zung min gcig kyang rdzogs min pa/ /de rnams kyi tshe yashās ma yin/ 3 /gal te gnyis pa bzhi pa'i tshogs/ /phyi gnyis dbus bzhugs dza dag bshad/ /phyed pa gnyis la gyur de tshe/ /kun nas g.yo sgor gyur pa yin/ 1 /gal te snga phyed 'ba' zhig nyid/ /g.yo ba yis ni mtshan nyid gyur/ /slar yang phyi phyed la gyur min/ /de tshe de sgo g.yo drir 'gyur/ 5 /gang la bstan pa'i g.yo mtshan nyid / /snga ma phyed la spangs nas kyang / /phyi mar gcig pur bstan nas bzhugs / /de ni lus brnyin g.yo ba'o/ 1 /gang du 'dab ma gnyis ka yang //drug tshogs dza 'am kha yig gyur/ /phyed snga bzhin dang lhag ma yang / /so sor nges gyur de dbyings 'gyur/ 1 /gang gi 'dab ma gnyis ka'i yang / /drug pa'i tshogs ni ka nyid gyur/ /phyed phyi bzhin dang lhag nges pa/ /de ni nye ba'i dpyongs su smra/ 2 /gang du snga phyed drug gyur ka /phyi phyed la ni dza 'am kha/ /120—1673

lhag nges 'dab ma log pa las/ /gyur pa de ni mchog dadhrings yin/ 3 /'dab ma 'dab mar brgyad rnams tsa/ /drug pa'i tshogs ni dza 'am kha/ /phyed snga bzhin dang lhag so sor/ /des de 'phags ma'i dbyangs rnyi 'gyur/ /'phags ma'i dzwa ti rnams so/ /zung min dang po da gsum pa/ /zung la da bzhi phyi ma la/ /ra la ga ste yang ba drug /bar ma chad du ma yin pa/ /de ni 60ro langs can du brjod/ 12 /dang bo ro langs can lta bu/ /phyi ma ra ya nye sdeb spyor/ /dang po ro langs can mtshungs 'dir/ /bha ga ga mtha' kun nas srab / /zung thog da las phyis dza dang / /lhag ma sngon 'dra rab 'phel yin / /zung nyamin dang po dza da ri —padag /lhag ma sngon 'dra phyi 'phel yin/ /zung min cha ni phyi 'phel gyi/ /zung cha rab 'phel kun 'phel lo/ /kun 'phel zung ni gzhan mtha' can/ /zung min rkang pas mdzes rgod ma/ /ro langs can gyi dzā ti rnams so/ /rkang ri pa rkang par chu gter tsa/ /phyi med mi g.yo brtan pa'o/ /'dab las yang zhing mtha' lci ba/ /phyi mo mnyam pa nyid yin no/ /tsa gnyis las bha nyer bkra yin/ /tsa las kha 'am dza nyid ni/ /khyad par tshigs bcad nyid yin no/ /phyed las kha 'am dza nyid ni/ /nags khrod gnas pa nyid yin no / /gal te tsa zhes bya ba las/ /sa gnyis pa de bkra ba'o/ /bshad ma thag pa'i mtshan nyid rten/ /phyi mo mnyam sogs rkang pa dkrugs/ /bṛtta'i tshad rnams rtogs gred pa/ /rkang dkrugs su ni thub pas brjod/ /gang gi phyed la brgyad brgyad pa/ /phyi ma gzhan kun yang ba ni/ /chu gter nor bsgyur rkang pa sgo/ /de ni lus med rtsen du brjod/ /'dab rer bcu bcu 120—1674

bcu yang ba/ /bkod mthar phyi byas gsal mdzes ma/ /dza med rang gi thog min par/ /bha bral tsa da ka da ka /tsa ①gsum dza ga zhes dum bu/ /phyi mo mnyam pa'i dṛtta rnams so/ /dzā ti rnams bshad zin to// //dṛtta'i dang por thams cad lci/ /lci gasgo'i 'og yang phyi rnams 'dra/ /snga mar phyi 'di prastu khya ra/ /ji srid thams cad yang de srid/ /sdeb rngusbyor so sor nyis rgya'agyur gyi/ /phreng ring steng lci 'og yang ba/ /nyis 'gyur lci yang tshogs rnams kyis/ /re rer rim spel prastu ra/ /'di 'dra 'di lta ci zhes pas//de bkod 'bras las 'da' ma bya/ /gcig bcas mi mnyam 'dab ma phyi/ /'dir mnyam yang 'bras naṣṭa'o/ /steng du gcig sogs rim pas ni/ /nyis 'gyur bris te yang ba'i steng / /bsdoms thupas gcig dang bcas 'di lta/ /nyid yin ces pa ud diṣṭa/ /gzugs bkod yi ge'i grangs kyis babeengs/ /mnyam pa steng du bcug pa yis/ /langs pa rim pas thung ngu ste/ /bṛtta yang med gcig yang sogs/ /dang por gzugs ni ma byas kyang / /steng bzhugs gang bri de nas 'og /gnas pa'i rang rang 'og mnyam bsre/ /dṛtta yang meed gcig yang sogs/ /bṛtta rnams kyi grangs kyi gzugs/ /zung gi sneyi ge'i grangs su bsgyur/ /ud diṣṭa'i am ka'i mtha'/ /gnyis 'gyur yang ba'i bya ba bsdu/ /grangs nyid yi ges bsgyur de nas/ /de phyed de nas gnyi ga'ang sdom//dang por yi ge dbus lci yang / /de nas phyi ma rnams yin no/ /yi ge bṛtta gnyis kyis bsgyur/ /gcig dman a dhwa 'phred dang 'og /phyi yang rnams kyi sa dang ni/ /de la bar yang mtshungs pa'o/ /mnyam pa'i bṛtta rnams kyi prastu ra/mtha' dag la rtogs byed drug po rnams bshad zin to // //kye7120—1675

thratta'am dzā ti 1re re la/ /phyi yang yi ge phyi mo rnams/ /grangs ni shes pa brjod bya ste/ /dper brjod tshigs byebacad 'di gnyis so/ /gang zhig mchog dang gang zhig dam pa'i don/ /ma lus don dam las 'bras rtogs gyur cing / /skye bo gang yang der ni bskyed mdzad pa/ /sangs rgyas chos tshogs de rnams rgyal gyur byug rgyal chos nang las rgyal ba rgyal gyur cig /de yi lhan cig spyod ma shes rab kyang / /gnyis las lhag mos sa bon las byung ba/ /lus can 'phags pa'i tshogs kyang rgyal gyur cig /yang ba rnams kyi yi ge dor//phyi mo'i yang ba dor mnga' ma/ /yi ge dor ba'i phyi mo yang / /de rnams ji sted 'dir lci ba/ /phyi ba'i grags so/ /lci ba gnyis 'gyur gyi phyi mo/ /yi ge gnyis 'gyur phyi mos spangs/ /lce ba bral ba'i yi ge rnams/ /ji snyed de rnams 'dir yang ba/ /yang ba'i grangs so/ / ci yang bsdoms pa lkuji snyed de//phyi mo 4phyi bral ji snyed do/ /ji snyed phyi mo yang bsdoms 5'dab/ /de snyed 'dir ni yi ge rnams/ /yi ge'i grangs so/ /lci ba nyis 'u'agyur yang ba bsre④//yi ge nyis ṣpe'agyur yang rnams dor/ /phyi ba bsres pa'i yi ge rnams/ /ji snyed de rnams 'dir phyi mo/ /phyi mo'i grangs so/ /rgyal ba'i rig pa kye'adi la bdag dad pa'i/ /bsod nams gang zhig bdag la rab skyes pa/ /de yis 'gro rnams dam pa'i lam dang ni/ /rig pa mchog la rab tu dad gyur cig / /⑫rtsod pa'i dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa rin chen 'byung gnas zhi ba'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i sdeb 1spyor rin chen 'byung gnas zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //'di rang 'grel dang bcas pa la chos ldan ras pa dang / yar lung pa grags pa rgyal mtshan dang / lo chen byang rtse ba rnams kyis sum rim du bsgyur 120—1676
